Building your application

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Building your application. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Building your application — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: [stream] fix, Prerendered pages, [cache] fix, [block] fix. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: production ke liye next build compiles, prerenders yogy routes, aur ek route table print karta hai jismein dikhaya gaya hai ki pratyek route kaise serve ki jati hai.

Kya next build karta hai (6 steps): (1) Setup — bhar env vars (.env filein), valid next.config banata hai, ek build ID generated karta hai; (2) Route khoj - app/ + pages/ skain karta hai, root kanveinshan files (proxy, instrumentation) ka pata lagata hai, TypeScript route paribhasha generated karta hai; (3) Compilation — client/server/edge code ko Turbopack (ya webpack) ke saath bundle karta hai, TS/JSX, per-shek ka optimization karta hai. (4) Static vishleshan - previous banam on-demand ke liye pratyek route ko vargeekrit karta hai, generateStaticParams output ko ikattha karta hai; previous blocked errors ke liye Cache Components chekon ke saath; (5) Prendering - Prerenders static pages + PPR shels ko HTML tak, client navigation ke liye RSC payload generated karta hai; (6) Output - .next/ likhte hain; output: 'standalone' bundle keval runtime-need files; output: 'export' ek full static site generated karta hai; print root tebala. build ki check TypeScript jab tak typescript.ignoreBuildErrors set kiya gaya hai. next dev mein dev server state + vriddhishil compilation cache store karta hai; deleting/moving .next ise tyaag data hai. ek prithak production build ke liye, ek alag distDir ko configure karein. .next/dev CSS/fonts

nirmaan output padhna - route pratik:

Without Cache Components: ○ static (sabhi route HTML ke roop mein render kiya gaya); ● SSG (generateStaticParams/getStaticProps prerender se path); ƒ dynamic (maarch par render).

With Cache Components (PPR) App Router pages ke liye ekmatr modal hai; symbols ka varnan hai ki kitni HTML ka production kiya gaya tha): ○ static (nishchit route); ◐ Partial Prerender (static HTML shell + mang par shesh content); ƒ dynamic (demand par prastutakarta - build ne empty HTML Prerender ko accept kiya; ek dynamic route mein generateStaticParams dwara wapas nahi kiye gaye pathnames ke liye ek fallback bhi shamil ho sakti hai.

any entries: request-nirbhar Route Handlers, Proxy, dynamic metadata routes (icon, opengraph-image, twitter-image) ka upyog ƒ - mang par rendering, koi PPR nahi.

Prender vaidhta: With Cache Components, next build pratyek App Router page ko valid karta hai, ek static shell ka production kar sakta hai. request samay maan (params, cookies(), headers()) bahar <Suspense> → runtime data error; uncached data → uncached data error; pratyek error uske fix ke liye link karti hai.

Debug prerender errors: production ka build server code + omit server source map ko chhota karta hai. next build --debug-prerender server minification ko inactive karta hai, server source map ko enable karta hai, aur baki ko rokne ke liye ek asaphal route ko rokta hai. Warning: kabhi --debug-prerender build (debugging vikalp, production optimized nahi) deploy nahi hai. Build vishisht routes: --debug-build-paths comma-separated paths/globs (! prefix) ko accept karta hai; --debug-prerender ke saath gathabandhana. keval match route route talika mein dikhai dete hain; ek App Router route ka chayan karne mein bilt-in /_not-found bhi shamil hai.

Worked udaharan - product page /products/[id] E (id param parhein, product prapt karein): next build Route "/products/[id]": Next.js encountered uncached or runtime data during prerendering + teen fix ke saath fail rahta hai: [stream] <Suspense fallback>; [cache] "use cache" ( ke liye nahi); [block] export const instant = false. keval body/html ko hi stack karein - pahle blocked access (const { id } = await props.params, line 2) ko point karne ke liye next build --debug-prerender --debug-build-paths="app/products/[id]/page.tsx" ka upyog karein. dev mein, next dev source-restore stack ke saath overlay + tarminal mein sabhi manyata errors ko darshata hai, jaisa ki aap edit karte hain. connection()

  • [stream] fix: app/products/[id]/loading.tsx (<div>Loading...</div>) jodo — page <Suspense> me wrap hota hai; fallback static shell ke roop me prerender hota hai; route table ○ /, ○ /_not-found, ◐ /products/[id] dikhati hai. Zyada granular: <Suspense> ko explicitly sirf us component ke around rakho jise request-time data chahiye.
  • [cache] fix se pehle — Prerendered pages: loading.js rakho, generateStaticParams known IDs return karta hai → route table ek group row dikhati hai /products/[id] Fallback ◐ /products/[id] + ◐ /products/1, ◐ /products/2, ◐ /products/3 ke saath (content shell me stream hota hai). Note: Cache Components ke saath, generateStaticParams ko kam se kam ek param return karna hoga — ek empty array ek build error hai.
  • [cache] fix: getProduct(id) me 'use cache' jodo → listed params ○ (full HTML) prerender ho jate hain; fallback row ◐ (unknown IDs) rehti hai. Ek unlisted product ki pehli visit: Partial Prefetching turant loading.js fallback serve karta hai jabki Next.js page ko render + ISR-cache karta hai; baad ki visits poora page paati hain. Jab kai paths maujood hon, to table [+N more paths] par end hone wali ek chhoti list print karti hai. Cached functions/components wale routes Revalidate aur Expire columns dikha sakte hain (route ke saare caches me sabse chhota); default profile 15m ke baad revalidate hoti hai; default expireTime 1y hai — next.config.ts me configure karo.
  • [block] fix: export const instant = false + loading.js hatao + 'use cache' hatao → route table har jagah ƒ dikhati hai (empty prerenders; request par render; client navigation ke dauraan current page tab tak dikhta hai jab tak product/not-found UI ready na ho). instant = false instant-navigation validation disable karta hai. Ek non-empty static shell ke liye check karo, jabki route abhi bhi prerender ho sakta hai. Agar ek shared layout {children} ko <Suspense> me wrap karta hai, to Next.js uski fallback ko static shell ke roop me rakhta hai aur ◐ use karta hai. Async values (Math.random(), new Date(), crypto.randomUUID()) abhi bhi prerender errors produce karte hain.

Dhyaan Do: --debug-prerender builds ko deploy nahi kiya jana chahiye; khali generateStaticParams array = build error; Cache Components ke saath ƒ ka matalab khali HTML prerender accept kiya jata hai; next dev kabhi cache page nahi (always on-demand) to dev behavior prod se alag hai.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
chhah build steps; Cache Components banam ke saath route symbols (○ / ● / UM banam ○ / UM); teen previous aatankavaadee fix (stream/cache/block) aur jab pratyek lagu hota hai; --debug-prerender + --debug-build-paths debugging varkaflo; Revalidate/Expire stanbhon ka arth hai.

Caching and Revalidating (Previous Model)

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Caching and Revalidating (Previous Model). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Caching and Revalidating (Previous Model) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Note: ye model sirf tab lagu hota hai jab tum Cache Components (cacheComponents flag, v16) use nahi kar rahe ho. Current model Getting Started → Caching/Revalidating me hai.

Key concepts — fetch ko cache karna: by default fetch requests cached nahi hotin. Individual requests ko { cache: 'force-cache' } se cache karo.

Non-fetch functions ke liye unstable_cache: DB queries/dusre async functions ko wrap karo:

%
ts
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
export const getCachedUser = unstable_cache(
  async (id: string) => db.select().from(users).where(eq(users.id, id)).then((res) => res[0]),
  ['user'], // cache key prefix
  { tags: ['user'], revalidate: 3600 }
)
%

Teesra argument: tags (revalidateTag se on-demand revalidation), revalidate (seconds).

Route segment config — dynamic: Page/Layout/Route Handler se export karo: export const dynamic = 'auto' | 'force-dynamic' | 'error' | 'force-static'.

  • 'auto' (default): components ko dynamic me opt-in karne se roke bina jitna ho sake cache karo.
  • 'force-dynamic': har request par dynamic rendering (≡ har fetch { cache: 'no-store', next: { revalidate: 0 } } ≡ fetchCache = 'force-no-store').
  • 'error': prerendering force karo; koi component request-time APIs ya uncached data use kare to error (≡ getStaticProps(); ≡ har fetch { cache: 'force-cache' }; ≡ fetchCache = 'only-cache').
  • 'force-static': cookies(), headers(), useSearchParams() ko empty values return karne par majboor karke prerendering + cache force karo; revalidate/revalidatePath/revalidateTag phir bhi mumkin hai.

fetchCache (advanced, kisi layout/page ki saari fetches ke default cache ko override karta hai): 'auto' (default: request-time APIs se pehle wali fetches ko unke diye option se cache karo; baad wali ko cache mat karo); 'default-cache' (koi option na ho to 'force-cache', request-time APIs ke baad bhi); 'only-cache' (default 'force-cache'; cache: 'no-store' par error); 'force-cache' (saari fetches 'force-cache'); 'default-no-store' (koi option na ho to 'no-store'); 'only-no-store' (default 'no-store'; 'force-cache' par error); 'force-no-store' (saari 'no-store', explicit 'force-cache' ko bhi override karke). Cross-route rules: ek route ke layouts/pages ke options compatible hone chahiye — 'force-cache' 'only-cache' par jeet-ta hai; 'force-no-store' 'only-no-store' par jeet-ta hai; ek route me 'only-cache' + 'only-no-store' allowed nahi; 'force-cache' + 'force-no-store' allowed nahi; agar child 'auto' ya '*-cache' deta hai to parent 'default-no-store' nahi de sakta. Salah: shared parent layouts ko 'auto' rakho, jahan child segments alag hon wahan customize karo. Bina cache option wali fetch next build ke dauran ek baar fetch hoti hai agar wo kisi request-time API se pehle reachable ho (route us point tak prerender hoti hai); request-time API ke baad wali fetches har request par chalti hain.

Time-based revalidation: fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } }); unstable_cache ka revalidate option. Route segment config revalidate: false (default — heuristic: 'force-cache' wali ya kisi request-time API se pehle discover hui fetches ko cache karo; semantically Infinity, anishchit kaal tak cached; individual fetches phir bhi 'no-store'/revalidate: 0 se dynamic ho sakti hain, ya kam positive number se zyada bar revalidate ho sakti hain); 0 (hamesha dynamic, bina request-time APIs/uncached fetches ke bhi; option-less fetches ka default 'no-store' ban jata hai, lekin explicit 'force-cache'/positive revalidate wali fetches jaisi hain waisi rehti hain); number (seconds — default revalidation frequency). Ye individual fetch revalidate ko override nahi karta. Statically analyzable hona chahiye (revalidate = 600 OK, 60 * 10 nahi). Deprecated runtime = 'edge' ke saath available nahi. Dev me pages hamesha on-demand render hoti hain, kabhi cached nahi. Frequency: ek route ke layouts/pages me sabse kam revalidate poore route ki frequency tay karta hai; individual fetches kam revalidate set karke use badha sakti hain.

On-demand revalidation: Server Action ya Route Handler me revalidateTag / revalidatePath. Fetches ko next: { tags: ['user'] } se tag karo (ya unstable_cache ke tags). revalidateTag('user', 'max'), revalidatePath('/profile').

Requests ko deduplicate karna: non-fetch access (ORM/DB) ke liye React cache() me wrap karo taaki ek hi render pass me dedupe ho.

Preloading: server-only + React cache preload utility: export const preload = (id) => { void getItem(id) }; blocking kaam se pehle preload(id) call karo.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • revalidate ek literal hona chahiye.
  • force-static cookies()/headers()/useSearchParams() ko chupchap empty kar deta hai.
  • Ek route me only-* ke combinations illegal hain.
  • Dev kabhi cache nahi karta.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
previous banam current caching model (fetch options + segment configs banam 'use cache' + cacheLife); dynamic/fetchCache/revalidate config ki tikdi; force-static request APIs ko empty kyun kar deta hai; tag-based invalidation ka flow.

Hissa 29 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Using a CDN with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Using a CDN with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Using a CDN with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Static pages, ISR pages, Dynamic pages, Safely ignorable, Must preserve. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js manak Cache-Control header CDN set karta hai jiska upyog kinaare par kiya jaa sakta hai. aaj kya kaam karta hai, jahan yeh challenging hai, aur pathname aadharit cache keering ki disha mein disha.

Kya aaj kaam karta hai - Cache-Control header rendering ranniti dwara:

  • Static page (no revalidation): s-maxage=31536000 (one year).
  • ISR pages: s-maxage={revalidate}, stale-while-revalidate={expire - revalidate} (default expire ek varsh hai, isliye SWR default roop se shamil kiya gaya hai; cacheLife ke madhyam se optimization).
  • Dynamic page: private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate.

s-maxage + stale-while-revalidate ka samman karne wale CDN kinaare par static/ISR pages ko cache kar sakte hain. Limitation: CDN caching akele NOT support on-demand revalidation — revalidateTag()/revalidatePath() ko Next.js server cache ko avaidh roop se declare kiya gaya hai, lekin CDN apni pratilipi ko s-maxage ki samapti tak simit rakhta hai. Propagate on-demand revalidation by trigger CDN purges with revalidation call (pattern: revalidateTag()/revalidatePath() → CDN purge API affected key ke liye, donon HTML aur RSC variant sahit).

Static assets: /_next/static/ files mein content hash + public, max-age=31536000, immutable hai. assetPrefix ek alag domain/CDN mool se static assets ki serve karta hai.

Static prefetches (PPR route): jab ek route mein PPR enable hota hai aur next-router-prefetch header set hota hai, to pratikriya niyat hoti hai (kuchh client router state ki parvah kiye bina content); next-router-state-tree ko par nahi kiya jata hai. ek CDN static prefetch pratikriyaon ko cache kar sakta hai yadi ismein (1) cache key mein _rsc khoj param shamil hai ( se prefetch variant ko alag karta hai), (2) Next.js Cache-Control ka samman karta hai. PPR ke bina routes ke liye, next-router-state-tree ko segments ko set karne ke liye prefetch ke dauraan padha jata hai - cache vary ko badhata hai. With Cache Components, segment-leval prefetch pahle se hi path naam-aadharit routes (e.g) ka upyog karte hain. /page.segments/_tree.segment.rsc) manak path naam key ke saath kaishebala. HTML

Kahan CDN caching challenging hai - custom header + Vary: App Router uttar is par bhinn hote hain: rsc (RSC payload banam HTML), next-router-state-tree ( lakshit segment update ke liye vishisht router state), next-router-prefetch (prefetch or not), next-router-segment-prefetch (vishisht segment), next-url (keval intercept routes ke liye - URL ko intercepting kiya jaa raha hai). Next.js ne ek Vary header ko yeh indicate kiya hai. Many CDNs extra config ke bina Vary ka support nahi karta hai. Next.js ise _rsc khoj parameter ke saath sanbodhit karta hai - ek cache key ke roop mein karya karne wale prasangik header manon ka ek hash, isliye alag-alag variant CDN par bhi alag-alag key prapt karte hain jo Vary ko andekha karte hain.

CDN: mein Handling header

  • Safely ignorable: next-router-state-tree (gair-prefetch RSC request par chhor diya gaya hai → server ek lakshit segment update ke bajaay ek full payload return karta hai); next-router-segment-prefetch (omitted → vyapak prefetch payload); next-url (omitted → avrodhan routes ka support nahi kiya gaya; server intarasepted ek ke bajaay niymit target page return karta hai).
  • Must preserve: rsc header (Threaded client → server); yadi ek CDN ise strips karta hai, to server HTML ko wapas return karta hai jab router RSC ki ummid karta hai → client-side navigation ko tortaa hai, browser navigation par wapas aa jata hai. Vary header + _rsc param ek RSC request ya iske viprit ke liye cached HTML ki serve ko rokne ke liye maujud hain. jab next-router-prefetch maujud hai, to both ko prefetch header aur _rsc param ko preserve karein. _rsc khoj parameter cache key mein hona chahiye - default roop se cache key se kuchh CDN strip query params; nahi. yadi ek RSC request sahi _rsc ke bina aata hai, to server sahi hash ke saath URL ko redirect karta hai ( experimental.validateRSCRequestHeaders: false ke madhyam se disabled); CDN ko iska palan karna chahiye; hash upstream ki computation karne wale platform pahle sahi _rsc ko shamil karne ke liye requests ko phir se likh sakte hain. dhyaan dein: aaj next-url ko static prefetch ke dauraan bhi _rsc hash mein shamil kiya gaya hai - cache mis ke bina ise surakshit roop se andekha nahi kar sakta hai (paithnaam aadharit disha ise theek karti hai).

Direction — path naam aadharit cache keeing (active design mein): sabhi cache-prabhaavkaaree input ko URL pathname mein le jaein, custom header par Vary ko hata dein aur _rsc ko hata dein. is yojna ka vistar output: 'export' aur segment prefetch pahle se hi upyog karte hain: file extension pratikriya prakar ki identity karte hain - full page RSC: /my/page.rsc; segment RSC: /my/page.segments/path/to/segment.segment.rsc. is modal ke tahat: paathnaam cache key set karta hai; khoj param ko surakshit roop se giraayaa jaa sakta hai; manak Cache-Control sammaanit; koi Vary support ki zaroorat hai. intarasepshan route: parivartanasheeltaa ek khoj param mein enkod kiya gaya hai, nahi path ka naam - yadi ek CDN khoj param ko preserve karta hai, to avrodhan karya karta hai; yadi yeh unhein chhor data hai, to avrodhan ne gair-intercepting kiye gaye page (naveejnon ko nahi torte) ko kripaapoorvak reject kar diya. intarasepshan ek opt-in CDN kshamata ban jata hai.

Proxy plesmeint: proxy.js ko before ko CDN cache chalana chahiye taaki yeh auth/redirects/rewrites. ke liye saty ka source bane. yadi deployment CDN ke pichhe proxy.js jaghon par jati hai, to nirnyon ke aadhar par routes ke liye caching ko bypass karne ke liye cache ko configure karein. proxy.js

Dhyaan Do: on-demand punarmaanveekaran bina kisi nuksaan ke CDN tak nahi pahunchta; rsc ya _rsc ko alag karna navigation ko tor data hai; Vary akele CDN ke par bharosa na karne layak hai.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
teen Cache-Control profile; kyon on-demand revalidation ki requirement CDN pars; _rsc ko cache-ki hash ke roop mein; path naam-aadharit disha aur yeh kya tay karta hai; CDN se pahle proxy.js.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/cdn-caching

How to configure Continuous Integration (CI) build caching

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to configure Continuous Integration (CI) build caching. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to configure Continuous Integration (CI) build caching — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Vercel, CircleCI, Travis CI, GitLab CI, Netlify CI, AWS CodeBuild. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js ne build ke beech sajha .next/cache ko ek build cache bacha liya. CI mein, varkaflo ko build ke beech is cache ko banaye rakhna chahiye ya aapko "No Cache Detected" error dikhai degi.

Per-provider configs:

  • Vercel: automatic, koi action ki zaroorat nahi (Vercel par tarborepo: Vercel monorepo dok dekhein).
  • CircleCI: key: dependency-cache-{{ checksum "yarn.lock" }} ke saath .circleci/config.yml mein save_cache step, path ./node_modules + ./.next/cache.
  • Travis CI: .travis.yml cache.directories: $HOME/.cache/yarn, node_modules, .next/cache.
  • GitLab CI: .gitlab-ci.yml cache: { key: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}, paths: [node_modules/,.next/cache/] }.
  • Netlify CI: Netlify Plugins @netlify/plugin-nextjs ke sath.
  • AWS CodeBuild: buildspec.yml cache.paths: 'node_modules/**/*', '.next/cache/**/*'.
  • GitHub action: path: ~/.npm + ${{ github.workspace }}/.next/cache, key: ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.js', '**/*.jsx', '**/*.ts', '**/*.tsx') }}, restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}- ke saath actions/cache@v4 (yadi source badal gaya hai to ek purv cache se punarnirman lekin package nahi hua).
  • Bitbucket Pipelines: caches: { nextcache:.next/cache } ko define karta hai, jo node ke saath kadam caches mein sandarbh data hai.
  • Heroku: custom cache - top level package.json "cacheDirectories": [".next/cache"].
  • Azure Pipelines: Cache@2 build karya se pahle karya: key: next | $(Agent.OS) | yarn.lock, path: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.next/cache.
  • Jenkins (Pipeline): Job Cacher plugin - manch "Restore npm sankul" (Cache node_modules, vaidhta file package-lock.json), manch "build" ($GIT_COMMIT ke saath next-lock.cache likhna, us vaidhta file ke saath cache .next/cache, npm run build chalaein).

Dhyaan Do: Forgetting .next/cache dridhta → "No Cache Detected" aur full punarnirman; cache key taalaa file + source hashes sahi karne ke liye shamil hona chahiye.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
kya .next/cache rakhti hai aur kyon CI ise banaye rakhna chahiye; GitHub action key/restore-key paitarna.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/ci-build-caching
Hissa 31 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Client-side data fetching

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Client-side data fetching. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Client-side data fetching — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: kai application ko client data-fetching library ki requirement nahi hai. yadi ek Client Component ko keval server data Once ko parhne ki requirement hoti hai, to ise React ke use() (Fetching Data dekhein) ke saath ek Promise aur unwrap paas karein. yeh un data ke liye ek library se bachata hai jo kabhi bhi client par nirbhar nahi karta hai. server Functions/transitions/optimistic UI/pending feedback pattern ke liye See Interactive Apps. Use a Library (SWR, TanStack Query, Apollo Client) jab Client Components ko shared browser kaish ki requirement hoti hai - phokas revalidation, gap polling, request deduplication, components par optimistic adyatana.

Three pattern (jab tak data upalabdh ho jata hai):

PatternSWRTanStack queryupalabdh data
inline loading statesuseSWRuseQueryhydration ke baad browser request
Suspense loading statesuseSWR + suspense: trueuseSuspenseQueryhydration ke baad browser request
server dwara pradan kiya gaya<SWRConfig fallback><HydrationBoundary>server se aarnbhik render ya stream

inline loading states: pratyek component apni khud ki loading UI pradan karta hai. Suspense: ek boundary par UI load ho raha hai, yeh samanvay karta hai ki kaun se bhag together/progressively. ko browser-sanchalit negotiation (e.g. automatic: full) ke liye prakat karte hain, ya to client-keval pattern karya - initial parinam hydration + browser request ke liye wait karte hain, aksar data ke liye sahi vyapar-band ki requirement nahi hoti jab tak negotiation nahi hoti. ek Server Component se Provide initial data jab server jaanta hai ki initial rendering ki requirement kya hai - initial rendering mein shamil value ya Suspense ke madhyam se stream kiya gaya; library ise RSC payload mein prapt karta hai aur ise browser mein prabndhit rakhta hai.

Three cache partein (svatantr tazgi policies, match avdhi ki zaroorat nahi; identity + mutation amanyata ko samanvit rahna chahiye):

LayerStorestazgi niyantran
Next.js server cachecached data + Server Component outputcacheLife revalidate/expire
Next.js client cachevisited/prefetched routes ke liye RSC payloadcacheLife stale
client data-fetching librarySWR key / TanStack query key ke tahat browser datalibrary revalidation vikalp + mutation

prefetching navigation se pahle client cache mein ek route ke RSC payload rakh sakta hai. initial data pradan karna aur server par ise pakadna svatantr vikalp hain - server read/rendered view ka phir upyog hone par Cache Components jorein.

Coordinate mutations: Server Components initial data pradan karte hain (khudsoorat segment ko copy kiya gaya); library ek sajha cache identity ke tahat browser value ko store karta hai; mutation browser cache ko turant update karta hai + cache server data ko avaidh karta hai taaki agle rendering taza ho. Optimistic update previous browser value agar likhne fail rahta hai bahal karna chahiye. yadi server padha cache nahi hai, vahan invalid karne ke liye koi server tag nahi hai. ek mutation ke baad, cached server ko invalid roop se parhne ke liye jo initial data pradan karta hai:

Methodkab upyog kareinagla server padha gaya
updateTag(tag)Server Action ko turant apna update dikhai dena chahiyefresh data ke liye await karein
revalidateTag(tag, 'max')update inactive / stale data svikarya haijab durbal ho jata hai, tab tak ruk jata hai
revalidateTag(tag, { expire: 0 })Webhook/external system ko tatkal samapti ki requirement hoti haifresh data ke liye await karein

Apply with: SWR guide, TanStack query guide. live demo: next-spa-patterns (next-spa-patterns.labs.vercel.dev) + source (github.com/nextjs/next-spa-patterns).

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
jab ek library anavashyak hai (use() Promise pattern); teen pattern aur unke loading UX; teen cache partein aur kyon unki tazgi policies svatantr hain; mutation samanvay talika; optimistic update rolbaik requirement.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/client-side-data-fetching
Hissa 32 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to fetch client-side data with SWR

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to fetch client-side data with SWR. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to fetch client-side data with SWR — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Client Components mein lane ke liye SWR ka upyog karein, Server Components se initial data pradan karein, cache server data ke saath browser mutation ka samanvay karein.

client par Fetch: jab initial view hydration ke baad browser request ke liye wait kar sakta hai. inline loading/error rajyon ke liye useSWR; ek conditional key (query? url: null) request mein delay jab tak ki intrekshan input pradan nahi karta hai:

tsx
'use client'
import useSWR from 'swr'
async function fetcher(url: string): Promise<Product[]> {
  const response = await fetch(url)
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch products')
  return response.json()
}
export function ProductAutocomplete({ query }: { query: string }) {
  const { data = [], error, isLoading } = useSWR(
    query ? `/api/products?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : null,
    fetcher
  )
  if (!query) return null
  if (error) return <p>Failed to load products.</p>
  if (isLoading) return <p>Loading products...</p>
  return (
    <ul>
      {data.map((product) => (
        <li key={product.id}>{product.name}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  )
}

client data ke liye Suspense: useSWR(key, fetcher, { suspense: true }) — nikatatam Suspense boundary load ho raha hai UI ko define karti hai; interactive shell outside ko boundary mein rakhein taaki yeh parinam bhar ke dauraan upalabdh rahe. ek bina shart key ke, SWR Suspense hal karne ke baad data ko define karta hai; nikatatam error boundary ke saath request errors ko sambhalta hai. isLoading = request chal raha hai + koi bhaarit data nahi; isValidating = koi bhi request chal raha hai. background revalidation. suspense: true ke saath, baad mein revalidation vartaman data ko render karta hai ( phir se koi fallback nahi) - background-refresh pratikriya ke liye isValidating ka upyog karein. svatantr Suspense sibling components mein padhta hai parallel mein shuru hota hai; multiple Suspense one component mein padhta hai kramik roop se run (vaataraphol).

ek Server Component (SWR 2.3.0 + React 19) se Provide initial data: skop <SWRConfig> root segment mein data ka malik hai (Keps fallback apne upbhokta ke karib), ek sajha layout mein feature data jorne se rokta hai. fallback maan server function se un-awaited Promise hai - keval component parhne ki key suspended:

tsx
// app/products/[id]/page.tsx (Server Component)
import { SWRConfig } from 'swr'
function ProductData({ id }: { id: string }) {
  return (
    <SWRConfig
      value={{
        fallback: {
          [productCache.key(id)]: getProduct(id), // not awaited
        },
      }}
    >
      <ProductView id={id} />
    </SWRConfig>
  )
}
// product-cache.ts — single source of truth for the key
export const productCache = {
  key: (id: string) => `/api/products/${id}`,
}
// product-view.tsx ('use client')
export function ProductView({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const { data } = useSWR(productCache.key(id), fetcher, { suspense: true })
  return <h1>{data.name}</h1>
}

phlembaik key aur useSWR key must bilkul match - yadi ve bahaav karte hain, to SWR phlembaik ko andekha karta hai aur client ko attract karta hai. fallback hook ka initial maan pradan karti hai; default roop se SWR ise hydration ke baad browser mein stale maan kar revalidate karta hai. SWR mein pholtbaik data ke liye no samay aadharit tazgi vindo hai - revalidateIfStale: false cache data ke saath hook mount karte samay revalidation chhor data hai (har mount par lagu hota hai, TanStack ke staleTime ke viprit). Focus/reconnect/polling/3 abhi bhi pun: valid kar sakte hain; set taza karne ke liye refreshInterval. SWR ek Route Handler GET ke liye pramukh points; handler usi getProduct ko fallback ke liye istemal kiya jaa sakta hai, jabki browser revalidation/polling. params.then() ke liye URL ka upyog karta hai, tab tak fallback ko dikhai data hai jab tak root params ka samadhan nahi ho jata; un-awaited getProduct(id) Promise RSC payload ke madhyam se visit karta hai aur parhne ka component tab tak suspended ho jata hai jab tak ki yeh hal nahi ho jata hai. mutate

Cache server-provided data Cache Components: enable cacheComponents; 'use cache' + cacheLife + cacheTag ko server function mein jorein:

ts
export async function getProduct(id: string) {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('max')
  cacheTag(`product:${id}`)
  const product = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { id } })
  if (!product) throw new Error('Product not found')
  return product
}

cacheLife('max') kyonki tag ko invalid karne ke liye likhte hain. stale niyantran kitni der tak Next.js client cache ek prefetched payload ka pun: upyog karta hai; revalidate/expire server cache ko controlled karta hai. SWR ka browser cache alag hai - iske punarmulyankan vikalp ko cacheLife se mel nahi account hai. ek sajha anubandh (productCache.key + productCache.tag) mein donon pahchaanon ko define karein, server-only/client-only import se mukt, taaki donon partein iska pun: upyog kar sakein.

mutation ke baad Coordinate cache: fallback, client parhne aur mutation ke liye saman key. optimisticData ke saath mutate - SWR turant optimistic value dikhata hai aur asaphalta par wapas rol karta hai; antim value known hone par saphalta ke baad optimistic value rakhta hai:

tsx
const { mutate } = useSWRConfig()
function markRead() {
  return mutate(
    activityCache.key,
    async () => {
      await markActivityReadAction()
      return { count: 0 }
    },
    { optimisticData: { count: 0 }, revalidate: false, rollbackOnError: true, throwOnError: false }
  )
}

Server Action DB + updateTag(activityCache.tag(userId)) ko likhte hain (cacheTag ke saath cached server query ko tag karein). Optimistic SWR maan vartaman screen update karta hai; updateTag agle cache server fresh padha banata hai. updateTag ko call karein jab ek Server Action ne ek cached reed ko badal diya jise turant likhne ko pratibinbit karna chahiye; ek ankechd reed mein update karne ke liye koi server tag nahi hai.

Dhyaan Do: key bahtee fallback ko maarta hai; revalidateIfStale: false prati-mount hai, ek samay vindo nahi; Suspense ek component jharne mein padhta hai.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
sashart key; suspense: true semantics (isLoading banam isValidating); <SWRConfig fallback> Promise pattern; sajha key + tag anubandh; optimistic mutate vikalpa.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/client-side-data-fetching/swr
Hissa 33 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to fetch client-side data with TanStack Query

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to fetch client-side data with TanStack Query. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to fetch client-side data with TanStack Query — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Client Components ke liye TanStack Query (React Query), server-built-in initial data, cache server data ke saath browser mutation ko samanvayit karta hai.

Provider setup: QueryClientProvider mein TanStack query ka upyog karke raip marg. New QueryClient prati server render; browser mein ek ka pun: upyog karein:

tsx
// app/products/providers.tsx — 'use client'
let browserQueryClient: QueryClient | undefined
function getQueryClient() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return new QueryClient()
  browserQueryClient ??= new QueryClient()
  return browserQueryClient
}
export function Providers({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return <QueryClientProvider client={getQueryClient()}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
}
// Render from the nearest shared layout: app/products/layout.tsx

client par Fetch: useQuery inline loading/error rajyon ke liye; enabled input maujud hone tak request mein delay karta hai:

tsx
const { data = [], error, isPending } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['product-search', query],
  queryFn: () => searchProducts(query),
  enabled: query.length > 0,
})

Suspense: useSuspenseQuery - nikatatam Suspense boundary load ho raha hai UI ko define karti hai; boundary ke bahar interactive shell rakhein. initial-request viphalta nikatatam error boundary ko badhava deti hai. data maujud hone ke baad, baad mein refetches ne cached data render kiya ( phir se koi fallback nahi) - background pratikriya ke liye isFetching ka upyog kiya. multiple useSuspenseQuery one component mein call kramik roop se chalane ke liye - alag-alag components mein svatantr prashnon ko daal diya ya useSuspenseQueries (request waterfalls) ka upyog karein.

Provide initial data (TanStack Query 5.40.0+ pending query ko nirjlit kar sakte hain): prarambh prefetchQuery Non awaiting, <HydrationBoundary> ko nirjlit state passed karein. server par queryFn ko override karein kyonki Route Handler ka relative URL keval browser mein hal karta hai:

tsx
function ProductData({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient()
  void queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    ...productCache.options(id),
    queryFn: () => getProduct(id), // server override
  })
  return (
    <HydrationBoundary
      state={dehydrate(queryClient, {
        shouldDehydrateQuery: (query) =>
          defaultShouldDehydrateQuery(query) || query.state.status === 'pending',
      })}
    >
      <ProductView id={id} />
    </HydrationBoundary>
  )
}
// product-cache.ts — key + options together
export const productCache = {
  key: (id: string) => ['product', id] as const,
  options: (id: string) =>
    queryOptions({
      queryKey: productCache.key(id),
      queryFn: async (): Promise<Product> => {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`)
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch product')
        return res.json()
      },
      staleTime: 30_000,
    }),
}
// product-view.tsx — 'use client'
export function ProductView({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const { data } = useSuspenseQuery(productCache.options(id))
  return <h1>{data.name}</h1>
}

staleTime (30s here) ek tatkal client ko hydrated data taza rakhne se rokta hai - kis tarah tezi se data badalta hai. server aur client ko usi query key ka upyog karna chahiye. params.then() <Suspense> ke andar ID ko hal karta hai; ProductData boundary ke neeche prefetches.

Cache Components ke saath Cache server data: 'use cache' + cacheLife('max') + cacheTag( product: ${id}) par getProduct (SWR pattern ke saman). TanStack ke staleTime ko cacheLife se mel nahi mila. With Cache Components, Next.js ne bhi Client Components ko pahle se render kiya hai - <Suspense> (TanStack Query) ke pichhe initial render ke dauraan ek query ki zaroorat rahti hai, active query state banate samay vartaman samay ko parh sakti hai; ek vartaman samay ke previous error ko badhane ke bajaay kaam karne wali boundary ko define karti hai. sajha anubandh: productCache.key + productCache.tag, koi server-only/client-only import nahi.

mutation ke baad Coordinate cache: useMutation + onMutate (optimistik update) + onError (previous restore karein):

tsx
const markRead = useMutation({
  mutationFn: markActivityReadAction,
  onMutate: async () => {
    await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey })
    const previous = queryClient.getQueryData(queryKey)
    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, { count: 0 })
    return { previous }
  },
  onError: (_error, _variables, context) => {
    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, context?.previous)
  },
})

Server Action: DB + updateTag(activityCache.tag(userId)) ko likhein.

Prenderable hydration state (tra mushkil hissa): saadaa dehydrate() Cache Components prerendering → current-time prerender error ke dauraan Date.now() padhta hai. theek karein: keval timestamp ko cache karein aur hath se nirjlit state ka build karein - data parhne ke saman tag ke saath 'use cache' mein parhne wale samay ko lapeto; jab ek mutation un taigon ko invalid karta hai, to data + timestamp ek saath aage badhta hai isliye <HydrationBoundary> agle navigation par client query ko overwrite karta hai:

tsx
// app/lib/hydrate.ts — 'server-only'
async function getHydrationUpdatedAt(tags: string[]) {
  'use cache'
  cacheTag(...tags)
  cacheLife('max')
  return Date.now()
}
export async function dehydrate(queries, options) {
  const updatedAt = await getHydrationUpdatedAt(options.tags)
  const queryClient = new QueryClient()
  for (const query of queries) {
    queryClient.setQueryData(query.queryKey, query.data, { updatedAt })
  }
  return {
    mutations: [],
    queries: queryClient
      .getQueryCache()
      .getAll()
      .filter((query) => defaultShouldDehydrateQuery(query))
      .map((query) => ({
        dehydratedAt: updatedAt,
        queryHash: query.queryHash,
        queryKey: query.queryKey,
        state: query.state,
        ...(query.meta ? { meta: query.meta } : {}),
      })),
  }
}
// Usage in ProductData:
async function ProductData({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const product = await getProduct(id)
  const state = await dehydrate(
    [{ queryKey: productCache.key(id), data: product }],
    { tags: [productCache.tag(id)] }
  )
  return (
    <HydrationBoundary state={state}>
      <ProductView id={id} />
    </HydrationBoundary>
  )
}

jab bhi hydrated data parivartan hota hai to timestamp ko aage badhana chahiye - helper tag-chaalit server data (saim tag) soot karta hai. samay-sanchalit server data ke liye, data + hydration timestamp ko ek hi cached snapshot se unrelated samay ki khirkiyon ko banaye rakhne ke bajaye.

Dhyaan Do: van QueryClient prati server render (requests mein koi bhi hissa nahi); dehydrate() + Date.now() prerendering ko tortaa hai - hath se built-in helper ka upyog karta hai; useSuspenseQuery ek component mein waterfall.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
provider singalatan pattern (server banam browser); prefetchQuery ka wait kiye bina + HydrationBoundary; staleTime banam cacheLife; optimistic mutation lifecycle (onMutate/onError); previous hydration workaround aur iski requirement kyon hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/client-side-data-fetching/tanstack-query
Hissa 34 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to set a Content Security Policy (CSP) for your Next.js application

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to set a Content Security Policy (CSP) for your Next.js application. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to set a Content Security Policy (CSP) for your Next.js application — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: CSP XSS ke khilaf guard, klikjaiking, code injekshan yeh nirdisht karke ki kaun se mool script, stylesheet, image, font, objekts, media, iframe aadi ke liye anumey hain. udaharan repo: with-strict-csp

Nonces: ek nonse ek bar upyog ke liye ek unique random string hai, jisse CSP ko chunindaa roop se vishisht inline scripts/styles. An attacker ko yeh anuman lagane ki requirement hogi - isliye ise unpredictable aur request ke anusar unique hona chahiye.

Adding a nonce with Proxy: Proxy header jodta hai + page render karne se pahle nonas generated karta hai. prati page view fresh nonce → must nonces jorne ke liye dynamic rendering ka upyog karte hain. udaharan Proxy:

ts
// proxy.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const nonce = Buffer.from(crypto.randomUUID()).toString('base64')
  const isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
  const cspHeader = `
    default-src 'self';
    script-src 'self' 'nonce-${nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'${isDev ? " 'unsafe-eval'" : ''};
    style-src 'self' 'nonce-${nonce}';
    img-src 'self' blob: data:;
    font-src 'self';
    object-src 'none';
    base-uri 'self';
    form-action 'self';
    frame-ancestors 'none';
    upgrade-insecure-requests;
`
  const contentSecurityPolicyHeaderValue = cspHeader.replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim()
  const requestHeaders = new Headers(request.headers)
  requestHeaders.set('x-nonce', nonce)
  requestHeaders.set('Content-Security-Policy', contentSecurityPolicyHeaderValue)
  const response = NextResponse.next({ request: { headers: requestHeaders } })
  response.headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', contentSecurityPolicyHeaderValue)
  return response
}

dev mein, 'unsafe-eval' ki requirement hoti hai (React advanced debugging ke liye eval ka upyog karta hai, e.g. browser mein server error stack ko phir se build karta hai); not production mein required hai (n to React aur Next.js default roop se production mein eval ka upyog karta hai). ek matcher ke saath filtar Proxy (api, _next/static, _next/image, favicon.ico ko chhorakar) aur prefetch request (missing: [{ type: 'header', key: 'next-router-prefetch' }, { type: 'header', key: 'purpose', value: 'prefetch' }]) ko andekha karein.

Kaise nonses Next.js (3 steps) mein kaam karte hain: (1) Proxy ek nonse generated karta hai, ise CSP header + ek custom x-nonce header mein jodta hai; (2) Next.js ko render karne ke dauraan CSP header ko par karta hai aur 'nonce-{value}' pattern ke madhyam se nonse ko nikalta hai; (3) Next.js automatic roop se dhanche script, page JS bundles, inline styles/scripts yeh generated karta hai, aur kisi bhi <Script> component nonce prop ka upyog karte hain. koi manual prati tag kaam ki zaroorat hai.

Forcing dynamic rendering: page ko dynamic roop se nonses ke liye render kiya jana chahiye (static pages ko build samay par generated nahi kiya jata hai jismein koi request/headers nahi hota hai).

tsx
import { connection } from 'next/server'
export default async function Page() {
  await connection() // wait for an incoming request to render
  // ...
}

: ek Server Component se headers() ke madhyam se:

tsx
const nonce = (await headers()).get('x-nonce')
return <Script src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js" strategy="afterInteractive" nonce={nonce} />

Static banam dynamic rendering CSP ke saath - gairej ke parinam: sabhi pages ko dynamic roop se render kiya jana chahiye; page OK ka build karte hain lekin agar galat config kiya jaa sakta hai to runtime errors ko maar sakte hain; pratyek request ek naye nonse ke saath ek fresh page generated karta hai; static optimization + ISR disabled; pages ko extra config ke bina CDN-cached nahi kiya jaa sakta hai; PPR gair-aadharit CSP ke saath asangat hai (static shell scripts nons tak nahi pahunch sakte hain). performance prabhav: dhimi initial bhar, server load mein vriddhi, koi barhat caching, uchch hosting lagata. jab: sakht security requirements 'unsafe-inline' ko rokti hain; sanvedanshil data; vishisht inline scripts ko permission di jaanee chahiye jabki any blocked ho jate hain; compliance sakht CSP ko anivarya karta hai.

Without nonces: CSP header ko seedhe next.config.js mein async headers() (source: '/(.*)', key Content-Security-Policy) ke madhyam se set karta hai - script/style. ke liye 'unsafe-inline' ka upyog karke yeh static rendering rakhta hai.

Subresource Integrity (experimental, App Router keval): hash aadharit CSP optional ki keeps static pidhi. SRI build samay par JS files ke kriptograaphik hash generated karta hai, jise integrity visheshataon ke roop mein joda jata hai taaki browser verify files ko paaragaman mein sanshodhit nahi kiya gaya tha. enable karein: next.config.js mein experimental: { sri: { algorithm: 'sha256' } } (ya sha384 / sha512); CSP tab script (script-src 'self' + dev 'unsafe-eval') ke liye 'unsafe-inline' / 'nonce-...' ko chhor sakta hai. labh: static pidhi, CDN compatibility, behatar performance, build samay security. limiteshan: experimental (may change/remove), keval App Router, keval build-time (dynamic roop se generated script ko sambhal nahi sakta). dynamic paridrishyon ke liye SRI + nonses ko jor sakte hain.

Dev banam prod: dev ki zaroorat 'unsafe-eval' (aur nonce udaharan mein, Prod mein dev banam 'nonce-...' mein styles ke liye 'unsafe-inline') hai. Prod muddon: koi bhi lagu nahi hai (Proxy ko sabhi required routes par chalnaa chahiye); static sanpatti blocked (CSP ko Next.js static assets ki permission dena chahiye); third-party script (policy ke liye domain).

Troubleshooting — third-party script: root layout mein headers() ke madhyam se nonce parhein, e.g paas karein. @next/third-parties/google se <GoogleTagManager gtmId="GTM-XYZ" nonce={nonce} />; CSP (script-src... https://www.googletagmanager.com; connect-src... https://www.google-analytics.com; img-src... https://www.google-analytics.com) mein domain jorein. aam ullanghan: inline styles (gair-helper CSS-in-JS ya external files ka upyog karein); dynamic import (script-src mein permission dein); WebAssembly ('wasm-unsafe-eval'); serve kaaryakartaaon (upyukt policies).

Version history: v14.0.0 experimental SRI joda gaya; v13.4.20 uchit nonce handling/CSP header parsing ke liye sifarish ki.

Dhyaan Do: Nonces taakat dynamic rendering + PPR/ISR/CDN caching ko maar daalo; static pages ko gairej nahi le sakta; dev ko unsafe-eval ki requirement hoti hai.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
nons phlo (Proxy → x-nonce → Next.js auto-taichmeint); kyon gair-vikalp dynamic rendering ki requirement hoti hai; SRI static vikalp ke roop mein; strict-dynamic arth; dev banam prod CSP matbheda.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/content-security-policy

How to use CSS-in-JS libraries

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to use CSS-in-JS libraries. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to use CSS-in-JS libraries — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: warning: naye React features (Server Components, streaming) ke saath CSS-in-JS library lekhkon ko maujuda React ka support karne ki requirement hoti hai.

Client Components mein app (alphabetical): ant-design, chakra-ui, @fluentui/react-components, kuma-ui, @mui/material, @mui/joy, pandacss, styled-jsx, styled-components, stylex, tamagui, ts-react, vanilla-extract. support par kaam karna: bhavna.

Configuring CSS-in-JS mein app — 3-step opt-in: (1) A style registry ek rendering mein sabhi CSS niymon ko ikattha karne ke liye; (2) useServerInsertedHTML hook kisi bhi content se pahle niymon ko injekt karne ke liye jo unhein istemal kar sakta hai; (3) initial SSR ke dauraan style registry ke saath apne app ko lapetna. Client Component

styled-jsx (v5.1.0+): ek registry component banaein:

tsx
// app/registry.tsx — 'use client'
import React, { useState } from 'react'
import { useServerInsertedHTML } from 'next/navigation'
import { StyleRegistry, createStyleRegistry } from 'styled-jsx'
export default function StyledJsxRegistry({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [jsxStyleRegistry] = useState(() => createStyleRegistry()) // lazy initial state — create once
  useServerInsertedHTML(() => {
    const styles = jsxStyleRegistry.styles()
    jsxStyleRegistry.flush()
    return <>{styles}</>
  })
  return <StyleRegistry registry={jsxStyleRegistry}>{children}</StyleRegistry>
}
// Wrap root layout children: <StyledJsxRegistry>{children}</StyledJsxRegistry>

Example: with-styled-jsx.

styled-components (v6+): next.config.js (compiler: { styledComponents: true }) mein enable hai, phir ServerStyleSheet + StyleSheetManager ka upyog karke registry:

tsx
// lib/registry.tsx — 'use client'
import { useServerInsertedHTML } from 'next/navigation'
import { ServerStyleSheet, StyleSheetManager } from 'styled-components'
export default function StyledComponentsRegistry({ children }) {
  const [styledComponentsStyleSheet] = useState(() => new ServerStyleSheet())
  useServerInsertedHTML(() => {
    const styles = styledComponentsStyleSheet.getStyleElement()
    styledComponentsStyleSheet.instance.clearTag()
    return <>{styles}</>
  })
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') return <>{children}</>
  return <StyleSheetManager sheet={styledComponentsStyleSheet.instance}>{children}</StyleSheetManager>
}

iske saath root layout bachchon ko lapetein. udaharan: with-styled-components Notes: SSR ke dauraan, styles ko global registry mein nikala jata hai aur unka upyog karne wali content se pahle <head> ko phlash kiya jata hai; streaming ke dauraan, pratyek bhag se styles ko ekatr kiya jata hai aur unka palan kiya jata hai; hydration ke baad, staaild-kanponeint aage ki dynamic styles ko lete hain aur injekt karte hain. registry per ke top par ek Client Component hai kyonki yeh adhik kushal hai - baad ke server reindron par phir se generated styles se bach jata hai aur unhein Server Component payload mein bhejne se rokta hai. advanced compiler vikalp: Next.js shailibaddh component API sandarbh (compiler.styledComponents).

Dhyaan Do: library ko React 18+ concurrent features ka support karna chahiye; bhavna abhi bhi pragti par hai; registry ek Client Component hona chahiye; lazy useState praarnbhikaaizar isliye registry ek bar banai gai hai.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
kyon ek registry + useServerInsertedHTML ki requirement hai (content, streaming se pahle SSR style sangrah); shailibaddh-jsx banam shailibaddh-component setup matbhed; shailibaddh-components ke liye compiler dhvaja.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/css-in-js

How to set up a custom server in Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to set up a custom server in Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to set up a custom server in Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js default roop se apne server (next start) shamil hain. Next.js ke saath maujuda backend ka upyog ek custom server not hai. ek custom server aapko programmatically custom pattern ke liye ek sarvar shuru karne data hai - keval zaroorat parne par hi bahar niklein. jis samay aapko iski requirement nahi hogi, uska Most keval tabhi upyog karein jab Next.js ka ekikrit router aapki aavashyaktaon ko pura nahi kar sakta. Standalone output mode custom server files ka pata nahi lagata hai - yeh iske bajaay ek alag minimum server.js ko output karta hai; donon ko ek saath istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.

Example:

ts
// server.ts
import { createServer } from 'http'
import next from 'next'
const port = parseInt(process.env.PORT || '3000', 10)
const dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'
const app = next({ dev })
const handle = app.getRequestHandler()
app.prepare().then(() => {
  createServer((req, res) => {
    handle(req, res)
  }).listen(port)
  console.log(`> Server listening at http://localhost:${port} as ${dev ? 'development' : process.env.NODE_ENV}`)
})

Set apne khud ke pratikriya header BEFORE calling handle: Next.js handle(req, res) ke andar jawab bhejne shuru hota hai, isliye jab tak iska Promise res.headersSent pahle se hi true hai aur kisi bhi baad res.setHeader() chupchap kharij kar diya gaya hai:

js
res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', 'sessionId=abc123; Max-Age=2592000')
await handle(req, res)

ek hi order kisi any dhanche (e.g) mein lapetan Next.js lagu hota hai. reply.raw in Fastify, res in Express. server.js not ko Next.js Compiler/bundling ke madhyam se chalaya jata hai - iske syntax aur required source vartaman Node.js sanskaran ke saath sangat hona chahiye.

Run it — update package.json script:

json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "node server.js",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "NODE_ENV=production node server.js"
  }
}

ya upyog nodemon (custom server udaharan dekhein).

The next() function vikalp:

OptionTypeDescription
confObjectnext.config.js ke saman object. default {}
devBooleandev mode mein launch karein. default false
dirStringNext.js project ka jagah. default '.'
quietBooleanserver jankari yukt error sandesh chhupaaein. default false
hostnameStringhostname server pichhe chalta hai
portNumberport server pichhe chalta hai
httpServernod:http#ServerHTTP server Next.js pichhe chalta hai
turbopackBooleanTurbopack ko enable karein (default dwara enable)
webpackBooleanwebpack enable karein

Dhyaan Do: res.headersSent jaal (handle ke baad header chupchap gira diya jata hai); custom server files ko standalone output dwara trace nahi kiya jata hai; server.js dwara compiled/bundled nahi hai. Next.js

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
jab ek custom server ko uchit (ekikrit router kam) banam jab yeh nahi hai (backend teks custom server ko chhorakar); app.prepare() → getRequestHandler() lifecycle; header ordring traipa.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/custom-server
Hissa 37 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to think about data security in Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to think about data security in Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to think about data security in Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Data fetching approaches, External HTTP APIs, Data Access Layer (DAL), Component-Level Data Access, External HTTP APIs (Zero Trust), Data Access Layer (recommended for new projects). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • React Server Components performance improve karte hain aur data fetching simplify karte hain, lekin data kahan/kaise access hota hai, ye badal dete hain — traditional security assumptions badal jate hain. Ye guide Next.js me data security ke baare me sochne aur best practices lagu karne ke tareeke cover karta hai.

data lane ke drishtikon

  • Teen recommended approaches, project size/age ke hisaab se — ek choose karo aur unhe mix karne se bacho (developers aur security auditors ke liye clearer):
  • External HTTP APIs — maujooda bade applications/organizations ke liye.
  • Data Access Layer (DAL) — nayi projects ke liye.
  • Component-Level Data Access — prototypes aur learning ke liye.
  • External HTTP APIs (Zero Trust): fetch ke saath Server Components se maujooda REST/GraphQL endpoints call karo, jaise Client Components me hota hai — jaise ek AUTH_TOKEN cookie server-side padho aur use header ke roop me forward karo:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

export default async function Page() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()
  const token = cookieStore.get('AUTH_TOKEN')?.value

  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/profile', {
    headers: {
      Cookie: `AUTH_TOKEN=${token}`,
      // Other headers
    },
  })
  // ....
}

jab security prathaon pahle se hi maujud hain aur alag backend teams svatantr roop se API ka prabandhan karte hain to achhi tarah se kaam karta hai.

  • Data Access Layer (nayi projects ke liye recommended): ek dedicated internal library jo control karti hai ki data kaise/kab fetch ho aur render context tak kya pahunche. Ek DAL ko chahiye: sirf server par chale; authorization checks kare; safe, minimal Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) return kare. Data access ko centralize karta hai, consistent access enforce karta hai, authorization bugs kam karta hai, aur ek request ke andar in-memory cache share karta hai. Example — cached getCurrentUser (React cache), taaki kai jagah use bina pass kiye wahi value mile, Client Component ko pass hone ka risk kam ho. Ek User class instance return karta hai (classes galti se poori object client ko pass hone se bachate hain; secret tokens/private info ko public fields ke roop me shamil mat karo):
ts
// data/auth.ts
import { cache } from 'react'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

export const getCurrentUser = cache(async () => {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()
  const token = cookieStore.get('AUTH_TOKEN')
  const decodedToken = await decryptAndValidate(token)
  return new User(decodedToken.id)
})
tsx
// data/user-dto.tsx
import 'server-only'
import { getCurrentUser } from './auth'

function canSeeUsername(viewer: User) {
  return true
}

function canSeePhoneNumber(viewer: User, team: string) {
  return viewer.isAdmin || team === viewer.team
}

export async function getProfileDTO(slug: string) {
  const [rows] = await sql`SELECT * FROM user WHERE slug = ${slug}`
  const userData = rows[0]
  const currentUser = await getCurrentUser()

  // only return the data relevant for this query and not everything
  return {
    username: canSeeUsername(currentUser) ? userData.username : null,
    phonenumber: canSeePhoneNumber(currentUser, userData.team)
      ? userData.phonenumber
      : null,
  }
}

yeh janne ke liye achha hai: gupt key env vars mein related hain, lekin keval DAL ko process.env tak pahunchna chahiye - app ke any hisson se rahasyon ko door rakhna.

  • Component-level data access (prototypes): DB ko seedhe Server Components me query karo. Risk: private data accidentally expose karna aasan hai — jaise ek Client Component <Profile user={userData} /> ko poori userData row pass karna har field expose karta hai. Pehli baar — sirf public fields return karo:
ts
// data/user.ts
import { sql } from './db'

export async function getUser(slug: string) {
  const [rows] = await sql`SELECT * FROM user WHERE slug = ${slug}`
  const user = rows[0]

  // Return only the public fields
  return {
    name: user.name,
  }
}

data padhna - server se client tak data guzarna

  • Initial load par, server aur Client Components dono HTML generate karne ke liye server par chalte hain, lekin alag module systems me: Server Components private data/APIs access kar sakte hain; Client Components nahi kar sakte. Server Components: sirf server par chalte hain; env vars, secrets, database, internal APIs ko safely access kar sakte hain. Client Components: prerendering ke dauraan server par chalte hain, lekin browser code jaise hi security assumptions follow karne chahiye; privileged data ya server-only modules tak access nahi hona chahiye. Application default roop se safe hai, lekin data leak ho sakta hai iske hisaab se ki data kaise fetch ya pass hota hai.
  • Tainting: React Taint APIs — experimental_taintObjectReference (data objects) aur experimental_taintUniqueValue (specific values) ke saath accidental exposure roko. next.config.js me experimental.taint: true ke saath enable karo:
js
// next.config.js
module.exports = {
  experimental: {
    taint: true,
  },
}

yeh block client ko passed hone se objects/values ko jhukaa hua hai - lekin yeh ek extra parat hai; abhi bhi DAL mein filter/sanitize data ko render sandarbh mein passed hone se pahle. yeh janne ke liye achha hai: env vars default roop se server hain (NEXT_PUBLIC_ upasarg unhein client ko expose karta hai); karya aur kakshaein pahle se hi default roop se Client Components mein passed hone se blocked hain.

  • Server-only code ke client-side execution ko rokna: server-only package ke saath ek module ko mark karo:
ts
// lib/data.ts
import 'server-only'

yeh ek build error ka karan banta hai yadi module client environment mein import kiya jata hai, to server par maalikaanaa code/internal tark ko banaye rakha jata hai. Next.js internal roop se server-only import sambhalta hai ( npm package content ka upyog nahi kiya jata hai); ise installed karein yadi jhande external dependency (npm install server-only) ko linting hai.

data ka upyog karna

  • Mutations ke liye Server Actions use karo. Built-in Server Actions security features: jab ek Server Action create/export hota hai, to ye seedhe POST request ke through accessible hai, sirf UI ke through nahi — bhale hi kahin aur import na ho, ise externally call kiya ja sakta hai. Built-in security:
  • Secure action IDs: encrypted, non-deterministic IDs client ko action reference/call karne ki permission dete hain; builds ke beech regenerate hote hain (compilation ke dauraan bante hain, max 14 din tak cached, naye build ya cache invalidation par regenerate).
  • Dead code elimination: unused Server Actions client bundle se hata diye jate hain (koi public endpoint nahi).
  • Ye risk kam karta hai jab ek dusri layer missing ho, lekin phir bhi Server Actions ko seedhe POST ke through accessible samjho aur har ek ke andar auth/authz verify karo.
jsx
// app/actions.js
'use server'

// If this action **is** used in our application, Next.js
// will create a secure ID to allow the client to reference
// and call the Server Action.
export async function updateUserAction(formData) {}

// If this action **is not** used in our application, Next.js
// will automatically remove this code during `next build`
// and will not create a public endpoint.
export async function deleteUserAction(formData) {}
  • Client input validate karna: hamesha client se input validate karo — form data, URL params, headers, searchParams sab modify ho sakte hain. BAD: ek admin panel render karne ke liye searchParams.isAdmin === 'true' par bharosa karna. GOOD: har baar re-verify karo (cookies se auth token padho, verifyAdmin(token)).
  • Authentication aur authorization: ek page-level auth check uske andar defined Server Actions tak extend nahi hota — hamesha action ke andar phir se verify karo (jaise ek admin page non-admins ko redirect karna abhi bhi auth() + admin requirement mangta hai). Authentication (logged in?) se aage authorization check karo (is specific resource par permission hai?) — IDOR vulnerabilities roko:
tsx
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { auth } from '@/lib/auth'
import { db } from '@/lib/db'

export async function deletePost(postId: string) {
  const session = await auth()
  if (!session?.user) {
    throw new Error('Unauthorized')
  }

  const post = await db.post.findUnique({ where: { id: postId } })

  // Check that the user owns this resource
  if (post.authorId !== session.user.id) {
    throw new Error('Forbidden')
  }

  await db.post.delete({ where: { id: postId } })
}
  • Mutation ke liye DAL use karna: reads jaisa hi pattern — auth, authz, aur DB logic ek dedicated server-only module me; "use server" action patla rehta hai aur delegate karta hai (deletePostAction DAL deletePost call karta hai, phir revalidatePath('/posts')). Tum DAL aur "use server" file dono me import 'server-only' kar sakte ho — dono kaam karte hain jab action ek Client Component me import hota hai, kyunki "use server" modules ek server-only webpack layer me resolve hote hain. useActionState
  • Return values control karna: Server Action return values client ke liye serialize hote hain — sirf wahi return karo jo UI ko chahiye, raw DB records nahi. BAD: db.user.update(...) return karna (poora record, internal fields). GOOD: update ko await karo, { success: true } return karo.
  • Rate limiting: mehnge operations ke liye (email bhejna, DB writes), abuse rokne ke liye rate limit karo (Backend for Frontend guide dekho).
  • Closures aur encryption: ek component ke andar defined Server Action ek closure banata hai jo outer scope (jaise publishVersion render time par snapshot hua) capture karta hai. Captured variables client ko bheje jate hain aur action invoke hone par wapas bheje jate hain — Next.js closure variables ko automatically encrypt karta hai; har build ke liye ek nayi private key generate hoti hai, isliye action sirf ek specific build ke liye invoke ho sakta hai. Ye jaanna achha hai: sensitive values ko client tak pahunchne se rokne ke liye akele encryption par bharosa mat karo.
  • Encryption key override karna (advanced): jab multiple servers par self-hosting ho, to har instance ek alag key generate kar sakta hai. NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY set karo — ek base64 value jiska decoded length ek valid AES key size ho (16/24/32 bytes; Next.js default roop se 32-byte key generate karta hai); openssl rand -base64 32 se generate karo. Instances me consistent key aur builds ke across ensure karo. Key rotation/signing practices follow karo (self-hosting guide dekho).
  • Allowed origins (advanced): Server Actions <form> me invoke ho sakte hain, jo CSRF risk khol sakta hai. Protections: sirf POST unhe invoke kar sakta hai (khaas taur par SameSite cookies ke saath default roop se). Next.js Origin header ko Host (ya X-Forwarded-Host) se compare bhi karta hai — mismatched requests reject hote hain, isliye action sirf usi host par invoke ho sakta hai jahan hosting page hai. Reverse proxies/multi-layer backends ke liye jahan API production domain se alag hai, experimental.serverActions.allowedOrigins use karo (strings, jaise ['my-proxy.com', '*.my-proxy.com']). CSRF
  • Rendering ke dauraan side-effects se bacho: mutations (log out karna, DB update, cache invalidation) kabhi server ya Client Components me side effect nahi hone chahiye — Next.js explicitly cookies set karne ya rendering ke andar revalidation trigger karne se rokta hai. BAD: jab searchParams.logout set ho to rendering ke dauraan AUTH_TOKEN cookie hatana. GOOD: ek Server Action use karo. Next.js mutations ke liye POST use karta hai, GET requests se accidental side-effects rokta hai aur CSRF risk kam karta hai.

Auditing

  • Audit checklist: DAL — kya ek alag DAL hai? Kya DB packages/env uske bahar import hue hain? "use client" files — kya props private data expect karte hain? Kya type signatures zyada broad hain? "use server" files — kya action logic action ya DAL me valid hai? Kya user action ke andar phir se authorized hai? Kya resource ownership check hoti hai (authz, sirf authn nahi)? Kya return values filtered hain? Kya DB use server-only DAL ko delegate hai? /[param]/ folders — brackets user input hain; kya params validate hote hain? proxy.ts aur route.ts — bahut power hai; traditional techniques se audit karo; regularly ya team ke SDLC ke hisaab se penetration testing/vulnerability scanning karo.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Poori DB rows Client Components ko pass karna (har field expose karta hai) — sirf required fields ke saath DTOs return karo.
  • Authorization decisions ke liye searchParams/form data/headers par bharosa karna (jaise URL se isAdmin) — har baar server-side re-verify karo.
  • Page-level redirect sochna ki us page ke Server Actions ko protect karta hai — actions alag access points hain; har ek ke andar phir se check karo.
  • Server Actions se raw DB records return karna — sirf utna return karo jitna UI ko chahiye.
  • Sensitive values ki protection ke liye akele closure encryption par depend karna.
  • Render ke dauraan mutate karna (cookies, cache invalidation) — Server Actions use karo.
  • Multi-instance self-hosting me NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY bhool jana — per-instance keys actions tod deti hain.

interview points

  • Teen data-fetching approaches (HTTP APIs/Zero Trust, DAL, component-level) aur kab har ek fit hota hai; DAL contract (server-only, authz checks, minimal DTOs) aur kyun classes/server-only/React cache madad karte hain.
  • Taint APIs (experimental_taintObjectReference/experimental_taintUniqueValue, experimental.taint: true) ek security net ke roop me, safai ka substitute nahi.
  • Server Actions security: direct POST accessibility, encrypted non-deterministic action IDs (14-day cache), dead code elimination, origin-vs-Host CSRF check, allowedOrigins, encryption aur shared key env var.
  • Authn vs authz aur IDOR (resource par ownership check); return value shaping; rate limiting; render ke dauraan koi side effects nahi.
  • Audit checklist (DAL separation, "use client" prop breadth, "use server" validation/authz/returns, [param] validation, proxy.ts/route.ts scrutiny).
