How to use debugging tools with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to use debugging tools with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to use debugging tools with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Debugging with VS Code, Debugging in JetBrains WebStorm, Debugging with browser DevTools, Client-side code, React Developer Tools, Server-side code. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Next.js ke frontend aur backend code ko full source-map support ke saath debug karo — VS Code debugger, Chrome DevTools ya Firefox DevTools se. Jo bhi debugger Node.js se attach ho sakta hai, wo Next.js app ko debug kar sakta hai (Node.js Debugging Guide dekho).

VS Code ke saath debugging

  • VS Code se debugging ke liye project root par .vscode/launch.json banao:
json
{
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "configurations": [
    {
      "name": "Next.js: debug server-side",
      "type": "node-terminal",
      "request": "launch",
      "command": "npm run dev -- --inspect"
    },
    {
      "name": "Next.js: debug client-side",
      "type": "chrome",
      "request": "launch",
      "url": "http://localhost:3000"
    },
    {
      "name": "Next.js: debug client-side (Firefox)",
      "type": "firefox",
      "request": "launch",
      "url": "http://localhost:3000",
      "reAttach": true,
      "pathMappings": [
        {
          "url": "webpack://_N_E",
          "path": "${workspaceFolder}"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "Next.js: debug full stack",
      "type": "node",
      "request": "launch",
      "program": "${workspaceFolder}/node_modules/next/dist/bin/next",
      "runtimeArgs": ["--inspect"],
      "skipFiles": ["<node_internals>/**"],
      "serverReadyAction": {
        "action": "debugWithEdge",
        "killOnServerStop": true,
        "pattern": "- Local:.+(https?://.+)",
        "uriFormat": "%s",
        "webRoot": "${workspaceFolder}"
      }
    }
  ]
}
  • Note: VS Code me Firefox debugging ke liye Firefox Debugger extension chahiye. npm run dev ko yarn dev / pnpm dev se badal sakte ho. 'debug full stack' config me serverReadyAction.action server ready hone par browser choose karta hai — debugWithEdge Edge launch karta hai; Chrome ke liye debugWithChrome kar do. Agar port badla hai to URL me 3000 badal do. Agar Next.js non-root directory se chal raha hai (jaise Turborepo), to server-side aur full-stack tasks me "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}/apps/web" jodo.
  • Debug panel (Ctrl+Shift+D / ⇧+⌘+D) kholo, ek launch configuration select karo, F5 dabao ya Debug: Start Debugging chalo.

JetBrains WebStorm mein debugging

  • JetBrains WebStorm me: runtime configuration dropdown → Edit Configurations... → URL ke roop me http://localhost:3000 ke saath ek JavaScript Debug configuration banao; customize karo (browser, project file ke roop me store), OK click karo, run karo — browser khulta hai aur debug mode me do apps milte hain: Next.js Node app aur client/browser app.

browser DevTools ke saath debugging

  • Client-side code: dev server (next dev / npm run dev / yarn dev) start karo, http://localhost:3000 kholo. Chrome: DevTools (Ctrl+Shift+J / ⌥+⌘+I) → Sources tab. Firefox: DevTools (Ctrl+Shift+I / ⌥+⌘+I) → Debugger tab. Execution kisi bhi debugger statement par rukta hai; ya files search karke manually breakpoints set karo (Chrome me Ctrl+P / ⌘+P; Firefox me Ctrl+P / ⌘+P ya file tree). Source files webpack://_N_E/./ se shuru hone wale paths ke neeche dikhti hain.
  • React Developer Tools: browser extension install karo — React components inspect karne, props/state edit karne aur performance problems pehchanne ke liye.
  • Server-side code: dev server ko --inspect flag pass karo:
bash
npm run dev -- --inspect

(pnpm: pnpm dev --inspect; yarn: yarn dev --inspect; bun: bun run dev --inspect.) value ko built-in Node.js prakriya mein passed kiya jata hai (advanced upyog ke liye Node ke --inspect dok dekhein). yeh janne ke liye achha hai: localhost (e.g) ke bahar durasth debugging ki permission dene ke liye --inspect=0.0.0.0 ka upyog karein. launch production ki tarah lag raha hai:

bash
Debugger listening on ws://127.0.0.1:9229/0cf90313-350d-4466-a748-cd60f4e47c95
For help, see: https://nodejs.org/learn/getting-started/debugging
ready - started server on 0.0.0.0:3000, url: http://localhost:3000

Chrome: khula chrome://inspect → Remote Target E → inspect → Sources tab ke tahat app dhundhein. Firefox: about:debugging → This Firefox E → Remote Targets E, Inspect → Debugger tab ke tahata. server-side debugging client-side jaise kaam karta hai; files ko khojte samay, path webpack://{application-name}/./ ke saath shuru hota hai ( package.json se aavedan ka naam). --inspect-brk/--inspect-wait ke liye, NODE_OPTIONS ko iske bajaay, e.g set karein. NODE_OPTIONS=--inspect-brk next dev

  • Browser DevTools se server errors inspect karna: Next.js error overlay version indicator ke neeche ek Node.js icon dikhata hai; use click karne par DevTools URL clipboard par copy ho jata hai — server process ko inspect karne ke liye use naye tab me kholo.
  • Windows par debugging: pakka karo ki Windows Defender disabled hai — ye har file read ko check karta hai, jo next dev ke saath Fast Refresh ko slow kar deta hai (ye ek known issue hai, Next.js se related nahi).

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Browser me server code debug karne ki koshish karte waqt --inspect bhool jana.
  • --inspect-brk ko seedha CLI flag ke roop me use karna — ise NODE_OPTIONS ke through jana chahiye.
  • Firefox Debugger extension ke bina VS Code me Firefox debugging karna.
  • Dev port badalne ke baad launch.json / debug configs me galat port; Turborepo/monorepo setup me cwd missing.
  • Windows Defender ki wajah se slow Fast Refresh — dev ke liye use disable karo.

interview points

  • Teen debugging surfaces (VS Code launch.json 4 configs ke saath: server-side node-terminal, client-side Chrome, client-side Firefox, serverReadyAction ke saath full-stack; WebStorm JavaScript Debug; browser DevTools) aur source maps kaise surface hote hain (webpack://_N_E/./ client, webpack://{app}/./ server).
  • --inspect (aur Docker/remote ke liye --inspect=0.0.0.0), chrome://inspect / about:debugging flow, NODE_OPTIONS=--inspect-brk, error overlay ka Node.js icon jo DevTools URL copy karta hai.
  • Components/props/state/performance inspect karne ke liye React Developer Tools.

Hissa 39 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Deploying Next.js to different platforms

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Deploying Next.js to different platforms. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Deploying Next.js to different platforms — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Minimum requirements, Functional fidelity vs performance fidelity, Functional fidelity, Performance fidelity, Feature support matrix, Streaming Required. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Next.js static aur dynamic content ko component level par ek spectrum ke roop me treat karta hai (Rendering Philosophy dekho). Is model me alag features ko alag platform capabilities chahiye. Ye page batata hai ki ek platform ko kya support karna hota hai aur deployment ko kaise configure karte hain.

minimum requirements

  • Next.js chalane ke liye, ek platform ko ek Node.js server chahiye — bas itna hi. Ek single next start process har feature ko sahi dhang se handle karta hai: Server Components, ISR, PPR, Cache Components, Server Actions, Proxy, aur after(). PPR aur Server Components ke liye streaming support chahiye taaki content progressively deliver ho sake — iske bina, responses buffer hokar puri ek saath bheji jati hain (kaam phir bhi hota hai, streaming ka faayda kho jata hai). Extra infrastructure (CDN caching, Edge computing, shared cache) mainly performance aur multi-instance stability improve karta hai; multi-instance deployments me, shared cache aur tag coordination stale divergence kam karta hai. Sirf ek extra dependency sharp package hai (Image Optimization ke liye required).

functional fidelity banam performance nishtha

  • Functional fidelity — har Next.js feature sahi dhang se kaam karta hai. Adapter test suite hi contract hai: agar koi platform ka adapter testing pass karta hai, to wo Next.js ko support karta hai. Binary: ya to pass hota hai ya nahi hota.
  • Performance fidelity — features optimal performance characteristics achieve karte hain (jaise PPR ka static shell origin latency ke bajaye CDN latency par; ISR stale content turant serve karta hai sub-second revalidation propagation ke saath). Ek spectrum — har platform ise apni architecture ke hisaab se alag-alag achieve karta hai.
  • Functional fidelity achieve karne wala platform ek puri tarah supported deployment target hai; performance fidelity hi hai jisse platforms alag hote hain, jo samay ke saath incrementally improve hoti hai. Is lens se feature matrix padho: "Streaming Required" aur "Shared Cache Recommended" functional fidelity ke liye kya required hai, ye batate hain; "Edge Stitching" ek performance-fidelity optimization hai.

feature support maitriks

FeatureStreamingsajha cacheEdge stitchedNotes
Server ComponentsRequiredNoNobuniyadi streaming support
ISR (samay aadharit)NoRecommendedNosajha cache ke bina prati insteins kaam karta hai
ISR (on-demand)NoRecommendedNotag prachar ko bahu-sansthaa ke liye sajha cache ki zaroorat hai
partial parishodhanRequiredRecommendedOptionalPPR platform guide dekhein
cache component (use cache)RequiredRecommendedNosajha cache kros-insteins stability ko enable banata hai
Proxy / midalaveyarNoNoNokinaare ya mool par bhaagtaa hai
server actionRequiredNoNoPOST request streaming pratikriya ke saath
after()NoNoNosundar shutdown support ki requirement hai
  • Streaming Required = platform ko chunked transfer encoding ya HTTP/2 streaming support karna chahiye aur client ko bhejne se pehle response ko buffer nahi karna chahiye.
  • Shared Cache Recommended = multiple instances shared cache backend se coordinate karke faayda uthate hain. ISR aur server response caching ke liye, cacheHandler use karo; 'use cache' entries ke liye, cacheHandlers use karo. Shared cache ke bina, har instance apna cache independently maintain karta hai — features abhi bhi per-instance sahi kaam karte hain, lekin revalidation events saare instances me propagate nahi hote.

CDN infrastructure compatibility

  • Per major CDN (available building blocks, finished integrations nahi):
CDNEdge computekey-Value / tagblob storejPPR Resuming
CloudflareWorkersKVR2han (worker)
AkamaiEdgeWorkersEdgeKVobject storagehan (worker)
amezan CloudFrontLambda@Edge.KeyValueStoreS3han (Lambda)
FastlyComputeKV storeobject storagehan (WASM)
AzureFunctionsmainejd redisblob storejhan (server)
Google cloudcloud runvibhinn KVcloud storejhan (server)
  • Aksar community adapters aaj Next.js ko ek Docker container ya Node.js server ke roop me deploy karte hain, bina CDN-specific primitives jaise Edge KV ya PPR revalidation ka faayda uthaye. Current adapter list ke liye Deploying dekho; CDN-specific caching considerations ke liye CDN caching (known Vary header boundaries samet).

Adapters

  • Deployment Adapter API (adapterPath) platforms ko ye customize karne deta hai ki Next.js applications unke infrastructure ke liye kaise built/deployed hon. Adapters build time par chalte hain aur standard build se platform-specific production output banate hain. Koi bhi public API use karke adapter bana sakta hai, bina kisi special access ke.
  • Adapter API plus Next.js caching interfaces milkar full platform integration surface banate hain: adapter build-time output handle karta hai, jabki cacheHandler aur cacheHandlers alag runtime caching paths cover karte hain — cacheHandler (single) server cache path (ISR, route handlers, patched fetch/unstable_cache, image optimization); cacheHandlers (plural) 'use cache' directive backend configure karta hai.
  • Verified adapters do requirements puri karte hain: (1) open source — source publicly available hai community/Next.js team ke inspect, contribute, validate karne ke liye; (2) compatibility test suite chalata hai — platform apne adapter ke against full Next.js compatibility test suite chalane ka tareeka deta hai, jo dikhata hai ki kya kaam karta hai, kya progress me hai, aur gaps kya hain. Verified adapters Next.js GitHub org ke under host hote hain, docs me supported deployment targets ke roop me listed hote hain, aur unki platform teams dwara maintain hote hain. Koi private infrastructure hook nahi hai — Vercel ka adapter wahi public API use karta hai jo har dusra adapter use karta hai.
  • Verified adapters aur Ecosystem Working Group ke through verified status ki taraf kaam kar rahe platforms ke liye, Next.js team commit karti hai: coordinated testing (major releases se pehle, platform teams ke saath compatibility suite chalana, surface issues ko triage karna); early access (adapter authors ko RFCs/release candidates ke dauraan API changes tak jaldi access milta hai); direct support (jab adapter contract ko update karna pade, to adapter teams ke saath seedhe kaam karna).
  • Ye jaanna achha hai: platforms usi public API/test suite par closed-source adapter bana sakte hain, lekin ve verified nahi honge kyunki team ye verify nahi kar sakti jo wo inspect nahi kar sakti.

infrastructure requirements - vyapar band

  • Rendering model static/dynamic boundary ko route level ke bajaye component level par rakhta hai. Finer-grained boundaries developers ko zyada flexibility deti hain, hosting-platform requirements ki cost par. Deliberate trade-off: infrastructure requirements ki wajah se hi rendering model jo flexibility deta hai, wo possible hoti hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Ek platform ko sahi hone ke liye Node.js server se zyada ki zaroorat nahi — ek single next start sab kuch handle karta hai; streaming/shared cache/edge performance/consistency improvements hain (streaming ko chhodkar, jo PPR/Server Components ko progressively stream karne ke liye required hai).
  • CDN primitives (Workers/KV/R2) ko finished integrations ke roop me treat karna — ve building blocks hain; aksar adapters sirf ek Node.js server/Docker container deploy karte hain.
  • Ek adapter ko "verified" manna kyunki wo maujood hai — validation ke liye open source + full compatibility test suite chahiye.
  • Multi-instance deployment me shared cache bhool jana — revalidation saare instances me propagate nahi hoga.

interview points

  • Minimum requirements (Node.js server + sharp) vs functional/performance fidelity ka fark, aur adapter test suite ek binary contract ke roop me.
  • Feature matrix: kis ke liye streaming required hai (Server Components, PPR, Cache Components, Server Actions), kaun shared cache se faayda uthata hai (ISR, PPR, Cache Components), aur edge stitching ek performance optimization hai, correctness requirement nahi.
  • CDN primitives table (Cloudflare Workers/KV/R2, CloudFront Lambda@Edge/KeyValueStore/S3, Fastly Compute/KV, wagera) aur PPR support.
  • Adapter API (adapterPath), cacheHandler vs cacheHandlers, verified adapter criteria (open source + test suite) aur Ecosystem Working Group commitments.

How to preview content with Draft Mode in Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to preview content with Draft Mode in Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to preview content with Draft Mode in Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Draft Mode, What Draft Mode does, What this guide covers (assumed contract), Step 1: Create a Route Handler, Step 2: Access the Route Handler from your headless CMS, Step 3: Preview the draft content. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Draft Mode editors ko ye dekhne deta hai ki draft/in-progress content kaise render hoga, bina revalidation ka wait kiye. Jabki ek editor Draft Mode me hai, cached/pre-rendered content bypass hokar seedhe upstream sources se fetch hota hai. Dusre visitors cached/pre-rendered version dekhna continue rakhte hain.

kya draft mode karta hai

  • Jab ek request ke liye enabled ho:
  • fetch() calls Next.js fetch cache skip karke seedhe network hit karte hain.
  • 'use cache' ke andar components/functions har request par re-execute hote hain; results cache me save nahi hote.
  • unstable_cache reads/writes usi tarah bypass hote hain.
  • Page ISR response cache se exclude hota hai aur Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate ke saath serve hota hai.
  • Effect tab bhi lagu hota hai chahe page statically generated ho, cache se serve ho, ya ISR ke through revalidate ho.

is guide cover kya (experienced anubandh)

  • Headless CMS configurable preview URLs support karta hai (aksar karte hain). CMS ek naya tab me /api/draft?secret=XXX&slug=/posts/foo jaisa URL kholta hai jab ek editor "Preview" click karta hai — secret ek shared token hai, slug preview karne wala path hai. Next.js app secret validate karta hai, Draft Mode enable karta hai, aur slug par redirect karta hai. Steps: (1) Route Handler ek cookie ke through Draft Mode enable karta hai; (2) use shared secret + slug se secure karo; (3) pages latest draft padhne ke liye render hote hain; (4) ek exit form ke saath preview banner dikhao. Phir: Cache Components ke saath Draft Mode (ek 'use cache' boundary se preview state surface karna) aur separate-draft-endpoint CMS setups.
  • Ye jaanna achha hai: GET ka matlab safe/read-only hai; future requests ko affect karne wale operations (jaise ek cookie ke through Draft Mode enable karna) ko POST use karna chahiye. Entry handler GET use karta hai kyunki CMS URL ko ek naye browser tab (ek GET request) me kholta hai. Exit flow POST use karta hai (Server Action ya POST Route Handler).

step 1: ek Route Handler banaein

  • Draft Mode cookie set karne wala ek Route Handler banao (koi bhi naam, jaise app/api/draft/route.ts).
ts
// app/api/draft/route.ts
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const draft = await draftMode()
  draft.enable()
  return new Response('Draft mode is enabled')
}
  • draft.enable() __prerender_bypass naam ki cookie set karta hai; use le jaane wale subsequent requests upar listed har cache layer skip karte hain. Manually /api/draft visit karke aur dev tools me Set-Cookie response header check karke test karo. Jaise likha hai, handler public hai — /api/draft hit karne wala koi bhi apne liye Draft Mode enable kar sakta hai; Step 2 use ek shared secret se band karta hai.

step 2: apne hedles CMS se Route Handler tak pahunchein

  • CMS custom draft URLs support karta hai (warna draft URL manually construct/access karo; steps CMS ke hisaab se alag hote hain).
  • 1. Ek secret token banao (apni pasand ka token generator) — sirf Next.js app aur CMS ko known.
  • 2. CMS me custom draft URL set karo: https://<your-site>/api/draft?secret=<token>&slug=<path> (jaise &slug=/posts/one); kuch CMS ek variable allow karte hain jaise &slug=/posts/{entry.fields.slug}.
  • 3. Route Handler me, check karo ki secret match karta hai aur slug exist karta hai (warna fail), draft.enable() call karo, phir slug par redirect karo:
ts
// app/api/draft/route.ts
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'

export async function GET(request: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
  const secret = searchParams.get('secret')
  const slug = searchParams.get('slug')

  // This secret should only be known to this Route Handler and the CMS
  if (secret !== 'MY_SECRET_TOKEN' || !slug) {
    return new Response('Invalid token', { status: 401 })
  }

  // Verify the slug exists in the CMS before enabling Draft Mode
  const post = await getPostBySlug(slug)
  if (!post) {
    return new Response('Invalid slug', { status: 401 })
  }

  const draft = await draftMode()
  draft.enable()

  // Redirect to the path from the fetched post, not from searchParams,
  // to avoid open redirect vulnerabilities
  redirect(post.slug)
}
  • Success par, browser Draft Mode cookie set ke saath target path par redirect hota hai.

step 3: draft content ka preview karein

  • Kyunki Draft Mode automatically cache bypass karta hai, page ko ye jaanne ki zaroorat nahi ki Draft Mode fresh content fetch karne ke liye on hai ya nahi — normally fetch karo:
tsx
// app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx
async function getPost(slug: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`https://cms.example.com/posts/${slug}`)
  return res.json()
}

export default async function Page({ params }: PageProps<'/posts/[slug]'>) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const post = await getPost(slug)

  return (
    <main>
      <h1>{post.title}</h1>
      <article>{post.content}</article>
    </main>
  )
}
  • Ab Draft Mode cookie ke saath, fetch Next.js cache skip karke current draft ke liye CMS hit karta hai; iske bina, wahi request cache se serve ho sakti thi. (Agar CMS drafts ke liye ek alag URL use karta hai, to neeche separate-endpoint section dekho.)

step 4: ek preview suchak dikhaaein

  • isEnabled editor ke liye ek indicator ke roop me sabse useful hai: ek banner jo confirm karta hai ki ve draft content dekh rahe hain, plus bahar nikalne ka ek tareeka. Use root layout se render karo taaki ye har preview page par dikhe:
tsx
// app/preview-banner.tsx
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'

async function exitPreview() {
  'use server'
  const draft = await draftMode()
  draft.disable()
  redirect('/')
}

export async function PreviewBanner() {
  const { isEnabled } = await draftMode()
  if (!isEnabled) return null

  return (
    <aside role="status">
      Preview mode is on.{' '}
      <form action={exitPreview}>
        <button type="submit">Exit preview</button>
      </form>
    </aside>
  )
}
  • Draft Mode se exit karna ek GET Route Handler ke saath bhi kaam karta hai, lekin POST semantically zyada sahi hai (Server Action ya POST Route Handler ke through). Agar tum ek GET Route Handler use karte ho, to use <Link> ke bajaye <form method="GET"> se trigger karo — Next.js <Link> ko prefetch karta hai, jo editor ke click se pehle cookie clear kar dega; forms method ki parwah kiye bina prefetch nahi hote.

Cache Components ke saath Draft Mode

  • Ek cached component se preview indicator render karne ke liye 'use cache' scope ke andar isEnabled padho — cache bypass abhi bhi lagu hota hai, isliye component har draft request par fresh data ke saath re-execute hota hai:
tsx
// app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'

async function Post({ slug }: { slug: string }) {
  'use cache'

  const post = await fetch(`https://cms.example.com/posts/${slug}`).then((r) =>
    r.json()
  )
  const { isEnabled } = await draftMode()

  return (
    <article>
      {isEnabled && <p role="status">Draft preview</p>}
      <h1>{post.title}</h1>
      <div>{post.content}</div>
    </article>
  )
}
  • Ye jaanna achha hai: draftMode().enable() aur draftMode().disable() ek caching directive scope ke andar call nahi ho sakte — iske bajaye ek Route Handler ya Server Action se Draft Mode toggle karo.

jab aapka CMS ek alag draft eindpoint ka upyog karta hai

  • Agar CMS draft content ko ek alag URL par expose karta hai ya alag credentials chahiye, to isEnabled par fetch branch karo:
tsx
// app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx
import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'

async function getPost(slug: string) {
  const { isEnabled } = await draftMode()
  const baseUrl = isEnabled
    ? 'https://cms.example.com/preview'
    : 'https://cms.example.com/published'

  const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/posts/${slug}`)
  return res.json()
}
  • Cache bypass abhi bhi dono branches par lagu hota hai; branch sirf ye choose karta hai ki kahan se padhna hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • /api/draft handler ko unsecured chhodna — koi bhi apne liye Draft Mode enable kar sakta hai; hamesha shared secret (aur slug existence) validate karo.
  • Search param se raw slug ko redirect karna — open-redirect vulnerability; iske bajaye fetched post se path par redirect karo.
  • Preview se exit karne ke liye <Link> use karna — prefetching click se pehle cookie clear kar deti hai; ek <form> use karo (Server Action/POST handler ya <form method="GET">).
  • Ek 'use cache' scope ke andar draftMode().enable()/disable() call karna — allowed nahi; ek Route Handler/Server Action se toggle karo.
  • Page ko fresh content fetch karne ke liye Draft Mode par branch karna chahiye sochna — cache bypass automatic hai; page normally fetch karta hai (branch sirf tab jab CMS ka ek alag draft endpoint ho).

interview points

  • Draft Mode kya karta hai (fetch cache bypass, 'use cache'/unstable_cache bypass, ISR exclusion, private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate; __prerender_bypass cookie) aur dusre visitors abhi bhi cached version dekhte hain.
  • Poora flow: CMS preview URL (/api/draft?secret=XXX&slug=...) → secret + slug validation → draft.enable() → redirect; isEnabled ke saath preview banner + draft.disable() (POST/Server Action) ke through exit.
  • Security details: shared secret, slug-existence check, open-redirect avoidance, <Link> exit cookie ko pehle clear kar deta hai.
  • Cache Components ke saath Draft Mode ('use cache' me isEnabled, cache scope me koi enable/disable nahi) aur separate-draft-endpoint branching.

Hissa 41 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to use environment variables in Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to use environment variables in Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to use environment variables in Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Loading environment variables, Loading env vars with `@next/env`, Referencing other variables, Bundling environment variables for the browser, Runtime environment variables, Test environment variables. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Next.js ne environment variables ke liye built-in support kiya hai: unhein load karne ke liye .env ka upyog karein, aur NEXT_PUBLIC_ ke saath samapt karke browser ke liye char ko bundle karein.
  • warning: default create-next-app template sabhi .env files ko .gitignore mein jodta hai - lagabhag kabhi bhi unhein commit nahi hai.

environment char load ho raha hai

  • Next.js ne process.env mein .env* files se vars ko load kiya:
txt
# .env
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_USER=myuser
DB_PASS=mypassword
  • not: multiline veriyebal ko .env* files ke andar support diya jata hai (dabal uddharanon ke andar line brek, ya dabal uddharanon ke andar \n).
  • not: ek /src folder ke saath, Next.js parent folder se .env files only ko load karta hai, na ki /src se. yeh Route Handlers mein upyog ke liye Node.js environment mein process.env.DB_HOST aadi ko load karta hai:
js
// app/api/route.js
export async function GET() {
  const db = await myDB.connect({
    host: process.env.DB_HOST,
    username: process.env.DB_USER,
    password: process.env.DB_PASS,
  })
  // ...
}
  • @next/env: ke saath Loading env vars ko Next.js runtime (e.g) ke bahar env vars ko load karne ke liye. ek ORM ya test ranar ke liye root config), @next/env package ka upyog karein (jise internal roop se Next.js dwara upyog kiya jata hai). ise installed karein (npm install @next/env) aur loadEnvConfig ka upyog karein:
tsx
// envConfig.ts
import { loadEnvConfig } from '@next/env'

const projectDir = process.cwd()
loadEnvConfig(projectDir)

phir jahan required config import karein, e.g. ek ORM config parhne process.env.DATABASE_URL.

  • Referencing any char: Next.js automatic roop se $VARIABLE sandarbhon ko .env* files ke andar vistarit karta hai:
txt
# .env
TWITTER_USER=nextjs
TWITTER_URL=https://x.com/$TWITTER_USER

process.env.TWITTER_URL https://x.com/nextjs ban jata hai. yeh janne ke liye achha hai: ek maan mein ek shabdik $ ka upyog karne ke liye, ise chhor dein (\$).

browser ke liye bundling environment variables

  • gair-NEXT_PUBLIC_ env vars keval Node.js environment mein upalabdh hain - browser ke liye accessible nahi hai (client ek alag environment mein chalta hai). browser mein ek value accessible banane ke liye, Next.js "inline" yeh client ko vitrit JS bundle mein samay ke build par, ek hard-kodit value ke saath process.env.[variable] ke sabhi sandarbhon ko replace karta hai - NEXT_PUBLIC_ ke saath char ko set karta hai:
txt
# .env
NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID=abcdefghijk

yeh un environment se value ke saath process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID ke sabhi sandarbhon ko replace karta hai jismein aap next build chalate hain, jo code mein kahin bhi upyog kiya jaa sakta hai; yeh browser ko bheje gaye kisi bhi JS mein rekhankit hai.

  • not: build ke baad, app ab in charon mein badlav ka jawab nahi data hai - e.g. ek harokoo slag ko badhava dene ke liye ek environment mein banaya gaya hai, ya ek Docker image ko multiple environment mein deploy kiya gaya hai, build samay par sabhi NEXT_PUBLIC_ values ko freeze karta hai; unhein uchit roop se build samay par set kiya gaya hai. runtime values ke liye, unhein client (dimaandeshan par ya prarambhikaran ke dauraan) pradan karne ke liye apne khud ke API ko set karein.
js
// pages/index.js
import setupAnalyticsService from '../lib/my-analytics-service'

// 'NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID' can be used here as it's prefixed by 'NEXT_PUBLIC_'.
// It will be transformed at build time to `setupAnalyticsService('abcdefghijk')`.
setupAnalyticsService(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID)
  • dynamic lookup not inlined hain:
js
// This will NOT be inlined, because it uses a variable
const varName = 'NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID'
setupAnalyticsService(process.env[varName])

// This will NOT be inlined, because it uses a variable
const env = process.env
setupAnalyticsService(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID)

runtime environment variables

  • Next.js build-time aur runtime env vars donon ka support karta hai. default roop se, env vars keval server par upalabdh hain; browser mein ek ko expose karne ke liye, NEXT_PUBLIC_ ke saath upasarg - lekin public var next build ke dauraan JS bundle mein shamil hain. dynamic rendering ke dauraan server par surakshit roop se env vars parhein:
tsx
// app/page.ts
import { connection } from 'next/server'

export default async function Component() {
  await connection()
  // cookies, headers, and other Request-time APIs
  // will also opt into dynamic rendering, meaning
  // this env variable is evaluated at runtime
  const value = process.env.MY_VALUE
  // ...
}

yeh ek Docker image ko vibhinn values ke saath kai environments ke madhyam se badhava dene ki permission data hai. yeh janne ke liye achha hai: register function (instrumeinteshan) ke saath server startup par code chalaein.

testing environment char

  • development aur production ke alava, ek teesraa environment hai: test. iske liye ek .env.test file (any do ki tulna mein kam aam) ke saath default set karein. Next.js testing environment mein .env.development ya .env.production load nahi karega. Jest/Cypress ke saath testing chalane ke dauraan upyogi testing-vishisht vars ki requirement hoti hai. test default load jab NODE_ENV test hai (testing tool aamtaur par ise sambhalte hain).
  • antar: .env.local not hai jo test environment mein load ho gaya hai, isliye testing sabhi ke liye saman parinam generated karte hain (.env.local default override karne ke liye hai). yeh janne ke liye achha hai: default env files ki tarah, .env.test ko commit hona chahiye, lekin .env.test.local ko nahi karna chahiye (.env*.local files ko gitignored hain).
  • jabki unit testing chal raha hai, load env vars ek hi rasta Next.js @next/env se loadEnvConfig (e.g) ke madhyam se karta hai.

environment parivartaniy load ordar

  • kram mein dekha gaya, ek bar dekha gaya: 1. .env.$(NODE_ENV).local 3. .env.local (No checked when NODE_ENV is test) 4.. .env process.env .env.$(NODE_ENV)
  • udaharan: NODE_ENV=development ke saath, .env.development.local aur .env donon mein define ek parivartaniy .env.development.local maan leta hai. ki permission di NODE_ENV maan: production, development, test.

jannaa zaroree hai

  • ek /src directory ke saath, .env.* filein project root mein rahti hain.
  • yadi NODE_ENV ko assign nahi kiya gaya hai, to Next.js auto-assigns development, ya production ke liye any sabhi kamaandon ke liye. next dev

sanskaran history

VersionChanges
v9.4.0.env aur NEXT_PUBLIC_ ke liye support pesh kiya gaya.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • .env files ko kam karna (ve gupt pakarate hain) - default template unhein gitignores.
  • runtime mein badalane ke liye NEXT_PUBLIC_ manon ki ummid - ve build samay par jame hue hain; runtime ke liye ek runtime API ya server-side connection() parhne ka upyog karein.
  • dynamic process.env[varName] lookup - inline nahi; static process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_X sandarbhon ka upyog karein.
  • /src ke andar .env files ko dalna - ve keval project root se load ho gaye hain.
  • parikshanon mein .env.local ki ummid - yeh design dwara test environment mein chhor diya gaya hai.
  • $VAR vistar ka upyog anjaane mein - \$ ke roop mein sakshar $ se bhag lein.

interview points

  • .env loading tantr, 5-step load ordar ( .env.local ke saath test mein chhor diya), aur NODE_ENV auto asaainmeinta.
  • build samay mein NEXT_PUBLIC_ inlining (keval static sandarbh); build ke baad jame hue; runtime values ko API ya connection() ke saath dynamic server parhne ki requirement hoti hai).
  • non-Next.js runtimes (ORM configs, test setup) aur $VARIABLE expansion/escaping. ke liye @next/env ka loadEnvConfig
  • multiline maan, /src folder behavior, .env.test banam .env.test.local niyam aur v9.4.0 moola.

How to create forms with Server Actions

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to create forms with Server Actions. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to create forms with Server Actions — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works, Passing additional arguments, Form validation, Validation errors, Pending states, Optimistic updates. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • React Server Actions Server Functions hain jo server par karya karte hain. unhein form sabmishan ko sambhalne ke liye server aur Client Components mein bulaya jaa sakta hai. yeh guide Next.js mein Server Actions ke saath rupon ka build karta hai. For Server Action behavior rupon se pare (single roundtrip pratikriya, sequential preshan, security, deployment), Server Actions aur Mutations dekhein.
  • warning: hamesha pratyek Server Action ke andar authentication aur authorization ko verify karein, bhale hi form keval ek authenticated page par diya gaya ho ( Data Security guide dekhein).

Ye Kaam Kaise Karta Hai

  • React HTML <form> element ka vistar karta hai, isliye Server Actions ko action visheshata ke saath bulaya jaa sakta hai. jab ek roop mein upyog kiya jata hai, to function automatic roop se FormData objekt prapt karta hai; mool FormData vidhiyon ke saath data nikalein:
tsx
// app/invoices/page.tsx
import { auth } from '@/lib/auth'

export default function Page() {
  async function createInvoice(formData: FormData) {
    'use server'

    const session = await auth()
    if (!session?.user) {
      throw new Error('Unauthorized')
    }

    const rawFormData = {
      customerId: formData.get('customerId'),
      amount: formData.get('amount'),
      status: formData.get('status'),
    }

    // mutate data
    // revalidate the cache
  }

  return <form action={createInvoice}>...</form>
}
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: multiple kshetron ke saath, Object.fromEntries(formData) ka upyog karein - dhyaan dein ki resulting object mein $ACTION_ ke saath extra gun hote hain.

extra tark passed karna

  • form field ke bahar, JavaScript bind ke saath Server Function ke extra tarkon ko paas karein. E.g ko userId ko updateUser ko paas karne ke liye:
tsx
// app/client-component.tsx
'use client'

import { updateUser } from './actions'

export function UserProfile({ userId }: { userId: string }) {
  const updateUserWithId = updateUser.bind(null, userId)

  return (
    <form action={updateUserWithId}>
      <input type="text" name="name" />
      <button type="submit">Update User Name</button>
    </form>
  )
}

The Server Function ko ek extra tark ke roop mein userId prapt hota hai:

ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

export async function updateUser(userId: string, formData: FormData) {}
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: ek vikalp chhipa input field (<input type="hidden" name="userId" value={userId} />) hai, lekin maan pradan kiye gaye HTML ka hissa hai aur ise inkod nahi kiya gaya hai. bind server aur Client Components donon mein kaam karta hai aur pragtishil vriddhi ka support karta hai.

form validation

  • client ya server par valid: client-side — HTML buniyadi vaidhta ke liye required aur type="email" jaise gun; server-side — ek schema validation library jaise Zod ya Valibot:
tsx
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { z } from 'zod'

const schema = z.object({
  email: z.string({
    invalid_type_error: 'Invalid Email',
  }),
})

export default async function createUser(formData: FormData) {
  const validatedFields = schema.safeParse({
    email: formData.get('email'),
  })

  // Return early if the form data is invalid
  if (!validatedFields.success) {
    return {
      errors: validatedFields.error.flatten().fieldErrors,
    }
  }

  // Mutate data
}

validation errors

  • authentication errors/messages pradarshit karne ke liye, component ko <form> ko Client Component mein define karne aur React useActionState ka upyog karne ke liye badal dein. useActionState ke saath, server function hastakshar mein parivartan apne pahle tark ke roop mein ek naya prevState/initialState parameter prapt karne ke liye:
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

export async function createUser(initialState: any, formData: FormData) {
  const validatedFields = schema.safeParse({
    email: formData.get('email'),
  })
  // ...
}
  • phir sashart roop se state objekt ke aadhar par error pradan karein:
tsx
// app/ui/signup.tsx
'use client'

import { useActionState } from 'react'
import { createUser } from '@/app/actions'

const initialState = {
  message: '',
}

export function Signup() {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(createUser, initialState)

  return (
    <form action={formAction}>
      <label htmlFor="email">Email</label>
      <input type="text" id="email" name="email" required />
      {/* ... */}
      <p aria-live="polite">{state?.message}</p>
      <button disabled={pending}>Sign up</button>
    </form>
  )
}

pending rajyon

  • useActionState ek load suchak ke liye ek pending boolean ko expose karta hai ya render button ko disabled karta hai jabki action executed hoti hai:
tsx
// app/ui/signup.tsx
'use client'

import { useActionState } from 'react'
import { createUser } from '@/app/actions'

export function Signup() {
  const [state, formAction, pending] = useActionState(createUser, initialState)

  return (
    <form action={formAction}>
      {/* Other form elements */}
      <button disabled={pending}>Sign up</button>
    </form>
  )
}
  • optional roop se, useFormStatus ek loading suchak dikhata hai - ise render karne ke liye ek alag component ki requirement hoti hai (yeh form ki sthiti ko parhne ke liye form ka ek bachcha hona chahiye):
tsx
// app/ui/button.tsx
'use client'

import { useFormStatus } from 'react-dom'

export function SubmitButton() {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus()

  return (
    <button disabled={pending} type="submit">
      Sign Up
    </button>
  )
}

ise form ke andar na rakhein:

tsx
// app/ui/signup.tsx
import { SubmitButton } from './button'
import { createUser } from '@/app/actions'

export function Signup() {
  return (
    <form action={createUser}>
      {/* Other form elements */}
      <SubmitButton />
    </form>
  )
}
  • achha janne ke liye: React mein 19, useFormStatus mein extra key (data, method, action); React ke bina 19, keval pending upalabdh hai.
  • achha pata karne ke liye: experimental useOffline config enable ke saath, ek Server Action ek connectivity drop dwara badhit pending rahta hai aur jab network return pura karta hai, to user apni jama raashi kho nahi data hai.

optimistik update

  • React useOptimistic ka prayog karein taaki UI ko customize roop se Server Function khatm hone se pahle update kiya jaa sake, bajaay jawab dene ki await ki jaa sake:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
'use client'

import { useOptimistic } from 'react'
import { send } from './actions'

type Message = {
  message: string
}

export function Thread({ messages }: { messages: Message[] }) {
  const [optimisticMessages, addOptimisticMessage] = useOptimistic<
    Message[],
    string
  >(messages, (state, newMessage) => [...state, { message: newMessage }])

  const formAction = async (formData: FormData) => {
    const message = formData.get('message') as string
    addOptimisticMessage(message)
    await send(message)
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {optimisticMessages.map((m, i) => (
        <div key={i}>{m.message}</div>
      ))}
      <form action={formAction}>
        <input type="text" name="message" />
        <button type="submit">Send</button>
      </form>
    </div>
  )
}

nested form element

  • Call Server Actions ke andar nested elements mein <form> — <button>, <input type="submit">, <input type="image">, formAction prop ya eeveint haindalars ko accept karte hain. ek roop ke bhitar multiple Server Actions ke liye upyogi (e.g) ek "sev draft" button plus "prakashit"). multiple rendering prakaron ko sambhalne par React <form> dok dekhein.

programmatic form sabmishan

  • ek textarea mein ⌘ + Enter par e.g - e.g ke saath trigger sabmishan programmatic roop se, onKeyDown ko sunne ke liye: requestSubmit()
tsx
// app/entry.tsx
'use client'

export function Entry() {
  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (
      (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) &&
      (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === 'NumpadEnter')
    ) {
      e.preventDefault()
      e.currentTarget.form?.requestSubmit()
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <textarea name="entry" rows={20} required onKeyDown={handleKeyDown} />
    </div>
  )
}

yeh nikatatam <form> ancestors ki prastuti ko trigger karta hai, jo Server Function ko run karta hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • action ke andar auth/authz ko chhor dena kyonki form keval ek authenticated page par render kiya jata hai - kriya seedhe call karne yogy hoti hai; hamesha andar verify hoti hai.
  • prevState/initialState ko kriya hastakshar ke liye pahla parameter jorne ke bina useActionState ka upyog karna.
  • <form> ke saman component mein useFormStatus ka upyog karna - yeh form stetas parhne ke liye ek alag child component mein hona chahiye.
  • chhipa input ke madhyam se extra arg ko paas karna jab unhein apratyashit rahna chahiye - chhipe hue input HTML mein aseinbal kiye gaye input pradan karte hain; bind ko pasand karte hain.
  • Forgetting Object.fromEntries(formData) mein $ACTION_-prefixed extra gun shamil hain.
  • client-side HTML validation (required, type="email") ko paryapt banane ke liye - hamesha vaidh server-side (Zod/Valibot).

interview points

  • kaise <form action> + FormData Server Actions ke saath kaam karta hai; Object.fromEntries shortakat aur iske $ACTION_ extra kalaakaara.
  • bind banam chhipa aadaanon (encoding/exposure vyapar band, pragtishil vriddhi) ke madhyam se extra tarkon ko paas karna.
  • validation: client HTML visheshataon banam server Zod/Valibot; safeParse + fieldErrors ke saath initial wapsi.
  • useActionState (signature change: initialState first arg) ke saath errors ko pradarshit karna aur useActionState ke pending banam useFormStatus (alag children component; React 19 extra key) ke madhyam se pending rajyon ko pradarshit karna.
  • useOptimistic ke saath optimistik update; prati svaroop kai karyon ke liye formAction elements ko nested; requestSubmit() (e.g) ke saath programmatic sabmishan; experimental useOffline pending-on-reconnect vyavhar.

How revalidation works in Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How revalidation works in Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How revalidation works in Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Time-based revalidation, On-demand revalidation, What gets revalidated, Out-of-sync risk, Cross-deployment skew, Tag system architecture. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • caching page ke liye deep-daaiv sathi: revalidation ke androoni hisson ko batata hai, jiska uddeshy platform injeeniyars aur edvaansd users ko custom cache haindalars ko lagu karna hai ya rivordeshan ko debugging karna hai.
  • do return prakar:
  • Time-based revalidation — stale-time-revalidate: cached content turant served jata hai; jab iski umr cacheLife / revalidate avdhi se adhik ho jati hai, to background punarjanan shuru ho jata hai; stale content tab tak serve hota rehta hai jab tak fresh content taiyar na ho jaye.
  • On-demand revalidation — revalidateTag() ya revalidatePath() spasht roop se invalid declare karta hai; agle request ek fresh render trigger karta hai.
  • adhikansh routes ko mang (App Router routes aur Pages Router ISR/prerender entries) par phir se valid kiya jaa sakta hai. Pages Router route jo automatic roop se static roop se customize hote hain (shuddh static production) NOT ki mang par punarmaany hain.
  • Pages Router on-demand ISR APIs (res.revalidate(), x-prerender-revalidate flow) abhi bhi kaam karte hain aur server cache handler (cacheHandler, vilakshan); cacheHandlers (plural) ka upyog 'use cache' nirdeshon ke liye kiya jata hai.

kya ho sakta hai revalidated

  • Revalidation both ko HTML pratikriya and ko usi React component tree se RSC payload ko phir se generated karta hai; donon artifacts ko usi cache entry mein ek saath sangrahit kiya jata hai. is stability ke mamle kyonki RSC payload client-side navigation drive karta hai - browser aur client navigation ko usi content ko rakhna chahiye.
  • Out-of-sync jokhim: yadi koi platform ek alag render se HTML ko ek render aur RSC se karya karta hai, to user client navigation ke dauraan stale/mismatched content ko dekhte hain. shaman: cache HTML aur RSC ek saath usi TTL aur avaidh niti ke saath, aur Vary header Next.js set ka samman karte hain (dekhein CDN caching guide).
  • Cross-deployment skew: roling deployment ke dauraan ek client ko deploy karne ke saath banaya gaya hai A ko server deployment B se pratikriya prapt ho sakti hai. deploymentId is ko chhota karta hai: jab client ek alag deployment ID ka pata lagata hai, to yeh lagatar content lane ke liye ek kathin navigation ko trigger karta hai.

tag system architecture

  • do tag prakar:
  • Explicit taig — ek use cache function ke andar cacheTag() ke madhyam se devalapar dwara set, ya next: { tags: [...] } ek fetch para. revalidateTag('my-tag', 'max') us tag ke saath sabhi entries ko avaidh declare karta hai.
  • Soft taig - route path se Next.js dwara svath generated, purv set _N_T_. E.g /blog/hello _N_T_/layout, _N_T_/blog/layout, _N_T_/blog/hello/layout, _N_T_/blog/hello generated karta hai. pratyek segment ko ek layout tag milta hai, saath hi patte ka route bhi milta hai.
  • sheetal tag shakti revalidatePath(): revalidatePath('/blog/hello') ne leaf route tag aur ancestor layout sopht tag ko invalid kiya hai.
  • cache handler API mein, sopht tag get() ko softTags ke roop mein passed kiya jata hai. handler ko yeh jaanchnaa chahiye ki access ke timestamp ke baad koi bhi sopht tag avaidh ho gaya hai. getExpiration() sabhi pradan kiye gaye tag, ya 0 mein sabse haal ke revalidation timestamp ko return karta hai, agar koi bhi pratyaavartit nahi hai; yeh signal sopht tag ke liye Infinity ko wapas kar sakta hai, iske bajaay get() ko passed kiya jana chahiye aur vahan check kar sakta hai. yadi wapsi timestamp access ke timestamp ki tulna mein naya hai to entry ko stale maano.

bahusankhyak vichar

  • Revalidation event is local by default: revalidateTag(), a only invalidates that udaharan; any udaharan jab tak ve iske bare mein seekhte hain tab tak stale content paroste rahte hain.
  • vitrit samanvay ke liye cache handler API hook:
  • updateTags() - jise tab bulaya jata hai jab revalidateTag() ko bulaya jata hai; sajha storage (Redis, DB) ke liye invalid event likhein taaki any udaharan ise khoj sakein.
  • refreshTags() — ko samay-samay par bulaya jata hai, lekin hamesha ek naye request shuru karne se pahle; haal hi mein avaidh events ke liye sajha storage ki check karein aur local tag state ko update karein.

platforms ke liye karyanvayan pattern

  • Single udaharan: default file system cache automatic roop se stability ko sambhalti hai; parmanu cache local FS, memory mein tag state par likhte hain. koi extra config nahi.
  • sajha cache ke saath Multi-instance: pratyek udaharan ke samanvay ke bina svatantr roop se karya karta hai; revalidation keval us udaharan par prabhav dalti hai jise call prapt hota hai. prachar karne ke liye: (1) ek sajha serve (Redis, DynamoDB, saral HTTP API) mein store tag amanyata taaimtemps; (2) ise likhne ke liye updateTags() ko lagu karein; (3) refreshTags() ko isse parhne ke liye lagu karein - must refreshTags() E mein errors ko catch: yadi yeh throw karta hai, to exception request viphalta ke roop mein propagate hota hai; pakadna requests ko antim known local tag state (sambhavatah stale) ke saath jari rakhne data hai jab tak connectivity bahal nahi hoti hai; (4) sajha storage mein cache entries (HTML + RSC) ko store karein; parmanu likhte hain ki galat vindo ko kam karein lekin sahi karne ke liye required nahi hain.
  • CDN ekikaran: CDN ko Vary header aur Cache-Control daayrektivs ka samman karna chahiye; vibhinn TTLs ke saath alag se HTML aur RSC pratikriyaon ko cache na karein.

gresphul digredeshan ( sakht stability par upalabdhata)

  • Cache likhte viphalta: pratikriya abhi bhi serve ki (writes async hain); access kho gaya hai, agle request phir se render fresh hai.
  • Cache ne viphalta ko padha: handler ko internal errors ko pakadna chahiye aur undefined (cache-misss sanket) ko wapas karna chahiye taaki route fresh ho sake. ek phenki hui error NOT ko mis ke roop mein ilaj kiya jata hai - yeh ek render error ke roop mein propagate karta hai. hamesha yaad karne ke liye undefined wapas lautein.
  • HTML/RSC inconsistency: unhein ek saath cache aur Vary ka samman karta hai.
  • Cross-deployment skew: deploymentId ko configure karta hai taaki ek build ID badlav ek kathin navigation ko trigger karta hai.
  • cache viphaltaon mein fallback performance (stol content, extra rendering) nahi hai - app kabhi toot nahi jata hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • revalidateTag/revalidatePath ka estimate karte hue, yeh ek sajha cache handler (updateTags/refreshTags) ke bina nahi hai.
  • undefined lautne ke bajaay cache handler ke reed path se pheinknaa - ek cache ko ek render error mein chhoot data hai.
  • chalo refreshTags() phenk - request fail ho jata hai; hamesha pakro.
  • ek CDN par vibhinn TTLs ke saath HTML aur RSC ko pakadna - client navigation par galat content.
  • roling deployment ke dauraan deploymentId ko bhool jana - kros-diploymeint skoo.

interview points

  • tag system ko samjhaein: eksaplikit tag banam _N_T_ sopht tag; kaise revalidatePath ko sopht tag ke top par lagu kiya gaya hai.
  • kyon HTML + RSC ek saath sangrahit aur avaidh hain.
  • time-aadharit (style-time-revalidate) banam on-demand punarvailideshan; jo API pratyek ka upyog karta hai.
  • updateTags/refreshTags ke madhyam se multi-insteins samanvay aur sajha storage; sundar fallback darshan (upalabdhata > sakht stability).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/how-revalidation-works
Hissa 44 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to implement Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to implement Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to implement Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works, step by step (minimal example), Time-based revalidation example, On-demand revalidation with `revalidatePath`, On-demand revalidation with `revalidateTag`, Handling uncaught exceptions, Customizing the cache location. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • ISR ( Cache Components ke bina - yadi cacheComponents ka upyog kiya jata hai, to ISR ko Cache Components guide ke bajaay dekhein) aapko data hai:
  • puri site ka punarnirman kiye bina static content ko update karein.
  • adhikansh requests ke liye previous static pages ki serve karke server load ko kam karein.
  • automatic roop se uchit cache-control header prapt karein.
  • lanbe next build bar ke bina badi matra mein content pages ko sambhal lein.
  • kor mechanical: generateStaticParams + export const revalidate = N ek dynamic route para.

yeh kaise kaam karta hai, step baay step (minimum udaharan)

tsx
// app/blog/[id]/page.tsx
// Next.js will invalidate the cache when a
// request comes in, at most once every 60 seconds.
export const revalidate = 60

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const posts: Post[] = await fetch('https://api.vercel.app/blog').then((res) =>
    res.json()
  )
  return posts.map((post) => ({
    id: String(post.id),
  }))
}

export default async function Page({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
}) {
  const { id } = await params
  const post: Post = await fetch(`https://api.vercel.app/blog/${id}`).then(
    (res) => res.json()
  )
  return (
    <main>
      <h1>{post.title}</h1>
      <p>{post.content}</p>
    </main>
  )
}

1. generateStaticParams ko previous ko post lauta kar dynamic route ke liye ISR ko enable banata hai. 2. next build ke dauraan, pratyek post ke liye ek page render kiya jata hai. 3. in pages ke sabhi request (e.g). /blog/1) cached aur tatkal hain. 4. 60 sekand ke baad, agle request abhi bhi cached (ab stale) page return karta hai. 5. cache invalid hai aur ek naya sanskaran background mein generated hone lagta hai. 6. ek bar saphaltapurvak generated hone ke baad, agla request update page return karta hai aur use cache karta hai. 7. yadi /blog/26 ka request kiya gaya hai aur yeh maujud hai, to page on-demand (dynamicParams ke madhyam se parivartaniy); yadi post maujud nahi hai, to 404 wapas aa gaya hai.

samay aadharit return udaharan

  • /blog par export const revalidate = 3600: ek ghante ke baad, agle visitor ko abhi bhi turant cached (stol) sanskaran milta hai; Next.js background mein fresh pun: generated karta hai; ek bar yeh cache ko replace karta hai. sifarish: ek uchch return samay set (1 ghante, 1 sekand nahi). adhik satik upyog ke liye on-demand revalidation; actual samay data ke liye dynamic rendering ka upyog karein.

revalidatePath ke saath on-demand revalidation

  • A Server Action ne ek post ko jorne ke baad pure route ke cache ko invalid declare kiya; agle request ne punarjanm kiya aur fresh data pradan kiya, phir ise cache kiya.
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'

export async function createPost() {
  // Invalidate the cache for the /posts route
  revalidatePath('/posts')
}
  • not: revalidatePath entries ko avaidh declare karta hai lekin punarjanm next request par hota hai. Eager regeneration abhi tak App Router mein upalabdh nahi hai (Pages Router mein res.revalidate hai); docs ka kahnaa hai ki naye tarikon par kaam kiya jaa raha hai.

revalidateTag ke saath on-demand revalidation

  • pure path ko punarjeevit karna; danedar niyantran ke liye revalidateTag ka upyog karein. tag vyaktigat prapt:
tsx
const data = await fetch('https://api.vercel.app/blog', {
  next: { tags: ['posts'] },
})
  • ek ORM/DB ke liye, { revalidate: 3600, tags: ['posts'] } ke saath unstable_cache ka upyog karein, phir revalidateTag('posts', 'max') ko Server Action ya Route Handler se call karein.

Uncaught exceptions ko sambhalne

  • yadi kisi error ko reject karte samay phenk diya jata hai, to antim saphaltapurvak generated data cache se serve rakhta hai; agle request retries revalidation.

cache sthan ko customize karna

  • pages/data ko tikau storage ke liye cache kiye gaye pages/data ko banaye rakhne ya containers/instances mein sajha karne ke liye cache sthan ko configure karein (khud hosting guide, caching aur ISR dekhein).

samasya nivaran / debugging

  • local dev: next.config.js mein logging: { fetches: { fullUrl: true } } ke madhyam se prapt karne ke liye loging jorein.
  • local roop se production behavior ko verify karein: next build to next start; server console mein ISR cache hits/misses ko log karne ke liye NEXT_PRIVATE_DEBUG_CACHE=1 ko .env mein jorein.

Caveats

  • ISR keval Node.js runtime (default) ke saath supported hai.
  • ISR Static Export ke saath supported NOT hai.
  • yadi ek previous route mein multiple fetch requests mein vibhinn revalidate aavrittiyaan hain, to lowest samay ka upyog ISR ke liye kiya jata hai (vyaktigat aavrittiyon ko abhi bhi data cache dwara sammaanit kiya jata hai).
  • yadi kisi route par kisi bhi fetch mein revalidate: 0 ya spasht no-store hai, to route dynamic roop se render karta hai.
  • Proxy NOT ko on-demand ISR requests ke liye executed kiya gaya hai - Proxy mein path rewrites/logic lagu nahi hoga; satik path (e.g) ko phir valid karein. /post/1, /post-1 ko phir se nahi likha gaya hai.
  • multiple udaharan: default filesystem cache prati-insteins hai; on-demand punarvikaas keval us udaharan ko invalid karta hai jo call prapt karta hai - samanvay karne ke liye ek sajha custom cache handler ka upyog karta hai.
  • background punarjanan (stale-time-revalidate) us udaharan par chalta hai jo trigger request prapt karta hai; prati-request-billing platforms par is background ka kaam extra computation ke roop mein ginaa jata hai.
  • x-nextjs-cache uttar header maan: HIT (cache se preserve), STALE (cache se preserve, background mein pun: valid), MISS (cache mein nahi, fresh render), REVALIDATED (on-demand revalidation ke madhyam se punarnirmit).

manch support

DeploymentSupported
Node.js serverYes
Docker containerYes
static exportNo
Adaptersmanch-vishisht

sanskaran history

  • v14.1.0 - custom cacheHandler sthira.
  • v13.0.0 — App Router ki shuruaat hui.
  • v12.2.0 - Pages Router on-demand ISR sthira.
  • v12.0.0 — Pages Router bot-aware ISR Fallback.
  • v9.5.0 — Pages Router static ISR pesh kiya gaya.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • turant punarjanm karne ke liye revalidatePath ki ummid - yeh keval invalid hai; agli request ke liye punarjanm await karta hai.
  • bahut kam revalidate (e.g) ki installation. 1s) ke bajaay on-demand punarvaidheekarana.
  • Static Export ya non-nod runtime ke saath ISR ka upyog karna.
  • Forget Proxy on-demand ISR requests ke liye nahi chal raha hai, isliye phir prapt path fail ho gaya.
  • ek no-store / revalidate: 0 route par kahin bhi lane ke liye pure route ko dynamic bana data hai.

interview points

  • ISR lifecycle ke madhyam se chalo: Prerender ka build → cached serve → stale gap → background punarjanm → update cache ke baad serve karte hain; dynamicParams ke madhyam se listed path ke liye on-demand pidhi.
  • time-aadharit banam on-demand revalidation: pratyek ka upyog karte samay; revalidatePath banam revalidateTag daanedaartaa.
  • x-nextjs-cache header manon ko samjhaein aur NEXT_PRIVATE_DEBUG_CACHE=1 ke saath ISR ko debug kaise karein.
  • multi-insteins boundary aur sajha cache handler phiksa.

Hissa 45 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Incremental Static Regeneration with Cache Components

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Incremental Static Regeneration with Cache Components. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Incremental Static Regeneration with Cache Components — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: App Shell, Param-specific prerenders, Partial Prefetching on/off — the key behavioral split, With Partial Prefetching, Without Partial Prefetching, Example — product catalog (Recipe API). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • ISR ke saath cacheComponents + Partial Prefetching har route ko instant pehli visit deta hai — un URLs ke liye bhi jo build me shamil nahi the. Ye Pages Router ke ISR / fallback: true ka Cache Components wala equivalent hai.
  • Build ke time par, Partial Prerendering har render ko do hisson me baant deta hai:
  • App Shell — page ka generic, dobara use hone wala hissa, jo URL data par nirbhar nahi karta.
  • Param-specific prerenders — generateStaticParams me listed URLs.
  • Listed URL par visit karne se poora prerendered page cache se milta hai. Unlisted URL par visit karne se turant App Shell milta hai, phir page background me ab-known params ke saath upgrade ho jata hai. Uske baad ki visits ko cache se upgraded result milta hai — App Shell poori tarah skip ho jata hai.
  • next.config.ts me cacheComponents: true aur partialPrefetching: true — dono enable karo.

Partial Prefetching on/off — sabse bada behavioral farak

  • With Partial Prefetching: tum <Suspense> ke andar await params kar sakte ho. Unlisted path ke liye Next.js turant fallback serve karta hai, URL-specific content render karta hai, aur poora result ISR cache me store kar deta hai.
  • Without Partial Prefetching: unlisted path ke pehle request ko URL-specific render poora hone ka wait karna padta hai. params ko kisi bhi <Suspense> boundary ke bahar await karo (loading.tsx se bani boundary bhi ginti hai), taaki Next.js us URL ke liye ek ISR entry bana sake.
  • Gotcha: Partial Prefetching ke bina, agar params ko <Suspense> ke andar await kiya, to Next.js URL-specific ISR entry banane ke bajaye shared fallback hi serve karta rahega. (Route se fetch kiya gaya data phir bhi alag se cache ho sakta hai.)
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  partialPrefetching: true,
}

export default nextConfig

Example — product catalog (Recipe API)

  • Demo: https://partial-fallbacks.labs.vercel.dev/ — Code: https://github.com/nextjs/partial-fallbacks
  • Category layout generateStaticParams ke through do categories prerender karta hai; layout khud props.params ko await nahi karta — wo params promise ko <Suspense> ke andar CategoryHeader ko pass karta hai, isliye await boundary ke andar hota hai aur unknown categories ke liye bhi App Shell generate ho sakta hai. Covered categories ke liye bhi read ko boundary ke andar hi rakho: statically known param bhi ek hi URL se juda hota hai, isliye boundary ke upar use await karne se layout ka App Shell us URL se bandh jayega.
tsx
// app/[category]/layout.tsx
import Link from 'next/link'
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { getCategory, getTopCategories } from '../lib/data'

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const categories = await getTopCategories()
  return categories.map((c) => ({ category: c.slug }))
}

async function CategoryHeader({
  params,
}: Pick<LayoutProps<'/[category]'>, 'params'>) {
  const { category } = await params
  const data = await getCategory(category)

  return (
    <div>
      <Link href="/">&larr; All categories</Link>
      <h1>{data?.name ?? 'Category'}</h1>
      {data?.description && <p>{data.description}</p>}
    </div>
  )
}

export default function CategoryLayout(props: LayoutProps<'/[category]'>) {
  return (
    <div>
      <Suspense fallback={<div>Loading...</div>}>
        <CategoryHeader params={props.params} />
      </Suspense>
      {props.children}
    </div>
  )
}
  • Product page har category ke liye ek product prerender karta hai; generateStaticParams ko parent category param milta hai. Wahi pattern: ProductDetails <Suspense> ke andar params await karta hai.
  • loading.tsx ko inline <Suspense> ki jagah use kar sakte ho — ye boundary ko segment ke edge par rakhta hai, jabki inline <Suspense> tree me kahin bhi rakha ja sakta hai.
  • Data helpers module-level 'use cache' use karte hain, taaki saare exported functions cache ho jayein aur unke results static shell me shamil ho sakein:
ts
// app/lib/data.ts
'use cache'

const API = 'https://next-recipe-api.vercel.dev'

export async function getCategory(slug: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/categories/${slug}`)
  if (!res.ok) return null
  return res.json()
}
// getProduct, getTopCategories (slice 0,2), getPopularProducts (slice 0,1) follow the same pattern
  • Agar koi component request-time API (cookies(), headers()) use karta hai, to use <Suspense> me wrap karo; prerendering ke dauraan Next.js static shell me sabse nazdeeki fallback shamil kar deta hai. Component ko <Link prefetch={true}> se bhi bahar rakhna ho, to request-time access se pehle navigation() ko await karo.

Build time par

  • next build har known category (tops, shorts) ke liye layout prerender karta hai, plus ek aur render jahan await params suspend hota hai — usi se [category] ke liye App Shell banta hai. Product page ke liye bhi waisa hi (tops ke neeche tee, shorts ke neeche joggers), plus [product] App Shell.
  • Combined output: /tops/tee, /shorts/joggers poori tarah static; /tops/[product], /shorts/[product] — category header rendered, product fallback dikhata hai; /[category]/[product] — dono fallback dikhate hain.
  • Kisi shell ke unknown params hamesha route order me sabse aakhir me aate hain — URL ke beech me koi unknown segment nahi ho sakta, isliye koi /[category]/tee shell nahi banta. Unlisted category wali visit ko /[category]/[product] milta hai, product kuch bhi ho.

Runtime par

  • /tops/tee (dono params prerendered) → poori tarah static page.
  • Pehli visit /tops/overshirt (unknown product, known category) → /tops/[product] ka App Shell, jisme category header pehle se rendered hai; product stream hokar aa jata hai.
  • Pehli visit /shoes/basketball-shoes (koi bhi param prerendered nahi) → generic App Shell /[category]/[product]; dono cheezein stream hoti hain.
  • Pehli visit ke baad, Next.js background me ab-known params ke saath route render karta hai; agle visitor ko upgraded result milta hai.
  • Jab kisi unlisted URL ka <Link prefetch={true}> viewport me aata hai, to Next.js click se pehle hi background upgrade shuru kar deta hai, taaki navigation upgraded result par hi land kare.
  • In pages ke links ko prefetch={true} chahiye hota hai — default <Link> sirf App Shell prefetch karta hai, jo usi route ke saare links share karte hain.
  • Note: unlisted params ke liye App Shell Next.js 16.3 se serve hota hai; purane versions response bhejne se pehle full server render ka wait karte the.

Poore static output ka wait karna ho to

  • ensureStatic = 'navigation' pehle request ko poore static page ke liye wait karata hai; iske bina, Next.js background me page generate karte hue prerendered fallback wapas bhej sakta hai, phir complete page ko baad ke requests ke liye store kar deta hai.

Upgrade se kya banta hai

  • Agar har data access cached hai aur saare params resolve ho gaye → fully static page.
  • Agar saare params resolve ho gaye, lekin render ab bhi <Suspense> me wrapped uncached data ya request-time APIs (cookies(), headers()) tak pahunchta hai → un fallbacks ke saath cached page; uncached / request-specific hisse request time par stream hote hain.

Kya prerender karein?

  • Har route ko prerender karna zaroori nahi — har route build ka kaam, storage aur deployment output badhata hai, aur kai routes agle deployment se pehle kabhi visit hi nahi hote. Un routes ko prerender karo jinhe sabse zyada fayda ho (popular pages, predictable content); kam visit hone wale routes on demand generate hote hain aur pehli visit ke baad upgrade ho jate hain.

Pages Router se aa rahe ho (migration mapping)

Pages RouterCache Components equivalent
fallback: true in getStaticPathsCache Components + Partial Prefetching (instant <Suspense> fallback, poora route store ho jata hai)
fallback: 'blocking'Partial Prefetching ke bina Cache Components, Partial Prefetching ke bina; params ko <Suspense> ke bahar await karo, taaki pehla request poore route ka wait kare
router.isFallbackZaroorat nahi — prerendering ek static shell generate karta hai, jo 'use cache' ke saath badhaya ja sakta hai
getStaticProps with revalidate'use cache' with cacheLife
getStaticPathsgenerateStaticParams

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • <Suspense> boundary ke upar params await karna App Shell ko ek URL se baandh deta hai aur shell ka fayda khatm kar deta hai.
  • Partial Prefetching ke bina, <Suspense> ke andar params await karne se URL-specific ISR entry kabhi nahi banti.
  • Unlisted URLs ke links par prefetch={true} bhool jana — default prefetch ko sirf shared App Shell milta hai.
  • Sab kuch prerender karna — un routes ke liye build/storage barbaad jo kabhi visit hi nahi hote.
  • Ye maan lena ki router.isFallback App Router me hota hai — wo wahan hai hi nahi.

Interview Points

  • App Shell + param-specific prerender wala split aur pehli visit ke baad background "upgrade" samjhao.
  • fallback: true vs fallback: 'blocking' ki mapping ko Partial Prefetching ke saath / bina ke contrast me samjhao.
  • Unknown params route order me hamesha aakhir me kyun aate hain (koi /[category]/tee shell nahi).
  • Upgrade se kya banta hai: fully static vs fallbacks ke saath cached.
