Hissa 46 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Ensuring instant navigations

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Ensuring instant navigations. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Ensuring instant navigations — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The tools, Build the static shell, `<Suspense>`, App Shell per route, Prefetch URL data for a link, Validate instant navigation. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • ek navigation instant hai jab browser naye page ko user click karne ke kshan ko render karna shuru kar sakta hai, static, cached aur fallback content ko turant dikhati hai, jabki server shesh content ko apni wapsi mein stream karta hai.
  • paribhasha warm cache ko maantee hai - kold cache abhi bhi ek bar cached parinam ki computation karne ke liye server ki requirement hoti hai, isliye ek route ke liye pahla navigation abhi bhi wait kar sakta hai.
  • Direct vizit banam client navigation vibhinn initial UI ka production karte hain: direct visits static shell ko HTML (aamtaur par CDN se); client navigation keval layout ke neeche phir se render karte hain, jo vartaman aur destination route sajha karte hain, isliye us sajha layout ke upar <Suspense> boundary ka upyog transition ke dauraan nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • udaharan: Nvigating /store/shoes → /store/hats keval /store layout ke neeche phir se prastutakarta; root layout mein ek <Suspense> boundary ek page load par sab kuchh cover karti hai lekin yeh navigation nahi hai.
  • useSearchParams() prerendering ke dauraan suspended kar data hai (anusandhan par agyat params) lekin client navigation par tulyakalik roop se hal karta hai (router pahle se hi param hai) - ek hi component client nev par turant render kar sakta hai lekin page load par ek fallback ke pichhe baith sakta hai.
  • Prerequisites: Cache Components + Partial Prefetching enable karein, phir validation errors ka palan karein:
ts
// next.config.ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  partialPrefetching: true,
}
  • agent sanchalit god lene ke liye kaushal: next-cache-components-adoption aur next-partial-prefetching-adoption (skills.sh/vercel/next.js /...), saath hi next-dev-loop ek chal rahe dev server ke khilaf verify karne ke liye.

tool

  • static shell ka build karein: caching directive ("use cache" aur variant) ek lifetime ko ek Async function ke parinam ke liye nirdisht karte hain, jisse Next.js mein ise static shell mein shamil kiya gaya hai. "use cache: private" cache function keval browser mein runtime API (cookies(), headers()) parhne ke karya karta hai, server par nahi - it static shell ka hissa nahi ho sakta hai.
  • <Suspense> ne bejor data ya runtime API parhne wale bhagon ke liye fallback UI ko declare kiya; jab yeh hal ho jata hai to content gir gai wapsi mein dhara. ek fallback khud ko cookies(), headers(), ya full URL tak pahunch sakti hai - build samay par fallback suspended ho jati hai aur ek <Suspense> boundary aage ki requirement hoti hai. ek <Link prefetch={true}> ke liye, prati-link prefetching navigation se pahle URL data ko upalabdh karata hai taaki fallback previous UI ka hissa ban sakti hai. cached maan (timestamps, data prapt) seedhe ek fallback ke andar baith sakte hain.
  • prati route App Shell: Cache Components ke saath generated; shesh content dharaon ke dauraan client navigation ke dauraan render karta hai. Partial Prefetching default <Link> prefetch ke roop mein App Shell ka upyog karta hai. prefetch={true} ke saath ek link bhi us link ke URL data ke aadhar par cached content ko hal kar sakta hai.
  • ek link ke liye Prefetch URL data: Partial Prefetching ke tahat pratyek view <Link> default roop se destination ke App Shell ko prefetches; usi route ke link ek App Shell sajha karte hain. shell ke saath page content ko prefetch karne ke liye prefetch={true} set karein - yeh link ko prati-link prefetching mein bhi chunta hai, jo click se aage params/searchParams/full URL ko hal karta hai. Per-link prefetching ek route ko theek nahi kar sakta hai jo iske bina block karta hai - pahle apne App Shell ke saath route ko tatkal banate hain.

tatkal navigation valid karein

  • default roop se (validationLevel: 'warning'), Cache Components app dev mein har page aur default segment ko valid karte hain. vailideshan ki sathein jo ek segment mein navigation ko tatkal rakhne se rokti hain - jo navigation block karti hain, jahan ek <Suspense> boundary gayab hai, jo data user ko bejor tak pahunchta hai.
  • automatic validation se opt out (keval un segments ko valid karein jo spasht roop se instant export karte hain) validationLevel: 'manual-warning' ke saath:
ts
// next.config.ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  experimental: {
    instantInsights: {
      validationLevel: 'manual-warning',
    },
  },
}
  • Kaise validation navigation ka anukaran karta hai: pratyek valid route ke liye yeh initial page load aur client navigation donon ko padanukram mein vibhinn points par check karta hai. /shop/[slug] ke liye: page load (mool se full per); root-layout <Suspense> sab kuchh pakadta hai) aur client navigation (e.g). /shop/shoes → /shop/hats; /shop layout pahle se hi ghurasavaar, keval pun: prastutakarta ke neeche page; root-layout boundary ise cover nahi karti hai). pratyek mamle ko svatantr roop se valid kiya jata hai - ek boundary ko cover karne wala ek path dusre ko cover nahi kar sakta hai, yahi karan hai ki ek page page page load ko paas kar sakta hai lekin client nev ko fail kar sakta hai.
  • CI mein Test: @next/playwright package ek instant() helper pradan karta hai jo turant navigation par upalabdh UI ke liye gunjaish karta hai.

sampark karne ka vivaran

  • Next.js DevTools mein Navigation Inspector E apne initial loading state par page ko freeze karta hai, jo seedhe visits aur client navigation par prefetched destination par static shell dikhata hai. React DevTools Suspense painal ke saath pair yeh dekhne ke liye ki kaun se boundary kis hisse ko cover karti hai.
  • Iske liye cacheComponents: true zaroori hai. DevTools kholo → Navigation Inspector → Pause on navigation toggle on karo → agla refresh ya click page ko freeze kar dega, taaki tum shell ko inspect kar sako (source/target URL ke saath Page load ya Client nav par "loading shell" labels dikhenge). Kaam ho jaye to toggle wapas off kar do.
  • Fallback coverage kam karne wale patterns ke liye Static Shell guide dekho.

ek aisa page jo turant navigate karta hai (store udaharan)

  • root /store/[slug], koi generateStaticParams (keval request samay par jana jata hai). product ki jankari (aamtaur par parivartan, cached deebee query) aur live list (pratyek request ko taza karein) pratyek await params apne khud ke <Suspense> boundary ke andar:
tsx
// app/store/[slug]/page.tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { db } from '@/lib/db'

export default function ProductPage(props: PageProps<'/store/[slug]'>) {
  return (
    <div>
      <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading product...</p>}>
        <ProductInfo params={props.params} />
      </Suspense>
      <Suspense fallback={<p>Checking availability...</p>}>
        <Inventory params={props.params} />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  )
}

async function ProductInfo({ params }: { params: Params }) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const product = await getProduct(slug)
  return (
    <>
      <h1>{product.name}</h1>
      <p>${product.price}</p>
    </>
  )
}

async function getProduct(slug: string) {
  'use cache'
  return db.products.findBySlug(slug)
}

async function Inventory({ params }: { params: Params }) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const item = await db.inventory.findBySlug(slug)
  return <p>{item.count} in stock</p>
}
  • Cache Components is route ko automatic roop se dev mein valid karta hai; ek blocked route ek dev-overlay insight ko theek card ke saath opheinding component ka naam data hai:
  • Cache: async function Posts() { "use cache"; return <List items={…} /> }
  • Stream: <Suspense fallback={…}> mein lapeta jata hai.
  • pratyek fix card ek vistrit walkthrough ke liye link; "copy prompt" ek agent ke liye fix ko hath data hai.
  • validation actual request ka upyog karke pratyek page load par chalta hai, isliye [slug] jaise dynamic param actual values ke khilaf check kiye jate hain.
  • Client Component page: ek sopht navigation hai jise "use client" page mein kiya jata hai, jo bina kisi server ke navigation samay-samay par render kiye jaane wale SPA transition ki tarah behavior karta hai. dev overlay ne yeh sujhav nahi diya (anumat server-component drishtikon ki tulna mein bada prabhav). jab page puri tarah se interactive hota hai to iske liye pahunchein. not: "use client" static-shell validation nahi chhortaa hai - useSearchParams() jaise hook ko abhi bhi <Suspense> boundary ki requirement hoti hai.

E2e testing ke saath pratigaman ko rokein

  • installed karein: pnpm add -D @next/playwright @playwright/test (npm/yarn/bun samakaksh).
  • donon entry points ka testing karein: page.goto() ke madhyam se initial page load (detaameint pratikriya se static UI) aur client navigation ek <Link> (destination's prefetched UI); prati-link prefetching request-vishisht content jor sakte hain) par click karke.
typescript
// e2e/navigation.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { instant } from '@next/playwright'

test.describe('Product page (/store/[slug])', () => {
  test('is instant on an initial page load', async ({ page, baseURL }) => {
    await instant(
      page,
      async () => {
        await page.goto('/store/hats')
        await expect(
          page.getByText('Loading product...').filter({ visible: true })
        ).toBeVisible()
        await expect(
          page.getByText('In stock').filter({ visible: true })
        ).toHaveCount(0)
      },
      { baseURL }
    )
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toContainText(
      'Baseball Cap'
    )
    await expect(
      page.getByText('In stock').filter({ visible: true })
    ).toBeVisible()
  })

  test('is instant on a client navigation', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/store/shoes')
    await instant(page, async () => {
      await page
        .locator('a[href="/store/hats"]')
        .filter({ visible: true })
        .click()
      await page.waitForURL((url) => url.pathname === '/store/hats')
      await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toContainText(
        'Baseball Cap'
      )
      await expect(
        page.getByText('In stock').filter({ visible: true })
      ).toHaveCount(0)
    })
    await expect(
      page.getByText('In stock').filter({ visible: true })
    ).toBeVisible()
  })
})
  • Pass Playwright ka baseURL se instant() jab page.goto() pahla navigation hai (helpar ko dastavez ke request se pahle mool ki requirement hoti hai).
  • callback ke andar, ek initial load static UI dikhata hai aur ek client nev prefetched destination UI dikhata hai; any dynamic content callback khatm hone tak blocked rahti hai. instant() gunjaish shuru = "paaus on navigation" par modna; iska ant "Resume" jaise thahrav ko jari karta hai.
  • client navigation ke liye, ghoshna karne se pahle destination URL ki await karein - anyatha ek sajha chayankarta destination ke liye pahle source page se mel khaa sakta hai; yadi prefetched destination nahi kar sakta hai, to URL await samay aur testing fail ho jata hai.
  • Cache Components previous pages ko navigation ke baad DOM mein chhipa rahta hai - getByRole (default dwara chhipe hue elements ko chhorakar) ya .filter({ visible: true }) ka upyog karta hai.
  • next dev ke khilaf bhaago (testing API automatic roop se enable). ek production build ke saath CI ke liye, exposeTestingApiInProductionBuild ko keval testing build ke liye enable banata hai ( env var dwara banaya gaya hai, donon next build aur next start ke liye set kiya gaya hai - ise keval next start ke liye set kiya gaya hai. user ke flow par phokas testing jo adhikansh mamle mein hota hai. EXPOSE_TESTING_API=1

ek navigation hai ki block phiksing (kaam udaharan)

  • root /products/[slug] ne top level par ek vishesh list (ankit) aur prati slag product data prapt kiya - donon block; validation unhein ek samay mein ek hi satah par rakhta hai.
  • Step 1 - Suspense mein slag-nirbhar karya ko moved karein: ne ProductInfo mein product ko nikala, <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading product...</p>}> mein lapeta; await props.params aur prapt ek saath suspended; product-fetch error spasht hoti hai.
  • Step 2 — vishesh rup se pradarshit prapt cache: 'use cache' ko getFeatured() mein jodta hai; App Shell ke saath vishesh list ships. not: server rahit deployment mein, in-memory "use cache" ne pure udaharanon mein jari nahi kiya - "use cache: remote" par vichar karein.
  • vaidhta Gujarati hai. DevTools client nev: pheechard sekshan turant dikhai data hai, "loading prodakt..." dikhata hai jahan vivaran stream hota hai.
  • load ho raha hai rajyon par Iterate: validation paas achha load ho raha rajyon. ek uchch <Suspense> boundary pure page satisfies validation lapetakar lekin har navigation par ek wapsi ke saath page ke adhikansh ki jagah leta hai. sarvashreshth: jitna sanbhav ho utna actual cached content ko dikhai dete hain, utna hi kamiyaan hoti hain jahan data vastav mein flight mein hota hai (e.g). header/image/description ko drishyaman rakhein, keval ek fallback ke pichhe price/availability).

AI varkaflo

  • agent loop: Observe (parhein validation insight, satik navigation + tatkal UI chunein) → Test (Confirm target UI common roop se render karta hai, ek instant() testing likhta hai, verify karta hai ki yeh route badalane se pahle fail ho jata hai) → Fix (apply named fix — use cache ya <Suspense>) → Verify (production-jaise build ke khilaf testing shuru karta hai; ek pratigaman guard ke roop mein gujarane ka testing rakhta hai).
  • agent ko full caching modal ki requirement nahi hai - ve jaane tak sirph insight ka palan karte hain. ise app-vishisht irade ki requirement hoti hai: turant kya dikhai dena chahiye, kya stream kar sakta hai, kya taza rahna chahiye. jab ek caching nirnay aspasht hota hai, to cache lifetime ka anuman lagane ke bajaay <Suspense> ke pichhe data fresh rakhein.
  • teen leevar agent ke liye pahunchte hain: Push down (I/O ko ek Suspense-wrapped children mein eksatraikt karein, isliye parent static rahta hai aur static bhai shell mein uthata hai); Cache ('use cache' + cacheLife); Per-link prefetching (nav-only); jab ek route URL data ko padhta hai, to dhanche ko link-prefetch samay par hal karta hai; cookies() / headers() se session data pahle se hi App Shell mein utarta hai.
  • ek before/after capture ke saath pratyek riphaiktar ko jore - saman capture ka matalab hai ki riphaiktar ko prabhav nahi mila. agent-browser + React DevTools ka upyog shell ko snapshot karne ke liye karein aur dekhein ki kaun se <Suspense> simaein abhi bhi pending hain. next-cache-components-optimizer kaushal package is paasha.

bahar nikalna

  • pratyek layout/page ko turant nahi hona chahiye. dev overlay pratyek insight ke saath ek Block fix pradan karta hai: page ya layout file par export const instant = false segment ko validation feedback se bahar nikalta hai. yadi iski structure iska support karti hai to segment abhi bhi turant navigate kar sakta hai; dhancha sirph iske liye saathi insight nahi dega. neeche diye gaye sections ke beech navigation abhi bhi valid hai.
tsx
// app/dashboard/layout.tsx
export const instant = false
  • /dashboard/layout.tsx par false ke saath, bahar se /dashboard mein navigation ab phlaig nahi kiya gaya hai; /dashboard/a aur /dashboard/b ke beech navigation abhi bhi check kiye gaye hain.
  • chaynit out segments ke liye server par navigation bloka. yadi content cookies/headers par nirbhar karti hai lekin ismein ek known cache lifetime hai, to ise use cache: private ke saath pakadna App Shell ko chunne ke bajaay click se aage le jaane data hai, jab tak iska stale time kam se kam 5 minat hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • root layout mein keval <Suspense> boundary ko rakhna aur yeh maante hue ki ismein client navigation shamil hain - yeh sajha layout ke neeche navigation ko cover nahi karta hai.
  • prati-link prefetching (prefetch={true}) ko ek route ko theek karne ke liye jo iske bina block karta hai - route ko pahle apne App Shell ke saath tatkal banata hai.
  • pure page ko ek uchch <Suspense> boundary mein lapetna - validation passed karta hai lekin ek kharab loading sthiti data hai.
  • Forgetting use cache: private parinam browser-keval hain aur static shell ka hissa nahi ho sakta hai.
  • E2e parikshanon mein, destination URL ki await kiye bina, ya chhipe hue previous page DOM se mel khaate hain (getByRole / visible: true filtar ka upyog karein).
  • keval next start ke liye EXPOSE_TESTING_API=1 set karna - testing API build mein nahi hoga.

interview points

  • "insteint" navigation ko define karein aur samjhaein ki page load aur client navigation alag-alag initial UI (sheyard-layout ree-render gunjaish) kyon dikhate hain.
  • kaise validation page load banam client navigation ko svatantr roop se anukaran karta hai, aur kyon ek page ek paas kar sakta hai aur dusre ko fail kar sakta hai.
  • fix paas: cache banam stream banam block (instant = false); do step mein kaam kiya udaharan (Suspense pahle, phir 'use cache').
  • instant() Playwright helper, Navigation Inspector, aur garm cache dharna.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/instant-navigation
Hissa 47 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to set up instrumentation

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to set up instrumentation. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to set up instrumentation — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Convention, Importing files with side effects, Importing runtime-specific code. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • instrumentation = monitoring/logging tool ko app mein ekikrit karne ke liye code ka upyog karke taaki aap performance aur behavior ko track kar sakein aur production mein muddon ko debug kar sakein.

Convention

  • project ke root directory mein instrumentation.ts|js banaein (ya yadi ek ka upyog kar src/ ke andar). ek register function ka export karein. ise Once kaha jata hai jab ek naya Next.js server udaharan shuru kiya jata hai, aur server requests ko sambhalne ke liye taiyar hone se pahle pura hona chahiye.
ts
// instrumentation.ts
import { registerOTel } from '@vercel/otel'

export function register() {
  registerOTel('next-app')
}
  • ek full karyanvayan ke liye OpenTelemetry udaharan (github.com/vercel/next.js/tree/kaineree/examples/with-opentelemetry) ke saath Next.js dekhein.
  • Gotchas:
  • file project root mein honi chahiye, NOT ke andar app/ ya pages/. src/ ke saath, ise pages aur app ke saath src ke andar rakhein.
  • yadi aap ek suffix jorne ke liye pageExtensions config vikalp ka upyog karte hain, to mel karne ke liye instrumentation file naam ko update karein.

side iphekts ke saath files ko import karna

  • register ke andar import karein (file ke top par nahi) isliye sabhi dushprabhavon ko ek sthan par rakha jata hai aur top par global roop se import nahi kiya jata hai.
ts
export async function register() {
  await import('package-with-side-effect')
}

runtime-vishisht code import karna

  • Next.js sabhi environments mein register ko call karta hai, isliye sashart roop se import code jo NEXT_RUNTIME env var ka upyog karke vishisht runtime (Edge banam Node.js) ka support nahi karta hai:
ts
export async function register() {
  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'nodejs') {
    await import('./instrumentation-node')
  }

  if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge') {
    await import('./instrumentation-edge')
  }
}

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • app/ ke andar instrumentation.ts dalna - ise nahi uthaya jayega.
  • runtime-vishisht code ke top level ke import jo any runtime par durghatanaagrast hote hain - hamesha NEXT_RUNTIME par geta.
  • server ke requests ko sambhalne se pahle register ko bhool jana chahiye - ise tez / gair-block karna jahan sanbhav ho.

interview points

  • kya instrumentation (server startup par avlokan) ke liye hai, register anubandh (requests se pahle server ke anusar), file plesmeint niyam aur NEXT_RUNTIME sashart import paitarna.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/instrumentation
Hissa 48 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Building interactive apps

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Building interactive apps. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Building interactive apps — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Step 1: Stream slow data with Suspense, Step 6: Manage form lifecycle (useActionState), Step 8: Make repeat navigation instant (cache + prefetch), Cache reusable reads, Invalidate from mutations, Prefetch the destination with the real request. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Jab kisi user interaction ke liye server-side kaam chahiye, to result turant available nahi hota — network requests unknown time lete hain aur fail ho sakte hain. Wait karte samay, client ko feedback dena chahiye aur un states ko respond karna chahiye, warna user purane data ko dekhte hue sochta hai ki kuch ho bhi raha hai ya nahi.
  • Ye guide Taskboard naam ke ek task-management app me responsive feedback jodta hai, step by step: slow reads stream karna, instant priority toggle, callback prop ke saath reusable filter, confirmation se pehle comments, columns ke beech cards drag karna, ek create dialog me form lifecycle, ek parent ko pending-deletion signal, phir reusable reads cache karna taaki navigations instant rahein.
  • Companion demo: https://async-react-demo.labs.vercel.dev (source: github.com/nextjs/async-react-demo).
  • Application structure: feature code features/task/ (queries, Server Functions, components) ke under; shared UI primitives components/ui/ me; app/ me pages feature components compose karte hain.
  • Starting point: ek Server Component app jo tasks/comments ek DB se padhta hai bina koi <Suspense> boundaries aur bina caching ke; Client Components mutations ke liye Server Functions call karte hain; har mutation ke baad Server Function refresh() call karta hai taaki server fresh data ke saath re-render kare.
  • Core Web Vitals note: <Suspense> ke saath streaming FCP/LCP kam karta hai (shell paint hota hai jabki slow reads finish hote hain); optimistic UI + transitions INP kam karte hain (click frame fast rehta hai); agle route ko prefetch karna destination par FCP/LCP/INP ko near-instant banata hai. Ye common INP kaam ko replace nahi karte: kam client JS ship karna aur interactions ke dauraan blocking roundtrips se bachna.

step 1: Suspense ke saath dhimi gati se data stream karein

  • Problem: task detail page page component ke top par tasks aur comments ka await karta hai — poora page block hota hai jab tak slowest read resolve na ho, aur comments read task read ke baad hi start hoti hai.
  • Fix: reads ko alag components me split karo, har ek ko ek Promise pass karo, <Suspense> me wrap karo. Page synchronous ho jata hai, shell turant return karta hai, aur server har section ko data resolve hone par stream karta hai:
tsx
// app/task/[id]/page.tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { TaskDetail, TaskDetailSkeleton } from '@/features/task/components/task-detail'
import { CommentSection, CommentSectionSkeleton } from '@/features/task/components/comment-section'

export default function TaskPage({ params }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <Suspense fallback={<TaskDetailSkeleton />}>
        {params.then(({ id }) => (
          <>
            <TaskDetail id={id} />
            <Suspense fallback={<CommentSectionSkeleton />}>
              <CommentSection taskId={id} />
            </Suspense>
          </>
        ))}
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  )
}
  • Har section component apne khud ke data ka await karta hai (TaskDetail getTask(id) ka await karta hai). JSX me params.then() inline call karna page ko synchronous rakhta hai. Outer <Suspense> params resolution + task detail cover karta hai; ek baar TaskDetail resolve ho jaye, React header reveal karta hai aur nested boundary CommentSectionSkeleton dikhati hai jabki comments load hote hain. Shell turant paint hota hai, header stream in hota hai, comments follow karte hain.

step 2: turant ek togal (useOptimistic + useTransition) par pratikriya dein

  • Problem: priority dot button server priority prop render karta hai; Server Function ko seedhe call karna current render me prop nahi badalta — button agle server render tak purana value rakhta hai.
  • Fix: useOptimistic stored prop ke bajaye render karne ke liye ek value deta hai; useTransition Server Function ko ek transition ke hisse ke roop me chalata hai; optimistic value tab tak lagu rehti hai jabki transition pending hai:
tsx
// features/task/components/task-card.tsx ('use client')
import { useOptimistic, useTransition } from 'react'
import { cyclePriority } from '@/features/task/task-actions'
import { PRIORITY_CYCLE } from '@/lib/data'

export function TaskCard({ id, priority }) {
  const [optimisticPriority, setOptimisticPriority] = useOptimistic(priority)
  const [, startTransition] = useTransition()

  function handlePriority() {
    startTransition(async () => {
      setOptimisticPriority(PRIORITY_CYCLE[optimisticPriority])
      await cyclePriority(id)
    })
  }

  return (
    <button onClick={handlePriority} className={priorityDot[optimisticPriority]}>
      {optimisticPriority}
    </button>
  )
}
  • setOptimisticPriority current frame par UI update karta hai; optimisticPriority se padhna (prop se nahi) ek stale closure value padhne ke bajaye fast double-click cycles ko sahi handle karta hai. Jab transition khatm hota hai aur fresh data aata hai, to optimistic value naye server-rendered prop me badal jati hai. Agar useTransition ke andar Server Function throw kare, to error manual try/catch ke bina nearest error boundary tak forward hoti hai.

step 3: pending pratikriya ke saath filtar karein (pun: prayojy ChipGroup + data-peinding)

  • Problem: label filter chips router.push() ke through ek query param update karte hain; jab tak navigation page ko complete nahi karta tab tak purana URL state render hota rehta hai aur koi signal nahi milta ki ek naya server render load ho raha hai.
  • Fix: do components me split karo. LabelFilter query string update ka owner hai aur ek filterAction callback ek reusable ChipGroup ko pass karta hai, jo saara pending feedback handle karta hai. ChipGroup ek changeAction prop accept karta hai, use apne khud ke startTransition ke andar call karta hai, aur do useOptimistic hooks use karta hai — ek selected chip ke liye, ek data-pending attribute ke liye jiske against ancestors style kar sakte hain:
tsx
// components/ui/chip-group.tsx ('use client')
import { startTransition, useOptimistic } from 'react'

export function ChipGroup({ items, value, changeAction }) {
  const [optimisticValue, setOptimisticValue] = useOptimistic(value)
  const [isPending, setIsPending] = useOptimistic(false)

  function handleClick(newValue) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      setOptimisticValue(newValue)
      setIsPending(true)
      await changeAction(newValue)
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex gap-1.5" data-pending={isPending ? '' : undefined}>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <button
          key={item.value}
          onClick={() => handleClick(item.value === optimisticValue ? null : item.value)}
          className={item.value === optimisticValue ? 'active' : ''}
        >
          {item.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
  • Convention: action naam ke props ya Action suffix is behavior ko signal karte hain (React docs: "action props ko components se expose karna").
  • data-pending attribute ancestors ko bina coordination ke CSS ke through feedback deta hai — board ko ek skeleton se replace kiye bina, jabki transition chalta hai, board ko dim karne ke liye group-has-data-pending:opacity-50 use karo.
  • Performance note: group-has-data-pending: / has-data-pending: CSS :has() selector par compile hota hai, jo jab bhi data-pending toggle hota hai re-evaluate hota hai — yahan sasta hai (filter per do baar toggle); dragging jaanboojhkar ise skip karta hai. Iske bajaye client state use karo jab ek broad :has() invalidation ek high-frequency interaction (dragging/scrolling) par toggle ho jahan ek bade subtree par baar-baar re-evaluation ho.

step 4: tatkal pratikriya ke saath comments jorein (optimistik list + form reset)

  • Problem: controlled state wala comment form seedhe Server Function call karta hai — input bhara rehta hai aur list server ke respond karne tak nahi badalti.
  • Fix: list ko split karo. Ek server component persisted comments deta hai; ek client component sirf pending comments ko useOptimistic([]) ke saath track karta hai. Jab transition complete hota hai aur fresh data aata hai, to pending list khali ho jati hai aur actual comment server-rendered list me dikhai deti hai:
tsx
// features/task/components/optimistic-comments.tsx ('use client')
import { useOptimistic, useRef } from 'react'
import { addComment } from '@/features/task/task-actions'
import { CommentCard } from './comment-card'

export function OptimisticComments({ taskId }) {
  const [pendingComments, setPendingComments] = useOptimistic([])
  const formRef = useRef(null)

  return (
    <>
      <form
        ref={formRef}
        action={async (formData) => {
          const content = formData.get('content')?.trim()
          if (!content) return
          formRef.current?.reset()

          const id = crypto.randomUUID()
          setPendingComments((current) => [
            { id, content, userName: 'You', createdAt: new Date().toISOString() },
            ...current,
          ])

          await addComment(taskId, content)
        }}
      >
        <input name="content" placeholder="Write a comment..." required />
        <button type="submit">Send</button>
      </form>
      {pendingComments.map((comment) => (
        <CommentCard key={comment.id} comment={comment} pending />
      ))}
    </>
  )
}
  • Submit karne par teen cheezein: (1) formRef.current?.reset() direct DOM manipulation se input clear karta hai — ek transition ke andar, useState setters tab tak defer hote hain jab tak transition complete na ho, lekin useOptimistic setters aur direct DOM calls jaise formRef.reset() current frame par lagu hote hain; (2) setPendingComments ek client-generated UUID ke saath comment jodta hai; (3) form action handler ko ek transition ke andar chalata hai. Result: input submit par clear hota hai, ek faded comment card top par dikhai deta hai; server confirmation par faded card gayab ho jata hai aur actual comment uski jagah leta hai.

step 5: stanbhon (useOptimistic reducer + upyog) ke beech card le jaein

  • Problem: board columns server tasks prop se render hote hain; ek card drop karna Server Function call karta hai, lekin card agle server render tak purane column me rehta hai.
  • Fix: useOptimistic ek reducer ke saath current frame par card ki position wapas karta hai. Component parent server component se ek Promise receive karta hai aur use React ke use() ke saath unwrap karta hai:
tsx
// features/task/components/board.tsx ('use client')
import { startTransition, use, useOptimistic } from 'react'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { updateStatus } from '@/features/task/task-actions'

export function Board({ tasksPromise }) {
  const tasks = use(tasksPromise)
  const [optimisticTasks, moveTask] = useOptimistic(
    tasks,
    (currentTasks, action: { taskId: string; status: Status }) =>
      currentTasks.map((t) =>
        t.id === action.taskId ? { ...t, status: action.status } : t
      )
  )

  function handleDrop(targetStatus, taskId) {
    startTransition(async () => {
      moveTask({ taskId, status: targetStatus })
      const result = await updateStatus(taskId, targetStatus)
      if (!result.success) toast.error(result.error)
    })
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
      {columns.map((col) => (
        <Column
          key={col.status}
          tasks={optimisticTasks.filter((t) => t.status === col.status)}
          onDrop={(taskId) => handleDrop(col.status, taskId)}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
  • Agar koi background refresh mid-drag aata hai (polling, dusre user ka mutation), to React reducer ko updated base data ke saath phir se chalata hai taaki optimistic steps fresh data ke upar baithein. Server Function ek error result deta hai jab task ab exist nahi karta → toast. useTransition ke bajaye standalone startTransition use hota hai kyunki hook ka isPending pehle se view feedback cover karta hai, isliye koi pending indicator nahi chahiye. Agar Server Function ek expected error return kare, to card wapas revert ho jata hai; unexpected errors nearest error boundary par jate hain.

step 6: prabandhan form laaiphsaaikal (useActionState)

  • Problem: manually managed create dialog (useState isOpen/isSubmitting, onSubmit handler ke liye useState) — dialog board ke naye task dikhane se pehle band ho jata hai (setIsOpen(false) ek transition ke bahar fire hota hai), aur fields apne values tab tak rakhte hain jab tak tum khud ek reset key track na karo.
  • Fix: useActionState teeno ko handle karta hai: button ke liye isPending, fields ke liye key-based reset aur ek wrapped dialog close:
tsx
// features/task/components/create-task-modal.tsx ('use client')
import { useActionState, startTransition, useState } from 'react'
import { createTask } from '@/features/task/task-actions'

export function CreateTaskModal() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)

  const [{ key }, formAction, isPending] = useActionState(
    async (prev, formData) => {
      const title = String(formData.get('title'))
      if (!title.trim()) return prev

      await createTask({
        title,
        description: String(formData.get('description')),
        status: 'todo',
        priority: 'medium',
      })

      startTransition(() => setIsOpen(false))
      return { key: prev.key + 1 }
    },
    { key: 0 }
  )

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
      <form action={formAction}>
        <div key={key}>
          <input name="title" placeholder="Task title..." required />
          <input name="description" placeholder="Describe the task..." />
        </div>
        <button type="submit" disabled={isPending}>
          {isPending ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Task'}
        </button>
      </form>
    </Dialog>
  )
}
  • Returned state me key reset control karta hai — success par ye increment hota hai, <div key={key}> ko remount karta hai aur andar ke har input ko reset karta hai. useActionState action ko ek transition ke roop me chalata hai, isliye dialog khula rehta hai aur isPending true rehta hai jabki createTask chalta hai. await ke baad ke state updates automatically us transition ka hissa nahi hote, isliye setIsOpen(false) ko startTransition me wrap karna chahiye — ye dialog close ko createTask ke andar ke board-update refresh() trigger ke saath batch karta hai, isliye naya task usi moment reveal hota hai jab dialog band hota hai (iske bina, dialog board update se ek frame pehle band ho jata hai). React docs: "React mere await ke baad ke state update ko ek transition ke roop me treat nahi karta" — post-await state updates ko startTransition me wrap karna recommended workaround hai jab tak ye fix na ho.
  • Side effects jo returned state ko affect nahi karte (analytics, toasts, focus changes) await ke baad chal sakte hain aur unhe transition ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Companion app note: modal me status/priority/assignee/label pickers wahi pattern use karte hain — hidden inputs har picker ke state ko track karte hain, key unhe success par sab reset karta hai.

step 7: ek parent ke liye signal pending vilopan (data pending + useOptimistic (false))

  • Problem: delete button server par comment delete karta hai, lekin click aur agle render ke beech card puri tarah visible rehta hai; list pending deletion nahi dikha sakti, isliye signal button se aana chahiye.
  • Fix: action ko ek <form> me wrap karo, useOptimistic(false) ke saath pending state track karo (useTransition ka isPending nahi), use data-pending attribute ke through expose karo, aur action ko deleteAction prop ke roop me accept karo taaki parent comment card CSS ke saath react kar sake:
tsx
// features/task/components/delete-button.tsx ('use client')
import { useOptimistic } from 'react'
import { Trash2 } from 'lucide-react'

export function DeleteButton({ deleteAction }: { deleteAction: () => void | Promise<void> }) {
  const [isPending, setIsPending] = useOptimistic(false)

  return (
    <form
      action={async () => {
        setIsPending(true)
        await deleteAction()
      }}
    >
      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={isPending}
        data-pending={isPending ? '' : undefined}
        aria-label="Delete comment"
      >
        <Trash2 className="size-3" />
      </button>
    </form>
  )
}
  • Parent card khud ko Tailwind ke has-data-pending: variant ke saath fade karta hai jab koi descendant data-pending set karta hai — koi lifted state ya threaded callbacks nahi:
tsx
<div className="rounded-lg px-3 transition-all has-data-pending:opacity-30">
  {/* comment content */}
  {deleteAction && <DeleteButton deleteAction={deleteAction} />}
</div>
  • Parent server component Server Function ko comment ID se bind karta hai (deleteComment.bind(null, comment.id)), DeleteButton ko reusable rakhta hai; sirf comment ke apne author ko deleteAction milta hai. Card click register hote hi 30% opacity par fade ho jata hai; server par confirmation par card unmount ho jata hai.

step 8: dohrane navigation tatkal (catch + prefetch) banaein

  • Steps 1-7 bina Cache Components ke kaam karte hain; ye step Cache Components (Next.js 16) use karta hai. Ise enable karna har route par prerender validation lagu karta hai — <Suspense> ke bahar request data (cookies(), headers(), searchParams) padhne wala root ab prerendering block karega aur Step 1 treatment chahiye. Maujooda apps ke liye Migrating to Cache Components dekho.
  • Cache reusable reads: poochho ki har read requests ke across reuse hona chahiye aur kya har write use sahi se declare kar sakta hai. Ek task per-ID tag ke saath cache karne ke liye kaafi static hai:
ts
// features/task/task-queries.ts
import { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'
import { getTaskById } from '@/lib/db'

export async function getTask(id: string) {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('hours')
  cacheTag('tasks', `task-${id}`)

  return getTaskById(id)
}
  • Per-ID tag task-${id} har task ko uska apna handle deta hai; broader tasks tag list ko cover karta hai.
  • Mutations se invalidate karo: refresh() dynamic kaam dobara chalata hai lekin cached entries ko jagah par chhod deta hai — use har tag ke liye updateTag se replace karo.
ts
// features/task/task-actions.ts
'use server'

import { updateTag } from 'next/cache'
import { updateTaskStatus } from '@/lib/db'

export async function updateStatus(taskId: string, newStatus: Status) {
  const updated = await updateTaskStatus(taskId, newStatus)
  if (!updated) {
    return { success: false as const, error: 'Task no longer exists' }
  }

  updateTag('tasks')
  updateTag(`task-${taskId}`)
  return { success: true as const, status: newStatus }
}
  • Har Server Function ek hi shape follow karta hai: write chalao, phir updateTag cached reads ko replace karta hai. Dynamic reads ke paas invalidate karne ke liye koi tag nahi, isliye un mutations ke liye refresh() use karo. Demo me comments dynamic rehte hain (readers open task page par turant updates expect karte hain) — comment add/delete karna refresh() call karta hai, task cache ko chhode bina dynamic comments dobara chalata hai.
  • Actual request ke saath destination prefetch karo: Partial Prefetching (16.3+) ke under, <Link> destination ke App Shell ko prefetch karta hai (current user ke liye links ke across shared) — shell URL data exclude karta hai (params/searchParams link-specific hain). Click se aage URL data resolve karne ke liye prefetch={true} ke saath per-link prefetching:
tsx
<Link href={`/task/${id}`} prefetch={true}>
  {/* … */}
</Link>
  • Per-link prefetching sabse valuable hai jab destination me URL-specific kaam users ko aage chahiye hone ki sambhavna hai. Cached reads prefetched output ko reusable aur Client Cache me tag-invalidatable banate hain; dynamic reads abhi bhi click se pehle resolve ho sakte hain, lekin har prefetch actual server kaam kar sakta hai. Companion app me, task cards detail page ko prefetch karte hain kyunki ve dhyaan me hain, isliye ye click par turant paint hota hai.

primitivs dhokhaa patr (disha ke agle steps se)

SituationUse
page ko blocked kiye bina data ko stream karna chahiye<Suspense>
Async vark run ke dauraan value ko update karna chahiyeuseOptimistic
Async kaam ki zaroorat pending state, error handling, ya samanvit UI updateuseTransition
ek form ko pending, reset aur parinam state ki requirement hoti haiuseActionState
ek ancestor ko kahin aur kaam karne ke liye pending state dikhana chahiyedata-pending visheshata CSS ke saath style
pun: prayojy parhne ko requests par jivit rahna chahiye aur likhne ke baad fresh rahna chahiyecacheTag ke saath 'use cache', updateTag ya revalidateTag dwara pun: valid
interactive app ke pages ke beech navigation ko turant mehsoos karna chahiyePartial Prefetching ke saath <Link> prefetch karna, prefetch={true} ke madhyam se prati-link prefetch karna

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Ek click handler se seedhe Server Function call karna aur UI ke update ki ummeed karna — agle server render tak props nahi badalte; useOptimistic use karo.
  • Optimistic handler ke andar stored prop padhna optimistic value ke bajaye — fast double-clicks tod deta hai.
  • Form clear karne ke liye ek transition ke andar useState setter use karna — ve deferred hain; current-frame effects ke liye formRef.reset() ya useOptimistic setters use karo.
  • Post-await state update (jaise dialog band karna) ko startTransition me wrap karna bhool jana — UI data se ek frame pehle update hota hai.
  • useTransition ke isPending ko ek deleted button ke pending state ke liye use karna jab pending signal CSS ke through expose hona chahiye — useOptimistic(false).
  • Broad :has() invalidation ko high-frequency interactions (drag/scroll) par toggle karna — mehnga; iske bajaye client state use karo.
  • Cache Components enable karna aur hairaan hona ki har route ab pehle validate hota hai.

interview points

  • Taskboard steps se chalo: nested <Suspense> + params.then() ke saath streaming, optimistic toggle, changeAction + data-pending ke saath reusable ChipGroup, client UUIDs ke saath optimistic comments, useOptimistic reducer ke saath drag-and-drop, useActionState + key reset, has-data-pending: ke through pending deletion.
  • Kyun useOptimistic setters current frame par lagu hote hain lekin ek transition ke andar useState setters defer hote hain.
  • Post-await transition gap aur startTransition workaround.
  • refresh() vs updateTag: kab har ek sahi hai (dynamic reads vs tagged cached reads).
  • Kaise primitives Core Web Vitals se map hote hain (streaming ke through FCP/LCP, optimistic UI/transitions ke through INP, prefetching ke through destination).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/interactive-apps
Hissa 49 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Internationalization

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Internationalization. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Internationalization — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Terminology — Locale, Routing overview, Localization (dictionaries), Sharing the locale across your app (next/root-params), Static rendering, Resources / libraries. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Next.js multiple languages ke liye routing aur rendering ko configure karne ka support karta hai: anuvaadit content (sthaniyakaran) + internationalized marg.
  • Terminology — Locale: bhasha aur formatting preferences ke ek set ke liye ek pahchankarta, aamtaur par user ki pasandida bhasha aur sanbhavath field: en-US (angrejee, US), nl-NL (dach, needaralaind), nl (dach, koi vishisht field).

routing avlokan

  • recommended: local chayan karne ke liye user ki browser bhasha priorities ka upyog karein - pasandida bhasha badalane se aane wale Accept-Language header ko sanshodhit kiya jata hai. libraries (@formatjs/intl-localematcher + negotiator) supported local logon ke khilaf header se mel khaa sakte hain:
js
import { match } from '@formatjs/intl-localematcher'
import Negotiator from 'negotiator'

let headers = { 'accept-language': 'en-US,en;q=0.5' }
let languages = new Negotiator({ headers }).languages()
let locales = ['en-US', 'nl-NL', 'nl']
let defaultLocale = 'en-US'

match(languages, locales, defaultLocale) // -> 'en-US'
  • routing ko sub-path (/fr/products) ya domain (my-site.fr/products) dwara internationalized kiya jaa sakta hai. user ko Proxy ke andar local logon ke aadhar par redirect karein:
js
// proxy.js
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";

let locales = ['en-US', 'nl-NL', 'nl']

// Get the preferred locale, similar to the above or using a library
function getLocale(request) { ... }

export function proxy(request) {
  // Check if there is any supported locale in the pathname
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl
  const pathnameHasLocale = locales.some(
    (locale) => pathname.startsWith(`/${locale}/`) || pathname === `/${locale}`
  )

  if (pathnameHasLocale) return

  // Redirect if there is no locale
  const locale = getLocale(request)
  request.nextUrl.pathname = `/${locale}${pathname}`
  // e.g. incoming request is /products
  // The new URL is now /en-US/products
  return NextResponse.redirect(request.nextUrl)
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    // Skip all internal paths (_next)
    '/((?!_next).*)',
    // Optional: only run on root (/) URL
    // '/'
  ],
}
  • phir app/[lang] ke tahat app/ ke andar sabhi vishesh files ko nested karein taaki router dynamic roop se local logon ko sambhal sake aur har layout aur page (/en-US/products → lang) ke liye lang param ko aage badhata hai. root layout ko nested (e.g) bhi kaha jaa sakta hai. app/[lang]/layout.js. "en-US"
  • PageProps aur LayoutProps global roop se upalabdh hain TypeScript helper tool jo root param ke liye mazboot typing dete hain.

sthaniyakaran (dictionary)

  • sthaniyakaran khud Next.js-vishisht nahi hai - ek hi pattern kisi bhi web app mein kaam karte hain. prati local shabdkoshon ko banaye rakhein (local strings ke liye maiping kunjiyon ko point karta hai), e.g. dictionaries/en.json (products.cart: "Add to Cart") banam dictionaries/nl.json ("Toevoegen aan Winkelwagen").
  • getDictionary ne anurodhit local logon ke liye dynamic import ke madhyam se anuvad load kiya:
ts
// app/[lang]/dictionaries.ts
import 'server-only'

const dictionaries = {
  en: () => import('./dictionaries/en.json').then((module) => module.default),
  nl: () => import('./dictionaries/nl.json').then((module) => module.default),
}

export type Locale = keyof typeof dictionaries

export const hasLocale = (locale: string): locale is Locale =>
  locale in dictionaries

export const getDictionary = async (locale: Locale) => dictionaries[locale]()
  • ek page/layout mein: lang ko string ke roop mein type kiya gaya hai; hasLocale ise supported local logon ke liye sankuchit karta hai; bina supported local logon ke liye notFound() ko call karta hai:
tsx
// app/[lang]/page.tsx
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { getDictionary, hasLocale } from './dictionaries'

export default async function Page({ params }: PageProps<'/[lang]'>) {
  const { lang } = await params

  if (!hasLocale(lang)) notFound()

  const dict = await getDictionary(lang)
  return <button>{dict.products.cart}</button> // Add to Cart
}
  • kyonki layouts/pages default Server Components mein anuvad files client JS bundle ko kabhi affected nahi karti hain - yeh code keval server par hi chalta hai aur parinamsvarup HTML browser tak pahunchta hai.

apne app (next/root-params) mein local logon ko sajha karna

  • aksar us page se pare local logon ki requirement hoti hai jo ise prapt karta hai (sheyard data-fetching upyogitaon, gehrai se nested components). prop-driling lang ke bajaay, ise seedhe next/root-params ke saath parhein, jo root layout ke upar pratyek dynamic segment ke liye ek getar export karta hai. chunki pratyek route app/[lang] ke tahat nested hai, lang ek root parameter hai jo kisi bhi Server Component ya server-side upyogita ko call kar sakta hai:
ts
// app/[lang]/dictionaries.ts
import { lang } from 'next/root-params'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'

export const getDictionary = async () => {
  const locale = await lang()
  if (!hasLocale(locale)) notFound()
  return dictionaries[locale]()
}
  • Pages/components tab koi tark ke saath getDictionary() ko bulata hai.
  • Notes: next/root-params se import karne wali files ko import 'server-only' ki requirement nahi hai - import pahle se hi build samay mein fail ho jata hai yadi Client Component mein upyog kiya jata hai. root parameter getars Server Components aur server-side upyogitaon mein chalte hain, lekin Client Components, Server Actions, ya Route Handlers mein NOT.

static rendering

  • ek page ya layout par generateStaticParams ke saath local logon ke ek set ke liye static route generated karein - e.g. global star par root layout mein:
tsx
// app/[lang]/layout.tsx
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  return [{ lang: 'en-US' }, { lang: 'de' }]
}

export default async function RootLayout({
  children,
  params,
}: LayoutProps<'/[lang]'>) {
  return (
    <html lang={(await params).lang}>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}

sansadhan / library

  • minimal i18n routing aur anuvad udaharan (vercel/next.js examples/i18n-routing); next-intl, next-international, next-i18n-router, paraglide-next, lingui, tolgee, next-intlayer, gt-next.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • app/[lang] ke tahat nested ALL vishesh files ko bhool jana - root layout shamil hai.
  • next/root-params ka upyog karne ke bajaay har jagah prop-driling lang.
  • ek Client Component, Server Action, ya Route Handler mein next/root-params ka upyog karna - yeh keval server Components/server upyogitaon mein kaam karta hai.
  • bina supported local logon ke liye notFound() ko call nahi karna - ek invalid local anyatha lapta anuvad ke saath render karega.

interview points

  • up-path banam domain aadharit i18n routing; Proxy + Accept-Language vaartaa flow (Negotiator + intl-localematcher).
  • dynamic import + server-only ke saath shabdkosh pattern; kyon anuvad filein client bundle ko blot nahi karti hain.
  • next/root-params prop-drilling vikalp aur iski boundaries ke roop mein.
  • generateStaticParams ke madhyam se local routes ki static pidhi.

How to implement JSON-LD in your Next.js application

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to implement JSON-LD in your Next.js application. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to implement JSON-LD in your Next.js application — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: JSON-LD, Implementation, Security — XSS sanitization, Validation and typing. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • JSON-LD structured data ke liye ek format hai jo search engines aur AI ek page ki structure ko shudh content se aage samajhne ke liye use karte hain — jaise ek person, event, organization, film, book, recipe ya product ka varnan.
  • Current recommendation: apne layout.js ya page.js components me <script> tag ke roop me structured data render karo.

Implementation

tsx
// app/products/[id]/page.tsx
export default async function Page({ params }) {
  const { id } = await params
  const product = await getProduct(id)

  const jsonLd = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Product',
    name: product.name,
    image: product.image,
    description: product.description,
  }

  return (
    <section>
      {/* Add JSON-LD to your page */}
      <script
        type="application/ld+json"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
          __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd).replace(/</g, '\\u003c'),
        }}
      />
      {/* ... */}
    </section>
  )
}

security - XSS svachhta

  • JSON.stringify XSS injection me use hone wale malicious strings ko sanitize NAHI karta. JSON-LD payload se HTML tags scrub karo — jaise < ko uske unicode equivalent \u003c se replace karo (upar snippet ki tarah: .replace(/</g, '\u003c')).
  • Potentially dangerous strings ko sanitize karne ke liye apne organization ke recommended approach ko review karo, ya JSON.stringify ke community alternatives jaise serialize-javascript use karo.

validation aur typing

  • Structured data ko Google ke Rich Results Test (search.google.com/test/rich-results) ya generic Schema Markup Validator (validator.schema.org) se validate/test karo.
  • TypeScript me JSON-LD type karo, community packages jaise schema-dts ke saath:
tsx
import { Product, WithContext } from 'schema-dts'

const jsonLd: WithContext<Product> = {
  '@context': 'https://schema.org',
  '@type': 'Product',
  name: 'Next.js Sticker',
  image: 'https://nextjs.org/imgs/sticker.png',
  description: 'Dynamic at the speed of static.',
}

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • JSON-LD ke liye next/script use karna — galat tool: next/script JavaScript load/execute karne ke liye optimized hai; JSON-LD structured data hai, executable code nahi, isliye native <script> tag sahi choice hai.
  • < → \u003c escaping bhoolna — ek XSS vector jab product data me user-controlled strings hon.

interview points

  • JSON-LD kya hai aur search engines/AI ko iski zaroorat kyun hai (visible content se aage structured data).
  • Ise kahan render karein (layout/page <script type="application/ld+json">), XSS sanitization ki requirement, aur ise kaise validate karein (Rich Results Test / Schema Markup Validator) aur type karein (schema-dts).
