Hissa 51 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Keeping Pages Static

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Keeping Pages Static. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Keeping Pages Static — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Example — online store (cart, product pages, buying guides). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Before Cache Components, dynamic = 'force-static', dynamic = 'force-dynamic' aur dynamic = 'error' jaise route segment config ne entire marg ke liye ek rendering mode ka chayan kiya. Cache Components ek route ko previous UI, cached kanteint aur request-vishisht kanteint ko request samay par render karne data hai - vyaktigatakaran ki requirement wale routes ke liye upyogi.
  • ensureStatic ka prayog karein jab kisi route ke kuchh ya sabhi ko bhavishyvaaniyon ke performance aur compute lagat ke liye request samay server rendering se bachna chahiye.
  • static output request-vishisht data par nirbhar nahi karta hai; Next.js request se pahle ise generated kar sakta hai aur request par iska pun: upyog kar sakta hai.
  • With Partial Prefetching, root output teen navigation steps mein upalabdh ho jata hai: (1) ek default <Link> ko load karta hai; (2) <Link prefetch={true}> us link ke URL ke liye content bhi load kar sakta hai; (3) navigation click ke baad bani hui kuchh bhi render karta hai. pratyek ensureStatic star in steps mein se ek ke madhyam se static requirement ko badhata hai: App Shell
  • 'shell' — App Shell ek default <Link> dwara load kiya gaya hai.
  • 'prefetch' - App Shell + <Link prefetch={true}> se prati-link prefetch, jismein link ke URL data (e.g) ke liye content shamil ho sakti hai. params.
  • 'navigation' — full route jismein user navigate karne ke baad pratikriya wapas aati hai.

udaharan - online store (cart, product page, guide khareednaa)

  • Setup: cacheComponents: true + partialPrefetching: true.
  • Step 1 - ek static App Shell load karein (ensureStatic = 'shell'): sajha store layout ek cookie se parhne wale visitor ki cart ki count ko darshata hai (CartButton ne cookies() ko padha). layout ise <Suspense fallback={<button>Cart (0)</button>}> mein lapeta hai. layout ke liye export const ensureStatic = 'shell' jodna ek default <Link> ko store load mein keval static App Shell (nav + Cart (0) Fallback) banata hai; server vartaman cart count ko tab tak nahi pradan karta hai jab tak ki baad mein prati-link prefetch ya navigation request karta hai. yeh user kabhi click nahi kar sakta link ke liye request samay server karya se bachata hai.
  • not: yadi keval CartButton ko App Shell se bachav ki requirement hai, to us subtree ke andar await prefetch() ko call karein; yahan requirement pure store shell (aane wala parivartan sahit) par lagu hoti hai, isliye layout ensureStatic ka upyog karta hai.
  • Step 2 - Prefetch static product vivaran (ensureStatic = 'prefetch'): product page ProductCartStatus ke saath cached ProductDetails ('use cache' query) ko jodti hai, yadi product cart mein hai to yeh jaanchne ke liye ek cookie padhti hai. alag <Suspense> boundaries vivaran ek static cart fallback ke sath render karte hain. catalog prefetch={true} ke saath link karta hai taaki prerender kiye gaye vivaran click se pahle load ho - lekin pratyek drishyaman prefetch={true} link cart action ko personalize karne ke liye ProductCartStatus ko render kar sakta hai, isliye 20 view products ka grid kisi bhi click se pahle 20 request-samay server renders ko trigger kar sakta hai. product page par export const ensureStatic = 'prefetch' jodna har product ko prefetch keval static output (cached vivaran + static "cart mein jorein" fallback); user ke link ka anusaran karne ke baad vartaman cart ki sthiti render karti hai. ek ensureStatic maan pure route ko cover karta hai, jismein us segment ke upar layout shamil hai jo ise export karta hai - product routes par 'prefetch' bhi store layout ko prati-link prefetch ke madhyam se static rakhta hai.
  • not: yadi keval ProductCartStatus ko prati-link prefetch se bachav ki zaroorat hai, to cookie parhne se pahle await navigation() ko call karein.
  • Step 3 - khareed guide (ensureStatic = 'navigation'): guide public sanpaadkeey page hain jinhein full static output wapas karna chahiye. guide page DB se content ko padhta hai aur cookie se theme lagu karta hai. next build shuru mein store/product/guide routes ke liye partial poorvnirdhaarnon (α) ko darshata hai.
  • sabse pahle, ensureStatic = 'navigation' requires ne ek eksported generateStaticParams() ko export kiya - iske bina build errors: Error: Page "/guides/[id]": ensureStatic = "navigation" requires an exported generateStaticParams() function. ne generateStaticParams() ko kam se kam ek guide ID (getGuideIds() helpar ke madhyam se); Next.js ne back ID ko build par pree-eddar kiya aur any permission prapt ID ko pahle request par, parinam ko sangrahit kiya. 'navigation' ke saath, yeh pahla request ek fallback ko chalane ke bajaay full static page ke liye wait karta hai (Cache Components ke saath ISR dekhein).
  • iske baad build report puri tarah se static nahi ho sakti: Error: Route "/guides/[id]": Next.js encountered uncached or runtime data on a route that must be fully static. fix ki peshakash: [check] "use cache" ke saath data access cache ( par lagu nahi hai); [remove] data access ko hata dein; [client] client par data parhein. sors-maipd code frame prapt karne ke liye, next dev chalaein aur route kholein, ya yadi aap keval build kar sakte hain to next build --debug-prerender ka upyog karein. connection()
  • Dev overlay the first point to the uncached DB query → Cache fix: 'use cache' ko getGuide() mein jorein (tool visitors mein sajha kiya jaa sakta hai).
  • phir shesh request-vishisht value ke liye overlay point, theme cookie → Remove fix: guide ko visitor-vishisht theme ki requirement nahi hai, isliye cookie access (optional: client par cookie parhein) ko hata dein.
  • donon fix ke baad, next build listed guide ko puri tarah se static (○) ke roop mein darshata hai jabki store/product route partial prerender (KM) bane rahe hain. Unlisted guide ID pahle request par await karte hain jabki Next.js full static page generated karta hai aur store karta hai. ensureStatic bhavishy mein parivartan ki report karega jo requirement ko tor dega.
  • parinam: store load ne apne static App Shell se navigation sajha kiya, ismein server ko run kiye bina prati-link prefetch mein cached product vivaran shamil hain, aur guide khareedne ke liye full static output data hai - vyaktigat cart data abhi bhi required hone par render karta hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • generateStaticParams() ke bina ensureStatic = 'navigation' ek build error hai.
  • yeh janne ke liye ki ensureStatic export segment ke upar layout sahit pure route ko cover karta hai.
  • Uncached DB queries ya cookie/header ne 'navigation' ko chihnit ek route par padha - build "ankechd ya runtime data" error ke saath fail rahta hai; client ko caching, hatane ya moved karke theek ho jata hai.
  • source sthanon ke bina build-time prerender errors ko kharij karna - next dev overlay ya next build --debug-prerender ka upyog karein.

interview points

  • iske viprit purv Cache Components dynamic = 'force-static' (whole-root mode) ensureStatic staron ke saath navigation steps (shell → prefetch → navigation) ke liye map kiya gaya.
  • dukaan ke udaharan ko kyon layout ke liye 'shell', product pages ke liye 'prefetch' (20 view link × request samay rendering), 'navigation' + generateStaticParams + 'use cache' + guide ke liye theme cookie ko hata dein.
  • build-error varkaflo: lapta generateStaticParams, uncached/runtime data, aur teen fix (check / nikalein / client).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/keeping-pages-static
Hissa 52 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to lazy load Client Components and libraries

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to lazy load Client Components and libraries. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to lazy load Client Components and libraries — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: next/dynamic, Importing Client Components, Skipping SSR (ssr: false), Importing Server Components, Loading external libraries, Adding a custom loading component. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • lazy load ho raha hai shuru mein load ho raha hai performance ko kam karne ke dwara JavaScript ki raashi ek route pradan karne ke liye required hai - Client Components aur imported libraries ko load karna, jismein keval client bundle mein shamil hain (e.g) user ise kholne ke liye click karne tak ek modal ko sthagit kar data hai.
  • do tarike: (1) next/dynamic ke saath Dynamic Imports; (2) Suspense ke saath React.lazy().
  • default roop se, Server Components automatic roop se code vibhajan hain, aur pragtishil roop se streaming server se client ko UI bhejtee hai. lazy loading Client Components par lagu hota hai.

next/dynamic

  • next/dynamic React.lazy() aur Suspense ka ek samagr sammishr hai; yeh app aur pages daayrektreez (aayaatkaaleen migration) mein ek hi tarah se behavior karta hai.

import Client Components

jsx
// app/page.js ('use client')
import { useState } from 'react'
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'

// Client Components:
const ComponentA = dynamic(() => import('../components/A'))
const ComponentB = dynamic(() => import('../components/B'))
const ComponentC = dynamic(() => import('../components/C'), { ssr: false })

export default function ClientComponentExample() {
  const [showMore, setShowMore] = useState(false)

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Load immediately, but in a separate client bundle */}
      <ComponentA />

      {/* Load on demand, only when/if the condition is met */}
      {showMore && <ComponentB />}
      <button onClick={() => setShowMore(!showMore)}>Toggle</button>

      {/* Load only on the client side */}
      <ComponentC />
    </div>
  )
}
  • not: jab ek Server Component dynamic roop se Client Component import karta hai, to automatic code vibhajan vartaman mein not supported hai.

SSR (ssr: jhooth) ko chhor dena

  • React.lazy() + Suspense ke saath, Client Components ko default roop se (SSR) render kiya jata hai. ek Client Component ke liye prerendering ko inactive karne ke liye, ssr: false ka upyog karein:
jsx
const ComponentC = dynamic(() => import('../components/C'), { ssr: false })
  • ssr: false keval Client Components ke liye kaam karta hai - ise client code-spliting karyon ko theek se sunishchit karne ke liye Client Components mein le jata hai.

import Server Components

  • yadi aap dynamic roop se ek Server Component import karte hain, to keval Client Components jo Server Component ke children hain, ve lazy-bhaarit hain - khud Server Component nahi. yeh Server Components mein upyog kiye jaane par CSS jaisi static assets ko purv load karne mein bhi madad karta hai.
jsx
// app/page.js
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'

// Server Component:
const ServerComponent = dynamic(() => import('../components/ServerComponent'))

export default function ServerComponentExample() {
  return (
    <div>
      <ServerComponent />
    </div>
  )
}
  • ssr: false NOT ko Server Components mein supported hai - iska upyog vahan errors ka upyog: "ssr: false ko Server Components mein next/dynamic ke saath permission nahi hai. kripya ise ek Client Component mein le jaein.

external libraries ko load karna

  • dynamic import() ke saath mang par external libraries ko load karein. udaharan: Fzzy khoj ke liye fuse.js keval khoj input mein user prakar ke baad client par load ho jata hai:
jsx
// app/page.js ('use client')
import { useState } from 'react'

const names = ['Tim', 'Joe', 'Bel', 'Lee']

export default function Page() {
  const [results, setResults] = useState()

  return (
    <div>
      <input
        type="text"
        placeholder="Search"
        onChange={async (e) => {
          const { value } = e.currentTarget
          // Dynamically load fuse.js
          const Fuse = (await import('fuse.js')).default
          const fuse = new Fuse(names)

          setResults(fuse.search(value))
        }}
      />
      <pre>Results: {JSON.stringify(results, null, 2)}</pre>
    </div>
  )
}

ek custom loading component jodna

jsx
// app/page.js ('use client')
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'

const WithCustomLoading = dynamic(
  () => import('../components/WithCustomLoading'),
  {
    loading: () => <p>Loading...</p>,
  }
)
  • loading component render karta hai jabki <WithCustomLoading/> load ho raha hai.

import naam export

  • import() Promise se named export wapas lautein:
jsx
// components/hello.js ('use client')
export function Hello() {
  return <p>Hello!</p>
}

// app/page.js
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'

const ClientComponent = dynamic(() =>
  import('../components/hello').then((mod) => mod.Hello)
)

magic ki comments

  • Next.js magic tippniyon ka support karta hai taaki yeh controlled kiya jaa sake ki kaise dynamic import bundler dwara sambhale jate hain. ve dynamic import(), require(), require.resolve() aur new Worker() abhivyaktiyon ke saath kaam karte hain. ve static import statement ke saath not kaam karte hain.
  • webpackIgnore / turbopackIgnore E - ek dynamic import bundle ko chhor dein; abhivyakti ko output mein chhor diya jata hai, jo runtime-keval module ke liye upyogi hota hai:
js
// Skip bundling - import happens at runtime
const runtime = await import(/* webpackIgnore: true */ 'runtime-module')

// Turbopack-specific variant
const plugin = await import(/* turbopackIgnore: true */ pluginPath)

// Also works with require
const mod = require(/* webpackIgnore: true */ 'runtime-module')
  • turbopackOptional (Turbopack keval) - ek module maujud nahi hone par build errors ko dabaanaa; import abhi bhi runtime par throw karta hai agar module gayab hai:
js
// No build error if './optional-feature' doesn't exist
// Runtime will throw MODULE_NOT_FOUND if executed
const feature = await import(/* turbopackOptional: true */ './optional-feature')

// Also works with require
const mod = require(/* turbopackOptional: true */ './optional-module')
  • ke liye upyogi: sashart visheshataein jo installed nahi ki jaa sakti hain; plugin system jahan module optional hain; kramik migration jahan kuchh files abhi tak maujud nahi ho sakti hain.
  • not: webpackOptional NOT supported hai - Turbopack ke bajaay turbopackOptional ka upyog karein.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • ek Server Component mein ssr: false ka upyog karna - error ka build; ise Client Component mein moved karein.
  • ek dynamic roop se imported Server Component khud ko lazy load hone ki ummid hai - keval iske Client Component children hain.
  • static import par magic comments dalna - ve keval dynamic abhivyaktiyon par kaam karte hain.
  • webpackOptional ka upyog karna - unsupported; turbopackOptional ka upyog karein.

interview points

  • jab lazy-load (bhari modals, neeche ke guna components, bare libraries) aur do tantron (next/dynamic banam React.lazy + Suspense).
  • ssr: false semantics aur iske client-Component-only pratibandha.
  • user negotiation (fuse.js pattern) par external libraries ka dynamic import aur naam-export haindlinga.
  • magic ki comments: webpackIgnore/turbopackIgnore banam turbopackOptional, aur unke runtime-vs-build-time vyavhar.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/lazy-loading
Hissa 53 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to optimize your local development environment

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to optimize your local development environment. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to optimize your local development environment — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: System configuration, 1. Antivirus, 2. Avoid Docker pitfalls (Mac/Windows), 3. Windows — Dev Drive or WSL 2, Improving application development performance, 1. Update Next.js and use Turbopack. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • next dev routes ko compile karta hai jaise tum unhe open/navigate karte ho (tez startup, kam memory) — next build + next start se alag, jo production optimizations jaise minification aur content hashes lagu karta hai.
  • Jaise app badhta hai, compilation time slow ho sakta hai; is guide me system config, app-level fixes aur diagnostic tools shamil hain.

system config

  • 1. Antivirus: AV software file access slow karta hai (Windows par sabse common).
  • Windows: project folder ko Microsoft Defender Antivirus exclusion list me jodo (Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Manage settings → Add or remove exclusions → Folder). Optional roop se ek Dev Drive use karo, jo Defender ke "performance mode" ka use karta hai.
  • macOS: terminal ke liye Gatekeeper disable karo — sudo spctl developer-mode enable-terminal chalao, phir System Settings → Privacy & Security → Developer Tools → ensure karo ki terminal listed/enabled hai, phir terminal restart karo.
  • Kisi bhi dusre employer-configured AV products ke liye settings check karo.
  • 2. Docker pitfalls se bacho (Mac/Windows): host par project files ko ek container me mount karna Docker Desktop ki host-to-VM file-sharing layer cross karta hai, jo filesystem events propagate karne me delay ya fail ho sakta hai — Fast Refresh seconds ya minutes bhi le sakta hai, jabki wahi app host par jaldi update ho jata hai. Best: dev ke dauraan bina Docker ke Next.js chalao (npm run dev / pnpm dev); Docker ko production deployments aur production builds test karne ke liye reserve karo. Agar dev ke liye Docker unavoidable hai: Linux par natively Docker chalao ya ek manually configured VM chalao jisme source code VM ke andar ho; Docker Desktop par synchronized file shares evaluate karo (latency phir bhi jodti hai, lekin polling ke bina file-watching reliability improve karti hai). watchOptions.pollIntervalMs ko Fast Refresh workaround ke roop me avoid karo — sirf last resort ke roop me; polling latency jodti hai aur CPU/I/O drastically badhati hai.
  • 3. Windows — Dev Drive ya WSL 2: Windows 11 Dev Drive ek alternative filesystem use karta hai jo dev-workflow performance improve karta hai. Optional roop se WSL 2: project ko VM filesystem ke andar store karo (jaise /home/$USER/project), Windows drive (C:\ / /mnt/c) par NAHI — warna kharab performance aur file updates sahi se reflect nahi ho sakte.

application development performance mein sudhar

  • 1. Next.js update karo aur Turbopack: har naye version me performance improvements shamil hain. Turbopack ab default dev bundler hai aur webpack se kaafi tez hai. pnpm dev --webpack (ya npm run dev -- --webpack) ke saath webpack par wapas jao.
  • 2. Apne imports check karo — import patterns compile/bundle time ko bahut affect karte hain. Tools: Dependency Cruiser, Madge.
  • Icon libraries (@material-ui/icons, @phosphor-icons/react, react-icons) hazaron icons import kar sakti hain agar tum kuch hi use karte ho. Sirf wahi import karo jo chahiye, jaise package root ke bajaye import { TriangleIcon } from '@phosphor-icons/react/dist/csr/Triangle'. react-icons ke saath, ek icon set choose karo aur usi par raho — kai sets se import karna (pi, md, tb, cg) hazaron modules kheenchta hai.
  • Barrel files (kai items re-export karne wali files) builds slow karti hain kyunki compiler ko module-scope side effects check karne ke liye unhe parse karna padta hai. Jab possible ho to seedhe specific files se import karo.
  • Package imports optimize karo: next.config.js me experimental.optimizePackageImports: ['package-name'] barrel-heavy packages ke liye jodo. Turbopack imports ko automatically analyze karta hai aur is config ki zaroorat nahi.
  • 3. Apne Tailwind CSS setup ko check karo: ek common galti ek content array hai jisme node_modules ya dusri badi directories shamil hain. Tailwind v3.4.8+ un settings ke baare me warn karta hai jo builds slow karti hain. Specific bano: content: ['./src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}'] — ../../packages/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx} jaise overly broad globs se bacho jo packages/**/node_modules se match karte hain; narrow karo jaise ../../packages/ui/src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}.
  • 4. Custom webpack settings check karo: ve compilation slow kar sakti hain; socho ki kya unhe local dev ke liye chahiye, kya kuch tools sirf production builds ke liye hone chahiye, ya iske bajaye configured loaders ke saath default Turbopack bundler use karo.
  • 5. Bahut bade apps ke liye memory usage optimize karo (Memory Usage guide dekho).
  • 6. Server Components aur data fetching: Server Components me shift karna matlab hai ki poora page locally re-render ho sakta hai, data refetch samet. Experimental serverComponentsHmrCache option Server Components ke across HMR ke dauraan fetch responses cache karta hai local dev me — tez refreshes aur kam build API calls ke liye.

samasyaon ko khojne ke liye tool

  • Detailed logging: next.config.js me logging: { fetches: { fullUrl: true } }.
  • Turbopack tracing: per-module timing aur relationships samjho. Steps: latest Next.js; pnpm dev --internal-trace (npm/yarn/bun equivalents); navigate/edit karke reproduce karo; server band karo; .next-profiles/ me ek trace-turbopack.bin file dikhai deti hai; npx next internal trace .next-profiles/trace-turbopack.bin se interpret karo (purane versions: npx next internal turbo-trace-server ...); individual timings dekhne ke liye https://trace.nextjs.org/ par "collect in order" par switch karo.
  • Abhi bhi stuck: GitHub discussions ya Discord par trace file share karo.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Mac/Windows par Docker ke andar develop karna aur slow Fast Refresh ke liye Next.js ko blame karna — ye host-to-VM file-sharing layer hai.
  • WSL 2 project ko /mnt/c par store karna VM filesystem ke andar ke bajaye.
  • Broad Tailwind content globs jo node_modules scan karte hain.
  • Pehle fix ke roop me watchOptions.pollIntervalMs use karna — high CPU/I/O cost.

interview points

  • Kyun next dev production build ki tulna me tez start hota hai (on-demand route compilation, koi minification/hashing nahi).
  • Dev me Turbopack vs webpack; kaise barrel files aur icon-library imports compile time ko hurt karte hain; optimizePackageImports.
  • Docker Desktop file-sharing aur Fast Refresh; Dev Drive / WSL 2 placement rules.
  • Server Component HMR ke liye serverComponentsHmrCache; Turbopack tracing workflow.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/local-development
Hissa 54 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Connecting coding agents to the Next.js MCP server

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Connecting coding agents to the Next.js MCP server. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Connecting coding agents to the Next.js MCP server — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: MCP (Model Context Protocol), Getting started, Capabilities, `nextjs_index`, `nextjs_call`, `nextjs_docs`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) ek khula manak hai jo AI agents/coding helper ek sajha intarafes ke madhyam se anupryogon ke saath negotiation karte hain.
  • Next.js 16+ mein, dev server /_next/mcp mein ek built-in MCP endpoint ko expose karta hai, jisse coding agent ko errors, routes, logs aur compilation muddon ke chal rahe app ko dekhne ka maukaa milta hai. next-devtools-mcp package ke madhyam se ek agent client kanekt karein.
  • aise next-dev-loop call /_next/mcp seedhe ke roop mein kaushal, isliye ve is setup ke bina kaam karte hain.

shuru karna

  • add-mcp ke saath apni machine par coding agents ke liye next-devtools-mcp installed karein:
bash
npx add-mcp next-devtools-mcp@latest
  • ya projekt root par ise .mcp.json mein jorein:
json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "next-devtools": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "next-devtools-mcp@latest"]
    }
  }
}
  • jab dev server shuru hota hai, to next-devtools-mcp chal rahe Next.js udaharan se judta hai. client-vishisht setup: agle-development-mcp bhandaara.

Capabilities

  • next-devtools-mcp agent client ko in tool data hai:
  • nextjs_index - Next.js dev server chalane ki khoj karta hai aur pratyek ekspoz mein runtime tool ko listed karta hai.
  • nextjs_call — khoje gaye dev server par ek runtime tool kahta hai.
  • nextjs_docs - node_modules/next/dist/docs/ mein installed Next.js ke saath bundle kiye gaye sanskaran-built-in docs mein agent ko point karta hai.
  • browser_eval — ek actual browser mein pages ko verify karne ke liye agent-browser CLI par agent ko point karta hai.
  • nextjs_docs aur browser_eval khud kaam nahi karte - ve us agent ko batate hain jahan docs hain / kaise CLI chalane ke liye, aur agent seedhe unka upyog karte hain.
  • Runtime tools (/_next/mcp mein dev server par nextjs_call ke madhyam se):
  • get_errors — vartaman error state: Next.js global errors (e.g). next.config validation), browser runtime errors, source maipd stack nishan ke saath errors ka nirmaan.
  • get_logs - dev log file (browser console log + server output) ka patha.
  • get_page_metadata - vartaman page render karne ke liye kya yogdan ke bare mein runtime metadata (ek browser mein khula page prapt karein).
  • get_project_metadata - project path aur dev server URL.
  • get_routes - sabhi routes jo file system ko skain karke access point ban jaenge, jo router prakar (appRouter, pagesRouter) dwara grouped honge; dynamic segment [param] / [...slug] ke roop mein dikhai dete hain.
  • get_server_action_by_id - ID → source file aur export naam se ek Server Action dekhein.
  • get_compilation_issues - sabhi routes aur return compilation muddon ( errors ko hal, lapta module, errors ko badalane); koi browser session ki zaroorat nahi; Turbopack kevala.
  • compile_route — HTTP request ke bina ek vishisht route compiled; ek routeSpecifier (e.g) accept karta hai. /blog/[slug], jaisa ki get_routes dwara lauta gaya hai) ya ek path (e.g). /blog/hello-world) ne match route ko hal kiya; compilation ke muddon ko lautaya; keval Turbopack.
  • get_request_insights - haal ke App Router request samayarekhaa, server prapt karta hai, aur local spain rikordar se cache behavior karta hai; experimental.requestInsights ki requirement hai.
  • compilation tool ke saath, agent yeh check sakte hain ki ab bhi sampadan karte samay next build chalane ke bajaay chal rahe dev server se code compiled hai ya nahi.

development workflow

1. dev server (pnpm dev / npm run dev / yarn dev / bun dev) shuru karein. 2. coding agent next-devtools-mcp ke madhyam se chal rahe udaharan se judta hai. 3. un pages ko kholein jinhein aap browser mein kaam kar rahe hain - get_errors aur get_page_metadata active browser session se parhe. 4. agent ko chal rahe app ke bare mein poochho.

Examples

  • Error detection/diagnosis: "kya errors vartaman mein mere application mein hain? → agent nextjs_index ke saath dev server ki khoj karta hai, nextjs_call ke madhyam se get_errors ko call karta hai, errors ka vishleshan karta hai aur fix ka sujhav data hai. udaharan: /about par hydration mismatch — page server par "server" aur browser mein "klieint" render karta hai; agent component ko theek karta hai aur phir se check karta hai.
  • Concepts/best prathaon: "main App Router mein 'upyog client' ka upyog kab karna chahiye? → agent ne project ke saath bundle kiye gaye sanskaran-built-in docs ko padha aur kodbes ke udaharanon ke saath jawab diya.

Ye Kaam Kaise Karta Hai

  • Next.js 16+ dev server /_next/mcp mein built-in MCP endpoint ko chalata hai. next-devtools-mcp in endpoints ki khoj karta hai aur unke saath sanvad karta hai, isliye yeh vibhinn bandaragaahon par multiple Next.js udaharanon se jur sakta hai, aage tool sahi dev server ko call karta hai, aur agent ko har udaharan ke liye upakaranon ka ek set data hai. agent pariyojnaon aur sanskaranon mein ek hi setup ka upyog karte hain.
  • antim point default roop se enable hai. ise next.config mein experimental.mcpServer: false ke saath disabled karein.

samasya nivaran - MCP server kanekt nahi hai

  • Next.js 16 ya baad mein prayog karein.
  • verify next-devtools-mcp ko agent client (e.g) mein configure kiya gaya hai. .mcp.json)
  • check experimental.mcpServer next.config mein false nahi hai.
  • dev server (npm run dev) shuru karein, ya pahle se hi chalne par ise phir shuru karein.
  • check coding agent ne MCP server configuration ko load kiya hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • ek browser mein khulne wale page ke bina kaam karne ke liye get_errors/get_page_metadata ko ekspekt karna - ve active browser satron se parhte hain.
  • chal raha hai Next.js <16 - koi built-in MCP endpoint nahi hai.
  • sampadan karte samay compilation ki check ke liye next build ka upyog karna - MCP compilation tool iske bajaay chal rahe dev server se check karte hain.

interview points

  • kya MCP hai aur kya /_next/mcp exposes; next-devtools-mcp setup (.mcp.json / add-mcp).
  • chaar client tool (nextjs_index, nextjs_call, nextjs_docs, browser_eval) aur pramukh runtime tool (get_errors, get_routes, get_compilation_issues, compile_route, get_request_insights).
  • agent ise dev paas (error Detection, version-matched docs) mein kaise istemal karte hain aur ise kaise inactive kar sakte hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/mcp
Hissa 55 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to use markdown and MDX in Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to use markdown and MDX in Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to use markdown and MDX in Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Markdown, MDX, Install dependencies, Configure next.config.mjs, Handling `.md` files, Add an mdx-components.tsx file. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Markdown plain text syntax ke saath text formatting ke liye ek halke markup bhasha hai, jise sanrachanaatmak roop se valid HTML (e.g) mein parivartit kiya gaya hai. I **love** using [Next.js](https://nextjs.org/) → <p>I <strong>love</strong> using <a href="https://nextjs.org/">Next.js</a></p>). website/blog content ke liye aama.
  • MDX markdown ka ek suparaset hai jo aapko seedhe markdown files mein JSX likhne ki permission data hai - dynamic interactivity aur content ke bhitar React components ko embedded karta hai.
  • Next.js application ke andar local MDX content ka support karta hai aur durasth MDX files ko server par dynamic roop se prapt kiya jata hai. Next.js plugin markdown + React components ko HTML mein badal data hai, jismein Server Components ( App Router default) mein upyog shamil hai.
  • ek full karya udaharan ke liye Portfolio Starter Kit template dekhein.

dependency installed karein

bash
pnpm add @next/mdx @mdx-js/loader @mdx-js/react @types/mdx

(npm/yarn/bun samtuly) @next/mdx local files se data source karta hai, jisse aap seedhe /pages ya /app mein .md/.mdx extension ke saath page bana sakte hain.

next.config.mjs

js
// next.config.mjs
import createMDX from '@next/mdx'

/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  // Configure `pageExtensions` to include markdown and MDX files
  pageExtensions: ['js', 'jsx', 'md', 'mdx', 'ts', 'tsx'],
  // Optionally, add any other Next.js config below
}

const withMDX = createMDX({
  // Add markdown plugins here, as desired
})

// Merge MDX config with Next.js config
export default withMDX(nextConfig)
  • yeh .mdx files ko pages, routes ya aayaton ke roop mein karya karta hai.
  • Handling .md files: default @next/mdx dwara keval .mdx compiled karta hai; webpack ke saath .md ko sambhalne ke liye, createMDX({...}) mein extension: /\.(md|mdx)$/ set karein.

ek mdx-components.tsx file jorein

  • mdx-components.tsx (ya .js) ko global MDX components ko define karne ke liye project root (pages/app ke saman star) par banaya gaya hai: src
tsx
// mdx-components.tsx
import type { MDXComponents } from 'mdx/types'

const components: MDXComponents = {}

export function useMDXComponents(): MDXComponents {
  return components
}
  • App Router ke saath @next/mdx ka upyog karne ke liye Required - yeh iske bina kaam nahi karega.

MDX

  • File aadharit routing: app/mdx-page/page.mdx (or .md); MDX page kisi any page ki tarah kaam karte hain, jismein App Router mein metadata shamil hain. seedhe MDX file ke andar React components ko import karein:
mdx
import { MyComponent } from 'my-component'

# Welcome to my MDX page!

This is some **bold** and _italics_ text.

This is a list in markdown:

- One
- Two
- Three

Checkout my React component:

<MyComponent />
  • Using import: kahin bhi MDX file rakhta hai (e.g). markdown/welcome.mdx) aur ise ek page mein import karein:
tsx
// app/mdx-page/page.tsx
import Welcome from '@/markdown/welcome.mdx'

export default function Page() {
  return <Welcome />
}
  • Using dynamic import: ek dynamic route segment ek alag directory se MDX components ko load kar sakta hai. Prerender routes ke liye generateStaticParams ka upyog karein; import karne se pahle anurodhit slag maips ko actual file mein check karein aur yadi yeh nahi karta hai to notFound() ko call karein:
tsx
// app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'

const contentSlugs = ['welcome', 'about']

export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params

  if (!contentSlugs.includes(slug)) {
    notFound()
  }

  const { default: Post } = await import(`@/content/${slug}.mdx`)

  return <Post />
}

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return contentSlugs.map((slug) => ({ slug }))
}
  • import mein .mdx extension nirdisht karein. module path aliases (@/content) optional lekin saral path hain.

custom styles aur components ka upyog karna

  • mool HTML elements (## heading → <h2>, list → <ul><li>) ke liye markdown ke nakshe. un elements ko map karne wale custom component pradan karein - global star par, local roop se, ya sajha layout ke madhyam se.
  • Global: mdx-components.tsx mein , sabhi MDX files ko affected karta hai - e.g. custom h1 (laal, 48px) aur img ko next/image (sizes="100vw", full chaudai, auto oonchaaee) ke liye map kiya gaya.
  • Local: ek imported MDX component mein components ko paas karta hai - ve global logon ke saath vilay aur override karte hain:
tsx
// app/mdx-page/page.tsx
import Welcome from '@/markdown/welcome.mdx'

function CustomH1({ children }) {
  return <h1 style={{ color: 'blue', fontSize: '100px' }}>{children}</h1>
}

const overrideComponents = {
  h1: CustomH1,
}

export default function Page() {
  return <Welcome components={overrideComponents} />
}
  • Shared layout: built-in layout support ka upyog karta hai - ek app/mdx-page/layout.tsx raiping bachchon (e.g). <div>
  • Tailwind typography plugin: @tailwindcss/typography markdown content par taaipograaphik styles ke liye prose kakshaon ko jodta hai; ek sajha layout, e.g ke saath gathabandhana. <div className="prose prose-headings:mt-8 prose-headings:font-semibold...">

Frontmatter

  • frontmatter (YAML-jaise key/value jore ek page ke bare mein data storage) not default roop se @next/mdx dwara supported hai. samadhan: remark-frontmatter, remark-mdx-frontmatter, gray-matter
  • @next/mdx does kisi any JS component ki tarah export ki permission data hai:
mdx
// content/blog-post.mdx
export const metadata = {
  author: 'John Doe',
}

# Blog post
  • metadata ko MDX file ke bahar sandarbhit kiya jaa sakta hai:
tsx
// app/blog/page.tsx
import BlogPost, { metadata } from '@/content/blog-post.mdx'

export default function Page() {
  console.log('metadata: ', metadata)
  //=> { author: 'John Doe' }
  return <BlogPost />
}
  • common upyog ka mamla: keval Node ke fs module ya globby server-side ka upyog karke MDX padon aur data nikalne (e.g) ke ek sangrah par iterate.

comment aur rehype plagins

  • optional roop se MDX content, e.g ko badalane ke liye remark/rehype plagins pradan karte hain. GitHub Flavored Markdown ke liye remark-gfm chunki remark/rehype ecosystem tantr ESM-keval hai, next.config.mjs ya next.config.ts ka upyog karein:
js
// next.config.mjs
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm'
import createMDX from '@next/mdx'

const nextConfig = {
  pageExtensions: ['js', 'jsx', 'md', 'mdx', 'ts', 'tsx'],
}

const withMDX = createMDX({
  options: {
    remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm],
    rehypePlugins: [],
  },
})

export default withMDX(nextConfig)
  • With Turbopack: latest @next/mdx mein upgrade karta hai aur strings ke roop mein plugin namon ko nirdisht karta hai ([name, options] tuples ke vikalp ke saath), e.g. remarkPlugins: ['remark-gfm', ['remark-toc', { heading: 'The Table' }]], rehypePlugins: ['rehype-slug', ['rehype-katex', { strict: true, throwOnError: true }]]
  • Note: remark/rehype plagins ka upyog abhi tak Turbopack ke saath nahi kiya jaa sakta hai, kyonki JavaScript phankshans ko rust mein nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.

deep gotaa: kaise markdown HTML ho jata hai

  • React mool roop se markdown ko nahi samajhta; saadetekst ko HTML mein remark (markdown ecosystem tantr) aur rehype (HTML ecosystem tantr) ke madhyam se parivartit kiya jana chahiye.
js
import { unified } from 'unified'
import remarkParse from 'remark-parse'
import remarkRehype from 'remark-rehype'
import rehypeSanitize from 'rehype-sanitize'
import rehypeStringify from 'rehype-stringify'

async function main() {
  const file = await unified()
    .use(remarkParse) // Convert into markdown AST
    .use(remarkRehype) // Transform to HTML AST
    .use(rehypeSanitize) // Sanitize HTML input
    .use(rehypeStringify) // Convert AST into serialized HTML
    .process('Hello, Next.js!')

  console.log(String(file)) // <p>Hello, Next.js!</p>
}
  • ecosystem tantr mein sintaiks highlighting (rehype-pretty-code) ke liye plagins hain, jo hedings (rehype-autolink-headings) ko jorte hain, jo content (remark-toc) ki ek talika generated karte hain, aur adhika. @next/mdx ke saath aap seedhe remark/rehype ka upyog nahi karte - yeh aapke liye sambhala gaya hai.

Rust-based MDX compiler (visheshajny)

  • Next.js ek naya rast MDX compiler ka support karta hai - abhi bhi experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. config mein experimental.mdxRs: true ke madhyam se enable karein withMDX ko passed kiya gaya. mdxRs ek object ko bhi accept karta hai: jsxRuntime, jsxImportSource, providerImportSource (ek useMDXComponents sandarbh pradan karne wala module), mdxType: 'gfm' | 'commonmark'.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Forgetting mdx-components.tsx — App Router MDX ne iske bina kaam nahi kiya.
  • default roop se @next/mdx compilation .md ka estimate karna - yeh keval .mdx ko compiled karta hai jab tak extension set nahi kiya jata hai.
  • box se frontmatter support ki ummid karna - remark-frontmatter/gray-matter ya export pattern ka upyog karein.
  • Turbopack ke saath gair-serialization plugin vikalp paas karna - karya Rust ko par nahi kar sakte; string plugin namon ka upyog karein.
  • client par MDX metadata ke liye fs/globby ka upyog karna - server-side kevala.

interview points

  • markdown banam MDX; @next/mdx setup (installed, pageExtensions, withMDX, mdx-components.tsx requirement).
  • teen rendering drishtikon: file aadharit routing, import, generateStaticParams + notFound() ke saath dynamic import.
  • global banam local component override aur sajha layout; Tailwind typography prose.
  • frontmatter vikalp (export pattern); remark/rehype pipeline (parse → HTML AST → sanitize → stringify); Turbopack string plugin badha; experimental mdxRs.

Hissa 56 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to optimize memory usage

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to optimize memory usage. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to optimize memory usage — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Reduce number of dependencies, experimental.webpackMemoryOptimizations, next build --experimental-debug-memory-usage, Record a heap profile, Analyze a snapshot of the heap, Webpack build worker. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Jaise apps badhte hain aur zyada feature-rich bante hain, ve local dev aur production builds me zyada resources demand karte hain. Ye guide memory optimize karne aur common memory issues address karne ki strategies ikatthi karta hai.

dependency ki sankhya kam karein

  • Zyada dependencies wale apps zyada memory use karte hain. Bundle Analyzer (Package Bundling guide dekho) performance aur memory improve karne ke liye badi dependencies investigate karne me madad karta hai.

experimental.webpackMemoryOptimizations

  • v15.0.0 ke baad se: next.config.js me experimental.webpackMemoryOptimizations: true jodo taaki Webpack behavior badle aur max memory usage kam ho jaye, compilation time me halki si badhotri ki cost par. Abhi experimental hai (zyada projects par test ho raha hai) lekin low-risk mana jata hai.

agla build - anubhavaheen-dibag-memory-upyog

  • 14.2.0 ke baad se: next build --experimental-debug-memory-usage — Next.js build ke dauraan memory usage ki jankari lagatar print karta hai (heap usage, garbage collection stats). Jab memory usage configured limit ke paas pahunch jata hai to heap snapshot automatically liya jata hai.
  • Webpack build worker option ke saath compatible nahi hai, jo auto-enable hota hai jab tak tumhare paas custom webpack configuration na ho.

ek hep profile rikord karein

  • Build start karte samay --heap-prof Node.js ko pass karo:
sh
node --heap-prof node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build
  • Build ke ant me Node.js ek .heapprofile file banata hai; use Chrome DevTools → Memory tab → "Load Profile" me kholo visualize karne ke liye.

hep ka ek snapshot ka vishleshan karein

  • next build / next dev se pehle NODE_OPTIONS=--inspect jodo taaki inspector agent default port par expose ho (--inspect-brk kisi bhi user code ke start hone se pehle break karne ke liye). Jab chal raha ho, Chrome DevTools se connect karo, ek heap snapshot record aur analyze karo ye dekhne ke liye ki kaunsi memory retain ho rahi hai.
  • 14.2.0 se, next build --experimental-debug-memory-usage snapshots ko aasan banata hai: kisi bhi point par process ko ek SIGUSR2 signal bhejo aur ye ek heap snapshot leta hai, project root me save hota hai, jo kisi bhi heap analyzer (jaise Chrome DevTools) me load ho sakta hai. Abhi tak Webpack build workers ke saath compatible nahi hai. Chrome ke "record and analyze heap snapshots" docs dekho.

Webpack build worker

  • Webpack compilations ko ek alag Node.js worker ke andar chalata hai, jo builds ke dauraan memory usage kam karta hai. Default roop se enabled agar app me koi custom Webpack config nahi hai (v14.1.0). Purane versions par ya custom webpack config ke saath, next.config.js me experimental.webpackBuildWorker: true ke saath enable karo.
  • Saare custom Webpack plugins ke saath compatible nahi ho sakta.

Webpack cache ko disabled karein

  • Webpack cache generated modules ko memory me aur/ya disk par save karta hai taaki builds tez hon — lekin memory usage badhata hai. Custom webpack config ke through disable karo:
js
// next.config.mjs
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  webpack: (
    config,
    { buildId, dev, isServer, defaultLoaders, nextRuntime, webpack }
  ) => {
    if (config.cache && !dev) {
      config.cache = Object.freeze({
        type: 'memory',
      })
    }
    // Important: return the modified config
    return config
  },
}

export default nextConfig

inactive static vishleshan (typechecking)

  • Typechecking badi projects me bahut zyada memory demand kar sakta hai; aksar projects ke paas ek dedicated CI runner hota hai jo ise handle karta hai. Agar "Running TypeScript" step ke dauraan build OOM hota hai, to builds ke dauraan ise disable karo:
js
// next.config.mjs
const nextConfig = {
  typescript: {
    // !! WARN !!
    // Dangerously allow production builds to successfully complete even if
    // your project has type errors.
    // !! WARN !!
    ignoreBuildErrors: true,
  },
}
  • Warning: ye type errors ki wajah se faulty deployments produce kar sakta hai. Sirf static analysis ke baad build ko promote karo — Vercel par, platform deployment use karta hai aur custom tasks succeed hone ke baad promote karta hai.

source ke nakshe ko disabled karein

  • Source maps banane me extra memory consume hoti hai. productionBrowserSourceMaps: false aur experimental.serverSourceMaps: false ke saath disable karo. Next.js next build ke previous step ke dauraan default roop se source maps use karta hai; agar tum us step ke dauraan lagatar memory issues face karte ho ("Generating static pages"), unhe enablePrerenderSourceMaps: false ke saath disable karo. Note: kuch plugins source maps par depend kar sakte hain aur disable karne ke liye custom config chahiye ho sakti hai.

Edge memory issues

  • Next.js v14.1.3 ne Edge runtime use karte samay ek memory issue fix kiya — us version ya baad me update karo agar ye tumhare issues address karta hai.

preloading entries

  • Jab Next.js server start hota hai, to ye har page ke JavaScript modules ko memory me preload karta hai (request time ke bajaye) tez response times ke liye, ek bade initial memory footprint ke badle me. experimental.preloadEntriesOnStart: false ke saath disable karo:
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const config: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    preloadEntriesOnStart: false,
  },
}

export default config
  • Note: Next.js in JS modules ko unload nahi karta, isliye optimization ke saath server ka memory footprint inactive rehta hai, aur ant me usi level tak pahunch jata hai jab saare pages eventually request ho jate hain.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • OOM build fix karne ke liye typechecking (ignoreBuildErrors) disable karna aur phir bina kisi type check ke production build ship karna.
  • preloadEntriesOnStart: false ko permanently memory kam karne ke roop me treat karna — saare pages request hone ke baad footprint converge ho jata hai.
  • --experimental-debug-memory-usage Webpack build worker ke saath incompatible hai.

interview points

  • Diagnostic ladder: Bundle Analyzer → --experimental-debug-memory-usage → --heap-prof / --inspect heap snapshots → SIGUSR2 snapshots.
  • Har lever ke trade-offs: webpackMemoryOptimizations (memory vs compile time), webpack cache disable karna (memory vs build speed), source maps/typechecking disable karna (memory vs debuggability/safety).
  • Webpack build worker (custom webpack config ke bina 14.1.0 ke baad se default) aur entry preloading behavior.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/memory-usage
