Hissa 58 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to migrate from Pages to the App Router

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to migrate from Pages to the App Router. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to migrate from Pages to the App Router — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Upgrading, Upgrading new features (work in both routers), `<Image/>`, `<Link>`, `<Script>`, Font optimization. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • teen-bhag guide: (1) update Next.js 12 → 13; (2) upgrade suvidhaein jo pages aur app donon mein kaam karti hain; (3) vriddhi se pages se app tak migrate hoti hai. video: "anivarya roop se App Router" (YouTube, 16 minat) ko apnaein.
  • app directory janboojhkar vriddhishil page-dar-page migration ke liye pages ke saath milakar kaam karne ke liye design ki gai hai - sanyukt jatilta ko kam karne ke liye migration ko chhote steps mein tor dein (server Components/Suspense jaisi nai Next.js features ke saath-saath vishesh files/layouts jaise naye Next.js conventions). React

Upgrading

  • minimum Node.js sanskaran: v18.17 E.
  • update: pnpm add next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest (npm/yarn/bun samakaksh). ESLint: pnpm add -D eslint-config-next@latest - ko VS Code (Command Palette → ESLint: Restart ESLint Server) mein ESLint server ko phir shuruaat karne ki requirement ho sakti hai.

nai features ko upgrade karna (donon routers mein kaam karna)

  • Next.js 13 mein upgrade karne ke liye not ko App Router ka upyog karne ki requirement hoti hai - aap nai features ke saath pages ka upyog kar rakh sakte hain.
  • <Image/>: Next.js 12 ke sudhar (next/future/image — kam client JS, aasan styling, behatar a11y, mool lazy loading) V13 mein next/image ke liye default ban gaya. Codemods: next-image-to-legacy-image (surakshit roop se next/image ka naam badalakar next/legacy/image mein import karta hai, behavior ko preserve karta hai) aur next-image-experimental (Dangerly inline styles/removes anaprayukt props ko naye dipholts se match karne ke liye jodta hai - pahla legacy codemod chalaein).
  • <Link>: ko ab manual roop se nested <a> children ki requirement nahi hai - <Link> hamesha <a> aur phoravards props pradan karta hai:
jsx
// Next.js 12
<Link href="/about">
  <a>About</a>
</Link>

// Next.js 13
<Link href="/about">
  About
</Link>

new-link codemod ke saath upgrade karein.

  • <Script>: donon pages aur app ka support karta hai, lekin: _document.js se ek root layout mein beforeInteractive script ko moved karta hai; experimental worker ranniti app mein kaam nahi karti hai (nikalein ya svich karein, e.g. se lazyOnload); onLoad/onReady/onError handler Server Components mein kaam nahi karte hain - unhein Client Component mein moved karein ya unhein hata dein.
  • Font optimization: v13 donon directories mein supported next/font (optimization font load ho raha hai, mahaan performance + privacy) pesh karta hai. Inlining font CSS abhi bhi pages mein kaam karta hai lekin app mein nahi - iske bajaay next/font ka upyog karein.

pages se app tak migrate karna - concept manchitran

Pages Router App Router
pages/_app.js + pages/_document.jssingle app/layout.js root layout
pages/_error.jsdanedar error.js vishesh file
pages/404.jsnot-found.js
pages/api/* API rootRoute Handlers route.js
getServerSideProps / getStaticPropsapp ke andar naya data-fetching API (Fetch + async Server Components)
getStaticPathsgenerateStaticParams
next/headbuilt-in Metadata API

step 1: app directory banaein

  • latest Next.js (13.4+ ki requirement) ko update karein, phir projekt root (ya src/) par ek nai app directory banaein.

step 2: ek root layout banaein

  • app/layout.tsx ki requirement hai; ise <html> aur <body> (Next.js) ko define karna hoga aur children ko accept karna hoga:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}
  • built-in Metadata API (export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Home', description: 'Welcome to Next.js' }) ke saath <head> ka prabandhan karein.
  • Migrating _document.js / _app.js: pratilipi content (e.g. global styles) root layout ke liye - lekin app/layout.tsx mein styles NOT ko lagu karte hain, isliye _app/_document ko rokte hue pages/* routes ko torne se bachne ke liye migrate karte hain; unhein puri tarah se migrate karne ke liye keval ek bar hata dein. React sandarbh pradataon ko ek Client Component mein moved karna hoga. pages/*
  • Migrating the getLayout() pattern (optional): page pattern (Page.getLayout = (page) => <DashboardLayout>{page}</DashboardLayout>) ko mool nested layout dwara replace kiya gaya hai: Page.getLayout ko hata dein, DashboardLayout content ko Client Component ('use client') mein le jaein aur ise app/dashboard/layout.js (A Server Component) mein import karein. non-interactive bhagon ko client JS ko kam karne ke liye Client Component se layout.js mein badhaya jaa sakta hai.

Step 3: Migrating next/head

  • next/head → Metadata API:
tsx
// Before (pages/index.tsx)
import Head from 'next/head'
export default function Page() {
  return (
    <>
      <Head>
        <title>My page title</title>
      </Head>
    </>
  )
}

// After (app/page.tsx)
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'My Page Title',
}
export default function Page() {
  return '...'
}

step 4: migrating page

  • app mein page default roop se Server Components hain ( pages mein ve Client Components the). roots nested folders + ek vishesh page.js file ka upyog kiya: index.js → page.js (/), about.js → about/page.js (/about), blog/[slug].js → blog/[slug]/page.js (/blog/post-1).
  • recommended do-step path (pages ke liye sabse adhik comparative behavior):
  • Step 1: default export page component ko ek naye Client Component file (e.g) mein le jata hai. 'use client' ke saath top par, import se pahle, app/home-page.tsx). yeh props ke roop mein data prapt karta hai, ismein state/effects hai, aur initial load ke dauraan server par prerender kiya jata hai.
  • Step 2: app/page.tsx (a Server Component) ko default roop se banate hain, Client Component import karte hain aur naye APIs ka upyog karke seedhe Server Component mein data prapt karte hain:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
import HomePage from './home-page'

async function getPosts() {
  const res = await fetch('https://...')
  const posts = await res.json()
  return posts
}

export default async function Page() {
  const recentPosts = await getPosts()
  return <HomePage recentPosts={recentPosts} />
}
  • yadi purane page mein useRouter ka upyog kiya jata hai, to naye routing hook ko update karein. dev server shuru karein aur ab app ke madhyam se serve karne wale index route ko verify karne ke liye http://localhost:3000 par jaein.

step 5: migrating routing hook

  • keval next/navigation (Client Components) se naye hook: useRouter(), usePathname(), useSearchParams() (plus useParams).
  • next/router ke useRouter se antar:
  • next/router sanskaran NOT ko app (pages mein abhi tak kaam karta hai) mein supported hai.
  • new useRouter return no pathname string - usePathname() ka upyog karein. koi query objekt - khoj param aur dynamic param alag hain (useSearchParams, useParams).
  • hata diya gaya: isFallback (fallback replace - step 6) dekhein, locale / locales / defaultLocale / domainLocales (bilt-in i18n ab app mein required nahi), basePath (optional abhi tak lagu nahi), asPath (as concept chala gaya hai), isReady (ab required nahi hai - useSearchParams() ka upyog karne wale component prerendering ko chhorte hain aur client ko runtime par render karte hain), route ( ya useSelectedLayoutSegments()). usePathname
  • router.push() / router.replace() ab ek Promise wapas nahi lautte - ve route ko React transition ke roop mein badal dete hain aur turant wapas lautte hain. pending sthiti ke liye, unhein useTransition se startTransition ke andar call karein aur isPending parhein.
  • useSearchParams + usePathname ek saath page parivartan (Router Events) sun sakte hain.
  • pages aur app ke beech Sharing component: next/compat/router (pages) se useRouter ka upyog karta hai, jiska uddeshy sajha components ke liye hai); ek bar next/navigation par svich karein, jab component app-keval hai.

step 6: data prapt karne ke tarikon ko migrate karna

  • getServerSideProps / getStaticProps → saral API fetch() + async Server Components par banaya gaya:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
export default async function Page() {
  // Similar to `getStaticProps` — cached, reusable across requests, revalidated on demand
  const cachedData = await fetch('https://...', { cache: 'force-cache' })

  // Similar to `getServerSideProps` — fetched on every request (default fetch behavior)
  const uncachedData = await fetch('https://...', { cache: 'no-store' })

  // Similar to `getStaticProps` with `revalidate` — cached, revalidated at most every 10s
  const revalidatedData = await fetch('https://...', {
    next: { revalidate: 10 },
  })

  return <div>...</div>
}
  • getServerSideProps → ek Async Server Component mein { cache: 'no-store' } E ke saath sahas thaapit prapt — kam JS client ke liye, ek hi server-render HTML.
  • Accessing request object: getServerSideProps({ req, query }) (Node HTTP API - req.getHeaders()['authorization'], req.cookies['theme']) ko Server Components: headers() ((await headers()).get('authorization')) aur cookies() ((await cookies()).get('theme')) mein Server Components mein keval web-API karyon dwara replace kiya gaya hai. next/headers
  • getStaticProps → fetch() default cache: 'force-cache' E ke saath ( manual roop se avaidh hone tak pakar liya gaya).
  • getStaticPaths → generateStaticParams: ne API ko sarleekrit kiya - nested param objekts ke bajaay segment ([{ id: '1' }, { id: '2' }]) ki ek sarani lauta di; ise layout ke andar bhi istemal kiya jaa sakta hai. get prefix → generate (adhik varnanatmak ab getStaticProps/getServerSideProps chala gaya hai); Paths → Params (ek se adhik dynamic segments ke saath nested routing phit baithta hai).
  • Replacing fallback: getStaticPaths ke fallback: true | false | 'blocking' ko dynamicParams dwara replace kiya gaya hai:
  • true (default): dynamic segment generateStaticParams mein nahi mang par generated hote hain.
  • false: unlisted dynamic segments 404 wapas lautte hain.
  • fallback: 'blocking' ke paas koi samtuly nahi hai - 'blocking' aur true ke beech ka antar streaming ke saath atuly hai.
  • ISR (getStaticProps) → fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 60 } }). revalidate
  • API roots → Route Handlers: pages/api aprivartit kaam jari rakhta hai, lekin app samtuly web Request/Response APIs (export async function GET(request: Request) {}) ke saath route.js hai. yadi aap pahle client se external API ko call karne ke liye API routes ka upyog karte hain, to aap ab surakshit roop se prapt karne ke liye Server Components ka upyog kar sakte hain.

step 7: styling

  • pages mein, global stylesheet pages/_app.js tak simit hain; app mein pratibandh uthaya jata hai - global styles ko kisi bhi layout, page ya component mein joda jaa sakta hai. CSS module, Tailwind, global styles, CSS-in-JS, external stylesheet, Sass ko cover karta hai.
  • Tailwind: ne tailwind.config.js content ('./app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}') ko app directory jor di aur app/layout.js (import '../styles/globals.css') mein global styles ka import kiya.

Pages Router ke saath App Router ka upyog karna

  • vibhinn routers dwara serve ki gayi routes ke beech navigate karna ek hard nevigeshan — next/link prefetching routers mein prefetch nahi karta hai. navigation ko prefetched/fast transition ko banaye rakhne ke liye customize kiya jaa sakta hai (Vercel guide: "kathor navigation ko dabaane").

Codemods

  • Next.js deprecated features ke liye codemod parivartan pradan karta hai - Codemods guide dekhein.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • puri tarah se migrate karne se pahle _app/_document ko hatane - pages/* routes ko torne (root-layout style un par lagu nahi hoti).
  • app mein next/router ke useRouter ka upyog karna - unsupported; next/navigation ka upyog karein (aur usePathname/useSearchParams ke bajaay pathname/query).
  • app mein ek Promise wapas karne ke liye router.push() ki ummid - yeh turant wapas lauta hai; pending state ke liye useTransition ke isPending ka upyog karein.
  • migrated page component par 'use client' ko bhool jana - app page default roop se Server Components hain.
  • fallback: 'blocking' ka estimate ek seedha samakaksh hai - yeh nahi hai; dynamicParams: true mein demand pidhi ko shamil kiya gaya hai.

interview points

  • vriddhishil migration ranniti (don router sah-astitv; page-dar-page) aur full concept map (_app/_document → root layout, getStaticProps → force-cache, getServerSideProps → no-store, getStaticPaths → generateStaticParams, fallback → dynamicParams).
  • kyon do step page migration (Client Component + Server Component page) sabse surakshit path hai.
  • naya routing hook aur kya hata diya gaya hai banam next/router; sajha components ke liye next/compat/router.
  • routers aur prefetching boundary ke beech hard navigation.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/migrating/app-router-migration
Hissa 59 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to migrate from Create React App to Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to migrate from Create React App to Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to migrate from Create React App to Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why switch?, Slow initial page load, No automatic code splitting, Network waterfalls, Fast, intentional loading states, Choose the data-fetching strategy. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

kyon svich?

  • Slow initial page load: CRA puri tarah se client side rendering (SPA) hai - browser ko React code ko download karna aur chalane chahiye aur isse pahle ki yeh data load karne ke liye request bhi bhej sakta hai; bundle har feature/dependency. ke saath badhta hai.
  • No automatic code vibhajan: manual code vibhajan anjaane mein network jharne pesh kar sakte hain. Next.js apne router mein built-in automatic code vibhajan aur per-sheking pradan karta hai aur pipe line ka build karta hai.
  • Network waterfall: SPA pattern (render plesholdar → mount ke baad prapt) ka matalab hai ki bachcha apne parent ke khatm hone ke baad hi prapt karna shuru kar sakta hai - sequential requests ka ek waterfall. Next.js client-side lane ka support karta hai, lekin aapko server mein lane ki permission data hai, aksar puri tarah se jharne ko nasht kar data hai.
  • Fast, janboojhkar loading rajyon: ne React Suspense ke madhyam se built-in streaming ki feature aapko yeh define karne ki permission deti hai ki kaun se UI pahle aur kis kram mein load karta hai, bina jharne - tej page, kam layout shiphta.
  • Choose data-fetching ranniti prati page/component: SSG build samay (e.g) para. CMS blog post) ya SSR request samay para.
  • Proxy: ek request pura karne se pahle server par run code - e.g. login karne ke liye unauthenticated upyogkartaon ko redirect karein (Unauthenticated content ki koi flash nahi), A/B testing, prayog, i18n.
  • Built-in optimization: images, font, third-party lipiyon ko automatic roop se vishesh components/APIs. ke madhyam se customize kiya jata hai.

migration ranniti

  • Goal: jaldi se sanbhav ke roop mein ek kaam kar rahe Next.js application prapt karein, phir Next.js features ko badhane ke liye encourage karein. application ko vishuddh roop se client-side SPA Non ke roop mein turant maujuda router ko replace karke shuru karein - jatilta ko kam karta hai aur sangharsh ko kam karta hai.
  • not: advanced CRA config (package.json mein custom homepage, custom serve worker, vishisht Babel/webpack tweaks) ko ant mein Additional Considerations section ki requirement hoti hai.

step 1: Next.js installed karein

bash
pnpm add next@latest

(npm/yarn/bun samakaksh)

step 2: Next.js config file banaein

  • project root par next.config.ts banaein:
ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  output: 'export', // Outputs a Single-Page Application (SPA)
  distDir: 'build', // Changes the build output directory to `build`
}

export default nextConfig
  • not: output: 'export' = static export - NO server-side features jaise SSR ya API tak pahuncha. Next.js server features ka labh uthane ke liye line ko hata dein.

step 3: root layout banaein

  • ek App Router app mein root layout (ek React Server Component sabhi pages ko lapetakar) shamil hona chahiye. iski nikatatam CRA samtuly public/index.html (<html>, <head>, <body>) hai.
  • src/ (ya projekt root par) aur app/layout.tsx ke andar app/ banaein; purani index.html content ko iski pratilipi banaein, body div#root (aur body noscript) ko <div id="root">{children}</div> ke saath badal dein.
  • Next.js CRA ke public/manifest.json ko andekha karta hai, extra aaikonograaphee aur default roop se config ka testing karta hai - Metadata API aur testing setup yadi required ho to inhein cover karta hai.

step 4: metadata

  • Next.js mein automatic roop se <meta charset="UTF-8" /> aur viewport meta tag shamil hain - unhein <head> se hata dein.
  • metadata files (favicon.ico, icon.png, robots.txt) ko app/ ke top level par rakha gaya hai, automatic roop se <head> mein joda jata hai - unhein moved karne ke baad, unke <link> tag ko hata dein.
  • ant mein ek eksported metadata objekt mein shesh <head> jankari ko moved karein:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'React App',
  description: 'Web site created with Next.js.',
}

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <div id="root">{children}</div>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
  • yeh convention-aadharit Metadata API drishtikon SEO aur saajhaataa ko behatar banata hai.

step 5: shailiyan

  • Next.js CSS module aur global CSS ko CRA jaise box se bahar ka support karta hai. ek global CSS file ko app/layout.tsx (import '../index.css') mein import karein. Tailwind ke liye, CSS instoleshan docs dekhein.

step 6: access point page (optional catch-all route) banaein

  • CRA ka access point src/index.tsx hai; App Router mein pratyek folder mein app/ ek page.tsx ke saath ek route hai. application ko ab ke liye SPA rakhne ke liye aur all routes ko intercepting karne ke liye, ek optional catch-all route app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx ka upyog karein:
tsx
export function generateStaticParams() {
  return [{ slug: [''] }]
}

export default function Page() {
  return '...' // We'll update this
}
  • yeh khali slag (/) ke liye ek single route generated karta hai, prabhavi roop se usi page par sabhi routes ko map karta hai (Server Component), jise static HTML mein render kiya jata hai).

step 7: ek client-keval access point jorein

  • ek Client Component ke andar CRA root App component ko embed karein taaki sabhi tark client-side rahta hai. Client Components ko abhi bhi default roop se server par pahle se render kiya gaya hai - unhein lagta hai ki client-side JS chalane ki extra kshamata hai.
tsx
// app/[[...slug]]/client.tsx
'use client'

import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'

const App = dynamic(() => import('../../App'), { ssr: false })

export function ClientOnly() {
  return <App />
}
  • 'use client' ise Client Component banata hai; ssr: false ke saath dynamic ko <App /> ke liye SSR ko inactive karta hai, jisse yeh vastav mein client-keval (SPA) ban jata hai. phir page.tsx <ClientOnly /> pradan karta hai.

step 8: update static image import

  • CRA: ek image ko import karne ke liye apne public URL ko string (import image from './img.png' → <img src={image} />) ke roop mein lautaya jata hai.
  • Next.js: static image import ek object wapas lautte hain. ise seedhe <Image> (automatic optimization) ke saath prayog karein; auto width/height layout badlav ko rokta hai - lekin keval ek dimension ke saath chitrit images ko vikrit kar sakta hai jo auto ke liye set nahi hai) ya maujuda <img> tag ke saath objekt ke src ka upyog karta hai (fewer change, viroopan issues se bachata hai; baad mein <Image> mein migrate kar sakta hai, optional roop se ek configure loader ke saath).
  • /public se relative import (import logo from '../public/logo.png') mein full import ko parivartit karein; logo.src ke bajaay logo.src ko <img> mein paas karein. optional roop se file naam (public/logo.png → /logo.png) dwara public URL ka sandarbh lein. logo
  • TypeScript warning: .src tak pahunch error ho sakti hai - tsconfig.json ki include array mein next-env.d.ts jor sakte hain (Next.js auto-generates is file ko jab app run hota hai).

step 9: migrate environment variables

  • Next.js CRA ki tarah env vars ka support karta hai lekin requires browser-exposed char ke liye ek NEXT_PUBLIC_ upasarg karta hai. sabhi REACT_APP_ char ko NEXT_PUBLIC_ mein badlein.

step 10: package.json mein update script

json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "npx serve@latest ./build"
  }
}
  • .next aur next-env.d.ts ko .gitignore mein jorein. pnpm dev ko chalaein aur http://localhost:3000 ko kholein - yeh app ab Next.js ( SPA mode mein) par chalta hai.

step 11: clean ap

  • CRA-vishisht artifacts ko hata dein: public/index.html, src/index.tsx, src/react-app-env.d.ts, reportWebVitals setup aur react-scripts dependency.

extra vichar

  • Custom homepage: next.config.ts mein basePath: '/my-subpath' ke saath dohrata hai.
  • Custom serve worker: ise await navigator.serviceWorker.register(new URL('../serviceWorker.js', import.meta.url),...) ke saath panjikrit karta hai; PWAs guide dekhein.
  • Proxying API request: CRA ka proxy field package.json → Next.js rewrites mein next.config.ts (e.g). source: '/api/:path*' → destination: 'https://your-backend.com/:path*'.
  • Custom webpack/Babel: ne next.config.ts mein webpack function ke madhyam se Next.js config ka vistar kiya. --webpack
  • TypeScript: Next.js auto set ap TS ek tsconfig.json ke saath; sunishchit karein ki next-env.d.ts include array (["next-env.d.ts", "app/**/*", "src/**/*"]) mein hai.

bundler compatibility

  • CRA webpack ka upyog karta hai; Next.js default roop se tezi se local dev (next dev) ke liye Turbopack ko default karta hai. next dev --webpack ke bajaay webpack ka upyog karein; custom webpack configuration abhi bhi advanced settings ko migrate karne ke liye supported hai.

agle step (teevr god lene)

  • React router se App Router (automatic code vibhajan, streaming SSR, RSCs); images (<Image>), font (next/font), third-party ke lipiyon (<Script>) ko customize karein; Next.js ke saath ESLint ko recommended niymon ko enable karein.
  • not: static export (output: 'export') vartaman mein useParams hook ya any server features ka support nahi karta hai - sabhi Next.js features ka upyog karne ke liye output: 'export' ko hata dein.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • server features / useParams ka upyog karne ki koshish karte samay output: 'export' rakhna.
  • REACT_APP_ → NEXT_PUBLIC_ ka naam badalane ke liye - client env vars chupchap lapta.
  • pure imported image objekt ko .src ke bajaay <img src> mein paas karna.
  • dynamic App import par ssr: false ko bhool jana - SPA ko keval client ke bajaay server-render kiya jayega.
  • <Image> ke auto width/height. ke tahat ek-dimension-styled images ko vikrit karna

interview points

  • kyon CRA kshudhaa dhire dhire load (client-only rendering, koi code vibhajan nahi, waterfall lane) aur kaise Next.js pratyek ko sanbodhit karte hain.
  • SPA-first migration ranniti: output: 'export' + [[...slug]] catch-ol + ssr: false client entrypoint, phir vriddhishil apnane.
  • image import semantics antar (string banam objekt), env var prefix antar, homepage → basePath, proxy → rewrites.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/migrating/from-create-react-app
Hissa 60 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to migrate from Vite to Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to migrate from Vite to Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to migrate from Vite to Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why switch?, Migration strategy, Step 1: Install Next.js, Step 2: Create the Next.js config file, Step 3: Update TypeScript configuration, Step 4: Create the root layout. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

kyon svich?

  • CRA guide ke roop mein ek hi SPA inspiration: default Vite React plugin ke saath, app puri tarah se client-side hai - dhimi initial load (browser ko data prapt karne se pahle pure bundle ko download/run hona chahiye); bundle har feature ke saath badhta hai), koi automatic code vibhajan (manual spliting aasani se network jharne ko pesh karti hai) paani ka waterfall (kold parent khatm hone tak nahi le sakti), banam Next.js server side pulaav, Suspense ke madhyam se streaming (anaitik loading ordar, kam layout shiphts), per-page/component data-fetching pasand (build samay, request samay ya client), Proxy (kisi bhi content ki flash se pahle andhikrit upyogkartaon ko apratyaksh karein); prayog; i18n), aur built-in image/font/script optimization.

migration ranniti

  • CRA ke saman: ek kaamkaajee Next.js app ko tezi se prapt karein, phir badhi hui features ko apnaein. maujuda router migrate kiye bina vishuddh roop se client-side SPA ke roop mein shuru karein - muddon ko kam karta hai aur sangharsh ko kam karta hai.

step 1: Next.js installed karein

bash
pnpm add next@latest

(npm/yarn/bun samakaksh)

step 2: Next.js config file banaein

js
// next.config.mjs
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  output: 'export', // Outputs a Single-Page Application (SPA).
  distDir: './dist', // Changes the build output directory to `./dist/`.
}

export default nextConfig
  • Either .js ya .mjs config file ke liye kaam karta hai.

step 3: update TypeScript config

  • yadi TS ka upyog kiya jata hai, to Next.js compatibility ke liye tsconfig.json update karein: 1. tsconfig.node.json project sandarbh ko hata dein. 2. ./dist/types/**/*.ts aur ./next-env.d.ts ko include mein jorein. 3. ./node_modules ko exclude mein jorein. 4. { "name": "next" } ko compilerOptions.plugins mein jorein. 5. "esModuleInterop": true, 6. "jsx": "react-jsx". "allowJs": true, 8. "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true. "incremental": true
  • udaharan karya tsconfig.json (target ES2020, moduleResolution: "bundler", allowImportingTsExtensions, resolveJsonModule, isolatedModules, noEmit, strict, noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch, skipLibCheck, include: ["./src", "./dist/types/**/*.ts", "./next-env.d.ts"], exclude: ["./node_modules"], plugins: [{ "name": "next" }]).

step 4: root layout banaein

  • CRA ke saman pattern: Vite index.html root layout ke nikatatam samtuly hai. src/ mein app/ banaein, phir app/layout.tsx; index.html content ko copy karein, body.div#root aur body.script ko <div id="root">{children}</div> ke saath badal dein.
  • Next.js auto- ismein meta charset aur viewport shamil hain - unhein <head> se hata dein. app/ ke top level par metadata files (favicon.ico, icon.png, robots.txt) ko automatic roop se <head> se joda jata hai - unhein moved karne ke baad apne <link> tag ko hata dein. ant mein ek eksported metadata objekt ({ title: 'My App', description: 'My App is a...' }) mein shesh <head> jankari ko moved karein.

step 5: access point page banaein

  • Vite's main.tsx ≈ Next.js page.tsx. optional catch-ol app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx (import global CSS, generateStaticParams return [{ slug: [''] }] - ek route, / mein anukramanikaa; Server Component ek static asset mein prerenders, koi dynamic code required nahi hai).
  • client-keval access point app/[[...slug]]/client.tsx:
tsx
'use client'

import React from 'react'
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'

const App = dynamic(() => import('../../App'), { ssr: false })

export function ClientOnly() {
  return <App />
}
  • page.tsx to <ClientOnly /> pradan karta hai. Client Components ko abhi bhi client ko bheje jaane se pahle server par HTML ko pahle se taiyar kiya gaya hai; ssr: false vastav mein client-keval app ke liye App se prerendering ko disabled karta hai.

step 6: update static image import

  • Vite: ek image ka import production mein apne public URL string (import image from './img.png' → /assets/img.2d8efhg.png) ko return karta hai. Next.js: static import ek object lautte hain - <Image> (auto optimization + auto width/height) ke saath layout shift ko rokne ka upyog karte hain, lekin ek-dimension-style wali images ko vikrit kar sakte hain) ya maujuda <img> tag ke saath .src ka upyog karte hain. nirpeksh /public import ko relative (../public/logo.png) mein kanavart karein; logo ke bajaay logo.src paas karein; ya file naam (public/logo.png → /logo.png) dwara public URL ka sandarbh lein.
  • TS warning: .src tak pahunchne wali errors ko abhi tak surakshit roop se andekha kiya jaa sakta hai - guide ke ant tak tay kiya gaya.

step 7: migrate environment variables

  • NEXT_PUBLIC_ mein sabhi VITE_ previous char ko parivartit karein.
  • Turbopack Vite ke built-in import.meta.env.MODE, DEV, PROD, BASE_URL, SSR ka support karta hai. BASE_URL Next.js basePath ko darshata hai aur ismein ek trailing slash shamil hai, jo Vite ke format se match karta hai. import.meta.glob ko Turbopack dwara bina kisi badlav ke supported kiya gaya hai.
  • Turbopack mein Vite ke ?raw / ?url prashnon ke liye koi built-in handling nahi hai - as vikalp (Vite 5 mein define) aur iske query pratisthapan ko next.config.ts mein ek match niyam ki requirement hoti hai:
js
// Before (Vite)
const modules = import.meta.glob('./dir/*.txt', { as: 'raw' })

// After (Next.js / Turbopack)
const modules = import.meta.glob('./dir/*.txt', { query: '?raw' })
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  turbopack: {
    rules: {
      // Any file imported with `?raw` is loaded as a string
      '*': { condition: { query: '?raw' }, type: 'text' },
    },
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • custom bes URL: next.config.mjs mein basePath: '/some-base-path' set karein.

step 8: package.json mein update script

json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start"
  }
}
  • .next, next-env.d.ts aur dist ko .gitignore mein jorein. npm run dev, khula http://localhost:3000 - app ab Next.js par chalta hai. udaharan: inngest/vite-to-nextjs PR #1 ek kaamkaajee Vite → Next.js migration dikhata hai.

step 9: clean ap

  • Delete Vite artifacts: main.tsx, index.html, vite-env.d.ts, tsconfig.node.json, vite.config.ts; Vite dependency ki installation radd karein.

agle step (teevr god lene)

  • React router se App Router (automatic code vibhajan, streaming SSR, RSCs); images (<Image>), font (next/font), third-party ke lipiyon (<Script>) ko customize karein; ESLint config ko Next.js niymon mein update karein.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • VITE_ → NEXT_PUBLIC_ naam badalane ke liye.
  • ?raw/?url import queries ko Turbopack mein kaam karna - unhein turbopack.rules config ki requirement hai.
  • pure imported image objekt ko .src ke bajaay <img src> mein paas karna.
  • dynamic App import par ssr: false ko bhool jana.
  • tsconfig.json adjustment ( tsconfig.node.json, plugins: [{ name: 'next' }], jsx: react-jsx) ke sandarbh mein) ko chhor dena.

interview points

  • Vite SPA banam Next.js inspiration (CRA ke saman, saath hi Vite-vishisht deltaa).
  • SPA-first migration size CRA (output: 'export', [[...slug]], ssr: false client entrypoint) aur Vite-vishisht tukron ke saath sajha kiya gaya: tsconfig.json parivartan, import.meta.env/import.meta.glob Turbopack support, ?raw niyam, distDir: './dist'.

Migrating to Cache Components

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Migrating to Cache Components. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Migrating to Cache Components — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Use the adoption skill (recommended), Incremental, Direct, Migrate by hand (steps in order), Enable Cache Components, Opting out of validation. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • When Cache Components enable hai, dynamic, revalidate aur fetchCache jaise root segment configs ko 'use cache' aur cacheLife dwara replace kiya jata hai.
  • migration instant navigation validation dwara sanchalit hai: Cache Components on ke saath, Next.js dev mein valid hai ki kya pratyek route mein navigate karna turant pradan karta hai, aur bloking code ko ek error ya insight ke roop mein samne rakhta hai.
  • aapka maujuda fetch aur unstable_cache caching kaam karta rahta hai. Migrating unstable_cache optional hai aur baad mein ho sakta hai.
  • dynamic param aur metadata ke saath routes mein apna kadam hai (generateStaticParams/dynamicParams aur generateMetadata/generateViewport neeche dekhein).

god lene ke kaushal (recommended) ka upyog karein

  • next-cache-components-adoption kaushal ek coding agent ke saath migration drive karta hai, ek samay mein ek feature, har feature boundary par check karta hai. do mode:
  • Incremental: ek single yaantrik PR ko kholta hai jo pratyek route ko vaidhta se bahar nikalta hai, phir pratyek feature ko folo-ap PR ke roop mein bhejta hai (neeche vriddhishil flow ko automatic karta hai).
  • Direct: pratyek route ko ek shakha mein sthan par apnaataa hai.
  • installed karein: npx skills add vercel/next.js --skill next-cache-components-adoption, phir agent ko prerit karta hai: "is project mein Adopt Cache Components agle cache-kanponeint-adoption kaushal ka upyog karte hue.

hath se migration (order mein kadam)

1. next.config.ts mein Enable Cache Components 2. tay karein: har route ko ab parivartit karein, ya pahle vaidheekaran se routes ka chayan karke aur ek samay mein ek parivartit karke vriddhi ko apnaein. 3. validation errors/insights ka palan karein, pratyek root segment ko apne Cache Components samakaksh ke saath configure karein aur 'use cache' ke saath ankechd data caching karein ya <Suspense> mein runtime data raiping karein.

cache component enable karein

  • requirement hai Next.js 16 - yadi 15 ya isse pahle ho, to pahle upgrade karein (16 upgrade guide; purane sanskaran: 16 tak pahunchne ke liye upgrade guide ke madhyam se kaam karte hain).
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
}

export default nextConfig
  • yadi aap experimental.dynamicIO ya experimental.useCache ka upyog karte hain, to cacheComponents unhein replace karta hai (v16 upgrade guide dekhein).
  • enable karne ke baad, segment abhi bhi dynamic, revalidate, ya fetchCache ka export error hogi - un configs ko pahle (neeche diye gaye section) ki jagah leinge.

validation se bahar nikalna

  • ek validation insight/error ka matalab hai ki ek route turant render nahi karega. ise 'use cache' ke saath data cache karke hal karein ya ise <Suspense> mein lapetakara. yadi abhi tak taiyar nahi hai, to us segment par instant = false set karein jisne ise (layout, page, ya parallel slot) badhaya aur baad mein wapas aa gaya:
tsx
// app/dashboard/layout.tsx
export const instant = false
  • instant = false ek segment ko chihnit karta hai kyonki ko block karne ki permission data hai. yeh NOT route dynamic (vastav mein prerenderable route abhi bhi ek static shell ship) ko majbur karta hai, aur yeh NOT spasht tulyakalik IO banata hai errors - new Date(), Math.random(), crypto.randomUUID() abhi bhi prerender fail rahta hai.

vetan vriddhi ko apnane

1. flag ko enable karein aur pratyek route segment config (dynamic = "force-dynamic", "force-static", "error", revalidate, fetchCache) ko migrate karein. roots jo abhi bhi turant aage kaam karne ki requirement nahi hai. 2. Opt the routes ki taiyar nahi hain — set instant = false us segment par jo ek insight/error. uthaya yeh cache-components-instant-false codemod ke saath ek paas mein: generateStaticParams

bash
npx @next/codemod@canary cache-components-instant-false ./app

ek src/ project mein ./src/app paas karein - asaphal hone ke bajaay ek galat path report 0 ok, isliye file computation ki check karein. application building/serving ko rakhta hai, jismein opt-out routes ke liye validation kiya gaya hai. 3. Fix tulyakalik IO — yeh deferred nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. new Date(), Date.now(), Math.random(), crypto.randomUUID(), previous ke dauraan instant = false ek build error ko phenk nahi sakta hai. yeh request samay par chalta hai, to yeh previous shell se bahar call le jaein: <Suspense> mein bhag ko lapeto aur call se pahle connection() ko call karein, ya ise Client Component mein le jaein. 4. ek samay mein ek route ko parivartit karein - ek route se instant = false ko hata dein, apni insight ( 'use cache' ke saath cache ya <Suspense> mein raip runtime data) ko hal karein, jab tak koi route nahi nikalta.

nimnlikhit validation

  • Cache Components dev aur sathon mein dev overlay mein routes ko valid karta hai, pratyek affected component ka namkaran karta hai aur ek fix par point karta hai: errors/insights
  • Cache: async function Posts() { "use cache"; return <List items={…} /> }
  • Stream: <Suspense fallback={…}><DataChild /></Suspense>
  • pratyek card click karne yogy hai aur pattern, code namoone aur vyapar-band ke saath ek page kholta hai. jab tak ve chale gaye tab tak insights/errors ke madhyam se kaam karte hain. full workflow/DevTools/CI: tatkal navigation guide.
  • insights ko HTTP pratikriya mein nahi dikhaya gaya hai - ek opheinding route abhi bhi 200 ko dev mein render HTML ke saath return karta hai. insight keval dev overlay, dev-server log, ya MCP get_errors tool mein dikhai deti hai - unhein dekhne ke liye overlay (ya MCP) ko parhein.

dynamic = "phors-dynamic" - configuration ko hata dein

  • Without Cache Components yeh request ke anusar pure route ko render karta hai aur iske fetch requests ko bina anubndhit karta hai. With Cache Components, uncached data aur request-samay APIs pahle se hi request samay par chal rahe hain; Next.js un chaaron or kisi bhi static/cached UI ko poorvjit karta hai. bas export ko hata dein, phir dikhai dene wale kisi bhi validation errors/insights ka palan karein.
tsx
// Before
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export default function Page() {
  return <div>...</div>
}

// After
export default function Page() {
  return <div>...</div>
}

dynamic = "phors-static" - config ko hata dein, caching spasht karein

  • Without Cache Components ne apne data ko cache karne ke liye route ko majbur kiya aur cookies(), headers(), useSearchParams() ko khali maan diya. cache data jise 'use cache' + ek upyukt cacheLife ke saath pun: upyog kiya jana chahiye. configuration ko hatane ke baad, request-samay API actual request maan parhte hain - un nirbhartaon ko hata dein yadi route puri tarah se taiyar rahna chahiye.
tsx
// Before
export const dynamic = 'force-static'

export default async function Page() {
  const data = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data')
  return <div>...</div>
}

// After
import { cacheLife } from 'next/cache'

export default async function Page() {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('max')
  const data = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data')
  return <div>...</div>
}
  • Enforce static production (optional, 16.4+): ko puri tarah se static route ki requirement hoti hai, iske caching ko migrate karne ke baad export const ensureStatic = 'navigation' jodti hai. dynamic = 'force-static' ke viprit, ensureStatic NOT ko nivedan samay API khali maan wapas karta hai - yeh ek error ki report karta hai yadi request-vishisht server karya prerendering ko rokta hai. yadi keval App Shell ya prati-link prefetch ko static rahna chahiye to kam pratibndhaatmak star ka upyog karein (dekhein rakhne wale page static).

dynamic = "error" - configuration ko hata dein

  • Without Cache Components ne ise prerender karne ke liye route ki requirement hai, jise default roop se cached ke roop mein fetch requests ka ilaj kiya hai, aur keval tabhi error hui jab bina kisi data ya request-samay API ne prerendering ko roka. config ko hatane ke baad, fetch ko ab yeh legacy mein nahi mila ki cached default - maujuda caching behavior ko preserve karne ke liye 'use cache' + cacheLife mein raip request; yadi route default par nirbhar nahi tha, to koi pratisthapan ki requirement nahi hai. optional roop se puri tarah se static route ki requirement ke liye ensureStatic = 'navigation' (16.4+) jorte hain.

Revalidate - cacheLife ke saath> 0 ki jagah

  • Without Cache Components, revalidate ne ek sampurn route ke liye default punarmulyankan samay set kiya hai. With Cache Components, data/UI ke aaspas 'use cache' jagah hai jise cache kiya jana chahiye, phir apne lifetime ko cacheLife ke saath set karein:
tsx
// Before
export const revalidate = 3600 // 1 hour

// After
import { cacheLife } from 'next/cache'

export default async function Page() {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('hours')
  return <div>...</div>
}
  • yadi aapka revalidate maan ek built-in cacheLife profile ('seconds', 'minutes', 'hours', 'days', 'weeks', 'max') se mel nahi account hai, to nikatatam chunein ya ek custom profile ko define karein; aap ek built-in profile (default sahit) ko bhi phir se define kar sakte hain.
  • revalidate = 0 ke liye, konphigar ko hata dein - request samay par pahle se hi bina data chala jata hai; pratyek request ke liye chalane par ek use cache gunjaish ke bahar data rakhein.

fetchCache - config ko hata dein, data source par caching set karein

  • Without Cache Components, fetchCache changed/restricted ek route mein pratyek fetch ke liye cache vikalpa. With Cache Components, ek use cache gunjaish ke andar jab tak prapt nahi kiya jata hai. default-cache/only-cache/force-cache ke liye, un data ko lapeto jinhein 'use cache' mein cache kiya jana chahiye; default-no-store/only-no-store/force-no-store ke liye, ek cache gunjaish ke bahar data chhor dein. yadi force-no-store pahle ek spasht cache vikalp ko override karta hai, to us vikalp ko bhi hata dein.
tsx
// Before
export const fetchCache = 'force-cache'

// After
export default async function Page() {
  'use cache'
  // All fetches here are cached
  return <div>...</div>
}

cache vikalp - cache ka upyog karne ke liye cache/next vikalpon ko moved karein

  • isse pahle: fetch(url, { cache: 'force-cache', next: { revalidate: 3600, tags: ['data'] } }) ke baad: ek 'use cache' function mein lane ke liye; andar lane automatic roop se cache kar rahe hain, aur revalidate/tags cacheLife/cacheTag ban jate hain:
tsx
// After
import { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'

async function getData() {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('hours')
  cacheTag('data')
  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data')
  return res.json()
}

export default async function Page() {
  const data = await getData()
  return <div>...</div>
}
  • Persistence antar: fetch Data Cache ne deployment aur server rahit udaharanon mein cached pratikriyaon ko jari rakha hai. 'use cache' in-memory storej ke liye default - server rahit udaharan nasht hone par entries ko kharij kar diya jata hai aur ek single deployment ke liye dayar kiya jata hai. storage ke liye 'use cache: remote' ya cache handler ka upyog karein jo udaharan ke aansoo ko bachata hai; yahan tak ki tikau storage ke saath, cache kiye gaye values ko ek nai deployment ke baad phir prapt karne ki ummid hai.

unstable_cache — koi parivartan ki requirement

  • unstable_cache Cache Components ke saath kaam karna jari rakhta hai; ise jagah par chhor dein aur baad mein yadi vaanchhit ho to migrate karein. migrating: ek 'use cache' function mein lipte function ko badal dein - cache key automatic roop se tarkon (koi key-paarts array ki requirement nahi) se lee gai hai, aur options objekt maips ko cacheLife/cacheTag:
tsx
// Before
import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
export const getUser = unstable_cache(
  async (id: string) => db.query.users.findFirst({ where: eq(users.id, id) }),
  ['user'], // cache key prefix
  { tags: ['users'], revalidate: 3600 }
)

// After
import { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'
export async function getUser(id: string) {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('hours')
  cacheTag('users')
  return db.query.users.findFirst({ where: eq(users.id, id) })
}
  • fetch Data Cache ki tarah, unstable_cache deployments/serverless udaharanon mein bani rahti hai, jabki 'use cache' nahi karta hai.

React.cache - aam taur par koi badlav nahi

  • React.cache abhi bhi ek React render ke bhitar matching call ko dupliket karta hai. lekin pratyek Cache Function mein ek prithak React cache gunjaish hai - alag Cache Functions se call ek React.cache parinam (e.g) ko sajha nahi karte hain. jab ek helper request data padhta hai aur matching call ko Cache Function ke dayre mein kaam sajha karne ki requirement hoti hai, to 'use cache: private' ke saath React wrapper ko replace karein. yadi function ko keval request-dabaav ki requirement hoti hai, to cacheLife({ stale: Infinity }) ka upyog karein taaki yeh route ke samay ko kam na kare. Private Cache Function parinam production requests mein server cache mein sangrahit nahi kiye jate hain. Cache Function

on-demand revalidation (revalidateTag, revalidatePath, updateTag)

  • on-demand amanyata abhi bhi cache data tag karke kaam karti hai aur ek event ke baad ise samapt kar deti hai. ek use cache function ke andar cacheTag ke saath tag data (fetch next.tags vikalp ke bajaay), phir behavior dwara amanyata API chunein:
  • updateTag — mutation jiske parinamsvarup user ko turant dekhna chahiye (parhein-apne-apne-apne-apne-apne-apne-apne-apne-apne-apne-lekhon). ek Server Action se call kiya gaya, yeh tag samapt ho gaya, isliye agla request stale content serve karne ke bajaay fresh data ke liye wait karta hai.
  • revalidateTag — stale-time-revalidate. ek cache profile hai required dusra tark ke roop mein, e.g. cache data ki serve ke liye jabki yeh background mein taza ho jata hai. Server Actions aur Route Handlers mein kaam karta hai. 'max'
  • revalidatePath - previous caching modal se aprivartita.
  • updateTag Cache Components ke liye vishesh nahi hai, lekin migrating ise apnane ka ek achha samay hai:
tsx
// app/actions.ts
'use server'
import { updateTag } from 'next/cache'

export async function createPost(formData: FormData) {
  // Create the post, then show it immediately on the next request
  updateTag('posts')
}
  • updateTag ko keval ek Server Action se bulaya jaa sakta hai - ise kahin aur throw karta hai. Route Handlers ya webhook mein, ek cache profile ke bajaay revalidateTag ka upyog karein:
tsx
// app/api/webhook/route.ts — After
import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'

export async function POST() {
  revalidateTag('posts', 'max')
  return Response.json({ ok: true })
}

unstable_noStore — requirement nahi

  • unstable_noStore (noStore()) ek component ko caching se bahar nikalta hai. jab tak aap 'use cache' jorte hain to With Cache Components ko cache nahi kiya jata hai. yadi kisi component ko request samay par chalana chahiye, to kaam se pahle connection() ko call karein aur ise <Suspense> mein lapet dein.

generateStaticParams aur dynamicParams

  • generateStaticParams ko kam se kam ek param lautana chahiye: ne [] ko wapas kar diya ab errors (empty-generate-static-params). Without Cache Components, [] ne pratyek path ko pahli bar runtime visit ke liye sthagit kar diya; Cache Components ke saath ise ≥1 param lautana chahiye taaki Next.js route ko poorvjit kar sake aur yeh valid ho sake ki yeh ek gair-khali static shell paida karta hai. generateStaticParams rakhein aur kam se kam ek actual param (e.g) wapas lautein. posts.slice(0, 1).map((post) => ({ slug: post.slug })). eksport ko hatane ke liye ISR — Next.js ke route ko har request par render karta hai, yahan tak ki jab yeh data ke liye 'use cache' ka upyog karta hai. abhi bhi request samay par upalabdh nahi hain.
  • Without Partial Prefetching, <Suspense> ke bahar params ki await karta hai taaki bina listed pathon ke liye ISR ko preserve kiya jaa sake. ek unlisted path render karte samay ek fallback ki serve karne ke liye, Partial Prefetching ko enable karein aur <Suspense> ke andar params ka wait karein.
  • dynamicParams supported nahi hai: Cache Components ko enable karte samay dynamicParams export ko hata data hai.
  • <Suspense> ke andar Await params: generateStaticParams ke bina routes ke liye , params ko top par await karne ke bajaay <Suspense> boundary mein Promise karta hai - shell prerender kar sakta hai jabki param agyat rah sakte hain:
tsx
// After
import { Suspense } from 'react'

export default function Page({ params }: PageProps<'/blog/[slug]'>) {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div>Loading...</div>}>
      <Post params={params} />
    </Suspense>
  )
}

async function Post({ params }: Pick<PageProps<'/blog/[slug]'>, 'params'>) {
  const { slug } = await params
  // ...
}
  • client hook jo route parhte hain usi Suspense pattern ka palan karte hain: jab path ka naam puri tarah se known hota hai ki ve prerendering (koi boundary ki requirement nahi) ke dauraan hal karte hain; jab yeh abhi tak known nahi hai, to ve jahan bhi component baithta hai - ek sajha layout mein ek nav/breadcrumb suspended ho jata hai jabki Next.js dynamic param ke saath iske neeche kisi bhi route ke liye static shell generated karta hai. <Suspense> mein parhne wale component ko lapetein (sabse chhote patte ko neeche chhor dein taaki baki pahle se bane rahe), ya build fail ho gaya. ephekted hook: usePathname, useParams, useSelectedLayoutSegment, useSelectedLayoutSegments. useSearchParams always ko ek <Suspense> boundary ki requirement hoti hai (anusandhan ke liye keval request samay par jana jata hai).

cookies, header aur searchParams - Suspense mein raip runtime access

  • Without Cache Components, parhne cookies(), headers(), ya searchParams ne pure route ko dynamic rendering mein chun liya. With Cache Components, unhein <Suspense> ke bahar access karne se blocking-prerender-runtime insight ki satah hoti hai. ek <Suspense>-wrapped component mein pahunch ko moved karein taaki baki ek static shell aur dynamic bhag dharaon ke roop mein aage barhein:
tsx
// After
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { Suspense } from 'react'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading...</p>}>
      <Dashboard />
    </Suspense>
  )
}

async function Dashboard() {
  const theme = (await cookies()).get('theme')?.value
  // ...
}
  • params aur searchParams props (promises) ke roop mein aate hain - seedhe <Suspense>-wrapped component ke madhyam se Promise paas karte hain aur await ise vahan (ya .then() ke saath anraip inline) aur ek plain value ko neeche paas karte hain.
  • not: jab ek cookie/header maan root layout (lang, dir, data-theme) mein <html> element par ek visheshata drive karta hai, to ise server par parhne se pure subtree request-bound hota hai - <Suspense> mein lapetne ke liye koi bachcha nahi hai. <head> mein ek inline <script> jo peint se pahle visheshata set karta hai, shell ko static rakhta hai (dekhein hydration se pahle flash ko rokna).

Route Handlers (GET) - upyog cache ke saath dynamic = 'phors-staitik' ki jagah

  • Without Cache Components, ek GET Route Handler dynamic hai jab tak aap dynamic = 'force-static' ke saath caching ka chayan nahi karte hain. With Cache Components, GET handler pages ke saman modal ka anusaran karte hain: jab ve uncached/runtime data tak pahunch nahi lete hain to ve pahle se render hote hain; 'use cache' ke saath cache ankechd data. dynamic config ko hata dein aur data ko ek alag cached helper mein moved karein (directory ko GET export par lagu nahi kiya jaa sakta hai).
ts
// app/api/products/route.ts — After
import { cacheLife } from 'next/cache'

export async function GET() {
  const products = await getProducts()
  return Response.json(products)
}

async function getProducts() {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('hours')
  return db.query('SELECT * FROM products')
}
  • ek GET handler mein uncached/runtime data padhna throwing dwara render karne se bahar jama karta hai - ek try/catch jo aapke paas pahle se hi any parichaalnon ke aaspas hai woh jamaanat-bahar pakregaa, aur yadi catch ne us error ko log kiya hai to yeh output banane ke liye shor jodta hai. jama karne ke baad utsarjit log ko chhipane ke liye experimental.hideLogsAfterAbort: true set karein.

generateMetadata aur generateViewport

  • ve components ke saman niymon ka palan karte hain. yadi ve runtime data (cookies(), headers(), params, searchParams) parhte hain ya bina data prapt karte hain jabki shesh page anyatha previous hai, to Next.js ek error uthata hai isliye vikalp spasht hai. yadi metadata external par nirbhar karta hai lekin runtime data nahi hai, to 'use cache' jorein:
tsx
export async function generateMetadata() {
  'use cache'
  const { title, description } = await db.query('site-metadata')
  return { title, description }
}
  • yadi metadata ko vastav mein runtime data ki requirement hoti hai, to aap <Suspense> mein generateMetadata ko lapet nahi sakte hain - iske bajaay page par ek dynamic marker component jorte hain (ek <Suspense>-wrapped component jo connection() ka wait karta hai aur null return karta hai) to static content abhi bhi previous hai jabki metadata dharaon mein.

runtime = 'edge' - export ko hata dein

  • Cache Components ko Node.js runtime (default) ki requirement hoti hai aur runtime route segment config ka support nahi karta hai. jab yeh runtime = 'nodejs' hai tab bhi export ko hata dein. yadi koi route deprecated runtime = 'edge' ka upyog karta hai, to ise hata dein aur kinaare ke behavior ki requirement hone par Proxy ka upyog karein.

experimental_ppr — hata diya gaya; cacheComponents ko iske bajaay enable karein

  • Next.js 16 experimental Partial Prerendering flag (experimental.ppr) aur experimental_ppr route segment config ko hata data hai. Partial Prerendering ab Cache Components ka hissa hai - segments se next.config aur experimental_ppr se experimental.ppr ko hata dein (ek codemod segment config ko hata data hai).

UI state sanrakshan

  • component avastha ab navigation par bani rahti hai: Cache Components ke saath, Next.js "hidden" mode mein React ke <Activity> ka upyog karne wale routes ko surakshit rakhta hai. common roop se saaf aur phir se shuru hone wale prabhav, lekin useState maan, form input aur scroll sthiti ko ab reset nahi kiya jata hai jab door aur pichhe navigate kiya jata hai.
  • yadi code state ko spasht karne ke liye unmounting par nirbhar karta hai, to spasht reset lojik jorein:
  • Dropdowns/popovers: wapas navigate karte samay khula rahta hai - unhein useLayoutEffect cleanup function mein band kar data hai.
  • initial tark ke saath Dialogs: prabhav sanvad state (e.g) par nirbhar karta hai. yadi state ko preserve kiya gaya hai to phir se aag nahi hogi - iske bajaay URL se deriv sanvad raajya.
  • jama karne ke baad Forms: input maan aur useActionState parinam (success/error sandesh) tab jari rahta hai jab yeh sanbhav ho to render handler ya user action mein reset ho jata hai, anyatha cleanup prabhav ka upyog karta hai.
  • vistrit udaharanon ke liye navigation ke dauraan See Preserving UI raajya.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • ek route dynamic banane ke roop mein instant = false ka ilaj karna - yeh keval validation ko define karta hai; async-IO abhi bhi errors fail ho jati hain.
  • generateStaticParams se [] lautnaa - ab ek build error hai.
  • Forgetting revalidateTag ko ab dusre tark (e.g) ke roop mein ek cache profile ki requirement hoti hai. 'max')
  • ek Server Action ke bahar updateTag ko bulana - yeh throw karta hai; root Handlers/webhooks. mein revalidateTag ka upyog karein
  • 'use cache' ka estimate fetch Data Cache ki tarah bana hua hai - yeh default, prati-nirdharan, prati-sansthaapan dwara in-memory hai.
  • dynamicParams ya runtime = 'edge' export ko rakhte hue - donon Cache Components ke tahat supported hain.
  • ek <Suspense> boundary ke bina useSearchParams - hamesha ki requirement hoti hai.
  • state ko reset karne ke liye unmount par nirbhar karte hue - <Activity> sanrakshan navigation par useState/form/scroll rakhta hai.

interview points

  • config → nirdeshan talika: dynamic='force-dynamic' (delete), 'force-static' ('use cache' + cacheLife('max'), optional roop se ensureStatic='navigation'), 'error' (delete + spasht caching), revalidate → cacheLife, fetchCache → data source par cache, fetch vikalp → cacheLife/cacheTag, unstable_cache (optional), unstable_noStore (delete), updateTag banam revalidateTag banam revalidatePath.
  • vriddhishil god lene ka flow: codemod cache-components-instant-false, async-IO ko sthagit nahi kiya jaa sakta hai, ek samay mein ek route ko parivartit kar sakta hai.
  • manyata drishyta: keval dev overlay/log/MCP get_errors mein insight, nahi HTTP pratikriya.
  • dridhta antar (fetch Data Cache banam in-memory 'use cache') aur <Activity> UI-state sanrakshan parivartana.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/migrating-to-cache-components
