Hissa 69 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Implementing Partial Prerendering on your platform

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Implementing Partial Prerendering on your platform. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Implementing Partial Prerendering on your platform — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Audience, How PPR works, Build time, Request time, Storing PPR artifacts, Origin-only implementation. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Audience: platform injeeniyarsa. Partial Prerendering (PPR) ek hi route mein static aur dynamic rendering ko jodti hai: build samay par Next.js ek static HTML shell + ek postponedState blob prati PPR route generated karta hai; request ke samay shell turant serve ki jati hai aur dynamic bhag client ko render karte hain. yeh page batata hai ki kaise pletform vibhinn parishkaar staron par PPR support ko lagu karte hain, buniyadi utpatti se lekar customize CDN ekikaran taka.

kaise PPR kaam karta hai

  • Build Time - pratyek PPR route ke liye, Next.js ka production hota hai:
  • sabhi previous content ke saath ek static HTML shell, Suspense Fallbacks ke saath jahan dynamic content dikhai degi.
  • A postponedState value — a serialized string. ise apardarshi ke roop mein ilaj karein: ise parsing ke bina paas karein ya ise sanshodhit karein. Altering postponedState galat dynamic rendering production ka production karta hai.
  • page ke static bhagon ke liye ek RSC payload.
  • Request samay: 1. server turant static HTML shell bhejta hai. 2. server ne postponted state ka upyog karke dynamic bhagon ko phir se shuru kiya. 3. dynamic content client ko stream karti hai, jisse React ko deferred Suspense boundaries ko hydrate kar data hai.
  • client turant static shell ko dekhta hai, phir dynamic content dikhai deti hai kyonki yeh hal karti hai.

storage PPR artifacts

  • pratyek PPR route ko do artifacts ki requirement hoti hai jo together: (1) static HTML shell (2) postponedState blob ko sangrahit karta hai. unhein sangrahit aur update kiya jana chahiye omyally. jab ek PPR route ko punarjeevit kiya jata hai (samay-aadharit ya on-demand), Next.js donon ko ek saath phir se generated karta hai - ek purane sthagit state (ya iske viprit) ke saath ek naya shell ki serve karna galat dynamic content paida karta hai.
  • cache update ka inspect karne aur unhein apne storej backend par prachar karne ke liye apne adapter mein requestMeta.onCacheEntryV2 ka upyog karein.

sirf root karyanvayan

  • saral drishtikon, pratyek platform par kaam karta hai jo streaming HTTP pratikriyaon ka support karta hai. sabhi request seedhe Next.js server par jate hain; server apne local cache se shell ko padhta hai, ise bhejta hai, phir renders/streams dynamic content. yeh kya hai next start default roop se karta hai. koi extra buniyadi dhanche ki requirement nahi - yadi aapka pletform HTTP pratikriyaon ko streaming ka support karta hai, to yeh PPR ka support karta hai.

CDN shell + mool computation

  • behatar TTFB ke liye, CDN kinaare par static HTML shell ko cache karein. ek request par: (1) CDN turant cached shell (edge latency); (2) CDN mool ke liye ek phir se jari request bhejta hai (vishesh roop se shell streaming ke parallel mein); (3) mool keval dynamic bhagon ko render karta hai aur unhein wapas stream karta hai; (4) CDN client ke liye single streaming pratikriya mein shell + dynamic content ko jodti hai.
  • ek CDN ko ek single streaming pratikriya mein cache + dynamic content ko jorne ke liye ek tantr ka support karne ki requirement hai. shail TTFB dhaar vilambata mein girta hai jabki dynamic content abhi bhi mool se dharaon.
  • sabse kam vilambata ke liye, shell ko Edge storej (e.g) se served jaa sakta hai. ek CDN cache ke bajaay onBuildComplete ke dauraan ek KV store popyulet kiya gaya tha - ek platform architecture nirnay, koi Next.js app parivartan ki requirement nahi hai.

phir se shuru protokol

  • phir se shuru protokol shell ko chhorne ke liye Next.js handler ko batata hai aur keval dynamic bhagon ko render karta hai. CDN-to-origin architecture aur adapter aadharit deployment dwara upyog kiya jata hai jo shell ko alag se paroste hain. manak next start mein server automatic roop se ek paas mein shell + dynamic render ko sambhalta hai.
  • CDN-to-origin: ne ek POST ko header next-resume: 1 aur postponedState blob ke saath sir wale request body ke roop mein route ka request kiya hai. server keval deferred Suspense boundaries ko render karta hai aur parinam ko stream karta hai.
  • jab ek POST ek Server Action ko ek PPR rijyoome ke saath jodti hai, to request nikaay mein sthagit avastha hoti hai jiske baad action body hoti hai; x-next-resume-state-length header ne postpont-state priphiks ki byte lambai ko vahan kiya hai taaki handler donon ko alag kar sake. ek shuddh PPR phir se shuru (aam mamla) ke liye pure body sthagit state hai aur is header ki zaroorat nahi hai.
  • Adapter-based: seedhe req.method = 'POST', next-resume: 1 header aur postponedState ke request nikaay ke roop mein access point handler ko call karta hai - ya requestMeta: { postponed: postponedState } ko handler run ke teesre tark ke roop mein paas karta hai (samtuly, puri tarah se HTTP parat ko bypass karta hai). handler keval Suspense boundaries ko sthagit kar data hai aur res ke parinam ko stream karta hai; koi HTTP round-trip ki zaroorat nahi (in-proses).
  • Finding PPR routes mein build production: adapter output mein , PPR routes ki identity previous array mein renderingMode: 'PARTIALLY_STATIC' dwara ki jati hai. unhein dhoondhne aur fallback.postponedState parhne ke liye Ierate outputs.prerenders. pprChain.headers mein phir se shuru protokol header shamil hain: { 'next-resume': '1' }. code udaharanon ke liye "ek adapter mein PPR ko badhana" dekhein.

karyanvayan cheklist

1. Read PPR build time par output - adapter ke onBuildComplete mein, renderingMode: 'PARTIALLY_STATIC' ke saath prerenders ki identity; apne cache mein shell HTML + postponedState ko store karein. 2. Serve the shell at request Time — aane wale requests ke liye PPR routes par turant cached shell ki serve karte hain aur streaming shuru karte hain. 3. Resume dynamic rendering - CDN-to-origin: POST ko next-resume: 1 + sthagit state body ke saath Next.js handler ke liye. adapter-aadharit: seedhe POST + sthagit state (ya requestMeta: { postponed }) ke saath handler ko call karein. client ko pratikriya wapas stream karein. 4. Handle cache update - revalidation ke baad naye shell + sthagit-state jore ko capture karne aur cache ko parmanu roop se update karne ke liye requestMeta.onCacheEntryV2 ka upyog karein. 5. Support graceful degradation - yadi sthagit state anupalabdh ya stale hai, to ek full server render karne ke liye wapas aate hain; user ko shell-pahli optimization ke bina ek full page prapt hota hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • postponedState ko parsing ya sanshodhit karna - yeh apardarshi hai; ise badalane se dynamic rendering toot jata hai.
  • Storing/updating shell aur postponedState alag se - ek bejor pair galat dynamic content paida karti hai; parmanu roop se update karti hai.
  • ek phir se shuru path ke bina shell ki serve - dynamic content kabhi nahi aati; phir se shuru protokol ko lagu karein ya ek full server render par wapas aati hai.

interview points

  • PPR build-time artifacts (static shell, apardarshi postponedState, RSC payload) aur request samay flow (shell pahle, phir se shuru, dhara).
  • teen karyanvayan star: sirf root (next start default), CDN shell + mool computation, KV/onBuildComplete ke madhyam se barhat storage.
  • phir se shuru protokol vivaran (next-resume: 1 POST, body ke roop mein sthagit state, sanyukt Server Action ke liye x-next-resume-state-length phir se shuru, requestMeta.postponed adapter barabar) aur PPR routes (renderingMode: 'PARTIALLY_STATIC', fallback.postponedState, pprChain.headers) ko kaise khojein.
  • Atomic shell + postponed-state update requestMeta.onCacheEntryV2 ke madhyam se aur ek full server render karne ke liye graceful giraavata.

Prefetching

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Prefetching. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Prefetching — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How prefetching works, What Next.js prefetches automatically, Static vs dynamic routes (without Cache Components), Automatic prefetch, Prefetch scheduling, Client cache. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • prefetching routes ke beech navigate karna tatkal mehsoos karta hai: user navigate karne se pahle samay se pahle sansadhanon ko prapt karein. Next.js automatic roop se is app ko chhote JS tukron mein vibhajit karta hai (keval vartaman route ka code load apaphrant); click samay tak, agle root ke sansadhan pahle se hi browser cache mein hain. navigation ek client-side transition hai - koi full page reload ya browser loading spinar nahi.
  • default: Next.js keval production mein apne code mein link ke aadhar par routes ko rokta hai. pratyek <Link> viewport mein access karta hai ke roop mein, Next.js iske pichhe ka route prakshepit karta hai, isliye link se bhara ek page network ko baarh nahi karta hai. pratyek route mein se kitne prefetch kiya jata hai, static banam dynamic par nirbhar karta hai, aur jab Partial Prefetching enable hota hai to badalta hai.
  • partialPrefetching enable hone ke saath, <Link> default roop se full page ke bajaay prati root App Shell ko prefetch karne ki permission data hai (neeche Partial Prefetching dekhein aur Adopting Partial Prefetching dekhein).

kaise prefetching kaam

  • jab navigate karte hain, to browser assets (HTML, JS) ka request karta hai. Prefetching unhein samay se pahle lane ke liye. initial navigation ke dauraan browser ko HTML, JS aur RSC payload milta hai; baad mein navigation ke liye yeh Server Components ke liye RSC payload aur Client Components ke liye JS bundle ko prapt karta hai.

kya Next.js automatic roop se prefetches

  • Static banam dynamic routes (Cache Components ke bina): ek static route full roop se banaya gaya hai; ek dynamic route tab tak chhor diya jata hai jab tak ki ismein loading.js boundary nahi hoti hai.
static pagedynamic page
Prefetchedhan, full routenahi, jab tak loading.js
client cache TTL5 minat (default)band, jab tak staleTimes ke madhyam se enable nahi
server roundtrip on clickNohan, shell ke baad dharabaddh
  • automatic prefetch: <Link href="/about">About</Link> automatic roop se prefetches.
Contextprefetched payloadclient cache TTL
No loading.jssampurn page5 min (staleTimes.static)
With loading.jspahli loading boundary ke liye layoutdefault roop se band (staleTimes.dynamic)
  • keval production mein automatic prefetching rana. prefetch={false} ya Disabled Prefetch mein wrapper ke saath disabled karein.
  • Prefetch scheduling: Next.js ek chhota karya queue banaye rakhta hai, is kram mein prefetching: (1) viewport mein link; (2) link dikha user irada (hover/touch); (3) naye link purane logon ki jagah; (4) link scroll oph screen ko tyaag diya jata hai. shedyoolar apryukt download ko kam karte samay sambhavit navigation ko priority data hai.
  • experimental useOffline config enable hone ke saath, pending prefetch is queue ke madhyam se phir se shuru hota hai jab app ek connectivity drop se theek ho jata hai.
  • Client cache: Next.js stors ne memory mein RSC payload ko prefetch kiya, jo root segment ki key hai. sibling routes (e.g) ke beech navigate karna. /dashboard/settings → /dashboard/analytics) parent ke layout ka pun: upyog karta hai aur keval update leaf page prapt karta hai.
  • Partial Prefetching (partialPrefetching config ke madhyam se, jiske liye Cache Components ki requirement hoti hai) sabhi-or-nothing modal se ek prati-route App Shell tak svich karta hai:
  • prati route One shell, link bhar mein sajha kiya gaya. <Link> route ke App Shell (static + session production) ko prefetches. ek hi route ke liye link ki koi bhi sankhya yeh pun: upyog karti hai ki ek shell, pahli kare ke roop mein ek bar laya viewport mein access karti hai - kai link ke saath ek page pratyek route ko pura karne ki tulna mein kam prefetch request banata hai.
  • The baki dharaon in. Uncached data dharaon ke baad navigation ke baad, shell ki <Suspense> boundaries ke pichhe. ek link apne URL data (searchParams, params) ko prefetch={true} ke saath prefetch time mein bhi hal kar sakta hai.
  • Immediate invalidations spasht prefetches. Data invalidations from Server Actions (updateTag, revalidatePath, ya tatkal-expiry revalidateTag) spasht previous routes (dekhein cacheLife client cache behavior ke beech matbhedon ke liye Revalidation APIs).

Prefetching ko controlled karna

  • Manual prefetch: next/navigation se useRouter import karta hai aur router.prefetch() ko viewport ke bahar ya analytics/hover/scroll ke jawab mein garm routes par call karta hai:
tsx
'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'

export function PricingCard() {
  const router = useRouter()

  return (
    <div onMouseEnter={() => router.prefetch('/pricing')}>
      <CustomLink href="/pricing">View Pricing</CustomLink>
    </div>
  )
}
  • Hover-triggered prefetch: default <Link> dwara viewport mein access karne par prefetches. keval user ko link karne se pahle hi milne ki sambhavna hoti hai, jab tak ki hovar:
tsx
'use client'

import Link from 'next/link'
import { useState } from 'react'

export function HoverPrefetchLink({ href, children }: { href: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(false)

  return (
    <Link
      href={href}
      prefetch={active ? null : false}
      onMouseEnter={() => setActive(true)}
    >
      {children}
    </Link>
  )
}

prefetch={null} default prefetching ko restore karta hai jab user irade se pata chalta hai. With Partial Prefetching, iske bajaay prefetch={active? true: 'auto'} ka upyog karte hain - 'auto' ne sajha App Shell ko irade se pahle attract kiya hai, jabki true ne inteint ke baad navigation se pahle cached URL-vishisht content ko hal kiya hai; false ko irade se pahle App Shell prefetch ko inactive kar data hai.

  • savdhani: Link ka vistar aapko prefetching, cache amanyata aur accessibility chintaaon ko banaye rakhne ka vikalp data hai - keval tabhi aisa karein jab default kam ho.
  • Extending or ejecting link: ek custom prefetching ranniti ke liye <Link> ka vistar — e.g. ForesightJS, jo karsar disha ki bhavishyavani karke link ko rokta hai. ya useRouter ke saath mool <Link> behavior ko phir se banaein (aapko prefetching + cache amanyata banaye rakhne mein madad karte hain):
tsx
'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { useEffect } from 'react'

function ManualPrefetchLink({ href, children }: { href: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter()

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false
    const poll = () => {
      if (!cancelled) router.prefetch(href, { onInvalidate: poll })
    }
    poll()
    return () => {
      cancelled = true
    }
  }, [href, router])

  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      onClick={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault()
        router.push(href)
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </a>
  )
}

Next.js ne onInvalidate ko lagu kiya jab yeh sandeh karta hai ki cache data stale hai, isliye aap prefetch ko taza kar sakte hain. not: ek plain <a> ek full page navigation ko trigger karta hai - ise rokne ke liye onClick ka upyog karta hai, phir client navigation ke liye router.push.

  • Disabled prefetch: theek sansadhan niyantran ke liye kuchh routes ke liye puri tarah se disabled prefetch - e.g. ek NoPrefetchLink wrapper prefetch={false} gujar raha hai (footer link ke liye upyogi jo viewport entry par prefetching ki requirement nahi hai).

Troubleshooting

  • Prefetching ke dauraan avaanchhit dushprabhavon ko Triggering: yadi layouts/pages shuddh nahi hain aur ismein side-prabhav (e.g. traiking analytics), Next.js unhein tab chala sakta hai jab route prefetch kiya jata hai, tab nahi jab user visit karta hai. fix: ek useEffect hook ya Server Action ko side-prabhavon ko ek Client Component se trigger karein. udaharan: trackPageView() ne prefetch ke dauraan seedhe ek layout run mein bulaya - ise useEffect(() => { trackPageView() }, []) ke saath AnalyticsTracker Client Component mein le jaata.
  • Preventing bahut kai prefetches: Next.js prefetches viewport link automatic roop se; bare link suchiyon (e.g. anant scroll tebal) is apshisht sansadhanon ke liye. link par prefetch={false} ke saath inactive - lekin phir static route keval click aur dynamic routes par pahunchte hain jo server ko navigate karne se pahle render karne ki await karte hain. puri tarah se disabled kiye bina upyog ko kam karne ke liye, hovar tak prefetch karna (HoverPrefetchLink pattern upar).

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • layouts/pages mein side-prabhav prefetch time (analytics dabal-kaaunting) par firing - components ko shuddh rakhein; prabhav useEffect ya Server Actions mein hain.
  • kai link par prefetch={false} - navigation apne tatkal anubhav kho dete hain (log on click / server render ke liye await karein).
  • dev mein prefetching run ka estimate karna - automatic prefetching keval production mein hi chalta hai.
  • cache amanyata aur pahunch ke liye lekhaankan ke bina <Link> ka vistar karna.

interview points

  • kaise prefetching kaam karta hai (root aadharit code vibhajan, viewport-triggered, anusuchit queue: viewport → intent → newer purane → oph-screen dikaard ki jagah).
  • static banam dynamic prefetch behavior aur loading.js boundary prabhav; client cache TTLs (staleTimes.static 5 minat banam staleTimes.dynamic band).
  • Partial Prefetching ki shift ko ek sajha prati root App Shell aur prefetch={true} ko URL data ke liye badal diya gaya.
  • Manual/hover prefetch pattern (router.prefetch, prefetch={null}) default roop se restore karne ke liye, 'auto' ke tahat Partial Prefetching), onInvalidate, aur side-prabhav sahi hona gotcha.
