How Next.js preserves UI state with Activity

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How Next.js preserves UI state with Activity. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How Next.js preserves UI state with Activity — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Choosing what to preserve, Expandable UI (dropdowns, accordions, panels), Keep, Reset, Reset on hide, Native popovers. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Maan lo Cache Components enabled hai (cacheComponents: true).
  • Cache Components se pehle, navigation ke paar page-level state preserve karne ke liye workarounds chahiye the (state ko shared layout me uthana ya external store). Cache Components ke saath, Next.js state aur DOM ko out of the box preserve karta hai.
  • Navigation par pages ko unmount karne ke bajaye, Next.js unhe React ke <Activity> component se hide karta hai. Activity DOM ko document me rakhta hai (display: none ke saath hidden), isliye React state aur DOM state dono preserve rehte hain: form drafts, scroll position, expanded <details> elements, video playback progress, aur bahut kuch.
  • Next.js 3 routes tak preserve rakhta hai; usse zyada hone par sabse purana route evict ho jata hai aur fresh render hota hai.
  • useRouter().bfcacheId ko React key ke roop me: ek single <Fragment key={bfcacheId}> push/replace navigation par poora subtree reset kar deta hai (<Link> clicks aur router.push/router.replace samet), jabki browser back/forward par state restore hota rehta hai. Ye mainly ek migration tool hai — naye code ke liye neeche wale per-pattern resets prefer karo.

kya banaye rakhne ke liye

  • Activity default roop se saari component aur DOM state preserve karti hai; kya preserve ho aur kya reset, ye is par nirbhar hai ki log UI ko kaise use karte hain.

vistaarneey UI (dropdown, samjhaute, painal)

  • Keep: expanded sections wala sidebar, FAQ accordion, filters panel — user ne apna view jaanboojh kar set kiya tha; restore karne se wo kaam dobara nahi karna padta.
  • Reset: button click se trigger hone wala dropdown menu/popover — ye transient interaction hai, persistent view state nahi; pehle se khule dropdown ke saath page par lautna ajeeb lagta hai.
  • Hide hone par reset: React state ko useLayoutEffect cleanup me update karo — cleanup Activity ke component ko hide karne se pehle chalta hai, isliye dropdown return par band milta hai:
tsx
'use client'

import { useState, useLayoutEffect } from 'react'

function SettingsDropdown() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)

  // Close dropdown when this component becomes hidden
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      setIsOpen(false)
    }
  }, [])

  return (
    <div>
      <button onClick={() => setIsOpen((o) => !o)}>Options</button>
      {isOpen && (
        <ul>
          <li>
            <button>Edit Profile</button>
          </li>
          <li>
            <button>Change Password</button>
          </li>
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}
  • Navigation link click hote hi dropdown turant band karne ke liye Link ke onNavigate callback ka bhi use kar sakte ho.
  • Native popovers: popover ki open state DOM me rehti hai — useLayoutEffect cleanup me hidePopover() call karo taaki Activity ke hide karte hi wo band ho jaye. Kyunki hidden pages DOM me rehte hain, hardcoded ID ka reuse ek button ko galat popover se jod sakta hai — useId har instance ko unique ID deta hai, button apne hi popover ke saath rehta hai. Yehi baat labels, aria-describedby aur form attributes me use hone wali IDs par bhi lagu hoti hai.

daaylog aur prarambhikaran tark

  • Activity dialog ki open/closed state preserve karti hai; dobara dikhne par React effects phir chalata hai, jisme initialization logic jaise input par focus karna shamil hai.
  • Keep: multi-step wizard ya settings panel jis par user actively kaam kar raha tha — step/input state preserve hoti hai aur progress khone se bachta hai.
  • Reset: ek temporary edit dialog jo return par band hona chahiye — dropdown wale example ki tarah useLayoutEffect cleanup use karo. Portal se render hone wale controlled dialogs ke liye, open state ko apne component me reset karo. showModal() se khule native dialogs ke liye, cleanup ke dauraan <dialog> ko close() call karke band karo.
  • Dialog ko URL se control karna: dialog state ek search param se — jaise dialog tab khulta hai jab URL me ?edit=true ho:
tsx
'use client'

import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Suspense, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'

function ProductTab() {
  const router = useRouter()

  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => router.push('?edit=true')}>Edit Product</button>
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <ProductDialog />
      </Suspense>
    </>
  )
}

function ProductDialog() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const router = useRouter()
  const isDialogOpen = searchParams.get('edit') === 'true'
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isDialogOpen) {
      inputRef.current?.focus()
    }
  }, [isDialogOpen])

  if (!isDialogOpen) return null

  return (
    <dialog open>
      <input ref={inputRef} placeholder="Product name" />
      <button onClick={() => router.replace('?', { scroll: false })}>
        Close
      </button>
    </dialog>
  )
}
  • Button ko Suspense boundary ke bahar rakhne se ye render ho pata hai jabki dialog search param padhta hai (agar koi parent pehle se boundary deta hai to boundary chhod do). ?edit=true ke bina wale link se lautne par dialog band ho jata hai; browser back/forward us history entry ka URL restore karta hai, isliye ?edit=true wala URL wapas aa jata hai.

prapatr, input aur state

  • Activity navigation par input values (text fields, selected options, checkbox states), submission results aur status messages preserve karti hai.
  • Keep: filters wala search page, banta hua draft, unsaved changes wala settings form — input state preserve karna sabse badi UX jeet me se ek hai (koi kaam nahi khota).
  • Reset: ek 'naya transaction' flow jahan har visit fresh shuru honi chahiye, ya aisa form jahan success/error message naye context me confuse karega.
  • Submit ke baad form state reset karna: submit ke baad router.push naye record par navigate karta hai; kyunki Activity page ko preserve karti hai, wapas navigate karne par form me abhi bhi pichhla naam dikhega — form ko fresh rakhne ke liye event handler me state reset karo (router.push se pehle setName('')).
  • Stale status messages reset karna: feedback dene ke liye state me status set karne ke baad, use clear karne ka aksar koi reliable user-triggered event nahi hota (user next/link ya browser controls se navigate kar sakta hai). Form/state reset karne ke liye useLayoutEffect cleanup use karo — ek shouldReset ref ke saath, taaki cleanup sirf successful submission ke baad chale (agar user bina submit kiye mid-draft navigate away karta hai, to unka input preserve rehta hai):
tsx
'use client'

import { useState, useRef, useLayoutEffect } from 'react'

function ContactForm() {
  const [name, setName] = useState('')
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'success'>('idle')
  const shouldReset = useRef(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    await sendMessage({ name })
    setStatus('success')
    shouldReset.current = true
  }

  // Reset stale success message when Activity hides this component
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (shouldReset.current) {
        shouldReset.current = false
        setStatus('idle')
        setName('')
      }
    }
  }, [])

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
      <button type="submit">Send</button>
      {status === 'success' && <p>Message sent!</p>}
    </form>
  )
}
  • useActionState ke saath bhi yehi approach lagu hai — reducer ke liye ek RESET action jodo (React docs: 'Reset state'). In hooks ke liye Building Interactive Apps guide dekho.
  • Uncontrolled form fields ko callback ref se reset karna: ek callback ref form.reset() call kar sakta hai jab Activity component ko hide karti hai, inputs ko default values par restore karke. resetOnHide ko component ke bahar define karo taaki wo static rahe (React callback badalne par pichhle ref ki cleanup chalata hai; re-render par form achanak reset nahi hona chahiye). form.reset() React state ko reset NAHI karta — controlled inputs ke liye value/checked state reset karo.

state aur authentication

  • Activity local component state (useState, DOM input values) ko navigation ke paar preserve karti hai, authentication changes par bhi — standard React behavior: props badalna (jaise naya user milna) re-render karta hai lekin maujooda state reset nahi karta. Ek user ka banaya draft dusre ko dikhai nahi dena chahiye.
  • Logout flow ke liye, router.push ke bajaye window.location.href full page reload trigger karta hai, saari client-side state saaf ho jati hai.
  • Jab user bina full reload ke badal jaye, to form ko reset karne ke liye use user ID se key karo — React me sign-in/out samet:
tsx
function UserScopedForm({ userId }: { userId: string | null }) {
  return <DraftForm key={userId} />
}

global style

  • Page-level styles (CSS variables, z-index, global classes) dikhne wale pages ko affect kar sakti hain jab original component Activity se hidden ho — hidden page ka background color ya z-index override visible page me leak nahi hona chahiye. Hide hone par unhe disable karo: stylesheet ki media attribute toggle karne ke liye callback ref use karo (media = '' jab visible, cleanup me media = 'not all' jab hidden), ya multiple style elements/complex cleanup ke liye useLayoutEffect.
  • :has selector: ek :root:has(...) rule apne selector ke aadhar par styles lagu karta hai; na selector ko aur na match element ko relationship ka pata hota hai — valid CSS hai, lekin ye React ke data flow ko bypass karta hai aur door ke components ko jod deta hai. Global state ke liye React ek data-* attribute prefer karta hai:
tsx
<html data-modal-open={modalOpen ? "true" : undefined}>
css
html[data-modal-open='true'] {
  overflow: hidden;
}
  • :has() ko ek component ke andar local parent/child styling ke liye reserve rakho (.card:has(img) { padding-top: 0; }). Broad :has() selectors asal performance cost bhi hain (MDN performance considerations). Agar hidden component khud global :has rule define karta hai, to media toggle use component ki baaki styles ke saath inactive kar deta hai.

Testing

  • Hidden Activity content me display: none hota hai lekin wo document me bana rehta hai — ye e2e testing (Playwright, Cypress, Puppeteer) ko affect karta hai:
  • DOM queries hidden elements ko dhoondh sakti hain; selectors visibility ki parwah kiye bina match kar sakte hain.
  • Hidden elements ke saath interaction fail ya timeout ho sakta hai — zyadaatar tools interaction se pehle visibility ka wait karte hain, lekin wait karne par ek visible aur ek hidden element dono match ho sakte hain (Playwright ise strict mode violation report karta hai).
  • Assertions hidden content se match kar sakti hain — visibility ke baare me explicit raho.
  • Visibility-aware selectors use karo: accessibility tree (hidden elements ko chhodta hai) ya visibility se filter karne wale locators prefer karo. Playwright me, getByRole default roop se hidden elements ko exclude karta hai:
ts
// Good - getByRole excludes hidden elements by default
await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click()
await page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Email' }).fill('test@example.com')

// Filter by visibility explicitly
await page.getByLabel('Email').filter({ visible: true }).fill('test@example.com')
await page.locator('.product-card').filter({ visible: true }).first().click()

// Avoid - may match hidden elements in Activity boundaries
await page.getByLabel('Email').fill('test@example.com')
await page.locator('.product-card').first().click()
  • getByRole Activity, tabbed navigation, accordions aur har us pattern ke liye robust hai jo DOM me hidden content rakhta hai. Kaun se locators hidden elements se match karte hain, ye testing tools/versions ke beech alag hota hai — apne tool ke docs check karo.

apne khud ke components mein Using Activity

  • Cache Components route level par automatically Activity use karta hai, lekin tum apne components me seedhe <Activity> bhi use kar sakte ho — tabs, expandable panels, ya kisi bhi UI ke liye useful jahan content ko bina state khoye hide karna hai.
  • Hidden content ko pehle render karna: Activity wo content render kar sakti hai jo user ne abhi tak nahi dekha; hidden boundaries low priority par render hoti hain. Suspense ke saath milakar, ye us content ka data prefetch karti hai jo user ke dekhne ki sambhavna hai. Ek Server Component turant data fetch shuru karta hai aur ek client component ko Promise pass karta hai; client component content ko tab tak hide rakhne ke liye Activity use karta hai jab tak user use request na kare, aur render hone par Promise ko resolve karne ke liye use() use karta hai:
tsx
// app/expandable-comments.tsx ('use client')
import { Activity, Suspense, useState, use } from 'react'

export function ExpandableComments({ commentsPromise }: { commentsPromise: Promise<Comment[]> }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false)

  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => setExpanded((e) => !e)}>
        {expanded ? 'Hide Comments' : 'Show Comments'}
      </button>

      <Activity mode={expanded ? 'visible' : 'hidden'}>
        <Suspense fallback={<CommentsSkeleton />}>
          <Comments commentsPromise={commentsPromise} />
        </Suspense>
      </Activity>
    </>
  )
}
  • Server Component turant comments fetch karna shuru karta hai; Activity hidden content ko low priority par render karti hai. 'Show Comments' par comments turant dikhte hain agar data ready hai; warna Suspense skeleton tab tak dikhata hai jab tak request poori na ho.
  • Effect aur media cleanup: jab Activity content ko hide karti hai, to React effect cleanups ko bina unmount kiye chalata hai — sahi cleanup wale timers, subscriptions aur media playback automatically handle hote hain (jaise setInterval effect cleanup me clear kiya gaya timer hide hone par ruk jata hai). <video>/<audio> ke liye, display: none playback NAHI rokta — useLayoutEffect se explicit cleanup jodo (video?.pause()) — hide hone par pause karo, playback state preserve rehti hai. Agar cleanup koi DOM property hatata/badalta hai, to use effect ke setup me restore karo — jaise ek effect jo hide karte waqt video ka media resource release karta hai (video.pause(); video.removeAttribute('src'); video.load()) aur dikhne par video.src = src restore karta hai; source release karne se playback state bhi reset hoti hai, isliye state preserve karni ho to sirf-pause wala version use karo.
  • Ek effect pehle chala hai ya nahi, ye track karna: effects har hidden → visible transition par chalte hain, sirf initial mount par nahi. Ek ref record karta hai ki effect pehle chala hai ya nahi. Ref hide/show cycles me bana rehta hai. Dev me, Strict Mode ek extra setup/cleanup cycle chalata hai, isliye 'phir chala' wali branch initial mount par bhi chal sakti hai — ye record ye hai ki effect pehle chala hai, ye nahi ki navigation hua hai. Setup/cleanup ko repeat-safe banao.

Examples

  • Activity Patterns Demo (react-active-patterns.labs.vercel.dev; source: github.com/nextjs/react-activity-patterns) — Cache Components ke saath ek Next.js app aur teen routes ke saath state preservation dikhata hai:
  • Data — sortable table + selectable list navigation par state rakhta hai, saath hi background me ek review section render karta hai.
  • Forms — DOM state (<details>, checkbox, text input) ke saath filters panel bana rehta hai, aur ek newsletter form render ke baad useLayoutEffect cleanup ke through reset ho jata hai.
  • Side Effects — navigate karne par ek live timer peeche chalta rehta hai aur return par resume hota hai, aur playback state preserve ke saath ek video player auto-pause hota hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Unmount par state reset hone ki ummeed karna — Activity ke tahat aisa nahi hota; 3 routes tak state + DOM intact preserve rehte hain.
  • Pages par hardcoded IDs ka reuse — hidden pages DOM me rehte hain; popovers/labels/form associations ke liye useId use karo (aria-describedby samet).
  • Non-visibility-aware testing locators — getByLabel/.locator() hidden elements se match kar sakte hain; getByRole ya .filter({ visible: true }) prefer karo.
  • Hidden pages se leak hoti global styles — hide hone par media="not all" toggle karo; broad :root:has() rules se bacho.
  • Ye bhoolna ki display: none media ko pause nahi karta — video/audio cleanup me explicitly pause() karo.
  • router.push se logout karne par dusre user ka draft dikhai dena — full reload (window.location.href) ya user ID se key kiye hue forms use karo.
  • Effects ka sirf ek baar chalne ki ummeed — ve har hide → show transition par phir chalte hain; setup/cleanup ko idempotent banao.

interview points

  • <Activity> state kaise preserve karta hai (DOM rakha gaya, display: none, 3 routes tak) vs pre-Cache-Components workarounds.
  • Reset patterns: dropdowns/popovers/dialogs ke liye useLayoutEffect cleanup, URL-derived dialog state (?edit=true), submit-handler reset vs stale messages ke liye shouldReset-gated cleanup, uncontrolled inputs ke liye callback ref se form.reset(), reset ke liye key={userId} / key={bfcacheId}.
  • Global styles + :has() guidance; visibility-aware selectors ke saath testing; background rendering ke saath tabs/panels ke liye seedhe <Activity> ka use; effect/media cleanup semantics (timers pause hote hain, video ko explicit pause() chahiye).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/preserving-ui-state
Hissa 72 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to prevent flash before hydration

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to prevent flash before hydration. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to prevent flash before hydration — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Dates and formatting — the problem, Fixing dates with an inline script, Understanding suppressHydrationWarning, Without `suppressHydrationWarning`, With `suppressHydrationWarning`, Extracting a reusable component (LocalDate). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • User preferences, browser settings aur client-side storage server rendering ke dauraan available nahi hote. Server ek reasonable default bhejta hai, lekin client-only state (locale, time zone, theme, persisted interactions) par based UI ko user ke dekhne se pehle sahi karna hota hai — browser ke paint karne ke baad sahi karne se flash of unstyled content (FOUC) hota hai.
  • Common approaches aur ve kyun fail hote hain:
  • Client values ke saath Client Component re-render karna → hydration error.
  • useEffect par chhodna → error se bachata hai lekin visible flash lata hai.
  • Sirf server par render karna → client-specific formatting puri tarah chhod deta hai.
  • Fix: ek inline script jo browser ke HTML parse karte hi synchronously chalti hai, pehle paint se pehle DOM update karke. Ye guide dates, themes aur persisted UI state ko cover karti hai.
  • Companion demo: preventing-flash-before-hydration.labs.vercel.dev (source: github.com/nextjs/preventing-flash-before-hydration) server/client locale mismatch simulate karne ke liye LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8 ke saath bana hai. Compare karo: inline-script date formatting (na flash, na hydration error), seedhe toLocaleDateString() call karta Client Component (hydration error), aur lazy useState initializer ke through apna open section localStorage me persist karta accordion. Locale override karne ke liye Chrome DevTools Sensors use karo (jaise ru-RU).

tarikh aur formatting - samasya

  • Ek UTC timestamp (jaise 2026-06-15T18:00:00Z) samay ka ek fixed point hai, lekin uska display user ke locale/time zone par nirbhar karta hai. Server par toLocaleDateString() / Intl.DateTimeFormat server ki settings use karte hain, jo user se match nahi kar sakti.
  • Ek Client Component jo date format karta hai:
tsx
// app/components/event-date.tsx ('use client')
export function EventDate({ date }: { date: string }) {
  return <p>{new Date(date).toLocaleDateString()}</p>
}
  • SSR ke dauraan, toLocaleDateString() Node.js me server ke locale ke saath chalta hai (jaise 6/15/2026); hydration par React use browser me user ke locale ke saath phir execute karta hai (jaise 2026/6/15). React mismatch pakadta hai, hydration error throw karta hai, aur user flash dekhta hai. useEffect error se bachata hai lekin user pehle server-formatted date dekhta hai; Server Component error se bach jata hai lekin date hamesha server ke locale me rehti hai.
  • Local dev me ye miss karna aasan hai agar tumhari machine ka locale browser se match karta ho — dev server ko browser se alag TZ aur LANG ke saath chalao taaki mismatch jaldi pakda jaye (jaise TZ=UTC LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8 next dev). TZ=UTC ek achha default hai kyunki zyadaatar servers UTC me chalte hain.

ek inline script ke saath dates ko theek karna

1. server apne local logon ko ek <p> mein pradan karta hai. 2. element ke baad ek <script> (dangerouslySetInnerHTML ke madhyam se) rakhein - browser pahle peint se pahle HTML parsing ke dauraan tulyakalik roop se chalata hai. 3. element mein suppressHydrationWarning jorein, kyonki inline script ne React hydrates (neeche dekhein) se pahle text ko badal diya hai.

tsx
// app/events/page.tsx
import { getEvent } from '@/app/lib/events'

export default async function Page() {
  const event = await getEvent('nextjs-conf')

  return (
    <section>
      <h1>{event.name}</h1>
      <p id="event-date" suppressHydrationWarning>
        {new Date(event.date).toLocaleDateString()}
      </p>
      <script
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
          __html: `document.getElementById("event-date").textContent=new Date("${event.date}").toLocaleDateString()`,
        }}
      />
    </section>
  )
}
  • Poore page load par kaam karta hai (direct visits, refresh). <Link> se client-side navigation ke liye, neeche wala reusable component dekho.

suppressHydrationWarning ko samajhanaa

  • Jab React hydrate karta hai aur text mismatch milta hai:
  • suppressHydrationWarning ke bina: React ise hydration error ki tarah treat karta hai aur nearest error ya Suspense boundary se client-render karke recover karta hai — us boundary ke andar dusre components par flash hota hai, aur us boundary ke andar ke inline-script corrections kho jate hain kyunki React ke dobara banane par scripts phir execute nahi hoti.
  • suppressHydrationWarning ke saath: React DOM me jo hai wahi rakhta hai aur us element ke liye client ke output ko chhod deta hai. DOM jeet-ta hai.
  • Inline script React ke hydrate karne se pehle DOM me sahi value daal deti hai. Server Components ke liye bhi, React hydration ke dauraan DOM ko RSC payload se compare karta hai, aur script ne text badal diya hota hai — suppressHydrationWarning React ko kehta hai ki behes karne ke bajaye DOM ko accept kare.

ek pun: prayojy component (LocalDate) nikalein

  • DOM updates ke through daali gayi scripts browser me execute nahi hoti. Client-side navigation par, React component ko RSC payload se render karta hai aur script nahi chalti. Component ko Client Component banana ye hal karta hai: toLocaleDateString() soft navigation par seedhe browser me chalta hai, jabki inline script hard navigation ko sambhalti hai. useId har instance ke liye ek static unique ID generate karta hai.
  • React dev me warning deta hai jab rendering <script> tag produce karti hai. Isse bachne ke liye script ko server par type="text/javascript" aur client par type="text/plain" set karke wrap karo; suppressHydrationWarning type ke mismatch ko sambhalta hai:
tsx
// app/components/inline-script.tsx
export function InlineScript({ html }: { html: string }) {
  return (
    <script
      type={typeof window === 'undefined' ? 'text/javascript' : 'text/plain'}
      suppressHydrationWarning
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: html }}
    />
  )
}
  • Note: useServerInsertedHTML bhi warning se bachata hai, lekin yahan InlineScript ko replace nahi kar sakta — ye script ko component ke markup se pehle insert karta hai, isliye script <time> element ke exist hone se pehle chal jati hai. Ye un scripts ke liye sahi hai jo poore document par kaam karti hain, jaise neeche wali theme script.
tsx
// app/components/local-date.tsx ('use client')
import { useId } from 'react'
import { InlineScript } from './inline-script'

export function LocalDate({ date, options }: { date: string; options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions }) {
  const id = useId()

  return (
    <>
      <time id={id} dateTime={date} suppressHydrationWarning>
        {new Date(date).toLocaleDateString(undefined, options)}
      </time>
      <InlineScript
        html={`{var n=document.getElementById("${id}");if(n)n.textContent=new Date("${date}").toLocaleDateString(undefined,${JSON.stringify(options)})}`}
      />
    </>
  )
}
  • Hard navigation (initial load/refresh): script HTML parsing ke dauraan execute hoti hai aur date sahi karti hai; suppressHydrationWarning React ko DOM accept karne ko kehta hai. Client-side navigation (<Link> ke through): toLocaleDateString() Client Component render ke hisse ke roop me browser me chalta hai; script text/plain hai aur ignore ho jati hai.
  • Notes: dateTime attribute ke saath <time> element use karo, taaki search engines/screen readers displayed text ki parwah kiye bina ISO string parse kar saken. dangerouslySetInnerHTML wali inline scripts sakht Content Security Policies se block ho jati hain jo 'unsafe-inline' allow nahi karti — agar tumhara app CSP use karta hai, to ek nonce jodo (guide dekho).

Themes

  • Page ko ek default theme (jaise light) ke saath server-render kiya ja sakta hai jabki user ne localStorage me dark mode preference save ki ho. Wahi inline-script technique: value padho aur browser ke paint karne se pehle <html> par data-theme attribute set karo:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
export default function RootLayout({ children }: LayoutProps<'/'>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" data-theme="light" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <script
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
            __html: `(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem("theme");if(t)document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme",t)}catch(e){}})()`,
          }}
        />
      </head>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}
css
/* app/globals.css */
[data-theme='light'] {
  --background: #ffffff;
  --foreground: #000000;
}

[data-theme='dark'] {
  --background: #0a0a0a;
  --foreground: #ededed;
}
  • Script <head> me chalti hai, isliye sahi theme kisi bhi content ke paint hone se pehle lagu ho jati hai. try/catch localStorage unavailable hone ko handle karta hai.
  • Theme script ko Client Component me useServerInsertedHTML se bhi return kar sakte ho, ek useRef flag ke saath, taaki ye sirf ek baar insert ho — script warning se bach jati hai, lekin sirf initial document par chalti hai. Theme ke liye ye theek hai, kyunki attribute <html> par set hota hai aur navigation par bana rehta hai.
  • Theme ko cookie me store karna: localStorage ke vipreet, cookie har request ke saath bheji jati hai, isliye server use cookies() se padh sakta hai. Lekin use root layout me padhne se poora app static prerendering se bahar ho jata hai (aur Cache Components ke tahat layout ke neeche ke har segment ko block karta hai). Page ko ek common default ke saath static render rakhne aur phir bhi flash se bachne ke liye, cookie ko iske bajaye inline script me padho:
tsx
// <head> inline script
__html: `(function(){try{var m=document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )theme=([^;]*)/);if(m)document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme",decodeURIComponent(m[1]))}catch(e){}})()`
  • Themes switch karne ke liye, <html> par attribute set karo aur cookie persist karo:
js
const theme = 'dark'
document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme)
document.cookie = `theme=${encodeURIComponent(theme)}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax`

React state (pratirodh samjhaute) ke saath samanvay karna

  • Jab ek Client Component interactive state manage karta hai (jaise kaunsa accordion section khula hai), React ki initial state ko inline script ke set kiye DOM se match karna hoga. Ek lazy state initializer use karo jo script ke same source se padhta hai:
tsx
// app/components/accordion.tsx ('use client')
const STORAGE_KEY = 'open-section'

export function Accordion() {
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_ID
    return localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? DEFAULT_ID
  })

  const handleToggle = useCallback(
    (id: string) => (e: React.ToggleEvent<HTMLDetailsElement>) => {
      if (e.newState === 'open') {
        setOpenId(id)
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, id)
      }
    },
    []
  )

  return (
    <div>
      {sections.map((section) => (
        <details
          key={section.id}
          name="accordion"
          id={`section-${section.id}`}
          open={openId === section.id}
          onToggle={handleToggle(section.id)}
        >
          <summary>{section.title}</summary>
          <p>{section.content}</p>
        </details>
      ))}
      <InlineScript
        html={`{var id=localStorage.getItem("${STORAGE_KEY}")??"${DEFAULT_ID}";${JSON.stringify(SECTION_IDS)}.forEach(function(s){var el=document.getElementById("section-"+s);if(el){if(s===id)el.setAttribute("open","");else el.removeAttribute("open")}})}`}
      />
    </div>
  )
}
  • Inline script aur lazy useState initializer dono localStorage se padhte hain — ve hamesha agree karte hain, isliye React ki initial state DOM se match karti hai.

development mein phir se lagu gun

  • Inline script parsing ke dauraan attribute set karti hai — ye saari production builds me kaam karta hai. Dev me, React Strict Mode saathi bugs pakadne ke liye components ko dobara mount karta hai, aur us par <html>, <head>, <body> par sirf ve attributes reset karta hai jo JSX se manage hote hain — jo script ke set kiye hue ko saaf kar deta hai; page tab attribute ke bina render hota hai, value ke asal source ko ignore karke.
  • Fix: client par stored value padho aur use us component me lagu karo jo theme ka malik hai, ek useLayoutEffect me jo paint se pehle chalta hai (production me iski zaroorat nahi):
tsx
// app/components/theme-toggle.tsx ('use client')
export function ThemeToggle() {
  // Re-apply after React clears it on the dev remount. This is a no-op in production.
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const theme = localStorage.getItem('theme')
    if (theme) document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme)
  }, [])

  function toggle() {
    const next =
      (localStorage.getItem('theme') ?? 'light') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'
    localStorage.setItem('theme', next)
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next)
  }

  return <button onClick={toggle}>Toggle theme</button>
}

any drishtikonon ka upyog kab karein

SituationApproach
tarikh request data (cookies, header) par nirbhar karti hai.request data aur format server-side parhne ke liye headers() ya cookies() ka upyog karein
date update live (kaauntdaaun timer, gharee)useEffect aur suppressHydrationWarning ke saath Client Component ka upyog karein
page pahle se hi puri tarah se dynamic haiAccept-Language header ka upyog karke server par tarikh ko formatted karein
languages ke beech content ka anuvad karnaprati-local static build ya dynamic rendering ke saath internationalization ka upyog karein
  • Kyun useEffect nahi? Ye hydration aur paint ke baad chalta hai — user pehle server value dekhta hai, phir correction; effect me state set karne se re-render hota hai jo parent Suspense boundaries ko trigger kar sakta hai. useLayoutEffect paint se pehle chalta hai lekin hydration ke baad — ye hydration aur paint ke beech ki flash rokta hai, lekin HTML aane aur React ke hydrate karne ke beech ki nahi (slow connection par React load hone se pehle browser server HTML paint kar sakta hai). Inline script HTML parsing ke dauraan chalti hai, React ke shamil hone se bhi pehle.
  • Kyun request time par headers/cookies se nahi padhte? await headers() ke saath Accept-Language padhna per-request data hai; Cache Components ke saath tum date ko sirf ek Suspense fallback me wrap kar sakte ho taaki baaki static rahe. Lekin tum turant content ke bajaye fallback dikhate ho, aur Accept-Language me time zone ki jaankari shamil nahi hoti.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Client Component seedhe toLocaleDateString() se dates format karna — hydration error + flash; inline-script + suppressHydrationWarning pattern (ya reusable LocalDate Client Component) use karo.
  • suppressHydrationWarning bhool jana — React nearest boundary se client-render karke recover karta hai, flash ke saath us boundary ke baaki inline-script corrections bhi kho jate hain.
  • DOM update ke through daali gayi scripts execute nahi hoti — soft navigation par script nahi chalegi; component ko Client Component banao taaki formatting browser rendering par chale.
  • Bina 'unsafe-inline' allow kiye strict CSP inline scripts ko block karta hai — ek nonce jodo.
  • Root layout me theme cookie padhna — static prerendering opt-out ho jata hai (aur Cache Components ke tahat har segment block hota hai); iske bajaye inline script me padho.
  • Local dev me locale mismatch miss karna — TZ/LANG ko browser se alag set karo (jaise TZ=UTC LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8 next dev).

interview points

  • FOUC Next.js context me kya hai aur client-only state (locale, time zone, theme, persisted UI) iska kaaran kyun banti hai.
  • Teen fail approaches (Client Component re-render → hydration error; useEffect → flash; server-only → galat locale) aur inline-script solution (pehle paint se pehle parsing ke dauraan chalti hai).
  • suppressHydrationWarning semantics (DOM jeet-ta hai); iske bina recovery client-render hoti hai aur siblings ke script corrections kho jate hain.
  • LocalDate reusable pattern (Client Component + InlineScript type switch + useId; hard vs soft navigation behavior) aur theme pattern (localStorage vs cookie, <html> par data-theme, optional useServerInsertedHTML).
  • Lazy state initializer se React state ko script-set DOM ke saath sync rakhna; <html> attributes ke liye Strict Mode dev remount workaround aur useLayoutEffect re-apply fix; dusre approaches (headers/cookies, live dates, fully dynamic pages, i18n) kab use karein.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/preventing-flash-before-hydration
Hissa 73 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to optimize your Next.js application for production

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to optimize your Next.js application for production. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to optimize your Next.js application for production — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Automatic optimizations (enabled by default, no config), Server Components, Code-splitting, Prefetching, Prerendering, Caching. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • build ke dauraan aur production mein jaane se pahle ek sandarbh ke roop mein upyog karne ke liye sabse achha abhyas cheklist, saath hi automatic: Next.js optimization ke bare mein jaagrook hona.

automatic optimization (default dwara enable, koi config nahi)

  • Server Components: default; server par chalaein, client bundle size par koi prabhav nahi daalne ke liye koi client JS ki requirement nahi hai. interactivity ke liye zaroorat ke hisaab se Client Components ka upyog karein.
  • Code-splitting: Server Components route segments dwara automatic code-spliting enable banata hai; lazy loading Client Components aur third-party ke libraries par bhi vichar karta hai.
  • Prefetching: jab ek link viewport mein access karta hai, to Next.js background mein route ko priority data hai - navigation lagabhag tatkal lagta hai; jahan upyukt ho bahar niklein.
  • Prendering: server aur Client Components ko server par build samay aur parinam cached par prerender kiya jata hai; vishisht routes ke liye Dynamic Rendering mein chunein jahan upyukt ho.
  • Caching: data request, Server/Client component parinam, static assets pradan ki jati hain, aur adhik ko server/DB/backend ko network requests ko kam karne ke liye cache kiya jata hai; jahan upyukt ho bahar niklein.
  • ye default performance mein sudhar karte hain aur prati network request ko moved lagat aur data ko kam karte hain.

development ke dauraan - routing aur rendering

  • Layouts: pages par UI sajha karta hai; navigation par partial rendering enable karta hai.
  • <Link>: ise client-side navigation aur prefetching ke liye upyog karte hain.
  • Error handling: ne custom error pages ke saath production mein catch-ol aur 404 errors ko sundar dhang se sambhala.
  • Client aur Server Components: recommended structure pattern ka palan karein; client JS bundle ko anavashyak roop se barhne se bachne ke liye "use client" boundary plesmeint ki check karein.
  • Request-time APIs (cookies, searchParams prop): ve keval request samay par known data ko parhte hain - unhein <Suspense> mein upyog karne wale components ko lapette hain, isliye baki route abhi bhi prahaar kar sakte hain. Without Cache Components ka upyog karte hue pure route ko Dynamic Rendering (ya puri app yadi Root Layout mein upyog kiya jata hai) mein chunta hai.

development ke dauraan - data lane aur caching

  • Server Components: server par data prapt karta hai.
  • Route Handlers: unhein Client Components se backend sansadhanon tak pahunchne ke liye upyog karta hai - lekin Route Handlers ko Server Components se call nahi karte hain (ek extra server request prapt).
  • Streaming: ka upyog load ho raha hai UI + React Suspense ko pragtishil roop se UI bhejne ke liye kiya jata hai aur pure route ko data lane par blocked karne se rokta hai.
  • Parallel data lane: parallel jahan upyukt mein lane ke dwara network jharne ko kam karta hai.
  • Data caching: verify karein ki kya data request cache kiye gaye hain; caching mein chunein jahan upyukt ho; gair-fetch requests ko sunishchit karna cached (unstable_cache) hai.
  • Static images: automatic roop se static assets ko cache karne ke liye public directory ka upyog karta hai.

development ke dauraan - UI aur sulabhataa

  • Forms and Validation: form prastutiyon, server-side validation aur error handling ke liye Server Actions ka upyog karta hai.
  • Global error UI: sangat, accessible fallback UI ke liye app/global-error.tsx jorte hain aur application mein bina kisi error ke recovery karte hain.
  • Global 404: ne app mein bejor routes ke liye accessible 404 ke liye app/global-not-found.tsx ko joda.
  • Font module: next/font any static assets ke saath auto-host font files, external network requests ko hata deti hain, layout shift ko kam karti hai.
  • <Image>: auto-optimizes images, layout shift ko rokta hai, WebP jaise aadhunik formats ka karya karta hai.
  • <Script>: third-party ki lipiyon ko define karta hai, unhein main dhage ko blocked karne se rokta hai.
  • ESLint: initial pahunch muddon ko catch ke liye built-in eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y ka upyog karta hai.

development ke dauraan - security

  • Tainting: sanvedanshil data ko data objekts and/or vishisht manon ko taint karke client tak pahunchne se rokta hai.
  • Server Actions: pratyek action ke andar authentication aur authorization ko verify karta hai; akele Proxy ya layout/page-level check par bharosa nahi karte hain. DB ko server-only Data Access Layer tak le jaata jaa sakta hai; mahnge karyon ke liye simit dar par vichar karein; recommended security prathaon (Next.js security blog) ki samiksha karein.
  • Environment char: sunishchit karta hai ki .env.* filein .gitignore mein hain; keval public char NEXT_PUBLIC_ upasarg prapt karte hain.
  • Content Security Policy: ne XSS, klikjaiking aur any code-injekshan hamlon ke khilaf security ke liye ek CSP jorne par vichar kiya.

development ke dauraan - metadata aur SEO

  • Metadata API: page shirshak, vivaran, aadi SEO ke liye.
  • Open Graph chhaviyan: samajik sharing ke liye OG image banata hai.
  • Sitemaps aur robot: sitemaps aur robot files ko generated karta hai taaki sarch injan application ko crawl/index kar sakein.

development ke dauraan - prakar security

  • TypeScript + TS plugin: behatar prakar security, jaldi errors ko pakro.

production karne se pahle

  • build errors ko catch ke liye local roop se next build chalaein, phir production jaisi environment mein performance ko mapne ke liye next start.
  • Core Web Vitals: ne user ke anubhav ko samajhane aur sudhaaron ko khojne ke liye incognito mein Lighthouse ko chalaya (simulated test — jaise field data ke saath pair). Core Web Vitals data ko analytics tool mein bhejne ke liye useReportWebVitals hook ka upyog karein. Core Web Vitals
  • Analyzing bundle: JS bundle size ka vishleshan karne aur bare modules/dependencies. ki identity karne ke liye @next/bundle-analyzer plugin ka upyog karta hai any tool: Import Cost (VS Code), Package Phobia, Bundle Phobia, bundles.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Route Handlers ko Server Components (extra server request) se call karna - iske bajaay seedhe Server Component mein le jana.
  • <Suspense> ke bina Root Layout mein request samay API ka upyog karna - pure app ko dynamic rendering ( Cache Components ke bina) mein chunta hai.
  • local roop se pahle next build + next start chalane ke bina shipinga.
  • Server Action security ke liye akele Proxy/layout check par nirbhar karta hai - pratyek action ke andar ek dusre ko verify karta hai.

interview points

  • panch automatic optimization (Server Components, code-spliting, prefetching, prerendering, caching) aur pratyek khareed kya hai.
  • routing/rendering, data/caching, UI/a11y, security, metadata/SEO, prakar security - aur key vastuon ke pichhe tark (e.g). "use client" boundary plesmeint, Route Handlers ko Server Components, teinting, server-only DAL se nahi bulaya gaya.
  • purv production validation paas: next build → next start → Lighthouse + useReportWebVitals + bundle vishleshana.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/production-checklist
Hissa 74 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to build a Progressive Web Application (PWA) with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to build a Progressive Web Application (PWA) with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to build a Progressive Web Application (PWA) with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: PWAs, Step 1: Creating the web app manifest, Step 2: Implementing web push notifications, PushNotificationManager (Client Component), InstallPrompt, Step 3: Implementing Server Actions (app/actions.ts). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • PWAs web apps ki reach/accessibility ko native mobile apps ke features aur UX ke saath jodte hain — ek codebase, cross-platform, koi app-store approvals nahi, instant updates, home-screen installation, push notifications.

step 1: web app ko prakat karna

  • Next.js ne App Router ke through web app manifest ke liye built-in support kiya hai — ek static ya dynamic manifest file banao, app/manifest.ts ya app/manifest.json:
tsx
// app/manifest.ts
import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'

export default function manifest(): MetadataRoute.Manifest {
  return {
    name: 'Next.js PWA',
    short_name: 'NextPWA',
    description: 'A Progressive Web App built with Next.js',
    start_url: '/',
    display: 'standalone',
    background_color: '#ffffff',
    theme_color: '#000000',
    icons: [
      {
        src: '/icon-192x192.png',
        sizes: '192x192',
        type: 'image/png',
      },
      {
        src: '/icon-512x512.png',
        sizes: '512x512',
        type: 'image/png',
      },
    ],
  }
}
  • Manifest me home-screen icon ke liye name, icons aur display mode hota hai — native-like app ke roop me install enable karta hai. Ek favicon generator (jaise realfavicongenerator.net) use karke icon sets banao aur unhe public/ me rakho.

step 2: web push notifications ko lagu karna

  • Saare modern browsers me supported: home screen par installed apps ke liye iOS 16.4+, macOS 13+ ke liye Safari 16, Chromium-based browsers, Firefox. Is tarah PWA ek viable native alternative hai; khaas taur par, tum offline support ki zaroorat ke bina install prompts trigger kar sakte ho. Push notifications users ko tab bhi re-engage karte hain jab ve actively app use nahi kar rahe.
  • PushNotificationManager (Client Component): 'serviceWorker' in navigator && 'PushManager' in window check karta hai → service worker register karta hai (navigator.serviceWorker.register(new URL('../lib/service-worker.js', import.meta.url), { scope: '/', updateViaCache: 'none' })), kisi bhi existing subscription ko registration.pushManager.getSubscription() ke through padhta hai. Subscribe: registration.pushManager.subscribe({ userVisibleOnly: true, applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY!) }), phir serialized subscription subscribeUser Server Action ko bhejta hai. Unsubscribe: subscription?.unsubscribe() + unsubscribeUser() Server Action. Test bhejo: sendNotification(message) Server Action. Agar supported nahi, to "Is browser me push notifications supported nahi hain" render hota hai.
  • urlBase64ToUint8Array URL-safe base64 VAPID public key ko convert karta hai (padding, - → +, _ → /, window.atob, byte array).
  • InstallPrompt: user-agent regex (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/) aur window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ke through standalone mode se iOS detect karta hai; pehle se installed hone par null return karta hai. Warna "Install App" / "Add to Home Screen" button dikhata hai, plus iOS instructions (share button tap karo, phir "Add to Home Screen").

step 3: karyanvayan server action (app/actions.ts)

  • web-push package; VAPID configure karo:
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import webpush from 'web-push'

webpush.setVapidDetails(
  '<mailto:your-email@example.com>',
  process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY!,
  process.env.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY!
)

let subscription: PushSubscription | null = null

export async function subscribeUser(sub: PushSubscription) {
  subscription = sub
  // In production, store the subscription in a database
  return { success: true }
}

export async function unsubscribeUser() {
  subscription = null
  return { success: true }
}

export async function sendNotification(message: string) {
  if (!subscription) {
    throw new Error('No subscription available')
  }

  try {
    await webpush.sendNotification(
      subscription,
      JSON.stringify({
        title: 'Test Notification',
        body: message,
        icon: '/icon.png',
      })
    )
    return { success: true }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error sending push notification:', error)
    return { success: false, error: 'Failed to send notification' }
  }
}
  • Production me, subscriptions ko ek database me store karo (server restarts, multiple users ke across stability) yahan dikhaye gaye in-memory variable ke bajaye.

step 4: VAPID key generated karna

  • Globally web-push install karo (pnpm add -g web-push / npm / yarn / bun), phir web-push generate-vapid-keys chalao aur output .env me rakho:
code
NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=your_public_key_here
VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key_here

step 5: ek serve worker banana (lib/service-worker.js)

js
self.addEventListener('push', function (event) {
  if (event.data) {
    const data = event.data.json()
    const options = {
      body: data.body,
      icon: data.icon || '/icon.png',
      badge: '/badge.png',
      vibrate: [100, 50, 100],
      data: {
        dateOfArrival: Date.now(),
        primaryKey: '2',
      },
    }
    event.waitUntil(self.registration.showNotification(data.title, options))
  }
})

self.addEventListener('notificationclick', function (event) {
  console.log('Notification click received.')
  event.notification.close()
  event.waitUntil(clients.openWindow('<https://your-website.com>'))
})
  • Incoming push events (custom icon/badge, vibration pattern, attached data) aur notification clicks handle karta hai (notification band karta hai, ek URL par application kholta hai — placeholder URL update karo). Devices/browsers ke across thoroughly test karo.

step 6: hom screen mein jodna

  • Requirements: ek valid web app manifest (step 1) + site HTTPS par serve ho. Modern browsers criteria pure hone par automatically ek installation prompt dikhate hain. beforeinstallprompt ke through ek custom install button possible hai lekin recommended nahi — ye cross-browser/platform nahi hai (Safari iOS par kaam nahi karta).

step 7: local roop se testing karna

  • Locally HTTPS: next dev --experimental-https ke saath chalao. Browser ko notifications enabled hone chahiye — locally permission accept karo; ensure karo ki notifications globally disabled nahi hain; agar abhi bhi kaam nahi kar rahe, to debug karne ke liye ek dusra browser try karo.

step 8: apne aavedan ko surakshit rakhein

  • async headers() ke through next.config.js me security headers configure karo:
  • Global (saare routes): X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (MIME sniffing rokta hai, malicious file uploads se risk kam karta hai); X-Frame-Options: DENY (clickjacking protection — iframes me embed hone se rokta hai); Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (requests ke saath bheji jaane wali referrer info control karta hai).
  • Service worker (/sw.js): Content-Type: application/javascript; charset=utf-8 (JS ke roop me sahi interpret); Cache-Control: no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate (koi bhi service worker ko cache nahi karta — users hamesha latest version paate hain); Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' (strict CSP, sirf same-origin scripts).
  • Zyada ke liye Content Security Policy guide dekho.

apne PWA ka vistar karna

1. More capabilities: background async, aavdhik background async, File System Access API, aadi - inspiration ke liye whatpwacando.today dekhein. 2. Static export: yadi app ko server ke bina chalana chahiye, to static export enable karein - lekin Server Actions se ek external API mein jaein aur header ko apne proxy mein le jaein. 3. offline support: Next.js connectivity-eveyar UI ke liye experimental useOffline hook + experimental.useOffline config pradan karta hai aur fail navigation/Server action requests ki automatic retry pradan karta hai. full serve-worker-aadharit offline caching ke liye, ek vikalp sarvist hai (Next.js ekikaran udaharan Turbopack aur webpack ke liye). 4. Security: HTTPS, push sandeshon ke source ko valid karte hain, uchit error haindlinga. 5. UX: pragtishil vriddhi isliye app achhi tarah se kaam karta hai jab PWA features ko browser dwara supported nahi kiya jata hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Bina HTTPS ke push test karna — notifications ko secure context chahiye; next dev --experimental-https use karo.
  • Production me subscriptions sirf memory me rakhna — restarts par gayab; ek DB me store karo.
  • Service worker ko cache karna — hamesha use no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate ke saath serve karo.
  • Custom beforeinstallprompt install button — cross-browser nahi (Safari iOS par fail); automatic prompt + iOS instructions par rely karo.
  • notificationclick handler me placeholder URL update karna bhool jana.

interview points

  • Ek PWA kya hai aur Next.js building blocks: manifest (app/manifest.ts), service worker, Web Push (VAPID), Server Actions (web-push), install criteria (manifest + HTTPS).
  • End-to-end push flow: VAPID keys → applicationServerKey ke saath pushManager.subscribe → subscription server-side stored → webpush.sendNotification → service worker push event → showNotification; notificationclick handling.
  • iOS specifics (16.4+ home-screen install; manual "Add to Home Screen" instructions) aur beforeinstallprompt limits.
  • App aur service worker ke liye security headers; offline options (useOffline vs Serwist); static-export trade-offs (koi Server Actions nahi).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/progressive-web-apps
Hissa 75 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Building public pages

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Building public pages. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Building public pages — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Public pages, Step 1: Add a simple header (static component), Step 2: Add the product list (dynamic component → cache it), Cache, Stream, Step 3: Add a dynamic promotion banner (stream it). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • pablik prishth pratyek user ko saman content dikhate hain - landing page, vipanan page, product page, list page (product, blog), news sthala. chunki data sajha kiya jata hai, isliye in pages ko samay se pahle render kiya jaa sakta hai aur pun: upyog kiya jaa sakta hai → tej page bhar, kam server lagata.
  • udaharan: ek product list page. sansadhan: video (youtu.be/F6romq71KtI), demo (cache-components-public-pages.labs.vercel.dev), code (github.com/nextjs/cache-components-public-pages). guide ek static header ke saath shuru hota hai, esink external data ke saath ek product list jodta hai, ise jawab ko blocked kiye bina render karta hai, aur ant mein dynamic rendering ke liye pure page ko svich kiye bina user-vishisht padonnti bainar jodta hai.

step 1: ek sadharan header (static component) jorein

tsx
// app/products/page.tsx
// Static component
function Header() {
  return <h1>Shop</h1>
}

export default async function Page() {
  return (
    <>
      <Header />
    </>
  )
}
  • ek static component un inputon par nirbhar nahi karta hai jo requests ke beech parivartan karte hain: external data, request header, root param, vartaman samay, random maana. iska production kabhi nahi badalta hai aur samay se pahle set kiya jaa sakta hai, isliye Next.js surakshit roop se page ko build time mein render kar sakta hai - koi spasht config ki requirement nahi hai. next build ki pushti:
bash
Route (app)      Revalidate  Expire
┌ ○ /products           15m      1y
└ ○ /_not-found

○  (Static)  prerendered as static content
  • not: kisi view flash ke bina local logon ke liye dates/times, hydration se pahle flash ko rokna dekhein.

step 2: product list jorein (dynamic component → ise cache karein)

tsx
// app/products/page.tsx
import db from '@/db'
import { List } from '@/app/products/ui'

function Header() {}

// Dynamic component
async function ProductList() {
  const products = await db.product.findMany()
  return <List items={products} />
}

export default async function Page() {
  return (
    <>
      <Header />
      <ProductList />
    </>
  )
}
  • product list external data par nirbhar karti hai ki can samay ke saath badalta hai, isliye iska production static nahi hai - yeh ek dynamic component hai. margdarshan ke bina, phremavark maan leta hai ki aap har request par fresh data chahte hain (manak web behavior: ek naya server request page render karta hai). lekin request samay par ise render karne se entire route mein delay hoti hai - bhale hi header turant render karta hai, ise browser mein tab tak nahi bheja jaa sakta jab tak ki product list taiyar nahi ho jati hai.
  • sanrakshan: pahli bar jab aap bina kisi data ka wait karte hain, to Next.js ek warning dikhata hai (bloking-prareindar-dynamic) - <Suspense> ke bahar bina kiye gaye data tak pahunchne se route ko roka jaa sakta hai. aapko yeh tay karna hoga ki pratikriya ko kaise blocked kiya jaaye:
  • Cache component → yeh static ho jata hai aur ise baki page ke saath render kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • Stream component → yeh gair blocked ho jata hai; shesh page await nahi karta hai.
  • product list upyogkartaon bhar mein sajha ki jati hai, isliye caching sahi vikalp hai - ise 'use cache' ke saath chihnit karein:
tsx
// Cache component
async function ProductList() {
  'use cache'
  const products = await db.product.findMany()
  return <List items={products} />
}
  • yeh ise ek cache component banata hai: pahla run ka return value cached aur pun: upyog kiya jata hai. yadi request aane se pahle ek cache component ke input upalabdh hain, to ise static component ki tarah prerender kiya jaa sakta hai. page turant load ho raha hai, aur next build abhi bhi static (○) ke roop mein /products ko dikhata hai.

step 3: ek dynamic padonnti bainar jorein (ismein stream karein)

  • request-vishisht input (user ka sthan, A/B testing) ke aadhar par ek padonnti bainar jorein - is bar caching blocked behavior ko theek nahi kar sakta hai:
tsx
// Dynamic component
async function PromotionContent() {
  const promotion = await getPromotion()
  return <Promotion data={promotion} />
}
  • Partial prerendering: dynamic content ka matalab puri tarah se blocked render par wapas nahi jana hai - streaming ke saath anabloka. Next.js default roop se streaming ka support karta hai: ek <Suspense> boundary us dhanche ko bataatee hai jahan dharabaddh pratikriya ko chankne mein vibhajit kiya jata hai aur content bhar ke dauraan dikhane ke liye kaun see fallback UI hoti hai:
tsx
export default async function Page() {
  return (
    <>
      <Suspense fallback={<PromotionSkeleton />}>
        <PromotionContent />
      </Suspense>
      <Header />
      <ProductList />
    </>
  )
}
  • fallback ko static/cached content ke saath purv mein render kiya gaya hai; baad mein ek bar mein internal component dharaon ko pura karta hai. route partial roop se prerendered ho jata hai - next build dikhata hai:
bash
Route (app)      Revalidate  Expire
┌ ◐ /products    15m      1y
└ ◐ /_not-found

◐  (Partial Prerender)  Prerendered as static HTML with dynamic server-streamed content
  • build Time par, adhikansh page (header, product list, padonnti wapsi) pradan kiya jata hai, cache kiya jata hai, aur ek CDN par dhakel diya jata hai. request time mein, previous bhag ko paas ke CDN nod se turant served jata hai; parallel mein, user-vishisht padonnti server par render karti hai, client ko stream karti hai, aur fallback slot mein svaip karti hai. adhikansh page turant load hota hai; dynamic bhagon mein upalabdh ke roop mein stream hota hai.

agla kadam

  • chaynit root output ko app mein parivartan ke roop mein static rakhein; purvnirdharit pages/cached data (ISR Cache Components ke saath); root parameter (generateStaticParams) ke saath variant banaein; ek Cache Components app mein authentication jorein.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • ek page ke top par anchahe data ka wait karna - pure route (header shamil) ko tab tak blocked karta hai jab tak ki pheephaa samapt nahi hota.
  • caching request-vishisht data (transfer, A/B testing) - galat tool; ise iske bajaay <Suspense> ke pichhe stream karein.
  • kisi bhi dynamic content ke saath ek page ka estimate puri tarah se dynamic hona chahiye - partial prerendering static bahumat ko tatkal rakhta hai.

interview points

  • static banam dynamic banam cache component: pratyek ko kya banata hai, aur yeh kaise tay karta hai.
  • blocked-prerender warning aur do anablok vikalp (catch banam stream) - jab pratyek lagu hota hai (sheyard data → cache; request-vishisht data → dhara).
  • partial prerendering maikeniks: build-time prerender + CDN, request-samay par fallback slot mein streaming; next build output (○ static banam polar prerender) padhna.

Hissa 76 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to handle redirects in Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to handle redirects in Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to handle redirects in Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key concepts — the five redirect APIs, redirect function, permanentRedirect function, useRouter() hook, redirects in next.config.js, NextResponse.redirect in Proxy. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

main concepts - panch redirect API

APIPurposeWherestetas code
redirectek mutation ya event ke baad user ko redirect kareinServer Components, server karya, Route Handlers307 (asthayi) ya 303 (Server Action)
permanentRedirectek mutation ya event ke baad user ko redirect kareinServer Components, server karya, Route Handlers308 (Permanent)
useRouterclient-side navigationClient Components mein iveint handlerN/A
redirects in next.config.jsek path ke aadhar par aane wale request ko redirect kareinnext.config.js file307 (asthayi) ya 308 (sthayi)
NextResponse.redirectek shart ke aadhar par ek aane wale request ko redirect kareinProxyAny

punarnirdeshan

  • redirect (next/navigation se) user ko dusre URL ko redirect karta hai; Server Components, Route Handlers aur Server Functions mein call karne yogya. aksar ek mutation/event, e.g ke baad upyog kiya jata hai. ek post banane:
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'

export async function createPost(id: string) {
  try {
    // Call database
  } catch (error) {
    // Handle errors
  }

  revalidatePath('/posts') // Update cached posts
  redirect(`/post/${id}`) // Navigate to the new post page
}
  • Notes:
  • ek Server Action mein, redirect ek client-side navigation karta hai jab JS upalabdh hai; JS ke bina, form sabmishan 303 (See Other) ka upyog karta hai. any sandarbhon mein yeh 307 (Temporary Redirect) ka upyog karta hai.
  • redirect throws ek error hai, isliye ise outside ko try/catch mein try block kahte hain.
  • ise render karne ke dauraan Client Components mein bulaya jaa sakta hai, lekin event ke handler mein nahi - iske bajaay useRouter hook ka upyog karein.
  • yeh full URL accept karta hai (external link par redirect kar sakta hai).
  • rendering prakriya se pahle redirect karne ke liye, next.config.js redirects ya Proxy ka upyog karein.

permanentRedirect function

  • permanentRedirect sthayi roop se user ko redirect karta hai; redirect ke saman call saaitsa. ek mutation/event ke baad ek ikai ke kainonikal URL — e.g ko badalane ke baad prayog kiya jata hai.
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { permanentRedirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'

export async function updateUsername(username: string, formData: FormData) {
  try {
    // Call database
  } catch (error) {
    // Handle errors
  }

  revalidateTag('username', 'max') // Update all references to the username
  permanentRedirect(`/profile/${username}`) // Navigate to the new user profile
}
  • ek Server Action mein yeh client-navigate jab JS upalabdh hai; JS ke bina form sabmishan 303 ka upyog karta hai. any sandarbhon mein yeh 308 (Permanent Redirect) ka upyog karta hai. iske alava full URL accept karta hai. pree-render redirect ke liye, next.config.js ya Proxy ka upyog karein.

useRouter() hook

  • ek Client Component mein ek event handler ke andar redirect karne ke liye, useRouter (next/navigation) se router.push() ka upyog karein:
tsx
// app/page.tsx ('use client')
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'

export default function Page() {
  const router = useRouter()

  return (
    <button type="button" onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')}>
      Dashboard
    </button>
  )
}
  • yadi aapko programmatic roop se navigate karne ki requirement nahi hai, to iske bajaay ek <Link> component ka upyog karein.

next.config.js mein redirect

  • ek alag destination ke liye ek aane wale request path ko redirect karein - URL structure ko badalane ya samay se pahle known punarnirdeshon ki list ke liye upyogi hota hai. path match plus header, cookie aur query match ka support karta hai.
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  async redirects() {
    return [
      // Basic redirect
      {
        source: '/about',
        destination: '/',
        permanent: true,
      },
      // Wildcard path matching
      {
        source: '/blog/:slug',
        destination: '/news/:slug',
        permanent: true,
      },
    ]
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • return 307 (asthayi) ya 308 (sthayi) permanent vikalp ke madhyam se.
  • platform boundary lagu ho sakti hai - e.g. Vercel 1,024 redirects ko simit karta hai. 1000+ redirect ke liye, ek custom Proxy samadhan ka upyog karein (neeche diye gaye paimane par prabandh redirect dekhein).
  • redirects before Proxy chalata hai.

Proxy mein NextResponse.redirect

  • Proxy ek request pura karne se pahle code chalata hai; aane wale request ke aadhar par, NextResponse.redirect ke saath redirect - shart aadharit redirects (autheintikeshan, session prabandhan) ya bare redirect count ke liye upyogi. udaharan: Unauthenticated upyogkartaon ko /login par redirect karein:
ts
// proxy.ts
import { NextResponse, NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { authenticate } from 'auth-provider'

export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const isAuthenticated = authenticate(request)

  // If the user is authenticated, continue as normal
  if (isAuthenticated) {
    return NextResponse.next()
  }

  // Redirect to login page if not authenticated
  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))
}

export const config = {
  matcher: '/dashboard/:path*',
}
  • Proxy after redirects ko next.config.js aur before rendering mein chalata hai.

paimane par redirect prabandhan (advanced)

  • 1000+ redirects ke liye, ek custom Proxy samadhan ka build karein taaki redirects ko programmatic roop se reepleing ke bina sambhala jaa sake. do chintaaon: (1) creating/storing ek redirect map; (2) lookup performance ko customize karna. udaharan: bloom philtar ke saath Proxy (redirects-bloom-filter.vercel.app).
  • 1. ek redirect map ka build aur storage: ek DB (aamtaur par ek pramukh value store) ya JSON file mein sangrahit punarnirdeshon ki ek list:
json
{
  "/old": {
    "destination": "/new",
    "permanent": true
  },
  "/blog/post-old": {
    "destination": "/blog/post-new",
    "permanent": true
  }
}
  • Proxy mein, ek DB jaise Vercel Global Config ya Redis se padha gaya aur aane wale request ke aadhar par redirect kiya gaya:
ts
// proxy.ts
import { NextResponse, NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { get } from '@vercel/global-config'

type RedirectEntry = {
  destination: string
  permanent: boolean
}

export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname
  const redirectData = await get(pathname)

  if (redirectData && typeof redirectData === 'string') {
    const redirectEntry: RedirectEntry = JSON.parse(redirectData)
    const statusCode = redirectEntry.permanent ? 308 : 307
    return NextResponse.redirect(redirectEntry.destination, statusCode)
  }

  // No redirect found, continue without redirecting
  return NextResponse.next()
}
  • 2. optimizing lookup performance: prati request ek bare dataset ko parhne ke liye slow/expensive. hai jo tezi se parhne wali DB and/or ek Bloom filtar ke saath optimize karta hai taaki kushalataapoorvak check ki jaa sake ki kya ek redirect maujud hai before bare punarnirdeshon ko parh raha hai file/DB. Proxy mein ek generated bloom philtar file import karein; yadi path ka naam philtar mein hai, to ek Route Handler (/api/redirects?pathname=...) ke liye aage barhein jo actual file ki check karta hai aur redirect entry return karta hai - yeh Proxy mein ek badi redirect file ko import karne se rokta hai (jo har request ko dhima kar dega). Route Handler ne redirects.json ko padha, entry (ya lapta path naam / bloom-philtar jhoothi positivity ke liye 400) laute. bloom-filters jaisi library ke saath filtar generated karein; durbhavnapurn requests ko rokne ke liye Route Handler ko request valid karein.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • try block ke andar redirect ko bulana - yeh throw karta hai, isliye ise error ke roop mein pakda jayega; ise after/outside try kahte hain.
  • ek Client Component iveint handler mein redirect ko bulana - vahan ki permission nahi; router.push() ka upyog karein.
  • next.config.js mein 1000+ redirect karna - pletform simaein (Vercel: 1,024); iske bajaay Proxy + redirect-map drishtikon ka upyog karein.
  • order ko bhool jana: redirects (config) Proxy se pahle chalta hai, jo rendering se pahle chalta hai.
  • bloom philtar jhoothi sakaaraatmak - Route Handler ko actual map ki phir se check karni chahiye aur anupasthit hone par koi apratyaksh nahi hona chahiye.

interview points

  • panch redirect tantr aur jab pratyek phit baithta hai (post-mutation redirect/permanentRedirect, client iveint router.push, static config redirects, sashart Proxy NextResponse.redirect).
  • stetas code: 307 banam 308 banam 303 (Server Action bina JS); redirect throw karta hai to yeh try ke bahar chala jata hai.
  • execution order (config redirects → Proxy → render) aur pletform simaein.
  • paimane par redirect karta hai: ek KV store + bloom philtar pree-check + Route Handler lookup mein map ko redirect karta hai; kyon filtar maujud hai (pratyek request par Proxy mein ek badi file import karne ke liye).
