Hissa 77 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Next.js Rendering Philosophy

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Next.js Rendering Philosophy. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Next.js Rendering Philosophy — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key concepts — static and dynamic as a spectrum, What this enables, Faster perceived load times, Incremental caching, Granular caching, The trade-off — three models compared. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

main concepts - ek spektram ke roop mein static aur dynamic

  • Aksar frameworks static aur dynamic ke beech route level par ek hard line kheenchti hain: ek page ya to build time par prerender hota hai ya request time par server-render. Samajhne/deploy karne me aasan (static files ek CDN ko, dynamic routes ek server ko).
  • Next.js ek alag approach leta hai: static aur dynamic ke beech ki boundary component level par hai, route level par nahi. Ek page me ek static shell ho sakta hai jo turant load hota hai aur dynamic sections jo resolve hone par stream in hote hain. Ek cached function ek dynamic route ke andar reh sakta hai. Ek static page bina redeploy ke update ho sakta hai.
  • Yahi hai jo Partial Prerendering, Cache Components ('use cache'), aur on-demand revalidation enable karte hain — incremental features nahi, lekin ek rendering model jo static/dynamic ko ek binary choice ke bajaye ek spectrum ke roop me treat karta hai.

kya yeh enable banata hai

  • Tez perceived load times: static shell turant render hota hai jabki dynamic content stream in hota hai — users poore page ka wait karne ke bajaye turant useful content dekhte hain.
  • Incremental caching: build time par pehle se decide kiye bina caching/revalidation incrementally jodo, chahe route static ho ya dynamic. Kisi bhi page ko on demand revalidate kiya ja sakta hai; kisi bhi function ko 'use cache' ke saath cache kiya ja sakta hai.
  • Granular caching: ek function ko 'use cache' ke saath cache karo, ek route ko nahi; ek tag revalidate karo, deployment nahi. Ek mehngi DB query baaki page se independently cache ho sakti hai.

vyapar band — teen modal ki tulna mein

  • Build-time prerendering: har page build time par generate hota hai; output static files hain jo zero runtime infrastructure ke saath kisi bhi CDN/file server se servable hain. Agar dynamic content ho, to use load ke baad client-side fetch karna padta hai. Deploy karne me sabse aasan, lekin har content change ke liye rebuild + redeploy chahiye.
  • Route-level boundaries: har route static ya dynamic choose karta hai; static routes build par prerender hote hain, dynamic routes per request server-render hote hain. Infrastructure saaf split hota hai (CDN vs server) aur reason karna straightforward hai — lekin choice per route all-or-nothing hai. Ek dynamic element (user greeting, live price) wala mostly-static page ya to puri tarah dynamic hona chahiye ya load ke baad us element ko client par fetch karna chahiye.
  • Component-level boundaries (Next.js): static aur dynamic content ek single streaming response ke andar coexist karte hain — ek static shell jo turant load hota hai, ek cached function jo independently revalidate hota hai, ek dynamic section jo resolve hone par stream in hota hai — bina kuch alag routes ya client-side fetches me split kiye. Trade-off infrastructure complexity hai: ek finer-grained rendering boundary complexity ko application code se hosting platform me transfer karti hai.

structure nihitaarth

  • Streaming required hai — static aur dynamic content ek response me serve hote hain; server pehle initial content bhejta hai, phir dynamic portions ko resolve hone par stream karta hai (Streaming dekho).
  • Multiple instances ke saath cache coordination required hai — kisi bhi cached content ko revalidateTag() / revalidatePath() ke through on demand invalidate kiya ja sakta hai (How Revalidation Works dekho).
  • Cache consistency matter karti hai — revalidation HTML response aur RSC payload (client-side navigation ke liye data) dono regenerate karti hai; agar ve out of sync ho jayein, to users navigation ke dauraan inconsistent data dekhte hain (How Revalidation Works dekho).
  • CDN latency par PPR shell delivery ke liye static shell ko alag store karne aur dynamic rendering ko sahi se resume karne ke liye extra platform integration chahiye ho sakta hai (PPR Platform Guide dekho).
  • Har requirement ek capability se map hoti hai: streaming → progressive delivery; cache coordination → invalidation saare instances me propagate hoti hai; cache consistency → HTML aur RSC sync me rehte hain; PPR-at-edge → extra shell/resume integration.

portebilitee aur nishtha

  • Next.js ek Node.js server process ke roop me chalta hai; ek single process har feature ko sahi handle karta hai. Streaming support Server Components aur PPR ki progressive delivery enable karta hai; iske bina, responses buffer hoti hain lekin phir bhi kaam karti hain. Extra infrastructure investment (CDN caching, Edge compute, shared cache) performance improve karte hain aur multi-instance deployments me consistency gaps kam karte hain.
  • Platform support ke do types:
  • Functional fidelity — har Next.js feature platform par sahi kaam karta hai. Adapter test suite hi contract hai: agar kisi platform ka adapter testing pass karta hai, to usme full functional fidelity hai. Binary: ye pass hota hai ya nahi hota. Suite ise fair aur complete rakhne ke liye platform partners ke contributions ke liye open hai.
  • Performance fidelity — features optimal performance characteristics achieve karte hain (jaise PPR ka static shell origin latency ke bajaye CDN latency par; ISR stale content turant serve karta hai jabki background me sub-second propagation ke saath revalidate hota hai). Ek spectrum: har platform architecture ke hisaab se alag levels achieve karta hai, samay ke saath improve hota hai.
  • Functional fidelity achieve karne wala platform ek puri tarah supported deployment target hai; performance fidelity hi hai jisse platforms differentiate hote hain. Poori feature compatibility matrix ke liye Deploying to Platforms dekho.

CDN feature compatibility

  • Kai CDNs ke paas deep Next.js integration ke liye useful primitives hain (edge compute, KV storage, blob storage), lekin end-to-end PPR resume support abhi bhi ubhar raha hai aur bespoke platform work chahiye ho sakta hai. Aksar community adapters aaj Next.js ko ek Node.js server ke roop me deploy karte hain bina in CDN-specific primitives ka faayda uthaye. Current adapter list ke liye Deploying page dekho; poori CDN compatibility table ke liye Deploying to Platforms; caching behavior details ke liye CDN Caching.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Route-level static-vs-dynamic terms me sochna aur ek mostly-static page ko puri tarah dynamic banana (ya dynamic bit ko client par fetch karna) — component-level model shell ko static rehne deta hai jabki ek segment stream in hota hai.
  • PPR/CDN integration ko automatic samajhna — end-to-end PPR resume support abhi bhi ubhar raha hai aur bespoke platform work chahiye ho sakta hai.
  • Functional fidelity (binary, adapter test suite) ko performance fidelity (ek spectrum) ke saath confuse karna.

interview points

  • Core thesis: static/dynamic boundary component level par, route level par nahi; jo Partial Prerendering, Cache Components, aur on-demand revalidation enable karta hai.
  • Teen models (build-time, route-level, component-level) aur unke trade-offs (deploy simplicity vs flexibility vs infrastructure complexity).
  • Chaar infrastructure requirements (streaming, cache coordination, cache consistency, PPR shell delivery) aur har ek jo capability enable karta hai.
  • Functional vs performance fidelity aur adapter test suite contract ke roop me; CDN primitives vs ubharta PPR resume support.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/rendering-philosophy
Hissa 78 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to use Sass

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to use Sass. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to use Sass — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Two syntaxes, Customizing Sass options (sassOptions), Implementation, Sass variables (exported from CSS Modules). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Next.js ne package installed hone ke baad Sass ke liye built-in support prapt kiya hai, donon .scss aur .sass extension ka upyog karte hue. component-star Sass .module.scss / .module.sass extension ke saath CSS module ke madhyam se kaam karta hai.
  • Install:
bash
pnpm add -D sass

(npm: npm install --save-dev sass; yarn/bun barabar).

do vakya rachnaaein

  • Sass do syntax ka support karta hai, pratyek apne khud ke vistar ke saath: .scss SCSS syntax ki requirement hoti hai; .sass ko Indented Syntax ("Sass") ki requirement hoti hai. yadi anishchit hai, to .scss ke saath shuru karein - yeh CSS ka ek suparaset hai aur Indented Syntax sikhne ki requirement nahi hai.

Sass vikalpon ko customize karna (sassOptions)

  • next.config mein sassOptions ke madhyam se Configure Sass vikalp:
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  sassOptions: {
    additionalData: `$var: red;`,
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • additionalData pratyek Sass file mein data (e.g. sajha char) ko prepends karta hai.
  • Implementation: default Next.js dwara Sass karyanvayan chunne ke liye implementation sanpatti ka upyog karta hai sass package ka upyog karta hai; e.g. sassOptions: { implementation: 'sass-embedded' }

Sass char ( module se export kiya gaya)

  • Next.js :export ke madhyam se CSS module files se export kiye gaye Sass veriyebal ka support karta hai:
scss
// app/variables.module.scss
$primary-color: #64ff00;

:export {
  primaryColor: $primary-color;
}
jsx
// app/page.js
import variables from './variables.module.scss'

export default function Page() {
  return <h1 style={{ color: variables.primaryColor }}>Hello, Next.js!</h1>
}
  • export kiye gaye Sass veriyebal imported module objekt par JS-accessible maan ban jata hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • ek .sass file mein SCSS sintaiks ka upyog karna (ya .scss mein indeinted sintaiks) - extension sintaiks ko set karta hai.
  • sass installed karne ke liye bhool jana - bilt-in saport package installed hone ke baad hi active ho jata hai.

interview points

  • Next.js mein Sass setup ( sass, .scss/.sass, CSS module .module.scss), do syntax, sassOptions (additionalData, implementation: 'sass-embedded') aur :export ke saath Sass char sajha karne ke liye paitarna.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/sass

How to load and optimize scripts

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to load and optimize scripts. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to load and optimize scripts — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Layout scripts, Application scripts, Strategy, Offloading scripts to a web worker (experimental), Inline scripts, Executing additional code (event handlers). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • built-in next/script component ke saath third-party ki lipiyon ka optimization karein.

layout script

  • multiple routes ke liye ek third-party script load karne ke liye, next/script import karein aur ise layout component mein shamil karein:
tsx
// app/dashboard/layout.tsx
import Script from 'next/script'

export default function DashboardLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <>
      <section>{children}</section>
      <Script src="https://example.com/script.js" />
    </>
  )
}
  • script tab prapt hoti hai jab folder root (e.g). dashboard/page.js) ya kisi bhi nested route (e.g). dashboard/settings/page.js) ka upyog kiya jata hai. Next.js script load ko sunishchit karta hai only ek bar , yahan tak ki jab ek hi layout mein kai routes ke beech navigate kiya jata hai.

application script

  • sabhi routes ke liye ek script load karne ke liye, ise root layout mein shamil karein:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import Script from 'next/script'

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>{children}</body>
      <Script src="https://example.com/script.js" />
    </html>
  )
}
  • jab koi route pahuncha jata hai to Loads/executes; abhi bhi navigation par keval ek baar.
  • sifarish: keval anavashyak performance prabhav ko kam karne ke liye vishisht pages/layouts mein third-party ki lipiyon ko shamil kiya gaya hai.

Strategy

  • strategy prop ke saath theek tune load ho raha hai:
  • beforeInteractive - kisi bhi Next.js code se pahle aur kisi bhi page hydration se pahle load karein.
  • afterInteractive - ( default) jaldi load ho raha hai lekin page par kuchh hydration ke baad.
  • lazyOnload - browser inactive samay ke dauraan baad mein load ho raha hai.
  • worker — (experimental) ek web worker mein script loda.
  • pratyek ranniti ke upyog ke mamlon ke liye next/script API sandarbh dekhein.

ek web worker (visheshajny) ko ophloding script

  • warning: worker ranniti abhi tak static nahi hai aur not abhi tak App Router ke saath kaam karta hai - savdhani ke saath upyog karein.
  • worker ranniti ke saath script ko band kar diya gaya hai aur Partytown ke saath ek web worker mein executed kiya gaya hai - application ke baki hisson ko main dhage ko samarpit karke performance mein sudhar karta hai. next.config.js mein nextScriptWorkers flag ki requirement hai:
js
// next.config.js
module.exports = {
  experimental: {
    nextScriptWorkers: true,
  },
}
  • required package (e.g) ko installed karne ke madhyam se aapko dev server aur Next.js guide chalaein. npm install @qwik.dev/partytown) ek bar installed hone ke baad, strategy="worker" automatic roop se paarteetaaun ko tatkal kar data hai aur script ko utaar data hai:
tsx
import Script from 'next/script'

export default function Home() {
  return (
    <>
      <Script src="https://example.com/script.js" strategy="worker" />
    </>
  )
}
  • vahan ek web worker mein ek third-party ki script load karne ke liye vyapar band kar rahe hain - paarteetaaun ke vyapar band dok dekhein.

inline script

  • inline scripts (external file se load nahi) supported hain - ghunghraale breses ke bhitar JS likhein, ya dangerouslySetInnerHTML ka upyog karein:
jsx
<Script id="show-banner">
  {`document.getElementById('banner').classList.remove('hidden')`}
</Script>
jsx
<Script
  id="show-banner"
  dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
    __html: `document.getElementById('banner').classList.remove('hidden')`,
  }}
/>
  • warning: ek id sanpatti ko inline scripts ke liye saunpa jana chahiye taaki Next.js unhein track aur optimize kar sakein.

extra code (event handlers) executed karna

  • onLoad - script load hone ke baad code executed karein.
  • onReady - script khatm hone ke baad code executed karein aur har bar component ko mount kiya jata hai.
  • onError - yadi script load karne mein fail ho jati hai to code ko executed karein.
  • ye handler keval tabhi kaam karte hain jab next/script ek Client Component ke andar imported/used hai - kisi bhi import se pahle file ke top par "use client" jorein:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
'use client'

import Script from 'next/script'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <>
      <Script
        src="https://example.com/script.js"
        onLoad={() => {
          console.log('Script has loaded')
        }}
      />
    </>
  )
}

extra visheshataein

  • DOM visheshataon ka upyog script component (e.g) dwara nahi kiya jata hai. nonce, custom data-* gun) ko automatic roop se HTML mein antim customize <script> element ko agreshit kiya jata hai:
tsx
<Script
  src="https://example.com/script.js"
  id="example-script"
  nonce="XUENAJFW"
  data-test="script"
/>

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Server Component mein onLoad/onReady/onError ka upyog karte hue - ve keval Client Components mein kaam karte hain.
  • inline script par id ko bhool jana - Next.js ko unhein track/optimize ki requirement hoti hai.
  • App Router mein worker ranniti ka upyog karna - abhi tak supported nahi hai; experimental, nextScriptWorkers + Partytown ki zaroorat hai.
  • default roop se root layout mein third-party script load ho raha hai - performance ke liye vishisht pages/layouts ko pasand karte hain.

interview points

  • next/script plesmeint (laayaaut banam root layout) aur load-ons guarantee.
  • chaar rannitiyon (beforeInteractive, afterInteractive default, lazyOnload, worker experimental) aur jab pratyek phit baithta hai.
  • paarteetaaun web-varkar ophloding (phlaig, install prompt, App Router boundary, vyapar-band).
  • inline scripts (id requirement), iveint haindalars aur unki Client Component requirement, aur visheshata agreshan (nonce, data-*).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/scripts

How to self-host your Next.js application

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to self-host your Next.js application. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to self-host your Next.js application — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Reverse proxy, Image Optimization, Proxy, Environment variables, Caching and ISR, Automatic caching / Cache-Control headers. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Jab deploy karte ho, to configure karo ki features tumhare infrastructure ke liye kaise handle hon. Self-hosting options: ek Node.js server (next start), ek Docker image, ya static HTML files (static export).

rivars proxy

  • Recommended: apne Next.js server ke saamne ek reverse proxy (jaise nginx) use karo use seedhe internet par expose karne ke bajaye. Ye malformed requests, slow-connection attacks, payload size limits, rate limiting, aur dusri security concerns handle karta hai, unhe Next.js server se offload karke taaki ye resources rendering ke liye dedicate kar sake.

image optimization

  • next/image Image Optimization next start ke saath deploy hone par zero config ke saath self-hosted kaam karta hai. Ek alag optimization service use karne ke liye, ek image loader configure karo. Ek static export ke saath, next.config.js me ek custom image loader define karo. Images runtime par optimize hoti hain, build ke dauraan nahi.
  • Ye jaanna achha hai: glibc-based Linux systems par, Image Optimization ko excessive memory usage (sharp memory allocator) rokne ke liye extra configuration chahiye ho sakta hai; tum TTL (minimumCacheTTL) configure kar sakte ho; tum Image Optimization (unoptimized) disable kar sakte ho aur phir bhi dusre next/image benefits rakh sakte ho.

Proxy

  • Proxy next start ke saath deploy hone par zero config ke saath self-hosted kaam karta hai. Kyunki ise incoming request tak access chahiye, isliye ye ek static export ke saath supported NAHI hai. Agar tumhe saare Node.js APIs chahiye, to ise ek layout me Server Component ke roop me le jao (jaise headers check karke redirect karna); next.config.js ke through headers/cookies/query se redirect/rewrite karo; warna ek custom server use karo (Pages Router).

environment variables

  • Build-time aur runtime env vars supported hain. Default roop se, env vars sirf server par available hain; browser me ek ko expose karne ke liye, NEXT_PUBLIC_ se prefix karo — lekin public vars next build ke dauraan JS bundle me inline ho jate hain.
  • Dynamic rendering ke dauraan server par env vars safely padho — jaise await connection() (ya cookies/headers/dusre request-time APIs) dynamic rendering me opt in karta hai taaki variable runtime par evaluate ho:
tsx
import { connection } from 'next/server'

export default async function Component() {
  await connection()
  const value = process.env.MY_VALUE
  // ...
}
  • Ye ek single Docker image ko alag values ke saath kai environments me promote karne deta hai. Tum register function (instrumentation) use karke server startup par code chala sakte ho.

caching aur ISR

  • Next.js responses, generated static pages, build outputs, aur static assets (images, fonts, scripts) cache karta hai. Caching aur pages revalidate karna (ISR) ek hi Next.js server cache use karte hain, jo default roop se har server instance ke local filesystem (disk par) par store hota hai. Persistent local disk wale ek single self-hosted next start instance ke liye automatically kaam karta hai. Kai instances, ephemeral compute, ya saamne ek CDN/reverse proxy ke saath, Configuring Caching, Multi-Instance Cache Coordination, aur Usage with CDNs bhi review karo.
  • Automatic caching / Cache-Control headers:
  • Truly immutable assets: Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable — override nahi ho sakta. Files ke naam me ek SHA-hash hota hai, isliye indefinitely cache karna safe hai (jaise static image imports). Images ke liye TTL configurable hai.
  • ISR: Cache-Control: s-maxage: <revalidate>, stale-while-revalidate. Revalidation time seconds me getStaticProps (Pages Router) me define hota hai; revalidate: false ek saal ke cache ke liye default hai. CDN layer par faayda uthane ke liye, CDN/reverse proxy ko in directives aur cache key variability (CDN caching) ka samman karna chahiye; warna responses client-side navigation ke dauraan CDN caching bypass kar sakti hain ya stale/mismatched variants serve kar sakti hain.
  • Dynamically rendered pages: Cache-Control: private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate user-specific data ko cached hone se rokne ke liye (App Router aur Pages Router), Draft Mode samet.

static asset

  • Static assets ko ek alag domain ya CDN par host karne ke liye, next.config.js me assetPrefix config use karo — Next.js ise JS/CSS files fetch karte samay use karta hai. Downside: extra DNS/TLS resolution time.

caching (custom cache handler) ko configure karna

  • Default roop se, generated cache assets memory (default 50 MB) aur disk par store hote hain. Ephemeral compute (common serverless setups) par, local disk non-persistent/unavailable hai, isliye cache effectively short-term aur per-instance hai. Kubernetes par, har pod ki apni copy hai — ek cache handler configure karo aur stale data rokne ke liye in-memory caching disable karo:
js
// next.config.js
module.exports = {
  cacheHandler: require.resolve('./cache-handler.js'),
  cacheMaxMemorySize: 0, // disable default in-memory caching
}
  • Handler ek class export karta hai jo get, set, revalidateTag, resetRequestCache implement karti hai. Signatures ke liye cacheHandler API reference dekho aur ek working implementation ke liye Redis cacheHandler example.
  • Ek production handler ko chahiye: (1) entries wahan store kare jahan har instance un tak pahunch sake (Redis, S3 — ek in-process Map nahi); (2) store ke size ko bound kare (TTL ya size-based eviction); (3) entries ko serialize kare — entries me Buffer (jaise rscData) aur Map (jaise segmentData) values ho sakti hain jinhe JSON.stringify/JSON.parse akele restore nahi kar sakte; client-side navigation/prefetch (RSC) requests par segmentData.get is not a function ya failed to pipe response jaisi confusing errors ka kaaran banta hai; (4) entries ko tag se index kare — APP_PAGE, APP_ROUTE, PAGES entries x-next-cache-tags response header (data.headers) me tags le jaati hain; ctx.tags fetch entries ke liye tags deta hai; revalidateTag ko har instance par invalid entries par rakho; (5) storage errors handle kare (timeouts, dropped connections).
  • Ye jaanna achha hai: revalidatePath cache tags par ek convenience layer hai (page ke liye ek specific default tag ke saath revalidateTag call karta hai). 'use cache' directive backend ke liye, cacheHandlers use karo. Production-oriented community Redis handlers Redis example README me listed hain.

cache / build ID

  • Next.js next build ke dauraan ek ID generate karta hai taaki ye identify ho sake ki kaun sa version serve ho raha hai; usi build ko kai containers ko boot karna chahiye. Agar tum per-environment variables ke liye rebuild karte ho, to next.config.js me generateBuildId ke saath consistent build IDs generate karo:
js
module.exports = {
  generateBuildId: async () => {
    return process.env.GIT_HASH
  },
}
  • Jab deploymentId set hota hai, to Next.js ek static build ID use karta hai jab tak generateBuildId explicitly configure na ho. Iske bajaye version skew deployment ID se detect hota hai.

bahu server deployment

  • Server Functions encryption key: Next.js client ko bhejne se pehle Server Function closure variables encrypt karta hai; default roop se har build ke liye ek unique key generate hoti hai. Multiple instances ke saath, sabhi ko ek hi key use karni chahiye, warna ek instance dwara encrypted Server Function dusre dwara decrypt nahi ho sakta ("Server Action ... ko find karne me failed" errors). NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY set karo — ek valid AES length (16, 24, ya 32 bytes; default 32) ke saath ek base64-encoded value. Key build me embedded hoti hai aur runtime par automatically use hoti hai.
bash
NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY=your-generated-key next build
  • Deployment identifier: rolling deployments ke dauraan version skew protection ke liye deploymentId ko ek consistent version se assets hamesha fetch karne ke liye configure karo.
  • Shared cache: default roop se in-memory cache instances ke across shared nahi hota; external storage me ek custom cache handler stale data ke saath 'use cache: remote' use karo.

sanskaran skew

  • Kaaran: missing assets (purani JS/CSS request karna jo ab exist nahi), Server Function mismatches (previous build ke action IDs jo server ab recognize nahi karta), navigation failures (naye server ke saath incompatible purane deployment se prefetched data).
  • Next.js deploymentId use karke detect/handle karta hai: static assets me ?dpl=<deploymentId> shamil hai; client-side navigation requests me x-deployment-id header shamil hai; server IDs compare karta hai. Mismatch par, Next.js client-side navigation ke bajaye ek hard navigation (full page reload) trigger karta hai, isliye client ek consistent version se assets fetch karta hai:
js
module.exports = {
  deploymentId: process.env.DEPLOYMENT_VERSION,
}
  • Reload caveat: application state kho sakti hai (URL state/local storage persist rehta hai, useState nahi).
  • Immutable assets: supportsImmutableAssets ke saath, assets deployments ke across shared ho sakte hain — unhe static file folder/CDN bucket me accumulate karo aur deployment ID track kiye bina koi version skew nahi (reverse proxy me koi green-blue deployment nahi chahiye).

streaming aur Suspense

  • App Router self-hosting ke samay streaming responses support karta hai. nginx ya ek similar proxy ke saath, use buffering disable karne ke liye configure karo — jaise /:path* ke liye headers() config ke through X-Accel-Buffering: no set karo.
  • End-to-end streaming support ensure karo: load balancers ko chunked transfer encoding ya HTTP/2 streaming support karna chahiye (kuch, jaise AWS ALB with Lambda, default roop se buffer karte hain); reverse proxy ko bina buffering ke chunked responses pass karne chahiye. PPR ko streaming chahiye — iske bina shell aur dynamic content full render ke baad deliver hote hain, jo PPR ka TTFB benefit kho deta hai.

multi-insteins cache samanvay

  • Default roop se, ek instance par revalidateTag() sirf us instance ke cache ko invalidate karta hai; dusre stale content serve karte rehte hain. Ek custom cache handler me refreshTags() method implement karo — har request se pehle call hota hai, ye shared storage (jaise Redis) se tag state sync karta hai taaki saare instances invalidation ke baare me turant seekhein. Tag architecture ke liye How Revalidation Works dekho.

cache component

  • Cache Components default roop se Next.js ke saath kaam karta hai aur ek CDN-only feature nahi hai — ek Node.js server (next start) aur Docker container samet.

upyog CDN

  • Saamne ek CDN ke saath, ek page me Cache-Control: private shamil hota hai jab dynamic API access ho (uncacheable HTML); ek puri tarah prerendered static page me Cache-Control: public shamil hai (CDN par cacheable). Agar tumhe static aur dynamic components ke mix ki zaroorat nahi, to poore route ko static banao aur HTML ko CDN (Automatic Static Optimization) par cache karo. Details ke liye CDN Caching dekho; PPR support ke liye PPR Platform Guide aur Deployment Adapter API. next build

after

  • next start ke saath self-hosting karte samay after puri tarah supported hai. Shutdown par, SIGINT/SIGTERM bhejo aur wait karo — server in-flight requests finish karta hai aur exit karne se pehle pending after() callbacks execute karta hai. Ek configurable drain period allow karo (10-30 seconds recommended).

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Bina reverse proxy ke Next.js ko seedhe internet par expose karna.
  • Default disk cache ko pods/instances ke across shared samajhna — har instance ki apni copy hoti hai; shared cache handler ke bina stale data.
  • Custom cache handler entries ko in-process (Map) me store karta hai ya Buffer/Map values serialize karne me fail hota hai — segmentData.get is not a function / failed to pipe response errors ka kaaran.
  • Alag NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY per instance → "Failed to find Server Action".
  • Proxy (nginx) buffering streaming/PPR ko maar deta hai; X-Accel-Buffering: no bhool jana.
  • Proxy static export me supported nahi hai; NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars build time par inline hote hain (runtime par nahi).
  • Ek static generateBuildId / deploymentId ke bina per-environment rebuild karna.

interview points

  • Self-hosting topology (reverse proxy, next start, Docker, static export) aur static export me kya toot-ta hai (Proxy, runtime env).
  • Default cache (per-instance 50 MB in-memory) vs custom cacheHandler requirements (shared store, bounded size, serialization, tag index, error handling) aur cacheMaxMemorySize: 0.
  • Version skew: kaaran, deploymentId detection (?dpl=, x-deployment-id, hard navigation), immutable assets.
  • Server Functions encryption key (NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY, AES 16/24/32 bytes) aur multi-instance cache coordination (refreshTags).
  • Cache-Control header profiles (immutable, ISR s-maxage + SWR, dynamic private, no-cache…).
  • Streaming requirements aur after graceful shutdown (SIGINT/SIGTERM, 10-30s drain).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/self-hosting
Hissa 81 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Server Actions and Mutations

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Server Actions and Mutations. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Server Actions and Mutations — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Sequential dispatch on the client, A single response carries data and UI, Security, CSRF check, Body size limit, Encrypted action IDs and dead code elimination. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • ek Server Action ek React Server Function hai, jise React ke action tantr ke madhyam se bulaya gaya hai: <form action>, <button formAction>, ya client-side sankramana. 'use server' nirdeshan ke saath ek banaein, ise ek roop se bulayein, ya startTransition mein lipte ek iveint handler ya useEffect se bulayein. mool baatein: Mutating Data aur form guide. yeh page Next.js-vishisht bhagon ko cover karta hai: karyon ke nakshe mutation, single roundtrip pratikriya modal, sequential preshan, security aur vinyas.

client par sequential preshan

  • Next.js ne prati client mein ek samay mein Server Actions one ko bheja hai: yadi koi user tvarit inheritance mein teenon ko trigger karta hai, to dusra pahla wait karta hai, phir dusra wait karta hai. yeh phir se render server per ko action ke parinam ke anurup rakhta hai jo ise generated karta hai.
  • parinam: kya not client se Server Actions ko parallel karne ke liye Promise.all par bharosa karte hain. parallel kaam ke liye, ise ek single Server Action ke andar karte hain, ek Server Component se parallel mein prapt karte hain, ya gair-mutation requests ke liye Route Handler ka upyog karte hain.
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: yeh client dispaichar ki sanpatti hai, common roop se Server Functions nahi - server Server Actions nahi hai; pratyek apne khud ke request par chalta hai kyonki yeh aata hai aur kuchh bhi kar sakta hai async function kar sakta hai.

ek single pratikriya mein data aur UI hota hai

  • jab ek Server Action tatkal amanyata ko trigger karta hai, to Next.js one HTTP request ke andar kaam karta hai: yeh action ko chalata hai, phir vartaman route server-side ko phir se render karta hai. uttar mein ek hi flight stream mein donon tukre shamil hain: action ka return value (useActionState ya wait kiye gaye vade se juraa hua) aur vartaman route ke liye ek naye render kiye gaye RSC payload, jo ek beej navigation ke roop mein commit hai. update UI dekhne ke liye koi anuvartee prapt karne ki requirement nahi hai.
  • jab action inmein se koi bhi karti hai to ek bar phir se render kiya jata hai:
  • turant cache data ko invalid karne ke liye updateTag ya revalidatePath ko call karta hai.
  • vartaman route ke RSC payload ko parishkrit karne ke liye refresh ko call karta hai.
  • cookies() — setting/deleting ke madhyam se cookies ko automatic roop se vartaman page ko phir se render karta hai taaki UI naye value ko darshata hai.
  • call redirect - pratikriya router ko navigate karti hai aur destination ke RSC payload ko stream karti hai.
ts
// app/posts/actions.ts
'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { auth } from '@/lib/auth'
import { db } from '@/lib/db'

export async function createPost(formData: FormData) {
  const session = await auth()
  if (!session?.user) throw new Error('Unauthorized')

  await db.post.create({
    data: {
      title: String(formData.get('title')),
      authorId: session.user.id,
    },
  })

  revalidatePath('/posts')
}
  • mutation, cache availideshan, aur page phir se render sabhi ek roundtrip mein pura ho gaya. kyonki redirect ek niyantran flow exception throw karta hai, iske baad code nahi chala jata hai - jagah revalidation call before redirect agar destination fresh data ki zaroorat hai.
  • ek stale-time-revalidate profile ke saath revalidateTag exception hai: yeh background taza karne ke liye tag ko chihnit karta hai aur not mein action pratikriya mein phir se render kiya gaya hai - page baad mein parhne par parivartan ko darshata hai. uprokt mein se koi bhi aisa karya keval iske return value ko karta hai aur route phir se render nahi kiya jata hai.

Security

  • A Server Action us page ke khilaf ek POST request ke roop mein chalta hai jo ise bulata hai. build samay mein, 'use server' ek sandarbh ke liye client bundles mein karya ke karyanvayan ko svaip karne ke liye compiler ko batata hai (ek action ID + preshak) jo server par wapas POSTs karta hai. karyanvayan server par rahta hai, lekin route un logon ke liye pahunch yogy hai jo saman POST bhej sakte hain - treat pratyek action ko untrusted access point ke roop mein.
  • phremavark-leval protekshan:
  • CSRF check — Host (ya X-Forwarded-Host) ki tulna mein Origin ka request; mismatches kharij kar diya. proxy/CDN domain ke liye serverActions.allowedOrigins ko configure karein.
  • Body size boundary - action request default roop se 1 MB par capture kar liya; bare payload ke liye serverActions.bodySizeLimit ko configure karein.
  • Encrypted action IDs aur mrit code elimination - action sandarbh build samay par encrypt kiye jate hain; upyog kiye gaye Server Functions ko client bundles se chheen liya jata hai taaki unke paas koi public endpoint na ho.
  • Closure veriyebal encryption — veriyebals ek inline action dwara capture kar liya client ko bheje jaane se pahle encrypt kiya jata hai. multi-instance/self-hosted deployment ke liye, NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY ko ek static key ke liye set kiya gaya jo pure udaharanon mein sajha kiya gaya tha.
  • phremavark security not application star ki check ke liye ek vikalp hai. pratyek action ke andar:
  • Authenticate and authorize — render-time gating (keval ek authenticated page par ek form render karna) ek security boundary nahi hai; request UI ke bina bheja jaa sakta hai.
  • Validate Inputs — FormData, query param, header ko untrusted maante hain.
  • Constrain return maan - action return client ko serialize kiya jata hai; unhein size dein ki UI kya pradan karta hai, nahi kachche DB rikorda.
  • Destructive Operations (delet) mazboot handling ki guarantee de sakta hai: uchch session ki check, phir prayas, jor se asaphalta jab check yaad aati hai. experimental authInterrupts flag ke saath, unauthorized() / forbidden() ko next/navigation se automatic roop se unauthorized.tsx / forbidden.tsx ko render karne ke liye phenk dein.
  • surakshit banam asurakshit pattern - client ko keval ek sandarbh (aam taur par ek ID) plus parivartan ki supply karni chahiye; session ka upyog karke baki ko vishvasniy source se phir se parhein. schema validation (zod aadi) keval size ki check karta hai - ek achhi tarah se built-in Item objekt abhi bhi ek pankti ko sandarbhit kar sakta hai jise kolar khud nahi karta hai:
ts
// app/items/actions.ts
'use server'

import { auth } from '@/lib/auth'
import { db } from '@/lib/db'

// Unsafe: no auth, no ownership check. The whole item, including its id, comes
// from the client, so anyone who can POST here can mark any item complete.
export async function completeItemUnsafe(item: Item) {
  await db.item.update({ where: { id: item.id }, data: { completed: true } })
}

// Safe: take only the change, derive identity from the session, look up by ownership.
export async function completeItem(itemId: string) {
  const session = await auth()
  if (!session?.user) return

  const item = await db.item.findFirst({
    where: { id: itemId, ownerId: session.user.id },
  })
  if (!item) return

  await db.item.update({ where: { id: item.id }, data: { completed: true } })
}

cache update ka chayan karna

  • data ko mute karne ke baad, on-demand revalidation server cache, client router ya donon ko update karta hai. kya badalane ki zaroorat ke aadhar par chunein:
  • updateTag — ek tag ki tatkal samapti. agle parhne (route sahit action ki pratikriya ke saath re-render shiping) fresh data ke liye wait karta hai. jab action ki requirement hoti hai to upyog karein read-your-own-writes. keval Server Actions.
  • revalidateTag - ek cache-life profile ke saath ek tag ka stale-time-revalidate taza. baad mein padha jata hai, jabki fresh data background mein aata hai, isliye action ka apna phir prastutakarta not naye data ke liye wait karta hai.
  • revalidatePath - URL path dwara invalid. jab ek route affected hota hai aur taiging ovarakiling hota hai to iska upyog karein.
  • refresh — vartaman route ke RSC payload ko cached data ko invalid kiye bina reefrech karein. jab drishtikon cache ke bahar state par nirbhar karta hai to iska upyog karein ki action abhi badal gai hai.
  • jab updateTag, revalidatePath, ya refresh run, Next.js vartaman route server-side ko phir se render karta hai aur ismein action ki pratikriya mein ek naya RSC payload shamil hota hai. ek SWR profile ke saath revalidateTag janboojhkar us tatkal phir se render chhor data hai. redirect ke viprit, inmein se koi bhi phenk nahi sakta, isliye action unhein bula sakti hai aur abhi bhi ek value wapas kar sakti hai.

Configuration

js
// next.config.js
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
module.exports = {
  experimental: {
    serverActions: {
      allowedOrigins: ['my-proxy.com', '*.my-proxy.com'],
      bodySizeLimit: '2mb',
    },
  },
}
  • band encryption key ke liye, deployment environment mein NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY set karein (khud hosting dekhein).

deployment ke vichar

  • Each Server Action ko build artifacts mein ek action ID dwara pehchana jata hai. nai deployment aam taur par nai ID generated karti hai (Next.js unhein source aprivartit hone par bhi har 14 dinon mein ghoomtee hai), isliye previous build par abhi bhi ek client ek action ID ko bula sakta hai jo ab maujud nahi hai - error: "Server Action khojne mein fail".
  • vighatan ko kam karein: jab user madhy-mutation ho sakta hai to achanak katovar par roling deployment ko pasand karte hain; udaharanon mein NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY ko static rakhein taaki action sandarbh dikriptebal rahe; ek kathin viphalta ke bajaay UI mein ek retry path ke roop mein error ko satah dein, isliye ek taza user ko theek kar data hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • client se multiple Server Actions par Promise.all - ve kramik roop se, parallel mein nahi bhejte hain.
  • render-time giting (form ko chhupaanaa) ki computation security hai - koi bhi seedhe POST kar sakta hai.
  • pure client-supplied objekt (ID + content + ownership) par bharosa karne ke bajaay ek ID + session-development ownership lukaapa.
  • calling revalidatePath baad redirect - redirect ke baad code kabhi nahi chalta hai.
  • usi pratikriya mein phir se render karne ke liye revalidateTag (SWR) ki ummid - yeh nahi hai; baad mein parhne par parivartan dikhata hai.
  • onLoad-style behavior ki ummid - Server Actions return maan aur RSC payload, iveint callback nahi.
  • achanak katovar in-flight mutation ko torte hain (" ko khojne mein fail") - roling deployment aur ek retry path ko pasand karte hain. Server Action

interview points

  • singal-roundtrip modal: action return value + ek flight stream mein phir se render RSC payload; jo call karta hai phir se prastutakarta (updateTag, revalidatePath, refresh, cookie mutation, redirect) banam revalidateTag SWR apvaada.
  • sequential client preshan aur kyon Promise.all actions ko parallel nahi karta hai; jahan samaantar karya (ek action ke andar, Server Component, Route Handler) hota hai.
  • security modal: POST kisi bhi vyakti dwara pahunch yogy endpoint, CSRF utpatti ki check, 1 MB body ki boundary, enkripted action ID, mrit code unmulan, band encryption, aur application star ke kartavyon (authn/authz, validation, pratibndhit return, ownership wale lookup - zod check size, ownership nahi).
  • updateTag banam revalidateTag banam revalidatePath banam refresh — jab pratyek sahi cache update hota hai.
  • deployment: action ID roteshan (≤14 din), roling deployment, static encryption key, " ko khojne mein fail" ke liye UI retry. Server Action

Hissa 82 / 471 · App Router · Guides

The Server and Client Boundary

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai The Server and Client Boundary. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: The Server and Client Boundary — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Rendering environments, Server Components and SEO, How data enters the tree, State and interactivity, Crossing the boundary, Code. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • React Server Components (RSC) ne server aur client module graphs ke beech ek component tree ko vibhajit kiya. yeh boundary set karti hai ki component code kis tarah chalta hai aur kya yeh code browser ko bhejta hai. RSC vishesh roop se server par Server Components rakhta hai aur interactive UI ke liye Client Components ko barkarar rakhta hai. donon ek per mein rachna karte hain, jo server RSC payload mein render karta hai - iske andar Client Components ke sandarbhon ko le jaane wale UI ka ek dharavahik vivarana.
  • RSC se pahle, React components ka palan kiya gaya ki RSC ab Client Component modal ko kya kahte hain: React unhein server par HTML ko render kar sakta hai, lekin usi code ne browser ko hydrate ko bhi bhej diya ki HTML. hydration ne server aur browser par initial HTML interactive aur required match output banaya. client par puri tarah se render apps khali shell ke saath shuru ho sakte hain aur browser mein per ko mount kar sakte hain.
  • pratyek component ka module server module graph, client module graph ya donon ke antargat aata hai. Next.js pratyek environment ke liye alag se donon graaphon dwara upyog kiye jaane wale module ko compiled karta hai. rendering ke dauraan, server graph Client Components ke sandarbh paida karta hai aur unke paas passed props ko kramabaddh karta hai. client graph not server graph import karta hai - yeh RSC payload ke madhyam se sandarbh aur dharavahik prop prapt karta hai.

rendering environment

  • component naam ek saf vibhajan ka sujhav dete hain, lekin rendering donon sthanon mein hota hai. server par, Server Component tree RSC payload ka production karta hai; Next.js build time mein HTML ko render karne ya request ko sambhalne ke dauraan payload aur Client Components ka upyog karta hai.
server parbrowser mein
Server ComponentYesNo
Client ComponentYesYes
  • "Client" point karta hai ki ek Client Component bhi browser mein apne server render ke saath chalta hai. ek seedhi visit par, ek Client Component server par aur phir se hydration ke dauraan browser mein render karta hai - iska console.log tarminal aur browser console mein dikhai data hai. client-side navigation par, server server server-render kiye gaye HTML ke bina browser mein RSC payload aur component render karta hai:
tsx
// app/hello.tsx
'use client'

export default function Hello() {
  console.log('Hello rendered') // on a direct visit: server, then browser
  return <p>Hello</p>
}
  • server par ek Client Component ko render karne se HTML generated hota hai, lekin yeh ek Client Component bani hui hai. Client Components ko RSC se pahle HTML ko saunpa gaya tha; route ke aadhar par, build samay (SSG) par Next.js generates/regenerates HTML, build ke baad (ISR), ya request ke anusar (SSR).
  • RSC ek alag prakriya hai: yeh server par Server Component code rakhta hai aur us code ko shiping ke bajaay RSC payload utsarjit karta hai. "Server-rendered" ka varnan hai ki kaise Next.js ne HTML ka production kiya; "Server Component" ka varnan hai ki code kahan chalta hai aur kya yeh browser ko bhejta hai.

Server Components aur SEO

  • ek krolar jo keval HTML padhta hai, pahli pratikriya ko dekhta hai aur koi JavaScript chalata hai. Both Server aur Client Components us pratikriya ke liye HTML yogdan karte hain. SEO is baat par nirbhar karta hai ki server render content tak pahunchta hai - user sanpark ke pichhe ki gai content ya ek event HTML mein dikhai nahi deti hai jo ek krolar par upalabdh hai jo JS ko nahi chalati hai.

kaise data per mein access karta hai

  • RSC se pahle, apps ne getStaticProps/getServerSideProps ke saath server data ikattha kiya, phir ise props ke roop mein per par pahuncha diya - data lane ka karan before ka per render (data → Loader/API → Props → component tree) hua.
  • ek Server Component keval server par chalta hai, isliye yeh ek database, filesystem, internal serve, ya seedhe gupt access kar sakta hai - yeh in sansadhanon ko padhta hai during apne khud ke render, bina kisi API route ke data ko client ko pahle expose karta hai:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
import { PostList } from '@/app/ui/post-list'
import { getPosts } from '@/lib/data'

export default async function Page() {
  const posts = await getPosts() // runs on the server, during render
  return <PostList posts={posts} />
}
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: kyonki ek Server Component seedhe secrets/server-only data ko parh sakta hai, kyonki aap Client Components ko kya paas karte hain, is bare mein vichar kiya jaa sakta hai - props ko serialize kiya jata hai aur browser ko bheja jata hai ( dekhein). Data Security
  • Server Components ko UI lautne se pahle sabhi data ka wait nahi karna padta hai. server se jure data ko ek Client Component mein stream karne ke liye, ek Server Component mein request shuru karein aur ek prop ke roop mein pending Promise ko paas karein. Client Component ne React ke use ke saath ek sansadhan ke roop mein Promise padha. jabki pending, nikatatam Suspense boundary apne patan ko darshata hai; Client Component ne Promise kiye jaane par render kiya. chunki request client run se pahle shuru hota hai, isliye Client Component ko mount ke baad usi data ko prapt karne ki requirement nahi hoti hai. jab data client-keval state ya user intrekshan par nirbhar karta hai to aapko abhi bhi browser ki requirement ho sakti hai.
  • Identical fetch requests ko server render ke dauraan yaad kiya jata hai. With Cache Components, aap ek data function ya component ko cache kar sakte hain aur us page ke baki hisson se svatantr roop se access kar sakte hain.

state aur interactivity

  • ek Server Component ka code kabhi browser tak nahi pahunchta; yeh phir se render karta hai jab Next.js route (navikaran, taza karne, phir praapti ke baad) render karta hai. ek Client Component code browser tak pahunchta hai; React ise initial load par hydrate karta hai aur client-side update ise browser mein phir se render kar sakta hai.
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: initial load par, RSC payload ship HTML ke sath. Server Component DOM nods ko seedhe DOM ko React ke per ke saath async se bahar nikaal sakte hain. Server Component output ko update karne ke liye, server par phir se component ko render karein - jab browser ko ek naya RSC payload prapt hota hai, to React per ko phir se radd kar data hai aur DOM ko update karta hai.
  • useState, useEffect, aur iveint handler ko browser mein code chalane ki requirement hoti hai jo adyatanon ka jawab data hai - Server Component code kabhi browser tak nahi pahunchta hai, isliye yeh in client-side APIs ka upyog nahi kar sakta hai.
  • built-in browser/HTML behavior interactivity Non ek Client Component pradan kar sakta hai: ek <details> element opens/closes; ek <form> apne action prop mein passed Server Function ke madhyam se render karta hai; <video controls> plays/pauses. ek Client Component ka upyog karein jab behavior samay ke saath browser state ko badalane ki requirement hoti hai (controlled input, live philtar, draig haindal). jab browser sabhi required behavior pradan karta hai to ek button ya form ko Client Component ki requirement nahi hoti hai.

boundary par karna

  • kisi bhi import se pahle, file ke top par 'use client' ke saath client entry point ke roop mein ek module chihnit karein. nirdeshan module graph mein ek boundary ko attract karta hai, aur do niyam yeh set karte hain ki yeh kya par karta hai:
  • Code import ke madhyam se kros karta hai - jo bhi ek Client Component import client bundle mein kheencha jata hai.
  • Data props ke madhyam se par karta hai, aur yeh serialization hona chahiye - iveint handler jaise karya kros nahi kar sakte.
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: ek Server Component se ek Client Component throw karne ke liye ek prop ke roop mein ek function ko paas karna - ek onClick handler ko par nahi kar sakta hai. A Server Function ne ek sandarbh ke roop mein 'use server' kros ko chihnit kiya. A Server Function apne prakar se ek plain function se alag nahi hai; TypeScript plugin ek Client Component prop ko ek function ke roop mein type karne ki permission data hai jab iska naam action hai ya Action mein samapt hota hai, aur any function prop ko dhvajaankit karta hai.
  • ek reindred React element boundary ko par kar sakta hai kyonki yeh dharavahik data hai. children ke roop mein render kiye gaye output ko passed karne se client graph mein Server Component ke code ko import kiye bina Client Component ke andar ek Server Component nested mil jata hai:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
import { Cart } from '@/app/ui/cart'
import { Modal } from '@/app/ui/modal'

// Page and Cart are Server Components. Modal is a Client Component
export default function Page() {
  return (
    <Modal title={<div>Your cart</div>}>
      <Cart />
    </Modal>
  )
}
tsx
// app/ui/modal.tsx
'use client'

import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'

export function Modal({ title, children }: { title: ReactNode; children: ReactNode }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(true)
  if (!open) return null

  return (
    <div role="dialog">
      <header>
        {title}
        <button onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Close</button>
      </header>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}
  • yahan Cart server par chalta hai aur Modal keval apne output ko kabhi nahi dekhta hai.
  • Owner banam parent: owner woh component hai jiska source ek children ke liye JSX hota hai (Page donon Modal aur Cart ka malik hai); parent seedhe render kiye gaye per mein children ko shamil karta hai (Modal Cart ka parent hai). kyonki Cart ka malik ek Server Component hai, Cart server par render karta hai. Modal keval parent hai, isliye ise Cart ka production sthan par prapt hota hai lekin ise chalane ke liye iska code nahi milta hai. yeh algav ek Client Component ko Server Component pradarshit karne data hai jise kabhi import nahi kiya jata hai.
  • boundary bhar mein Compound component: yaugik component static gunon (Menu.Item, Tabs.Panel) ke roop mein up-kanponeints ko expose karte hain. yeh ek graph ke bhitar kaam karta hai jab sabhi tukre Server Components ya sabhi Client Components hain. pattern tab toot jata hai jab ek static sadasy boundary ko par karta hai: ek Server Component import ek Client Component ko karya ke bajaay ek client sandarbh prapt hota hai, isliye Menu.Item undefined hai aur React throw karta hai "Element type invalid hai." kisi any Client Component se ek yaugik Client Component ka upyog karein; ek Server Component se apne tukron ka upyog karne ke liye, unhein static gunon ke bajaay named export ke roop mein expose karein.
  • aapko keval ek client subtree mein access par 'use client' ki requirement hai, iske andar har file par nahi - us entry se imported pratyek module client module graph ka hissa ban jata hai. ek sajha component ko aprivartit chhorne ke liye, ek Client Component wrapper banate hain jo ise import karte hain aur wrapper par directive dete hain - wrapper sajha module ko aprivartit rakhta hai aur aapke application code ke karib boundary ko rakhta hai, jisse useState/useEffect ka upyog karke pratyek sajha component ko directive jorne se bachna chahiye. yadi client code bina kisi boundary ke server graph mein access karta hai, to compiler us point ko point karta hai jahan aapko directive ki requirement hoti hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • "Client Component" ka matalab yeh hai ki yeh keval browser mein render karta hai - yeh server (aur hydrate) par bhi render karta hai; "Server Component" banam "server-render" alag-alag concepts hain.
  • ek Server Component se ek Client Component tak ek iveint handler/function prop paas karna - yeh Server Functions ko action/*Action props ke roop mein chhorakar) throw karta hai.
  • ek Server Component ko seedhe Client Component mein import karna - iska code client bundle mein kheencha jata hai; ise iske bajaay children ke roop mein paas karein.
  • static sadasyon ke saath mishrit component (Menu.Item) boundary ke par - undefined + "Element type invalid"; export naam ka upyog karein.
  • passing rahasy ya full DB rikords ke roop mein props ke roop mein Client Components — props ko browser mein kramabaddh kiya jata hai.
  • seedhe Server Component DOM nods ko mutate — DOM ko React ke saath async se bahar rakhta hai; iske bajaay server par phir se render kiya jata hai.
  • ek subtree mein pratyek file mein 'use client' jodna - keval entry ki zaroorat hai.
  • krolar-vizibal HTML (SEO) mein dikhai nahi dene wali intrekshan ke pichhe content ko get kiya gaya.

interview points

  • module-graph boundary: server graph banam client graph, RSC payload, kya import (code) banam props (serialization data) ke madhyam se par karta hai.
  • rendering talika (server: keval server; client: server + browser) aur direct visits par Client Components ke hydration/double-render.
  • data entry: Server Components rendering ke dauraan (koi getStaticProps pree-step nahi); server render ke dauraan ek pending Promise + use + Suspense; fetch sansmaran streaming.
  • children pattern aur malik-vs-parent bhed; mishrit component boundary par torte hain.
  • jab ek Client Component ki vastav mein zaroorat hai banam built-in HTML/browser behavior (<details>, <form action>, <video controls>).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/server-and-client-boundary

How to build single-page applications with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to build single-page applications with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to build single-page applications with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why use Next.js for SPAs, Pattern 1: Using React's `use` within a Context Provider, Pattern 2: Rendering components only in the browser, Pattern 3: Shallow routing on the client, Pattern 4: Mutating data with Server Actions, Static export (optional). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Next.js puri tarah se client-side navigation aur data lane ke saath singal-Page Applications (SPA) ke build ka support karta hai. yeh ek hi app mein client aur server pattern ka support karta hai, aur maujuda SPA puri tarah se likhne ke bina migrate kar sakte hain.
  • ek "strict SPA" ko define kiya gaya hai: client-side rendering (CSR) - app ko ek HTML file (e.g) dwara served jata hai. index.html; har route, page transition aur data lane ko browser mein JS dwara controlled kiya jata hai; no full-page reloads — client side JS vartaman page ke DOM mein herpher karta hai aur zaroorat ke hisaab se data prapt karta hai.
  • Strict SPAs aksar page interactive hone se pahle JS ki badi matra ki requirement hoti hai, aur client data jharne ka prabandhan karna mushkil hota hai. Next.js in muddon ko sanbodhit karte hain.

SPA ke liye Next.js ka upyog kyon karein

  • JS bundles aur multiple HTML entry points ko vibhinn routes mein automatic code vibhajan - anavashyak JS client-side ko load karne se rokta hai, bundle size ko kam karta hai aur page load ko tej karta hai.
  • next/link automatic roop se prefetches routes - tezi se SPA jaise page transition, linking/sharing. ke liye URL ko routing state ko banaye rakhne ke labh ke saath
  • Next.js ek static site ya yahan tak ki ek sakht SPA (everything client-render) ke roop mein shuru ho sakta hai. jaisa ki project barhtee hai, pragtishil roop se server features (React Server Components, Server Actions, aadi) ko zaroorat ke hisaab se jodti hai.

pattern 1: ek Context Provider ke bhitar React ke use ka upyog karna

  • server se Client Component tak data stream karne ke liye React ke use API ka upyog karein. ek Server Component (ek parent ya layout) mein data prapt karein aur Promise ko neeche paas karein. Client Component ne ise use() ke saath aprivartit nahi kiya kyonki yeh render ke dauraan await nahi kar sakta hai. server par request shuru karne se pahle, baki app render karne se pahle, pratikriya stream ko turant permission data hai aur client-side request votarafol se bachata hai.
  • ek prop ke roop mein ek single Promise paas karein aur ise use() ke saath kholna, ya ise React sandarbh provider ke saath joda jaaye taaki koi bhi Client Component ek custom hook ke madhyam se value parh sake. jab ek Client Component ko phokas rivailideshan, polling, mutation ya request diduplikeshan ki requirement hoti hai, to SWR ya TanStack query jaise library ka upyog karein (client-paksh data prapt karne).
  • ek Server Component mein request shuru karein (jahan root layout) Non ise ka wait kar raha hai, aur Promise ko provider ko paas karein:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { UserProvider } from './user-provider'
import { getUser } from './user' // some server-side function

export default function RootLayout({ children }: LayoutProps<'/'>) {
  let userPromise = getUser() // do NOT await

  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>
        <UserProvider userPromise={userPromise}>{children}</UserProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: per mein ek Promise set ko phir se shuru karne wale Server Component ko phir se shuru karta hai jo ise set karta hai, isliye app ki zaroorat ke keval data ke liye, provider ko root layout ke bajaay us subtree par rakhein. yadi kai component ek request mein usi data ko parhte hain, to React ke cache mein getUser ko lapeto taaki ve ek single call sajha karein.
  • provider Promise ko sandarbh (Client Component) ke madhyam se aage badhata hai:
tsx
// app/user-provider.tsx
'use client'

import { createContext, useContext } from 'react'

type User = { id: string; name: string }

const UserContext = createContext<Promise<User> | null>(null)

export function useUser() {
  const userPromise = useContext(UserContext)
  if (!userPromise) {
    throw new Error('useUser must be used within a UserProvider')
  }
  return userPromise
}

export function UserProvider({
  children,
  userPromise,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
  userPromise: Promise<User>
}) {
  return (
    <UserContext.Provider value={userPromise}>{children}</UserContext.Provider>
  )
}
  • kisi bhi Client Component mein use() ke saath milakar, upbhokta ko ek fallback ke liye <Suspense> mein lapeto jabki Promise hal:
tsx
// app/profile.tsx
'use client'

import { use } from 'react'
import { useUser } from './user-provider'

export function Profile() {
  const userPromise = useUser()
  const user = use(userPromise)

  return <p>{user.name}</p>
}
tsx
// app/page.tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { Profile } from './profile'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading…</p>}>
      <Profile />
    </Suspense>
  )
}
  • upbhokta ko suspended kar data hai jabki Promise hal karta hai, isliye user JS ko load karne se pahle dharabaddh, HTML ko parishodhit karte hain. live demo: next-spa-patterns.labs.vercel.dev/use-context

pattern 2: keval browser mein Rendering component

  • client components ko next build ke dauraan pree-render kiya jata hai. ek Client Component ke liye prerendering ko inactive karne aur ise keval browser mein load karne ke liye, next/dynamic ka upyog karein:
jsx
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'

const ClientOnlyComponent = dynamic(() => import('./component'), {
  ssr: false,
})
  • third-party ke libraries ke liye upyogi hai jo browser API jaise window/document par nirbhar hai. optional roop se, ek useEffect jorein jo in API ke liye check karta hai aur yadi anupasthit ho to null / ek loading state return karta hai.
  • React 19.3 mein react-dom se browser API shamil hain. keval use(browser()) ka upyog karein jab ek Client Component ka pahla browser render server-reindred HTML se mel nahi khaa sakta. Prerendering ke dauraan, use(browser()) nikatatam <Suspense> boundary ko suspended kar data hai - fallback component ke initial HTML ban jati hai, isliye krolars jo JS ko executed nahi karte hain, component ke bajaay fallback ko dekhte hain. un content ko rakhein jinhein browser-keval boundary ke bahar anukrmit kiya jana chahiye. udaharan - ek editor localStorage se saheje gaye draft ko padhta hai:
jsx
// app/browser-only-editor.jsx
'use client'

import { use, useState } from 'react'
import { browser } from 'react-dom'

export default function BrowserOnlyEditor() {
  use(browser('The saved draft is stored in localStorage.'))

  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem('draft') ?? '')

  function handleChange(event) {
    const nextDraft = event.target.value
    setDraft(nextDraft)
    localStorage.setItem('draft', nextDraft)
  }

  return <textarea value={draft} onChange={handleChange} />
}
  • ise ek Suspense boundary mein lapetein:
jsx
// app/page.jsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import BrowserOnlyEditor from './browser-only-editor'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading editor…</p>}>
      <BrowserOnlyEditor />
    </Suspense>
  )
}
  • browser mein, browser() ne undefined ko lautaya aur editor saheje gaye draft ke saath render kiya. live demo: next-spa-patterns.labs.vercel.dev/browser-only

pattern 3: client par shaalo routing

  • yadi ek sakht SPA se migrate kiya gaya hai jaise ki React app ya Vite banaein, to maujuda code URL state ko update karne ke liye uthle-route ho sakta hai - Next.js file-system routing ka upyog kiye bina vicharon ke beech manual sankramana.
  • Next.js aapko page ko phir se load kiye bina browser ke history stack ko update karne ke liye deshi window.history.pushState / window.history.replaceState ka upyog karne data hai. Next.js in kolon ko router mein ekikrit karta hai, isliye usePathname ya useSearchParams update ke saath render karne wale component jab URL mein parivartan hota hai. jab ek event handler ekmatr sthan hota hai to ek component ko URL ki requirement hoti hai, to usePathname/useSearchParams ko call karne ke bajaay handler mein window.location ko padha jata hai - donon hook prerendering ko affected karte hain:
tsx
// app/ui/sort-products.tsx
'use client'

export default function SortProducts() {
  function updateSorting(sortOrder: string) {
    const urlSearchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
    urlSearchParams.set('sort', sortOrder)
    window.history.pushState(null, '', `?${urlSearchParams.toString()}`)
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button onClick={() => updateSorting('asc')}>Sort Ascending</button>
      <button onClick={() => updateSorting('desc')}>Sort Descending</button>
    </>
  )
}
  • live demo: next-spa-patterns.labs.vercel.dev/shallow-routing

pattern 4: Server Actions ke saath data mutating

  • interactivity ko aksar data likhne ki requirement hoti hai. ek Client Component server par mutation chalane ke liye Server Action ko call kar sakta hai. ek client data-fetching library ek hi Server Action ke aaspas ek optimistic browser update ko samanvit kar sakti hai. React ke built-in tool UI ko uttardayi rakhte hain: transition, useOptimistic, useActionState, useFormStatus.
  • saral: ek transition ke andar ek Server Action ko call karein aur feedback ke liye pending sthiti ka upyog karein:
tsx
// app/delete-post.tsx
'use client'

import { useTransition } from 'react'
import { deletePost } from './actions'

export function DeletePost({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  return (
    <button
      disabled={isPending}
      onClick={() => startTransition(() => deletePost(id))}
    >
      {isPending ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete'}
    </button>
  )
}
  • list ki tarah state jahan pratyek parivartan turant dikhai dena chahiye ke liye, useOptimistic ke saath useActionState gathabandhana. ek too-doo list udaharan ek shuddh reducer ka upyog karta hai, yeh define karta hai ki pratyek action list ko kaise badalta hai, client aur server dwara sajha kiya gaya hai:
ts
// app/todos-reducer.ts
export type Todo = { id: string; text: string; done: boolean }

export type TodoAction =
  | { type: 'add'; id: string; text: string }
  | { type: 'toggle'; id: string }
  | { type: 'edit'; id: string; text: string }
  | { type: 'delete'; id: string }

export function todosReducer(todos: Todo[], action: TodoAction): Todo[] {
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'add':
      return [...todos, { id: action.id, text: action.text, done: false }]
    case 'toggle':
      return todos.map((todo) =>
        todo.id === action.id ? { ...todo, done: !todo.done } : todo
      )
    case 'edit':
      return todos.map((todo) =>
        todo.id === action.id ? { ...todo, text: action.text } : todo
      )
    case 'delete':
      return todos.filter((todo) => todo.id !== action.id)
    default:
      return todos
  }
}
  • The Server Action reducer lagu karta hai, parinam jari rakhta hai, aur agli list return karta hai:
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { db } from './db'
import { todosReducer, type Todo, type TodoAction } from './todos-reducer'

export async function saveTodos(
  todos: Todo[],
  action: TodoAction
): Promise<Todo[]> {
  const next = todosReducer(todos, action)
  await db.saveTodos(next)
  return next
}
  • client useOptimistic ke saman reducer se guzarta hai, isliye optimistic update aur server agle state ko saman roop se computation karta hai. ek runAction helper optimistic parivartan ko lagu karta hai aur usi transition mein Server Action ko bhejta hai:
tsx
// app/todo-list.tsx
'use client'

import { useActionState, useOptimistic, startTransition } from 'react'
import { saveTodos } from './actions'
import { todosReducer, type Todo, type TodoAction } from './todos-reducer'

export function TodoList({ initialTodos }: { initialTodos: Todo[] }) {
  const [todos, dispatch, isPending] = useActionState(saveTodos, initialTodos)
  const [optimisticTodos, addOptimistic] = useOptimistic(todos, todosReducer)

  function runAction(action: TodoAction) {
    startTransition(() => {
      addOptimistic(action)
      dispatch(action)
    })
  }

  return (
    <>
      <form
        action={(formData) =>
          runAction({
            type: 'add',
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),
            text: String(formData.get('text')),
          })
        }
      >
        <input name="text" />
        <button>Add</button>
      </form>
      <ul>
        {optimisticTodos.map((todo) => (
          <li key={todo.id}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={todo.done}
              onChange={() => runAction({ type: 'toggle', id: todo.id })}
            />
            <span
              style={{ textDecoration: todo.done ? 'line-through' : 'none' }}
            >
              {todo.text}
            </span>
            <button onClick={() => runAction({ type: 'delete', id: todo.id })}>
              Delete
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {isPending && <p>Syncing to server…</p>}
    </>
  )
}
  • optimistic update turant dikhata hai, jabki useActionState ka pending flag ek sukshm suchak (e.g) dikhata hai. "Syncing to server..." jab tak Server Action hal nahi hota. live demo: next-spa-patterns.labs.vercel.dev/mutations bilding interactive apps guide aur iske ranebal demo bhi dekhein.

static export (optional)

  • Next.js ek puri tarah se static site (output: 'export') ka support karta hai, jismein sakht SPA par fayde hain:
  • automatic code-splitting: ek index.html ke bajaay , Next.js prati route ek HTML file generated karta hai - visitor client JS bundle ke wait ke bina content ko tezi se prapt karte hain.
  • Improved UX: puri tarah se ek minimum skeleton ke bajaay prati route pages ko render karta hai; client-side navigation transition abhi bhi tatkal hain aur SPA ki taraha.
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  output: 'export',
}

export default nextConfig
  • next build ke baad, Next.js ne HTML/CSS/JS assets ke saath ek out folder banaya. not: Next.js server suvidhaein static export ke saath supported nahi hain.

maujuda pariyojnaon ko Next.js mein migrate karna

  • Incrementally ke madhyam se migrate karein: mek React app se migrate karna, Vite se migrate karna, ya (Pages Router SPA) badha kar App Router ko apnaanaa.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • ise passed karne se pahle layout mein Promise ko accept karna - request ko wait kiye bina shuru karein taaki yeh dharaon ko stream kar sake; paani ke patan ka wait kar raha hai.
  • data ke liye root layout par ek provider ki installation keval app ki zarooraton ke hisse ke liye - ise set karne wale Server Component ko phir se chalata hai; provider ko subtree ka dayra data hai.
  • aisi content ke liye use(browser()) ka upyog karna jise anukrmit kiya jana chahiye - krolars Suspense ki fallback ko dekhte hain, component nahi.
  • usePathname/useSearchParams ka upyog sirph ek iveint handler mein URL ko parhne ke liye kiya jata hai - ve prerendering ko affected karte hain; iske bajaay handler mein window.location parhein.
  • server features ka support karne ke liye static-export application ka anveshan karein - ve nahi karte hain.

interview points

  • kya ek "strict SPA" banam kya Next.js pradan karta hai (code vibhajan, prati root HTML, prefetching, pragtishil server features).
  • use-with-context pattern: bina await kiye ek Server Component mein Promise shuru karein, sandarbh ke madhyam se aage, use() + Suspense ke saath unwrap; sajha call ke liye React.cache; polling/mutations/dedup. ke liye SWR/TanStack query
  • browser keval rendering: dynamic(..., { ssr: false }) banam React 19.3 use(browser()) aur iske SEO/fallback nihitaartha.
  • mool history.pushState/replaceState ke madhyam se shaalo routing ko Next.js router ke saath ekikrit kiya gaya.
  • Mutations: Server Action + useTransition pending state; ek sajha shuddh reducer ke saath useActionState + useOptimistic; "server ke liye signing..." pending suchak paitarna.
  • static eksport (output: 'export', out folder) fayde aur iske server-feature boundary.
