How to create a static export of your Next.js application

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to create a static export of your Next.js application. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to create a static export of your Next.js application — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Configuration, Supported features, Server Components, Client Components, Image Optimization, Route Handlers. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Next.js ek static site ya SPA ke roop mein shuru karne mein enable banata hai, phir optional roop se baad mein ek server ki requirement wali features ka upyog karne ke liye upgrade karta hai. next build par, Next.js prati route ek HTML file generated karta hai - vyaktigat HTML files mein ek sakht SPA ko torakar anavashyak JS client-side ko load karne se rokta hai, bundle size ko kam karta hai aur page load ko tej karta hai. ek static export kisi bhi web server par deployed/hosted ho sakta hai jo HTML/CSS/JS static assets ka karya karta hai.

Configuration

js
// next.config.js
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  output: 'export',

  // Optional: Change links `/me` -> `/me/` and emit `/me.html` -> `/me/index.html`
  // trailingSlash: true,

  // Optional: Prevent automatic `/me` -> `/me/`, instead preserve `href`
  // skipTrailingSlashRedirect: true,

  // Optional: Change the output directory `out` -> `dist`
  // distDir: 'dist',
}

module.exports = nextConfig
  • next build ke baad, Next.js ne HTML/CSS/JS assets ke saath ek out folder banaya.

supported suvidhaein

  • Server Components: next build ke dauraan, Server Components mein build (jaise paramparik SSG) ke dauraan chal raha hai. parinam initial load ke liye static HTML mein aur client navigation ke liye static payload mein pradan kiya gaya hai. jab tak ve dynamic server karyon ka upbhog nahi karte hain, tab tak koi parivartan required nahi hai: app
tsx
// app/page.tsx
export default async function Page() {
  // This fetch will run on the server during `next build`
  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/...')
  const data = await res.json()

  return <main>...</main>
}
  • Client Components: client-side data lane ke liye, requests ko yaad karne ke liye SWR ke saath Client Component ka upyog karein:
tsx
// app/other/page.tsx
'use client'

import useSWR from 'swr'

const fetcher = (url: string) => fetch(url).then((r) => r.json())

export default function Page() {
  const { data, error } = useSWR(
    `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1`,
    fetcher
  )
  if (error) return 'Failed to load'
  if (!data) return 'Loading...'

  return data.title
}
  • root transition client-side hota hai, isliye yeh paramparik SPA (e.g) ki tarah behavior karta hai. <Link href="/post/1">
  • Image Optimization: next/image ka upyog next.config.js (e.g) mein ek custom image loader ko define karke static export ke saath kiya jaa sakta hai. Cloudinary:
js
// next.config.js
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  output: 'export',
  images: {
    loader: 'custom',
    loaderFile: './my-loader.ts',
  },
}

module.exports = nextConfig
ts
// my-loader.ts
export default function cloudinaryLoader({
  src,
  width,
  quality,
}: {
  src: string
  width: number
  quality?: number
}) {
  const params = ['f_auto', 'c_limit', `w_${width}`, `q_${quality || 'auto'}`]
  return `https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/${params.join(
    ','
  )}${src}`
}

phir Cloudinary mein image ke relative path ke saath next/image ka upyog karein.

  • Route Handlers: next build ke dauraan static pratikriya pradan karta hai; keval GET kriya ka support kiya jata hai. static HTML, JSON, TXT, ya cached/uncached data se any files ko generated kar sakte hain. Prerendering ko sunishchit karne ke liye, spasht roop se handler ko export const dynamic = 'force-static' ke saath static roop se chihnit karein jab static export enable ho jata hai:
ts
// app/data.json/route.ts
export const dynamic = 'force-static'

export async function GET() {
  return Response.json({ name: 'Lee' })
}

yeh build ke dauraan { name: 'Lee' } yukt data.json ka production karta hai. yadi aapko aane wale request se dynamic values ko parhne ki requirement hai, to aap static export ka upyog nahi kar sakte.

  • Browser APIs: Client Components ko HTML ke liye next build ke dauraan pree-render kiya gaya hai. Web APIs jaise window, localStorage, navigator server par upalabdh nahi hain - keval browser mein hi unhein access karein, e.g. ke andar useEffect:
jsx
'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';

export default function ClientComponent() {
  useEffect(() => {
    // You now have access to `window`
    console.log(window.innerHeight);
  }, [])

  return ...;
}

anusamarthit suvidhaein

  • suvidhaein ek Node.js server ya dynamic tark ki requirement hoti hai jo build ke dauraan computation nahi ki jaa sakti hai, not supported hain:
  • dynamicParams: true ke saath dynamic root
  • dynamic roots bina generateStaticParams()
  • Route Handlers jo request par bharosa karte hain
  • cookies, Rewrites, Redirects, header, Proxy
  • vriddhishil static punarjanan (ISR)
  • default loader ke saath Image Optimization
  • Draft Mode, Server Actions, Intercepting Routes
  • inmein se kisi ko bhi next dev errors ke saath prayog karne ka prayas karna, jo root layout mein export const dynamic = 'error' ki installation ke saman hai.

Deploying

  • ek static export ke saath, kisi bhi web server ki serve karne wale HTML/CSS/JS. next build ko out mein export generated karta hai. udaharan ke route / aur /blog/[id] /out/index.html, /out/404.html, /out/blog/post-1.html, /out/blog/post-2.html ka production karte hain.
  • Nginx - sahi files ke aane wale requests ko phir se likhte hain:
nginx
# nginx.conf
server {
  listen 80;
  server_name acme.com;

  root /var/www/out;

  location / {
      try_files $uri $uri.html $uri/ =404;
  }

  # This is necessary when `trailingSlash: false`.
  # You can omit this when `trailingSlash: true`.
  location /blog/ {
      rewrite ^/blog/(.*)$ /blog/$1.html break;
  }

  error_page 404 /404.html;
  location = /404.html {
      internal;
  }
}
  • GitHub pejon ko deploy karne ke liye official template (github.com/nextjs/deploy-github-pages) ka upyog karein.

sanskaran history

VersionChanges
v14.0.0next export ko "output": "export" ke paksh mein hata diya gaya
v13.4.0App Router (Stable) ne RSC aur Route Handlers sahit static export support ko badhaya
v13.3.0next export ki vyakhya ki gai, jise "output": "export" ke saath badal diya gaya

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • generateStaticParams() ke bina ya dynamicParams: true ke saath dynamic routes ka upyog karna - build fail rahta hai.
  • Route Handlers request object ko parhne, ya cookies/rewrites/redirects/headers/Proxy/ISR/Draft Mode/Server Actions/Intercepting roots ka upyog karte hue - sabhi asamarthita.
  • default loader ke saath next/image ka upyog karna - ek custom loader (ya unoptimized) ki requirement hoti hai.
  • render karne ke dauraan window/localStorage tak pahunchna - useEffect (ya preserve) ke andar hona chahiye kyonki Client Components ko build mein pahle se taiyar kiya gaya hai.
  • ek Route Handler par export const dynamic = 'force-static' ko bhool jana chahte hain.
  • purane next export command ka upyog - v14 mein hata diya gaya; output: 'export' ka upyog karein.

interview points

  • output: 'export' config, out folder, aur kisi bhi static host (nginx try_files pattern) par deployment.
  • ek static export mein kya kaam karta hai (Server Components) build samay par, Client Components + SWR, custom image loader, static GET Route Handlers force-static ke saath) banam kya nahi (full anusamarthit list).
  • kyon ek HTML file prati route ek sakht SPA (bundle size, tej bhar, prati root content) ko haraayaa jata hai.
  • sanskaran history: next export ne 13.3 ko hata diya, 14.0 ko hata diya.

Streaming

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Streaming. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Streaming — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key concepts — what is streaming?, How the App Router delivers a page, The HTML stream, The component payload, The static shell, Page-level streaming with `loading.js`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

main concepts - kya streaming hai?

  • paramparik SSR mein, server kuchh bhi bhejne se pahle full HTML dastavez generated karta hai - ek single dhimi DB query/API call pure page ko blocked karta hai. streaming ka upyog karta hai chunked hastantaran encoding pratikriya ke kuchh hisson ko bhejne ke liye kyonki ve taiyar ho jate hain; browser shuru hota hai HTML rendering jabki server abhi bhi baki paida kar raha hai.
  • vishesh roop se dhime dynamic content (vyaktigat data, vishleshan, recommendations) ke saath tezi se static content (headers, nev, layout) ke sanyojan wale pages ke liye prabhaavkaaree: static bhag previous aur ek CDN se serve karte hain, turant peinting karte hain, jabki dynamic bhag taiyar hone ke roop mein stream karte hain.
  • React server reindarar <Suspense> boundaries ke saath sanrekhit tukron mein HTML ka production karta hai. Next.js ise App Router mein ekikrit karta hai taaki extra config ke bina streaming karyon ko ekikrit kiya jaa sake. ek sathi streaming demo (streaming-demo.labs.vercel.dev) page-star streaming, danedar sibling boundaries, hydration tulna, ek Route Handler mein kachche HTML streaming aur ek config ReadableStream endpoint ko darshata hai.

kaise App Router ek page vitrit karta hai

  • do stream initial load par milakar kaam karte hain:
  • The HTML stream: React ka server reindarar pragtishil HTML chank paida karta hai. static bhagon (layout, navigation, Suspense fallback) pahle render karte hain aur turant bheje jate hain. jab ek <Suspense> boundary ki content taiyar ho jati hai (e.g. ek Async Server Component hal), React apne full HTML plus inline <script> tag ko stream karta hai: ek nai content ke saath fallback DOM nod ko svaip karta hai, dusra component payload karta hai isliye React ise baad mein hydrate kar sakta hai. browser turant svaip karta hai, bina JS bundle ya hydration ki await ke. yeh vahi hai jo user dekhta hai: page peinting uttrottar, section dwara anubhaaga.
  • The component payload: component tree React ka ek dharavahik pratinidhitv page ko hydrate karne aur client side update ko sambhalne ke liye upyog karta hai. initial load par yeh HTML stream mein embedded aata hai; client-side nevigeshan par, keval component payload prapt kiya jata hai (ek rsc: 1 request header ke saath) aur koi HTML hastaantrit kiya jata hai. React ise per ko jagah mein update karne ke liye upyog karta hai.
  • The static shell: sab kuchh kisi bhi async kaam hal karne se pahle rendering - layout, navigation, Suspense Fallback UI. turant bheje gaye, upyogkartaon ko see/interact ko dynamic content dharaon ke saath kuchh dena. With Cache Components, static shell ka build samay par kiya jata hai aur turant kinaare se serve ki jati hai.
  • pratyek <Suspense> boundary ek svatantr streaming point hai - alag-alag boundaries mein component ek dusre ko blocked kiye bina svatantr roop se hal aur stream karte hain.

loading.js ke saath page-stariy streaming

  • sabse saral tareeka: page.js ke saath loading.js ko jagah - Next.js automatic roop se page content ko ek <Suspense> boundary mein lapeta hai, jo aapke loading component ko fallback ke roop mein upyog karta hai:
tsx
// app/dashboard/loading.tsx
export default function Loading() {
  return (
    <div className="animate-pulse">
      <div className="h-8 w-48 bg-gray-200 rounded mb-4" />
      <div className="h-4 w-full bg-gray-200 rounded mb-2" />
      <div className="h-4 w-full bg-gray-200 rounded mb-2" />
      <div className="h-4 w-2/3 bg-gray-200 rounded" />
    </div>
  )
}
  • drishyon ke pichhe, loading.js ko layout.js ke andar nested kiya jata hai aur page.js ko <Suspense> boundary mein lapeta jata hai: layout turant static shell ke hisse ke roop mein render karta hai; loading skeleton turant fallback ke roop mein dikhata hai; jab page load ho jata hai, to iska HTML skeleton ki jagah leta hai.
  • loading.js tab upyogi hota hai jab page ke data ko hal karne tak dikhane ka koi arth nahi hota hai. yadi page ko kisi cheez ko render karne se pahle data ka wait karna chahiye, to ek full page skeleton ek uchit fallback hai.

<Suspense> ke saath danedar streaming

  • Parallel sibling boundaries ke saath streaming: apne khud ke <Suspense> boundary mein pratyek Async component lapeta hai - pratyek dhara svatantr roop se apne async kaam pura karne ke roop mein, kisi bhi kram mein, ek dusre ko blocked kiye bina:
tsx
// app/dashboard/page.tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { Revenue } from './revenue'
import { RecentOrders } from './recent-orders'
import { Recommendations } from './recommendations'

export default function Dashboard() {
  return (
    <div>
      <h1>Dashboard</h1>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading revenue...</p>}>
          <Revenue />
        </Suspense>
        <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading orders...</p>}>
          <RecentOrders />
        </Suspense>
      </div>
      <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading recommendations...</p>}>
        <Recommendations />
      </Suspense>
    </div>
  )
}
  • yadi Revenue 200ms, RecentOrders mein 1s mein hal karta hai, aur 3s mein Recommendations, to user pratyek section ko tab tak dikhai data hai jab tak uska data taiyar ho.
  • pragtishil vistar ke liye Nested simaein: e.g. ek product page header ko turant stream karta hai, agle product vivaran, antim samiksha - external boundary "loading product vivaran" jab tak ProductDetails hal nahi karta hai, tab tak internal boundary "loading sameekshaaein..." dikhati hai jab tak Reviews hal karta hai (pragtishil khulasa).
  • Push dynamic pahunch neeche: jo dharaon ko turant adhikatam karne ki key component hai ki vastav mein iski zaroorat ke liye dynamic data pahunch defering hai — params, searchParams, cookies(), headers(), data prapt karta hai. yadi aap ek layout/page ke top par inmein se koi bhi await hain, to neeche sab kuchh dynamic ho jata hai aur ise static shell ke hisse ke roop mein render nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. iske bajaay, Promise ko paas karein aur upbhokta component ko ise <Suspense> boundary ke andar hal karne dein:
tsx
// app/dashboard/layout.tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { Nav } from './nav'
import { UserMenu } from './user-menu'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

export default function DashboardLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const cookieStore = cookies() // Start the work, but don't await

  return (
    <div>
      <Nav>
        <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading user...</p>}>
          <UserMenu cookiePromise={cookieStore} />
        </Suspense>
      </Nav>
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}
  • <Nav> aur {children} static shell ke hisse ke roop mein render karte hain kyonki layout wait mein kuchh bhi nahi hai; keval <UserMenu> cookie Promise ko hal karte samay suspended kar data hai. yadi layout mein top par await cookies() tha, to pure layout aur bachchon ko prerendering se blocked kar diya jayega.
  • params/searchParams ke liye ek hi principle: us component ko Promise karta hai jise value, e.g ki requirement hoti hai. <ProductGrid paramsPromise={params} /> ek Suspense boundary ke andar, isliye <Hero /> static shell ke hisse ke roop mein peint karta hai. ya .then() ke saath anraip inline isliye children ko ek plain value prapt hota hai:
tsx
<Suspense fallback={<p>Loading products...</p>}>
  {params.then(({ category }) => (
    <ProductGrid category={category} />
  ))}
</Suspense>

loading.js banam <Suspense> ka upyog kab karein

loading.js<Suspense>
Scopesampurn pagekoi component
Setupek file mein dropspasht roop se component lapetein
Navigationtatkal fallback ke roop mein Prefetcheddefault roop se prefetched nahi
ke liye sarvashreshthpage jahan data ke bina koi rendering nahi karta haiadhikansh page, danedar niyantran ke liye
  • Prefer explicit <Suspense> boundaries dynamic pahunch ke karib hai. jab prerender dynamic kaam ka samna karta hai, to yeh nikatatam Suspense boundary ki talaash mein per chala jata hai; yadi koi nahi paya jata hai, to build blocked route error ke saath fail ho jata hai. per mein ek loading.js uchch ek vaidh boundary hai, isliye dhancha ise dhoondhta hai aur ruk jata hai - lekin pura page danedar roop se streaming ke bajaay ek full page skeleton par wapas aata hai.

mid-stream ko sambhalne mein error

  • yadi koi component streaming shuru hone ke baad throw karta hai, to nikatatam error.js boundary ise pakadti hai aur asaphal component ke sthan par error UI ko render karti hai; baki page barkarar rahta hai - keval galat section ko replace kiya jata hai. chunki HTTP stetas code (200 OK) pahle se hi pahle hi pahli bar ke saath bheja gaya tha, isliye ise 4xx/5xx mein badla nahi jaa sakta - error ko puri tarah se stream kiye gaye HTML ke bhitar sambhala jata hai.

client ko data stream karna

  • ek Server Component mein ek prapt shuru karein aur ek Client Component ko ek prop ke roop mein ansulajh Promise passed karein (jaisa ki zaroorat ke hisaab se kai parton ke madhyam se). keval component React ke use API ko value parhne ke liye uske aaspas ek <Suspense> boundary ki requirement hoti hai:
tsx
// app/dashboard/page.tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { StatsChart } from './stats-chart'

type Stats = { revenue: number; orders: number }

async function getStats(): Promise<Stats> {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/stats')
  return res.json()
}

export default function Dashboard() {
  // Start the fetch during server render, don't await it
  const statsPromise = getStats()

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading chart...</p>}>
      <StatsChart dataPromise={statsPromise} />
    </Suspense>
  )
}
tsx
// app/dashboard/stats-chart.tsx
'use client'

import { use } from 'react'

type Stats = { revenue: number; orders: number }

export function StatsChart({ dataPromise }: { dataPromise: Promise<Stats> }) {
  const stats = use(dataPromise)

  return <div>{/* render chart with stats */}</div>
}
  • fallback ko turant static shell ke saath bheja jata hai; jab Promise hal karta hai, to React pure HTML ko page mein stream karta hai.
  • Sharing a Promise pure per mein: jab kai components ko ek hi data ki requirement hoti hai, to ek bar lane shuru karein aur ek sandarbh provider ke madhyam se Promise passed karein taaki subtree mein koi bhi component ise use() ke saath hal kar sake (spaas guide ke use-within-context pattern dekhein).

Route Handlers mein streaming

  • React rendering ke bahar, Route Handlers Web Streams API ka upyog karke kachche pratikriyaon ko stream kar sakta hai - server-Sent Events, badi file pidhi, ya kisi pragtishil roop se sanpann pratikriya ke liye upyogi:
ts
// app/api/stream/route.ts
export async function GET() {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()

  const stream = new ReadableStream({
    async start(controller) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(`Chunk ${i + 1}\n`))
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200))
      }
      controller.close()
    },
  })

  return new Response(stream, {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8',
      'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
    },
  })
}
  • browser mein ya curl http://localhost:3000/api/stream ke saath bhaagne ke liye ek samay mein ek aane ke liye route par jaein.
  • unhein puri tarah se memory mein load kiye bina files ko stream karein - FileHandle.readableWebStream() seedhe ek file se ek web ReadableStream data hai:
ts
// app/api/download/route.ts
import { open } from 'node:fs/promises'

export async function GET() {
  const file = await open('/path/to/large-file.csv')

  return new Response(file.readableWebStream(), {
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'text/csv',
      'Content-Disposition': 'attachment; filename="data.csv"',
    },
  })
}

streaming aur Web Vitals

  • TTFB aur FCP: streaming ke bina, TTFB dhimi gati se query ke barabar hai. streaming ke saath, server static shell ko jald hi taiyar bhejta hai - TTFB ko layouts/fallbacks ko render karne ke samay mein gir jata hai; browser shell ko turant peint karta hai, isliye FCP ko data-fetching samay se alag kiya jata hai.
  • LCP: yadi LCP element (hero image, main shirshak, product photo) ek Suspense boundary ke andar hai, to yeh tab tak peint nahi kar sakta jab tak ki boundary ki content svaip nahi hoti - tab yeh server ke kaam par nirbhar karta hai taaki ise render kiya jaa sake, initial pratikriya samay nahi. ise client par bhi kharch karna: React boundary ke HTML ke saath ek chhoti inline script ko stream karta hai aur keval script ranon ke baad content dikhai deti hai. data lane ka ekmatr karan nahi hai ki ek boundary delay LCP — React bhi apni HTML bhejne ke karan ek badi boundary wapas rakhti hai. angoothe ka niyam: yadi ek Suspense boundary hai, to React iska upyog kar sakta hai - ek dhimi network/busy CPU ke tahat, concurrent rendering bhi apratyashit roop se ise wapas gir sakta hai; aapko koi boundary nahi jor sakte hain. LCP ko tezi se rakhne ke liye: LCP elements ko outside/above Suspense boundaries (static shell mein); ek known LCP image ke liye next/image par preload prop ka upyog karein taaki browser ko <img> ki khoj karne se pahle load hona shuru ho jaaye (jab image prapt ho jaaye, tab preloading kantrols nahi, jab yeh peint karta hai - ek boundary ke andar ek image abhi bhi svaip ke liye wait karti hai); Suspense boundaries ke bahar gair-image wale LCP elements (text, hedings) ko render karein.
  • CLS: jab ek Suspense girbaik ko hal content dwara replace kiya jata hai, to browser punhpravaah; yadi fallback aur content size mein bhinn hoti hai, to layout badlaava. CLS ko chhota karein: ve pratinidhitv karne wali content ke dimensions se mel khaate hue design skeleton ki kami; antriksh ko reserved karne ke liye Suspense boundaries ke aaspas fixed/min-height kantenron ka upyog karein.
  • INP: streaming selective Hydrtion — React hydrates components ko svatantr roop se enable banata hai kyonki ve hydrating ko stream karte hain aur priority dete hain jo bhi user ke saath negotiation kar raha hai. pratyek <Suspense> boundary ek hydration ikai hai. unke bina, React pure page ko ek blocked paas mein hydrate karta hai; unke saath, hydration un chhote karyon mein toot jata hai jo browser ko paida karte hain, main yarn uttardayi rakhte hain.
  • Early sansadhan khoj: static shell mein bahut pahle HTML mein <link>/<script> tag shamil hain - browser ko pata chalta hai aur turant CSS, JS aur fonts lane shuru hota hai, jabki server abhi bhi content paida kar raha hai.
  • dashboard udaharan mein: <h1> shell (LCP ke liye achha) mein render karta hai, pratyek data section apne khud ke Suspense boundary ke pichhe svatantr roop se stream karta hai (vibhajit hydration ke madhyam se INP ke liye achha), skeleton fallback reserved sthan (CLS ke liye achha).

HTTP anubandh

  • ek bar streaming shuru hone ke baad, HTTP pratikriya header (sthiti code sahit) pahle se hi bheje gaye hain - you streaming shuru hone ke baad stetas code ya header ko badal nahi sakte hain.
  • Status code: jab ek <Suspense> Fallback renders ya ek component suspended ho jata hai, to server ko 200 OK ko HTML stream bhejne ke liye commit hona chahiye. yadi notFound() madhy dhara mein aag lagata hai, to Next.js 404 ki sthiti ko badal nahi sakta hai - iske bajaay yeh <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> ko dharabaddh HTML mein injekt karta hai taaki sarch injan page ko anukrmit na karein. isi tarah, ek mid-stream redirect() ek client-side redirect ho jata hai, bajaay ek HTTP redirect header hota hai.
  • Kab streaming shuru hota hai? pratikriya body tab streaming shuru hota hai jab ek Suspense Fallback renders (e.g). loading.tsx) ya jab koi component <Suspense> boundary ke tahat suspended ho jata hai. ek 404 lautane ke liye, notFound() before ko boundary mein rakhein:
tsx
// app/post/[slug]/page.tsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { PostContent } from './post-content'

export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const posts = await getPublishedPosts()
  return posts.map((post) => ({ slug: post.slug }))
}

export default async function PostPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const exists = await checkSlugExists(slug) // Fast existence check
  if (!exists) notFound() // Returns a 404 before streaming starts

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading post...</p>}>
      <PostContent slug={slug} />
    </Suspense>
  )
}
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: Cache Components ke saath, Next.js ne previous shell aur header ko CSS/fonts/images ko preload kiya jabki request-time check run - yeh ek 200 pratikriya shuru karta hai, bhale hi shell mein koi view nahi hai UI ya route instant = false set karta hai. baad mein notFound() abhi bhi nahi-installed UI render karta hai aur noindex jodta hai. ek request-samay 404 lautane ke liye, page render karne se pahle Proxy ka upyog karein (Proxy shuru hone se pahle redirect/rewrite/return ko ek pratikriya bhi de sakta hai); page render karne se pahle next.config.js mein configure kiye gaye redirect karta hai.
  • Bots aur krolar: HTML-simit bots/crawlers ko initial HTML ke <head> mein metadata ki requirement hoti hai. Next.js unhein user agent dwara pata lagata hai aur page content streaming se pahle hal karne ke liye generateMetadata ka wait karta hai. full browser aur DOM-capable krolar page content ke saath streaming metadata prapt karte hain. customize karein ki kaun se bot ko htmlLimitedBots config ke saath blocked metadata prapt hota hai. With Cache Components, visitor aur DOM-capable krolars ko turant aur dynamic content stream prapt hoti hai; HTML-simit bot prerendered shell ko chhorte hain aur dynamic roop se render karte hain isliye metadata <head> mein ho sakta hai - ek bar metadata hal karta hai, shesh content abhi bhi stream kar sakti hai. Caveat: yadi preereindard shell keval maujuda input par nirbhar karta hai, jabki prerendering (build-time data, request samay par pahunch yogy value), ek aisa page jo kisi vyakti ke liye load ek krolar ke liye fail ho sakta hai - sunishchit karein ki shell data request samay par bhi upalabdh hai.

kya streaming ko affected kar sakta hai

  • server aur client ke beech koi bhi parat jo pratikriya ko baphar karta hai, streaming ko kam karta hai - HTML ko pragtishil roop se generated kiya jaa sakta hai, lekin yadi koi proxy, CDN, ya client rendering se pahle sabhi hisse ekatr karta hai, to user ek vilnbit pratikriya dekhta hai.
  • Reverse proxy: default roop se nginx baphar - X-Accel-Buffering: no header (next.config.js mein headers()) ke saath disabled karein.
  • CDNs: puri pratikriyaon ko baphar kar sakta hai - provider ki streaming support/config/plan tiyar ki check karein.
  • Serverless platform: sabhi support streaming nahi - AWS Lambda ko pratikriya streaming mode ko spasht roop se enable karne ki requirement hoti hai (default nahi); Vercel mool roop se streaming ka support karta hai.
  • Compression: gzip/Brotli internal roop se phlashing se pahle baphar kar sakte hain - compression parat ki check aggressive roop se paryapt ho jati hai.
  • Clients: Safari/WebKit baphar streaming pratikriyaon tak 1024 bytes prapt hone tak, isliye bahut chhoti pratikriyaein ek hi bar mein sabhi ko peint karti hain; actual application aasani se is se adhik ho jate hain. default roop se curl baphar (-N) output baphring ko disabled karta hai, lekin phir bhi laainon ko phlash karne ke liye nai line par nirbhar karta hai.

streaming karyon ko verify karna

  • Network tab: Chrome DevTools mein , dastavez request ka time brekdaaun - ek lanbe "Content Download" step ke saath ek initial "time too First Byte" ke saath sabhi-saath vitaran ke bajaay streaming ki pushti karta hai.
  • Observe Raw chunks: ne ek chhoti script ke saath ek dhara ke roop mein pratikriya ko padha (iski baphring ke karan curl se adhik vishvasniy); compression ko inactive karne ke liye Accept-Encoding: identity ka upyog karein taaki bhag baphar na hon. do siblings Suspense boundaries ke saath ek page ke liye udaharan output: taksaal 0 (+0ms) static shell (<head>, CSS, nausenaa, patajhar ke skeleton, <template id="B:0"> / <template id="B:1"> plesholdar, bootstrap script); taksaal 1 (+170ms) component payload (self.__next_f.push) hydration ke liye; 2 (+1000ms) mausam vijet payload + <div hidden id="S:0"> (swap B:0); 3 (+3000ms) analytics dashboard payload + <div hidden id="S:1"> (swap B: 1). <template id="B:0"> marker Suspense phlembaik plesholdar hain; jab ek boundary ka samadhan hota hai, to React ek <div hidden id="S:0"> ko full HTML ke saath stream karta hai aur ek script mein ise svaip karta hai.
  • Compare a bot request: ek bot user agent (e.g) ke saath . Twitterbot/1.0), await fetch() apne aap ko block karta hai jab tak ki full render pura (~ 3s) - server pratikriya rakhta hai jab tak ki uske paas samapt dastavez na ho, tab tak ise ek single phat mein bhej data hai jismein koi barabaraa nahi hota hai.

Summary

  • trigger your code hai: async kaam, gair-deterministic production, ya runtime data. jab phremavark inse samna karta hai, to yeh per ko ek <Suspense> boundary ke liye dekh raha hai jo fallback ke roop mein upyog kiya jata hai. un boundaries ke upar sab kuchh static shell banata hai, turant bhej diya. pratyek boundary ke samadhan ke roop mein, React page mein parinam ko stream karta hai. pramukh nirnay: what to kaish and where to place Suspense boundaries — cache jo aap ke saath kar sakte hain "use cache" static shell viksit karne ke liye; dynamic pahunch ko dhakka components ki yeh zaroorat hai aur <Suspense> mein un lapeto.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • ek layout/page ke top par dynamic APIs (cookies(), params, searchParams) ka wait karna - static shell se pure subtree ko blocked karta hai; ek Suspense boundary mein pahunch ko dhakka data hai.
  • kahin bhi Suspense boundary nahi → build blocked route error ke saath fail rahta hai.
  • LCP element ko Suspense boundary ke andar rakhna - LCP mein delay; aapko un boundaries ko bhi nahi jorte hain jinka aapko requirement nahi hai (React unhein dhima network/busy CPU ke tahat upyog kar sakte hain).
  • antim content → CLS ki tulna mein vibhinn dimensions ke saath skeleton ki wapsi.
  • HTTP sthiti ko badalane ke liye mid-stream notFound()/redirect() ko Expect karna - yeh nahi ho sakta; sthiti pahle se hi 200 hai, isliye aapko iske bajaay noindex meta / client-side redirect prapt hota hai. kya astitv boundary se pahle check karte hain.
  • infrastructure baphring (nginx, CDN, Lambda bina pratikriya streaming, compression) chupchap streaming labh ki hatyaa.
  • ek static export mein streaming ki ummid - supported nahi hai.

interview points

  • kya streaming hai (chankd transfer enkoding, Suspense-aligned HTML chunks) aur do dharaon (HTML dhara banam component payload, client navigation par rsc: 1).
  • static shell concept aur kaise Cache Components ise kinaare par render karta hai.
  • loading.js banam danedar <Suspense> (skop, setup, prefetch, best-for) aur blocked root error jab koi boundary maujud nahi hai.
  • push-dynamic-access-daaun pattern (paas Promise karta hai, andar ki boundaries ko hal karta hai, .then() inline anraip).
  • Unresolved Promise + use() ke madhyam se Client Components ko data stream karna aur Route Handler ko ReadableStream / FileHandle.readableWebStream() ke madhyam se streaming karna.
  • Web Vitals prabhav (TTFB/FCP, LCP, CLS, INP/selective hydration, initial sansadhan khoj).
  • HTTP anubandh (ek bar streaming shuru hone ke baad 200 par jamee hui sthiti, noindex madhy dhara notFound() ke liye, htmlLimitedBots ke saath bot handling, Cache Components bot behavior).
  • kya brek streaming (nginx baphring / X-Accel-Buffering: no, CDN, Lambda pratikriya streaming, compression, Safari 1024-byte baphar) aur ise kaise verify karein (network tab taaiming, kachche-chunk paryvekshak script).

How to install Tailwind CSS v3 in your Next.js application

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to install Tailwind CSS v3 in your Next.js application. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to install Tailwind CSS v3 in your Next.js application — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Installing Tailwind v3, Configuring Tailwind v3, Using classes, Usage with Turbopack. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • yeh guide vyapak browser support ke liye ek Next.js app mein Tailwind CSS v3 ko installed karne ke liye cover karta hai. latest Tailwind 4 setup ke liye, CSS Getting Started page ka Tailwind CSS section dekhein.

installed karna Tailwind v3

  • Tailwind CSS aur iske sahakarmi dependency installed karein, phir init command ko tailwind.config.js aur postcss.config.js donon ko generated karne ke liye chalaein:
bash
pnpm add -D tailwindcss@^3 postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p

(npm: npm install -D tailwindcss@^3 postcss autoprefixer; yarn/bun barabar).

Tailwind v3 ko configure karna

  • tailwind.config.js mein template path ko configure karein:
js
// tailwind.config.js
/** @type {import('tailwindcss').Config} */
module.exports = {
  content: [
    './app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}',
    './pages/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}',
    './components/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}',
  ],
  theme: {
    extend: {},
  },
  plugins: [],
}
  • global CSS file mein Tailwind directive jorein:
css
/* app/globals.css */
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;
  • mool layout mein CSS file import karein:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import './globals.css'

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}

kakshaon ka upyog karna

  • setup ke baad, Tailwind ki upyogita kakshaon ka upyog karein:
tsx
// app/page.tsx
export default function Page() {
  return <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold underline">Hello, Next.js!</h1>
}

Turbopack ke saath prayog

  • Next.js 13.1, Tailwind CSS aur PostCSS ke roop mein Turbopack ke saath supported hain.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • jab aap v3 - pin tailwindcss@^3 chahte hain to galti se Tailwind v4 installed karna.
  • content path ko bhool jana - bina soche directory mein kakshaein generated nahi hueen.
  • root layout mein globals.css import karne ke liye bhool jana - koi Tailwind styles lagu hote hain.
  • v3 ke saath v4 @import "tailwindcss" setup ka upyog karna - v3 teen @tailwind directive plus tailwind.config.js + postcss.config.js ka upyog karta hai.

interview points

  • Tailwind v3 banam v4 setup antar (v3: tailwindcss@^3 + postcss + autoprefixer, tailwindcss init -p, tailwind.config.js content path, @tailwind base/components/utilities directive; v4: CSS-first setup — CSS guide dekhein).
  • kyon content path padarth (Tailwind keval kakshaon ko generated karta hai jo ise skain ki gai files mein pata hai).
  • Next.js 13.1 ke baad se Tailwind/PostCSS ke liye Turbopack samarthana.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/tailwind-v3-css

Testing

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Testing. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Testing — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Types of tests, Unit Testing, Component Testing, Integration Testing, End-to-End (E2E) Testing, Snapshot Testing. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • React aur Next.js me, kuch alag-alag types ke tests hote hain, har ek ka apna purpose aur use cases. Ye page types aur commonly used tools ka overview hai.

testing ke prakar

  • Unit Testing — individual units (code ke blocks) ko isolation me test karna. React me, ek unit ek single function, hook ya component ho sakti hai.
  • Component Testing — unit testing ka zyada focused version jahan primary subject React component hai: ve kaise render karte hain, props ke saath kaise interact karte hain, aur user events ke response me kaise behave karte hain.
  • Integration Testing — multiple units ek saath kaise kaam karte hain, ye test karna (components, hooks, functions ka combination).
  • End-to-End (E2E) Testing — production-like environment me real user scenarios simulate karte hue user flows test karna, jaise browser — specific tasks (jaise signup flow).
  • Snapshot Testing — ek component ke rendered output ko capture karke snapshot file me save karna; baad ke runs par, current output ko saved snapshot se compare kiya jata hai; changes unexpected behaviour changes ko indicate karte hain.

Async Server Components

  • Kyunki async Server Components React ecosystem ke liye naye hain, kuch tools unhe fully support nahi karte. Is beech, async components ke liye Unit Testing ke bajaye End-to-End Testing use karne ki recommendation hai.

guide (prati tool)

  • Cypress — E2E aur Component Testing setup.
  • Jest — Unit Testing aur Snapshot Testing setup.
  • Playwright — E2E testing setup.
  • Vitest — Unit Testing setup.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Un tools ke saath async Server Components ko unit-test karne ki koshish karna jo unhe support nahi karte — unke liye E2E prefer karo.
  • Test types ko confuse karna (unit vs component vs integration vs E2E vs snapshot) — har ek alag sawaal ka jawaab deta hai.

interview points

  • Paanch test types aur har ek kya cover karta hai; kaun sa tool kis type se map hota hai (Cypress: E2E + component; Jest: unit + snapshot; Playwright: E2E; Vitest: unit).
  • Kyun async Server Components ke liye unit testing ke bajaye E2E recommend kiya jata hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/testing

How to set up Cypress with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to set up Cypress with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to set up Cypress with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Quickstart, Manual setup, Creating your first Cypress E2E test, Testing routes preserved by Cache Components, Running E2E tests, Creating your first Cypress component test. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Cypress ek testing runner hai jiska upyog End-to-End (E2E) aur Component Testing ke liye kiya jata hai.
  • warning: 13.6.3 ke neeche Cypress sanskaran TypeScript 5 ko moduleResolution: "bundler" ke saath support nahi karte hain - Cypress 13.6.3+ mein tay kiya gaya.

Quickstart

  • with-cypress udaharan ke saath create-next-app ka upyog karein:
bash
npx create-next-app@latest --example with-cypress with-cypress-app

manual setup

  • cypress ko dev dependency (pnpm add -D cypress) ke roop mein installed karein, package.json ko khulee script jorein:
json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "eslint",
    "cypress:open": "cypress open"
  }
}
  • pahli bar (pnpm cypress:open) ke liye Run Cypress test suite kholne ke liye; E2E testing and/or Component Testing E ka chayan karein - ek vikalp auto-creates cypress.config.js aur ek cypress folder ka chayan karna.

apna pahla Cypress E2E test banana

  • sunishchit karein ki cypress.config mein E2E config hai:
ts
// cypress.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from 'cypress'

export default defineConfig({
  e2e: {
    setupNodeEvents(on, config) {},
  },
})
  • udaharan page: hom (app/page.js <Link href="/about"> ke saath) aur ke bare mein (app/about/page.js ek link back hom ke saath). test navigation:
js
// cypress/e2e/app.cy.js
describe('Navigation', () => {
  it('should navigate to the about page', () => {
    // Start from the index page
    cy.visit('http://localhost:3000/')

    // Find a link with an href attribute containing "about" and click it
    cy.get('a[href*="about"]').click()

    // The new url should include "/about"
    cy.url().should('include', '/about')

    // The new page should contain an h1 with "About"
    cy.get('h1').filter(':visible').contains('About')
  })
})
  • Testing route Cache Components dwara preserve: Cache Components ke saath , previous page client-side navigation ke baad DOM mein chhipa rahe hain, isliye cy.get() abhi bhi un elements se mel khaa sakta hai. unki count par negotiation karne ya dava karne se pahle sankirn maichon ke liye .filter(':visible') ka upyog karein (testing preserve UI dekhein).
  • Running E2E testing: Cypress app ko navigate karne wale user ko anukaran karta hai, isliye Next.js server ko chalana chahiye. actual behavior ke saman production code ke khilaf testing chalaein: npm run build && npm run start, phir ek any tarminal mein npm run cypress:open.
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: baseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000' ko cypress.config.js mein jorakar full URL ke bajaay cy.visit("/") ka upyog karein. ya Cypress ke saath production server chalane ke liye start-server-and-test installed karein: "test": "start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 cypress" ko package.json script mein jorein. parivartan ke baad punarnirman karna yaad rakhein.

apna pahla Cypress component testing banana

  • component testing pure app ko bundle kiye bina ya server shuru kiye bina ek vishisht component ka build aur mount karte hain. Cypress app mein Component Testing ka chayan karein, phir front-eind phremavark ke roop mein Next.js E - ek cypress/component folder banaya gaya hai aur Component Testing ke liye update cypress.config.js:
ts
// cypress.config.ts
import { defineConfig } from 'cypress'

export default defineConfig({
  component: {
    devServer: {
      framework: 'next',
      bundler: 'webpack',
    },
  },
})
  • udaharan testing:
tsx
// cypress/component/about.cy.tsx
import Page from '../../app/page'

describe('<Page />', () => {
  it('should render and display expected content', () => {
    // Mount the React component for the Home page
    cy.mount(<Page />)

    // The new page should contain an h1 with "Home"
    cy.get('h1').contains('Home')

    // Validate that a link with the expected URL is present
    // Following the link is better suited to an E2E test
    cy.get('a[href="/about"]').should('be.visible')
  })
})
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: vartaman mein Cypress Component Testing ko async Server Components ke liye support nahi karta hai - iske bajaay E2E testing ka upyog karein. chunki component parikshanon ko Next.js server ki requirement nahi hai, isliye <Image /> jaisi suvidhaein jo server par bharosa karti hain, box se bahar nahi ho sakti hain.
  • npm run cypress:open ke saath bhaago.

satat ekikaran (CI)

  • Run Cypress hedleeyar cypress run ke saath, CI ke liye behatar favorable:
json
{
  "scripts": {
    "e2e": "start-server-and-test dev http://localhost:3000 \"cypress open --e2e\"",
    "e2e:headless": "start-server-and-test dev http://localhost:3000 \"cypress run --e2e\"",
    "component": "cypress open --component",
    "component:headless": "cypress run --component"
  }
}
  • sansadhan: Next.js Cypress udaharan ke saath, Cypress CI docs, Cypress GitHub action guide, official Cypress GitHub action, Cypress Discord.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Cypress < 13.6.3 + TS 5 + moduleResolution: "bundler" toot gaya hai - Cypress upgrade karein.
  • server ke bina E2E testing chal raha hai, ya production build ke bajaay next dev ke khilaapha.
  • With Cache Components, chhipe hue preserve page abhi bhi cy.get() se mel khaate hain - :visible se filtar karein.
  • Component Testing async Server Components - supported nahi; E2E ka upyog karein.
  • component parikshanon mein <Image /> server ke bina kaam nahi kar sakta hai.

interview points

  • Cypress ke do mode (E2E banam Component Testing) aur unke setup (cypress.config e2e banam component.devServer.framework: 'next').
  • cy.visit / cy.get / cy.url().should flow; baseUrl; start-server-and-test CI ke liye.
  • Cache Components preserve-UI testing milaachaa (.filter(':visible')).
  • CI ke liye hedles cypress run; boundaries (async Server Components, component parikshanon mein server-nirbhar features).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/testing/cypress

How to set up Jest with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to set up Jest with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to set up Jest with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Quickstart, Manual setup, Optional: handling absolute imports and module path aliases, Optional: extend Jest with custom matchers, Add a test script to `package.json`, Creating your first test. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • jest aur React Testing Library aksar Unit Testing aur Snapshot Testing E ke liye ek saath upyog kiya jata hai.
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: chunki async Server Components naye hain, isliye vartaman mein Jest unhein support nahi data hai. aap abhi bhi sinkronas server aur Client Components ke liye unit testing chala sakte hain, lekin async components ke liye E2E testing ka upyog kar sakte hain.

Quickstart

  • with-jest udaharan ke saath create-next-app ka upyog karein:
bash
npx create-next-app@latest --example with-jest with-jest-app

manual setup

  • chunki Next.js 12, Next.js ne jest ke liye built-in config banaya hai. jest installed karein aur package dev dependency ke roop mein:
bash
pnpm add -D jest jest-environment-jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom @testing-library/jest-dom ts-node @types/jest
  • pnpm create jest@latest chalane ke dwara ek buniyadi Jest config generated karein (prompts jest.config.ts|js banate hain).
  • next/jest ka upyog karne ke liye configuration ko update karein - is transformer mein Jest ke liye Next.js ke saath kaam karne ke liye sabhi required config hain:
ts
// jest.config.ts
import type { Config } from 'jest'
import nextJest from 'next/jest.js'

const createJestConfig = nextJest({
  // Provide the path to your Next.js app to load next.config.js and .env files in your test environment
  dir: './',
})

// Add any custom config to be passed to Jest
const config: Config = {
  coverageProvider: 'v8',
  testEnvironment: 'jsdom',
  // Add more setup options before each test is run
  // setupFilesAfterEnv: ['<rootDir>/jest.setup.ts'],
}

// createJestConfig is exported this way to ensure that next/jest can load the Next.js config which is async
export default createJestConfig(config)
  • hud ke tahat, next/jest automatic roop se Jest ko configure karta hai: transform ko Next.js Compiler ka upyog karke installed karna; auto-moking stylesheet (.css, .module.css, SCs variant), image import aur next/font; .env (aur sabhi variant) ko process.env mein load karna; testing resolving/transforms se node_modules ko andekha karna; testing hal karne se .next ko andekha karna; SWC ko enable karne wale jhande ke liye next.config.js load karna.
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: seedhe env vars testing karne ke liye, unhein manual roop se ek alag setup script mein ya jest.config.ts mein load karein (Env vars guide mein Test Environment Variables dekhein).

optional: nirpeksh import aur module path aliases ko sambhalne

  • yadi project module path aliases ka upyog karti hai, to tsconfig.json/jsconfig.json mein moduleNameMapper ke saath moduleNameMapper mein paths vikalp se match karke import ko hal karne ke liye Jest ko configure karein: jest.config.js
json
// tsconfig.json or jsconfig.json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "baseUrl": "./",
    "paths": {
      "@/components/*": ["components/*"]
    }
  }
}
js
// jest.config.js
moduleNameMapper: {
  // ...
  '^@/components/(.*)$': '<rootDir>/components/$1',
}

optional: custom maichars ke saath jest ka vistar

  • @testing-library/jest-dom mein suvidhajanak custom maichars (e.g) shamil hain. .toBeInTheDocument()) unhein Jest config mein setupFilesAfterEnv: ['<rootDir>/jest.setup.ts'] ke madhyam se har testing ke liye import karein, phir jest.setup mein:
ts
// jest.setup.ts
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: extend-expect ko v6.0 mein hata diya gaya tha - yadi V6 se pahle @testing-library/jest-dom ka upyog kiya jata hai, to iske bajaay @testing-library/jest-dom/extend-expect import karein. zaroorat ke hisaab se jest.setup mein adhik setup vikalp jorein.

package.json mein ek testing script jorein

json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "test": "jest",
    "test:watch": "jest --watch"
  }
}
  • jab ek file mein parivartan hota hai to jest --watch phir se run testing karta hai.

apna pahla testing banana

  • projekt root mein ek __tests__ folder banaein. udaharan - check ek shirshak render karta hai: <Page />
jsx
// __tests__/page.test.jsx
import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import Page from '../app/page'

describe('Page', () => {
  it('renders a heading', () => {
    render(<Page />)

    const heading = screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })

    expect(heading).toBeInTheDocument()
  })
})
  • optional roop se, apratyashit parivartanon ko track karne ke liye ek snapshot test jorein:
jsx
// __tests__/snapshot.js
import { render } from '@testing-library/react'
import Page from '../app/page'

it('renders homepage unchanged', () => {
  const { container } = render(<Page />)
  expect(container).toMatchSnapshot()
})

apne testing chalana

  • pnpm test (or npm run test / yarn test / bun run test).

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Jest async Server Components ka support nahi karta hai - un logon ke liye E2E ka upyog karein; ikai testing keval tulyakalik Server/Client component ke liye.
  • @/ path aliases ka upyog karte samay moduleNameMapper ko bhool jana - import testing mein hal nahi hoga.
  • purane @testing-library/jest-dom/extend-expect ka upyog jest-dom v6+ ke saath import - seedhe @testing-library/jest-dom import karein.
  • ek setup script ke bina direct testing ke liye load kiye jaane wale env vars ki ummid - next/jest process.env mein .env load karta hai, lekin direct env-var testing manual loading ki zaroorat hai.

interview points

  • next/jest (Next.js 12 ke baad se built-in): yeh auto config kya hai (SWC badalna, style/image/font moking, .env load ho raha hai, node_modules/.next ne upekshaa ki, next.config.js jhande).
  • manak Jest setup: sankul, jest.config.ts (coverageProvider: 'v8', testEnvironment: 'jsdom'), setupFilesAfterEnv + jest.setup.ts ke liye jest-dom matchers, __tests__ folder, render/screen.getByRole + .toBeInTheDocument(), .toMatchSnapshot().
  • @/ ke liye tsconfig paths ko pratibinbit karne wala tsconfig paths. moduleNameMapper
  • jest ki boundary async Server Components aur E2E sifarish ke saath hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/testing/jest

How to set up Playwright with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to set up Playwright with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to set up Playwright with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Quickstart, Manual setup, Creating your first Playwright E2E test, Testing instant navigations, Testing routes preserved by Cache Components, Running your Playwright tests. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Playwright ek testing dhancha hai jo ek single API E ke saath Chromium, Firefox aur WebKit ko automatic karta hai. End-to-End (E2E) testing likhne ke liye upyog kiya jata hai.

Quickstart

  • with-playwright udaharan ke saath create-next-app ka upyog karein:
bash
npx create-next-app@latest --example with-playwright with-playwright-app

manual setup

  • Install Playwright (intrektiv instolar prompts ke madhyam se chalta hai, jismein playwright.config.ts shamil hain):
bash
npm init playwright

(pnpm: pnpm create playwright; yarn/bun samtulya.) step-by-step ke liye Playwright instoleshan guide dekhein.

apna pahla Playwright E2E testing banana

  • udaharan page: hom (app/page.tsx <Link href="/about"> ke saath) aur ke bare mein (app/about/page.tsx ek link back hom ke saath). test navigation:
ts
// tests/example.spec.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

test('should navigate to the about page', async ({ page }) => {
  // Start from the index page (the baseURL is set via the webServer in the playwright.config.ts)
  await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/')
  // Find an element with the text 'About' and click on it
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'About' }).click()
  // The new URL should be "/about" (baseURL is used there)
  await expect(page).toHaveURL('http://localhost:3000/about')
  // The new page should contain an h1 with "About"
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toContainText('About')
})
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: "baseURL": "http://localhost:3000" ko playwright.config.ts mein jorakar full URL ke bajaay page.goto("/") ka upyog karein.
  • Testing tatkal navigation: Cache Components ke saath , @next/playwright se instant() helper aapko ek navigation ke turant baad kya dikhai data hai, isse pahle ki kisi bhi dynamic content dhara (insteint navigation guide aur instant API sandarbh dekhein).
  • Testing route Cache Components dwara preserve: previous page client-side navigation ke baad DOM mein chhipa rahe hain; testing loketar drishyaman aur chhipe hue routes donon mein elements se mel khaa sakte hain - drishyta-avkaash loketron ka upyog karte hain (dekhein testing preserve UI).

apne Playwright testing chal raha hai

  • Playwright ek user ko teen browsers (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) ka upyog karke app ko navigate karne ka anukaran karta hai, isliye Next.js server chal raha hai. production code ke khilaf testing karein: npm run build + npm run start, phir ek any tarminal mein npx playwright test.
  • achha janne ke liye: Playwright dev server shuru karne aur puri tarah se upalabdh hone tak wait karne ke liye webServer feature ka upyog karein.
  • CI: Playwright default roop se hedles mode mein chalta hai. npx playwright install-deps ke saath sabhi Playwright dependencies installed karein. sansadhan: Playwright udaharan ke saath Next.js, apne CI provider, Playwright Discord par Playwright.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • server ke bina ya production build ke bajaay next dev ke khilaf testing chal raha hai.
  • With Cache Components, chhipe hue preserve pages se mel khane wale loketar - drishyta-jaagrook loketron ka upyog karte hain.
  • har jagah baseURL aur hard coding http://localhost:3000 ko bhool jana.

interview points

  • Playwright ke teen-browser single API (Chromium/Firefox/WebKit) E2E ke liye; npm init playwright (playwright.config.ts, webServer, baseURL) ke madhyam se setup; test/expect + page.getByRole loketar style; npx playwright test; CI hedles mode + npx playwright install-deps.
  • Cache Components testing extra: tatkal navigation ke liye @next/playwright instant() helper, preserve routes ke liye drishyta-avkaash loketara.
  • Playwright banam Cypress: donon E2E, Playwright ek API aur ek webServer feature ke saath teen browsers ko cover karta hai; Cypress bhi component testing pradan karta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/testing/playwright
Hissa 91 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to set up Vitest with Next.js

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to set up Vitest with Next.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to set up Vitest with Next.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Quickstart, Manual setup, Creating your first Vitest unit test, Running your tests. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • vitest aur React Testing Library aksar Unit Testing ke liye ek saath upyog kiya jata hai.
  • achha janne ke liye: chunki async Server Components naye hain, isliye vartaman mein unka support nahi karta hai. aap abhi bhi sinkronas server aur Client Components ke liye unit testing chala sakte hain, lekin async components ke liye E2E testing ka upyog kar sakte hain.

Quickstart

  • with-vitest udaharan ke saath create-next-app ka upyog karein:
bash
npx create-next-app@latest --example with-vitest with-vitest-app

manual setup

  • vitest installed karein aur package dev dependency ke roop mein:
bash
# Using TypeScript
npm install -D vitest @vitejs/plugin-react jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom vite-tsconfig-paths
# Using JavaScript
npm install -D vitest @vitejs/plugin-react jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom
  • project root mein ek vitest.config.mts|js file banaein:
ts
// vitest.config.mts
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import tsconfigPaths from 'vite-tsconfig-paths'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [tsconfigPaths(), react()],
  test: {
    environment: 'jsdom',
  },
})

(JavaScript sanskaran: vitest.config.js keval react() plugin ke sath.) adhik vikalpon ke liye Vitest Configuration dok dekhein.

  • package.json mein ek test script jorein:
json
{
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "test": "vitest"
  }
}
  • jab aap npm run test chalate hain, to default roop se parivartan ke liye vitest watches.

apna pahla vitest unit test banana

  • check <Page /> ek shirshak pradan karta hai:
tsx
// __tests__/page.test.tsx
import { expect, test } from 'vitest'
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'
import Page from '../app/page'

test('Page', () => {
  render(<Page />)
  expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1, name: 'Home' })).toBeDefined()
})
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: udaharan common __tests__ convention ka upyog karta hai, lekin testing files ko app router ke andar bhi moved kiya jaa sakta hai.

apne testing chalana

  • pnpm test (or npm run test / yarn test / bun run test).

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • vitest async Server Components ka support nahi karta hai - un logon ke liye E2E ka upyog karein; keval tulyakalik Server/Client components ke liye ikai testing.
  • TS pariyojnaon mein vite-tsconfig-paths ko phorget karna - @/ path ke aaliyaas ko hal nahi kiya jayega.
  • Forgetting environment: 'jsdom' — component parikshanon ko DOM environment ki requirement hoti hai.
  • default roop se vitest ghariyon (npm run test chal raha rahta hai); ek single CI paas ke liye vitest run ka upyog karein.

interview points

  • vitest setup: package (vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react, jsdom, Testing Library, vite-tsconfig-paths, vitest.config.mts, vitest.config.mts (plugins: [tsconfigPaths(), react()], test.environment: 'jsdom'), "test": "vitest", __tests__ convention banam colocated testing.
  • vitest banam jest: donon unit-testing Testing Library ke saath; vitest vit-aadharit (fast, default, vit plugin config) hai jabki jest next/jest (SWC morph, auto-moking) ka upyog karta hai. donon ki kami async Server Component support - E2E vahan sifarish hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/testing/vitest

How to optimize third-party libraries

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to optimize third-party libraries. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to optimize third-party libraries — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Google third-parties (from `@next/third-parties/google`), Google Tag Manager, Sending events, Server-side tagging, Options, Google Analytics. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • @next/third-parties ek library hai jo components aur utilities deti hai, jinse popular third-party libraries ko Next.js app me load karne ka performance aur developer experience behtar hota hai. Saare integrations performance aur ease of use ke liye optimized hain.
  • Install:
bash
npm install @next/third-parties@latest next@latest
  • @next/third-parties abhi ek experimental library hai jo active development me hai — latest ya canary flag ke saath install karo, jabki aur integrations jude ja rahe hain.

Google third-parties (@next/third-parties/google se)

Google Tag Manager

  • GoogleTagManager component ek GTM container instantiate karta hai. Default roop se, ye original inline script ko page par hydration ke baad fetch karta hai.
  • Saare routes ke liye, ise apni GTM container ID ke saath root layout me shamil karo:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { GoogleTagManager } from '@next/third-parties/google'

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <GoogleTagManager gtmId="GTM-XYZ" />
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}
  • Ek hi route ke liye, ise page file me shamil karo.
  • Events bhejna: sendGTMEvent dataLayer object ke through user interactions ko track karta hai; <GoogleTagManager /> component kisi parent layout, page, component ya usi file me shamil hona chahiye:
jsx
// app/page.js
'use client'

import { sendGTMEvent } from '@next/third-parties/google'

export function EventButton() {
  return (
    <div>
      <button
        onClick={() => sendGTMEvent({ event: 'buttonClicked', value: 'xyz' })}
      >
        Send Event
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
  • Server-side tagging: agar tum server-side tag manager use kar rahe ho jo tumhare tagging server se gtm.js serve karta hai, to gtmScriptUrl option use karo.
  • Options: gtmId (required*, aam taur par GTM- se shuru hota hai), gtmScriptUrl (optional*, default https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js), dataLayer (optional), dataLayerName (optional, default dataLayer), auth (optional, environment snippets ke liye gtm_auth), preview (optional, gtm_preview). *gtmId tab chhoda ja sakta hai jab gtmScriptUrl diya gaya ho (advertisers ke liye Google tag gateway).

Google Analytics

  • GoogleAnalytics component Google tag (gtag.js) ke through Google Analytics 4 shamil karta hai. Default roop se, ye original scripts ko hydration ke baad fetch karta hai.
  • Sifarish: agar Google Tag Manager pehle se shamil hai, to Google Analytics ko alag component ki jagah usi ke through configure karo.
  • Saare routes ke liye, ise apni measurement ID ke saath root layout me shamil karo:
tsx
// app/layout.tsx
import { GoogleAnalytics } from '@next/third-parties/google'

export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>{children}</body>
      <GoogleAnalytics gaId="G-XYZ" />
    </html>
  )
}
  • Ek hi route ke liye, ise page file me shamil karo.
  • Events bhejna: sendGAEvent dataLayer ke through interactions measure karta hai; <GoogleAnalytics /> component kisi parent layout, page, component ya usi file me shamil hona chahiye:
jsx
// app/page.js
'use client'

import { sendGAEvent } from '@next/third-parties/google'

export function EventButton() {
  return (
    <div>
      <button
        onClick={() => sendGAEvent('event', 'buttonClicked', { value: 'xyz' })}
      >
        Send Event
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
  • Pageviews track karna: jab browser history state badalti hai to GA automatically pageviews track karta hai — Next.js routes ke beech client-side navigations bina kisi configuration ke pageview data bhejte hain. Verify karo ki Admin me "Enhanced Measurement" enabled hai aur "Page changes based on browser history events" checkbox selected hai. Note: agar tum manually pageview events bhejte ho, to duplicates se bachne ke liye default pageview measurement disable kar do.
  • Options: gaId (required, aam taur par G- se shuru hota hai), dataLayerName (optional, default dataLayer), debugMode (optional), nonce (optional, CSP nonce).

Google Maps Embed

  • GoogleMapsEmbed ek Google Maps Embed jodta hai; default roop se ye loading attribute use karke embed ko fold ke neeche lazy-load karta hai:
jsx
// app/page.js
import { GoogleMapsEmbed } from '@next/third-parties/google'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <GoogleMapsEmbed
      apiKey="XYZ"
      height={200}
      width="100%"
      mode="place"
      q="Brooklyn+Bridge,New+York,NY"
    />
  )
}
  • Options: apiKey (required), mode (required — map mode), height/width (optional, default auto), style (optional), allowfullscreen (optional), loading (optional, default lazy — agar embed fold ke upar hai to badlo), q (optional — map marker location; mode ke hisaab se required ho sakta hai), center, zoom, maptype, language, region (optional).

YouTube Embed

  • YouTubeEmbed ek YouTube embed load/display karta hai, aur andar se lite-youtube-embed use karke tez load hota hai:
jsx
// app/page.js
import { YouTubeEmbed } from '@next/third-parties/google'

export default function Page() {
  return <YouTubeEmbed videoid="ogfYd705cRs" height={400} params="controls=0" />
}
  • Options: videoid (required), width/height (optional, default auto), playlabel (optional — play button ke liye visually hidden label, accessibility), params (optional — player params query string ke roop me, jaise params="controls=0&start=10&end=30"), style (optional).

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • sendGTMEvent/sendGAEvent bina corresponding component kahin mounted kiye use karna — events kahin nahi jate.
  • GTM aur alag GA component dono shamil karna, jab GTM akela hi GA configure kar sakta tha.
  • Default pageview measurement disable kiye bina manually pageviews bhejna — duplicate data.
  • GoogleMapsEmbed ko fold ke upar default lazy loading ke saath rakhna — loading ko sahi set karo.
  • @next/third-parties ko stable samajhna — ye experimental hai; latest/canary ke saath install karo.

Interview Points

  • @next/third-parties kya hai (popular third-party libs ke liye performance-optimized components, experimental) aur iske Google integrations (GoogleTagManager/sendGTMEvent, GoogleAnalytics/sendGAEvent, GoogleMapsEmbed, YouTubeEmbed — lite-youtube-embed ke through).
  • GTM vs GA (gtag.js) choice — jab GTM maujud ho to GA ko GTM ke through configure karna behtar; pageview tracking history-state changes + Enhanced Measurement se hoti hai.
  • Key options: gtmId/gtmScriptUrl (server-side tagging, tag gateway), gaId, dataLayerName, debugMode, nonce; Maps ke mode/q/loading; YouTube ke videoid/params.
  • Scripts default roop se hydration ke baad load hote hain (performance); Maps default roop se lazy-load hota hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/third-party-libraries
