Hissa 94 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Upgrade with a Coding Agent

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Upgrade with a Coding Agent. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Upgrade with a Coding Agent — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Experimental feature, Start an upgrade, Choose a policy, Adopt future defaults, What the command does, Choose how to run the agent. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Experimental feature (production ke liye recommended nahi; GitHub ke madhyam se pratikriya). ek coding agent upgrade karne aur apne app ko verify karne ke liye next upgrade --agent ka upyog karein. order configure ki gai niti se target sanskaran ko set karta hai, prasangik migration guide aur kaushal taiyar karta hai, aur agent ko karya karta hai. App Router aur Pages Router pariyojnaon ka support karta hai. --agent ke bina, next upgrade iske bajaay interactive codemod varkaflo chalata hai.

upgrade shuru karein

bash
npx next@canary upgrade --agent=latest
  • ek workspace root se, app directory ko paas karein: npx next@canary upgrade apps/web --agent=latest.
  • next@canary ka upyog karke latest upgrade tooling chalata hai, yahan tak ki jab app purane Next.js sanskaran ka upyog karta hai. CLI installed sanskaran padhta hai aur keval ek canary target ka chayan karta hai jab app pahle se hi canary sanskaran ka upyog karta hai. yadi package mainejar minimum release ki umr set karta hai, to CLI us latest canary ka upyog karta hai jo policy ki permission data hai.

ek niti chunein

PolicyBehavior
securityek affected static sanskaran ke liye, sabse pahle yogy pramukh mein latest surakshit release ka chayan karta hai.
lateststatic, RC, bita, aur preview kshudhaa ko npm ke latest static release, ya canary release ke liye ek canary app mein le jata hai.
experimental-futurelatest niti lagu hoti hai, phir lagu Future Defaults ko god leti hai.
  • experimental.agentUpgrade se string maan ka upyog karne ki niti ko chhor dein; anyatha order security: npx next@canary upgrade --agent ka upyog karta hai. --agent ko --revision ke saath joda nahi jaa sakta hai. security static organizations ka support karta hai; canary instoleshan latest ya experimental-future ka upyog kar sakta hai; RC/beta/preview ek naye static release par jaane ke liye latest ka upyog kar sakta hai. any previous chainlon ka support nahi kiya jata hai.
  • Adopt bhavishy default: Future Defaults default (e.g) dwara enable karne ke liye Next.js yojna hai. Cache Components, Partial Prefetching). experimental-future niti is baat ka ek initial sanskaran hai ki kaise upgrade app unhein apnane mein madad karta hai, yahan tak ki jab app pahle se hi latest Next.js sanskaran ka upyog karta hai - ek naye default mein jaane se alag migration ke bajaay upgrade ka hissa ban jata hai. App Router pariyojnaon ke liye Next.js 16.3+, yeh niti vartaman mein Cache Components guide aur dattak kaushal: npx next@canary upgrade --agent=experimental-future taiyar karti hai. Pages Router projects ise sanskaran upgrade ke liye istemal kar sakti hain, lekin yeh Cache Components ki peshakash nahi karta hai jab tak ki project App Router ka upyog nahi karti hai. aaj nai features ko apnane ke liye, apni god lene ki kaushal ka seedhe upyog karein (Cache Components, Adopting Partial Prefetching).

kya order karta hai

  • ek agent session shuru karne se pahle, CLI ne installed sanskaran ki check ki, metadata jari kiya aur chaynit niti dwara required kisi bhi security data ki check ki. yeh ek spashteekaran ke saath ruk jata hai jab koi upgrade ki requirement nahi hoti hai ya yeh target installed nahi kar sakta hai.
  • ek taiyar upgrade ke liye, CLI ek asthayi directory mein prasangik migration guide ki pratilipi banata hai, lagu kaushal taiyar karta hai, aur chaynit target ke liye ek karya banata hai. ek pramukh upgrade ke liye, karya mein every pramukh sanskaran crossed ke liye guide shamil hai. yeh agent ko dupliket kaam ki check karne ke liye bhi puchhta hai, jab upalabdh ho to ek alag git varkatree ka upyog karein, prasangik check chalaein aur parinam ko verify karein.
  • yeh karya agent ko bhavishy ke upgrade reminder ke liye next.config mein experimental.agentUpgrade ke roop mein chaynit niti ko bachane ke liye bhi kahta hai. reminder ko inactive karne ke liye, false ko vikalp set karein.
  • jab ek coding agent ke andar chala jata hai, to CLI vartaman agent ka palan karne ka karya print karta hai. ek interactive tarminal mein, yeh ek installed kodeks ya Claude Code session shuru kar sakta hai, ya kisi any agent ke liye karya ki pratilipi bana sakta hai. ek non-interactive tarminal mein yeh karya print karta hai.

agent ko chalane ke liye kaise chunein

  • ek interactive tarminal mein, yeh puchhta hai ki kis agent ka upyog karne ke liye kiya gaya hai. ek naye agent session ke liye, aap apne modal, tark prayas ka bhi chayan kar sakte hain, chahe auto anumtiyon ka upyog kiya jaaye, aur kya ek alag git varkatree ka upyog kiya jaaye - vikalp chaynit agent aur CLI sanskaran par nirbhar karte hain. udaharan sanket: "kodeks ke saath jari rakhein / Claude Code ke saath jari rakhein / kisi any coding agent / radd karne ke liye copy prompt; modal vikalp (e.g). Terra/Sol; tark prayas (low/medium/high/xhigh/max/ultra); auto permission mode (Yes / No, anumodan ke liye puchhte hain); alag git varkatree (Yes/No).
  • jab ek maujuda coding agent se chala jata hai, to yeh us agent ko iske bajaay taiyar karya pradan karta hai; agent apne pahle se hi configure kiye gaye modal, tark prayas aur permission rakhta hai.

upgrade reminder ko configure karein

  • upgrade reminder security niti ke saath default roop se enable hain. kisi any policy ya disabled reminder chunne ke liye experimental.agentUpgrade set karein:
ts
// next.config.ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    agentUpgrade: 'latest',
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • reminder ko disabled karne ke liye false ko vikalp set karein. vikalp not automatic roop se app ko upgrade karta hai. ek interactive tarminal mein, next dev ya next build jari rahta hai jabki reminder khula hai aur iske production ko baphar karta hai. Upgrade now upgrade shuru karne se pahle order band ho jata hai. Skip chal rahe command par lauta hai aur us output ko phir se chalata hai. agle sanskaran tak Skip ne installed sanskaran ke liye reminder ko kharij kar diya.
  • jab ek coding agent ek reminder ka samna karta hai, to yeh upalabdh upgrade ki report karta hai aur order ko phir prapt karne ke baad mool karya jari rakh sakta hai.
  • next dev ke dauraan, Next.js DevTools ek Vulnerability Insight bhi dikha sakta hai jab installed sanskaran ek known security bhedytaa se affected hota hai - yeh ek coding agent ke saath security upgrade shuru karne ke liye ek copy karne yogy sanket pradan karta hai.
  • CLI ko metadata jari karne aur static target, security advisor data ke liye access ki requirement hoti hai. yadi yeh target installed nahi kar sakta hai, to yeh ek agent session shuru kiye bina karan ki report karta hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • --agent ko --revision ke saath joda nahi jaa sakta hai.
  • yeh feature experimental hai - production workflow mein is par bharosa nahi karta hai.
  • experimental-future keval 16.3+ par App Router pariyojnaon ke liye Cache Components pradan karta hai; Pages Router pariyojnaon ko keval sanskaran upgrade milta hai.
  • agentUpgrade vikalp keval reminders/policy ko configure karta hai - yeh automatic roop se upgrade nahi karta hai.

interview points

  • npx next@canary upgrade --agent=<policy> flow: target nirdharan, guide/Skill taiyaaree, Codex/Claude code (ya mudrit karya), Worktree + validation directive, experimental.agentUpgrade ko niti ki bachata.
  • teen policies (security, latest, experimental-future) aur pratyek support ki installation.
  • upgrade ke hisse ke roop mein Future Defaults god lene (Cache Components, Partial Prefetching).
  • Reminder behavior (Upgrade now / Skip / Skip until next version, false ko disabled karne ke liye) aur DevTools mein Vulnerability Insight.

Hissa 95 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Codemods

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Codemods. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Codemods — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage, Upgrade (meta-codemod), Options, Codemods by version, 16.3, `cache-components-instant-false`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Codemods aise parivartan hain jo aapke kodbes programmatic roop se chal rahe hain - manual roop se har file ke madhyam se jaane ke bina badi sankhya mein parivartan lagu hote hain. Next.js codemod parivartanon ko kodbes ko upgrade karne mein madad karta hai jab ek API ko update kiya jata hai ya dipreeket kiya jata hai.

Usage

bash
npx @next/codemod <transform> <path>
  • transform — morph ka naam; path — files ya directory badalane ke liye; --dry — shushk run, koi code edit nahi; --print — tulna ke liye badal output mudrit karein.

upgrade (meta-codemod)

  • application ko upgrade karta hai, automatic roop se codemods chal raha hai aur Next.js, React aur React DOM ko update karta hai. ek coding agent chalane ke liye, shesh migration karya ko pura karein aur app ko verify karein, iske bajaay npx next@canary upgrade --agent=latest chalaein (coding agent ke saath upgrade dekhein).
bash
npx @next/codemod upgrade [revision]
  • Options: revision (optional) - upgrade type (patch, minor, major), ek NPM distrikt tag (latest, canary, rc), ya ek satik sanskaran (e.g). 15.0.0; static sanskaranon ke liye minor ko difolta. --verbose - vistrit generation. --skip-react-upgrade — React deps/types/overrides ko preserve karta hai, React codemods ko chhor data hai. --skip-eslint-upgrade - eslint / eslint-config-next / @next/eslint-plugin-next ko preserve karta hai, next-lint-to-eslint-cli ko chhor data hai (full required lint migration manual roop se validation se pahle). -y, --yes - pratyek interactive prompt ko chhor dein aur default accept karein (React previous 18 mein upgrade karein, Turbopack ko enable karein, sabhi recommended codemods ko lagu karein, React 19 codemods chalaein); yeh bhi svath enable hai jab stdin ek TTY (CI, AI coding agent, non-interactive shell) nahi hai.
  • Examples:
bash
npx @next/codemod upgrade patch    # e.g. 16.0.7 -> 16.0.8
npx @next/codemod upgrade minor    # e.g. 15.3.7 -> 15.4.8 (default)
npx @next/codemod upgrade major    # e.g. 15.5.7 -> 16.0.7
npx @next/codemod upgrade 16       # specific version
npx @next/codemod upgrade canary
npx @next/codemod upgrade canary --yes  # from an agent or CI
  • yeh janne ke liye achha hai: yadi target sanskaran vartaman sanskaran ki tulna mein saman ya kam hai, to command bina parivartan ke bahar nikalta hai. chhorein jhande target ki sahakarmi dependency aavashyaktaon ko bypass nahi karte hain - yadi installation pahle fail ho gai hai, to dependency ki marammat aur prasangik flag ke saath ek hi satik target ko phir prapt karein; yadi Next.js pahle se hi target se match karta hai, to vyaktigat roop se chhore gaye migration chalaein. upgrade ke dauraan aapko yeh chunne ke liye prerit kiya jaa sakta hai ki Next.js codemods ko React 19 codemods ko lagu karne aur chalane ke liye React 19 codemods ko upgrade karne ke liye kaun se Next.js codemods ko lagu karne ke liye prerit kiya jayega. jab ek AI coding agent ya CI (stdin ek TTY nahi hai), to upgrade non-interactive roop se chalta hai aur har default ko accept karta hai; tarminal se ise majbur karne ke liye --yes ko paas karein.

sanskaran dwara Codemods

16.3

  • cache-components-instant-false — npx @next/codemod@canary cache-components-instant-false./app. application directory mein pratyek {page,layout,default} file mein export const instant = false jodta hai jo pahle se hi instant export nahi karta hai, isliye aap cacheComponents ko enable kar sakte hain aur phir route dwara opt-out route ko hata sakte hain. Client Components ("use client") ko chhor dein aur pahle se hi instant ko declare karne wali files ko chhor dein. generated @next-codemod-ignore comment compilation ko blocked kiye bina janboojhkar opt-out ko chihnit karti hai. yeh janne ke liye achha hai: ek src/ project mein ./src/app paas karein - asaphal hone ke bajaay ek galat path report 0 ok, isliye file computation ki check karein.
diff
+ // @next-codemod-ignore Cache Components adoption: this segment temporarily allows blocking.
+ // Remove this opt-out after verifying the segment passes validation without it.
+ // See: https://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/migrating-to-cache-components
+ export const instant = false
+
  export default function Page() {
    return <h1>Hello</h1>
  }
  • remove-partial-prefetch — npx @next/codemod@canary remove-partial-prefetch./app. {page,layout} files se export const prefetch = 'partial' ko hata data hai, isliye aap global star par partialPrefetching ko enable kar sakte hain aur prati root opt-ins ko chhor sakte hain. keval 'partial' maan ko hata data hai; any manon jaise prefetch = 'force-disabled' sthan par chhor data hai. saman ./src/app path guphaa.
diff
- export const prefetch = 'partial'

16.0

  • remove-experimental-ppr — npx @next/codemod@latest remove-experimental-ppr.. App Router pages/layouts (- export const experimental_ppr = true;) se experimental_ppr Route Segment Config ko hata data hai.
  • remove-unstable-prefix — npx @next/codemod@latest remove-unstable-prefix.. static API, e.g se unstable_ upasarg ko hata data hai. import { unstable_cacheTag as cacheTag } from 'next/cache' → import { cacheTag } from 'next/cache'.
  • middleware-to-proxy — npx @next/codemod@latest middleware-to-proxy.. Deprecated middleware se migraits ko proxy ka convention: middleware.<ext> → proxy.<ext> ka naam badalakar export middleware → proxy; config experimental.middlewarePrefetch → experimental.proxyPrefetch; experimental.middlewareClientMaxBodySize → experimental.proxyClientMaxBodySize; experimental.externalMiddlewareRewritesResolve → experimental.externalProxyRewritesResolve; skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize → skipProxyUrlNormalize. udaharan: export function middleware() in middleware.ts → export function proxy() in proxy.ts.
  • next-lint-to-eslint-cli — npx @next/codemod@canary next-lint-to-eslint-cli.. next lint se ESLint CLI tak migrate local ESLint config ke saath: eslint.config.mjs (Next.js) ko FlatCompat ke madhyam se configure karne ki recommended, next/core-web-vitals + next/typescript ko vistarit karta hai, node_modules/**, .next/**, out/**, build/**, next-env.d.ts ko andekha karta hai; package.json script ("lint": "next lint" → "lint": "eslint.") ko update karta hai; required ESLint dependency ko jodta hai; paya jaane par maujuda ESLint config ko preserve karta hai.

15.0

  • app-dir-runtime-config-experimental-edge (App Router vishisht) - npx @next/codemod@latest app-dir-runtime-config-experimental-edge.. Transforms root segment Config runtime maan experimental-edge → edge.
  • next-async-request-api — npx @next/codemod@latest next-async-request-api.. Migrates dynamic API (cookies(), headers(), draftMode() se next/headers) jo ab lagu hone wale React.use() ke saath wait ya lapeta jaane wala async hai. jab automatic: migration sanbhav nahi hai, to yeh ek @next-codemod-error comment jodta hai aur ek asthayi UnsafeUnwrapped* cast jor sakta hai - unhein hatane se pahle migration ko pura karein; yadi sujhav diya gaya parivartan lagu nahi hota hai, to @next-codemod-ignore ke saath directive ko replace karein aur kyon samjhaein. udaharan: module gunjaish → /* @next-codemod-error... */ (cookies() as unknown as UnsafeUnwrappedCookies).get('token') par const token = cookies().get('token'); ek hook ke andar → use(cookies()).get('token'); ek async page ke andar → (await cookies()).get('name'). params/searchParams ke liye page/layout/route/default entries ya generateMetadata/generateViewport mein props, yeh function async banata hai aur props (e.g) ka wait karta hai. params: { slug: string } → params: Promise<{ slug: string }> + const params = await props.params); yadi ise async (Client Component) nahi banaya jaa sakta hai, to yeh React.use ka upyog karta hai. yeh janne ke liye achha hai: comments purv set @next/codemod hain, taaipkaast UnsafeUnwrapped; build errors jab tak ki in tippniyon ko spasht roop se hata diya jata hai (sinkron-dynamic-apis sandesh dekhein).
  • next-request-geo-ip — npx @next/codemod@latest next-request-geo-ip.. @vercel/functions installed karta hai aur geo/ip gun NextRequest ko isi @vercel/functions features mein badal data hai: const { geo, ip } = req → const geo = geolocation(req); const ip = ipAddress(req) ke saath const geo = geolocation(req); const ip = ipAddress(req). import { geolocation, ipAddress } from '@vercel/functions'

14.0

  • next-og-import — npx @next/codemod@latest next-og-import.. ImageResponse ko next/server se next/og (Dynamic OG Image Generation) mein import karta hai.
  • metadata-to-viewport-export — npx @next/codemod@latest metadata-to-viewport-export.. Migrates viewport metadata ko viewport export: export const metadata = { title: 'My App', themeColor: 'dark', viewport: { width: 1 } } → export const metadata = { title: 'My App' } + export const viewport = { width: 1, themeColor: 'dark' }.

13.2

  • built-in-next-font — npx @next/codemod@latest built-in-next-font.. @next/font ki installation radd karein aur @next/font ko bilt-in next/font (e.g) mein badal data hai. import { Inter } from '@next/font/google' → from 'next/font/google').

13.0

  • next-image-to-legacy-image — surakshit roop se next/image import ka naam Next.js 10/11/12 kshudhaa mein next/legacy/image aur next/future/image se next/image mein badal diya gaya hai.
  • next-image-experimental - khatarnak roop se next/legacy/image se naye next/image mein inline styles ko jorakar aur apryukt props ko hata kar migrate karta hai: layout prop (adds style), objectFit (adds style), objectPosition (adds style), lazyBoundary, lazyRoot) ko hata data hai.
  • new-link — link components ke andar <a> tag ko hata data hai: <Link href="/about"><a>About</a></Link> → <Link href="/about">About</Link>; ek <a onClick> handler ko <Link> par le jata hai.

11

  • cra-to-next — npx @next/codemod cra-to-next. Migrates ek banana React application project Next.js karne ke liye, ek Pages Router banane aur behavior se match karne ke liye required vinyas. client-side-only rendering shuru mein SSR ke dauraan window ke upyog se breaking compatibility ko rokne ke liye lee jati hai, aur Next.js features ke kramik apnane ke liye aasani se enable kiya jaa sakta hai.

10

  • add-missing-react-import — lapta React import karta hai to naya React JSX karya ko badal data hai.

9

  • name-default-component (versions 9+) - agyat components ko Fast Refresh ke naam ke components mein badal data hai; naam oont-cased file naam se hai, aur yeh teer karyon ke saath kaam karta hai.

8

  • withamp-to-config - withAmp HOC ko Next.js 9 page config (export const config = { amp: true }) mein badal data hai. not: built-in AMP support aur is codemod ko Next.js 16. mein hata diya gaya tha.

6

  • url-to-withrouter — parivartit ho jata hai deprecated auto-injected url sanpatti top level ke pannon par withRouter aur iski injekted router sanpatti (url-deprecated sandesh dekhein). sabhi morph mamlon ka testing __testfixtures__ directory mein kiya jata hai.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • galat path (e.g) ke saath ek codemod chalana. ek src/ project mein ./app chupchap 0 ok ki report karta hai - hamesha file computation ki check karta hai.
  • Ignoring @next-codemod-error comments / UnsafeUnwrapped* casts from next-async-request-api — build errors jab tak ve spasht roop se removed/repaired. kar rahe hain
  • next-image-experimental ka andhaa upyog karna - yeh ek "khatarnak" migration hai (props ko hata data hai, inline styles ko jodta hai).
  • pratyek mamle ko sambhalne ke liye next-async-request-api ki ummid - kuchh sthanon ko manual hastakshep ki requirement hoti hai.
  • upgrade ka estimate kisi bhi target ko accept karta hai - yadi target ≤ vartaman sanskaran hai, to yeh parivartan ke bina bahar nikalta hai; flag chhorein sahakarmi dependency aavashyaktaon ko nahi chhorte hain.

interview points

  • kya codemods hain aur CLI (npx @next/codemod <transform> <path>, --dry, --print) hain.
  • upgrade Meta-codemod: sanshodhan vikalp (patch/minor default/major/tag/version), --skip-react-upgrade, --skip-eslint-upgrade, -y/--yes aur gair-TTY auto-behaviour.
  • key prati sanskaran badalta hai: 16.3 (cache-components-instant-false, remove-partial-prefetch), 16.0 (remove-experimental-ppr, remove-unstable-prefix, middleware-to-proxy, next-lint-to-eslint-cli), 15.0 (next-async-request-api + @next-codemod-error / UnsafeUnwrapped, next-request-geo-ip, app-dir-runtime-config-experimental-edge), 14.0 (next-og-import, metadata-to-viewport-export), 13.x (built-in font, image migration, new-link), 11 (cra-to-next)). name-default-component Fast Refresh

Hissa 96 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to upgrade to version 14

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to upgrade to version 14. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to upgrade to version 14 — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Upgrading from 13 to 14, v14 summary, Review migration checklist. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

13 se 14 tak upgrade karna

bash
npm i next@next-14 react@18 react-dom@18 && npm i eslint-config-next@next-14 -D

(yarn/pnpm/bun samtuly) janne ke liye achha hai: yadi TypeScript ka upyog kiya jata hai, to @types/react aur @types/react-dom ko unke latest sanskaranon mein upgrade kiya jata hai.

v14 summary

  • minimum Node.js sanskaran 16.14 se 18.17 (16.x ant ke jivan tak pahunch gaya) tak takkar lagee hai.
  • output: 'export' config ke paksh mein next export command removed (Static Exports dekhein).
  • ImageResponse ke liye next/server import ka naam next/og — codemod upalabdh (next-og-import) hai.
  • @next/font package puri tarah se built-in next/font ke paksh mein hata diya gaya hai - codemod upalabdh (built-in-next-font).
  • next-swc ke liye WASM target ko hata diya gaya.

migration cheklist

  • [] app Node.js 18.17+ aur sangat React 18 nirbhartaon aur prakaron ka upyog karta hai.
  • [] static export next export ke bajaay output: 'export' aur next build ka upyog karte hain.
  • [] ImageResponse import next/server ke bajaay next/og ka upyog karte hain.
  • [] font import @next/font ke bajaay next/font ka upyog karte hain.
  • [] app hataye gaye next-swc WASM target par nirbhar nahi hai.
  • [] app ki supported check aur affected runtime behavior paas.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • abhi bhi next export chal raha hai - v14 mein hata diya gaya; output: 'export' par svich karein.
  • Node 18.17 minimum ya @types/react/@types/react-dom upgrade ko bhool jana.
  • lephtovar @next/font ya next/server ImageResponse import - codemods ka upyog karein.

interview points

  • V14 breaking badlav: Node 18.17 minimum, next export hatane, ImageResponse → next/og, @next/font hatane → next/font, next-swc WASM target hatane — aur do codemod jo import namon ko automatic karte hain.

Hissa 97 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to upgrade to version 15

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to upgrade to version 15. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to upgrade to version 15 — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Upgrading from 14 to 15, React 19, Async Request APIs (breaking change), `cookies` — recommended async usage, Temporary sync usage (TS), `headers` — recommended. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

14 se 15 tak upgrade

  • upgrade codemod use karo: npx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest (pnpm: pnpm dlx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest; yarn/bun ke equivalents).
  • Ya manually latest versions install karo: npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest eslint-config-next@latest.
  • Jaan-na achha hai: peer-dependency warnings par react/react-dom ko suggested versions par update karo, ya warning ignore karne ke liye --force/--legacy-peer-deps use karo (Next.js 15 aur React 19 stable hone ke baad iski zaroorat nahi rehti).

React 19

  • react aur react-dom ke minimum versions ab 19 hain.
  • useFormState ko useActionState se replace kar diya gaya hai — useFormState React 19 me ab bhi maujud hai lekin deprecated hai aur hata diya jayega; useActionState ki sifarish hai, aur isme pending state ko seedhe padhne jaise extra properties hain.
  • useFormStatus me ab data, method aur action jaisi extra keys shamil hain (React 19 ke bina sirf pending available hai).
  • React 19 upgrade guide dekho. Jaan-na achha hai: @types/react aur @types/react-dom ko bhi upgrade karo.

Async Request APIs (breaking change)

  • Pehle synchronous request-time APIs ab async hain: cookies, headers, draftMode, params (layout.js, page.js, route.js, default.js, opengraph-image, twitter-image, icon, apple-icon me) aur searchParams (page.js me).
  • Ek codemod (next-async-request-api) migration ko automate karta hai, aur APIs ko temporarily synchronously bhi access kiya ja sakta hai.
  • cookies — sifarish kiya gaya async usage:
tsx
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

// Before
const cookieStore = cookies()
const token = cookieStore.get('token')

// After
const cookieStore = await cookies()
const token = cookieStore.get('token')
  • Temporary sync usage (TS): const cookieStore = cookies() as unknown as UnsafeUnwrappedCookies — dev me warning log hoti hai. (JS: plain cookies() bhi dev me warning deta hai.)
  • headers — recommended: const headersList = await headers(); temporary sync: headers() as unknown as UnsafeUnwrappedHeaders (dev warning).
  • draftMode — recommended: const { isEnabled } = await draftMode(); temporary sync: draftMode() as unknown as UnsafeUnwrappedDraftMode (dev warning).
  • params aur searchParams — async layout:
tsx
// Before
type Params = { slug: string }

export function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Params }) {
  const { slug } = params
}

export default async function Layout({ children, params }: { children: React.ReactNode; params: Params }) {
  const { slug } = params
}

// After
type Params = Promise<{ slug: string }>

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Params }) {
  const { slug } = await params
}

export default async function Layout({ children, params }: { children: React.ReactNode; params: Params }) {
  const { slug } = await params
}
  • Sync layout: React ke use ka use karo: type Params = Promise<{ slug: string }> ke saath const params = use(props.params).
  • Async page: type Params = Promise<{ slug: string }>; type SearchParams = Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }>; const params = await props.params; const searchParams = await props.searchParams — generateMetadata aur page dono me.
  • Sync page (Client Component): const params = use(props.params); const searchParams = use(props.searchParams).
  • Route Handlers: export async function GET(request: Request, segmentData: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) { const params = await segmentData.params; ... }.

runtime configuration (breaking change)

  • runtime segment config pehle edge ke alawa experimental-edge ko bhi support karta tha — dono ka matlab ek hi hai; v15 me experimental-edge use karne par error aata hai. Fix: edge par update karo. Codemod available hai (app-dir-runtime-config-experimental-edge).

fetch requests

  • fetch requests ab default roop se cache nahi hote. Khaas requests ko cache: 'force-cache' se opt in karo:
js
export default async function RootLayout() {
  const a = await fetch('https://...') // Not Cached
  const b = await fetch('https://...', { cache: 'force-cache' }) // Cached
}
  • Kisi layout/page ki saari fetch requests ko caching me opt in karne ke liye export const fetchCache = 'default-cache' (segment config) use karo; individual fetch ke cache options ise override karte hain:
js
// Since this is the root layout, all fetch requests in the app
// that don't set their own cache option will be cached.
export const fetchCache = 'default-cache'

Route Handlers

  • Route Handlers me GET functions ab default roop se cache nahi hote. Kisi route config option se opt in karo, jaise export const dynamic = 'force-static':
js
// app/api/route.js
export const dynamic = 'force-static'

export async function GET() {}

Client Cache

  • Jab <Link>/useRouter se navigate karte ho, to page segments ab Client Cache se reuse nahi hote — lekin browser back/forward navigation ke dauraan aur shared layouts ke liye ab bhi reuse hote hain. staleTimes config se page segments ko caching me opt in karo:
js
// next.config.js
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    staleTimes: {
      dynamic: 30,
      static: 180,
    },
  },
}

module.exports = nextConfig
  • Layouts aur loading states ab bhi cache hote hain aur navigation par reuse hote hain.

next/font

  • @next/font package ko built-in next/font ke haq me hata diya gaya — codemod available hai (built-in-next-font): import { Inter } from '@next/font/google' → from 'next/font/google'.

bundlePagesRouterDependencies

  • experimental.bundlePagesExternals ab stable hai aur iska naya naam bundlePagesRouterDependencies hai:
js
const nextConfig = {
  // Before
  experimental: { bundlePagesExternals: true },
  // After
  bundlePagesRouterDependencies: true,
}

serverExternalPackages

  • experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages ab stable hai aur iska naya naam serverExternalPackages hai:
js
const nextConfig = {
  // Before
  experimental: { serverComponentsExternalPackages: ['package-name'] },
  // After
  serverExternalPackages: ['package-name'],
}

Speed Insights

  • Speed Insights ke liye auto-instrumentation Next.js 15 me hata diya gaya. Ise use karte rehne ke liye Vercel Speed Insights Quickstart follow karo.

NextRequest Geolocation

  • NextRequest par geo aur ip properties hata di gayi hain (values hosting provider deta hai). Ek codemod (next-request-geo-ip) migration ko automate karta hai. Vercel par, iske bajaye @vercel/functions se geolocation aur ipAddress use karo:
ts
// middleware.ts
import { geolocation } from '@vercel/functions'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const { city } = geolocation(request)
  // ...
}
ts
import { ipAddress } from '@vercel/functions'

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const ip = ipAddress(request)
  // ...
}

Troubleshooting

  • React 19 par upgrade ke baad installation fail ho jaye to: agar kisi aur package ki peer deps React 19 ko reject karti hain, to react, react-dom, unke types aur react-is (agar maujud ho) ko pichhle versions par wapas le jao (basharte ki target Next.js version aur router unhe support karein); package.json/pnpm-workspace.yaml me upgrade se jude React type overrides/resolutions ko restore/remove karo; agar installation ne upgrade command ko beech me roka tha, to wahi exact target --skip-react-upgrade ke saath dobara try karo; agar Next.js pehle se target se match karta hai, to deps install karo aur skipped codemods alag-alag chalao; app ke checks chalao.
  • ESLint 9 par upgrade ke baad installation fail ho jaye to: pichhle compatible eslint/eslint-config-next/@next/eslint-plugin-next versions aur purani lint config restore karo; wahi target --skip-eslint-upgrade ke saath dobara try karo; agar Next.js pehle se match karta hai, to deps install karo aur skipped codemods alag-alag chalao; required lint migration manually poori karo, phir lint checks chalao.

Migration checklist — review karo

  • [ ] React deps aur types app ke router ke liye React 19 requirements poori karte hain.
  • [ ] Font imports @next/font ke bajaye next/font use karte hain.
  • [ ] bundlePagesExternals aur serverComponentsExternalPackages apne documented stable naam use karte hain, package config preserve karke.
  • [ ] NextRequest geo/ip use karne wale actual hosting provider ke liye sahi source use karte hain.
  • [ ] Automatic Speed Insights instrumentation par bharosa karne wale apps me, agar ab bhi zaroorat hai, to ek explicit integration hai.
  • [ ] App ke supported checks aur affected runtime behaviour pass hote hain.
  • [ ] Async Request API access (affected helpers/callers samet) migrate ho gaya hai — codemod ki error comments aur UnsafeUnwrapped casts ko resolve karo, unhe poori repair mat samjho.
  • [ ] Route segment runtime ab experimental-edge use nahi karta.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Ye maan lena ki fetch v15 me ab bhi default roop se cache hota hai — nahi hota; cache: 'force-cache' ya fetchCache = 'default-cache' use karo.
  • Ye maan lena ki Route Handler GET cached hain — nahi hain; dynamic = 'force-static' use karo.
  • Ye maan lena ki <Link> navigation par page segments Client Cache se reuse hote hain — nahi hote (back/forward aur shared layouts ko chhodkar); staleTimes use karo.
  • UnsafeUnwrapped* casts ko waise hi chhod dena — ye temporary hain, dev warnings log karte hain, aur codemod ki error comments resolve karni chahiye.
  • experimental-edge use karna — ab error hai; edge use karo.
  • Naye code me useFormState use karna — deprecated hai; useActionState use karo.

Interview Points

  • V15 ke headline breaking changes: React 19 minimum, async Request APIs (cookies/headers/draftMode/params/searchParams — async components me await, sync/Client Components me use(), UnsafeUnwrapped* temporary escape hatch), fetch ab default roop se cache nahi, Route Handler GET ab cache nahi, Client Cache page segments ab reuse nahi hote (staleTimes opt-in).
  • Renames: useFormState → useActionState; experimental.bundlePagesExternals → bundlePagesRouterDependencies; experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages → serverExternalPackages; experimental-edge → edge; @next/font → next/font.
  • Removals: NextRequest geo/ip (→ @vercel/functions ke geolocation/ipAddress), automatic Speed Insights instrumentation.
  • next-async-request-api codemod aur troubleshooting paths (--skip-react-upgrade, --skip-eslint-upgrade).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/upgrading/version-15
Hissa 98 / 471 · App Router · Guides

How to upgrade to version 16

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to upgrade to version 16. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to upgrade to version 16 — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Use a coding agent (recommended), Or upgrade manually (steps, in order), Using the codemod, Node.js runtime and browser support, Turbopack by default, Turbopack config location. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

ek coding agent (recommended) ka upyog karein

bash
npx next@canary upgrade --agent=latest
  • CLI agent ke liye Next.js 16 migration guide aur codemod command taiyaar karta hai, phir use changes apply karne aur app verify karne ko kehta hai (Upgrade with a coding agent dekho).

ya manual roop se upgrade (kram, kram mein)

1. AI agent docs (npx @next/codemod@canary agents-md — ank AGENTS.md ko sanskaran-maichd docs par set karein; upgrade karne ke baad, node_modules/next/dist/docs/ mein installed sanskaran ke saath bundle docs par AGENTS.md points ki check karein; 16.2+ par, next dev is block ko tarikh tak rakhta hai jab yeh ek coding agent ka pata lagata hai; .next-docs/ ko ek bar kuchh bhi sandarbhon ko hata dein). 2. upgrade codemod (npx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest) chalaein. 3. ya manual roop se package installed karein (npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest); @types/react/@types/react-dom ko upgrade bhi karein. 4. neeche diye gaye breaking parivartanon ke madhyam se kaam karein, check chalaein, shesh muddon ko theek karein.

codemod ka upyog karna

  • upgrade codemod kar sakta hai: naye turbopack config use karne ke liye next.config.js update karna; next lint se ESLint CLI me migrate karna; middleware se proxy me migrate karna; stabilized APIs se unstable_ prefix hatana; pages/layouts se experimental_ppr Route Segment Config hatana.
  • Ye note: codemod har migration codemod nahi chalata. Agar app abhi bhi Next.js 15 compatibility period se synchronous params, searchParams, cookies(), headers(), ya draftMode() use karta hai, to ye bhi chalao: npx @next/codemod@canary next-async-request-api .

Node.js runtime aur browser support

RequirementChange
20.9+ Nodeminimum ab 20.9.0 (LTS); Node.js 18 ab supported nahi hai
TypeScript 5+ab minimum 5.1.0
BrowsersChrome 111+, Edge 111+, Firefox 111+, Safari 16.4+

default roop se Turbopack

  • Next.js 16 se shuru, Turbopack stable hai aur next dev aur next build ke saath default roop se use hota hai — --turbopack/--turbo flags ab required nahi; package.json scripts ko plain next dev / next build me update karo.
  • Agar project me ek custom webpack config hai aur tum next build chalate ho (ab Turbopack default), to build misconfiguration rokne ke liye fail hota hai. Options: webpack config ignore karne ke liye next build --turbopack chalao; webpack config ko Turbopack-compatible options me migrate karo; ya --webpack flag ke saath Webpack rakho (jaise production builds ke liye Turbopack dev me, Webpack: "build": "next build --webpack"). Ye jaanna achha hai: agar tumne webpack option define nahi kiya, to likely ek plugin use jod raha hai.
  • Turbopack config location: experimental.turbopack experimental se bahar hai — nextConfig me top-level turbopack use karo. 16 me naye options me advanced webpack loader conditions aur debugIds shamil hain.
  • Resolve alias fallback: client-side code jo Node.js native modules import karta hai Module not found: Can't resolve 'fs' errors ka kaaran banta hai — refactor karo taaki client bundles unhe reference na karein. Agar impossible ho, to browser ke liye ek empty module load karne ke liye turbopack.resolveAlias use karo (jaise fs: { browser: './empty.ts' }) — refactoring behtar hai.
  • Sass node_modules imports: Turbopack node_modules se Sass import karna puri tarah support karta hai, lekin Webpack ke allowed legacy tilde (~) prefix ko support NAHI karta: @import '~bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css' → @import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css'; ya agar imports nahi badal sakte to turbopack.resolveAlias: { '~*': '*' } use karo.
  • Turbopack File System Caching: compiler artifacts disk par store hote hain taaki restarts ke across compiles tez hon; experimental.turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev / experimental.turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild ke through next dev aur next build ke liye default roop se enabled (configure/disable karne ke liye turbopackFileSystemCache dekho).

Async Request APIs (breaking change)

  • Version 15 ne temporary synchronous compatibility ke saath Async Request APIs introduce kiye. Next.js 16 se shuru, synchronous access puri tarah hata diya gaya hai — cookies, headers, draftMode, params (layout/page/route/default/opengraph-image/twitter-image/icon/apple-icon), searchParams (page) sirf asynchronously access ho sakte hain. next-async-request-api codemod use karo.
  • Types migrate karna: globally available type helpers PageProps, LayoutProps, RouteContext on the fly generate karne ke liye npx next typegen chalao (15.5 me introduce hua):
tsx
// /app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx
export default async function Page(props: PageProps<'/blog/[slug]'>) {
  const { slug } = await props.params
  const query = await props.searchParams
  return <h1>Blog Post: {slug}</h1>
}

icon aur opan-graph image (breaking change) ke liye Async parameter

  • Props opengraph-image, twitter-image, icon, apple-icon me image-generating functions ko pass hote hain. v15 me, Image aur generateImageMetadata ko ek synchronous params object aur id string ke roop me mila. v16 me, image functions params aur id ko Promises ke roop me receive karte hain (jabki generateImageMetadata abhi bhi synchronous params receive karta hai).
js
// app/shop/[slug]/opengraph-image.js
export async function generateImageMetadata({ params }) {
  const { slug } = params
  return [{ id: '1' }, { id: '2' }]
}

// Next.js 16 - asynchronous params and id access
export default async function Image({ params, id }) {
  const { slug } = await params // params now async
  const imageId = await id // id is now Promise<string> when using generateImageMetadata
  // ...
}

sitemap (breaking change) ke liye Async id parameter

  • Pehle, generateSitemaps ke id values seedhe sitemap function me pass hote the (ek number). v16 me, sitemap id ko ek Promise ke roop me receive karta hai:
js
// app/product/sitemap.js
export async function generateSitemaps() {
  return [{ id: 0 }, { id: 1 }, { id: 2 }, { id: 3 }]
}

// Next.js 16 - asynchronous id access
export default async function sitemap({ id }) {
  const resolvedId = await id // id is now Promise<string>
  const start = Number(resolvedId) * 50000
  // ...
}

React 19.2

  • Next.js 16 me App Router latest React canary release use karta hai, jisme React 19.2 features shamil hain: View Transitions (ek Transition/navigation ke andar elements update karna), useEffectEvent (non-reactive logic ko reusable Effect Event functions me effects se extract karna), Activity (state aur cleanup effects preserve karte hue display: none ke saath "background activity" UI hide karna).

React Compiler support (static)

  • Built-in React Compiler support ab Next.js 16 me stable hai (React Compiler 1.0 release ke baad) — components ko automatically memoize karta hai, zero manual code changes ke saath unnecessary re-renders kam karta hai. reactCompiler option ko experimental se stable me promote kiya gaya hai, lekin ye default roop se enabled NAHI hai (build performance data abhi bhi collect ho raha hai).
ts
// next.config.ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  reactCompiler: true,
}
  • Plugin install karo: npm install -D babel-plugin-react-compiler. Ye jaanna achha hai: enabled hone par dev aur builds me higher compilation times expect karo (compiler Babel par depend karta hai).

caching API

  • revalidateTag ko ab ek cacheLife profile specify karne wala dusra argument chahiye — single-argument form deprecated hai aur ek TypeScript error generate karta hai:
ts
// Before
revalidateTag('posts')

// After
revalidateTag('posts', 'max')

yadi tatkal samapti () ki requirement hai, to Server Actions mein updateTag ka upyog iske bajaay (client ko taza rakhne ke liye bhi) kiya jata hai. revalidateTag ka upyog karein jahan mamuli delay svikarya hai (blog post, product list, docs) - user background mein fresh data load karte samay stale content prapt karte hain.

ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { revalidateTag } from 'next/cache'

export async function updateArticle(articleId: string) {
  // Mark article data as stale - article readers see stale data while it revalidates
  revalidateTag(`article-${articleId}`, 'max')
}
  • updateTag (naya, sirf Server Actions) read-your-writes semantics deta hai — ek hi request ke andar data expire aur turant refresh karta hai taaki user apne changes turant dekh sake:
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { updateTag } from 'next/cache'

export async function updateUserProfile(userId: string, profile: Profile) {
  await db.users.update(userId, profile)

  // Expire cache and refresh immediately - user sees their changes right away
  updateTag(`user-${userId}`)
}

form, user settings aur kisi bhi varkaflo ke liye bilkul sahi jahan user turant update ki ummid karte hain.

  • refresh ek Server Action ke andar client router ko refresh karta hai:
ts
// app/actions.ts
'use server'

import { refresh } from 'next/cache'

export async function markNotificationAsRead(notificationId: string) {
  await db.notifications.markAsRead(notificationId)
  // Refresh the notification count displayed in the header
  refresh()
}
  • cacheLife aur cacheTag ab stable hain — unstable_ prefix ab required nahi: import { unstable_cacheLife as cacheLife, unstable_cacheTag as cacheTag } from 'next/cache' → import { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'.

badhi hui routing aur navigation

  • Next.js 16 me routing/navigation system ka ek complete overhaul shamil hai — leaner, tez page transitions; optimized prefetching/caching: layout deduplication (ek shared layout wale multiple URLs layout ek baar download karte hain) aur incremental prefetching (poore pages ke bajaye sirf wo parts prefetch hote hain jo cache me pehle se nahi). Koi code changes required nahi. Tum bahut kam total transfer size ke saath zyada individual prefetch requests dekh sakte ho — intended trade-off; agar request counts problems cause karein to issues report karo.

partial Prerendering (PPR)

  • Next.js 16 experimental PPR flag aur config options hatata hai, route-level experimental_ppr segment config samet. cacheComponents config ke saath PPR me opt in karo:
js
const nextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
}
  • Next.js 16 me PPR Next.js 15 canary ki tulna me alag kaam karta hai — agar tum aaj PPR use karte ho, to current Next.js 15 canary (experimental: { ppr: true }) par raho aur migration patterns ke liye Migrating to Cache Components dekho.

middleware to proxy

  • middleware filename deprecated hai, network boundary/routing focus clarify karne ke liye proxy rename kiya gaya. Rename: mv middleware.ts proxy.ts (ya .js); named export middleware → proxy rename karo (default exports ke saath bhi):
ts
// proxy.ts
export function proxy(request: Request) {}
  • edge runtime proxy me supported NAHI hai — proxy runtime nodejs hai aur configure nahi ho sakta. edge runtime use karne ke liye, middleware use karte raho; aage chalke edge runtime directives ek minor release me aayenge.
  • Config flags bhi rename hue, jaise skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize → skipProxyUrlNormalize (v16 config me top level). v16 codemod in flags ko update karta hai.

next/image changes

  • Query strings ke saath local images (breaking): query strings wale local image sources ko ab enumeration attacks rokne ke liye images.localPatterns.search config chahiye. <Image src="/assets/photo?v=1" ... /> ko localPatterns: [{ pathname: '/assets/**', search: '?v=1' }] chahiye.
  • minimumCacheTTL default (breaking): 60 seconds se 4 hours (14400s) me badla — bina Cache-Control header wali images ke liye revalidation cost kam karta hai. Restore karne ke liye: images: { minimumCacheTTL: 60 }.
  • imageSizes default (breaking): 16 default imageSizes array se hataya gaya (few projects 16px images serve karte hain; srcset size kam karta hai). Restore karne ke liye: images: { imageSizes: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384] }. Note: devicePixelRatio: 2 retina blurriness rokne ke liye kisi bhi tarah 32px image receive karta hai.
  • qualities default (breaking): saari qualities allow karne se sirf [75] allow karne me badla. Support karne ke liye: images: { qualities: [50, 75, 100] }. Jo quality prop array me nahi hai wo nearest value par clamp hoti hai (jaise 80 → 75). Custom qualities review karo; direct /_next/image requests test karo — unsupported q values 400 return karti hain.
  • Local IP restriction (breaking): naya security restriction default roop se local IP optimization block karta hai. Sirf private networks ke liye images.dangerouslyAllowLocalIP: true set karo — split-horizon DNS wale VPC me hosting karte samay required ho sakta hai aur 400 Bad Request mil sakta hai; sirf SSRF risk samajhne ke baad set karo.
  • Maximum redirects (breaking): images.maximumRedirects default unlimited se 3 me badla. Configure karo: maximumRedirects: 0 (disable) ya 5 (edge cases me badhao).
  • next/legacy/image deprecated — next/image use karo.
  • images.domains deprecated — images.remotePatterns use karo (improved security), jaise remotePatterns: [{ protocol: 'https', hostname: 'example.com' }].

concurrent dev aur build

  • next dev aur next build ab alag output directories use karte hain, jo concurrent execution enable karta hai — next dev .next/dev par output karta hai. Ek lockfile mechanism ek hi project par multiple next dev/next build instances rokta hai. Turbopack tracing command: npx next internal trace .next-profiles/trace-turbopack.bin.

parallel roots default.js requirement

  • Saare parallel route slots ko ab explicit default.js files chahiye — unke bina builds fail hote hain. Previous behavior maintain karne ke liye, ek default.js banao jo notFound() call karta hai ya null return karta hai:
tsx
// app/@modal/default.tsx
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'

export default function Default() {
  notFound()
}

ESLint Flat Config

  • @next/eslint-plugin-next ab ESLint Flat Config format me default hai, ESLint v10 (jo legacy config support drop karta hai) ke saath aligned. Agar legacy .eslintrc use ho raha hai, to flat config me migrate karne par vichaar karo (ESLint migration guide).

scroll behavior override

  • Pehle, agar scroll-behavior: smooth globally <html> par set tha, to Next.js use SPA route transitions ke dauraan snappy instant scroll-to-top ke liye override karta tha (temporarily auto). Next.js 16 me, Next.js ab default roop se scroll-behavior override nahi karta. Purana behavior restore karne ke liye, <html> me data-scroll-behavior="smooth" jodo:
tsx
export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" data-scroll-behavior="smooth">
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}

execution mein sudhar

  • next dev/next start, clearer terminal output, behtar error messages, behtar performance metrics ke liye significant optimizations.
  • Next.js 16 next build output se size aur First Load JS metrics hatata hai (server-driven RSC architecture me misleading paye gaye); Turbopack aur Webpack Client Component payloads ke accounting par disagree karte the. Actual route performance Chrome Lighthouse ya Vercel Analytics (Core Web Vitals) se measure karo.
  • next dev config loading: Next.js configuration file pehle dev me do baar load hoti thi (ek baar next dev command ke liye, ek baar jab server start hua). Ab ye ek baar load hoti hai — result: config me 'dev' ke liye process.argv check karna false return karta dikhai deta hai (sirf typegen aur build). Side effects wale plugins ke liye important — iske bajaye NODE_ENV === 'development' check karo, ya config phase use karo.

adapter API (alpha) banaein

  • Build Adapters RFC ke baad, pehla alpha available hai — custom adapters build process me hook karte hain taaki deployment platforms/custom integrations config modify kar sakein ya build output process kar sakein:
js
const nextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    adapterPath: require.resolve('./my-adapter.js'),
  },
}
  • adapterPath ko 16.2.0 me ek stable top-level option me promote kiya gaya tha.

aadhunik Sass API

  • sass-loader v16 me bump hua, modern Sass syntax aur nayi features support karta hai.

Removals

  • AMP support hataya gaya: saare AMP APIs/configs hataye — amp config, next/amp hook import (useAmp), export const config = { amp: true }. Evaluate karo ki kya AMP abhi bhi required hai; aksar benefits ab built-in optimizations/modern standards se aate hain.
  • next lint hataya gaya: seedhe Biome ya ESLint use karo; next build ab linting nahi chalata. Codemod: npx @next/codemod@canary next-lint-to-eslint-cli .. Next config me eslint option bhi hataya gaya hai.
  • Runtime config hataya gaya: serverRuntimeConfig aur publicRuntimeConfig hataye gaye — iske bajaye environment variables use karo. Server-only values: Server Components me seedhe process.env padho (sensitive values ko galti se Client Components ko pass hone se rokne ke liye taint API use karo). Client values: .env.local me NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix. Runtime (build-time ke bajaye) env padhne ke liye, process.env padhne se pehle connection() use karo.
  • devIndicators options hataye gaye: appIsrStatus, buildActivity, buildActivityPosition — indicator khud rehta hai.
  • experimental.dynamicIO aur experimental.useCache hataye gaye — actively use kar rahe ho to top-level cacheComponents: true me migrate karo; warna flags hata do. Dhyaan do: cacheComponents enable karna sirf naam ka change nahi hai — ye <Suspense> ke bahar kisi bhi request data ke liye build errors cause kar sakta hai aur Cache Components model apnana padta hai.
  • unstable_rootParams hataya gaya — iske bajaye next/root-params use karo.
  • Dusre experimental flags baad ke 16 minors me hataye gaye: experimental.viewTransition (15.2.0 me introduce) 16.3.0 me hataya — flag hata do; App Router me bina config ke View Transitions kaam karte hain; experimental.appNewScrollHandler (16.2.0 me introduce, 16.3.0 me default, 16.4.0 me hataya) — flag hata do; true default se match karta hai; false opt-out chala gaya hai aur naya handler patterns unchanged hain.

Troubleshooting

  • React 19: upgrade karne ke baad v15 guide me React recovery checklist follow karo.
  • ESLint upgrade karne ke baad installation fail hoti hai: Next.js 16 next lint hatata hai, lekin ESLint CLI me migrate karne ke liye ESLint upgrade karna required nahi hai. eslint-config-next@16 ko ESLint 9+ chahiye; eslint-config-next@16.4.0+ ESLint 10 support karta hai. Agar existing lint configuration eslint-config-next@16 use nahi karti, to uska compatible ESLint version maintain rakho. Peer conflicts par, previous compatible eslint/eslint-config-next/@next/eslint-plugin-next + previous lint configuration restore karo; blocked upgrade par, --skip-eslint-upgrade ke saath ek hi target dobara try karo; agar Next.js pehle se match karta hai, to deps install karo aur poora migration individually karo; next lint script ko ESLint CLI command se replace karo; installed + lint pass confirm karo.

migration cheklist

  • [ ] App Node.js, TypeScript, React requirements puri karta hai.
  • [ ] Dev/build scripts effective bundler config (plugins, loaders, aliases, affected Sass imports) ke saath agree karte hain.
  • [ ] Middleware/proxy changes required runtime/routing behavior preserve karte hain — Edge middleware ko blindly proxy me rename nahi kiya gaya.
  • [ ] Affected image requests intended quality preserve karte hue documented restrictions/defaults ke under succeed hote hain.
  • [ ] Existing cache API calls documented signatures/semantics follow karte hain; React Compiler aur Cache Components sirf upgrade complete karne ke liye enabled nahi hue.
  • [ ] Removed APIs/config ke koi remaining consumers nahi; runtime configuration replacements server/client visibility aur required evaluation timing preserve karte hain.
  • [ ] Scripts/CI ab next lint call nahi karte; linting jahan required ho alag se chalti hai.
  • [ ] App ke supported checks aur affected runtime behavior pass hote hain — akele ek green build runtime conclusions close nahi karta.
  • [ ] Async Request API access aur callers migrated; codemod error comments aur UnsafeUnwrapped casts resolved; async Client Components ke liye jahan appropriate ho React use.
  • [ ] Dynamic metadata image functions aur sitemap functions async params handle karte hain; affected generated URLs kaam karte hain.
  • [ ] Parallel route slots ke paas appropriate defaults hain; direct navigations/reloads intended fallback behavior maintain rakhte hain.

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Jab ye edge runtime use karta hai to blindly middleware → proxy rename karna — proxy Node.js-only hai aur unconfigurable hai.
  • Async request API access abhi bhi synchronous kaam karne ki ummeed karna — v16 me puri tarah hataya gaya (v15 ka UnsafeUnwrapped* escape hatch gaya).
  • revalidateTag ka ab-required dusra argument (cacheLife profile) bhool jana — single-arg form ek TS error hai.
  • Parallel route slots me default.js bhool jana — build fail hota hai.
  • next build se size/First Load JS dikhane ki ummeed karna — hataya gaya; Lighthouse/Vercel Analytics use karo.
  • next lint ya eslint config option use karna — hataya gaya; next build ab lint nahi karta.
  • serverRuntimeConfig/publicRuntimeConfig use karna — hataya gaya; env vars (+ runtime reading ke liye connection()) use karo.
  • Sirf dynamicIO/useCache flags hatane ke liye chup-chaap cacheComponents enable karna — ye behavior badalta hai aur saathi build errors cause kar sakta hai.

interview points

  • Headline v16 changes: Turbopack default (aur --webpack opt-out, top-level turbopack config, ~ Sass prefix gaya, FS caching), Node 20.9+/TS 5.1+ minimums, async Request APIs se sync access puri tarah hataya (npx next typegen helpers), React 19.2 features (View Transitions, useEffectEvent, Activity), React Compiler stable-but-opt-in (reactCompiler: true + babel-plugin-react-compiler), stable cacheLife/cacheTag, revalidateTag/updateTag/refresh, PPR → cacheComponents, middleware → proxy (Node.js-only), image defaults (query-string localPatterns.search, minimumCacheTTL 4h, imageSizes minus 16, qualities [75], local IP restriction, maximumRedirects 3), parallel routes ko default.js chahiye, next lint/AMP/runtime-config removals, size/First Load JS hatana, scroll-behavior override change (data-scroll-behavior="smooth"), Build Adapters.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/upgrading/version-16
