How to use and optimize videos

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai How to use and optimize videos. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: How to use and optimize videos — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Using `<video>` and `<iframe>`, `<video>`, Video best practices, Dimensions, Poster image, Fallback content. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Performance ko affect kiye bina Next.js me video files ko store aur display kaise karein.

<video> aur <iframe> ka upyog karna

  • Videos direct video files ke liye HTML <video> tag se aur external platform-hosted videos ke liye <iframe> tag se embed hote hain.

<video>

  • Self-hosted ya seedhe serve hone wala video content embed karta hai, playback aur appearance par full control ke saath:
jsx
// app/ui/video.jsx
export function Video() {
  return (
    <video
      width="320"
      height="240"
      poster="/path/to/poster.jpg"
      controls
      preload="none"
    >
      <source src="/path/to/video.mp4" type="video/mp4" />
      <track
        src="/path/to/captions.vtt"
        kind="subtitles"
        srcLang="en"
        label="English"
      />
      Your browser does not support the video tag.
    </video>
  )
}
  • Common attributes: src (source file), width/height, controls (default playback controls), autoPlay (autoplay policies browser ke hisaab se alag hoti hain), loop, muted (autoPlay ke saath aksar zaroori, iOS Safari par autoplay ke liye), poster, preload (none / metadata / auto), playsInline.
  • Ye jaanna achha hai: autoPlay ke saath muted bhi shamil karo (taaki zyadaatar browsers me autoplay ho) aur playsInline (iOS compatibility).

video sarvashreshth prathaon

  • Dimensions: width/height ya CSS aspect-ratio set karo taaki browser file load hone se pehle box reserve kar le — bina dimensions wala video pehle collapse hota hai phir page ko neeche dhakelta hai, Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) ko nuksaan pahunchata hai.
  • Poster image: poster use karo reserved box ko bharne ke liye jabki video load hota hai, khaas taur par preload="none" ke saath (playback shuru hone tak koi frame nahi aata).
  • Fallback content: video support ke bina wale browsers ke liye tag ke andar fallback content shamil karo.
  • Subtitles/captions: un users ke liye shamil karo jo deaf/hard of hearing hain — caption file sources ke saath <track> tag use karo.
  • Accessible controls: standard HTML5 video controls keyboard navigation aur screen reader compatibility ke liye recommended hain; advanced zarooraton ke liye react-player ya video.js jaise third-party players par vichaar karo (accessible controls, consistent browser experience).

<iframe>

  • External platforms (YouTube, Vimeo) se videos embed karna:
jsx
// app/page.jsx
export default function Page() {
  return (
    <iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/19g66ezsKAg" allowFullScreen />
  )
}
  • Common attributes: src, width/height, allowFullScreen, sandbox (extra restrictions), loading (jaise lazy loading), style (jaise fixed shape ke liye aspect-ratio), title (accessibility).
  • Bina dimensions wala iframe apni content load hone tak collapse rehta hai, video ki tarah hi — use width/height ya aspect-ratio do, khaas taur par loading="lazy" ke saath jahan embed page ke paint hone ke bahut baad resolve ho sakta hai.

video embeding vidhi ka chayan karna

  • Self-hosted/direct video files: <video> tag — player functionality/appearance par detailed control; apni content ka optimization aur control.
  • Video hosting services (YouTube, Vimeo, aadi): <iframe> players — kam control, lekin use karne me aasani aur platform features. Wo method chuno jo application ki requirements aur desired UX se match kare.

external roop se host kiye gaye video ko embed karna

  • Next.js ke saath video info fetch karo aur load hone ke dauraan fallback ke liye React Suspense use karo: 1. Ek Server Component banao jo iframe generate karta hai — ye source URL fetch karta hai aur iframe render karta hai:
jsx
// app/ui/video-component.jsx
export default async function VideoComponent() {
  const src = await getVideoSrc()

  return <iframe src={src} allowFullScreen />
}

2. ise React Suspense ke saath stream karein:

jsx
// app/page.jsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import VideoComponent from '../ui/VideoComponent.jsx'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <section>
      <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading video...</p>}>
        <VideoComponent />
      </Suspense>
      {/* Other content of the page */}
    </section>
  )
}
  • Ye jaanna achha hai: embeds responsive rakho (CSS se iframe/video player screen size ke hisaab se adjust hota hai); network conditions ke hisaab se loading strategies use karo, khaas taur par limited data wale users ke liye. Ye page ko block hone se rokta hai — user video stream hote hue interact kar sakta hai. Zyada engaging loading experience ke liye, plain message ke bajaye fallback ke roop me loading skeleton (jaise <VideoSkeleton />) use karo.

sva-hosted video

  • Kyun self-host karein: full control/independence (external platform restrictions se free, content ka direct management); customization (jaise dynamic background video ki unique zarooratein); performance/scalability (high performance, scalable storage chuno); cost/integration (storage/bandwidth costs ko commercial Next.js integrations ke saath balance karo).
  • Video hosting ke liye Vercel Blob: scalable cloud storage jo Next.js ke saath achhi tarah kaam karta hai. (1) Vercel dashboard (Storage tab → Blob store → upload), Server Action (server-side upload) ya client-side upload ke through upload karo. (2) <video> tag + React Suspense use karke Next.js me display karo:
jsx
// app/page.jsx
import { Suspense } from 'react'
import { list } from '@vercel/blob'

export default function Page() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading video...</p>}>
      <VideoComponent fileName="my-video.mp4" />
    </Suspense>
  )
}

async function VideoComponent({ fileName }) {
  const { blobs } = await list({
    prefix: fileName,
    limit: 1,
  })
  const { url } = blobs[0]

  return (
    <video controls preload="none" aria-label="Video player">
      <source src={url} type="video/mp4" />
      Your browser does not support the video tag.
    </video>
  )
}
  • Subtitle jodna: Vercel Blob se subtitle file fetch karo (limit: 2 ke saath list, dusra blob caption URL hai) aur <video> ke andar ek <track> element jodo:
jsx
async function VideoComponent({ fileName }) {
  const { blobs } = await list({
    prefix: fileName,
    limit: 2,
  })
  const { url } = blobs[0]
  const { url: captionsUrl } = blobs[1]

  return (
    <video controls preload="none" aria-label="Video player">
      <source src={url} type="video/mp4" />
      <track src={captionsUrl} kind="subtitles" srcLang="en" label="English" />
      Your browser does not support the video tag.
    </video>
  )
}

Resources

  • Video formats/codecs: compatibility ke liye MP4, web optimization ke liye WebM (MDN video codec guide).
  • Video compression: FFmpeg — quality ko file size ke saath balance karo.
  • Resolution/bitrate adjustment: mobile devices ke liye kam settings.
  • CDN: distribution speed/high traffic ke liye CDN use karo (Vercel Blob CDN automatically handle karta hai).
  • Streaming platforms: open-source next-video component (<Video>), jo Vercel Blob, S3, Backblaze, Mux ke saath kaam karta hai; Cloudinary (<CldVideoPlayer>, adaptive bitrate streaming); Mux Video API (video course starter kit, high-performance embedding); Fastly (on-demand/streaming media ke liye video); ImageKit.io (<IKVideo>).

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • <video>/<iframe> par width/height ya aspect-ratio na hona — content load hone par layout shift (CLS).
  • muted ke bina autoPlay (aur iOS par playsInline) — autoplay block ho jata hai.
  • poster ke bina preload="none" — playback shuru hone tak khaali box.
  • Video fetch par page ko block karna — iske bajaye Suspense ke through embed stream karo.
  • Captions/track na hona — deaf/hard-of-hearing users ke liye accessibility gap.

interview points

  • <video> vs <iframe> embedding (self-host control vs platform aasani) aur unke main attributes.
  • Performance best practices: reserved dimensions / aspect-ratio (CLS), poster, preload values, lazy loading, Suspense se embeds ki streaming, skeleton fallback, responsive embeds, network-aware loading.
  • Vercel Blob (list + <video> + Suspense) aur ecosystem tools (next-video, Cloudinary <CldVideoPlayer>, Mux, ImageKit <IKVideo>) ke through self-hosting.
  • Formats/codecs (MP4 vs WebM), compression (FFmpeg), resolution/bitrate, CDN distribution.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/guides/videos
Hissa 100 / 471 · App Router · Guides

Designing view transitions

App RouterGuides

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Designing view transitions. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Designing view transitions — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Add view transitions with an agent, Example app — "Frames" photography gallery, Customizing the morph, Step 2: Animate loading states with Suspense reveals, Step 3: Add directional motion for navigation, Anchoring the header. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Main Points — Pehle Ye Samjho

  • Web apps me, route changes poore page ko ek baar me badal dete hain — elements ka ek set gayab ho jata hai, dusra aa jata hai, bina kisi visual connection ke. Ek user photo thumbnail ko detail me dekhne ke liye select karta hai; ve ek hi image hain, lekin kuch bhi ye communicate nahi karta.
  • In transitions ki zaroorat wale apps aam taur par complex animation libraries par nirbhar karte hain jo mount/unmount lifecycles manage karti hain, routes ke paar element positions track karti hain, aur timing manually coordinate karti hain.
  • React ka <ViewTransition> component browser ke View Transitions API ke saath integrate karke ise declaratively handle karta hai: un elements ko naam do jo persist hone chahiye, aur browser purani aur nayi positions ke beech animate karta hai.
  • Chaar patterns sabse common cases cover karte hain: shared elements ko morph karna, loading states ko animate karna, directional navigation jodna, aur same route ke andar content crossfade karna.
  • Ek agent ke saath view transitions jodo: vercel-react-view-transitions skill ek coding agent ko patterns, CSS recipes aur troubleshooting sikhati hai: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill vercel-react-view-transitions, phir prompt karo jaise 'Add view transitions to this app using the vercel-react-view-transitions skill' (ya koi specific transition: thumbnail ko hero me morph karna, routes forward/back ke beech slide, same route ke andar crossfade).
  • Example app — 'Frames' photography gallery: thumbnail ko hero image me morph karo (shared elements), loading skeleton ko asal content me animate karo (Suspense reveals), forward/back navigation ke liye directional slides jodo (route transitions), photographer tabs ke beech crossfade karo (same-route transitions). Demo: react-view-transitions-demo.labs.vercel.dev; code: github.com/nextjs/react-view-transitions-demo.
  • View transitions App Router me bina kisi configuration ke kaam karte hain. React 19.3 me <ViewTransition> component aur addTransitionType API shamil hai. Note: React ka integration naye View Transitions API features (transition types, view-transition-class) use karta hai, jo Chromium 125+ aur recent Safari/Firefox me available hain; kuch animations Safari me alag behave kar sakti hain. Browser support ke bina, app normally kaam karta hai — transitions bas animate nahi hoti.
tsx
import { ViewTransition } from 'react'
  • <ViewTransition> animations Transitions (useTransition), <Suspense> aur useDeferredValue se activate hoti hain. Regular setState calls unhe trigger NAHI karte. Next.js me, <Link>, router.push(), router.replace() ke saath navigations transitions hain, isliye animations automatically activate ho jati hain. Browser history navigation unhe trigger NAHI karta.

step 1: Morph ek thumbnail mein ek hero image (sheyard elements)

  • Gallery grid photos dikhata hai; kisi par click karne se usi image ke bade version ke saath detail page khulta hai. Transitions ke bina, thumbnail gayab ho jata hai aur hero aa jata hai — kuch bhi unhe jodta nahi. Motion design me, jab koi object ek cut ke paar bana rehta hai to wo continuity communicate karta hai — viewer samajhta hai ki ye wahi cheez hai, replacement nahi. Ye sabse important pattern hai: shared element morphing.
  • Grid thumbnail aur detail hero dono ko same name ke saath <ViewTransition> me wrap karo:
tsx
// components/photo-grid.tsx
import { ViewTransition } from 'react'
import Image from 'next/image'
import Link from 'next/link'

function PhotoGrid({ photos }) {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
      {photos.map((photo) => (
        <Link key={photo.id} href={`/photo/${photo.id}`}>
          <ViewTransition name={`photo-${photo.id}`}>
            <Image src={photo.src} alt={photo.title} />
          </ViewTransition>
        </Link>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
tsx
// app/photo/[id]/photo-content.tsx
import { ViewTransition } from 'react'
import Image from 'next/image'

async function PhotoContent({ id }) {
  const photo = await getPhoto(id)

  return (
    <ViewTransition name={`photo-${photo.id}`}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', aspectRatio: '3 / 2' }}>
        <Image src={photo.src} alt={photo.title} fill />
      </div>
    </ViewTransition>
  )
}
  • name prop identity banata hai: React purane/naye pages par same naam wale elements ko match karta hai aur size aur position ke beech automatically animate karta hai. Ek thumbnail image click par grid cell se hero slot me scale/reposition hota hai; <Link href="/"> se lautne par shape ulta ho jata hai. Morph sabse dramatic tab hota hai jab destination navigation ke saath ready ho (prefetched/cached pages); agar destination pehle fallback me suspend ho jata hai, to koi pair nahi banta aur content aane par apne enter animation ke saath aata hai.
  • Morph ko customize karna: default="none" ke saath share="morph" jodo; share view transition ke liye morph class assign karta hai, jise CSS pseudo-elements se target kiya ja sakta hai — jaise:
tsx
<ViewTransition name={`photo-${photo.id}`} share="morph" default="none">
  <Image src={photo.src} alt={photo.title} />
</ViewTransition>

donon snipets ke liye ek hi props jorein. default="none" pratyek naam ki image ko pratyek unrelated transition par apna khud ka krosfed chalane se rakhta hai - iske bina, pratyek naam ke <ViewTransition> kisi bhi transition run par ankit karta hai. jab aap default="none" ko ek named pair mein jorte hain, to share ko spasht rakhein - default="none" aur share ke saath, pair chupchap roop se morph band ho jati hai.

css
/* app/globals.css */
::view-transition-group(.morph) {
  animation-duration: 400ms;
}
::view-transition-image-pair(.morph) {
  animation-name: via-blur;
}
@keyframes via-blur {
  30% {
    filter: blur(3px);
  }
}

bloor piksel-star interpolation artifacts ko chhipata hai; 400ms rajistar karne ke liye paryapt dhima hai lekin seedhe mehsoos karne ke liye kaafi tej hai.

step 2: Suspense ke saath enimet loading states prakat hota hai

  • Detail page asynchronously load hota hai; ek Suspense boundary data resolve hone tak skeleton dikhati hai, phir swap achanak hota hai (skeleton gayab, content pop in). Motion design me, vertical direction hierarchy encode karti hai: content upar slide = arrival; neeche slide = departure; saath me ve ek handoff banate hain — placeholder asal cheez ke liye raasta deta hai.
  • Suspense ke fallback ko exit animation wale ViewTransition me wrap karo, aur content ko enter animation wale me:
tsx
// app/photo/[id]/page.tsx
import { Suspense, ViewTransition } from 'react'

export default async function PhotoPage({ params }) {
  const { id } = await params

  return (
    <Suspense
      fallback={
        <ViewTransition exit="slide-down" default="none">
          <PhotoContentSkeleton />
        </ViewTransition>
      }
    >
      <ViewTransition enter="slide-up" default="none">
        <PhotoContent id={id} />
      </ViewTransition>
    </Suspense>
  )
}
  • Step 1 me, default="none" unrelated transitions ke dauraan animation rokta hai (jaise shared-element morph).
  • CSS asymmetric timing use karta hai — tez exit (150ms), enter par slow fade (210ms) jo exit poora hone tak delay hota hai, slide movement lamba (400ms):
css
/* app/globals.css */
:root {
  --duration-exit: 150ms;
  --duration-enter: 210ms;
  --duration-move: 400ms;
}

::view-transition-old(.slide-down) {
  animation:
    var(--duration-exit) ease-out both fade reverse,
    var(--duration-exit) ease-out both slide-y reverse;
}
::view-transition-new(.slide-up) {
  animation:
    var(--duration-enter) ease-in var(--duration-exit) both fade,
    var(--duration-move) ease-in both slide-y;
}

@keyframes fade {
  from {
    filter: blur(3px);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    filter: blur(0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}
@keyframes slide-y {
  from {
    transform: translateY(10px);
  }
  to {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
  • Asymmetry jaanboojh kar hai: purani content jaldi nikalti hai taaki dhyaan ke liye compete na kare; nayi content dheere aati hai taaki user use register kare. Enter fade par var(--duration-exit) delay ka matlab hai nayi content purani ke jaane ka wait karti hai. Refresh par, skeleton neeche slide/fade out hota hai, phir asal content upar slide/fade in hota hai.

step 3: navigation ke liye directional gati jorein

  • Forward aur back navigation bina directional cue ke ek jaise dikhte hain. Film/animation me, horizontal direction spatial position encode karti hai: left = aage badhna (jaise left-to-right bhasha me page palatna); right = wapas jana. Iska ullanghan karna galat mehsoos hota hai.
  • Forward navigation ko tag karne ke liye <Link> par transitionTypes prop use karo:
tsx
// components/photo-grid.tsx
<Link href={`/photo/${photo.id}`} transitionTypes={['nav-forward']}>
  {/* photo thumbnail */}
</Link>

previous page par lautne wale link ke liye, nav-back ka upyog karein:

tsx
// app/photo/[id]/page.tsx
<Link href="/" transitionTypes={['nav-back']}>
  ← Gallery
</Link>

transition prakar automatic nahi hai - aap tay karte hain ki kaun se link app ke navigation padanukram par aadharit "forward" banam "back" hain. ek vistar page par Previous/next teer ek hi tarah se nav-back/nav-forward ka upyog kar sakte hain.

  • Page content ko ek ViewTransition me wrap karo jo transition types ko directional animations se map karta hai:
tsx
// app/photo/[id]/page.tsx
<ViewTransition
  enter={{
    'nav-forward': 'nav-forward',
    'nav-back': 'nav-back',
    default: 'none',
  }}
  exit={{
    'nav-forward': 'nav-forward',
    'nav-back': 'nav-back',
    default: 'none',
  }}
  default="none"
>
  {/* page content */}
</ViewTransition>

enter/exit props transition ke prakar se ki gai object ko accept karte hain. nav-forward ke saath, exit purani content ko chhor data hai aur sahi se nai content ko slide karta hai. default: "none" ek prakar ke bina transition sunishchit karta hai (router.refresh(), Suspense reveal hota hai) koi directional animation generated nahi karta hai.

  • Har participating page ko usi tarah wrap karo (jaise gallery page bhi, taaki wo forward navigation par ek taraf aur nav-back par dusri taraf slide kare). Wrapper har page.tsx me rakho, layout me nahi — layout navigation par bana rehta hai, isliye enter/exit wahan kabhi fire nahi hote.
  • Directional slide (60px offset — itna ki user ko tez element track kiye bina direction samajh aaye) ke liye CSS:
css
/* app/globals.css */
::view-transition-old(.nav-forward) {
  --slide-offset: -60px;
  animation:
    150ms ease-in both fade reverse,
    400ms ease-in-out both slide reverse;
}
::view-transition-new(.nav-forward) {
  --slide-offset: 60px;
  animation:
    210ms ease-out 150ms both fade,
    400ms ease-in-out both slide;
}

::view-transition-old(.nav-back) {
  --slide-offset: 60px;
  animation:
    150ms ease-in both fade reverse,
    400ms ease-in-out both slide reverse;
}
::view-transition-new(.nav-back) {
  --slide-offset: -60px;
  animation:
    210ms ease-out 150ms both fade,
    400ms ease-in-out both slide;
}

@keyframes slide {
  from {
    translate: var(--slide-offset);
  }
  to {
    translate: 0;
  }
}
  • Header ko anchor karna: directional slide ke dauraan, header move nahi hona chahiye — sliding header user ke spatial anchor ko tod deta hai. Header ko ek viewTransitionName do aur uska animation suppress karo:
tsx
// components/header.tsx
<header style={{ viewTransitionName: 'site-header' }}>
  {/* navigation links */}
</header>
css
/* app/globals.css */
::view-transition-group(site-header) {
  animation: none;
  z-index: 100;
}
::view-transition-old(site-header) {
  display: none;
}
::view-transition-new(site-header) {
  animation: none;
}

purane snapshot par display: none ek flash ko rokta hai jahan donon header sankshipt roop se dikhai dete hain; z-index: 100 phisalane wali content ke upar header rakhta hai.

  • Browser history navigation: Back/Forward buttons, history swipe gestures, router.back(), router.forward() view transition animations trigger NAHI karte, shared-element morphs samet — Next.js inhe popstate ke through handle karta hai, jahan React ne scroll/form restoration preserve karne ke liye transition animations chhod di hain. Matching name props ise nahi badalte. Gallery me wapas jaane ke liye <Link href="/"> use karo (ek naya navigation, history ke vipreet nahi) — matching name props morph enable karte hain aur transitionTypes={['nav-back']} directional slide choose karta hai.
  • Page ko interactive rakhna: jab transition chalta hai, ::view-transition overlay pointer events capture kar leta hai, isliye animation ke dauraan clicks kho jate hain. Ise content tak jaane do:
css
/* app/globals.css */
::view-transition {
  pointer-events: none;
}

yeh unnamed content ke liye interaction ko restore karta hai. hit testing abhi bhi transition ki avdhi ke liye named pratibhaagiyon (jaise einkar header) ko chhor data hai - transition ko kam rakhein aur namkaran elements se bachne ke liye user tezi se click karta hai.

  • Reduced motion ka sammaan: directional slides physical motion simulate karti hain — motion sensitivity ke liye sabse common trigger. Morphs, iske vipreet, crossfades kam risk lete hain (chhote areas / opacity based). Saral approach — saari animation durations disable karo:
css
/* app/globals.css */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  ::view-transition-old(*),
  ::view-transition-new(*),
  ::view-transition-group(*) {
    animation-duration: 0s !important;
    animation-delay: 0s !important;
  }
}

animation ke bina, content turant ( browser default) svaip karti hai. ek aur parishkrit drishtikon sthitigat motion ko hatate samay crossfades/opacity transition ko barkarar rakhta hai.

step 4: usi route ke bhitar krosfed content

  • Gallery ke photographer section me tabs hain; har tab ek alag photographer ki photos dikhata hai, same route structure (/collection/[slug]). Tabs ke beech click karna ek hi container ke andar content switch karne jaisa lagna chahiye, naye page par navigate karne jaisa nahi. Directional slide galat hogi — slides 'nayi jagah ja raha hai' communicate karti hain; crossfade 'wahi jagah, alag content' communicate karta hai. Container (continuity) rehta hai, sirf grid ke andar change (swap) hota hai.
  • key ke saath ek ViewTransition use karo jo current slug par set ho — jab key badalti hai, React purani aur nayi content ke beech transition trigger karta hai:
tsx
// app/collection/[slug]/page.tsx
import { Suspense, ViewTransition } from 'react'

export default async function CollectionPage({ params }) {
  const { slug } = await params

  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<CollectionGridSkeleton />}>
      <ViewTransition
        key={slug}
        name="collection-content"
        share="auto"
        enter="auto"
        default="none"
      >
        <CollectionGrid slug={slug} />
      </ViewTransition>
    </Suspense>
  )
}

share="auto" aur enter="auto" apne default krosphed animation ka upyog karne ke liye React batate hain. name container identity data hai; navigation transition ko trigger karta hai, aur key={slug} parivartan React ko old/new content ko ek exit/enter pair (share ko active karne) ke bajaay ek in-place update ke roop mein behavior karta hai. tab krosphed grid ke beech click karna; tab bar aur aaspas ke layout ko moved nahi kiya jata hai.

pattern summary

Patternyeh kya batata hai
sajha element (morph)"samee cheez, gahree jaa rahi hai"
Suspense reveal"data load"
directional slide"going phoravard / wapas aa raha hai"
sam-root krosfed"Same place, vibhinn content"

Aam Galtiyaan — Dhyaan Do

  • Regular setState se view transitions trigger karne ki ummeed karna — sirf Transitions, <Suspense> aur useDeferredValue unhe activate karte hain.
  • Directional wrapper layout me daalna — layout bana rehta hai, isliye enter/exit kabhi fire nahi hote; har page.tsx ko wrap karo.
  • Named pair par explicit share ke bina default="none" — pair chupchaap morph karna band kar deta hai.
  • Browser Back/Forward (popstate) ke animate hone ki ummeed — React wahan animations chhod deta hai; animated return ke liye <Link> use karo.
  • ::view-transition { pointer-events: none; } bhool jana — transition ke dauraan clicks kho jate hain.
  • Us element ko naam dena jise user tez click karta hai — hit testing transition ke dauraan unhe chhod deti hai.
  • Morph ko same-render ki zaroorat samajhna — agar destination pehle fallback me suspend ho jata hai, to koi pair nahi banta; content iske bajaye apna enter animation use karta hai.
  • prefers-reduced-motion ko ignore karna — directional slides sabse bade motion sensitivity triggers hain.

interview points

  • <ViewTransition> + View Transitions API kya hal karta hai (declarative shared-element animation vs manual animation libraries jo mount/unmount aur positions track karti hain).
  • Chaar patterns aur har ek kya communicate karta hai (morph = continuity, Suspense = data load, directional slide = forward/back, crossfade = wahi jagah alag content).
  • Activation rules (sirf Transitions/Suspense/useDeferredValue); <Link> / router.push / replace transitions hain; popstate nahi hai.
  • name prop as identity; share/enter/exit/default props aur default="none" + explicit share rule; <Link>/useRouter par transitionTypes aur type-keyed enter/exit objects.
  • Browser support (Chromium 125+, recent Safari/Firefox; graceful no-animation fallback) aur React 19.3 requirement.
  • Practical details: header anchoring (viewTransitionName + purane snapshot par display: none), pointer-events passthrough, reduced motion handling, key={slug} crossfade share="auto"/enter="auto" ke saath, vercel-react-view-transitions agent skill.

Hissa 102 / 471 · App Router · API Reference

Directives (index)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Directives (index). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Directives (index) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The three directives, Where to place a directive, What each directive requires, Placement decides what you cache, Code examples (verbatim), Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: directive string sakshar hain jo compiler/bundler ko batate hain ki unke aaspas code ka ilaj kaise karein. apne aap mein ve plain taar ki tarah dikhte hain, lekin Next.js aur React ne unhein directive ke roop mein padha jo code ko ve cover karte hain. ek nirdeshan ek client entry point, ek Server Function bana sakta hai, ya ek function's/component ka output cache kar sakta hai. Next.js development aur production donon mein compilation ke dauraan directive lagu karta hai; error overlays/indicators/stack nishan source file aur line par point karte hain, production generated nahi hote hain.

  • teen directive:
Directivedwara defineEffect
'use client'ReactServer Components se client access point banata hai
'use server'ReactServer Functions ke roop mein server-side function ko expose karta hai
'use cache' Next.jscache aur code ke input ke aadhar par output ka pun: upyog karta hai

'use cache' mein 'use cache: remote' aur 'use cache: private' variant bhi hain. custom cache handler niyantran jahan cached entries ko sangrahit kiya jata hai.

  • Kahan to place a directive:
  • kisi bhi import se pahle, 'use client' ko ek file ke top par hona chahiye; yeh pure module (file-void boundary) par lagu hota hai kyonki module ko bundle kiya jata hai aur browser mein bhej diya jata hai. iska upyog inline nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • 'use server' / 'use cache': ek file ke top par → pratyek export par lagu hota hai; ek function ke top par → keval us function par lagu hota hai.
  • server module mein 'use server' aur 'use cache' ki ghoshna, NOT ek 'use client' module mein. ek 'use server'/'use cache' function ko ek Client Component mein import karne ke liye server module ke top par directive dein - Client Component ko ek sandarbh prapt hota hai jo server par karya ko lagu karta hai.
  • jab yeh keval us function/component par lagu hona chahiye, to directive ko ek function ke andar rakhein; file ke top par jab ise kai export karyon par lagu karna chahiye.
  • file-star 'use server' ya 'use cache' directive dwara cover kiye gaye pratyek export function ko async hona chahiye.
  • Kya pratyek directive ki requirement hai:
  • 'use client': ank server/client boundary ke roop mein export karta hai. Client Component malik boundary par karne ke liye dharavahik hona chahiye. sadharan karya (e.g. iveint handler) par nahi kar sakte, lekin Server Functions sandarbh ke roop mein par kar sakte hain.
  • 'use server': cover kiye gaye karyon ko async hona chahiye. jab ek Client Component se invited kiya jata hai, to tark aur return valueon ko network mein kramit kiya jata hai; client ko ek sandarbh prapt hota hai, code nahi.
  • 'use cache': cached functions/components ko async hona chahiye. tark aur return values ko serial karne yogy hona chahiye, gair-serialization values ko chhorakar cache code ka inspect kiye bina guzarta hai. cached code request samay API jaise cookies(), headers(), ya searchParams ko seedhe nahi parh sakta hai.
  • ek page/layout file ke top par 'use cache' ke saath, generateMetadata aur generateStaticParams jaise export kiye gaye karyon ko async hona chahiye.
  • Placement ka faisla karta hai ki aap kya cache karte hain: ek page ke top par ek directive page ke output ko cache karta hai aur woh component import karta hai; ek data function cache ke andar ek hi directive keval us function ke parinam ko cache karta hai. jab ek data request mahnga kaam karta hai, to cache us page ke bajaay karya karta hai. 'use cache: remote' ke saath, ek durasth cache handler store entries - badi entries storage aur network lagat ko badha sakti hain.
  • Code udaharan (verbatim):
ts
  // File-level: applies to every export
  'use cache'

  export async function getUser(id: string) {
    return { id }
  }
tsx
  // Function-level: applies to this function only
  export async function User() {
    'use cache'
    return <p>User</p>
  }
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: 'use client' keval file-vyaapee hai; 'use server'/'use cache' file- ya function-star hain; file-star server/cache export async hona chahiye; cache code request-samay APIs ko seedhe sparsh nahi kar sakta hai (jo 'use cache: private' ke liye hai); client boundary paar karke jaane wale props ko serialize hona chahiye.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives

use cache

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai use cache. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: use cache — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Enable (verbatim), How it works — cache keys, Cache output, Serialization, Constraints, Runtime behavior. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: use cache nirdeshan ek route, React component, ya kaishebal ke roop mein karya karta hai. file-top → sabhi export cached; ek function/component → cache ke top par inline. cached functions/components ko async hona chahiye. yeh ek Cache Components feature hai - next.config.ts mein cacheComponents: true ke saath enable hai. v16.0.0 mein static; v15.0.0 mein experimental pesh kiya gaya.

  • Enable (verbatim):
ts
  // next.config.ts
  import type { NextConfig } from 'next'
  const nextConfig: NextConfig = { cacheComponents: true }
  export default nextConfig
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai — cache key: key = dharavahik input: (1) build ID — unique prati build, yeh sab entries invalidates (deploymentId config overrides key prayojnon ke liye ID ka build); (2) function ID — surakshit hash function sthan + hastakshar; (3) dharavahik tark — props (Components) or function args; (4) HMR taza hash (keval dev). external gunjaaishon (band) se capture kiye gaye char automatic roop se tarkon ke roop mein badhya hote hain aur key ka hissa ban jate hain - e.g. ek component parhne ke andar ek nested getData(filter) ko band karne se userId aur filter donon ki key hai. vastav mein parhne ke liye keval mool param key ka hissa ban jate hain. userId
  • Cache output: diye gaye input ke saath pharst call body aur dukaanon ke production ko chalata hai; baad mein usi input ke saath call karta hai, jab tak access chal jata hai tab tak use ek render paas aur requests ke bhitar wapas le jata hai. ek cache handler (default dwara in-memory) dwara revalidation tak store kiya gaya. nested cached call pratyek ko apni entry prapt hoti hai; pahle se hi bhara hua ek internal cached call phir se run nahi hota hai. Prerendering entry bharta hai aur route ke static shell aur prefetch mein yogdan data hai; ek cache life bhi surakshit roop se store karne ke liye request samay par hal ek chhed chhor data hai.
  • Serialization: Args aur return values ko serialize kiya jana chahiye. aargs React Server Components serialization (adhik pratibndhaatmak) ka upyog karte hain; return maan Client Component serialization (JSX wapas kar sakte hain) ka upyog karte hain, lekin paas-through ko chhorakar JSX ko arg ke roop mein accept nahi kar sakte hain. supported args: aadim, plain vastuein, sarani, dates, map, set, TypedArrays, ArrayBuffers, React element (keval paas-through). return maan: saman plus JSX tatva. Unsupported: kaksha ke udaharan, karya (paas-through ko chhorakar), pratik, WeakMaps/WeakSets, URL udaharan. paas-through: gair-serialization maan (e.g). children: ReactNode, Server Actions) ko tab tak accept kiya jaa sakta hai jab tak cache code NOT introspect/call karta hai - bas unhein guzarta hai.
  • Constraints:
  • request samay API: cache code CANNOT access cookies(), headers(), searchParams — pratibandh call stack ka anusaran karta hai (ek helper cached function call jo kisi ko bhi fail rahta hai, next-request-in-use-cache error). dynamic routes par yeh next build passed kar sakta hai aur next start ke tahat fail ho sakta hai. fix: cached gunjaish ke bahar parhein aur tark ke roop mein values ko paas karein.
  • runtime caching: default in-memory LRU. server rahit: entries aam taur par requests par jari nahi rahti hain (pratyek request ek alag udaharan ho sakta hai); common roop se build-time caching kaam karta hai. sva-hosted: entries bani rahti hain; cacheMaxMemorySize ke saath niyantran ka aakaar. hosting provider handler ki jagah le sakte hain; kuchh runtime par use cache output ko store nahi karte hain. na to nirdeshan ek nai deployment (key mein build/deployment ID shamil hain) ko pura karta hai. deploy kiye gaye data ke liye unstable_cache ya fetch cache ka upyog karein. 'use cache: remote' (Redis/KV) jab in-memory kam hoti hai to madad karta hai - lagat storage/network/platform pheesa.
  • Draft Mode: jab enable ho jata hai, to sabhi cached functions/components pratyek request ko phir prapt karte hain aur parinam sahej nahi jate hain. draftMode() ke isEnabled CAN ko use cache gunjaish ke andar padha jaa sakta hai; enable()/disable() andar throw karta hai (keval Route Handlers ya Server Actions mein).
  • React.cache algav: React.cache use cache boundaries ke andar ek prithak dayre mein kaam karta hai - bahar sangrahit value andar dikhai nahi dete hain. iske bajaay function tarkon ke madhyam se data paas karein.
  • Proxy: use cache mein NO ka prabhav Proxy mein hota hai (koi nirdeshan vahan nahi badalta); Proxy dwara imported ek cached function ek sadharan karya ke roop mein chalta hai, aur ismein cacheLife/cacheTag ko bulata hai.
  • Runtime behavior: server: entries mein memory sangrhit, cacheLife se revalidate/expire ka samman karein; cacheHandlers ke madhyam se customize karein. client: stale samay ke liye browser memory mein sangrahit server cache content; client router configuration ki parvah kiye bina minimum 30 second ka stale time lagu karta hai. x-nextjs-stale-time uttar header aajeevan server → client ko soochit karta hai.
  • Revalidation: samay-aadharit cacheLife ke madhyam se (yeh pratyek use cache field mein spasht hone ke liye call karein); cacheTag + revalidateTag/updateTag ke madhyam se on-demand. default profile (jab cacheLife omitted): 5 minat (client), 15 minat (server) revalidate, kabhi samapt nahi ho raha hai. ek spasht cacheLife ke bina ek ke andar ek short-term use cache ko band karna previous ke dauraan build mein fail rahta hai. pair: lanbe cacheLife jaise max + tag un content ke liye jo keval edit par badal jate hain; laghu profile jaise hours un suchiyon ke liye jo din ke madhyam se update karte hain.
  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  export async function getData() {
    'use cache'
    const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data')
    const data = await res.json()
    return data
  }
tsx
  import { cacheLife, cacheTag } from 'next/cache'
  export async function getOrderSummary(accountId: string) {
    'use cache'
    cacheLife('hours')
    const orders = await getOrders(accountId)
    const totals = await getOrderTotals(accountId)
    return { orders, totals }
  }
tsx
  // On-demand: tag + updateTag in a Server Action
  async function getProducts() {
    'use cache'
    cacheTag('products')
    const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/products')
    return res.json()
  }
  // 'use server' action:
  export async function updateProduct() {
    await db.products.update(...)
    updateTag('products') // Invalidates all 'products' caches
  }
tsx
  // File-level: every export cached, all must be async
  'use cache'
  export async function getMonthlyTotals(accountId: string) {
    return db.orders.aggregate({ where: { accountId }, _sum: { amount: true } })
  }
tsx
  // Route segment: add to top of every segment file it renders (page, layout, parallel slots)
  'use cache'
  export default async function Layout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    return <div>{children}</div>
  }

ek cached layout NOT ko children ko cache karta hai jo ise render karta hai (slots paas). Interleaving: children/slots ek cached component ke madhyam se passed kar diya jab tak cached body unhein sandarbhit nahi karta tab tak apni cache entry ko affected nahi karta hai. Server Actions ko cache kiye gaye components ke madhyam se Client Components ko passed kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • Dhyaan Do / samasya nivaran: NEXT_PRIVATE_DEBUG_CACHE=1 npm run dev|start (verbose cache loging) ke saath debag; ISR bhi log karta hai. dev mein, cache kiye gaye karyon se console log ek Cache upasarg ke saath dikhai dete hain. haing ka build: promaaijes tak pahunchna jo uncached/runtime data ko ek use cache boundary ke bahar banaya gaya hai → cached function prerender ke dauraan await karta hai, 50s ke baad timeout: "prerender time out ke dauraan ek cache bharnaa, sambhavna hai kyonki request-vishisht tark jaise ki param, searchParams, cookies() ya uncached data ka upyog 'upyog cache' ke andar kiya gaya tha. fix: bahar runtime values ka wait karna aur plain values ko paas karna; Next.js fetch deduplication ya alag nakshe ka upyog karein. seedhe cookies() / headers() ko bulana ek alag error ke saath turant fail ho jata hai, na ki ek taaimaauta. jab ek cached directive file top par hota hai, to export kiye gaye karyon ko ek Client Component mein import kiya jaa sakta hai aur seedhe (server par chalaya jata hai, jaise ki Server Function) - lekin keval export kiye gaye karya upalabdh hain; any export (constants/objects) ko gira diya jata hai aur import kiya jata hai, jo "export maujud nahi hai" ke saath build mein fail rahta hai - directive ke bina ek alag file mein sajha values ko moved karta hai. generateMetadata/generateStaticParams file leval use cache ke saath ek file mein async hona chahiye.
  • Platform support: Node.js server han; Docker Yes; static export sankhya; optimizer manch-vishishta.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
cache key structure (build ID, function ID, args, band capture, HMR hash); default cacheLife profile (5m stale / 15m revalidate / kabhi samapt nahi); kyon use cache ke andar cookies() fail ho jata hai aur paas-as-argument pattern; server rahit banam sva-hosted runtime caching; use cache banam unstable_cache (kros-deploy dridhta); 50s previous timeout kaarana.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache
Hissa 104 / 471 · App Router · API Reference

use cache: private

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai use cache: private. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: use cache: private — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: When to reach for it, Behavior, Key example (verbatim), Request APIs allowed, Client stale time, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: karyon ko ek cached gunjaish ke andar runtime request API (cookies(), headers(), searchParams) tak pahunchne ki permission data hai. production mein, ONE request ke bhitar match call usi parinam ka pun: upyog kar sakte hain, lekin Next.js NOT ko requests par server cache mein store karta hai. development mein, Next.js ise memory mein store karta hai, request ke cookies aur header ki key rakhta hai, aur ise agle match request par karya karta hai jabki background mein ek naya parinam generated hota hai. client router stale samay ke liye browser memory mein render kiye gaye output ko cacheLife ke saath configure kiya jaa sakta hai; yeh client-side cache page reload ke par nahi rahta hai. v16.0.0 mein Cache Components ke saath sakshama. cacheComponents: true ki requirement hai.

  • Kab iske liye pahunchne ke liye: (1) aap ek aisa karya cache karna chahte hain jo pahle se hi runtime data tak pahunchta hai aur runtime access ko bahar le jaane aur values ko passed karne ke liye riphaiktring karta hai kyonki tark vyaavhaarik nahi hai; (2) aapko request-vishisht data ki requirement hai jo server cache se bahar rakha gaya hai jo production requests ko pura karta hai. Preferred pattern abhi bhi hai: bahar runtime values ko parhein aur tark ke roop mein passed karein.
  • BHavior: Private Cache Functions request samay par chal raha hai aur static shell pidhi se bahar rakha gaya hai. ek component se pahle shuru karne ke liye iske parinam ki requirement hoti hai, data preloading ka upyog karti hai. yeh 'use cache: private' ke liye custom cache haindalars ko configure karne ke liye NOT sanbhav hai.
  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  async function getRecommendations(productId: string) {
    'use cache: private'
    cacheTag(`recommendations-${productId}`)
    cacheLife({ stale: 60 })

    // Access cookies within private cache functions
    const sessionId = (await cookies()).get('session-id')?.value || 'guest'
    return getPersonalizedRecommendations(productId, sessionId)
  }
  • Request APIs ki permission:
APIuse cache mein permission'use cache: private' mein permission
cookies()NoYes
headers()NoYes
searchParamsNoYes
connection()NoNo

connection() ko BOTH mein nishiddh hai kyonki yeh kanekshan-vishisht jankari pradan karta hai jise surakshit roop se cache nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • Client stale time: Private Cache Functions route ke Client Cache mein apne stale samay ka yogdan data hai. yadi kisi function ko keval request-dabaav ki requirement hoti hai, to cacheLife({ stale: Infinity }) ka upyog karein taaki yeh route ke samay ko kam na kare. Next.js route ki cache entries se sabse kam samay ka upyog karta hai, isliye ek any cache/route setting abhi bhi ek parimit value set kar sakti hai. stale: Infinity NOT ko server par production requests par private parinam sangrahit karta hai; client router ko known gap ke baad vyaktigat output ko phir se valid karna chahiye jab ek parimit maan ka upyog karta hai. stale kaam karne ke liye prati-link prefetching ke liye ≥30s hona chahiye, aur root ke App Shell mein shamil hone ke liye content ke liye ≥5 minata.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: private tang jari rakha - production server cache NOT requests par private parinam rakhta hai (keval bhitar-request dedup); dev behavior bhinn hota hai (cookies + header, stale-time-revalidate style dwara key). koi custom cache handler nahi. upyog ka mamla vyaktigat data hai (e.g session cookie dwara recommendations) jo upyogkartaon ko sajha server cache ke madhyam se kabhi bhi leak nahi hona chahiye.

Hissa 105 / 471 · App Router · API Reference

use cache: remote

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai use cache: remote. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: use cache: remote — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why plain `use cache` can underperform, When to avoid remote caching, When remote caching makes sense, Comparison table (verbatim from docs), Persistence across deploys, Caching with runtime data. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: 'use cache: remote' nishchit roop se ek REMOTE cache (ek cache handler, e.g) mein ek cache output store karta hai. in-memory ke bajaay Redis/KV, tikau caching sabhi server udaharanon mein sajha karne ke liye de raha hai. Tradeoffs: buniyadi dhancha lagat + cache lookup par network vilambata. cacheComponents: true ki requirement hai; handler ko cacheHandlers ke madhyam se configure kiya gaya (hosting provider aam taur par ise automatic roop se pradan karte hain; sva-hosting ko ise configure karna chahiye). v16.0.0 mein Cache Components ke saath sakshama. yahan tak ki plain use cache mein abhi bhi server caching se pare value hai: yeh Next.js ko soochit karta hai ki kya prefetch kiya jaa sakta hai aur client navigation ke liye stale time ko define kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • Plain use cache kyun underperform kar sakta hai: in-memory entries evict ho jati hain, memory constraints hote hain, cache requests/restarts ke paar persist nahi karta. Serverless me memory instances ke beech share nahi hoti aur aam taur par request serve karne ke baad khatm ho jati hai → runtime caching ke liye baar-baar misses.
  • Remote caching se kab bachein: tumhare paas pehle se ek server-side KV store hai jo tumhari data layer ko wrap karta hai (use cache static shell me data shamil karne ke liye kaafi ho sakta hai); operations pehle se tez hain (<50ms) — remote lookup madad nahi karega; cache keys zyadaatar har request ke liye unique hain (search filters, price ranges, user params) → utilization near-zero; data har seconds–minutes me badalta hai → hits jaldi stale ho jate hain, baar-baar misses.
  • Remote caching kab samajh me aata hai: content request time par deferred hai (static shell ke bahar), aam taur par kyunki ek component Suspense boundary ke andar cookies()/headers()/searchParams padhta hai — har request component ko execute karta hai aur cache lookup karta hai; serverless instances ki ephemeral memory ki hit rates kam hoti hain; remote instances ke beech ek shared cache deta hai. Compelling scenarios: rate-limited APIs, slow backends ki raksha, expensive operations, flaky/unreliable services. Static shell content ke liye use cache aam taur par kaafi hai; agar upstream concurrent revalidation handle nahi kar sakta (rate-limited CMS), to remote ek shared layer ki tarah kaam karta hai — DB ke saamne KV store wala hi pattern, lekin code me declare kiya gaya.
  • Comparison table (docs se verbatim):
Featureuse cache'use cache: remote''use cache: private'
server-side cachingin-memory ya cache handlerrimot cache handlerNone
cache skopsabhi upyogkartaon ke beech sajhasabhi upyogkartaon ke beech sajhaPer-client (browser)
seedhe cookies/headers access kar sakte hainnahi (arj ke roop mein paas)nahi (arj ke roop mein paas)Yes
server cache upyogstatic shell ke bahar kam ho sakta haiuchch (udaharan ke dauraan sajha)N/A
extra lagatNoneinfrastructure (storage, network)None
vilambata prabhavNonecache handler dekhoNone
pariniyojan ke dauraan parsistNoNoN/A
  • Deploys ke paar persistence: remote entries deploys ke paar persist NAHI hoti — key me deploymentId (jab configured ho) ya buildId shamil hota hai, isliye naya build nayi keys banata hai aur purani entries unreachable ho jati hain. Ye jaanboojh kar hai: builds ke beech function identity hash ya return shape badal sakta hai; entries reuse karna stale/malformed data ka risk hai. Cross-deploy persistence ke liye unstable_cache ya fetch cache use karo.
  • Runtime data ke saath caching: use cache aur remote dono seedhe runtime values access nahi kar sakte — unhe extract karke arguments ke roop me pass karo.
  • Cache key considerations: har unique value = ek alag entry, jo utilization kam karti hai. Low-cardinality dimensions par cache karo aur baaki ko memory me filter karo: getProductsByCategory(category) cache karo (kuch hi categories), phir memory me minPrice se filter karo — har price value ke liye entry mat banao. User data ke liye bhi yehi soch: getUserProfile(sessionID) ko remote cache mat karo (har user ki alag entry, reuse near-zero); getCMSContent(language) remote cache ho sakta hai (us language ke saare users ek entry share karte hain). Agar user-data serve karne wala frontend load ke saath scale nahi kar sakta, to in-memory caching ke liye chhote cacheLife ke saath use cache use karo; zyadaatar user data seedhe source se fetch karo. 'use cache: private' sirf compliance ke liye use karo, ya jab runtime data argument ke roop me pass nahi kar sakte.
  • Nesting rules: remote ko remote ke andar nest kiya ja sakta hai; remote ko regular use cache ke andar nest kiya ja sakta hai; remote ko private ke andar nest NAHI kiya ja sakta; private ko remote ke andar nest NAHI kiya ja sakta (dono invalid combos error dete hain).
  • Key example (verbatim):
tsx
  async function getProductPrice(productId: string, currency: string) {
    'use cache: remote'
    cacheTag(`product-price-${productId}`)
    cacheLife({ expire: 3600 }) // 1 hour
    // Cached per (productId, currency) - few currencies means high cache utilization
    return db.products.getPrice(productId, currency)
  }
tsx
  // Defer to request time with connection(), then remote-cache expensive query
  async function DashboardStats() {
    await connection() // Defer to request time
    const stats = await getGlobalStats()
    return <StatsDisplay stats={stats} />
  }
  async function getGlobalStats() {
    'use cache: remote'
    cacheTag('global-stats')
    cacheLife({ expire: 60 }) // 1 minute
    const stats = await db.analytics.aggregate({ total_users: 'count', active_sessions: 'count', revenue: 'sum' })
    return stats
  }
  // => upstream DB sees at most one request per minute, regardless of traffic
tsx
  // Mixed strategy on one page:
  async function getProduct(id: string) { 'use cache'; cacheTag(`product-${id}`); return db.products.find({ where: { id } }) } // static, build-time
  async function getProductPrice(id: string) { 'use cache: remote'; cacheTag(`product-price-${id}`); cacheLife({ expire: 300 }); return db.products.getPrice({ where: { id } }) } // shared runtime
  async function getRecommendations(productId: string) { 'use cache: private'; cacheLife({ expire: 60 }); const sessionId = (await cookies()).get('session-id')?.value; return db.recommendations.findMany({ where: { productId, sessionId } }) } // per-user, never shared
  • Dhyaan do / interview point: remote caches server-side store hote hain aur saare users ke liye shared hote hain — unme kabhi per-user data mat daalo (uske liye private use karo); ye static shell ke bahar kaam karta hai jahan use cache server hits nahi de sakta; cacheTag / revalidateTag se invalidate hota hai, cacheLife se expire hota hai; static export: nahi; adapter: haan (plain use cache ki tarah, jahan adapters platform-specific hain).
  • Platform support: Node.js haan; Docker haan; static export nahi; adapter haan.

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai use client. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: use client — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage, Key example (verbatim), Props must be serializable, Nesting pattern, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: 'use client' client side par render kiye jaane wale components ke liye ek access point declare karta hai. ise interactive UI ke liye client-side JS ki requirement ke liye upyog karein: state prabandhan, event prabandhan, browser API. yeh ek React feature hai. yeh server/client boundary ko define karta hai; aisi file se export kiye gaye component client ko entry points ke roop mein serve karte hain.

  • Usage: kisi bhi import se pahle file ke TOP mein 'use client' jorein. yeh pure module par lagu hota hai aur CANNOT ko ek component ya function ke andar rakha jata hai.
  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  'use client'

  import { useState } from 'react'

  export default function Counter() {
    const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
    return (
      <div>
        <p>Count: {count}</p>
        <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>
      </div>
    )
  }
  • Props dharavahik hona chahiye: Client Component props ek format mein hona chahiye React data server → client bhejne par kramabaddh kar sakte hain. ek plain function prop NOT serialized hai:
tsx
  'use client'
  export default function Counter({
    onClick /* ❌ Function is not serializable */,
  }) {
    return <button onClick={onClick}>Increment</button>
  }

(Exception: Server Functions CAN sandarbh ke roop mein boundary ko par karte hain.)

  • Nesting pattern: static content, data lane, SEO ke liye Server Components; interactive elements (state, prabhav, browser API) ke liye Client Components; Server Components ke andar nested Client Components dwara rachna. udaharan: ek Server Component Page server Header + client Counter import karta hai aur donon pradan karta hai.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: aap NOT ko Client Components yukt pratyek file mein 'use client' ki requirement hoti hai - keval un files mein jinke component aap seedhe Server Components ke bhitar render karna chahte hain; ek 'use client' file dwara imported files pahle se hi client-side hain. 'use client' ka matalab "keval client par rendering" nahi hai - Client Components abhi bhi server (SSR) par hydrated hai. sandarbh: React docs react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai use server. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: use server — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: File-level usage (verbatim), Using Server Functions in a Client Component, Inline usage (verbatim), Security considerations, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: 'use server' server side par executed karne ke liye ek function ya file ko nirdisht karta hai. file-top → file mein sabhi karya server-side hain; ek function ke top par inline → ank jo ek Server Function ke roop mein karya karte hain. React feature. Next.js-vishisht Server Action behaviors (pratikriya modal, security, config, deployment) ke liye, Server Actions guide dekhein. Proxy NOT ko directive morph karta hai, isliye 'use server' ka Proxy mein koi prabhav nahi hai - ek Server Function kahin aur ek sadharan karya ke roop mein chalta hai jab Proxy ise import karta hai.

  • File-level use (verbatim):
tsx
  'use server'

  import { db } from '@/lib/db'
  import { auth } from '@/lib/auth'

  export async function createUser(data: { name: string; email: string }) {
    const session = await auth()
    if (!session?.user) {
      throw new Error('Unauthorized')
    }
    const user = await db.user.create({ data })
    return { id: user.id, name: user.name }
  }
  • ek Client Component mein Using Server Functions: unhein file-top 'use server' ke saath samarpit file mein banaein, phir client (ya server) component mein import karein aur executed karein. client ko ek sandarbh milta hai, code nahi:
tsx
  'use client'
  import { fetchUsers } from '../actions'

  export default function MyButton() {
    return <button onClick={() => fetchUsers()}>Fetch Users</button>
  }
  • Inline upyog (verbatim): A Server Function ko Server Component ke andar define kiya gaya hai, jise Client Component (e.g) ke prop ke roop mein passed kiya gaya hai.
tsx
  export default async function PostPage({ params }: PageProps<'/posts/[id]'>) {
    const { id } = await params
    const post = await getPost(id)

    async function updatePost(formData: FormData) {
      'use server'
      await savePost(id, formData)
      revalidatePath(`/posts/${id}`)
    }

    return <EditPost updatePostAction={updatePost} post={post} />
  }

not karein band id - Server Functions server values par band kar sakte hain.

  • Security vicharon: design data-access karyon ko surakshit praaimitaaivs ke roop mein: valid input, check auth/authz, keval kolar ki zaroorat ke anusar return prakar ko controlled karein. ek Data Access Layer ko saunp dein taaki ek sthan par rahne ki guarantee di jaa sake. hamesha sanvedanshil operation se pahle authenticate/authorize; karya mapdandon ke roop mein token accept karne ke bajaay cookies/headers se auth padha. return value ko serialize kiya jata hai aur client ko bheja jata hai - keval wapas lautein ki UI ki zaroorat kya hai, kachche DB rikord nahi hai.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: file star 'use server' export async hona chahiye; inline Server Functions kaise <form action={...}> kaam karta hai; Server Functions client se call karne yogy hain lekin server (network round-trip, args/return dharavahik); kabhi bhi client-paas wale auth toknon par bharosa nahi karta - session server-side ko parhein; Proxy mein 'use server' ek no-op hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Font Module. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Font Module — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works, Key example (verbatim), Options reference, Applying styles — three ways, Google Fonts — non-variable fonts need a weight, Multiple fonts. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next/font automatic roop se font (custom font sahit) ko customize karta hai aur behatar privacy aur performance ke liye external network requests ko hata data hai. kisi bhi font file ke liye built-in automatic sva-hosting - optimal roop se koi layout shift (CLS) ke saath web font load karein. Google Fonts: CSS aur font files ko build samay par download kiya jata hai aur aapki baki static assets ke saath sva-host kiya jata hai; no requests ko Google ko browser dwara bheja jata hai. chunki v13.2.0 @next/font ko next/font naam diya gaya tha aur koi installation ki requirement nahi hai ( mein @next/font ke roop mein joda gaya). v13.0.0

  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: ek font loader function import karta hai (Google fonts ke liye next/font/google, local files ke liye next/font/local), ise vikalp ke saath bulata hai, aur laute objekt ke className, style, ya variable ko elements ke liye lagu karta hai. loader ek pathniy object data hai. pratyek call font ko ek udaharan ke roop mein host karta hai - ek bar paribhasha file mein ek font load karein aur us objekt ko import karein jahan required ho.
  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'
  // If loading a variable font, you don't need to specify the font weight
  const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'], display: 'swap' })
  export default function RootLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return (
      <html lang="en" className={inter.className}>
        <body>{children}</body>
      </html>
    )
  }
  • Options sandarbh:
Optionfont/googlefont/localRequired
src✗✓han (keval local)
weight✓✓yadi required ho to NOT ek parivartaniy font
style✓✓optional (default 'normal')
subsets✓✗Optional
axes✓✗Optional
display✓✓optional (default 'swap')
preload✓✓optional (default true)
fallback✓✓optional (taaron ki array, koi default nahi)
adjustFontFallback✓✓Optional
variable✓✓Optional
declarations✗✓Optional
  • src (keval local): path string ya {path, weight?, style?} ki array directory ke relative jahan loader ko bulaya jata hai, e.g. src: './fonts/my-font.woff2' ya src: [{path: './inter/Inter-Thin.ttf', weight: '100'}, {path: './inter/Inter-Bold-Italic.ttf', weight: '700', style: 'italic'}].
  • weight: string ('400', ya ek reinj '100 900' for veriyebal fonts) ya gair parivartaniy font (['100','400','900'] - keval Google) ke liye vajan ki array. antar ke maan: '100'-'900' ya 'variable' (default).
  • style: 'normal'/'italic' (google); kisi bhi manak maan e.g. local ke liye 'oblique'; gair parivartaniy Google fonts ke liye array.
  • subsets: array e.g. ['latin'] Google Fonts automatic roop se subsetted (chhoti files) hain. subsets mein fonts ko <head> mein ek link preload tag milta hai jab preload sahi hota hai. kisi bhi sabset ko nirdisht karne mein fail rahte hue preload true ek warning paida karta hai.
  • axes: vajan se pare extra char font aksh, e.g. intar ke liye axes: ['slnt']; Google veriyebal fonts page ( ke alava any x) par ek font ki kulhaaree khojein. wght
  • display: font-display maan — 'auto', 'block', 'swap' (default), 'fallback', 'optional'.
  • preload: Boolean, default true. pratyek font file ek call load is setting (@font-face niymon ka single group, ek font-family) ko sajha karta hai.
  • fallback: array e.g. ['system-ui', 'arial'], yadi font load nahi ho sakta hai to iska upyog kiya jata hai.
  • adjustFontFallback: CLS ko kam karne ke liye automatic fallback fonta. Google: boolean, default true. local: 'Arial', 'Times New Roman', ya false; default 'Arial'.
  • variable: CSS char naam e.g. CSS-variable vidhi ke liye '--my-font'.
  • declarations (keval local): @font-face varnanakartaa key-value jore, e.g ki array. [{ prop: 'ascent-override', value: '90%' }]; setting font-family generated naam ki jagah leta hai - ise export static rakhne ke liye className aur CSS parivartaniy sandarbh ek hi parivar ke saman hai.
  • Applying styles - teen tarike: (1) className: load font ke liye keval kaksha, e.g. <p className={inter.className}>; (2) style: read-only style objekt incl. style.fontFamily, e.g. <p style={inter.style}>; (3) CSS char: variable: '--font-inter' set karein, inter.variable ko ek mool container mein lagu karein, phir CSS mein font-family: var(--font-inter) ka upyog karein.
  • Google Fonts - gair parivartaniy fonts ko vajan ki requirement hoti hai: Roboto({ weight: '400', subsets: ['latin'], display: 'swap' }); multiple weights/styles array ke madhyam se: weight: ['400','700'], style: ['normal','italic']. multi-vard font naam ek andaraskor ka upyog karte hain: Roboto Mono → Roboto_Mono.
  • Multiple fonts: do drishtikon — (a) ek utility/definitions file (e.g). app/fonts.ts) pratyek font object ka export karta hai, import kiya jata hai jahan zaroorat hoti hai to pratyek font ko keval jab render kiya jata hai; (b) CSS char <html> (className={${inter.variable} ${roboto_mono.variable}}}) ke saath CSS jaise html { font-family: var(--font-inter); } h1 { font-family: var(--font-roboto-mono); }. sifarish: multiple fonts ka upyog roorhivaadee roop se karein - pratyek ek extra client download hai.
  • Local fonts: import localFont from 'next/font/local'; localFont({ src: './my-font.woff2', display: 'swap' }); font files ko app ke andar kaataa jaa sakta hai. prati file path/weight/style ke saath src array ke madhyam se ek parivar ke liye multiple files.
  • Tailwind CSS: CSS-variable vidhi ka upyog karta hai, phir Tailwind v4: @theme inline { --font-sans: var(--font-inter); --font-mono: var(--font-roboto-mono); }; Tailwind v3: theme.extend.fontFamily: { sans: ['var(--font-inter)'], mono: ['var(--font-roboto-mono)'] }, phir font-sans/font-mono upyogitaon ka prayog karte hain. veriyebal <html> ya <body> par jaa sakte hain.
  • Font paribhasha file: ek file banaein (e.g). styles/fonts.ts) ek bar sabhi phonton ko define karta hai aur unhein export karta hai; aasan import ke liye tsconfig.json/jsconfig.json ("@/fonts": ["./styles/fonts"]) mein ek path alias jorein.
  • Preloading gunjaish: ek font ko keval related routes par preload kiya jata hai, jis par loader ko bulaya jata hai: unique page → woh route keval; layout → iske dwara lipte sabhi routes; root layout → sabhi routes.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: Prefer char fonts (koi weight ki zaroorat hai, sabse achha performance/flexibility); runtime par koi Google request nahi (build-time download + self-host); subsets ke bina preload: true warning data hai; pratyek loader call = ek hosted udaharan, isliye ek paribhasha file ke madhyam se sajha karein; adjustFontFallback default Google (true) aur local ('Arial') ke beech bhinn hote hain.

Form Component (`<Form>`)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Form Component (`<Form>`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Form Component (`<Form>`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Behavior depends on `action` type, Key example (verbatim), Props — string `action`, Props — function `action`, Search-form pattern, Mutations pattern. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: <Form> (next/form se) HTML <form> element ko badha data hai taaki UI ko load karne, jama karne par client-side navigation aur pragtishil vriddhi ko prefetch kiya jaa sake. yeh un rupon ke liye sabse upyogi hai jo URL khoj param ko update karte hain, anyatha un teen behaviors ke liye required boyalaraplet ko hatate hain.

  • BHavior action prakar: par nirbhar karta hai
  • action ek string hai: GET E vidhi ka upyog karke ek mool HTML form ki tarah behavior karta hai - form data ko URL mein khoj param ke roop mein kodit kiya jata hai aur jama karne ke liye us URL ko navigate karta hai. iske alava, Next.js us path ki bhavishyavani karta hai jab form dikhai data hai ( aur loading.js jaise sajha UI) aur ek full page reload ke bajaay client-side navigation karta hai (retains ne UI aur client-side state sajha kiya). layout.js
  • action ek function (Server Action) hai: ek React <form> ki tarah behavior karta hai, jo render karne par action ko karyanvit karta hai. chunki yeh destination tab tak agyat hai jab tak ki action chal jati hai, to <Form> is mode mein sajha UI ko nahi rok sakta hai.
  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  import Form from 'next/form'
  export default function Page() {
    return (
      <Form action="/search">
        {/* On submission, the input value will be appended to the URL, e.g. /search?query=abc */}
        <input name="query" />
        <button type="submit">Submit</button>
      </Form>
    )
  }
  • Props — string action:
PropExampleTypeRequired
actionaction="/search"string (URL ya relative path)Yes
replacereplace={false}boolean–
scrollscroll={true}boolean–
prefetchprefetch={true}boolean–
  • action: URL/path navigate karne ke liye; khali string "" update khoj param ke saath usi route par navigate karta hai.
  • replace: ek nai entry ko dhakka dene ke bajaay vartaman history ki sthiti ko replace karta hai; default false.
  • scroll: navigation par scroll ko controlled karta hai; default true (naye route ke top par scroll karta hai, back/forward ke liye sthiti rakhta hai).
  • prefetch: kya jab form viewport mein access karta hai to path ko prefetch karna; default true.
  • Props - function action: keval action ( Server Action) ki requirement hai. is mode mein replace aur scroll ko nazarandaz kar diya gaya hai.
  • Search-form pattern: parinamon ke page par, searchParams page prop (searchParams: Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }>) ke madhyam se query parhne aur parinam prapt karne ke liye. jama karne par, form turant navigate karta hai aur parinam load karte samay loading.js ko dikhata hai; tatkal pending pratikriya ke liye 'use client' button component mein useFormStatus (React) ka upyog karein, e.g button tekst status.pending? 'Searching...': 'Search'.
  • Mutations pattern: <Form action={createPost}> ek 'use server' action ke saath jo mutation karta hai to redirect(/posts/${data.id} se next/navigation. )
  • Caveats / gotchas:
  • ek jama button/input overrides action (client-side navigation abhi bhi hota hai) par NOT support prefetching; basePath ke saath, ise formAction path (e.g) mein shamil kiya gaya. /base-path/search) formAction
  • ek string-action <Form> par key prop supported nahi hai - yadi aapko re-render/mutation trigger ki requirement hai to ek function action ka upyog karein.
  • onSubmit karya karta hai, lekin event.preventDefault() ko <Form> behavior (e.g) ko override karta hai.
  • method, encType, target NOT supported hain (ve <Form> behavior ko override kareinge); isi tarah formMethod/formEncType/formTarget mool browser behavior mein wapas aate hain - yadi aapko unki requirement ho to plain HTML <form> ka upyog karein.
  • ek string action ke saath <input type="file"> browser behavior se match karta hai: file naam jama karta hai, file objekt nahi.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
kyon <Form> khoj ke liye plain <form> par (prefetch + client-side nev + pragtishil vriddhi); string banam function action (GET khoj-params navigation banam Server Action mutation, keval string mode mein prefetch); replace / scroll / prefetch default; UI pending ke liye useFormStatus.
