Image Component (`next/image`)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Image Component (`next/image`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Image Component (`next/image`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Props, How `src` works, `fill` + `objectFit`, `sizes` and `srcset` generation, `loader`, `preload` vs `loading="eager"` vs `fetchPriority`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: <Image> automatic image optimization ke liye HTML <img> element ka vistar karta hai: size badalane, aadhunik formats, lazy loading, aur CLS rokthaam (width/height se pahlu anupat ke madhyam se antriksh ko bachata hai). mool upyog: import Image from 'next/image' to <Image src="/profile.png" width={500} height={500} alt="Picture of the author" />.

  • Props:
PropType Status/notes
srcStringrequired - internal path, full external URL ( ki zaroorat), ya static import remotePatterns
altStringrequired - screen readers/SEO ke liye varnanatmak text; puri tarah se decorative images ke liye alt=""
width / heightInteger (px)internal size; reserved sthan ke liye pahlu anupat (sanshodhit size nahi, jo CSS niyantran) ko lagu karta hai. jab tak static import ya fill
fillBooleanimage parent ke size ka vistar karti hai; parent ko position: relative/fixed/absolute hona chahiye; <img> khud hi position: absolute hai.
loaderFunctioncustom URL janretar ({src, width, quality}) => string
sizesStringe.g "(max-width: 768px) 100vw, 33vw" — browser ko batata hai jo srcset entry ko chunne ke liye
qualityInteger 1–100default 75; configure kiye gaye qualities permission list mein nikatatam value ki tulna mein
preloadBooleandefault false; true ne <head> mein <link> preload dala (ek known LCP/hero image ke liye upyog karein)
placeholderStringempty (default), blur, ya data:image/... URL
styleObjectbuilt-in <img> ke liye CSS; yadi custom chaudai set ki jati hai, to height: 'auto' bhi set kiya jata hai.
onLoad / onErrorFunctioncallback; Client Components ki requirement hoti hai (function props ko serialize karna chahiye)
onLoadingCompleteFunctionNext.js 14 mein Deprecated - onLoad ka upyog karein
loadingStringlazy (default) ya eager
blurDataURLStringdata URL plesholdar; jpg/png/webp/avif (unless enimeted) ke static import ke liye auto-set; dynamic/remote (tools: png-pixel.com, Plaiceholder) ke liye manual - ise chhota rakhein (≤10px recommended)
unoptimizedBooleanImage Optimization API ko chhorein, ke roop mein kaam karte hain (chhote <1KB image, SVG, GIF)
overrideSrcStringkeval generated src visheshata (keeps generated srcset) ko override karta hai - SEO/image rainking ko preserve karne ke liye <img> se migrate karte samay upyogi
decodingStringdefault async; sync ya auto

priority ko Next.js 16 mein define kiya gaya hai - preload (same preloading behavior) ya loading="eager" (keval lazy loading ko disabled karein) ka upyog karein. baaki saare props srcSet ko chhodkar built-in <img> ko waise ke waise pass ho jate hain (uske bajaay deviceSizes ka upyog karein).

  • Kaise src kaam karta hai: internal path string; absolute external URL (remotePatterns ke saath configure hona chahiye); static import (import profile from './profile.png' — width/height auto-inferred, blurDataURL auto-added). Security: default loader src fetch karte samay headers forward NAHI karta; agar source ko auth chahiye, to unoptimized use karo.
  • fill + objectFit: koi style nahi → image container me stretch hoti hai; style={{objectFit: 'contain'}} (scale down, aspect ratio preserve) ya 'cover' (fill + crop) use karo. Hamesha sizes ke saath pair karo taaki browser 100vw assume na kare aur oversized images download na kare.
  • sizes aur srcset generation: ek fixed-width image → limited srcset (1x, 2x); fill image → deviceSizes se srcset (full viewport jaisa); sizes → full srcset (640w, 750w, ...) ke saath. Responsive/fill images par missing sizes unnecessarily bade downloads ka kaaran banta hai.
  • loader: custom function ({ src, width, quality }) => string; ya globally next.config.js me set karo (images: { loader: 'custom', loaderFile: './my/image/loader.js' }, file ko default roop se ek function export karna hoga jo ek URL string return karta hai).
  • preload vs loading="eager" vs fetchPriority: ek known LCP image ke liye preload use karo (<img> se pehle load hona start hota hai). Jab multiple images LCP ho sakti hain, ya jab loading/fetchPriority use ho raha ho to iska use mat karo. Aam taur par loading="eager" + fetchPriority="high" above-the-fold images ke liye kaafi hai (fetchPriority akele lazy loading disable nahi karta). React SSR ke dauraan eagerly loaded images ko auto-preload bhi kar sakta hai.
  • Config (images) next.config.js me:
  • localPatterns: local paths ki allow list (jaise pathname: '/assets/images/**', search: ''); koi bhi dusra path → 400. search omit karna kisi bhi query string ko allow karta hai (security risk — ek exact value pin karo).
  • remotePatterns: external URLs ki allow list — objects {protocol, hostname, port, pathname, search} ya new URL('https://example.com/account123/**'); unmatched → 400. Wildcards: * = ek segment/subdomain, ** = end/beginning me koi bhi number (beech me nahi). Ek field omit karne ka matlab ** hai (recommended nahi). Redirects ko bina re-validate kiye follow kiya jata hai (redirects ko maximumRedirects ke saath control karo).
  • path: Image Optimization API ke liye prefix, default /_next/image.
  • deviceSizes: default [640, 750, 828, 1080, 1200, 1920, 2048, 3840]; imageSizes: default [32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384] (sirf sizes ke saath use hota hai).
  • qualities: default [75]; Next.js 16 se required (unrestricted qualities ka abuse ho sakta hai). Out-of-range quality nearest allowed value par clamp hoti hai; direct API unused quality ke saath → 400.
  • formats: default ['image/webp']; browser ka Accept header sabse achha match pick karta hai, jo array order me pehla match jeet-ta hai; AVIF optional (['image/avif', 'image/webp'] — AVIF encode karne me ~50% slow, ~20% chhota; har format alag cache hota hai). Self-hosted proxy/CDN ko Accept header forward karna chahiye.
  • minimumCacheTTL: default 14400 (4h); expiry = max(minimumCacheTTL, upstream Cache-Control). Koi invalidation mechanism nahi — ise kam rakho, ya src badlo / <distDir>/cache/images delete karo. Static imports ke bajaye filename + immutable caching hoti hai.
  • disableStaticImages: true static image imports disable karta hai.
  • maximumRedirects: default 3 (0 = disable); maximumDiskCacheSize: default startup par available disk ka 50%, 0 disk cache disable karta hai (limit se zyada hone par LRU eviction); maximumResponseBody: default 50MB source-image fetch cap (memory-controlled servers par kam karo, jaise 5MB). Respectively v16.1.7 / v16.1.2 me jode gaye.
  • dangerouslyAllowLocalIP: default false — ek private network (SSRF risk) par local IPs se images optimize karne ki permission deta hai; sirf tab jab tum risk samajhte ho, jaise VPC split-horizon DNS 400s.
  • dangerouslyAllowSVG: default false — Next.js kabhi SVG (vector) optimize nahi karta, aasani se nuksaan pahuncha sakta hai; SVGs me scripts ho sakti hain → CSP risk. .svg ke liye unoptimized prefer karo (automatic jab src .svg par end ho). Agar enable karo, to contentDispositionType: 'attachment' + contentSecurityPolicy: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; sandbox;" set karo.
  • contentDispositionType: default attachment (har image ko directly visit karne par download karta hai; inline render karne ki permission deta hai); contentSecurityPolicy: served images ke liye CSP header.
  • Deprecated: domains (Next.js 14, remotePatterns use karo — domains me koi wildcards nahi, protocol/port/path restrictions nahi, aur shared hosts unsafe hain).
  • getImageProps (next/image se): un props ko return karta hai jo built-in <img> par jayenge taaki tum unhe kisi dusre component/canvas/CSS me pass kar sako. Example: const { props } = getImageProps({ src, alt, width: 1200, height: 800 }) se <img {...props} />. useState se bacho, behtar performance; placeholder ke saath use nahi ho sakta (placeholder kabhi hataya nahi gaya). Art direction (<picture><source media="..." srcSet={...} /> ke through per-breakpoint alag src/width/height/quality) aur CSS background images (srcSet ko image-set() me convert karo) ko power karta hai.
  • Examples / patterns: className ya style ke saath styling, style-jsx nahi; remote images ke liye width/height manually supply karni chahiye (Next.js build me remote files nahi padh sakta) + optional blurDataURL; fill + objectFit: 'cover' images ke liye sizes="100vw", placeholder="blur", quality={100} background ke liye; theme detection — do <Image> ko @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) ke saath wrap karo; loading="lazy" sirf ek visible load ke saath (yahan preload/eager use mat karo — dono load ho jayenge; iske bajaye fetchPriority="high" use karo); responsive grid/background sizes="100vw" style={{width: '100%', height: 'auto'}} width height ke saath.
  • Known browser bugs: native lazy loading Safari 15.4 se pehle eager ho jata hai; blur placeholder Safari 12 se pehle empty ho jata hai; width/height: auto Safari 15 se pehle layout shift ka kaaran ban sakta hai (koi aspect-ratio preservation nahi); Safari 15-16.3 loading ke dauraan ek grey border dikhata hai (fix: clip-path: inset(0.6px) hack ya fold ke upar loading="eager"); Firefox 67+ loading ke dauraan white background dikhata hai (fix: AVIF format ya placeholder).
  • Version history (key): v16.0.0 — qualities default [75], preload joda gaya, priority deprecated, dangerouslyAllowLocalIP + maximumRedirects jode gaye; v15.3.0 — remotePatterns URL objects accept karta hai; v14.2.0 — overrideSrc joda gaya; v14.1.0 — getImageProps stable; v14.0.0 — onLoadingComplete + domains deprecated; v13.0.0 — next/image ne next/future/image ko replace kiya, <span> wrapper hataya, layout/objectFit/lazyBoundary/alt changes.
  • Dhyaan do / interview points: width/height aspect ratio set karte hain, size nahi; fill ko ek positioned parent chahiye; hamesha fill/responsive images ke saath sizes set karo; remote images ko remotePatterns + manual dimensions chahiye; quality 75 default aur v16 qualities allow list; preload (v16) priority ko replace karta hai; SVG kabhi default roop se optimize nahi hota; art direction/backgrounds ke liye getImageProps.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/components/image

Link Component (`next/link`)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Link Component (`next/link`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Link Component (`next/link`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key example (verbatim), Props, Examples, Sticky-header scroll offset, Prefetching links in Proxy, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: <Link> routes ke beech prefetching aur client-side navigation pradan karne ke liye HTML <a> element ko badhata hai; yeh Next.js mein navigate karne ka prathmik tareeka hai. <a> visheshataon jaise className ya target="_blank" ko built-in <a> ko props aur flow ke roop mein passed kiya jaa sakta hai. chunki v13.0.0 koi bachcha <a> tag ki requirement nahi hai (codemod upalabdh).

  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  import Link from 'next/link'
  export default function Page() {
    return <Link href="/dashboard">Dashboard</Link>
  }
  • Props:
PropExampleTypeRequired
hrefhref="/dashboard"string ya objektYes
replacereplace={false}Boolean– (default false)
scrollscroll={false}Boolean– (default true)
prefetchprefetch={false}boolean, "auto", ya null– (default "auto"/null)
onNavigateonNavigate={(e) => {}}Function–
transitionTypestransitionTypes={['slide-in']}string[]–
  • href: path/URL, ya ek object { pathname: '/about', query: { name: 'test' } } → /about?name=test.
  • replace: true ek nai entry ko dhakka dene ke bajaay vartaman history ki sthiti ko replace karta hai.
  • scroll: default true - browser back/forward ki tarah scroll sthiti ko banaye rakhta hai; yadi naya page viewport mein dikhai data hai, to sthiti rahti hai; yadi drishyaman nahi hai, to Next.js pahle page element ke top par scroll karta hai. scroll={false} pahle page element par scroll karne mein disabled hai. internal roop se Next.js top level ke elements ka inspect karke scroll target ko dhoondhta hai, gair-skrolebal, sticky/fixed ko chhor data hai, aur jab tak ki yeh drishyaman scroll karne yogy nahi pata hai tab tak gair-vizual tatva.
  • prefetch: prefetching tab hota hai jab <Link> viewport (initial roop se ya scroll ke madhyam se); yadi prefetched data hovar time se samapt ho gaya hai, to Next.js phir preephecha. Only production mein enable.
  • "auto" ya null (default): static route → full route prefetched (sabhi data sahit); dynamic route → ek loading.js boundary ke saath nikatatam segment ke neeche partial marg.
  • true: static aur dynamic routes donon ke liye full route; Partial Prefetching ke saath, prefetch mein link ke URL data ke aadhar par App Shell + cached content shamil hai.
  • false: kabhi nahi prefetch, viewport entry ya hovar para.
  • partialPrefetching: true ke saath, default parivartan: auto pure page ke bajaay prati root App Shell (static + cached content) ko priority data hai.
  • onNavigate (v15.3.0): handler jise client-side navigation ke dauraan bulaya jata hai; navigation ko radd karne ke liye preventDefault() ke saath ek program prapt karta hai. keval SPA navigation ke liye chalata hai - Ctrl/Cmd + click (naya tab, onClick abhi bhi aag) ke liye nahi, external URL ke liye nahi, download link ke liye nahi. ise block navigation ke liye upyog karein (e.g. unsaved-changes ek React sandarbh ke madhyam se pushti link par sajha: ek NavigationBlockerProvider track isBlocked, ek custom CustomLink onNavigate mein e.preventDefault() call karta hai jab tak window.confirm('You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?') guzarta hai).
  • transitionTypes (v16.2.0): navigation transition ke andar React.addTransitionType ko passed transition prakaron ki list, <ViewTransition> components ko vibhinn prakar ke navigation prakar ke anusar alag-alag tarike se alag-alag alag-alag alag-alag alag-alag alag-alag tarike se alag karne data hai. link ka anusaran karte samay lagu hota hai; browser Back/Forward view-transition animation ko trigger nahi karta hai.
  • Examples: template literals ke madhyam se dynamic segment: <Link href={/blog/${post.slug}}>{post.title}</Link>; usePathname() (Client Component) ke madhyam se active link pathname === href ki tulna mein active class jorne ke liye; hash link: <Link href="/dashboard#settings"> <a href="/dashboard#settings"> render karta hai aur id (Next.js) ko page par scroll karta hai yadi navigation par dikhai nahi data hai); hash link (href="/#hashid") ya router.push('/dashboard', { scroll: false }) ke saath scroll={false}.
  • Sticky-header scroll offset: Next.js scroll target ko khojne ke dauraan sticky/fixed elements ko chhor data hai, isliye content ek sticky header ke pichhe chhip sakti hai. CSS scroll-padding-top: 64px ke saath vyaktigat target par html (match header oonchaaee) ya scroll-margin-top par theek karein - jab bhi Next.js mool scrollIntoView() ka upyog karta hai, jismein hash navigation shamil hai.
  • Prefetching Link in Proxy: jab Proxy phir likhte hain (e.g). /dashboard → /auth/dashboard ya /public/dashboard cookie dwara), <Link> ko extra proxy receipts se bachne ke liye disple URL aur prefetch URL donon ki requirement hoti hai: (legacy) as prop — <Link as="/dashboard" href={path}> ka upyog karein jahan path actual route chunee gai client-side (e.g) hai.
  • Version history: v16.2.0 — transitionTypes joda gaya; v15.4.0 — auto alia for default prefetch; v15.3.0 — onNavigate joda gaya; v13.0.0 — koi bachcha <a> ki zaroorat; v10.0.0 — dynamic root href auto-resolved, koi as ki zaroorat; v8.0.0 — behatar prefetching; v1.0.0 — next/link ki shuruaat hui.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: prefetch keval production mein, viewport entry par trigger; default prefetch static banam dynamic bhinn hota hai; onNavigate banam onClick (navigation-only, cancellable, modifier-click/external/download ko chhor data hai); scroll default hamesha top par scroll karne ke bajaay sthiti banaye rakhta hai; as abhi bhi Proxy-rewritten prefetch target ke liye mayne rakhta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/components/link

Script Component (`next/script`)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Script Component (`next/script`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Script Component (`next/script`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Props, `strategy` — four loading strategies, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: <Script> (next/script se) third-party lipiyon ka optimization karta hai. features/usage ke liye Optimizing Scripts guide dekhein; yeh page props sandarbh hai. buniyadi upyog: <Script src="https://example.com/script.js" />.

  • Props:
PropTypeRequired
srcstring (asabhy external URL ya internal path)jab tak ek inline script ka upyog nahi kiya jata hai
strategyString–
onLoadFunction–
onReadyFunction–
onErrorFunction–
  • strategy - chaar loading rannitiyon:
  • beforeInteractive: server se initial HTML mein injekt kiya gaya, kisi bhi Next.js module se pahle download kiya gaya, jo plesmeint ordar mein executed kiya gaya. kisi bhi pahli party code se pahle Preloaded/fetched, lekin execution NOT block hydration karta hai. ek root layout (app/layout.tsx ya app/[locale]/layout.tsx) ke andar rakha jana chahiye; load jab koi page server-side load ho jata hai. hamesha plesmeint ki parvah kiye bina <head> mein injekt kiya jata hai. prati dastavez load ek bar run - client-side navigation unhein phir se run nahi karta hai, yahan tak ki root-param-only parivartan (/en → /fi, root layout aprivartit) ke liye bhi. keval mahatvapurn lipiyon ke liye required ASAP: bot ditektron, cookie sahamati prabandhaka.
  • afterInteractive ( default): injekshan client side, some/all hydration ke baad loda. script ke liye ASAP ki requirement hoti hai lekin pahle-party code se pahle nahi. kisi bhi page/layout mein rakha jaa sakta hai; keval tab load hota hai jab page/group khulta hai. udaharan: tag mainejar, analytics.
  • lazyOnload: sabhi page sansadhanon ko prapt karne ke baad browser inactive samay ke dauraan client-side injekt kiya gaya. background/low-priority script ke liye. kisi bhi page/layout. udaharan: chait support plagins, soshal media vijeta.
  • worker (experimental): main dhage ko mukt karne ke liye script ko web worker ko utaar data hai; next.config.js mein experimental: { nextScriptWorkers: true } ki requirement hoti hai. abhi tak static nahi hai, abhi tak App Router ke saath kaam nahi karta hai, vartaman mein keval pages/ mein upyog yogy hai; advanced upyog ka mamla, sabhi third-party lipiyon ka support karne ki guarantee nahi data hai.
  • Callbacks (sabhi client-Components-only; koi bhi Server Components mein kaam nahi karta hai):
  • onLoad: script khatm hone ke baad ek bar code chalata hai (keval afterInteractive ya lazyOnload ke saath). iska upyog beforeInteractive ke saath nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - iske bajaay onReady ka upyog karein. udaharan: CDN, onLoad={() => console.log(_.sample([1, 2, 3, 4]))} se lodaish load karne ke baad.
  • onReady: pratyek baad ke component phir-mount (e.g) par load AND ke baad chalta hai, jiska upyog tab kiya jata hai jab ek script ko prati mount phir se installed kiya jana chahiye, to e.g ek Google Maps embed: <Script id="google-maps" src="https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js" onReady={() => { new google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, { center: { lat: -34.397, lng: 150.644 }, zoom: 8 }) }} />.
  • onError: load viphalta ko sambhalti hai, e.g. onError={(e) => console.error('Script failed to load', e)} beforeInteractive ke saath istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — beforeInteractive/afterInteractive ko app ka support karne ke liye sanshodhit kiya gaya; v12.2.4 — onReady joda gaya; v12.2.2 — beforeInteractive ne _document mein permission di; v11.0.0 — next/script ne pesh kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: ranniti vikalp = jab script hydration (beforeInteractive = initial HTML, afterInteractive = default post hydration, lazyOnload = inactive, worker = experimental/pages-only); onLoad banam onReady (ek bar mount banam); sabhi callback ko 'use client' ki requirement hoti hai; beforeInteractive script kabhi bhi client navigation par phir se run nahi karti hai.

default.js

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai default.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: default.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Required, Props — `params` (optional), Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: default.js Parallel Routes ke bhitar ek fallback render karta hai jab Next.js ek full page load ke baad ek slot ke active state ko theek nahi kar sakta hai. sopht (klieint-side) navigation ke dauraan Next.js pratyek slot ke active upprishth ko track karta hai; hard navigation (full page load/refresh) par yeh us state ko theek nahi kar sakta hai, isliye un upprishthon ke liye jo vartaman URL se mel nahi khaate hain, yeh default.js pradan karta hai. udaharan: @team slot mein ek settings page hai lekin @analytics nahi hai - /settings ke liye navigate karna sopht nev ke dauraan @analytics ka vartaman page rakhta hai, lekin refresh Next.js ne @analytics/default.js ko render kiya.

  • Required: yadi default.js maujud nahi hai, to iska naam slot (@team, @analytics,...) error hai aur aapko ek ko jari rakhne ke liye define karne ki requirement hai. purane 404 behavior ko preserve karne ke liye, ek default.js banaein jo notFound() ko call karta hai:
tsx
  // app/@team/default.js
  import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function Default() {
    notFound()
  }

children ek jatil slot hai, isliye ise ek default.js ki requirement hoti hai, jab parent ke page ke active state ko theek nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - iske bina, route ek 404 lauta data hai.

  • Props — params (optional): slot ke upprishthon ke neeche root segment se dynamic route mapdandon ko hal karne ka Promise karta hai. /zack → Promise<{ artist: 'zack' }> par app/[artist]/@sidebar/default.js, app/[artist]/[album]/@sidebar/default.js, /zack/next → Promise<{ artist: 'zack', album: 'next' }> para. async/await ya React ke use() ka upyog manon tak pahunchne ke liye karna chahiye (v14 mein aur isse pahle params tulyakalik tha; async access abhi bhi pichhre compatibility ke liye v15 mein kaam karta hai lekin ise vikrit kiya jayega).
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: default.js keval Parallel Routes + hard navigation ke liye mayne rakhta hai; sopht nev slot state ko preserve karta hai, riphresh nahi karta; ek named slot par default.js lapta ek error hai, ek chup nahi 404; children ko bhi ek ki zaroorat hai.

Dynamic Route Segments

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Dynamic Route Segments. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Dynamic Route Segments — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Convention, `params` is a Promise, Catch-all segments, Optional catch-all segments, TypeScript, With Cache Components. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: A URL path segments ka ek anukram hai; ek segment static hai (shabdik, match bilkul) ya dynamic (placeholder URL se maan capture). jab kisi segment ka value samay se aage nahi jana jata hai, to dynamic data se route banane ke liye ek Dynamic Segment ko define karein. Next.js ne params prop ke madhyam se manon par capture kar liya, request samay par bhara ya build samay par render kiya. iske alava path param / route param / URL param bhi kaha jata hai.

  • Convention: square brackets mein folder ka naam rakho: app/blog/[slug]/page.js — [slug] dynamic segment hai. params ko layout, page, route aur generateMetadata ko passed kiya gaya hai.
tsx
  export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
    const { slug } = await params
    return <div>My Post: {slug}</div>
  }

/blog/a → { slug: 'a' }, /blog/b → { slug: 'b' }. root layout se pahle segment root parameter hain, jo kisi bhi Server Component se next/root-params ke madhyam se pathniy hain.

  • params ek Promise hai: ko async/await ya React ke use() ka upyog manon (v14 aur isse pahle yeh tulyakalik tha) tak pahunchne ke liye karna hoga; async access abhi bhi pichhre compatibility ke liye v15 mein kaam karta hai lekin ise reject kar diya jayega). Client Component pages mein, use(params) ke saath unwrap; client per mein kahin bhi, useParams hook ka upyog karein.
  • Catch-all segment: [...folderName] ne sabhi agle segments ko pakar liya - app/shop/[...slug]/page.js match /shop/clothes, /shop/clothes/tops, /shop/clothes/tops/t-shirts; params ek sarani hai: /shop/a/b → { slug: ['a', 'b'] }.
  • Optional catch-all segment: [[...folderName]] bhi criteria ke bina route se match karta hai - app/shop/[[...slug]]/page.js bhi /shop se match karta hai. { slug: undefined }
  • TypeScript: prakar PageProps<'/route'>, LayoutProps<'/route'>, ya RouteContext<'/route'> ke saath page/layout/route. manon ke liye string, string[], ya undefined (optional catch-all) type kiye gaye hain kyonki user kisi bhi URL ko type kar sakte hain - sabhi mamlon ko sambhal sakte hain. ek nishchit set (e.g) ke liye. [locale], runtime par valid aur ek daave ke saath sankirn: function assertValidLocale(value: string): asserts value is Locale { if (!isValidLocale(value)) notFound() }. params
  • With Cache Components: generateStaticParams ke bina, param maan prerender par agyat hain → param runtime data hain; <Suspense> mein param pahunch lapeto (ya page-star ki fallback ke liye loading.tsx ka upyog karein). build ek static shell generated karta hai; prati request content load. layout mein, top level (prevents prerendering) par params ki await nahi karte hain - Promise ko neeche paas karein aur jahan required ho vahan await karein. generateStaticParams ke saath, namoonaa param un namoonon ke liye previous static HTML ka build karte hain; ek saphal pahle request ke baad runtime param pages ko disk mein sahejaa jata hai. build-time validation keval code path ko shamil karta hai jo namoonaa param ke saath executed hota hai - gair-namoonaa values (e.g) ke liye ek sashart shakha eksesing runtime API. slug.startsWith('private-') parhne cookies()) build mein valid NOT hai aur pahle request par fail rahta hai; <Suspense> mein us shakha ko lapetakar theek karein.
  • generateStaticParams udaharan: wapsi posts.map((post) => ({ slug: post.slug })); fetch andar yeh automatic roop se layouts/pages (faster builds) mein alag ho jata hai. yeh dynamic Route Handlers (app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts) mein bhi kaam karta hai taaki static roop se build samay par API pratikriyaon ko generated kiya jaa sake; any IDon ko request samay par dynamic roop se sambhala jata hai.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: [slug] banam [...slug] banam [[...slug]] (array banam aparibhashit); params Promise + use() in Client Components; generateStaticParams authentication andhaa spot ka build; next/root-params ke madhyam se root pairaama.

error.js

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai error.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: error.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key example (verbatim), Hierarchy, Props, `global-error.js`, Graceful error recovery, Good to know. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: error.js apratyashit runtime errors ko sambhalti hai aur fallback UI ko pradarshit karti hai. yeh React Error Boundary mein ek route segment aur uske nested bachchon ko lapeta hai; jab ek error boundary ke andar phenkti hai, to error component fallback UI ke roop mein dikhata hai. Error simaein Client Components E ('use client') honi chahiye.

  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  'use client' // Error boundaries must be Client Components
  import { useEffect } from 'react'
  export default function Error({ error, retry }: { error: unknown; retry: () => void }) {
    useEffect(() => {
      // Log the error to an error reporting service
      console.error(error)
    }, [error])
    return (
      <div>
        <h2>Something went wrong!</h2>
        <button onClick={() => retry()}>Try again</button>
      </div>
    )
  }
  • Hierarchy: component padanukram mein, error.js loading.js, not-found.js, page.js lapeta hai, aur ek React Error Boundary mein nested layout.js filein. yeh NOT ek hi segment mein iske upar layout.js ya template.js lapeta hai. root layout mein errors ko sambhalne ke liye, global-error.js ka upyog karein.
  • Props:
  • error: phenka moolya. Server Components se errors ek Error udaharan ke roop mein aati hain; ek Client Component mein pheinke gaye value ko saman roop se passed kiya jata hai aur message/digest ko parhne se pahle instanceof Error ke saath sankirn nahi ho sakta hai. development mein, serialized Error mein mool message shamil hain; production mein yeh NOT karta hai, jisse sanvedanshil vivaran leak hone se bachne ke liye. Error
  • error.message: Client Component errors mool sandesh dikhati hain; Server Component errors ek common sandesh + pahchankarta dikhati hain (server log mein error.digest ke madhyam se dekhein).
  • error.digest: server-side log se match karne ke liye throw karne wali error ke auto-janreted haisha.
  • retry() (Stable v16.3.0); v16.2.0 mein unstable_retry ke roop mein joda gaya: phir se pakre gaye aur boundary ke bachchon ko phir se render karte hain; saphalta par fallback ko replace kiya jata hai. ise asthayi errors ke liye upyog karein.
  • reset(): error avastha ko saaf karta hai aur phir se render karta hai children WITHOUT phir se khinchta hai. adhikansh mamlon mein retry() ko pasand karte hain.
  • global-error.js: root layout/template mein errors ko sambhalta hai; root app directory mein rahta hai (i18n ke saath kaam karta hai). ise apne khud ke <html> aur <body> tag plus kisi bhi global styles/fonts ko define karna hoga, jiski zaroorat hai - yeh active hone par root layout ko replace karta hai. yeh aur bilt-in 500 page apne dastavez ko render karte hain aur NOT ko apni global styles mein shamil karte hain, isliye ek app theme togal (class / data-theme) un tak nahi pahunchegaa - default UI OS rang yojna ka anusaran karta hai; apne khud ke global-error component ke andar apni theme lagu karein. metadata/generateMetadata ko global-error.jsx (Client Component) mein supported nahi hai - iske bajaay React ke <title> component ka upyog karein. chunki v15.2.0 global-error development mein bhi pradarshit hota hai.
  • Graceful error vasuli: ek custom class error boundary (GracefullyDegradingErrorBoundary) ek error (contentRef + getDerivedStateFromError + componentDidCatch) se pahle vartaman HTML ko capture aur preserve kar sakta hai, phir error ko phir se render karne par dangerouslySetInnerHTML ke madhyam se capture kiye gaye HTML (suppressHydrationWarning ke saath) plus ek lagatar notification bar - isliye user khali fallback ke bajaay antim known server-render kiye gaye UI ko rakhte hain.
  • Good janne ke liye: React DevTools error rajyon ka testing karne ke liye error boundaries ko togal kar sakte hain; error component ko render karte samay parent boundary, throw mein error ko babal karne ke liye; component-star vasuli ke liye route segments se bandhe nahi hain, catchError function ka upyog karein.
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — retry static; v16.2.0 — unstable_retry joda gaya; v15.2.0 — global-error bhi dev mein dikhaya gaya; v13.1.0 — global-error pesh kiya gaya; v13.0.0 — error pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: error.js ek Client Component hona chahiye; yeh apne segment ke layout/template ko lapet nahi karta hai; production server errors design dwara common hain (digest server log ke liye link); retry phir-fetches, reset nahi karta; global-error ko apne khud ke <html> / <body> ki zaroorat hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai instrumentation.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: instrumentation.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Exports, `onRequestError` parameters, Runtime targeting, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: instrumentation.js|ts apne app mein avlokan tool ko ekikrit karta hai - performance/behavior ko track karta hai aur production mein muddon ko debug karta hai. ise apne aavedan ke root (ya ek ka upyog karte samay src/ ke andar) mein rakhein.

  • Exports:
  • register() (optional): jise Once kaha jata hai, jab ek naya Next.js server udaharan shuru kiya jata hai, aur server requests ko sambhalne ke liye taiyar hone se pahle pura hona chahiye. async ho sakta hai. vishisht upyog: OpenTelemetry - import { registerOTel } from '@vercel/otel'; export function register() { registerOTel('next-app') } panjikrit karein.
  • onRequestError(err, request, context) (optional, v15.0.0): kisi bhi avlokan provider ko server errors ko track karta hai. iske andar kisi bhi Async karya ko chhor dein; jab Next.js server error ko capture karta hai to yeh aag lag jati hai. error udaharan mool phenka error nahi ho sakta hai (React ise Server Components rendering ke dauraan sansadhit kar sakta hai) - actual error prakar ki identity karne ke liye apni digest sanpatti ka upyog karein.
  • onRequestError parameters:
  • error: unknown - message/digest parhne se pahle tang.
  • request (keval parhein): { path: string /* e.g. /blog?name=foo */, method: string /* GET, POST… */, headers: { [key: string]: string | string[] } }.
  • context: { routerKind: 'Pages Router' | 'App Router', routePath: string /* e.g. /app/blog/[dynamic] */, routeType: 'render' | 'route' | 'action' | 'proxy', renderSource: 'react-server-components' | 'react-server-components-payload' | 'server-rendering', revalidateReason: 'on-demand' | 'stale' | undefined, renderType: 'dynamic' | 'dynamic-resume' /* 'dynamic-resume' for PPR */ }.
  • Runtime target: donon Node.js aur Edge runtimes mein kaam karta hai; process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME ka upyog shakha, e.g mein kiya jata hai. if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge') return require('./register.edge') aur require('./register.node') (onRequestError ke liye saim pattern).
  • Version history: v15.0.0 — onRequestError ne parichay diya, instrumentation static; v14.0.4 — Turbopack support; v13.2.0 — experimental ke roop mein pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: register ek bar server udaharan aur block tatparataa chalata hai; onRequestError keval server-side hai (klieint errors ko instrumentation-client.js ki requirement); error ko React-processed kiya jaa sakta hai - digest par bharosa; context.routeType aapko batata hai ki error kahan hui (render/route/action/proxy).

instrumentation-client.js

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai instrumentation-client.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: instrumentation-client.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Execution timing, Error handling, `onRouterTransitionStart(url, navigationType)`, Experimental transition event (v16.3.0), Performance considerations, Polyfills. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: instrumentation-client.js|ts nigrani, vishleshan aur any dushprabhavon ko jodta hai jo aapke app se pahle chal rahe hain interactive performance traiking, error nigrani, polyfill, client-side vedhakshamataa. ise application ke root mein ya src/ ke andar rakhein. server-side instrumentation ke viprit, koi vishisht export ki requirement nahi hai - seedhe file (e.g) mein nigrani code likhein. performance.mark('app-init'), window.addEventListener('error', …).

  • Execution Time: ne HTML dastavez load ke baad (1) chalata hai, (2) React hydration shuru hone se pahle, (3) user ke sanpark sanbhav hone se pahle - initial lifecycle ki events ko capture karne ke liye aadarsha. keval tulyakalik top level code ko hydration se pahle pura karne ki guarantee hai; esink vark (Promise, import(), top-leval await) fire-eind-phorget hai aur hydration shuru hone ke baad hal kar sakta hai.
  • Error handling: koshish pakar mein raip instrumentation code to ek traiking viphalta any instrumentation ko tor nahi hai.
  • onRouterTransitionStart(url, navigationType): optional export App Router navigation ki shuruaat ka inspect karne ke liye. url: string (destination), navigationType: 'push' | 'replace' | 'traverse'. navigation bredakranb (error track), analytics iveints (analytics.track('page_navigation', { url, type: navigationType, timestamp })), ya performance chihn (performance.mark(\ nav-start-${url}\)) ke liye upyog karein. hook errors alag hoti hain - ve navigation ya any hook ko affected nahi karte hain.
  • Experimental transition event (v16.3.0): ek teesre event tark prapt karne ke liye next.config.ts mein experimental: { instrumentationClientRouterTransitionEvents: true } enable banata hai: { id, timestamp, fromRoutes, prefetchIntent }: RouterTransitionStartEvent ('next' se RouterTransitionType). event.id — opaque ID is transition ke liye events dwara sajha; event.timestamp — phremavark capture yooniks ms; event.fromRoutes — route pattern navigation se pahle dikhai dete hain (prathmik children route pahle, phir set kram mein parallel slot; filesystem-style pattern, e.g. /blog/hello ke liye /blog/[slug]; event.prefetchIntent — link navigation ke liye 'full' | 'auto' | 'none', ya null programmatic router.push()/replace() ya browser back/forward. RouterTransitionStartEvent
  • Performance vichar: code ko halkaa rakhta hai - Next.js dev mein samay ki nigrani karta hai aur yeh warning data hai ki kya yeh 16ms se adhik hai (smooth page loading ko chot pahuncha sakta hai).
  • Polyfills: ek polyfill ki guarantee ke liye component chalane se pahle lagu hota hai, static roop se ise import karte hain aur feature ka pata lagane (if (!window.ResizeObserver) { window.ResizeObserver = ResizeObserverPolyfill }) ke baad tulyakalik roop se lagu hote hain - pratyek visitor ke liye ek static import jahaaja. yahan sthit sashart import() se bachein (fire-eind-phorget, hydration ke baad bhi utar sakta hai). code mein bahuphiling ko priority dein jo on-demand mamlon ke liye feature ka upyog karta hai. Next.js pahle se hi un browsers ke liye baseline polyfill (fetch, URL, Object.assign,...) ko injekt karta hai jinhein unhein requirement hoti hai.
  • Plugins: next.config.js plagins (e.g). withSentry) apne khud ke client instrumentation ko instrumentationClientInject ke madhyam se panjikrit kar sakta hai; is file se pahle injekt kiye gaye module, array kram mein, aur usi router-transition hook ko export kar sakte hain. app code ko abhi bhi is file convention ka seedhe upyog karna chahiye.
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — experimental router transition shuru event; v15.3 — instrumentation-client shuru kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: server instrumentation.js (register/onRequestError) banam client instrumentation-client.js (top level code + onRouterTransitionStart); hydration se pahle async-keval guarantee; 16ms dev warning; static import keval poleephila.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/instrumentation-client

Intercepting Routes

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Intercepting Routes. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Intercepting Routes — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Convention, Route segments, not filesystem, Modals (with Parallel Routes), Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: intarasepting route vartaman layout ke bhitar apne app ke dusre hisse se ek route load karte hain - sviching sandarbh ke bina root ki content pradarshit karte hain. classic udaharan: ek feed mein ek tasveer click karne se feed ko overlay karne wale modal mein photo dikhai deti hai - Next.js ne /photo/123 route ko intercepting kiya, URL ko mask kiya aur ise /feed par overlay kiya. lekin sajha karne yogy URL ko seedhe navigate karna ya taza karna iske bajaay full photo page render karna - hard navigation par koi intercept nahi.

  • Convention: (..) convention, relative path ../ ki tarah lekin route segments ke liye:
  • (.) - same level par match segment
  • (..) — match segment one star upar
  • (..)(..) — match segment two star upar
  • (...) — root app directory se match segment
  • udaharan: (..)photo directory banaakar feed segment ke bhitar se photo segment ko intercepting karein.
  • Route segment, file system nahi: (..) convention route segments ki count karta hai, file system star nahi - yeh Parallel Routes mein @slot folders par vichar nahi karta hai. modal udaharan mein, photo ka path (..) ka upyog karta hai kyonki @modal ek slot hai, ek segment nahi hai, isliye photo do file system star adhik hone ke bawajud keval ek segment star adhik hai.
  • Modals (Parallel Routes ke saath): intarasepting + parallel route classic modal chunautiyon ko hal karte hain: URL ke madhyam se sajha modal content; sandarbh taza par preserve (modal ko band karne ke bajaay); modal previous route par jaane ke bajaay pichhre navigation par band ho jata hai; modal aage navigation par phir se khulta hai. any udaharan: ek samarpit /login page ke saath ek top navbaar mein login modal, ya ek shoping cart side modala. step-by-step modal udaharan aur agle graam image gallery udaharan (github.com/nextjs/nextgram) ke liye See Parallel Routes doksa.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: intercept keval naram (client-side) navigation par hota hai, kabhi kathor navigation/refresh/direct URL par nahi; (..) star segment aadharit hain, slot count nahi karte hain; modals ko Parallel Routes + avrodhan routes ko ek saath ki requirement hoti hai.

layout.js

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai layout.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: layout.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key example (verbatim), Props, Layout Props helper, Root layout, Caveats, Request object. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: A layout ek route segment ke liye sajha UI ko define karta hai. component padanukram mein, layout.js ek segment mein sabse adhik component hai - yeh template.js, error.js, loading.js, not-found.js aur page.js lapeta hai. layout navigation ke dauraan client mein cache kiye jate hain aur navigation par NOT ko phir se render karte hain, state ko preserve karte hain aur phir se attract hone se bach jate hain.

  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  // app/dashboard/layout.tsx
  export default function DashboardLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <section>{children}</section>
  }
  • Props:
  • children (required): lipte route segments ke saath population - main roop se ek bachcha layout ya page, lekin yeh bhi lagu hone par Loading/Error vishesh files. parallel root slot bhi props (e.g) ke roop mein aate hain. app/dashboard/@analytics ke liye props.analytics).
  • params (optional): us layout ke neeche root segment se dynamic route quantity ka Promise — /dashboard/1 → Promise<{ team: '1' }> par app/dashboard/[team]/layout.js; /shop/1/2 → Promise<{ tag: '1', item: '2' }> par app/shop/[tag]/[item]/layout.js; /blog/1/2 → Promise<{ slug: ['1', '2'] }> par catch-ol app/blog/[...slug]/layout.js. ise chhor dein ya React ke use() (v14 async params abhi bhi v15 mein kaam karta hai lekin ise hata diya jayega) ka upyog karein.
  • Layout Props helper: LayoutProps<'/dashboard'> dridhta se type kiye gaye params ko data hai aur ise directory strakchar se chuna gaya slots ka naam diya jata hai; duniya bhar mein upalabdh hone ke baad prakar generated hote hain (next dev/next build/next typegen), koi import ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Root layout: app directory MUST mein ek root layout (top sabse adhik, aam taur par app/layout.js) shamil hai jo <html> aur <body> ko define karta hai. kya NOT manual roop se <head> tag (<title>, <meta>) jorte hain - iske bajaay Metadata API ka upyog karein (hath streaming + di-duplikeshan). multiple root layout sanbhav hain: route samuhon (app/(shop)/layout.js + app/(marketing)/layout.js) ke madhyam se, ya app/layout.js ko melt ke dwara to subdirectory layout pratyek root layout ban jate hain. multiple root layout mein navigate karna ek full page lod ka karan banta hai, client-side navigation nahi. ek root layout ek dynamic segment (e.g) ke tahat baith sakta hai. I18n ke liye app/[lang]/layout.js); root layout se pahle segment root parameter hote hain, jo kisi bhi Server Component se next/root-params ke madhyam se pathniy hote hain.
  • Caveats:
  • Request objekt: layout kachche request (unmein cached/reused hain); ek layout mein mahnge user code performance ko chot pahunch sakta hai) tak pahunch nahi sakta. iske bajaay server Components/functions mein headers()/cookies() ka prayog karein (e.g). theme app/shop/layout.tsx
  • Query params: layout navigation par phir se render nahi karte hain, isliye ve khoj param ka upyog nahi kar sakte hain. page searchParams prop ka upyog karein, ya Client Component ko useSearchParams (Client Components) ke saath layout mein import kiya gaya hai.
  • Pathname: saman - Client Component (e.g) mein usePathname ka upyog karein. pathname /
  • intrekshan with loading.js: loading.js, BELOW layout.js baithta hai, isliye yeh khud hi layout mein uncached/runtime data access (cookies(), headers()) ke liye ek wapsi nahi dikha sakta hai. Without Cache Components, layout render tak navigation block (koi loading.js dikhaya gaya hai). With Cache Components, loading.js ek niymit <Suspense> boundary hai - layout mein uncached/runtime pahunch ko spasht roop se apne khud ke <Suspense> mein lapeta jana chahiye (aapko build-time error guide ka prayog karein); static shell turant stream karta hai aur bina kisi content mein svaip karta hai. fix: e.g ke aaspas <Suspense fallback={<NavSkeleton />}> mein layout mein raip runtime eksesa. <DashboardNav />, ya page.js mein bejor lane ki koshish karta hai jahan loading.js ise cover kar sakta hai.
  • Fetching data: layout data ko children mein paas nahi kar sakta hai. donon layout aur page - React cache() ya Next.js fetch mein usi data ko automatic roop se request karta hai.
  • Accessing child segment: layout un neeche segments ko nahi dekh sakte hain; Client Component (e.g) mein useSelectedLayoutSegment / useSelectedLayoutSegments ka upyog karein. NavLink slug === useSelectedLayoutSegment()
  • Examples: ek layout mein export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Next.js' } ke madhyam se metadata; layout mein imported Client Component mein usePathname ke madhyam se active nausenaa link; params (e.g) se content pradarshit karna. Welcome to {team}'s Dashboard; use(params) ke saath Client Components mein params ko padhna.
  • Version history: v15.0.0-RC — params ek Promise ban gaya (codemod upalabdh); v13.0.0 — layout ki shuruaat hui.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: layout pure navigation mein state ko preserve karte hain (re-render nahi kiya gaya); root layout mein <html> / <body> hona chahiye; layout mein koi searchParams/pathname/raw request nahi - Client Components ko pratinidhi karna; loading.js layout data ko nahi dhak sakta hai - Suspense mein lapeto ya page par le jaane ke liye.

loading.js

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai loading.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: loading.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key example (verbatim), Hierarchy, Navigation behavior, Instant loading states, SEO, Status codes. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: loading.js React Suspense ke saath sarthak loading UI banata hai - server se ek tatkal loading sthiti jabki ek root segment ki content dharaon mein; ek bar mein nai content automatic roop se svaip ho jati hai. kisi bhi halke loading UI (skelatan, spinar, ya cover photo/title jaise bhavishy ki screen ka ek chhota sarthak hissa) jorein. default ek Server Component hai, lekin 'use client' ke madhyam se ek Client Component ho sakta hai. koi parameter accept nahi karta hai.

  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  // app/feed/loading.tsx
  export default function Loading() {
    // Or a custom loading skeleton component
    return <p>Loading...</p>
  }
  • Hierarchy: usi folder mein, loading.js layout.js ke andar nested hai aur automatic roop se page.js aur kisi bhi children ko <Suspense> boundary mein neeche lapeta hai. yeh not-found.js, page.js, aur nested layout.js files ko lapeta hai - yeh NOT ko usi segment mein layout.js, template.js ya error.js ko lapeta hai. yadi layout uncached/runtime data (cookies(), headers()) tak pahunchta hai, to iske liye loading.js koi fallback nahi dikhata hai: layout render tak Cache Components navigation block ke bina; Cache Components ke saath jo access ko spasht roop se <Suspense> (build-time error) mein lapeta jana chahiye, aur static shell pahle stream karta hai.
  • Navigation behavior: fallback UI prefetched hai, jab tak ki prefetching pura nahi ho gaya hai tatkal navigation banata hai; navigation badhit hai (sviching routes vartaman route ki content ke liye wait nahi karna chahiye); sajha layout interactive rahte hain jabki naye segment load karte hain.
  • Instant loading rajyon: fallback UI turant navigation par dikhaya gaya hai - Prerender skeletons/spinners ya sarthak tukre isliye upyogkartaon ko pata hai ki app jawab de raha hai.
  • SEO: bots ke liye jo keval static HTML (e.g) ko skraip karta hai. Twitterbot, Next.js UI streaming se pahle generateMetadata ko hal karta hai aur initial <head> mein metadata dalta hai; anyatha streaming metadata ka istemal kiya jaa sakta hai (Next.js user agents ko bloking banam streaming chunne ka pata lagata hai). streaming server-render hai, isliye yeh SEO ko chot nahi pahunchata (Google ke Rich Results Test ke saath verify).
  • Status code: streaming page uttar 200 ke saath shuru hota hai - initial pratikriya header baki ke jawab ke liye sthiti tay karte hain. phir Next.js ko redirect kar sakte hain aur HTTP access fallback ko redirect(), notFound(), forbidden(), unauthorized() ke saath stream kar sakte hain. With Cache Components, prerendered shell pahle bheja jata hai (headers CSS/fonts/images ko preload karne ke saath), jab shell mein koi view nahi hota to bhi 200 ke saath pratikriya shuru hoti hai. ek dharabaddh 404 page mein <meta name="robots" content="noindex"> shamil hain, isliye khoj injan 200 ke bawajud URL ko anukrmit nahi karte hain (kuchh krolar ise "sopht 404" kah sakte hain; noindex ise parinamon se bahar rakhta hai). related check BEFORE streaming ko chalane ke liye ek actual 404/403/401 ko compliance/analytics — e.g ke liye wapas aanaa shuru hota hai. Proxy mein slag ki check karein aur ek na hone wale route par phir se likhna ya 404 pratikriya wapas karna (keep Proxy tezi se jaanchtaa hai, vahan puri content nahi milti hai). jab streaming shuru hoti hai? stream shuru karna header bhejta hai aur sthiti ko theek karta hai. Without Cache Components, ek loading.js/<Suspense> fallback ko render karne se streaming shuru ho jati hai; yadi koi pratikriya shuru nahi hui hai, to Next.js abhi bhi 404/403/401 ko wapas lauta sakta hai jab rukavat chali jati hai. With Cache Components, ek intercept apni sthiti ko preserve kar sakta hai jab yeh previous ke dauraan chalta hai, pratikriya shuru hone se pahle; shell bheje jaane ke baad page ke andar ek request-samay par check (yahan tak ki jab shell khali hai aur route instant = false set karta hai), to sthiti 200 bani hui hai.
  • Browser simaein: kuchh browser ek streaming pratikriya baphar - aap stream output nahi dekh sakte jab tak ki pratikriya 1024 bytes (aamtaur par keval "hailo varld" app ko affected karti hai).
  • Platform support: Node.js server han; Docker Yes; static export sankhya; optimizer manch-vishishta. jab sva-hosting streaming ko configure karein.
  • Manual Suspense: loading.js ke alava, danedar loading (e.g) ke liye apne khud ke <Suspense> boundaries mein Async component lapeto. labh: streaming server rendering (pragtishil HTML) + chaynaatmak hydration (React interactive banata hai jo user ke saath negotiation karta hai). <PostFeed /> <Weather />
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — loading pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: loading.js layout ke neeche ek Suspense boundary hai, iske upar nahi; previous fallback = tatkal navigation; dharabaddh pratikriyaon 404s ke liye noindex ke saath 200 hain - actual sthiti code ke liye streaming se pahle access check karein; browsers ko dharabaddh HTML ke <1024 bytes ko baphar kar sakte hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/loading

Asaan bhasha me samjho: not-found.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `not-found.js`, `global-not-found.js`, `global-not-found.js` (experimental), Props, Data fetching, Metadata. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js ne nahi paya mamlon ke liye do conventions ko pradan kiya:

  • not-found.js: UI ko render karta hai jab notFound() function ko root segment ke bhitar phenk diya jata hai.
  • global-not-found.js (experimental, v15.4.0): pure app mein bejor routes ke liye ek global 404 page, routing star par sambhala - ek layout ya page ko render karne par nirbhar nahi karta hai; Next.js chhor data hai aur is page ko seedhe lauta data hai.
  • not-found.js: streaming shuru hone se pahle, Next.js ek 404 sthiti return karta hai; streaming shuru hone ke baad, sthiti 200 bani hui hai aur pratikriya mein nahi hone wali UI render karta hai. Next.js donon mamlon mein <meta name="robots" content="noindex" /> injekshan data hai. component padanukram mein, not-found.js loading.js aur page.js ke beech render karta hai, jise loading.js se <Suspense> boundary dwara lapeta jata hai aur usi segment mein error.js se error boundary hoti hai.
tsx
  // app/not-found.tsx
  import Link from 'next/link'
  export default function NotFound() {
    return (
      <div>
        <h2>Not Found</h2>
        <p>Could not find requested resource</p>
        <Link href="/">Return Home</Link>
      </div>
    )
  }

default nahi-installed UI OS rang yojna (prefers-color-scheme) ka anusaran karta hai aur ek app-leval theme (<html> par shreni / data-theme) ko nahi padhta hai - chunki yeh aapke root layout ke andar render karta hai, global CSS (e.g) mein uchch-vishishttaa niyam pair ke saath ek spasht theme se match karta hai. html[data-theme='light'] body / html[data-theme='dark'] body), ya full markup niyantran ke liye apna khud ka not-found.js pradan karte hain.

  • global-not-found.js (experimental): next.config.ts mein experimental: { globalNotFound: true } ke saath enable hai, phir app/global-not-found.js banati hai. yeh common rendering ko bypass karta hai, isliye kisi bhi global style, fonts, ya dependency ko 404 page ki zarooraton ko import karta hai - jismein aapki theme (class/attribute) shamil hai, kyonki keval OS rang yojna anyatha dikhai deti hai. ek chhote se global style ke sabset aur saral font parivar is page ke performance mein sudhar kar sakte hain. yeh <html> aur <body> tag ke saath ek full HTML dastavez lautana chahiye, aur metadata/generateMetadata export (global-error ke viprit) ka support karta hai. upyogi jab ek 404 layout.js + not-found.js se banaya nahi jaa sakta: (1) multiple root layout (e.g). app/(admin)/layout.tsx + app/(shop)/layout.tsx) - rachna karne ke liye koi bhi layout nahi; (2) top level ke dynamic segments (e.g) ke tahat root layout. app/[country]/layout.tsx.
  • Props: na to not-found.js aur na hi global-not-found.js kisi bhi props ko accept karta hai.
  • Data geting: not-found default roop se ek Server Component hai; data prapt karne aur pradarshit karne ke liye ise async chihnit karein (e.g). headers() ke madhyam se host parhne aur site data prapt karne ke liye. path-aadharit content ke liye usePathname jaise client hook ka upyog karne ke liye, iske bajaay data client-side prapt karein.
  • Metadata: donon root app/not-found.js aur app/global-not-found.js support metadata ya generateMetadata ko <title>/<meta> ko customize karne ke liye export karta hai; global-not-found.js sahit 404 pages ke liye noindex auto-injekts noindex. Next.js
  • Good janne ke liye: root app/not-found.js aur app/global-not-found.js bhi pure app ke liye apekshit notFound() errors AND kisi bhi bejor URL ko pakadti hai. Next.js pratyek not-found.js ko apne segment ke tahat har route ke saath bhejta hai (keval nahi-installed page) aur load karta hai Client Components yeh un pages par import karta hai - root app/not-found.js ke liye jo har page hai, isliye Server Components aur <Link> ko pasand karte hain.
  • Version history: v15.4.0 — global-not-found.js (experimental); v13.3.0 — root app/not-found global bejor URL sambhalta hai; v13.0.0 — not-found pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: 404 sthiti keval streaming shuru hone se pahle (ke baad: 200 + noindex); not-found.js = route star ( dwara trigger), global-not-found.js = routing-star (anmeted URL, skips layout) apni khud ki <html> / <body> + styles ki requirement hoti hai); Client Components par root not-found.js prakash rakhein. notFound()

page.js

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai page.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: page.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Key example (verbatim), Props, Page Props helper, Examples, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: page file UI ko define karti hai jo unique ko ek route mein define karti hai - default roop se iska ek component export karti hai. .js, .jsx, ya .tsx extension sabhi kaam karte hain. ek page hamesha root subtree ke leaf hai, aur ek page file ko public roop se accessible root segment banane ki requirement hoti hai. page default roop se Server Components hain, lekin Client Components ho sakta hai. padanukram mein, page.js ek hi segment mein loading.js (Suspense), error.js (error boundary), template.js aur layout.js dwara lipte internal convention hai.

  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  // app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx
  export default function Page({
    params,
    searchParams,
  }: {
    params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
    searchParams: Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }>
  }) {
    return <h1>My Page</h1>
  }
  • Props:
  • params (optional): page par neeche root segment se dynamic route quantity ka Promise — /shop/1 → Promise<{ slug: '1' }> par app/shop/[slug]/page.js; app/shop/[category]/[item]/page.js par /shop/1/2 → Promise<{ category: '1', item: '2' }>; /shop/1/2 → Promise<{ slug: ['1', '2'] }> par catch-all app/shop/[...slug]/page.js. Await or use React's use() (v14 async params abhi bhi v15 mein kaam karta hai, bhavishy mein deprecated).
  • searchParams (optional): ek plain object ke roop mein URL ke khoj mapdandon ka Promise — /shop?a=1 → Promise<{ a: '1' }>, /shop?a=1&b=2 → { a: '1', b: '2' }, /shop?a=1&a=2 → { a: ['1', '2'] }. yeh ek plain JS objekt hai, NOT ek URLSearchParams udaharan hai. Await ya Client Component pages (const filters = use(searchParams).filters) mein use() ka upyog karein. searchParams ek request samay API hai - iska upyog page ko request samay par dynamic rendering mein chunta hai. With Cache Components, jahan aap per mein searchParams tak pahunchte hain, yeh set karta hai ki kitne page ko render kiya jaa sakta hai (static shell ko adhikatam dekhein).
  • Page Props helper: PageProps<'/blog/[slug]'> route se literal - svath full aur sakht key params ke liye dridhta se type kiye gaye params + searchParams data hai; static route params ko {} ka samadhan karte hain. global roop se type janreshan (next dev / next build / next typegen) ke baad upalabdh hai, koi import ki zaroorat nahi hai.
  • Examples: display/fetch content params (<h1>Blog Post: {slug}</h1>); searchParams (const { page = '1', sort = 'asc', query = '' } = await searchParams) se filtering/pagination/sorting; use(params) / use(searchParams) ke madhyam se Client Components mein donon ko padhna.
  • Version history: v15.0.0-RC — params aur searchParams (codemod upalabdh); v13.0.0 — page ki shuruaat hui.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: page = leaf + ek public route ke liye required; donon props v15+ mein Promises hain; searchParams dynamic rendering ko majbur karta hai aur ek plain object hai; type kiye gaye props ke liye PageProps<'/route'> ka upyog karta hai.
