Hissa 127 / 471 · App Router · API Reference

Parallel Routes

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Parallel Routes. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Parallel Routes — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Convention — slots, Behavior — soft vs hard navigation, Reading the active segment, Conditional routes, Tab groups, Modals (with Intercepting Routes). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Parallel Routes ek saath ya sashart roop se ek hi layout ke bhitar ek ya adhik pages ko render karte hain - dashboard aur soshal pheed jaise atydhik dynamic classes ke liye. udaharan: ek dashboard ek hi bar mein team aur analytics pages ko render karta hai.

  • Convention — slot: @folder convention, e.g ke saath banaya gaya. @analytics and @team. slot sajha mool layout ke liye props ke roop mein passed kar rahe hain aur children ke saath parallel mein render:
tsx
  // app/layout.tsx
  export default function Layout({ children, team, analytics }: {
    children: React.ReactNode; analytics: React.ReactNode; team: React.ReactNode
  }) {
    return (<>{children}{team}{analytics}</>)
  }

slot NOT route segment hain aur URL ko affected nahi karte hain - /@analytics/views /views hai. slot segment ke liye antim page banane ke liye niymit page ke saath gathabandhan karte hain. aap ek hi route segment star par previous aur dynamic roop se pradan kiye gaye slot ko nahi mila sakte hain - yadi ek slot dynamic hai, to us star par sabhi slot dynamic hona chahiye. children ek implicit slot (app/page.js) hai. app/@children/page.js

  • Behavior - sopht banam hard navigation: Next.js prati slot active state (upprishth) ko track karta hai. sopht navigation (klieint side): partial render any slots ke active sabpejon ko rakhte hue slot ke bhitar sabpej ko badal data hai, bhale hi ve vartaman URL se mel nahi khaate hon. hard navigation (full page load/refresh): Next.js active sthiti ko set nahi kar sakta slots URL se mel nahi account hai - yeh bina kisi cheez wale slots ke liye default.js pradan karta hai, ya 404 yadi koi maujud nahi hai (ek parallel route render karne ke khilaf 404 guard jahan iska irada nahi tha). default.js ko foltbaik vivaran ke liye dekhein.
  • active segment ko padhna: useSelectedLayoutSegment / useSelectedLayoutSegments ek parallelRouteKey ko accept karte hain - useSelectedLayoutSegment('auth') return "login" jab user app/@auth/login (/login) mein hota hai.
  • Conditional route: shart ke anusar vibhinn routes ko render karta hai, e.g. bhumika aadharit dashboard - app/dashboard/layout.tsx mein return role === 'admin'? admin: user. security getcha: BOTH slot server par render karte hain, bhale hi layout return - @admin/page.js apne data ko har user ke liye laate hain aur iske output ko browser ko bheje gaye jawab mein shamil kiya gaya hai. pratyek slot ke page ke andar ya apne Data Access Layer (e.g) mein adhikrit karein. @/lib/dal mein getAdminStats()).
  • Tab group: ne ek slot ke andar ek layout rakha taaki user svatantr roop se slot navigate kar sakein - e.g. /page-views aur /visitors ke saath @analytics ne ek tab nev (app/@analytics/layout.tsx) ko <Link> ke saath sajha kiya.
  • Modals (Intercepting Routes ke saath): sajha modal URL ko hal karta hai, sandarbh ko taza par preserve karta hai, wapas navigation par band karta hai, aage navigation par phir se khulta hai. step: (1) main /login page banata hai; (2) @auth/default.tsx ko null return karta hai taaki modal inactive hone par render nahi kiya jaa sake; (3) slot mein intercepting: app/@auth/(.)login/page.tsx ne <Modal><Login /></Modal> ko render kiya - modal content se <Modal> (Client) ko alag karna Server Components ke roop mein content rakhta hai; (4) mool layout (<div>{auth}</div> + nav <Link href="/login">Open modal</Link>) mein slot pradan karta hai. link par click karne se navigate karne ke bajaay modal khulta hai; /login ka refresh/direct load main login page dikhata hai. modal (Client Component) ya ek <Link> mein router.back() ke saath band karein; jab ek page par link ke madhyam se navigate kiya jata hai jise slot nahi dena chahiye, to slot ko null — e.g lautne wale component se match karna chahiye. app/@auth/page.tsx ne / ke liye null lautaya, ya kisi any page ke liye null lautaya. app/@auth/[...catchAll]/page.tsx
  • Loading aur error UI: parallel route svatantr roop se stream karte hain, isliye pratyek route mein apna khud ka loading/error state ho sakta hai.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: slot URL ko nahi badalta hai; sopht nev slot state ko preserve karta hai, hard nev ko default.js ki requirement hoti hai; sashart rendering NOT authorization hai (donon slot server-side ko executed karte hain); modal endpoint ko null ritarning slot match ki requirement hoti hai; dynamic-ness segment star par ol-or-nothing hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/parallel-routes
Hissa 128 / 471 · App Router · API Reference

proxy.js

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai proxy.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: proxy.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Location, Exports, Params, Matcher, NextResponse capabilities, Execution order. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: proxy.js|ts ek request pura karne se pahle server par code chalata hai - phir se likhna, redirect karna, request/response header ko sanshodhit karna, ya seedhe jawab dena. Proxy routes se pahle executed karta hai; auth, loging, redirects ke liye upyogi. Note: middleware file convention ko proxy (v16.0.0) ke naam se define kiya gaya hai. Proxy ka matalab alag se render code se alag se chalane ke liye hai aur customize mamlon mein, fast redirect/rewrite handling ke liye apne CDN ko deploy kiya gaya hai - sajha modules/globals. directive par bharosa na karein Proxy ('use server'/'use cache') mein lagu nahi hai, vahan koi vikalp nahi hain; ek cached function jise Proxy dwara ek sadharan karya ke roop mein sanchalit kiya jata hai. Proxy se app mein jankari paas karne ke liye header, cookies, rewriting, redirects, ya URL ka upyog karein.

  • Location: project root mein proxy.ts (ya .js) banati hai, ya yadi lagu ho to src ke andar, pages/app ke saman star para. yadi pageExtensions ko customize kiya gaya hai (e.g). .page.ts, ise usi hisaab se proxy.page.ts kahte hain.
  • Exports: ek single karya, default export ya named proxy (ek file supported se multiple proxy); optional roop se matcher ke saath ek config objekta. function async ho sakta hai. shorthaind type: 'next/server' se NextProxy donon params ko affected karta hai.
ts
  import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
  import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
  export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/home', request.url))
  }
  export const config = { matcher: '/about/:path*' }
  • Params: proxy(request, event) — request ek NextRequest hai; event ek NextFetchEvent hai jiska upyog background ke kaam ke liye Proxy ke run ko jivit rakhne ke liye waitUntil(promise) (logging/analytics) ke saath kiya jata hai.
  • Matcher: ek ke bina , Proxy EVERY request par chalta hai, jismein _next/static, _next/image aur public/ assets shamil hain - unhein bahar nikalne ke liye nakaratmak match ka upyog karein, ya auth/redirects CSS/JS/images. form ko block kar sakte hain: single path string ('/about'), array (['/about/:path*', '/dashboard/:path*']), regex ('/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|.*\\.png$).*)'), ya objekts ki array { source, locale?, has?, missing? } — source path pattern hai, locale: false local routing ko andekha karta hai, has/missing sthiti headers/query/cookies () para. { type: 'header', key: 'Authorization', value: 'Bearer …' }, { type: 'query', key: 'userId', value: '123' }, { type: 'cookie', key: 'session', value: 'active' }. source pattern: / ke saath shuru hona chahiye; naam ke param (/about/:path ek segment se match karta hai); sanshodhak * zero-or-more, ? zero-or-one, + ek-or-more (/about/:path* match /about/a/b/c); regex in parens (/about/(.*)) maichar maan static hona chahiye (static roop se build mein vishleshan kiya gaya); dynamic char ko nazarandaz kar diya gaya. /public ko hamesha pichhre compatibility ke liye /public/index ke roop mein mana jata hai. /about/:path* /about /about /about/team /blog/about
  • NextResponse capabilities: redirect, rewrite, set request header (API routes / getServerSideProps/punarlekh sthalon ke liye), set pratikriya cookies, set pratikriya haidara. ek Page/Route handler ko phir se likhna ya NextResponse/Response ko seedhe lautana (v13.1.0). nirdeshan ke liye, Response.redirect bhi kaam karta hai.
  • Execution order: 1. headers (next.config.js) → 2. redirects (next.config.js) → 3. Proxy → 4. beforeFiles rewrites → 5. file system routes (public/, _next/static/, pages/, app/) → 6. afterFiles rewrites → 7. dynamic routes (/blog/[slug]) → 8. fallback rewrites. Server Functions NOT alag-alag route hain - ve us route par POSTs hain jahan istemal kiya gaya tha, isliye ek route ko chhorakar ek maichar bhi vahan Server Function call ko chhor data hai; ek Refactor ek Server Function ko chupchap Proxy kavrej ko hata sakta hai - hamesha pratyek Server Function ke andar auth/authz ko verify karein, akele Proxy par bharosa nahi karein.
  • Runtime: Proxy default roop se Node.js runtime ke liye; runtime config vikalp NOT files mein upalabdh hai (yeh throw karta hai). Proxy
  • Advanced flags (v13.1): skipTrailingSlashRedirect — disables Next.js trailing-slash redirects so Proxy unhein prati-path (incremental migrations); skipProxyUrlNormalize — disables URL samanyikaran to direct visits aur client transition ek hi mool URL (e.g) dekhein. /_next/data/build-id/hello.json /hello banne ke bajaay asaamaanyeekrit rahta hai.
  • Examples:
  • sashart punarlekhan: /about → NextResponse.rewrite(new URL('/about-2', request.url)); /dashboard → /dashboard/user.
  • cookies: request cookies vidhiyon get/getAll/set/delete/has/clear; jawab cookies vidhiyon get/getAll/set/delete. request.cookies.get('nextjs') → { name: 'nextjs', value: 'fast', Path: '/' }; response.cookies.set('vercel', 'fast') → Set-Cookie: vercel=fast;path=/.
  • header: klon request header (new Headers(request.headers)) set x-hello-from-proxy1, NextResponse.next({ request: { headers: requestHeaders } }) (upstream) - NOT NextResponse.next({ headers }) (jo unhein grahakon ko expose karta hai) ke madhyam se guzarta hai. response.headers.set('x-hello-from-proxy2', 'hello') ke madhyam se uttraadhikaaree. bare header (431 errors) se bachein.
  • RSC request: Next.js internal flight header (rsc, next-router-state-tree, next-router-prefetch) ko request.headers se Proxy mein khinchta hai taaki RSC aur HTML requests ko sanrekhit kiya jaa sake; NextResponse.rewrite() propagates ko RSC ko automatic roop se header likhne ki requirement hoti hai; custom fetch() ko manual roop se aage badhana chahiye (ya skipProxyUrlNormalize ko enable karna).
  • CORS: anumtisoochee mool; preflight (OPTIONS) → NextResponse.json({}, { headers: preflightHeaders }) Access-Control-Allow-Origin (keval yadi permission ho) + methods/headers ke saath; saral request → NextResponse.next() ek hi header set ke sath. (CORS) bhi Route Handlers mein prati root set kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • ek pratikriya ka build: matcher: '/api/:function*' ke saath !isAuthenticated(request) par Response.json({ success: false, message: 'authentication failed' }, { status: 401 }) wapas lautein.
  • nakaratmak match: '/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico|sitemap.xml|robots.txt).*)'; has / missing (e.g) ko jorte hain. missing: [{ type: 'header', key: 'next-router-prefetch' }] ke madhyam se prefetch request chhorein. yahan tak ki jab _next/data ko bahar rakha gaya hai, to Proxy abhi bhi /_next/data/* routes ke liye chala jata hai - janboojhkar, ek page ki security ko rokne ke liye lekin iske data route ko bhoolne ke liye.
  • waitUntil: event.waitUntil(fetch('https://my-analytics-platform.com', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ pathname: req.nextUrl.pathname }) })) then return NextResponse.next().
  • Unit testing (experimental, v15.1): next/experimental/testing/server unstable_doesMiddlewareMatch({ config, nextConfig, url }) ko yeh dava karne ke liye pradan karta hai ki kya Proxy puri proxy function ka testing karne ke liye URL/headers/cookies ke saath isRewrite/getRewrittenUrl/getRedirectUrl ke liye chalta hai.
  • Platform support: Node.js han; Docker Yes; static export san; optimizer manch-vishishta.
  • Migration to Proxy: "middleware" ka naam badal diya gaya kyonki yeh shabd eksapres midalaveyar ke saath bhramit hai aur ati upyog ko encourage karta hai - Proxy app ke samne ek antim-resort network boundary hai; Next.js behatar APIs ka build kar raha hai isliye devalapars ko iski requirement nahi hai. Codemod: npx @next/codemod@canary middleware-to-proxy. (renames file + function middleware → proxy).
  • Version history: v16.0.0 - midalaveyar deprecated/renamed se Proxy, Node.js runtime default; v15.5.0 — Node.js runtime static; v15.2.0 — Node.js runtime experimental; v13.1.0 — advanced flag; v13.0.0 — header sanshodhan + uttar; v12.2.0 — midalaveyar static; v12.0.0 — midalaveyar (beta).
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: koi matcher = static assets par bhi chalta hai; Proxy eksapres midalaveyar nahi hai aur sajha state ke liye ek jagah nahi hai; Server Functions unke route ke maichar ko legacy mein mila; runtime config Proxy mein throw karta hai; _next/data hamesha bahar nikalane par Proxy chalata hai; Proxy par uddeshy-built-in API ko pasand karte hain.

Key concepts: Next.js root directory mein ek public folder se static files (e.g. images) ka karya karta hai. public ke andar ki files bes URL (/) se sandarbhit hain: public/avatars/me.png ko /avatars/me.png, e.g mein served jata hai. <Image src={/avatars/${id}.} alt={alt} width="64" height="64" />.

  • Caching: Next.js surakshit roop se public assets ko cache nahi kar sakta kyonki ve badal sakte hain - default header Cache-Control: public, max-age=0 hai.

route.js` (Route Handlers)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai route.js` (Route Handlers). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: route.js` (Route Handlers) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: HTTP methods, Parameters, Route Context helper, Examples, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Route Handlers web Request/Response APIs ka upyog karke ek route ke liye custom request handler banate hain. mool udaharan: export async function GET() { return Response.json({ message: 'Hello World' }) }

  • HTTP vidhi: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS — prati vidhi ek Async function export karein (export async function GET(request: Request) {}). yadi OPTIONS ko define nahi kiya gaya hai, to Next.js auto-implements ise set karta hai aur any define tarikon ke aadhar par Allow header set karta hai.
  • Parameters:
  • request (optional): ek NextRequest — Web Request API ko cookies ke saath vistarit kiya gaya tha aur ek parsed nextUrl (e.g) ke saath vistarit kiya gaya. request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('query') - /api/search?query=hello ke liye "hello".
  • context (optional): { params } - route ke dynamic param ka ek Promise. /dashboard/1 → Promise<{ team: '1' }>; app/shop/[tag]/[item]/route.js → Promise<{ tag: '1', item: '2' }>; catch-ol app/blog/[...slug]/route.js → Promise<{ slug: ['1', '2'] }>. ise chhor dein. app/dashboard/[team]/route.js
  • Route Context helper: RouteContext<'/users/[id]'> ek root sakshar se sandarbh (ctx.params) type karta hai; global roop se prakar pidhi ke baad upalabdh, koi import ki zaroorat nahi.
  • Examples:
  • cookies: next/headers se cookies() — cookieStore.get('a'), .set('b', '1'), .delete('c'); ya Set-Cookie header ke saath Response wapas lautein; ya NextRequest par request.cookies.get('token') ke madhyam se parhein.
  • header: next/headers se headers() keval (headersList.get('referer')); header set karne ke liye, headers ke saath ek naya Response wapas lautein. ya new Headers(request.headers) ke madhyam se padha.
  • cache data ko naveeneekrit karna: export const revalidate = 60 route file (ISR ke liye Route Handlers) mein.
  • Redirects: import { redirect } from 'next/navigation' tab redirect('https://nextjs.org/') ek handler ke andara.
  • dynamic segment: app/items/[slug]/route.ts - const { slug } = await params; generateStaticParams static roop se listed param ke liye build samay par pratikriya generated karta hai, dusron ne dynamic roop se sambhala; Cache Components ke saath previous aur runtime param ke data caching ke liye generateStaticParams + use cache ko jodti hai.
  • streaming: LLM-style AI SDK (streamText + StreamingTextResponse) ya kachche Web APIs ke madhyam se streaming - ek async iterator ko ReadableStream (pull/enqueue/close) aur return new Response(stream) mein parivartit karein.
  • body ka request karein: await request.json(); FormData: await request.formData() to formData.get('name') - sabhi maan taar hain, isliye validate/coerce ke saath e.g. zod-form-data
  • CORS: new Response('Hello, Next.js!', { headers: { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*', 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS', 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type, Authorization' } }) ke madhyam se prati-handler set; multiple handler Proxy ya next.config.js header ka upyog karte hain.
  • webhook: POST handler parhne await request.text(), try/catch error par 400 lautne aur 200 'Success!' ko anyatha; koi bodyParser config ki zaroorat nahi hai ( Pages Router API root ke viprit).
  • gair-UI pratikriyaein: seedhe XML aadi lautein, e.g. app/rss.xml/route.ts ek RSS string ko Content-Type: text/xml ke saath return karta hai. (sitemap.xml, robots.txt, application icon, OG images mein built-in support hai.
  • segment config: Route Handlers usi route segment config ka upyog pages/layouts: export const dynamic = 'auto', dynamicParams = true, revalidate = false, fetchCache = 'auto', runtime = 'nodejs', preferredRegion = 'auto' (deprecated) ke roop mein karta hai.
  • Version history: v15.0.0-RC — context.params ek Promise ban gaya (codemod upalabdh); v15.0.0-RC — GET handler ke liye default caching static se dynamic mein badal gaya; v13.2.0 — Route Handlers ne pesh kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: GET handler default roop se V15 (ab static nahi) ke baad se dynamic hain; OPTIONS auto-implemented; context.params ek Promise hai; headers() keval padha jata hai; koi bodyParser ki zaroorat; Route Handlers pages ke saath route segment config sajha karte hain.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ek template ek layout ki tarah ek layout ya page lapeta hai - lekin layout ke viprit, jo routes ke par bane rahte hain aur state ko banaye rakhte hain, templates ko ek unique key milti hai, isliye children Client Components ne apne state ko navigation par reset kiya. templates ka upyog karein: navigation par useEffect ko phir se sinkronaaiz karein; navigation par children Client Component state ko reset karein (e.g). layout ke andar Suspense ki simaein keval pahle load par ek fallback dikhati hain, jabki templates ise har navigation par dikhate hain.

  • Convention: default roop se React component ko template.js se export karta hai jo children prop ko accept karta hai:
tsx
  // app/template.tsx
  export default function Template({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <div>{children}</div>
  }

nesting: <Layout><Template key={routeParam}>{children}</Template></Layout> - template ek layout aur uske bachchon ke beech render karta hai; padanukram mein yeh layout.js aur error.js ke beech baithta hai, error.js, loading.js, not-found.js aur page.js ko lapeta hai, lekin NOT usi segment mein layout.js.

  • BHavior: template default roop se Server Components hain. ek template apne segment star ke liye ek unique key prapt karta hai aur jab us segment (iski dynamic param sahit) mein badlav aata hai; gahre segments ke bhitar navigation NOT ko uchch star ke templates ki punarbhugtaan karte hain; khoj param NOT trigger remount karte hain. wapas aane par: Client Component state ke andar reset ho jata hai, useEffect phir se synchronize ho jata hai, aur DOM elements ke andar puri tarah se banaya jata hai.
  • Remount walkthrough (tree: app/template.tsx, app/blog/template.tsx, app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx): / par, root template key / hai; /about par navigate karein - pahla segment parivartan, root template amounts (key /about); /blog par navigate karein - root template raashi (key /blog) aur blog star ke template mount (key /blog); /blog/first-post par navigate karein - root template key aprivartit, blog template amounts (key /blog/first-post); /blog/second-post par navigate karein - blog template phir se shuru hota hai (key /blog/second-post).
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — template pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: layout = lagatar state, template = prati navigation remount + state reset; key segment star prati hai (deep navigation uchch template nahi remount); khoj-param parivartan wapas nahi; templates keval pahle load ke bajaay har navigation par Suspense girbaik dikhane ka tareeka hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Experimental (production ke liye recommended nahi). unauthorized file UI render karta hai jab unauthorized() function ko lagu kiya jata hai. streaming shuru hone se pahle, Next.js ek 401 stetas code lauta data hai; streaming shuru hone ke baad, sthiti 200 bani hui hai aur andhikrit UI jawab mein render karta hai. Next.js donon mamlon mein <meta name="robots" content="noindex" /> injekt karta hai.

  • Key udaharan (verbatim):
tsx
  // app/unauthorized.tsx
  import Login from '@/app/components/Login'
  export default function Unauthorized() {
    return (
      <main>
        <h1>401 - Unauthorized</h1>
        <p>Please log in to access this page.</p>
        <Login />
      </main>
    )
  }
  • Usage pattern: ek page mein , session ko verify karne aur anupasthit hone par unauthorized() ko call karein:
tsx
  import { verifySession } from '@/app/lib/dal'
  import { unauthorized } from 'next/navigation'
  export default async function DashboardPage() {
    const session = await verifySession()
    if (!session) {
      unauthorized()
    }
    return <div>Dashboard</div>
  }
  • Props: unauthorized.js component koi props accept nahi karta.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: v15.1.0 ke baad se prayogik; 401 keval streaming shuru hone se pahle (ke baad: 200 + UI); hamesha noindex. Next.js pratyek unauthorized.js ko apne segment ke tahat har route ke saath ship karta hai, yahan tak ki jab unauthorized() ko kabhi nahi bulaya jata hai, aur Client Components ko load karta hai, yeh un pages par import karta hai - interactive UI par Server Components aur <Link> ko pasand karte hain. joda forbidden.js (403) aur not-found.js (404) ke saath auth-interrupt parivar ke roop mein; authInterrupts config ke madhyam se enable karein.
  • RELated: unauthorized() fankshana.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: favicon, icon, ya apple-icon file conventions ne apne app ke liye icon set kiya - browser tab, phon hom screen, khoj parinam mein dikhaya gaya hai. do tarike: image files ya code pidhi.

  • Image files:
file conventionsupported prakarvaidh sthan
favicon.icokeval app/ (top level)
icon.ico, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .svgapp/**/*
apple-icon.jpg, .jpeg, .pngapp/**/*

file ko /app mein rakhein; Next.js iska mulyankan karta hai aur sahi <link> tag ko <head> mein auto-adds karta hai. favicon.ico → <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" sizes="any" />; icon.* → <link rel="icon" href="/icon?<generated>" type="image/<generated>" sizes="<generated>" />; apple-icon.* → <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/apple-icon?<generated>" type="image/<generated>" sizes="<generated>" />. multiple icon: sankhya-suffixed naam (icon1.png, icon2.png,...) ne lexically sort kiya. rel/href/type/sizes file ke prakar aur metadata (e.g) se prapt hote hain. ek 32 × 32 .png type="image/png" sizes="32x32" ho jata hai); .svg ke liye sizes="any" ya set aakaar. Favicons ko keval root /app segment mein set kiya jaa sakta hai - adhik daanedaartaa ke liye icon ka upyog karein.

  • code ke saath Generate icon (.js, .ts, .tsx): ek icon ya apple-icon root default roop se ek function ka export karta hai; next/og se ImageResponse ke saath sabse aasan:
tsx
  // app/icon.tsx
  import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'
  export const size = { width: 32, height: 32 }
  export const contentType = 'image/png'
  export default function Icon() {
    return new ImageResponse(
      (<div style={{ fontSize: 24, background: 'black', width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', color: 'white' }}>A</div>),
      { ...size }
    )
  }

→ <link rel="icon" href="/icon?<generated>" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" /> jenret kiye gaye icon static roop se customize hote hain (build time aur cached par banaya gaya) jab tak ki ve request samay API ya bina data ka upyog nahi karte hain; ve default roop se cache kiye gaye vishesh Route Handlers hain. generateImageMetadata ke madhyam se prati file multiple aaikana. aap CANNOT ek favicon generated karte hain - icon ya favicon.ico file ka upyog karte hain.

  • Props — params (optional): () icon ke segment (app/shop/[slug]/icon.tsx) ko neeche root segment se dynamic root params ka Promise, /shop/1 → Promise<{ slug: '1' }>; app/shop/icon.js → undefined). generateImageMetadata ke saath, function ko ek id prop bhi prapt hota hai (wapsi ki gai vastuon mein se ek se id ka prachar).
  • Returns: Blob; ArrayBuffer; TypedArray; DataView. ReadableStream Response ImageResponse
  • Config export: size = { width, height } aur contentType (image MIME type string, e.g). 'image/png'. pratik Pages/Layouts. ke saman route segment config vikalpon ka support karta hai
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — params ab ek Promise hai; v13.3.0 — favicon/icon/apple-icon shuru kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: favicon keval root app/ aur keval .ico par; multiple aaiknon ke liye sankhyaabaddh files; default roop se cache kiye gaye icon generated; koi code generated faaivikon nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: apne web application (PWA) ke bare mein browser jankari dene ke liye Web Manifest Specification directory ke root mein Web Manifest Specification se mel khaati ek manifest.(json|webmanifest) file jorein ya generated karein. app

  • Static file: app/manifest.json (ya app/manifest.webmanifest) JSON ke saath { "name": "My Next.js Application", "short_name": "Next.js App", "description": "An application built with Next.js", "start_url": "/" } ki taraha.
  • code ke saath Generate: app/manifest.js/manifest.ts default roop se ek function ko eksport karta hai jo Manifest objekt return karta hai ('next' se MetadataRoute.Manifest type karein):
ts
  import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'
  export default function manifest(): MetadataRoute.Manifest {
    return {
      name: 'Next.js App',
      short_name: 'Next.js App',
      description: 'Next.js App',
      start_url: '/',
      display: 'standalone',
      background_color: '#fff',
      theme_color: '#fff',
      icons: [{ src: '/favicon.ico', sizes: 'any', type: 'image/x-icon' }],
    }
  }

manifest.js default roop se ek vishesh Route Handler cache hai jab tak ki yeh ek request samay API ya dynamic config ka upyog nahi karta hai.

  • Manifest objekt: vyapak vikalp list jo web standards ke saath viksit hoti hai - sabhi vartaman vikalpon ke liye apne editor (TypeScript) ya MDN Web Manifest docs mein MetadataRoute.Manifest prakar ki check karein.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: prakatan keval app ki root par rahta hai (non nested segment); static banam generated variant; generated prakatan ek cached Route Handler hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai opengraph-image and twitter-image. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: opengraph-image and twitter-image — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Precedence with metadata exports, Image files, Generate with code (`.js`, `.ts`, `.tsx`), Props — `params` (optional), Returns, Config exports. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: opengraph-image aur twitter-image file conventions ne ek route segment ke liye opan Graph/Twitter chhaviyan set ki - jab ek link sajha kiya jata hai to soshal network aur maisejing app par dikhaye gaye chitra. do tarike: image files ya code pidhi.

  • metadata export ke saath Precedence: (static aur generated images par lagu hota hai, metadata ordring ke baad) - ek page ka spasht openGraph.images/twitter.images (metadata ya generateMetadata se) related file ko override karta hai, jismein saman segments mein files aur parent segments se legacy mein mili hui chhaviyan shamil hain. E.g app/blog/page.tsx setting openGraph.images: ['/custom-og.png'] ne app/blog/opengraph-image.png par jeetee. layout metadata: ek page ka koloneted image file, jise same/parent segment mein layout dwara configure kiya gaya images ko replace kar sakta hai, jab page related images sanpatti ko chhor data hai.
  • Image files: opengraph-image.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif) aur twitter-image.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif) kisi bhi route segment mein; Next.js auto-adds <head> tag: <meta property="og:image" content="<generated>" /> + og:image:type/width/height; <meta name="twitter:image" … /> + type/width/height. optional text usi segment mein .txt files ke saath: opengraph-image.alt.txt yukt e.g. About Acme → <meta property="og:image:alt" content="About Acme" /> (twitter-image.alt.txt ke liye saim). size boundary: twitter-image ≤ 5MB, opengraph-image ≤ 8MB - unmein se adhik build fail rahta hai.
  • code ke saath Generate (.js, .ts, .tsx): ek opengraph-image/twitter-image route default roop se ek function ka export karta hai, jo next/og se ImageResponse ke saath sabse aasan hai:
tsx
  // app/about/opengraph-image.tsx
  import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'
  import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
  import { join } from 'node:path'
  export const alt = 'About Acme'
  export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 }
  export const contentType = 'image/png'
  const interSemiBold = await readFile(join(process.cwd(), 'assets/Inter-SemiBold.ttf'))
  export default async function Image() {
    return new ImageResponse(
      (<div style={{ fontSize: 128, background: 'white', width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>About Acme</div>),
      { ...size, fonts: [{ name: 'Inter', data: interSemiBold, style: 'normal', weight: 400 }] }
    )
  }

generated chhaviyan static roop se customize hain (build-time + cached) jab tak ki ve request samay APIs/uncached data ka upyog nahi karte hain; ve default roop se vishesh Route Handlers cached hain. prati file multiple chhaviyan generateImageMetadata ke madhyam se.

  • Props - params (optional): image ke segment (app/shop/[slug]/opengraph-image.js) ko neeche dynamic param ka Promise /shop/1 → Promise<{ slug: '1' }>; app/shop/opengraph-image.js → undefined). generateImageMetadata ke saath, ek id prop bhi prapt karta hai (object ke id ka prachar).
  • Returns: ek Response (ImageResponse is santusht hain).
  • Config export: alt (string), size = { width, height } (e.g). 1200 × 630), contentType (MIME prakar). saman route segment config vikalp Pages/Layouts. ke roop mein
  • Examples: external data — app/posts/[slug]/opengraph-image.tsx ne params.slug ka wait kiya, post ko prapt kiya, {post.title} ko ImageResponse mein render kiya (static roop se default roop se customize; vikalp ya segment config ke madhyam se tune). Node.js runtime + local sanpatti - module gunjaish (await readFile(join(process.cwd(), 'logo.png'), 'base64') → data:image/png;base64,… for <img src>) par ek bar logo ko padha, kyonki asset request data par nirbhar nahi karti hai; ya ArrayBuffer (Uint8Array.from(logoData).buffer) ko <img src> ke roop mein paas karti hai - runtime par Satori injan dwara supported lekin HTML spek mein nahi, isliye TypeScript ko {/* @ts-expect-error Satori accepts ArrayBuffer/typed arrays for <img src> at runtime */} comment ki requirement hai.
  • Troubleshooting: file aadharit image ka upyog nahi kiya jata hai - reindred og:image/twitter:image meta tag ka inspect karein; page ke metadata export mein openGraph.images/twitter.images ke liye check karein ( sajha vastuon se copy ki gai sanpatti sahit); puri tarah se colocated file ka upyog karne ke liye images sanpatti ko chhor dein. not: images ko [], null ya undefined mein set karna abhi bhi file aadharit image ko override karta hai; tvitar ke liye, keval [] bhi Open Graph images ko hal karne ke liye fallback ko daba data hai. Inherited image gayab ho jata hai - ek children ka route openGraph/twitter ko images ke bina define karta hai aur koi colocated file legacy mein mili hui images ko kho sakta hai; metadata ko legacy mein rakhne ke liye vilay karta hai.
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — params ab ek Promise hai; v13.3.0 — opengraph-image/twitter-image pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: spasht metadata file aadharit images ko maarta hai; images: []/null/undefined abhi bhi file ko override karta hai; size boundary build mein fail; default roop se generated images; 1200 × 630 manak OG size hai.

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai robots.txt. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: robots.txt — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Static file, Generate with code, Per-agent rules, Non-standard directives (v16.3.0), Robots object type, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: khoj injan krolars jo URL ve access kar sakte hain ko bataane ke liye app directory ke root mein Robots Exclusion Standard se mel khaate hue ek robots.txt file jorein ya generated karein.

  • Static file: app/robots.txt:
txt
  User-Agent: *
  Allow: /
  Disallow: /private/
  Sitemap: https://acme.com/sitemap.xml
  • code ke saath Generate: app/robots.js/robots.ts default roop se ek function ko ek Robots objekt ('next' se MetadataRoute.Robots type karein); default roop se ek vishesh Route Handler cached, jab tak ki yeh request samay API ya dynamic config ka upyog nahi karta hai:
ts
  import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'
  export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
    return {
      rules: { userAgent: '*', allow: '/', disallow: '/private/' },
      sitemap: 'https://acme.com/sitemap.xml',
    }
  }
  • Per-agent niymon: ek array ko rules — e.g paas karta hai. { userAgent: 'Googlebot', allow: ['/'], disallow: '/private/' } aur { userAgent: ['Applebot', 'Bingbot'], disallow: ['/'] }; pratyek userAgent maan ko output mein apna khud ka User-Agent: block milta hai.
  • gair manak directive (v16.3.0): injan jaise Seznam (Request-Rate) ya Yandex (Clean-param) manak ke bahar support directive - unhein ek niyam par other field ke madhyam se passed karein: other: { 'Request-Rate': '10/1m' }. key aavaran ko preserve karti hai; array maan prati entry ek line ka utsarjan karte hain, jo niyam ke User-Agent block ke dayre mein aata hai. manon ko kriya ke madhyam se passed kiya jata hai - Next.js nirdeshaatmak names/values ko valid nahi karta hai; satik syntax ke liye target injan ke docs ki check karein.
  • Robots objekt prakar:
tsx
  type Robots = {
    rules:
      | { userAgent?: string | string[]; allow?: string | string[]; disallow?: string | string[]; crawlDelay?: number; other?: Record<string, string | number | Array<string | number>> }
      | Array<{ userAgent: string | string[]; allow?: string | string[]; disallow?: string | string[]; crawlDelay?: number; other?: Record<string, string | number | Array<string | number>> }>
    sitemap?: string | string[]
    host?: string
  }
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — other field gair manak prati agent directive ke liye joda gaya; v13.3.0 — robots shuru kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: robot file keval app ki root par rahti hai; array niyam prati user agent ek block ka production karte hain; other kriyaasheel hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai sitemap.xml. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: sitemap.xml — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Static sitemap, Generate with code, Image sitemaps, Video sitemaps, Localized sitemaps, Multiple sitemaps. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: sitemap.(xml|js|ts) ek vishesh file hai jo sitemap XML format se mel khaati hai jo khoj injan krolars ko aapki site ko adhik kushalataa se anukrmit karne mein madad karta hai.

  • Static sitemap: app (chhote apps ke liye achha) ki root mein app/sitemap.xml, <urlset> entries ke saath <loc>, <lastmod>, <changefreq>, <priority> (e.g) ghareloo priority 1 vaarshik; lagabhag 0.8 maasik; blog 0.5 weekly).
  • code ke saath Generate: app/sitemap.(js|ts) default roop se ek function ko URL ki ek array return karta hai; 'next' se MetadataRoute.Sitemap type karein. default roop se cached ek vishesh Route Handler jab tak yeh request samay API ya dynamic config ka upyog nahi karta hai:
ts
  import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'
  export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
    return [
      { url: 'https://acme.com', lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'yearly', priority: 1 },
      { url: 'https://acme.com/about', lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'monthly', priority: 0.8 },
      { url: 'https://acme.com/blog', lastModified: new Date(), changeFrequency: 'weekly', priority: 0.5 },
    ]
  }
  • Image sitemaps: ek entry par images: ['https://example.com/image.jpg'] <image:image><image:loc>… ko xmlns:image nemaspes ke saath utsarjit karta hai.
  • Video sitemap: videos: [{ title: 'example', thumbnail_loc: 'https://example.com/image.jpg', description: 'this is the description' }] <video:video> ko title/thumbnail_loc/description ke saath xmlns:video namespace ke tahat utsarjit karta hai.
  • Localized sitemaps: alternates: { languages: { es: 'https://acme.com/es', de: 'https://acme.com/de' } } xmlns:xhtml ke tahat <xhtml:link rel="alternate" hreflang="es" href="…" /> entries ka utsarjan karta hai.
  • Multiple sitemaps: (1) nested sitemap.(xml|js|ts) multiple route segments ke andar, e.g. app/sitemap.xml aur app/products/sitemap.xml; (2) generateSitemaps ka upyog karte hain - [{ id: 0 }, { id: 1 }, { id: 2 }, { id: 3 }] lautte hain aur default export ko props.id (A Promise<string>, v16.0.0) prapt hota hai. udaharan: app/product/sitemap.ts slice product 50,000 prati sitemap (Google ki boundary prati sitemap 50,000 URL hai), pratyek ke nakshe { url: \${BASE_URL}/product/${product.id}\, lastModified: product.date }; jenret kiye gaye saaeetmaip ko /.../sitemap/[id].xml, e.g mein served jata hai. /product/sitemap/1.xml
  • Returns — sitemap prakar:
tsx
  type Sitemap = Array<{
    url: string
    lastModified?: string | Date
    changeFrequency?: 'always' | 'hourly' | 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' | 'yearly' | 'never'
    priority?: number
    alternates?: { languages?: Languages<string> }
    images?: string[]
    videos?: Videos[]
  }>
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — id ab ek string ko hal karne ka Promise hai; v14.2.0 — sthaniyakaran support; v13.4.14 — changeFrequency and priority joda gaya; v13.3.0 — sitemap pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: static banam generated sitemaps; Google ki 50,000-URL boundary prati sitemap generateSitemaps ke madhyam se vibhajit karne ka karan hai; default roop se cached saaeetmaipa.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai dynamicParams. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: dynamicParams — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage, Values, Background, With Cache Components, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: dynamicParams niyantran kya hota hai jab ek dynamic segment ka daura kiya jata hai jo generateStaticParams ke saath generated NOT tha.

  • Usage:
tsx
  // layout.tsx | page.tsx
  export const dynamicParams = true // true | false

route.js mein bhi prayog kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • Values: true (default) - dynamic route segments mein nahi generateStaticParams request samay par generated hote hain. false - is tarah ke segment ek 404 wapsi karte hain.
  • background: yeh vikalp pages directory mein getStaticPaths ke fallback: true | false | blocking vikalp ko replace karta hai.
  • With Cache Components: dynamicParams NOT upalabdh hai jab Cache Components enable ho jata hai. generateStaticParams dwara wapas nahi jaane wale path ko request samay par sambhala jata hai; page par notFound() ko call karein jab request kiya gaya sansadhan nahi hone ke bawajud UI ko render karne ke liye maujud nahi hai (dekhein stetas code / loading kaise streaming HTTP sthiti ko affected karta hai).
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: dynamicParams: false fallback: false ke barabar App Router hai; Cache Components ke saath vikalp puri tarah se gayab ho jata hai aur aap notFound() ke saath lapta sansadhanon ko sambhalte hain.

ensureStatic

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai ensureStatic. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: ensureStatic — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Prerequisites, Usage, Reference, `'shell'`, `'prefetch'`, `'navigation'`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ensureStatic ko prati request ke bajaay static hone ke liye chaynit route output ki requirement hoti hai. ise ek page ya layout se eksport karein taaki ise App Shell, prati-link prefetch, ya full server-render route ke liye lagu kiya jaa sake - isliye baad mein parivartan galti se request-samay server ko ek navigation step mein render nahi kar sakte jinhein static rahna chahiye (dekhein "keeping page static").

  • Prerequisites: keval tabhi kaam karta hai jab cacheComponents ko enable kiya jata hai - build anyatha fail rahta hai. ek Client Component se ensureStatic ko export karne se error ho jati hai.
  • Usage:
tsx
  // app/blog/layout.tsx
  export const ensureStatic = 'navigation'
  • Reference: 'auto', 'shell', 'prefetch', 'navigation', ya false ko accept karta hai; default 'auto' = export ko chhor data hai. niyantran jo server-render output static hona chahiye; Partial Prefetching ke saath in aautputon ko "navikaran step" kaha jata hai. pratyek sakht star mein pahle step shamil hain:

| Value | output jo static hona chahiye |

| 'auto' (default) | koi extra static requirement nahi |

| 'shell' | app shail |

| 'prefetch' | App Shell aur prati link prefetch |

| 'navigation' | pura server-render route | false koi static star ka chayan nahi karta hai - common rendering ko preserve rakhta hai aur ek any segment ko 'shell', 'prefetch' ya 'navigation' ko root mein lagane se rokta hai. |

  • 'shell': ko ek default <Link> dwara static hone ke liye load kiye gaye App Shell ki requirement hoti hai. Without Partial Prefetching koi App Shell nahi hai, isliye koi prabhav nahi hai aur Next.js ek warning log karta hai. shell mein static/cached content aur <Suspense> fallback shamil ho sakte hain; <Suspense> ke pichhe request-vishisht content baad mein prati-link prefetch (<Link prefetch={true}>) ke dauraan ya navigation ke dauraan render kar sakti hai. await prefetch() prati-subtree ki tarah lekin root-void ko lagu kiya. not: 'shell' NOT ko prati-link prefetch ki requirement hoti hai - yadi route cookies()/headers()/URL data ko await navigation() se pahle padhta hai, to pratyek view <Link prefetch={true}> abhi bhi ek server render ko trigger kar sakta hai; jab prefetch ko static bhi hona chahiye to 'prefetch' ka upyog karein.
  • 'prefetch': ko App Shell AND prati-link prefetch ki requirement hoti hai. Without Partial Prefetching koi requirement nahi jodta hai (link common full-prefetch behavior rakhte hain); ek full prefetch mein request-vishisht data shamil ho sakta hai aur static ki guarantee nahi hai). user link ka anusaran karne se pahle prati-link prefetch static/cached URL-vishisht content ko load kar sakta hai; navigation pura hone par <Suspense> renders ke pichhe request-vishisht content. static HTML shell mein is static/cached prati-link content shamil ho sakte hain lekin kabhi request-vishisht data (yeh previous hai) nahi. await navigation() prati subtree ki tarah lekin root-void ko lagu kiya.
  • 'navigation': ko prerendering ke dauraan utpaadit hone wale full server-render route ki requirement hoti hai, isliye initial bhar aur client navigation static production ka upyog karte hain. akele Cache Components ke saath kaam karta hai, koi Partial Prefetching ki zaroorat nahi hai. pure app ke liye static server output ki requirement ke liye, root layout par 'navigation' set karein.
  • Validation: 'shell'/'prefetch' mein koi build manyata nahi hai ( ke andar apekshit-vishisht karya baad ke step mein chal sakta hai; Instant Navigation authentication <Suspense> ke bahar request-vishisht karya ki report kar sakta hai kyonki yeh navigation ko blocked karta hai). 'navigation' antim step hai, isliye Next.js donon next dev aur next build mein apni puri static-output requirement ko valid karta hai (dev errors mein source-maipd stack trace shamil hain; build production sankshipt hai - vistar ke liye next build --debug-prerender ka upyog karein). <Suspense>
  • Kya 'navigation' E ke saath validation mein fail rahta hai (yahan tak ki <Suspense> ke andar ya instant = false ke saath): uncached data ( fetch / DB call bina use cache, connection()); runtime data (cookies(), headers(), server-side searchParams); 5 minat ke tahat expire ke saath ek use cache gunjaish, 30 sekand ke tahat stale, ya revalidate 0 (stale 30 s-5 minat ki permission hai); request-nirbhar server data ke liye ek Promise jise Client Component ko padha ya nahi hai. ye baadhaaein bhi generateMetadata aur generateViewport par lagu hoti hain. permission di: use cache (prerenderable); prefetch() aur navigation() (static prerender unke step boundaries ke madhyam se jari hai) ke saath cache data.
  • Dynamic route params: 'navigation' ke saath , ek dynamic route kam se kam ek full parameter set lauta generateStaticParams() export karna chahiye - pratyek dynamic parameter shamil hai, bhale hi upyog na kiya jaaye ya keval Client Component mein padha jaaye. Unprerendered maan: Next.js serve se pahle generated hone wale static parinam ke liye wait karta hai. 'shell'/'prefetch' ke saath, ek apryukt value <Suspense> ke fallback hisse ke saath wapsi ke shell ka karya karta hai jabki page background mein generated hota hai (Cache Components ke saath ISR). build fail rahta hai agar generateStaticParams() lapta hai ya ek adhooraa set return karta hai.
  • Client Components: browser mein request-vishisht content ko load kar sakta hai; <Suspense>, use(browser()) aur use(io()) ke andar permission di jati hai (provider mein fallback shamil hai). client hook useParams() / useSearchParams() ki permission hai; dynamic routes ko abhi bhi generateStaticParams() ki requirement hoti hai; ek Server Component se request-nirbhar Promise passed karna abhi bhi errors hai.
  • false: Partial Prefetching ke saath common rendering rakhta hai aur build mein fail rahta hai yadi dusra segment 'shell'/'prefetch'/'navigation' set karta hai - sanket karta hai ki segment static roop se customize nahi hai.
  • Kaise ensureStatic instant se bhinn hota hai: ensureStatic ko request-samay par kaam se bachne ke liye chaynit server-render output ki requirement hoti hai. instant authenticated karta hai ki kya ek navigation turant UI ko update kar sakta hai (cached/prerendered UI ise request-vishisht content dharaon ke baad <Suspense> ke pichhe santusht kar sakta hai). instant = false ki installation Instant Navigation validation ko disabled karta hai; 'shell'/'prefetch' abhi bhi client ko related static production ka request karte hain lekin koi alag build valid nahi hai; 'navigation' alag-alag static-output validation ka upyog karta hai ki instant = false aaram nahi karta hai.
  • Combining star: root layout par ek star har route par lagu hota hai; pratyek route par ek any layout par ise render karta hai (incl. nested layouts/pages/parallel route). ek route ke bhitar star har segment ko cover karta hai, jismein iske upar layout shamil hain. Unset/'auto' kisi bhi star ke saath sangat hai. ek vanshaj ek sakht star set kar sakta hai, ek kamjor nahi - e.g. layout 'prefetch' + page 'navigation' ki permission hai; ek kamjor bachcha build mein fail rahta hai ("ek bachcha segment kam prashikshit ensureStatic ke saath ek parent segment ko override nahi kar sakta hai."). parent/child mein static star ke saath false milaanaa fail ho gaya ("incompatible ensureStatic"). parallel routes ko ek saath render karna ek hi value set karna chahiye, ise bina set chhor dena, ya 'auto' ka upyog karna - takrav maan fail ("paraalel slot mein asangat ensureStatic nahi ho sakta hai").
  • TypeScript:
tsx
  type EnsureStatic = 'auto' | 'shell' | 'prefetch' | 'navigation' | false
  export const ensureStatic: EnsureStatic = 'navigation'
  • Version history: v16.4.0 — ensureStatic pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: keval Cache Components (bilding anyatha fail rahta hai); sakht-keval legacy; 'navigation' build manyata ke saath ekmatr star hai; 'navigation' ke tahat dynamic routes ko full generateStaticParams() ki requirement hoti hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/route-segment-config/ensureStatic

instant

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai instant. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: instant — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Prerequisites, Usage, Reference, Disabling instant, Disabling static shell validation, How validation works. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: instant ko controlled karta hai ki kaise Next.js ne yeh authenticated kiya ki kya is segment mein ek navigation tatkal UI ka production karega. Next.js vartaman page par sabhi in-app linkon ke liye navigation ki bhavishyavani karta hai, lekin client-side data lane ya partial roop se prerender server parinam turant UI ko update nahi kar sakte hain. instant aapko yeh ghoshna karne data hai ki kya ummid ki jaa sakti hai - e.g. ki is segment mein navigation ko external roop se load kiye gaye data par wait kiye bina turant render karna chahiye, ya ve tatkal hone ki ummid nahi kar rahe hain. jab ek segment ek tatkal UI ki ummid karta hai, to Next.js kisi bhi code ko satah data hai jo turant UI ko update karne se navigation ko blocked karega ( guide dekhein). Instant Navigation

  • Prerequisites: keval tabhi kaam karta hai jab cacheComponents enable hai; Client Components mein istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta hai (ek error ko throw karta hai). Next.js development mein prefetch nahi karta hai, isliye navigation production mein tatkal ke roop mein nahi mehsoos kar sakte hain - validation next start ke dauraan kya hota hai.
  • Usage:
tsx
  // layout.tsx | page.tsx
  export const instant = true
  • Reference:
  • true — kisi bhi star par us segment ko vaidhta mein chunta hai jise global star par configure kiya gaya hai (phremavark default: dev-keval, dev overlay mein errors).
  • false - segment ko bahar nikalta hai (dekhein "Disabling Instant").
  • objekt - vikalp ke saath vikalp chunta hai: { level: 'warning' }. 'warning' keval dev mein valid hai; errors dev overlay mein dikhai deti hain; build aprabhavit hai. bhavishy ka star build-time validation ka support karega; vartaman mein keval 'warning' maujud hai, isliye aamtaur par level ko nirdisht karne ki koi requirement nahi hai.
  • Disabling tatkal: ne layout/page ko us segment mein navigation ko blocked karne ki permission dene ke liye ek layout/page par false set kiya - upyogi jab ek gahra page tatkal hona chahiye lekin ek ancestor nahi ho sakta. udaharan: app/tabs/layout.tsx → export const instant = false, app/tabs/[tab]/page.tsx → export const instant = true; ek tab mein bahar se navigation layout par blocked ho sakta hai, lekin tab ke beech navigation tatkal UI ke liye valid hain. aapko tatkal page ke ancestors par false ki requirement nahi hai kyonki ve kuchh blocked karte hain - ek uchch-upar instant = true ko valid karne ke liye vanshjon ko majbur nahi karta hai; keval false tak pahunchein jab ek gahra page tatkal hota hai aur aapko blocked ancestors ke madhyam se gujarane wale navigation ko mukt karne ki requirement hoti hai. instant = false keval validation ko controlled karta hai; yeh route abhi bhi previous aur streaming ka upyog karta hai.
  • Disabling static shell validation: Cache Components bhi valid hai ki pratyek page previous samay par ek gair-khali static shell paida karta hai. ek route ko chunne ke liye, route ke per mein uchchatam instant config sunishchit karein false hai - per mein ek false uchch static-shell check ke liye kisi bhi gahre true par priority leta hai. mool layout par false ki installation pure app ke liye static shell validation ko disabled karti hai; false ko jitna sanbhav ho utna kam rakhein taaki baki app valid rahe.
  • Kaise validation karya: instant route mein har sajha layout boundary par validation ko trigger karta hai, development (page bhar aur HMR update) ke dauraan, dev error overlay mein sarphesing errors. pratyek error us component ko pehchanti hai jo navigation ko blocked karega; fix aamtaur par use cache ke saath data ko cache karne ya ise <Suspense> boundary mein lapetne ke liye hota hai.
  • Kaise instant ensureStatic: instant se bhinn hota hai, yeh authenticated karta hai ki kya ek navigation turant UI ko dikhata hai; ensureStatic ko chaynit server-render output ki requirement hoti hai taaki prati-request ke bajaay static ho. ek route puri tarah se static ho sakta hai aur abhi bhi ek navigation ko blocked kar sakta hai - e.g. jab ek Client Component browser mein data load karta hai.
  • Configuring Validation defaults: default validationLevel: 'warning' — Cache Components application har page aur default segment ko dev mein valid karte hain. next.config.js mein experimental.instantInsights.validationLevel ke madhyam se tune:
js
  module.exports = { experimental: { instantInsights: { validationLevel: 'warning' } } }

star: 'warning' (phremavark default - pratyek Page/Default segment spasht roop se valid, keval dev); 'manual-warning' - keval ek spasht instant wale segment ko valid kiya jata hai, keval deva. instant = false puri tarah se bahar nikalta hai. phremavark default bhavishy ke sanskaranon mein badal sakta hai (visheshajny, breaking badlav nahi) - validationLevel ko spasht roop se set karke pin vyavhar. phremavark-sanshleshit error routes (/_global-error, /_not-found) ko built-in validation se bahar rakha gaya hai; unhein valid karne ke liye instant ke saath spasht roop se chunein.

  • Inspecting loading rajyon: Cache Components enable ke saath , khula Next.js DevTools → Navigation Inspector → "Pause on navigation" par baaree. Refresh dynamic data dharaon se pahle initial static UI ko freeze karta hai; ek link par click karke destination ke liye prefetched UI ko freeze karta hai. navigation samapt karne ke liye Click Resume; togal tab tak ruk jata hai jab tak band ho jata hai. donon taza aur link click ki check karein.
  • Testing tatkal navigation: @next/playwright ek instant() helper ka export karta hai jo dynamic content ko wapas rakhta hai jabki callback tatkal UI ke khilaf chalta hai; automatic roop se dev mein upalabdh hai, aur experimental.exposeTestingApiInProductionBuild ke madhyam se production build karta hai.
  • Known issue: DevTools dynamic content ko wapas catch ke liye ek next-instant-navigation-testing cookie ka upyog karte hain; cookies domain ke dayre mein hain, port nahi - localhost par multiple projects chalate hue cookie sajha karte hain aur apratyashit behavior ka karan ban sakte hain; cookie ko saaf karein ya band karein Navigation Inspector jab sviching projekts (jab feature static ho jata hai to nishchit kiya jana chahiye).
  • TypeScript: type InstantConfig = true | false | { level?: 'warning' }.
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — instant export static, unstable_instant (keval Cache Components) ki jagaha.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: instant manyata hai, ek performance switch nahi - yeh blocked code ki satah hai, yeh code tatkal nahi banata hai; false ancestors ko itnaa gahra pages ko abhi bhi valid kiya jaa sakta hai; ek puri tarah se static route abhi bhi client-side data loading ke madhyam se navigation ko blocked kar sakta hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: DEPRECATED — apne root files se preferredRegion export ko hata dein (dipreshan sandesh dekhein). yeh ek route segment ke liye pasandida deployment field ko nirdisht karta hai, jo deployment manch ke madhyam se passed hota hai.

  • Usage (Historical):
tsx
  // layout.tsx | page.tsx | route.ts
  export const preferredRegion = // string || string[]
  • string: ek vishisht field (platform-vishisht code, e.g) ke route ko deploy karta hai. 'iad1')

Next.js pariniyojan manch ke madhyam se field values ko passed karta hai - satik behavior aur upalabdh code manch-vishisht hain.
  • Vercel: kshetron ko pahle keval export const runtime = 'edge' ke saath support diya gaya tha, jo ab deprecated hai. vikalp: 'auto' (default - default field), 'global' (sabhi upalabdh kshetron ko priority dein), 'home' (ghar field ko priority dein). ek unsupported value ek error throw karta hai.

prefetch (prefetch config)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai prefetch (prefetch config). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: prefetch (prefetch config) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Prerequisites, Usage, Options, `'partial'`, `'force-disabled'`, Relationship with the `<Link prefetch>` prop. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: prefetch route segment config controlled karta hai ki kaise client-side navigation ke dauraan ek segment ko prefetch kiya jata hai. default roop se dhancha app ke partialPrefetching setting ke aadhar par ranniti ka prabandhan karta hai; is export ko override karne ke liye prati segment set karta hai.

  • Prerequisites: keval tabhi kaam karta hai jab cacheComponents enable ho; Client Component mein istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta. sarthak maan 'partial' aur 'force-disabled' hain; 'auto' default hai (= export ko melt) - prefetch = 'auto' spasht roop se nahi likhte hain. ek page/layout jo prefetch() function ko bhi call karta hai, use dusre naam, e.g ke tahat import karna chahiye. import { prefetch as prefetchStage } from 'next/cache'
  • Usage:
tsx
  // layout.tsx | page.tsx
  export const prefetch = 'partial'
  • Options:
  • 'partial' - global partialPrefetching flag ko enable kiye bina segment ko Partial Prefetching mein chunta hai. is tarah ke ek segment mein point ek <Link> legacy full prefetch ke bajaay prati root App Shell load karta hai. ise destination par set karein, link nahi. <Link prefetch={true}> ke saath ek vyapak prefetch mein chunne wale link ke liye, Next.js prati-link prefetching ka upyog karta hai: server ek fresh pratikriya ko hal karta hai URL data (params, searchParams, full URL); puri tarah se static roop se render karne yogy page static cache se prefetch ki serve karte hain, jabki gair-static data tak pahunchne wale pages ko runtime par prefetch kiya jata hai. jab global flag ko abhi tak app-void enable nahi kiya jaa sakta hai to vriddhishil god lene ke liye upyog karein; ek bar jab pratyek route mein prefetch = 'partial' hai, to global flag ko enable karein aur prati root export ko hata dein. not: jab Next.js kisi segment ke liye prati-link prefetch karta hai, to sabhi downstream segments ko usi request mein shamil kiya gaya hai - gahre segments ko configure kiya gaya 'force-disabled' abhi bhi pratikriya ke hisse ke roop mein prefetch kiya gaya hai.
  • 'force-disabled' — is segment ko kabhi nahi moregaa; client navigation se pahle segment data ka request nahi karega. un segments ke liye upyog karein jahan prefetching bekaar hai, e.g. un pages ke pichhe jinhein shayad hi kabhi daura kiya jata hai. yeh NOT ko route ke bare mein metadata prefetch karne se Next.js ko rokta hai, lekin is segment ke liye actual segment data aur sabhi gahre segments ko chhor diya jata hai.
  • <Link prefetch> prop ke saath Relationship: ek prefetch ek <Link> eksapresing irade ke saath shuru hota hai (is destination ko prefetch kiya jaa sakta hai, aur kis tarah utsuk) aur ek segment setting mein ek lagat chhat par samapt hota hai (han bahut kaam samay se aage OK hai, kisi bhi link ke liye yahan point karta hai). segment config topi kya kisi bhi <Link prefetch={true}> kheenchtee hai: 'partial' → App Shell default link ke liye; <Link prefetch={true}> extra roop se URL data ko hal karta hai aur iske pichhe cached content; 'force-disabled' → puri tarah se segment data chhor data hai. <Link prefetch={false}> destination ke config ki parvah kiye bina link star par prefetching chhor data hai. puri tarah se static page static cache (ya ek CDN) se prefetch ki serve karte hain; gair-static data (cookies/headers) tak pahunchne wale pages ko ek fresh server render, lagat server CPU prati page view ke saath runtime par prefetch kiya jata hai.
  • TypeScript: type Prefetch = 'auto' | 'partial' | 'force-disabled'.
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — prefetch export static, unstable_prefetch (keval Cache Components) ki jagaha.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: ne destination segment par 'partial' ko set kiya, link par nahi; 'force-disabled' abhi bhi root metadata prefetch ki permission data hai; segment config ek lagat chhat hai, link prop irade hai.

Functions (index)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Functions (index). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Functions (index) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: API sandarbh index Next.js karyon aur App Router mein hook ke liye. jin entries ka anusaran karte hain un classes mein shamil:

  • after - ek pratikriya samapt hone ke baad code chalaein; cacheLife — ek cached function/component ke liye cache ekspaayreshan set karein; cacheTag — cache amanyata ka prabandhan karein; catchError — cached karyon se errors ko pakro; connection — code chalane se pahle request ke liye await karein; cookies — read/set cookies; draftMode — draft mode state; fetch — vistarit prapt karein; forbidden — nishiddh UI pradan karein; generateImageMetadata — ek Metadata API file mein multiple chhaviyan generated karein; generateMetadata - SEO/shareability ke liye metadata jorein; generateSitemaps — multiple sitemap banaein; generateStaticParams — previous dynamic route; generateViewport — set viewport metadata; headers — request header parhein; ImageResponse — rachnaakaar generated images ke liye; io — io function ke madhyam se browser mein code chalaein; navigation — defer runtime Work jab tak navigation; NextRequest — vistarit request; NextResponse — vistarit pratikriya; Hissa 150 / 471 · App Router · API Reference

after

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai after. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: after — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Not a request-time API, Reference — parameters, Good to know, With request APIs, Route Handlers and Server Functions, Server Components (pages/layouts). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: after schedule ek pratikriya (ya previous) ke baad chalane ke liye kaam karta hai - tasks/side prabhav ke liye jise loging aur analytics jaise pratikriya ko blocked nahi karna chahiye. Server Components (generateMetadata), Server Functions, Route Handlers, Proxy aur Proxy sahit) mein prayog kiya jaa sakta hai. 'next/server' se imported; pratikriya samapt hone ke baad executed callback leta hai:

tsx
  // app/layout.tsx
  import { after } from 'next/server'
  import { log } from '@/app/utils'
  export default function Layout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    after(() => {
      // Execute after the layout is rendered and sent to the user
      log()
    })
    return <>{children}</>
  }
  • Request-time API nahi hai: after call karna ek route ko dynamic NAHI banata. Ek static page par callback build time par execute hota hai, ya jab bhi page revalidate hota hai.
  • Reference — parameters: ek callback function jo response (ya prerender) khatm hone ke baad execute hota hai. Duration: after platform ke default ya route ke configured max duration tak chalta hai; agar platform support kare to maxDuration route segment config ke saath timeout configure karo.
  • Good to know: after tab bhi execute hota hai bhale hi response successfully complete na hua ho — error throw hone ya notFound/redirect call hone samet. Server Components me, React cache after ke andar call hue functions ko dedupe kar sakta hai; callback render ke dauraan pehle se compute hue values reuse karta hai. after ko dusre after calls ke andar nest kiya ja sakta hai (jaise utility wrappers).
  • Request APIs: cookies/headers ko after ke andar use kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi, ye is par depend karta hai ki ise kahan se call kiya gaya hai.
  • Route Handlers aur Server Functions: cookies/headers ko seedhe after callback ke andar call karo.
ts
    // app/api/route.ts
    import { after } from 'next/server'
    import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers'
    export async function POST(request: Request) {
      after(async () => {
        const userAgent = (await headers()).get('user-agent') || 'unknown'
        const sessionCookie = (await cookies()).get('session-id')?.value || 'anonymous'
        logUserAction({ sessionCookie, userAgent })
      })
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: 'success' }), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } })
    }
  • Server Components (pages/layouts): after ke andar cookies, headers ya koi request-time APIs use NAHI kar sakte — Next.js ko pata hona chahiye ki tree ka kaun sa hissa request data access karta hai (Partial Prerendering / Cache Components ke liye), lekin after React ke rendering lifecycle ke baad chalta hai. Request data pehle padho aur values ko closure ke through pass karo; ek Server Component me callback ke andar cookies()/headers() call karna ek runtime error throw karta hai.
  • Cache Components ke saath: request data use karne wale components ko <Suspense> me wrap karna chahiye taaki baaki page ek static shell me prerender ho. Dynamic component me (render ke dauraan) request data padho aur use closure ke through after me pass karo — jaise <Suspense> ke andar DynamicContent cookie padhta hai, after(() => logUserAction({ sessionCookie })) schedule karta hai aur UI return karta hai; <h1> aur fallback static shell me rehte hain.
  • Platform support: Node.js server — haan; Docker — haan; static export — nahi; adapters — platform-specific. after configure karne ke liye self-hosting guide dekho.
  • Serverless support (platform implementers ke liye): ek serverless context me after ko Promise resolve hone tak run lifetime extend karna padta hai. Next.js expect karta hai ki globalThis[Symbol.for('@next/request-context')] { get(): { waitUntil?: (promise: Promise<any>) => void } } ho; platforms ko apna waitUntil provide karna hoga (jaise waitUntil(promise) ko AsyncLocalStorage RequestContextStorage.run(contextValue, () => nextJsHandler(req, res)) ke saath).
  • Version history: v15.1.0 — after stable hua; v15.0.0-rc — unstable_after introduce hua.
  • Dhyaan do / interview points: after ek route ko dynamic nahi banata; ye errors/redirects/notFound par bhi chalta hai; after ke andar request APIs Route Handlers/Server Functions me allowed hain lekin Server Components me prohibited hain (pehle padho, pass karo); koi static export support nahi.
