cacheLife

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai cacheLife. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: cacheLife — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Setup, Preset profiles, Cache profile properties (3 timings), Preset profile table, Overriding default profiles, Custom profiles. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: cacheLife ek function ya component ke cache lifetime ko set karta hai, jiska upyog use cache nirdeshan ke saath aur 'next/cache' se imported function/component. ke dayre mein kiya jata hai.

  • Setup: pehle next.config me cacheComponents: true enable karo. cacheLife sirf ek cache directive scope ke andar use ho sakta hai (file level par ya ek async function/component ke top par use cache jodo); module scope me use nahi ho sakta — file ke top level par use call karna error throw karta hai. Recommendation: har use cache scope me ek cacheLife set karo, taaki behavior explicit ho (ise chhodne se implicit default profile reh jata hai); use usi function/component me call karo jahan caching define hai, shared utilities me abstract mat karo; pakka karo ki per invocation sirf ek call execute ho (alag branches OK hain, lekin per request sirf ek chalega).
  • Preset profiles (content kitni baar badalta hai, us hisaab se chuno): seconds (real-time: stock prices, live scores), minutes (social feeds, news), hours (product inventory, weather), days (blog posts), weeks (podcasts, newsletters), max (legal pages, archived content). Usage:
tsx
  'use cache'
  import { cacheLife } from 'next/cache'
  export default async function BlogPage() {
    cacheLife('days') // Blog content updated daily
    const posts = await getBlogPosts()
    return <div>{/* render posts */}</div>
  }

ek cacheLife call ke bina, default profile lagu hoti hai.

  • Cache profile properties (3 timings):
  • stale — client server ko check kiye bina cached data kitni der use kar sakta hai; iske dauraan client router bina network request ke cached content turant dikhata hai. Agar omitted ho, to default ke stale (5 min, staleTimes dekho) par default hota hai. Ye ye bhi set karta hai ki content route ke App Shell ka hissa ho sakta hai ya nahi. cacheLife({ stale: 300 }) = 5 min.
  • revalidate — is samay ke baad agli request ek background refresh trigger karti hai: server turant cached version serve karta hai, background me regenerate karta hai, cache update karta hai (ISR jaisa). Agar omitted ho, to default ke revalidate (15 min) par default hota hai. cacheLife({ revalidate: 900 }) = 15 min.
  • expire — server ko regenerate karne se pehle maximum samay; is period ke baad traffic na ho, to agli request fresh content ke liye synchronously wait karti hai. Jab dono set hon, to expire ko revalidate se lamba hona chahiye (Next.js validate karta hai). Agar omitted ho, to default ke expire par default hota hai (kabhi expire nahi). cacheLife({ expire: 3600 }) = 1 ghanta.
  • Preset profile table:

| Profile | mamle ka prayog karein | stale | revalidate | expire |

| default | manak content | 5 min | 15 min | never |

| seconds | reeyal-time data | 30 s | 1 s | 1 min |

| minutes | aksar update kiya gaya | 5 min | 1 min | 1 hour |

| hours | multiple dainik update | 5 min | 1 hour | 1 day |

| days | dainik update | 5 min | 1 day | 1 week |

| weeks | weekly update | 5 min | 1 week | 30 days |

| max | shayad hi kabhi badlav | 5 min | 30 days | 1 year |

  • Default profile override karna: next.config.ts me cacheLife: { default: { stale: 300, revalidate: 3600, expire: 86400 } } ke tahat kisi bhi preset (default aur max samet) ko redefine karo. Built-in naam editor autocomplete ke saath kaam karte rehte hain. Apne project me redefinitions document karo; time-named profiles (days ≈ 24 h expectation) ko redefine karna readers ko default/max redefine karne se zyada surprise karta hai. default redefine karna us lifetime ko bhi badal deta hai jo ek use cache scope par koi cacheLife call na hone par lagu hota hai. cacheLife ke type signatures next dev/next build/next typegen ke dauraan next.config.ts se generate hote hain, isliye autocomplete/JSDoc tumhare values dikhate hain.
  • Custom profile: next.config.ts me apne naam ke saath ek reusable profile define karo, jaise cacheLife: { biweekly: { stale: 14 days, revalidate: 1 day, expire: 14 days } }, phir cacheLife('biweekly'). Custom profile me missing properties default se inherit hoti hain; inline profile objects ke liye bhi wahi.
  • Inline profile: one-offs ke liye seedhe object pass karo — cacheLife({ stale: 3600, revalidate: 900, expire: 86400 }); sirf us function/component par lagu hota hai. cacheLife({}) par default profile lagu hota hai.
  • Client cache behavior: stale Client Cache ko control karta hai, Cache-Control header ko nahi — server stale time x-nextjs-stale-time response header se bhejta hai; client router use ye tay karne ke liye use karta hai ki kab revalidate karna hai. Minimum 30 s enforce hota hai (sirf time-based expiry ke liye) taaki prefetched links usable rahen. Ek Server Action se revalidation client cache ko pehle saaf kar sakti hai: ek profile resolve karne wale revalidatePath, updateTag aur revalidateTag jinka expire: 0 ho (inline { expire: 0 } samet) explicit previous routes aur back/forward pages saaf karte hain; refresh back/forward pages saaf karta hai aur dusre previous routes rakhta hai; nonzero expire (jaise 'max') ke saath revalidateTag client cache ko vaise hi chhod deta hai. cacheLife me stale staleTimes (global setting) se alag hai; staleTimes.static update karne se default profile ka stale bhi update hota hai.
  • Prerendering behavior: chhoti lifetimes badal deti hain ki content kahan distribute ho sakta hai: revalidate: 0 ya expire 5 min ke neeche: prerenders se bahar ('dynamic hole' request time par resolve hota hai); stale 30 second ke neeche: prerenders se bahar rakha gaya (user ke click karne se pehle prefetch expire ho jayega); stale 30 s–5 min: prerenders me shamil lekin route ke App Shell se bahar rakha gaya. seconds preset pehle se in thresholds ke neeche girta hai (iska 1 min expire use prerenders se bahar rakhta hai). Ye page ko static (prerendered) aur dynamic content mix karne deta hai — dynamic cache ko fallback ke liye <Suspense> me wrap karo.
  • Examples: per-page presets (app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx me cacheLife('days'), app/products/[id]/page.tsx me 'hours'); custom profiles (editorial stale 10 min / revalidate 1 h / expire 1 din; marketing stale 5 min / revalidate 30 min / expire 12 h); ek Route Handler ke cached function me inline profile (getLimitedOffer stale 1 min / revalidate 5 min / expire 1 h ke saath); per-function caching (getSettings, 'seconds' ke saath getRealtimeStats, 'max' ke saath).
  • Nested caching behavior: explicit outer cacheLife ke saath, outer cache apne lifetime ka use karta hai inner lifetime ki parwah kiye bina (explicit jeet-ta hai, chahe lamba ho ya chhota). Explicit outer cacheLife ke bina, outer default (15 min revalidate) use karta hai; chhoti lifetime wale inner caches use kam kar sakte hain, lekin ab use default se aage nahi badha sakte. Explicit cacheLife recommended hai taaki nested caches ko trace kiye bina behavior saaf ho.
  • Nested short-lived cache: ek short-lived cache (zero revalidate ya expire <5 min) jo bina explicit cacheLife wale use cache ke andar nested ho, chupchaap outer lifetime ko chhota kar dega — Next.js ise rokne ke liye rendering ke dauraan error throw karta hai (nested cache ek imported module ya third-party dependency me chhupa ho sakta hai). Fix: outer scope me explicit cacheLife jodo — ek lamba (jaise 'default') outer ko static rakhne ke liye, ya ek explicit chhota (jaise 'seconds', <Suspense> me wrapped) jaanboojh kar short life confirm karne ke liye. Note: short-lived example "use cache: remote" use karta hai kyunki serverless me runtime caching default in-memory cache ke saath requests ke paar persist nahi karta; self-hosted ke liye, "use cache" kaafi ho sakta hai.
  • Conditional cache lifetime: alag branches me cacheLife call karo — per invocation sirf ek chalega. Example: getPostContent cacheTag(`post-${slug}`) karta hai, phir jab post missing ho to cacheLife('minutes') + jab published ho to cacheLife('days'). Data-driven lifetime ke liye, inline profile object use karo: cacheLife({ revalidate: post.revalidateSeconds ?? 3600 }) (stale/expire default se inherit hote hain).
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — cacheLife stable, unstable_cacheLife deprecated (update karne ke liye Next.js 16 upgrade guide dekho).
  • Dhyaan do / interview points: kabhi module scope par nahi; asal me per invocation ek hi cacheLife call; expire revalidate se bada hona chahiye; explicit outer lifetime hamesha jeet-ta hai; nested short-lived cache error deta hai jab tak outer me explicit cacheLife na ho; stale staleTimes ko track karta hai (per-scope vs global).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/cacheLife

cacheTag

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai cacheTag. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: cacheTag — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Setup, Purging on demand, Good to know, Examples, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: cacheTag tag ne on-demand amanyata ke liye data cache kiya. cache entries ke saath tag ko ikattha karke, aap chunindaa roop se any cache data ko affected kiye bina purge/revalidate vishisht entries ko affected kar sakte hain. 'next/cache' se import kiya gaya; ek ya adhik string maan leta hai.

  • Setup: next.config mein cacheComponents: true enable banata hai. ek use cache gunjaish ke andar call karein:
tsx
  // app/data.ts
  import { cacheTag } from 'next/cache'
  export async function getData() {
    'use cache'
    cacheTag('my-data')
    const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data')
    return res.json()
  }
  • mang par Purging: ek Server Function ya Route Handler se - updateTag parhne ke liye-apne-apne-lekhon paridrishyon (rupon aur user-triggered mutation jahan agle parhne ko turant fresh data prapt karna chahiye; keval Server Functions ke andar upalabdh) banam revalidateTag jabki background mein revalidation svikarya hota hai, ya jab ek Route Handler ya any sandarbh se pun: valid hota hai:
tsx
  // app/action.ts
  'use server'
  import { updateTag } from 'next/cache'
  export default async function submit() {
    await addPost()
    updateTag('my-data')
  }

multi-insteins deployment ke liye, Distributed Tag Coordination (cacheHandlers) dekhein.

  • Good to know: Idempotent Tags — multiple bar ek hi tag lagane ka koi extra prabhav nahi hai. Multiple tag — ek entry ke liye kai allocated: cacheTag('tag-one', 'tag-two'). Limits — ek single cacheTag() call 128 tag tak accept karta hai, pratyek adhikatam 256 varn; 256 chars se lanbe samay tak tag ko chhor diya jata hai, ek call mein 128th ke previous tag ko gira diya jata hai; donon mamle ek console warning log karte hain.
  • Examples: taiging components/functions (Bookings component 'use cache' + cacheTag('bookings-data') ke saath); external data se tag - lautaye gaye data ka upyog karke lane ke baad cacheTag ko call karein. cacheTag('bookings-data', data.id); updateBookingData() ke baad ek Server Action mein revalidateTag('bookings-data', 'max') ke saath invalid.
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — cacheTag static, unstable_cacheTag deprecated (Next.js 16 upgrade guide dekhein).
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: updateTag = tatkal fresh padha (keval Server Functions), revalidateTag = stale-timeground-revalidate; 128 tags/call, 256 chars/tag console warning ke saath boundary; tag idempotent hain.

catchError

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai catchError. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: catchError — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why not a custom React error boundary, Usage, Reference — parameters, Returns, Recovering from errors, Server-rendered error fallback. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: catchError ek component banata hai jo apne bachchon ko ek error boundary mein lapeta hai - error.js file convention ke liye ek programmatic vikalp, component tree mein kahin bhi component star ki error vasuli ko enable karta hai. 'next/error' se import kiya gaya; Client Components se bulaya gaya.

  • Kyun ek custom React error boundary nahi: built-in error vasuli - retry() ek transition ke andar page ko phir se render karta hai, error boundary ke bahar Client Component state ko preserve karta hai; phremavark-aware ekikaran — redirect()/notFound() hud ke tahat vishesh errors ko pheinkakar kaam karte hain, aur catchError unhein nirbaadh roop se sambhalte hain taaki ve galti se pakre na hon; client navigation handling - error state automatic roop se client navigation par ek alag route ke liye spasht karta hai.
  • Usage:
tsx
  // app/custom-error-boundary.tsx
  'use client'
  import { catchError, type ErrorInfo } from 'next/error'
  function ErrorFallback(props: { title: string }, { error, retry }: ErrorInfo) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    return (
      <div>
        <h2>{props.title}</h2>
        <p>{message}</p>
        <button onClick={() => retry()}>Try again</button>
      </div>
    )
  }
  export default catchError(ErrorFallback)

Usage: <ErrorWrapper title="Dashboard Error">{children}</ErrorWrapper>.

  • Reference — mapdandon: ek single fallback function error UI rendering jab ek error pakdi jati hai. ise props (props) aur errorInfo ko chhorakar wrapper ko passed kiya gaya hai: children

| Property | Type | Description |

| error | unknown | phenka value; ise sankirn (e.g). | instanceof Error) parhne se pahle message.

| retry | () => void | phir se prapt hota hai aur boundary ke bachchon ko re-render karta hai; saphalta par fallback ki jagah leta hai |

| reset | () => void | error sthiti ko reset karein aur phir se prapt kiye bina ridar; adhikansh mamlon mein retry() pasand karte hain | fallback ko ek Client Component hona chahiye (ya ek 'use client' module mein define). |

  • Returns: ek React component usi props ko accept karta hai, jaise ki fallback ka pahla tark plus children; ek error boundary mein children ko lapeta hai aur fallback ko tab render karta hai jab ek error children mein pakdi jati hai.
  • Recovering from errors: retry() ka upyog sheeghr vasuli ke liye karta hai - yeh phir se prapt hota hai aur phir se render karta hai children. reset() keval error state ko spasht karta hai aur phir se prapt kiye bina re-render karta hai, isliye yeh Server Component errors se theek nahi hoga - adhikansh mamlon mein retry() ka upyog karein.
  • Server-rendered error Fallback: paas server-rendered content ek prop (fallback={<ErrorFallback />} jahan ErrorFallback ek async Server Component hai) ke roop mein data sanchalit fallback UI pradarshit karne ke liye. Caveat: yeh pattern utsukta se har page par fallback ko render karta hai, yahan tak ki jab koi error nahi hoti hai - adhikansh ke liye ek saral client-side fallback suffices ka upyog karta hai.
  • Good to know: error.js ke viprit , catchError per ke kisi bhi hisse ko lapeta hai; wrapper props ko fallback ke liye agreshit kiya jata hai, isliye pun: prayojy error UI ko upyog ke anusar configure kiya jaa sakta hai; NOT lapet error.js default export catchError — error.js pahle se hi ek built-in error boundary ke andar render karta hai.
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — catchError static ho gaya; v16.2.0 — unstable_catchError ki shuruaat hui.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: reset() par retry() ko pasand karte hain (reset Server Component errors ko theek nahi kar sakta); redirect() / notFound() throw karta hai; client navigation par error state auto kleeyarsa.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai connection. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: connection — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage, Example — synchronous database drivers, Reference, Good to know, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: connection() point karta hai ki jari rahne se pahle ek aane wale user request ke liye await karni chahiye. upyogi jab koi component request-samay API jaise cookies/headers ka upyog nahi karta hai, lekin abhi bhi request ke anusar alag-alag output ki requirement hai - e.g. Math.random() ya new Date()

  • Usage:
ts
  // app/page.tsx
  import { connection } from 'next/server'
  export default async function Page() {
    await connection() // prerendering stops here
    // the following code only runs at request time
    const rand = Math.random()
    return <span>{rand}</span>
  }
  • Example - tulyakalik database driver: previous ke dauraan puri tarah se async driver jaise better-sqlite3 se query karta hai; query se pahle unhein prerendering se bahar nikalne ke liye connection() ko call karein:
ts
  // app/lib/data.ts
  import { connection } from 'next/server'
  import Database from 'better-sqlite3'
  const db = new Database('app.db')
  export async function getVisitorCount() {
    await connection()
    return db.prepare('SELECT value FROM counters WHERE name = ?').get('visitors')
  }

kisi bhi component ko call karne wale getVisitorCount() ko uske baad uske production ke baki hisson ke saath prerendering se bahar rakha gaya hai.

  • Reference: function connection(): Promise<void> — koi parameter nahi; ek void Promise lauta (nahi khapat hone ka matalab).
  • Good to know: connection unstable_noStore ko Next.js ke bhavishy ke saath behatar sanrekhit karne ke liye badal data hai. jab dynamic rendering ki requirement hoti hai aur aam request-samay par API ka upyog nahi kiya jata hai. With Cache Components, ek <Suspense> boundary ke andar connection() ko bulane wale component ko jagah data hai (direct ya loading.js jaise ancestors ke madhyam se): nikatatam boundary ki fallback ko static shell mein render kiya jata hai, aur request samay par connection() run ke baad code; ek boundary ke bina, tatkal hone ke bajaay route block ke liye navigation. With Cache Components, static shell se content ko chhorakar io() ko pasand karte hain - yeh usi tarah kaam karta hai aur ise "use cache" ke dayre ke andar bhi bulaya jaa sakta hai (jahan yeh turant hal karta hai); keval connection() tak pahunch jab rendering ko actual user request ke liye wait karna chahiye.
  • Version history: v15.0.0 — connection static; v15.0.0-RC — shuru kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: connection() spasht hai "is dynamic banayein" bhaago haich jab koi request-samay API ka upyog nahi kiya jata hai; yeh unstable_noStore ki jagah leta hai; Cache Components ke saath, io() ko shell bahishkaar ke liye pasand kiya jata hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai cookies. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: cookies — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Reference — methods, Options (when setting), Good to know, Cookies in Server Components, Cookies in Server Functions, Examples. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: cookies ek async function ('next/headers' se) hai jo Server Components aur reads/writes mein aane wale request cookies ko padhta hai. Route Handlers Server Functions

tsx
  // app/page.tsx
  import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
  export default async function Page() {
    const cookieStore = await cookies()
    const theme = cookieStore.get('theme')
    return '...'
  }
  • Reference — Methods:

| Method | Return | Description |

| get('name') | Object | cookie ka naam + maan |

| getAll() | vastuon ki array | ek matching naam ke saath sabhi cookies (koi naam nahi → sabhi cookies) |

| has('name') | Boolean | kya cookie maujud hai |

| set(name, value, options) | — | outgoing request cookie set karein |

| delete(name) | — | cookie ko hata data hai |

| toString() | String | cookies ka string pratinidhitv |

  • Options (jab setting): name (string), value (string), expires (Date), maxAge (sekeind), domain, path (defolt '/'), secure (HTTPS keval), httpOnly (koi client side access nahi), sameSite (boolean, 'lax', 'strict', 'none'), priority ("low"/"medium"/"high"), partitioned (CHIPS). default maan ke saath ekmatr vikalp path hai.
  • Good to know: cookies async hai - async/await ya React ke use ka upyog karna chahiye. v14 mein aur isse pahle yeh tulyakalik tha; async access abhi bhi Next.js 15 mein kaam karta hai lekin ise alag kar diya jayega. yeh ek request samay API hai jiska maan samay se pahle known nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. With Cache Components, ek <Suspense> boundary dharaon ke andar cookies() ko bulaate hue keval request samay par us up-tri ko jab baki prerender karta hai; ek boundary ke bahar yeh prerendering ko rokta hai. Without Cache Components ek layout/page mein cookies ka upyog karte hue route ko dynamic rendering mein chunta hai. .delete ko keval ek Server Function ya Route Handler mein bulaya jaa sakta hai, aur keval tabhi jab yeh usi domain se related ho, jismein se .set ko bulaya gaya tha (vildkaard domain ke liye vishisht up domain ko bilkul match karna chahiye, aur code ko usi protokol HTTP/HTTPS par chalaya jana chahiye). HTTP streaming shuru hone ke baad cookies set karne ki permission nahi data hai, isliye .set ka upyog Server Function ya Route Handler mein kiya jana chahiye.
  • Server Components mein Cookies: reading varks (browser request sheershlekhon mein cookie data bhejta hai); setting NOT hai jo Server Component rendering ke dauraan supported hai - client ya Route Handler se generated ek Server Function ke madhyam se cookies ko sanshodhit karta hai. server keval Set-Cookie header bhejta hai; storage client-side hota hai.
  • Server Functions mein Cookies: setting/deleting ke baad Server Function mein ek cookie jiska upyog Server Action (e.g) ke roop mein kiya jata hai, Next.js ek server roundtrip mein update UI aur naye data donon ko return karta hai. UI ko unmount nahi kiya gaya hai, lekin server data ree-run ke aadhar par prabhav padta hai. cached data ko bhi taza karne ke liye, function ke andar revalidatePath ya revalidateTag ko call karein. action
  • Examples: ko ek cookie ((await cookies()).get('theme')) milti hai; sabhi (getAll().map(c => …)) cookie.name/cookie.value ke saath); set (cookieStore.set('name', 'lee'), set('name', 'lee', { secure: true }), ya objekt form set({ name: 'name', value: 'lee', httpOnly: true, path: '/' })); check astitv (has('theme')); hata dein - teen tarike: delete('name'), set('name', ''), ya set('name', 'value', { maxAge: 0 }) (maxAge) turant samapt ho gaya.
  • Version history: v15.0.0-RC — cookies ek async function ban gaya (codemod upalabdh); v13.0.0 — shuru kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: V15 ke baad se async; kahin bhi server-side padha, lekin keval server Functions/Route handler mein set/delete; path ekmatr default vikalp hai; hatane ke liye saman domain + saman protokol ki requirement hoti hai.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: draftMode — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Reference, Good to know, Examples, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: draftMode ek async function ('next/headers' se) hai ki enables/disables Draft Mode aur check karta hai ki kya yeh Server Component mein enable hai - isliye editor ek request ke liye Next.js caching ko bypass karke ek hedles CMS se aprkaashit content ka preview kar sakte hain.

tsx
  import { draftMode } from 'next/headers'
  export default async function Page() {
    const { isEnabled } = await draftMode()
  }
  • Reference:

| Method | Description |

| isEnabled | Boolean - kya Draft Mode enable hai? |

| enable() | ek cookie (__prerender_bypass) ko set karke Enables Draft Mode mein Route Handler ki installation |

| disable() | ek cookie ko hata kar Route Handler mein Disables Draft Mode |

  • Good to know: async — async/await ya React ke use (V14 aur isse pahle async access abhi bhi Next.js 15 mein kaam karta hai, lekin ise alag kiya jayega). ek naya bypass cookie maan pratyek next build generated hota hai, isliye bypass cookie ka anuman nahi lagaya jaa sakta hai. HTTP par local roop se Draft Mode ka testing karne ke liye, browser ko third-party cookies aur local storage pahunch ki permission deni chahiye. isEnabled ek caching nirdeshan (use cache) gunjaish ke andar pathniy hai - any runtime API jaise cookies()/headers() ko caching nirdeshan ke andar permission nahi di jati hai, bhale hi Draft Mode active ho. ek caching directive gunjaish ke andar enable() / disable() ko bulana ek error throw karta hai. When Draft Mode enable hai, sabhi functions/components ek caching directive gunjaish ke tahat pratyek request par phir se chhoot prapt karte hain aur parinam cache ko nahi bachaate hain - draft content hamesha fresh hoti hai.
  • Examples:
  • enebal (Route Handler app/draft/route.ts): const draft = await draftMode(); draft.enable(); return new Response('Draft mode is enabled').
  • disabled karein: draft.disable(); return new Response('Draft mode is disabled'). default roop se jab browser band ho jata hai to Draft Mode session samapt hota hai. manual roop se disabled karne ke liye, Route Handler mein disable() ko call karein, phir ise bulane ke liye ek request bhejein - yadi <Link> ke madhyam se route ko bulana hai, to prefetch={false} ko prefetch par cookie ko galti se hatane se bachne ke liye paas karein.
  • check: ek Server Component, const { isEnabled } = await draftMode() mein aur e.g ko render karta hai. Draft Mode is currently {isEnabled? 'Enabled': 'Disabled'}
  • Version history: v15.0.0-RC — draftMode async (codemod upalabdh); v13.4.0 — shuru hua.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: enable/disable keval Route Handlers (cookie set/delete) mein; isEnabled ek runtime API hai jo use cache gunjaish ke andar pathniy hai; Draft Mode balon ko bina kisi caching ke request ke prati phir execution ko majbur karta hai; bypass cookie maan har build ko punarjeevit karta hai; disabled link ko prefetch={false} ki requirement hoti hai.

fetch

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai fetch. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: fetch — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `fetch(url, options)`, `options.cache`, `options.next.revalidate`, `options.next.tags`, Memoization, Troubleshooting. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js web fetch() API ka vistar karta hai taaki pratyek server request apne khud ke lagatar caching aur revalidation semantics set kar sake. browser mein, cache vikalp browser ke HTTP cache ko controlled karta hai; is vistar ke saath, cache yeh controlled karta hai ki server-side kaise dhanche ke lagatar cache ke saath negotiation karta hai. async/await ke saath seedhe Server Components mein call karein: fetch

tsx
  export default async function Page() {
    let data = await fetch('https://api.vercel.app/blog')
    let posts = await data.json()
    return <ul>{posts.map((post) => <li key={post.id}>{post.title}</li>)}</ul>
  }
  • fetch(url, options): sabhi mool vikalp upalabdh hain, saath hi Next.js extension:
  • options.cache — fetch('https://…', { cache: 'force-cache' | 'no-store' }):
  • auto no cache (default): dev mein har request par durasth server se prapt hota hai, lekin ek bar next build ke dauraan kyonki route static roop se parityaagit hota hai; yadi request-samay par API ko route par pata lagaya jata hai, to har request par milta hai.
  • no-store: pratyek request par durasth server se prapt hota hai, yahan tak ki request samay API ke bina bhi.
  • force-cache: server-side cache (URL par match, vidhi, header, body - alag-alag requests ko alag se cache kiya gaya); fresh match → cache se lauta; no/stale match → cache prapt karein aur update karein. keval 200 pratikriyaon ko sangrahit kiya jata hai. caching opt-in hai: POST sahit kisi bhi request ko cache karne ke liye cache: 'force-cache' set karein aur authorization/cookie header ke saath request karein. Draft Mode puri tarah se cache bypass karta hai (koi padha ya likhna nahi).
  • options.next.revalidate — fetch('https://…', { next: { revalidate: false | 0 | number } }); sekand mein cache lifetime: false = cache anishchit roop se (semantly Infinity; HTTP cache purane sansadhanon ko nasht kar sakta hai); 0 = cache nahi; number = adhikansh n sekand mein kaisha. yadi koi vyakti prapt route ke default revalidate ki tulna mein kam revalidate set karta hai, to pure route ka punarmulyankan gap kam ho jata hai; ek hi route mein usi URL ke do hisson ke saath, kam value jeeta. { revalidate: 3600, cache: 'no-store' } jaise sangharsh vikalp ki permission nahi hai - donon ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai aur unhein warning di jati hai.
  • options.next.tags - fetch('https://…', { next: { tags: ['collection'] } }); set cache tag isliye data ko revalidateTag ke saath on-demand kiya jaa sakta hai. maiks tag ki lambai 256 varn, adhikatam 128 taiga.
  • Memoization: GET ek hi URL ke saath request prapt karte hain aur ek server render paas ke dauraan vikalp automatic roop se yaad kiye jate hain - ek hi laanch jise multiple Server Components, layout, pages, generateStaticParams, generateViewport mein bulaya jata hai, keval ek bar executed hota hai aur parinam sajha kiya jata hai. memoijeshan keval ek render paas rahta hai (requests mein lagatar caching se alag). ek AbortController sanket passed karke bahar nikalna: const { signal } = new AbortController(); fetch(url, { signal }). Memoization NOT Route Handlers (React per ka hissa nahi) mein lagu hota hai.
  • Troubleshooting:
  • auto no cache / no-store dev mein fresh data nahi dikha raha hai: Next.js cache tezi se pratikriyaon ke liye Server Components mein pratikriyaon ko prapt karte hain aur build API lagat ko kam karne ke liye; HMR cache default aur no-store sahit sabhi receipts par lagu hota hai. Uncached request HMR refresh ke beech fresh data nahi dikhaayegaa; cache navigation ya full page reload par spasht karta hai (serverComponentsHmrCache dekhein).
  • dev mein hard riphresh karein: yadi request mein cache-control: no-cache, options.cache/next.revalidate/next.tags ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai aur is request ko source se serve kiya jata hai. browser ise tab bhejte hain jab cache ko devool mein ya hard riphresh ke dauraan disabled kiya jata hai.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — fetch pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: default auto no cache hai (No force-cache - caching opt-in hai); keval 200 ko force-cache ke tahat cache kiya jata hai; sansmaran lagatar caching; takrav revalidate + no-store ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai; HMR cache dev mein fresh data chhipa sakta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/fetch

Asaan bhasha me samjho: forbidden` (function) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Setup, Where it can be invoked, Good to know, Example — after streaming has started, Examples — role-based route protection, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: EXPERIMENTAL (production ke liye recommended nahi; GitHub par pratikriya). forbidden() ek error throw karta hai jo pratibndhit UI ko render karta hai - authorization errors ke liye; forbidden.js file ke saath UI ko customize karein. yeh ek NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;403 error throw karta hai aur root segment ke rendering ko samapt karta hai jahan ise phenk diya gaya tha. Next.js ne <meta name="robots" content="noindex" /> ko injekt kiya taaki page anukrmit na ho. kyonki yeh throw karne se kaam karta hai, ise render path mein kahte hain - ek component, ya ek component ka wait karta hai. bina await kiye gaye vade mein chhore gaye ek call throw karta hai jahan kuchh bhi ise nahi pakadta hai aur koi nishiddh UI render karta hai.

  • Setup: next.config mein experimental authInterrupts enable banata hai:
ts
  const nextConfig: NextConfig = { experimental: { authInterrupts: true } }
  • Kahan ise radd kiya jaa sakta hai: Server Components, Server Functions, Route Handlers. 'next/navigation' se import kiya gaya:
tsx
  // app/admin/page.tsx
  import { verifySession } from '@/app/lib/dal'
  import { forbidden } from 'next/navigation'
  export default async function AdminPage() {
    const session = await verifySession()
    if (session.role !== 'admin') {
      forbidden()
    }
    return <></>
  }
  • Good to know: ko root layout mein nahi bulaya jaa sakta hai. return forbidden() ke liye koi requirement nahi - yeh throw karta hai (TypeScript never return type), isliye execution band ho jata hai. call ke chaaron or ek try/catch badha ko daba data hai aur koi nishiddh UI render karta hai - ise dene ke liye unstable_rethrow ka upyog karta hai. ek forbidden() ek gair-prerit Promise mein chhor diya throw karta hai jahan kuchh bhi ise pakadta hai (dev server log ⨯ unhandledRejection: NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;403) - hamesha await us karya ko jo ise bula sakta hai.
  • Example - streaming ke baad shuru hua hai: page shell ko rakhne aur UI ko dikhai dene ke liye, jabki session ki check ki jati hai, ne Data Access Layer function mein bhumika ki check ki hai jo data ko load karta hai aur ise <Suspense> mein lapete gaye ek component mein render karta hai; check boundary ke andar chalta hai isliye shell dharaon jabki session hal karta hai. jab pahunch se inkaar kar diya jata hai, to getProjects() forbidden() ko call karta hai, exception nikatatam forbidden boundary ko propagate karta hai, jo stream-in content ke sthan par render karta hai, bhale hi shell pahle se hi bheja gaya tha. UI (e.g) ke liye route ke saath forbidden.tsx jorein. <h1>403 - Forbidden</h1><p>You don't have access to this page.</p>. jawab forbidden() run se pahle <Suspense> boundary se streaming shuru hota hai, isliye yeh apni 200 sthiti rakhta hai, aur Next.js ek noindex tag jodta hai. forbidden() ek 403 lauta hai jab yeh pratikriya shuru hone se pahle chalta hai, jismein render karne ke dauraan (sthiti code dekhein) shamil hai.
  • Examples - bhumika aadharit route sanrakshan: check session.role!== 'admin' to app/admin/page.tsx mein forbidden(); Server Actions ke saath mutations: ek 'use server' action ke andar ek hi check (e.g). updateRole(formData)) to keval vyavasthapak sanvedanshil data update kar sakte hain.
  • Version history: v15.1.0 — forbidden pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: authInterrupts ke pichhe experimental; NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;403 throw karta hai; kabhi ise wapas nahi return; ise na pakro (ya unstable_rethrow ke madhyam se phir se pheinko); hamesha calling function ka wait karte hain; 403 streaming se pahle, 200 + noindex streaming shuru hone ke baad; root layout mein permission nahi hai; 403 = authenticated lekin adhikrit nahi hai (vs unauthorized = authenticated nahi).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/forbidden

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: generateImageMetadata ek image ke vibhinn sanskaranon ko generated karta hai ya ek root segment ke liye multiple images ko return karta hai - hard coding metadata maan, e.g se bachne ke liye upyogi. Metadata API vishesh files (icon, opengraph-image, twitter-image, apple-icon) ke andar upyog kiya jata hai.

  • Parameters - params (optional): ko segment generateImageMetadata ke neeche root segment se dynamic route mapdandon ka ek objekt kaha jata hai (yahan ples objekt hai, vade nahi): app/shop/icon.js → undefined; app/shop/[slug]/icon.js ko /shop/1 → { slug: '1' }; app/shop/[tag]/[item]/icon.js → { tag: '1', item: '2' } para.
  • Returns: image metadata vastuon ki ek array; pratyek item must mein ek id maan shamil hai (image generation function ko ek Promise ke roop me pass kiya jata hai):

| Field | Type |

| id | string (required) |

| alt | string |

| size | { width: number; height: number } |

| contentType | string |

tsx
  // icon.tsx
  import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og'
  export function generateImageMetadata() {
    return [
      { contentType: 'image/png', size: { width: 48, height: 48 }, id: 'small' },
      { contentType: 'image/png', size: { width: 72, height: 72 }, id: 'medium' },
    ]
  }
  export default async function Icon({ id }: { id: Promise<string | number> }) {
    const iconId = await id
    return new ImageResponse(<div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 88, background: '#000', color: '#fafafa' }}>Icon {iconId}</div>)
  }
  • Image janreshan function props: id — lautaye gaye aaitmon mein se ek (string ya nanbar) se id ko hal karne ka Promise; params (optional) - dynamic route ko hal karne ka Promise image ke segment ({ params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) ke neeche hai.
  • Example - external data: app/products/[id]/opengraph-image.tsx — generateImageMetadata({ params }) ne getOGImages(params.id) ka wait kiya aur images.map((image, idx) => ({ id: idx, size: { width: 1200, height: 600 }, alt: image.text, contentType: 'image/png' })) ko lauta diya; default export donon params aur id ka wait kar raha hai, getCaptionForImage(productId, imageId) ke madhyam se kaipshan prapt karta hai, aur ise ImageResponse mein render karta hai.
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — id image production function mein passed kiya ab ek Promise hai (string ya sankhya); params yeh karne ke liye passed kiya ab ek Promise hai; v13.3.0 — shuru kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: har wapsi item ek id ki zaroorat hai; params generateImageMetadata mein ek plain object hai lekin image function mein ek Promise hai; id bhi image function mein ek Promise hai.

generateMetadata

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai generateMetadata. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: generateMetadata — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The `metadata` object, `generateMetadata` function, Rules, Parameters, Metadata fields, Types. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: SEO aur web sajha karne ki kshamata ke liye metadata ko define karne ke liye metadata objekt (static) ya generateMetadata function (dynamic) ka upyog karein. Next.js metadata ko hal karta hai aur prasangik <head> tag banata hai.

  • metadata object: static metadata ke liye layout.js/page.js se ek Metadata object export karo: export const metadata: Metadata = { title: '...', description: '...' }.
  • generateMetadata function: dynamic info (route params, external data, parent metadata) ke hisaab se dynamic metadata — ek function export karo jo ek Metadata object return kare. Use resolve karna page render karne ka hissa hai; agar page prerender ho sakta hai aur generateMetadata dynamic behavior introduce nahi karta, to metadata initial HTML me shamil hai, warna ye initial UI ke baad stream ho sakta hai:
tsx
  // app/products/[id]/page.tsx
  import type { Metadata, ResolvingMetadata } from 'next'
  type Props = { params: Promise<{ id: string }>; searchParams: Promise<{ [key: string]: string | string[] | undefined }> }
  export async function generateMetadata({ params, searchParams }: Props, parent: ResolvingMetadata): Promise<Metadata> {
    const { id } = await params
    const product = await fetch(`https://.../${id}`).then((res) => res.json())
    const previousImages = (await parent).openGraph?.images || []
    return { title: product.title, openGraph: { images: ['/some-specific-page-image.jpg', ...previousImages] } }
  }

prakar PageProps<'/route'>/LayoutProps<'/route'> ke saath props.

  • Rules: metadata layout.js aur page.js me joda ja sakta hai; metadata aur generateMetadata sirf Server Components hain (metadata ko page render se pehle server par resolve hona chahiye, isliye ye initial HTML me hai — page ko Server Component rakho aur client logic ko ek alag 'use client' file me le jao); tum dono ko ek hi segment se export nahi kar sakte. generateMetadata ke andar fetch automatically generateMetadata, generateStaticParams, Layouts, Pages, Server Components ke beech memoize hota hai (React cache). Ek page ka explicit openGraph.images/twitter.images same/inherited segments me corresponding file-based images ko override karta hai.
  • Parameters: props — params (segment tak ke dynamic route params; jaise app/shop/[slug]/page.js me /shop/1 → { slug: '1' }, [...slug] → { slug: ['1','2'] }) aur searchParams (URL search params; /shop?a=1&a=2 → { a: ['1','2'] }); parent — parent segments se resolved metadata ka ek Promise. Ek Metadata object return karta hai. Agar metadata request info par depend nahi karta, to static metadata object prefer karo. searchParams sirf page.js segments me available hai. redirect()/notFound() generateMetadata ke andar use ho sakte hain.
  • Metadata fields:
  • title — string ya template object: title: 'Next.js' → <title>Next.js</title>; title.default = bina title wale child segments ke liye fallback; title.template (jaise '%s | Acme') child segments me titles ke liye prefix/suffix jodta hai — template ke saath default required hai; layout.js me template usi segment ke page.js me title par lagu nahi hota; page.js me template ka koi effect nahi (page terminating hai); agar koi title/default define nahi hai to template ka koi effect nahi. title.absolute parent templates ignore karta hai (jaise absolute: 'About' → <title>About</title>). Layout rules: string/default = child segments ke liye default title, nearest parent ke template se wrap hota hai; absolute = default title parent templates ignore karta hai; template = bachchon ke liye naya template. Page rules: koi title nahi → nearest parent ka resolved title; string → root title nearest parent template se augmented; absolute → root title parent templates ignore karta hai.
  • description — description: 'The React Framework for the Web' → <meta name="description" … />.
  • Dusre fields — generator, applicationName, referrer ('origin-when-cross-origin'), keywords: ['Next.js', 'React', 'JavaScript'], authors: [{ name: 'Seb' }, { name: 'Josh', url: 'https://nextjs.org' }], creator, publisher, formatDetection: { email: false, address: false, telephone: false } → jaise <meta name="application-name" content="Next.js" />, <meta name="author" content="Seb" />, <link rel="author" href="https://nextjs.org" />, <meta name="format-detection" content="telephone=no, address=no, email=no" />.
  • metadataBase — current segment aur neeche URL-based fields ke liye base URL prefix, isliye ve relative paths use kar sakte hain: metadataBase: new URL('https://acme.com') + alternates: { canonical: '/', languages: { 'en-US': '/en-US', 'de-DE': '/de-DE' } } + openGraph: { images: '/og-image.png' } → canonical https://acme.com, og:image https://acme.com/og-image.png. Aam taur par root app/layout.js me set hota hai. 'use cache' use karke generateMetadata ke saath, return values serialize honi chahiye — URL instances supported nahi, isliye strings return karo (url.toString()). Isme ek subdomain ya base path ho sakta hai; ek full field URL metadataBase ko override karta hai; metadataBase ke bina ek relative path ek build error ka kaaran banta hai; duplicate slashes normalize hote hain. URL structure developer intent ko favor karti hai: / → https://acme.com; payments, /payments, ./payments, ../payments → https://acme.com/payments; absolute https://beta.acme.com/payments ke roop me rehta hai.
  • openGraph — title, description, url, siteName, images: [{ url (absolute), width, height, alt }], videos: [{ url, width, height }], audio: [{ url }], locale: 'en_US', type: 'website' → og:title, og:description, og:url, og:site_name, og:locale, og:image (+ width/height/alt), og:video, og:audio, og:type. Article type: type: 'article', publishedTime, authors: ['Seb','Josh'] → article:published_time, article:author. File-based Metadata API OG images ke liye zyada convenient hai (sahi metadata auto-generates).
  • robots — { index: true, follow: true, nocache: false, googleBot: { index: true, follow: true, noimageindex: false, 'max-video-preview': -1, 'max-image-preview': 'large', 'max-snippet': -1 } } → <meta name="robots" content="index, follow" /> + <meta name="googlebot" content="index, follow, max-video-preview:-1, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1" />.
  • icons — { icon: '/icon.png', shortcut: '/shortcut-icon.png', apple: '/apple-icon.png', other: { rel: 'apple-touch-icon-precomposed', url: '…' } } → <link rel="shortcut icon" … />, <link rel="icon" … />, <link rel="apple-touch-icon" … />. Array forms { url, media: '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)' }, new URL('/icon.png', 'https://example.com'), sizes/type support karte hain. Icons ke liye file-based Metadata API recommended hai. msapplication-* meta tags ab Chromium Edge me supported nahi hain.
  • themeColor / colorScheme / viewport (metadata me) — Next.js 14 se DEPRECATED; iske bajaye viewport config (generateViewport) use karo.
  • manifest — manifest: 'https://nextjs.org/manifest.json' → <link rel="manifest" href="…" />.
  • twitter — card: 'summary_large_image', title, description, siteId, creator: '@nextjs', creatorId, images: ['https://nextjs.org/og.png'] (absolute) → twitter:card, twitter:site:id, twitter:creator, twitter:creator:id, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image. card: 'app' variant images: { url, alt } aur app: { name, id: { iphone, ipad, googleplay }, url: { iphone, ipad } } jodta hai → twitter:app:name:iphone, twitter:app:id:*, twitter:app:url:*. (Twitter Card markup X se aage bhi use hota hai.)
  • verification — { google, yandex, yahoo, other: { me: ['my-email', 'my-link'] } } → <meta name="google-site-verification" … />, <meta name="y_key" … />, <meta name="yandex-verification" … />, <meta name="me" … /> (×2).
  • appleWebApp (+ itunes) — itunes: { appId, appArgument } → <meta name="apple-itunes-app" content="app-id=…, app-argument=…" />; appleWebApp: { title, statusBarStyle: 'black-translucent', startupImage: ['/…png', { url, media }] } → <meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />, <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" … />, <link rel="apple-touch-startup-image" … />, status-bar-style meta.
  • alternates — canonical, languages (hreflang), media (media query → URL), types ('application/rss+xml' → URL) → <link rel="canonical" />, <link rel="alternate" hreflang="…" />, <link rel="alternate" media="…" />, <link rel="alternate" type="…" />.
  • appLinks — ios: { url, app_store_id }, android: { package, app_name }, web: { url, should_fallback } → al:ios:url, al:ios:app_store_id, al:android:package, al:android:app_name, al:web:url, al:web:should_fallback.
  • archives — ['https://nextjs.org/13'] → <link rel="archives" href="…" />; assets → <link rel="assets" … />; bookmarks → <link rel="bookmarks" … />; pagination: { previous, next } → <link rel="prev" /> / <link rel="next" />; category: 'technology' → <meta name="category" … />; facebook: { appId } → <meta property="fb:app_id" … /> (ya admins), multiple fb:admins tags ke liye string ya array; appId aur admins mutually exclusive hain; pinterest: { richPin: true } → <meta name="pinterest-rich-pin" content="true" />; other: { custom: 'meta' } → <meta name="custom" content="meta" /> (array values → multiple same-key tags).
  • Types: import type { Metadata } from 'next'; generateMetadata ek regular function ho sakta hai jo Metadata return kare, ya Promise<Metadata>, segment props aur parent: ResolvingMetadata samet. JS projects: JSDoc /** @type {import("next").Metadata} */. Built-in TS plugin manual typing ke bina IDE completion deta hai.
  • Unsupported metadata: <meta http-equiv> (HTTP headers redirect(), Proxy, security headers ke through), <base>, <noscript>, <style>, <script>, <link rel="stylesheet"> (stylesheets import karo), <link rel="preload"> (ReactDOM preload), <link rel="preconnect"> (preconnect), <link rel="dns-prefetch"> (prefetchDNS) ke liye koi built-in support nahi — pehle group ko seedhe layout/page me render karo.
  • Resource hints: Metadata API unhe seedhe support nahi karta; ek Client Component me ReactDOM methods use karo (jahan bhi SSR initial load par ho): ReactDOM.preload(href, { as }) → <link rel="preload" href="…" as="…" />; ReactDOM.preconnect(href, { crossOrigin }) → <link rel="preconnect" … crossorigin />; ReactDOM.prefetchDNS(href) → <link rel="dns-prefetch" … />. next/font, next/image, next/script relevant hints automatically handle karte hain.
  • Behavior — default fields: do meta tags hamesha bina metadata define kiye jode jate hain: <meta charset="utf-8" /> aur <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" /> (viewport tag override ho sakta hai).
  • Behavior — streaming metadata: Next.js generateMetadata ka wait kiye bina initial UI render/bhejta hai; jab ye resolve hota hai, to metadata tags <body> me inject hote hain (JS verify kar sakta hai ki ve sahi hain). HTML-limited bots ke liye jo JS execute nahi kar sakte (jaise facebookexternalhit), Next.js response start karne se pehle generateMetadata ka wait karta hai taaki metadata <head> me ho; user-agent header ke through detect hota hai; htmlLimitedBots config option ke saath UA list override karo. next.config me htmlLimitedBots: /.*/ ke saath streaming puri tarah disable karo. Streaming TTFB improve karti hai aur LCP kam kar sakti hai; override karna response time lamba kar sakta hai — aksar cases me default sahi hai.
  • Behavior — Cache Components: generateMetadata dusre components jaise hi rules follow karta hai; runtime data (cookies(), headers(), params, searchParams) ya bina cache ke kisi request-time fetch ko guard karo. Agar dusre parts bhi define hain, to static shell pehle render hota hai aur metadata uncached content ke saath stream hoti hai. Agar page/layout warna puri tarah prerenderable hai, to Next.js ek error raise karta hai jiske liye ek explicit choice chahiye: agar possible ho to data cache karo ('use cache' ke andar generateMetadata, jaise const { title, description } = await db.query('site-metadata')), ya deferral ko ek dynamic marker component ke saath jaanboojhkar signal karo — ek DynamicMarker jo <Suspense><Connection /></Suspense> render karta hai jahan Connection connection() ka await karta hai aur null return karta hai; ye kuch render nahi karta, lekin Next.js ko batata hai ki page me jaanboojhkar dynamic content hai, jabki static content abhi bhi prerender hoti hai (ise seedhe page par await connection() NAHI karo — ye article content ko static shell se bahar rakh dega).
  • Ordering: metadata root → nearest page segment evaluate hota hai, jaise app/layout.tsx → app/blog/layout.tsx → app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx.
  • Merging: multiple segments ke metadata objects shallowly merge hote hain; duplicate keys order se replace hoti hain. openGraph/robots jaise nested fields pehle define hue wholesale overwrite ho jate hain unhe define karne wale last segment dwara (jaise page openGraph: { title: 'Blog' } set karna layout ke openGraph.description ko drop kar deta hai). Nested fields share karne ke liye unhe ek shared variable me nikalo aur spread karo (...openGraphImage). Jo field re-define nahi hua wo inherit hota hai (jaise page sirf title: 'About' set karna layout ke openGraph ko inherit karta hai).
  • Version history: v15.2.0 — generateMetadata ke liye streaming support; v14.0.0 — viewport, themeColor, colorScheme viewport config ke favor me deprecated; v13.2.0 — metadata aur generateMetadata introduce hue.
  • Dhyaan do / interview points: kabhi ek segment me metadata aur generateMetadata dono export mat karo; merging sirf Server Components ke liye hai — nested objects replace hote hain, deep merge nahi; title.template ko default chahiye aur sirf bachchon ko affect karta hai; streaming metadata JS bots ke liye <body> me land hoti hai lekin HTML-limited bots ke liye <head> me; Cache Components ke saath, runtime-data metadata ko 'use cache' ya ek explicit dynamic marker chahiye.

generateSitemaps

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai generateSitemaps. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: generateSitemaps — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Returns, URLs, Example, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: generateSitemaps aapke application ke liye kai sitemap generated karta hai - kai files mein ek badi sitemap ko vibhajit karne ke liye istemal kiya jata hai.

  • Returns: ek id sanpatti ke saath vastuon ki ek array .
  • URLs: generated sitemap /.../sitemap/[id].xml, e.g par upalabdh hain. /product/sitemap/1.xml
  • Example: app/product/sitemap.ts — generateSitemaps() se [{ id: 0 }, { id: 1 }, { id: 2 }, { id: 3 }] lauta (kul product count ko prapt karein aur computation karein ki kitne sitemap ki requirement hai), phir default sitemap function ko props.id (ek Promise <string>) aur slice product 50,000 prati sitemap (Google ki boundary prati sitemap 50,000 URL hai):
ts
  import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next'
  export async function generateSitemaps() {
    return [{ id: 0 }, { id: 1 }, { id: 2 }, { id: 3 }]
  }
  export default async function sitemap(props: { id: Promise<string> }): Promise<MetadataRoute.Sitemap> {
    const id = await props.id
    const start = id * 50000
    const end = start + 50000
    const products = await getProducts(`SELECT id, date FROM products WHERE id BETWEEN ${start} AND ${end}`)
    return products.map((product) => ({ url: `${BASE_URL}/product/${product.id}`, lastModified: product.date }))
  }
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — generateSitemaps manon ko ab ek string ke liye sitemap function ko hal karne ka Promise kiya gaya hai; v15.0.0 - development aur production ke beech susangat URL; v13.3.2 — render (dev mein, /.../sitemap.xml/[id], e.g par generated sthalaapam dekhein). /product/sitemap.xml/1. id
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: prati sitemap 50,000 URL par vibhajit hai; id v16 ke baad se ek Promise <string> hai.

generateStaticParams

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai generateStaticParams. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: generateStaticParams — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Timing, Parameters — `options.params` (optional), Returns, Examples — prerendering, With Cache Components, With Route Handlers. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: generateStaticParams dynamic route segments ke saath sanyukt roop se request samay par jari kiye gaye samay ke bajaay routes ko static roop se generated karta hai. page (page.tsx), layout (layout.tsx) aur Route Handlers (route.ts) mein upyog karne yogya. yeh Pages Router se getStaticPaths ko replace karta hai:

tsx
  // app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx
  export async function generateStaticParams() {
    const posts = await fetch('https://.../posts').then((res) => res.json())
    return posts.map((post) => ({ slug: post.slug }))
  }
  export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
    const { slug } = await params
  }
  • Timing: next dev mein ne kaha ki jab aap route par navigate karte hain; next build ke dauraan, related Layouts/Pages se pahle chalta hai; revalidation (ISR) ke dauraan, NOT ko phir se bulaya gaya.
  • Parameters - options.params (optional): yadi multiple dynamic segment generateStaticParams ka upyog karte hain, to children ke parent parm set ke anusar ek bar run karte hain; params objekt mein parent ke popyuleted param hote hain, jo children ke param generated karne mein enable hote hain.
  • Returns: objekts ki ek array, pratyek ek root ke population wale dynamic segment (property name = segment ka naam, maan = phil-in maan) ka pratinidhitv karta hai.

| Route | Return type |

| /product/[id] | { id: string }[] |

| /products/[category]/[product] | { category: string, product: string }[] |

| /products/[...slug] | { slug: string[] }[] | udaharan: single segment return [{ id: '1' }, { id: '2' }, { id: '3' }] → /product/1,2,3; multiple segment [{ category: 'a', product: '1' }, …]; catch-ol [{ slug: ['a', '1'] }, …] → /product/a/1. |

  • Examples - prerendering: sabhi path build samay (API se full list); build samay (e.g) par sabseta. posts.slice(0, 10)) aur baki runtime par pahli visit par - dynamicParams niyantran karta hai jo an-generated segment mein hota hai; dynamicParams = false ke saath, top 10 ke alava sabhi post 404 hain. runtime mein sabhi path: ek khali array (nothing built-in) wapas lautein ya export const dynamic = 'force-static' ka upyog karein; hamesha khali hone par bhi ek sarani wapas lautein, anyatha route dynamic roop se pradan kiya jata hai.
  • With Cache Components: generateStaticParams ko kam se kam ek param lautana chahiye - khali array build error ka karan bantee hai (to Cache Components route ko valid kar sakte hain, galat tarike se cookies() / headers()/searchParams ko runtime par access nahi karta). yadi param value build samay par agyat hain, to ek plesholdar (e.g) wapas karein. [{ slug: '__placeholder__' }]) aur ise notFound() ke saath sambhalte hain - lekin yeh build-time validation ko kamjor kar data hai aur runtime errors ka karan ban sakta hai. Cache Components aur ISR ke saath dynamic routes ko sabset prerendering ke liye Cache Components + App Shells baki ke liye dekhein. iske alava: ensureStatic = 'navigation' ke saath, ek dynamic route kam se kam ek params objekt lautana chahiye aur har object mein sabhi dynamic parameter shamil hona chahiye.
  • With Route Handlers: static roop se build samay par API pratikriyaon ko generated karta hai - generateStaticParams ritarning [{ id: '1' }, { id: '2' }, { id: '3' }] aur GET(request, { params }: RouteContext<'/api/posts/[id]'>) ritarning Response.json({ id, title: \ Post ${id}\ }) ke saath app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts. With Cache Components, use cache ke saath gathabandhan - getPost(id: Promise<string>) cached function ko API lane ke liye, jise getPost(params.then((p) => p.id)) kaha jata hai.
  • nirdisht path ke liye Disable rendering: export const dynamicParams = false — keval generateStaticParams path served jata hai; nirdisht routes 404 (ya match, catch-all routes ke liye).
  • ek route mein Multiple dynamic segment: aap dynamic segments above vartaman layout/page ke liye params generated kar sakte hain, lekin not neeche — e.g. app/products/[category]/[product]/page.js donon [category] aur [product] generated kar sakte hain; app/products/[category]/layout.js keval [category] generated kar sakte hain. do drishtikon: bottom up — children ka page ek call ({ category: product.category.slug, product: product.id }) mein donon segment generated karta hai; top down — parent ka layout [category] generated karta hai, phir children ka generateStaticParams({ params: { category } }) prati parent ki shreni mein ek bar chalata hai aur [product] (https://…/products?category=${category}) generated karta hai. params tark tulyakalik roop se accessible hai aur ismein keval parent segment param shamil hain. yadi ek mool dynamic segment ek root parameter hai, to ise next/root-params se apne getar ke madhyam se nested generateStaticParams mein parhein. prakar pura: Awaited<LayoutProps<'/products/[category]'>['params']> (ya Page Props helper).
  • Good to know: fetch automatic roop se sabhi generate-prefixed karyon, layout, pejon, Server Components; React cache ke beech ek hi data ke liye sansmaran kiya jata hai.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — shuru kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: getStaticPaths ko replace karta hai; dynamicParams: false = 404 ko bina listed pathon ke liye; hamesha ek sarani (empty array ux no function); Cache Components ke saath, kam se kam ek param anivarya hai; ek layout keval apne star aur upar ke liye params generated kar sakta hai, kabhi neeche nahi; ISR revalidation ke dauraan phir se nahi bulaya jata hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: static viewport objekt ya dynamic generateViewport function ke saath page ke initial drishtikon ko customize karta hai. donon hi keval Server Component hain; aap donon hi ek hi segment se export nahi kar sakte. ek metadata-too-viewport-export codemod purane metadata export ko migrate karne ke liye maujud hai.

  • The viewport objekt: layout.jsx/page.jsx se export:
tsx
  import type { Viewport } from 'next'
  export const viewport: Viewport = { themeColor: 'black' }
  • generateViewport function: ek Viewport objekt return karta hai; params (/LayoutProps<'/route'> ke madhyam se prakar); static object ko pasand karte hain jab viewport request jankari par nirbhar nahi karta hai: PageProps<'/route'>
tsx
  export function generateViewport({ params }) {
    return { themeColor: '...' }
  }
  • Viewport field:
  • themeColor — saral: themeColor: 'black' → <meta name="theme-color" content="black" />; media ke saath: themeColor: [{ media: '(prefers-color-scheme: light)', color: 'cyan' }, { media: '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)', color: 'black' }] → do <meta name="theme-color" media="…" content="…" /> taiga.
  • width, initialScale, maximumScale, userScalable () — e.g. { width: 'device-width', initialScale: 1, maximumScale: 1, userScalable: false } → <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no" />. not: viewport meta tag automatic hai aur manual config aamtaur par anavashyak hai - default suffice. interactiveWidget: 'resizes-visual'
  • colorScheme — colorScheme: 'dark' → <meta name="color-scheme" content="dark" />.
  • With Cache Components: generateViewport any components ke saman niymon ka palan karta hai - runtime data (cookies(), headers(), params, searchParams) ya ankechd rivar diphars ko request karne ke liye. metadata ke viprit, viewport CANNOT ko stream kiya jaa sakta hai (yeh initial page-load UI ko affected karta hai) - yadi yeh dipheindar karta hai, to page block ko hal hone taka. fix: yadi yeh external data par nirbhar karta hai lekin runtime data nahi hai, to generateViewport ke andar 'use cache' ka upyog karein; yadi ise vastav mein runtime data ki requirement hoti hai, to pure route ko point karne ke liye ek <Suspense> boundary mein dastavez <body> ko lapeto dynamic hona chahiye (khule jahaaz turant, dastavez streams ek bar viewport hal); optional roop se segment ko instant = false ke saath tatkal-naukik validation (root har request par render karta hai, navigation block jab tak pura nahi hota - keval us segment ka vikalp chunta hai; vanshaj abhi bhi global default dwara valid hain). vishisht routes ke liye puri tarah se dynamic drishtikon ko alag karne ke liye multiple root layout ka upyog karein jabki any route static shell rakhte hain.
  • Types: import type { Viewport } from 'next'; niymit roop se karya lautane wala Viewport, ya segment prop (params/searchParams promis); JS projekts: JSDoc /** @type {import("next").Viewport} */.
  • Version history: v14.0.0 — viewport aur generateViewport pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: themeColor / colorScheme / viewport ne V14 mein metadata ke OUT ko moved kiya; viewport metadata ki tarah stream nahi kar sakta - runtime-data viewport page ko block karta hai; Suspense-around-<body> pattern ya instant = false do bhag hain.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: headers ek async function ('next/headers' se) hai jo Server Component se aane wale request header ko padhta hai: HTTP

tsx
  // app/page.tsx
  import { headers } from 'next/headers'
  export default async function Page() {
    const headersList = await headers()
    const userAgent = headersList.get('user-agent')
  }
  • Reference: koi parameter nahi. entries(), forEach(), get(), has(), keys(), values() ke saath ek read-only web Headers objekt return karta hai.
  • Good to know: async — async/await ya React ke use (V14 aur isse pahle async access abhi bhi Next.js 15 mein kaam karta hai, lekin ise alag kiya jayega). keval parhne ke liye - aap set ya delete outgoing request header nahi kar sakte. yeh ek request samay API hai jiska maan samay se aage nahi known ho sakta hai; iska upyog dynamic rendering mein ek route ka chayan karta hai. With Cache Components, ek <Suspense> boundary ke bahar headers() ko bulane se route ko roka jaa sakta hai.
  • Example - authorization header: ne ise ek API: const authorization = (await headers()).get('authorization'); const res = await fetch('...', { headers: { authorization } }); const user = await res.json(); return <h1>{user.name}</h1> ko agreshit kiya.
  • Version history: v15.0.0-RC — headers async (codemod upalabdh); v13.0.0 — shuru hua.

io

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai io. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: io — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage — Server Component, Usage — Client Component, When you don't need `io()`, How `io()` differs from `connection()`, Reference, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: With Cache Components enable, Next.js aapko yeh tay karne ki requirement hai ki kya ek bar new Date() ya Math.random() jaise ek tulyakalik maan ko capture karna hai aur ise har visitor ke liye pun: upyog karna hai, ya ise prati request fresh production karna hai. ise static shell mein catch ke liye, ise "use cache" mein lapeto; ise static shell se bahar rakhne ke liye, await io() ka upyog karein, jo prerendering ke dauraan suspended ho jata hai. request ke dauraan, cached dayre ke andar, browser mein aur bina Cache Components (incl) ke apps mein. Pages Router, io() turant hal karta hai. 'next/cache' se import kiya gaya.

  • Usage — Server Component: call await io() parhne se pahle new Date(), Math.random(), crypto.randomUUID(), ya node:sqlite jaise ek async DB driver:
tsx
  // app/page.tsx
  import { Suspense } from 'react'
  import { io } from 'next/cache'
  export default function Page() {
    return (
      <Suspense fallback={<p>Loading...</p>}>
        <CurrentTime />
      </Suspense>
    )
  }
  async function CurrentTime() {
    await io()
    return <p>{new Date().toISOString()}</p>
  }

<Suspense> ke andar, prerender await io() ke dauraan static shell mein fallback ships ko suspended kar diya jata hai. iske bajaay ek "use cache" gunjaish ke andar, io() ek no-of hai - value static shell mein capture kar liya jata hai aur koi <Suspense> boundary ki requirement nahi hoti hai.

  • Usage — Client Component: call io() React ke use hook ke saath ek async source jaise Date.now() (Client Components) ko parhne se pahle SSR ke dauraan server par prerender karte hain, jahan parhne ko anyatha static shell mein shamil kiya jayega):
tsx
  'use client'
  import { use } from 'react'
  import { io } from 'next/cache'
  export function CurrentTime() {
    use(io())
    return <div>{Date.now()}</div>
  }
  • Kab aapko io(): ki requirement nahi hai yadi ek opreshan pahle se hi poorvnirdhaaran ko suspended kar data hai (fetch, <Suspense> ke andar async DB query), koi extra io() call ki requirement nahi hai. request data ke baad Sync IO: build-time prerendering ke dauraan , cookies()/headers() ka wait nimnlikhit code executed karne se pahle suspended ho jata hai; Partial Prefetching ke saath ye API runtime prerendering ke dauraan hal kar sakte hain, isliye unke baad time/randomness ka ek uncached pathan abhi bhi <Suspense> ke andar ek prerender error ko trigger kar sakta hai - async parhne se pahle await io() ko call karein (ya isse pahle ek helper vyakti). iske bajaay runtime prefetching ke liye paatr rakhne ke liye, ek use cache gunjaish ke bahar required request manon ko parhein aur unhein tarkon ke roop mein paas karein, aur cached gunjaish mein parhne wale async ko shamil karein.
  • Kaise io() connection() ke viprit connection(): se bhinn hota hai, io() ek "use cache" gunjaish ke andar bhi kaam karta hai, isliye yeh call karne wala ek function cached aur uncached code ko saman roop se chala sakta hai; ek cache gunjaish ke andar connection() ko call karne se error ho jati hai. ek cache gunjaish ke bahar do saman behavior karte hain - kisi ke baad code ko har prerender se bahar rakha jata hai, chahe build samay par ho ya prefetch ke liye. connection() par io() ko priority dein; keval tabhi connection() tak pahunchein jab aapko actual user request ke liye wait karna hoga.
  • Reference: function io(): Promise<void> — koi parameter nahi; wapas Promise<void>. With Cache Components, yeh wait kar raha hai ki yeh pahle se render karna band kar data hai, isliye nimnlikhit code ko prerender output se bahar rakha gaya hai; pratyek any sandarbh (actual request, cache gunjaish, generateStaticParams, browser, Cache Components ke bina route) mein yeh turant hal karta hai.
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — io joda gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: io() = "yeh maan prati request fresh hona chahiye, ise static shell se bahar rakhna chahiye"; yeh use cache ke andar ek no-op nahi hai; ise connection() par pasand karein; Client Components mein use(io()) ka upyog karein.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/io
