navigation

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai navigation. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: navigation — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Setup, Navigation stages (with Partial Prefetching), Usage, How `navigation()` differs from `connection()`, When to use it, Keeping a route's prefetch static. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: await navigation() App Shell se neeche runtime kaam rakhta hai aur prati-link prefetch; jab user navigate karta hai to kaam chalta hai, jabki previous output mein nikatatam <Suspense> girbaik render karta hai. ise pun: prayojy content ke liye upyog karein jo generated karne mein mahnga hai aur navigation tak wait karna chahiye. static prerenderers mein abhi bhi unke output mein content shamil hai, isliye yeh static prefetch mein dikhai de sakta hai. 'next/cache' se import kiya gaya.

  • Setup: ko Cache Components ki requirement hoti hai (iske bina throw karta hai); Partial Prefetching ka upyog karne wale routes ke liye, global star par (cacheComponents: true, partialPrefetching: true mein next.config) ya ek samay mein ek route enable kiya.
  • Navigation steps (Partial Prefetching ke saath): (1) ek default <Link> App Shell load karta hai - URL ke aadhar par route ka hissa; (2) ek optional <Link prefetch={true}> link ke URL ke aadhar par content bhi load kar sakta hai; (3) jab user link ka anusaran karta hai, to navigation baki ko render karta hai. runtime rendering ke dauraan, navigation() App Shell aur prati-link prefetch se content rakhta hai, isliye yeh navigation ke dauraan render karta hai; static prerender abhi bhi ismein shamil ho sakte hain. Without Partial Prefetching, navigation() abhi bhi ek default <Link> ke liye content ko dipheindar karta hai, lekin <Link prefetch={true}> pure route (deferred content) ko ek navigation ke roop mein bhi prapt karta hai. App Shell se content ko banaye rakhne ke liye, jabki abhi bhi ismein ek prati-link prefetch shamil hai, prefetch() ka upyog karein.
  • Usage: sab kuchh navigation() se upar app Shell/per-link prefetch mein render kar sakta hai; sab kuchh neeche navigation ke liye wait kar raha hai. Deferral component hai ki yeh wait kar raha hai aur neeche per - bhai bahne wali shakhaon unke behavior ko rakhne ke liye dayra hai. ise <Suspense> mein define karne aur component ko lapetne ke liye code ke upar rakhein:
tsx
  // app/post/[slug]/page.tsx
  import { Suspense } from 'react'
  import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
  import { cacheLife, navigation } from 'next/cache'
  async function Comments({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
    await navigation() // runtime work below renders on navigation
    const { slug } = await params
    const sort = (await cookies()).get('comment-sort')?.value ?? 'newest'
    const items = await getComments(slug, sort)
    return <CommentList items={items} />
  }
  async function getComments(slug: string, sort: string) {
    'use cache'
    cacheLife('hours')
    return db.comments.list({ slug, sort })
  }

comment slag dwara prapt ki jati hai, isliye unhein prefetch karna ek prati-link prefetch hoga - navigation() unhein prefetch se bahar rakhta hai. slag aur cookie ko navigation() ke neeche padha jata hai aur tark ke roop mein passed kiya jata hai, isliye getComments cache prati post/sort visitor ke bajaay; URL ko samay-samay par define content render dwara hal kiya jata hai, isliye params navigation() ke neeche upalabdh hai. 'use cache' directive ko neeche diye gaye ek function par rakhein - ek cached gunjaish (use cache, use cache: private) ke andar navigation() ka wait karne ki permission nahi hai. route-wide static shell + static prefetch ke liye, iske bajaay ensureStatic = 'prefetch' ka upyog karein (navigation() ek subtree ko define karta hai).

  • Kaise navigation() connection() se bhinn hota hai: connection() ek actual request ke liye wait karta hai - AND preefreching se nimnlikhit code ko bahar karta hai, jisse yeh request-nirbhar hota hai. navigation() root prefetch se nimnlikhit code ko bahar karta hai lekin jab user karya request-nirbhar banane ke bina navigate karta hai to hal karta hai - await navigation() ke baad bulaye gaye ek karya "use cache" ka upyog kar sakta hai aur prefetching ke dauraan iske parinam generated kiye bina apne cache lifetime ko banaye rakh sakta hai. kaam karte samay connection() ka upyog actual request ke liye karna chahiye; navigation() jab kaam pun: prayojy ho jata hai lekin user navigate karne tak wait karna chahiye.
  • Kab ise upyog karne ke liye: neeche content mehngi hai aur koi prefetch ise generated nahi karna chahiye - na to runtime App Shell aur na hi runtime prati-link prefetch us code ko chalata hai, isliye upstream request tab tak jari nahi kiye jate jab tak user navigate nahi hota. leeving kanteint ko bhi ise prefetch se bahar rakhta hai lekin iske cache lifetime ko data hai; navigation() ke saath kanteint ko use cache ke saath cache kiya jaa sakta hai, jisne ek lifetime diya aur navigation ko sthagit kar diya. ise ≥5 minat ka ek stale samay dein aur client router ise route mein pahli navigation ke baad phir se upyog karta hai; iske neeche, ek chhota lifetime ise App Shell se bahar rakhta hai, isliye pratyek navigation ise phir se prapt karta hai.
  • Keeping ek route ke prefetch static: jab har parhne ke cookies(), headers(), params, searchParams neeche baithta hai navigation(), prerender ek prefetch trigger hoga static production pahle se hi generated build se adhik production nahi kar sakte hain, isliye prefetch ko us production se served jata hai - ek optional optimization: ek static pratikriya ko CDN mein cache kiya jaa sakta hai, isliye route lagat mein ek link koi server CPU nahi hai. udaharan: app/feed/page.tsx — FeedHeader static, Stories ka wait navigation() to topic cookie padhta hai; pure prefetch static hai.
  • Good to know: page ke initial bhar par koi prabhav nahi padta. navigation() ke neeche cookies()/headers() parhne se prati request render nahi kiya jata hai - un tak pahunchon ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai kyonki ve kisi bhi prefetch mein hal nahi honge. ek <Suspense> boundary ke bahar ek call dev mein ek Instant Insight (ek puri tarah se previous route aprabhavit hai, lekin insight jhande ki call fallback ke bina content ko sthagit karega yadi route baad mein runtime rendering ki requirement hoti hai). ise use cache, use cache: private, unstable_cache(), after(), generateStaticParams, ya Client Component thro ke andar bulana.
  • Reference: function navigation(): Promise<void> — koi parameter nahi; ek Promise<void> lauta data hai (umdaa nahi).
  • Version history: v16.4.0 — navigation ne pahle ke canary release se unstable_navigation ki jagah pesh ki.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: navigation() ne navigation ko define kiya lekin cacheability rakhta hai ( connection() ke saman, jo karya request-nirbhar banata hai); kabhi ek use cache gunjaish ke andar nahi; router ke liye stale ≥ 5 minat ke saath pair pun: upyog karti hai; yeh ek up-tree ko deeph karta hai, ensureStatic = 'prefetch' ise route-wide roop se lagu karta hai.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: NextRequest — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `cookies`, `nextUrl`, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: NextRequest extra feature vidhiyon ke saath Web Request API ka vistar karta hai. Route Handlers aur Proxy (middleware) mein prayukt hota hai.

  • cookies - request ke Set-Cookie header ko parhein ya mute karein:
  • set(name, value) — e.g. request.cookies.set('show-banner', 'false') → request ko Set-Cookie:show-banner=false;path=/home milta hai.
  • get(name) - cookie maan ({ name: 'show-banner', value: 'false', Path: '/home' } ki tarah mool); undefined yadi nahi mila, to sabse pahle yadi multiple match hota hai.
  • getAll() — ek naam ke saath, us cookie ke values (e.g. do experiments cookies); koi naam nahi ke saath, request par sabhi cookies wapas aati hai.
  • delete(name) - cookie ko hata data hai; yadi hata diya gaya hai to true ko lauta data hai, to false ko hata diya gaya hai.
  • has(name) - true yadi cookie maujud hai.
  • clear() — request se sabhi cookies ko hata data hai.
  • nextUrl — mool URL API ko Next.js-vishisht gunon ke saath vistarit karta hai: request.nextUrl.pathname (e.g). /home ke request ke liye /home; request.nextUrl.searchParams (e.g). /home?name=lee ke liye { name: 'lee' }); plus basePath (string — configure kiya gaya aadhar path), buildId (string | aparibhashit - app ka build pahchankarta, generateBuildId ke madhyam se optimization). not: Pages Router se internationalization gun App Router mein upalabdh NOT hain.
  • Version history: v15.0.0 — ip aur geo hata diya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: NextRequest.cookies utprivartaneey hai (keval next/headers cookies() ke saman); ip/geo ko v15 mein hata diya gaya; App Router sanskaran mein koi i18n gun nahi. Server Components

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai NextResponse. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: NextResponse — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `cookies`, `json()`, `redirect()`, `rewrite()`, `next()`, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: NextResponse extra feature vidhiyon ke saath Web Response API ka vistar karta hai. Route Handlers aur Proxy mein prayukt hota hai. 'next/server' se import kiya gaya.

  • cookies — read/mutate the Set-Cookie header of the zimmedari: set(name, value) (e.g). response.cookies.set('show-banner', 'false') → Set-Cookie:show-banner=false;path=/home); get(name) (value object ya undefined); pahla match agar multiple); getAll() (naam se, ya naam ke saath sabhi cookies); has(name) (boolean); delete(name) (true/false).
  • json() — ek JSON body ke saath ek pratikriya generated: NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal Server Error' }, { status: 500 }).
  • redirect() - ek URL: NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/new', request.url)) ke liye ek redirect pratikriya generated karta hai. Build/modify pahle URL — e.g. const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url); loginUrl.searchParams.set('from', request.nextUrl.pathname); return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
  • rewrite() - mool URL ko preserve karte hue diye gaye URL ko phir se likhte hue ek pratikriya generated karte hain: aane wale /about, browser /about dikhata hai, phir se likhit request /proxy — NextResponse.rewrite(new URL('/proxy', request.url)).
  • next() - Proxy ke liye: jaldi wapas lautein aur routing jari rakhein - return NextResponse.next(). NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } }) ke saath phoravard header upstream:
ts
  const newHeaders = new Headers(request.headers)
  newHeaders.set('x-version', '123')
  return NextResponse.next({ request: { headers: newHeaders } })

yeh header ko target page/route/Server action ke liye aage badhata hai aur NOT ko client ko expose karta hai - data upstream ko passed karne ke liye upyogi hai, lekin savdhani ke saath upyog karein (headers ko external sevaon ke liye agreshit kiya jaa sakta hai). iske viprit, NextResponse.next({ headers }) proxy se client ke liye header bhejne ke liye ek chhota hath hai - NOT achha abhyas, isse bachne ke liye: Content-Type jaise pratikriya header set karna dhanche ki ummeedon ko override kar sakta hai (e.g. Content-Type) dwara istemal kiya gaya Server Actions), breaking sabmishan ya streaming. common taur par, sabhi aane wale request header ki nakal karne se bachein (sanvedanshil data leak kar sakte hain); ek permission-list ko pasand karein - e.g. keval known-surakshit header rakhein, custom x-*, authorization aur cookie ko chhor dein.

  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: redirect browser URL badalta hai, rewrite nahi; next({ request: { headers } }) aage ki or (surakshit-ish), next({ headers }) client ko bhejta hai (avoid); header ko agreshit karte samay ek permission-list ka upyog karta hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai next/root-params. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: next/root-params — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Good to know, Root parameters and `generateStaticParams`, Root parameters vs other route parameters, Accessing root parameters in shared code, Behavior with caching directives, Multiple root layouts. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next/root-params module Server Components mein root-level route mapdandon tak pahunchne ke liye getar function pradan karta hai. pratyek root parameter ko vartaman route ke liye parameter maan ko hal karne wale ek async function ke roop mein export kiya jata hai. export naam aapke dynamic segment folder naam - e.g se generated hote hain. app/[locale] ke andar root layout → 'next/root-params' se locale import karein. prop drilling ke bina application (sheyard yootiliteej, layout, gehrai se nested components) bhar mein required ek language/locale segment jaise values ke liye upyogi:

tsx
  // app/[lang]/layout.tsx
  import { lang } from 'next/root-params'
  export default async function RootLayout(props: LayoutProps<'/[lang]'>) {
    return (
      <html lang={await lang()}>
        <body>{props.children}</body>
      </html>
    )
  }

root parameters before ko root layout dikhai dene wale dynamic segment hain; niymit params prop ke viprit, root parameter getars ko kisi bhi Server Component se prop driling ke bina app mein bulaya jaa sakta hai.

  • Good to know: root parameter naam valid hona chahiye JS function pahchankarta - kebab-cased segment naam (e.g). [post-slug]) ko dev/build samay par supported aur error nahi hai. keval Server Components mein upyog karne yogy - Client Components, Server Actions, ya Route Handlers mein NOT (Route Handler saport ki yojna banai gai hai). export ke liye prakar next dev/next build/next typegen ke dauraan generated hote hain, jaise PageProps/LayoutProps.
  • Root parameter aur generateStaticParams: root parameter jaise hi aap unhein define route banate hain, upalabdh hain. ek generateStaticParams function keval Cache Components ke saath required hai, jahan pratyek root parameter mein kam se kam ek maan hona chahiye ya build fail hona chahiye: singal root param - app/[lang]/layout.tsx export generateStaticParams() ritarning [{ lang: 'en' }, { lang: 'fr' }]; multiple - app/[lang]/[locale]/layout.tsx return [{ lang: 'en', locale: 'us' }, { lang: 'en', locale: 'uk' }]. ek nested segment ke generateStaticParams ke andar, params: const language = await lang() ko app/[lang]/posts/[slug]/page.tsx mein nasht karne ke bajaay apne getar ke saath seedhe ek root parameter parhein, phir bhasha dwara post prapt karein.
  • Root mapdandon banam any route mapdandon: keval root layout tak segment root parameter hain; gahre log params prop ka upyog karte hain. E.g app/[lang]/layout.tsx (mool layout) + app/[lang]/posts/[slug]/page.tsx — keval lang ek root parameter hai; slug ek niymit root parameter (const { slug } = await props.params; const language = await lang()) hai.
  • sajha code mein Accessing root parameter: getter kisi bhi Server Component ya server-side upyogita se call karne yogy module import kar rahe hain, na keval layouts/pages — e.g. lib/get-translations.ts export async function getTranslations() { const language = await lang(); return import(\7${language}.json\) }. import 'server-only' ke liye koi requirement nahi - import pahle se hi Client Component mein build samay par fail raha. @/locales/
  • caching directive ke saath Behavior: kyonki getars imported karyon, Next.js track jo ek cached function ka upyog karta hai - keval un root parameter use cache cache key ka hissa ban jate hain, isliye entries unrelated parameter manon mein vibhajit nahi hain. niymit params prop ke saath aap cached function ke bahar params ka wait kar rahe hain aur ek tark ke roop mein value ko paas kar sakte hain; root params ke saath aap cached function ke andar seedhe getar ko bulaate hain.
  • Multiple root layout: jab app mein vibhinn mapdandon ke saath multiple root layout hote hain, to getars ko sabhi sambhavit routes ke liye type kiya jata hai - pratyek root layout mein koi parameter string | undefined type nahi hai. E.g app/dashboard/[id]/layout.tsx (id ke saath root layout) banam app/marketing/layout.tsx (bina) - await id() string | undefined hai, jo vipanan routes par undefined laut raha hai.
  • Catch-all aur optional catch-all: root parameter catch-all segment ke saath kaam karte hain - app/docs/[...path]/layout.tsx: const segments = await path() → string[] | undefined.
  • Returns: pratyek getar ek Promise ko hal karne ke liye lauta hai: dynamic [id] → string; catch-all [...path] → string[]; optional catch-all [[...path]] → string[] | undefined. yadi vartaman route ke root layout mein parameter maujud nahi hai, to return type mein undefined shamil hai.
  • Restrictions: Server Components keval - ek Client Component mein import karne se ek build error (" mein import nahi kar sakte") unstable_cache mein upalabdh nahi hai (ek runtime error prapt karein - iske bajaay "use cache" ka upyog karein); Server Actions (error) mein upalabdh nahi hai; Route Handlers abhi tak supported nahi hai (yojna). Client Component
  • Kyun root parameter vishesh hain: root layout top leveleey rendering boundary hai; mapdandon se pahle yeh sabhi routes ke tahat sajha kar rahe hain, isliye ve us per mein kisi bhi Server Component se access karne ke liye surakshit hain. gahre parameter children ke page ke anusar bhinn hote hain (kuchh naam mein alag-alag types/meanings ho sakte hain ya maujud nahi - e.g. blog [slug] banam store [...slug]), isliye ve keval params prop ke madhyam se define page/layout. exception mein upalabdh hain: multiple root layout - getars mein un routes ke liye undefined shamil hain jahan parameter maujud nahi ho sakta hai.
  • Version history: v16.3.0 — next/root-params pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: koi kebab-case segment naam; Server Components keval (NO Client Components, Server Actions, Route Handlers abhi tak, koi unstable_cache nahi); keval prayukt root param use cache key mein access karte hain; undefined jab param vartaman root layout mein nahi hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai notFound. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: notFound — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Where it can be invoked, Good to know, Example — after streaming has started, Example — Route Handler 404, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: notFound() ek error throw karta hai jo lapta sansadhanon ko sambhalne ke liye nahi-installed UI ko render karta hai; not-found.js file ke saath UI ko customize karein. yeh ek NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404 error throw karta hai aur root segment ke rendering ko samapt karta hai jahan ise phenk diya gaya tha. Next.js ne <meta name="robots" content="noindex" /> ko injekt kiya taaki page anukrmit na ho. kyonki yeh throw karne se kaam karta hai, ise render path mein kahte hain - ek component, ya ek component ka wait karta hai. bina await kiye gaye vade mein chhore gaye ek call throw karta hai jahan kuchh bhi ise nahi pakadta hai aur nahi-installed UI render karta hai (dev logs ⨯ unhandledRejection: NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404).

  • Kahan ise radd kiya jaa sakta hai: Server Components, Server Functions, Route Handlers. 'next/navigation' se import kiya gaya:
tsx
  // app/user/[id]/page.tsx
  import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
  export default async function Profile({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
    const { id } = await params
    const user = await fetchUser(id)
    if (!user) {
      notFound()
    }
    // ...
  }
  • Good to know: return notFound() ke liye koi requirement nahi - yeh throw karta hai (TypeScript never return type), isliye execution band ho jata hai, aur ek check kiye gaye value baad mein sankirn rahta hai (user ko check ke baad define kiya gaya hai). call ke aaspas ek try/catch ise dabata hai aur nahi paya UI render nahi karega - yadi aap paas ki errors ko pakadna chahte hain to badha ko rokne ke liye unstable_rethrow ka upyog karein.
  • Example - streaming ke baad shuru ho gaya hai: shell/loading UI ko dikhai data hai jabki data load ek <Suspense>-wrapped component ke andar astitv ki check kar raha hai; muhaavre sthan data-access function hi hai (getPost call notFound()) ek 404 par sthiti lane ke liye, any viphaltaon ke liye ek common Error throw karta hai). jab post maujud nahi hai, to exception nikatatam not-found boundary ko badhava data hai, halanki shell pahle se hi bheja gaya tha, dharabaddh content ke sthan par render karta hai. custom UI ke liye route ke saath not-found.tsx jorein; ek ke bina, nikatatam parent not-found boundary pradan karta hai, wapas Next.js ke default 404 page par gir jata hai. jawab notFound() run se pahle <Suspense> boundary se streaming shuru hota hai, isliye yeh apni 200 sthiti rakhta hai aur Next.js ek noindex tag jodta hai. notFound() ek 404 lauta hai jab yeh pratikriya shuru hone se pahle chalta hai, jismein render karne ke dauraan (sthiti code dekhein) shamil hai.
  • Example — Route Handler 404: notFound() Route Handlers mein bhi kaam karta hai - app/api/posts/[slug]/route.ts notFound() ko call karta hai jab upstream laataa theek nahi hai, kolar ko 404 ki serve karta hai.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — shuru kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: ne NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;404 ko phenk diya; kabhi ise wapas nahi kiya; ise na pakro (ya phir se pheinko); hamesha calling function ka wait karte hain; 404 streaming se pahle, 200 + noindex streaming shuru hone ke baad; Cache Components ke saath, path generateStaticParams ke liye notFound() ka upyog wapas nahi kiya gaya.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai permanentRedirect. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: permanentRedirect — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Parameters, Returns, Behavior, Example, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: permanentRedirect user ko dusre URL par redirect karta hai. Server Components, Client Components, Route Handlers aur Server Functions mein upyog yogya. ek streaming sandarbh mein yeh redirect client-side ka utsarjan karne ke liye meta tag ko sammilit karta hai. ek Server Action mein yeh client-side navigation karta hai jab JS upalabdh hota hai; pragtishil-prachaaran form prastutiyon ke liye yeh ek 303 HTTP redirect karya karta hai; anyatha yeh 308 (sthayi) HTTP ko redirect karta hai. yadi koi sansadhan maujud nahi hai, to iske bajaay notFound() ka upyog karein.

  • Parameters: permanentRedirect(path, type) — path (string, relative ya nirpeksh URL to redirect); type — 'replace' (default) ya 'push' ( Server Actions mein default). default roop se yeh Server Actions aur replace mein push (naya history entry) ka upyog karta hai (vartaman mein URL ko history stack mein badal data hai) har jagah; RedirectType ka upyog karke type parameter ke madhyam se override:
ts
  import { permanentRedirect, RedirectType } from 'next/navigation'
  permanentRedirect('/redirect-to', RedirectType.replace)
  // or
  permanentRedirect('/redirect-to', RedirectType.push)

type parameter ka Server Components mein koi prabhav nahi hai.

  • Returns: koi maan nahi (ek NEXT_REDIRECT error ko throw karta hai aur route segment ke rendering ko samapt karta hai).
  • BHavior: Server Actions aur Route Handlers mein , permanentRedirect outside ko try/catch ka upyog karte samay try block kahte hain, kyonki yeh throw karta hai. 307 (asthayi) ke liye 308 (sthayi) ke bajaay redirect karein, redirect() ka upyog karein.
  • Example:
jsx
  // app/team/[id]/page.js
  import { permanentRedirect } from 'next/navigation'
  export default async function Profile({ params }) {
    const { id } = await params
    const team = await fetchTeam(id)
    if (!team) {
      permanentRedirect('/login')
    }
    // ...
  }

koi return permanentRedirect() ki zaroorat - TypeScript never prakaara.

  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: 308 sthayi banam redirect() asthayi; NEXT_REDIRECT throw karta hai (prem block ke bahar bulaao); type ka arth Server Components mein hai; Server Actions default push, kahin aur replace hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/permanentRedirect

prefetch` (function)

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai prefetch` (function). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: prefetch` (function) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Setup, Navigation stages, Usage, How `prefetch()` differs from `connection()`, When to use it, Keeping the App Shell static. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: await prefetch() route ke App Shell se neeche runtime kaam rakhta hai; yeh kaam prati-link prefetch ya navigation ke dauraan chalaya jaa sakta hai, jabki nikatatam <Suspense> fallback shell mein render hoti hai. ise content ke liye upyog karein App Shell anyatha render karega lekin yeh generated karne ke liye mahnga hai. static prerenderers mein abhi bhi unke output mein content shamil hai. 'next/cache' se import kiya gaya.

  • Setup: ko Cache Components ki requirement hoti hai (yadi enable nahi hai to unmein se kuchh). Without Partial Prefetching ek route mein koi App Shell nahi hai, isliye function ka koi prabhav nahi hai - ek samay mein global star par Partial Prefetching ya ek route enable karein.
  • Navigation steps: (1) default <Link> App Shell load karta hai (URL ke aadhar par nahi route ka hissa); (2) optional <Link prefetch={true}> bhi URL-nirbhar content load karta hai; (3) navigation aaram pradan karta hai. runtime rendering ke dauraan, prefetch() App Shell se content ko bahar rakhta hai taaki yeh prati-link prefetch ya navigation ke dauraan render ho; static prerender abhi bhi ismein shamil ho sakte hain. prati-link prefetch ke saath-saath (keval navigation par render) se content ko banaye rakhne ke liye, navigation() ka upyog karein.
  • Usage: App Shell mein prefetch() ke upar sab kuchh pradan karta hai; sab kuchh neeche ek prati link prefetch ya navigation par render karta hai. Deferral component hai ki yeh wait kar raha hai aur neeche per - siblings shell mein common roop se render karne ke liye dayra hai. ise <Suspense> mein component ko define karne aur lapetne ke kaam ke upar rakhein:
tsx
  // app/dashboard/page.tsx
  import { Suspense } from 'react'
  import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
  import { cacheLife, prefetch } from 'next/cache'
  async function Greeting() {
    const session = (await cookies()).get('session')?.value
    return <p>{session ? 'Welcome back' : 'Welcome'}</p>
  }
  async function Recommendations() {
    await prefetch() // runtime work below renders on a per-link prefetch or navigation
    const items = await getRecommendations()
    return <List items={items} />
  }
  async function getRecommendations() {
    'use cache: private'
    cacheLife('hours')
    const session = (await cookies()).get('session')?.value
    return db.recommendations.rank({ session })
  }

badhaaee session padhti hai aur App Shell mein rahti hai; recommendations ise getRecommendations ke andar bhi padhti hain, taaki parhne ko rainking ke saath define kiya jaa sake - prefetch() ko hata dein aur ve har link load App Shell ka hissa ban jate hain. ise neeche bulaye gaye ek function par directive dein; ek cached gunjaish (use cache, use cache: private) ke andar prefetch() ka wait karne ki permission nahi hai. ek route-wide static App Shell ke liye, ensureStatic = 'shell' ka upyog karein.

  • Kaise prefetch() connection() se bhinn hota hai: connection() ek actual request ke liye wait karta hai - prerendering aur prefetching se nimnlikhit code ko bahar karta hai, jisse yeh request-nirbhar hota hai. prefetch() App Shell se nimnlikhit code ko bahar karta hai lekin karya request-nirbhar banane ke bina prati-link prefetch ke dauraan hal kar sakta hai - await prefetch() ke baad bulaye gaye karya "use cache" ka upyog kar sakte hain aur route mein pratyek link ke liye iske parinam generated kiye bina apne cache lifetime ko banaye rakh sakte hain. kaam karte samay connection() ka upyog actual request ke liye karna chahiye; prefetch() jab kaam pun: prayojy ho jata hai lekin keval ek chaynit prati-link prefetch ya navigation ke liye chalaya jana chahiye.
  • Kab ise upyog karne ke liye: neeche content mehngi hai aur ise App Shell mein har <Link> load mein generated nahi kiya jana chahiye - shell ka build us code ko nahi chala jata hai, isliye upstream requests ko prati-link prefetch ya navigation tak jari nahi kiya jata hai. content ko chhorakar bhi ise shell se bahar rakhta hai lekin iske cache lifetime ko data hai aur ise prati-link prefetch ke dauraan upalabdh nahi kar sakta hai; prefetch() ke saath content ko cache kiya jaa sakta hai (use cache / use cache: private) ek lifetime diya jaa sakta hai, aur sthagit kar diya jaa sakta hai. Uncached reads, laghu stale bar, aur params/searchParams ke pichhe kuchh bhi pahle se hi apne khud ke shell se bahar chhor diya jata hai.
  • Keeping the App Shell static: jab pratyek cookies()/headers() parh prefetch() ke neeche baithta hai, to prerender ek shell prefetch trigger hoga jo pahle se generated static production se adhik production nahi kar sakta hai, isliye shell ko us output se served jata hai - ek static pratikriya ko CDN mein cache kiya jaa sakta hai, isliye ek default <Link> ki lagat koi server CPU nahi hai. ek route ko hal karne wala params/searchParams us prerender ko iske bajaay prapt karta hai, jaisa ki upar ka udaharan hai (iska greeting shell mein session padhta hai, isliye shell prati visitor ek bar render karta hai aur keval recommendations ko sthagit kar diya jata hai).
  • Good to know: page ke initial bhar par koi prabhav nahi padta. connection() ke viprit, yeh subtree ko request-nirbhar ke roop mein chihnit nahi karta hai - neeche ki content puri tarah se kaishebal rahti hai. ek <Suspense> boundary ke bahar ek call dev mein ek Instant Insight sataha. ise use cache, use cache: private, unstable_cache(), after(), generateStaticParams, ya Client Component thro ke andar bulana. ek page/layout mein jo prefetch route segment config ko bhi set karta hai, dusre naam (import { prefetch as prefetchStage } from 'next/cache') ke tahat karya import karta hai kyonki donon ko prefetch naam diya gaya hai.
  • Reference: function prefetch(): Promise<void> — koi parameter nahi; return Promise<void> (ka matalab nahi).
  • Version history: v16.4.0 — prefetch ne pahle ke canary release se unstable_prefetch ki jagah pesh ki.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: prefetch() prati-link prefetch/navigation ko define karta hai lekin cacheability rakhta hai (vs connection() = request-nirbhar); kabhi ek cached gunjaish ke andar nahi; segment config export ke saath naam takrav - import ke alias; navigation() sakht bhai bahne wala hai (preeft ke pichhe ki raksha karta hai).

Asaan bhasha me samjho: redirect — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Parameters, Returns, Behavior, Examples, FAQ — why 307 and 308?, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: redirect user ko dusre URL par redirect karta hai. server aur Client Components, Route Handlers aur Server Functions mein render karte samay upyog yogya. ek streaming sandarbh mein yeh redirect client-side ka utsarjan karne ke liye meta tag ko sammilit karta hai. ek Server Action mein yeh client-side navigation karta hai jab JS upalabdh hota hai; pragtishil-prachaaran form prastutiyon ke liye yeh 303 HTTP redirect karta hai; anyatha yeh 307 HTTP redirect karta hai. yadi koi sansadhan maujud nahi hai, to iske bajaay notFound() ka upyog karein.

  • Parameters: redirect(path, type) — path (string, relative ya full); type — 'replace' (default) ya 'push' ( Server Actions mein default). default: Server Actions, replace mein push (naya history entry) kahin aur; RedirectType (redirect('/redirect-to', RedirectType.replace) / RedirectType.push) ke saath override karein. type parameter ka Server Components mein koi prabhav nahi hai.
  • Returns: koi maan nahi - ek NEXT_REDIRECT error ko throw karta hai aur route segment ke rendering ko samapt kar data hai.
  • Behavior: server Actions/Route handler (yeh throw karta hai) mein try block ke bahar bulata hai. 308 (sthayi) ke liye 307 (asthayi) ke bajaay redirect karein, permanentRedirect ka upyog karein. Client Components mein, redirect ko rendering ke dauraan bulaya jaa sakta hai, lekin NOT iveint handler mein - iske bajaay useRouter ka upyog karein. full URL accept karta hai (external link bhi). render karne ki prakriya se pahle redirect karne ke liye, next.config.js redirect ya NextResponse.redirect ka upyog Proxy mein karein.
  • Examples: Server Component — app/team/[id]/page.tsx lapta hone par team aur redirect('/login') prapt karta hai (koi return redirect() ki zaroorat nahi - never prakar). Client Component — 'use client' component usePathname() aur redirect('/admin/login') padhta hai jab path /admin se shuru hota hai aur /login nahi hai; initial SSR load par yeh server-side redirect karta hai. Via Server Action - action={navigate} ke saath ek client form jahan 'use server' action call redirect(\/posts/${data.get('id')}\).
  • FAQ - kyon 307 aur 308? paramparik roop se 302 (asthayi) aur 301 (sthayi) ka upyog kiya gaya tha, lekin kai browsers ne ek 302 par POST se GET tak request vidhi ko badal diya. 307 POST (e.g) ke roop mein vidhi ko preserve karta hai. redirect() 302 ke bajaay default roop se 307 ka upyog karta hai; Server Action form sabmishan exception hain - ve 303 ka upyog karte hain isliye browser ek GET (ya client-side navigation jab JS upalabdh hai) ke saath anusaran karta hai. /users /people POST POST
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — shuru kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: 307 asthayi (method-serving) banam permanentRedirect ka 308; NEXT_REDIRECT ko throw karta hai - bahar ki koshish blokon ko bulata hai; keval Client Components (event handlers → useRouter); type jiska arth Server Components mein nahi hai; purv-render punarnirdesh next.config.js ya Proxy mein hain.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai refresh. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: refresh — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage, Client cache behavior, Parameters/returns, Example, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: refresh ek Server Action se vartaman route ke liye dynamic kaam ko phir se chalata hai, bina server-side cached data ko avaidh karta hai. 'next/cache' se import kiya gaya.

  • Usage: ONLY ko Server Actions se bulaya jaa sakta hai - Client Components mein router.refresh() ka upyog karein; iska upyog Route Handlers ya any sandarbhon mein nahi kiya jaa sakta hai (yeh Route Handler mein ek error throw karta hai).
  • Client cache behavior: calling refresh back/forward navigation ke liye rakhe gaye pages ko saaf karta hai, lekin NOT ko any prefetch rooton ko avaidh roop se declare karta hai - Server Action se pahle ek route phir se istemal kiya jaa sakta hai jab tak iska stale time khatm nahi ho jata. yadi ek mutation any routes dwara istemal kiye gaye cache data ko badal data hai, to iske bajaay Server Action se updateTag ya revalidatePath ko call karein - ve server-side cache data ko avaidh roop se disabled karte hain aur vartaman mein client cache se prefetch routes ko saaf karte hain.
  • Parameters/returns: refresh(): void — koi maan nahi.
  • Example:
ts
  // app/actions.ts
  'use server'
  import { refresh } from 'next/cache'
  export async function createPost(formData: FormData) {
    const title = formData.get('title')
    const content = formData.get('content')
    const post = await db.post.create({ data: { title, content } })
    refresh()
  }
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: refresh ≠ revalidatePath / updateTag - yeh keval vartaman route ke liye dynamic kaam ko phir se chalata hai, bina server cache ke; Server Actions keval (Client Components → router.refresh()); yeh back/forward pages ko saaf karta hai lekin any previous routes ko rakhta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/refresh

revalidatePath

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai revalidatePath. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: revalidatePath — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Behavior, Parameters, What can be invalidated, With rewrites, Relationship with `revalidateTag`/`updateTag`, Examples. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: revalidatePath ne ek vishisht path ke liye data on-demand cache kiya. Server Functions aur Route Handlers mein call karne yogy; Client Components ya Proxy mein NOT (keval server parivesh).

  • Behavior: Server Functions — turant UI ko update karta hai (yadi affected path ko dekh raha ho); vartaman mein sabhi pahle vizit kiye gaye pages ko phir se navigate karte samay riphresh karne ka bhi karan banta hai (asthayi behavior, bhavishy mein vishisht path ke liye dayar kiya jayega). Route Handlers — revalidation ke liye path ko chihnit karta hai; revalidation path ki agli visit par hota hai, isliye ise ek dynamic route segment ke saath bula kar NOT ek bar mein kai pratyaashiyon ko trigger karta hai - amanyata keval tab hoti hai jab path agli visit hoti hai.
  • Parameters: revalidatePath(path: string, type?: 'page' | 'layout'): void — path route file structure hai: /product/123 jaise ek shabdik path, ya /product/[slug] jaise dynamic segments ke saath ek route pattern; kya NOT ne /page ya /layout (type ke bajaay upyog karein); adhikatam 1024 varn; kes-sanvedanshil; trailingSlash config ki parvah kiye bina koi trailing slash ki zaroorat nahi hai. type (optional): 'page' ya 'layout'; required jab path mein ek dynamic segment hota hai; ek shabdik path ke liye mata. ek page ko refresh karne ke liye ek sakshar path ka upyog karein; sabhi match pages ko taza karne ke liye ek route pattern + type. kuchh bhi nahi return karta hai.
  • Kya ko invalid declare kiya jaa sakta hai: page (vishisht page ko amanyata pradan karta hai); layout (invalidates ki segment ke layout.tsx, iske neeche sabhi nested layout, aur unke neeche sabhi page); Route Handlers (unmein cache kiye gaye data ko unke bhitar access kiya gaya - e.g). revalidatePath("/api/data") ne ek GET handler ko cache: 'force-cache' ka upyog karke declare kiya hai.
  • Rewrites ke saath: destination path (actual route file sthan), browser ke edres bar mein source path nahi — e.g Rewrite /blog → /news ko revalidatePath('/news') ki requirement hoti hai, '/blog' nahi, kyonki route file structure par revalidation karya karta hai, view URL nahi (cache entries kis route file dwara unhein render ki jati hain).
  • revalidateTag/updateTag ke saath Relationship: revalidatePath ek vishisht page/layout path ko avaidh roop se declare karta hai; revalidateTag un taigon ka upyog karke sabhi pages mein stale ke roop mein vishisht tag ke saath data chinhit karta hai; updateTag expires data jiska upyog sabhi pages mein vishisht taigon ke saath kiya jata hai. revalidatePath('/blog'), Page A (/blog) ke baad, posts ko tag kiya gaya. poorak primitive aksar ek saath upyog kiya jata hai: Page B /dashboard posts
ts
  'use server'
  import { revalidatePath, updateTag } from 'next/cache'
  export async function updatePost() {
    await updatePostInDatabase()
    revalidatePath('/blog') // Refresh the blog page
    updateTag('posts') // Refresh all pages using 'posts' tag
  }
  • Examples: vishisht path — revalidatePath('/blog/post-1'); page path — revalidatePath('/blog/[slug]', 'page') (route samuhon ke saath bhi: '/(main)/blog/[slug]') — invalid match page lekin NOT pages ke neeche (e.g). /blog/[slug] ne /blog/[slug]/[author] ko avaidh nahi kiya; layout path — revalidatePath('/blog/[slug]', 'layout') — invalidates match layout aur pages ke neeche (e.g). /blog/[slug]/[another] bhi); sabhi data - revalidatePath('/', 'layout') Client Cache ko shuddh karta hai aur agli visit par revalidation ke liye sabhi cache data ko invalid karta hai; Server Function — submit() call submitForm() to revalidatePath('/'); Route Handler — app/api/revalidate/route.ts path ko request.nextUrl.searchParams se padhta hai aur revalidatePath(path) ko call karta hai, { revalidated: true, now: Date.now() } return karta hai.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: path = route file structure, browser URL (rewrites → upyog destination); type dynamic pattern ke liye required; layout revalidation cascades neeche, page revalidation nahi; revalidatePath path-skipd hai jabki tag data-skaipd hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/revalidatePath

revalidateTag

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai revalidateTag. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: revalidateTag — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Revalidation behavior, Client cache behavior, Parameters, Relationship with `revalidatePath`, Examples, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: revalidateTag ne ek vishisht cache tag ke liye data on-demand cache kiya. aisi content ke liye ideal jahan mamuli delay svikarya hai (blog post, product list, pralekhan) - recommended max profile ke saath, user background mein fresh data load karte samay stale content prapt karte hain. Server Functions aur Route Handlers mein call karne yogy; Client Components ya Proxy mein NOT.

  • Revalidation behavior: call karne wale revalidateTag chihnon ne data ko stale ke roop mein tag kiya; agle request ne ek revalidation ko band kar diya aur ise stale content served jata hai jabki yeh daurtaa hai. dusra tark yeh set karta hai ki kitni der tak stale content serve kiya ja sakta hai; ateet mein, ek request block jab tak revalidation pura nahi ho jata hai:
  • profile="max" (recommended) - ek saal ki khirkee, lanbe samay tak paryapt ki requests ko hamesha ghoomne ke dauraan stale served jata hai.
  • ek any profile ya ek object - kisi any default/custom cacheLife profile, ya ek alag vindo ke liye ek expire sanpatti ke saath ek object.
  • { expire: 0 } - stale content kabhi serve nahi ki jati hai; agle request ek blocked revalidate/cache yaad hai. jab kolar ko turant data ki requirement hoti hai to iska upyog karein aur aap updateTag ka upyog nahi kar sakte.
  • koi dusra tark (deprecated) - { expire: 0 } ki tarah behavior karta hai; Server Actions ya profile="max" mein updateTag mein migrate karein. profile us point ko set karti hai jo data sahi hona gati se adhik hoti hai. ek request dwara ek revalidation shuru ki jati hai, na ki revalidateTag call dwara — tag ka upyog karne wale pages ko phir se valid kiya jata hai kyonki ve ek bar mein nahi jate hain. multi-insteins deployment: Distributed Tag Coordination (cacheHandlers) dekhein.
  • Client cache behavior: Server Action mein , expire: 0 ko hal karne wala ek profile bhi updateTag ke client riphresh aur cache amanyata ko trigger karta hai; ek nonzero expire (e.g). 'max') in client prabhavon ko trigger karta hai. Route Handler ek khula page ke client cache ko turant refresh kiye bina server-side cache data ko invalid call karta hai.
  • Parameters: revalidateTag(tag: string, profile: string | { expire?: number }): void — tag mamle ke prati sanvedanshil, adhikatam 256 varn hain (ek lamba tag kabhi cached data ko saunpa nahi gaya hai, isliye ise phir se prakashit karna kuchh nahi hai); profile — "max" ki sifarish ki; kisi any cacheLife profile (keval iski expire padha gaya hai) ya ek object expire ke saath sekand mein. tag ko pahli bar saunpa jana chahiye: fetch(url, { next: { tags: ['posts'] } }) ke madhyam se ya cacheTag('posts') ke madhyam se ek 'use cache' function/component. ke andar single-aargmeint form revalidateTag(tag) ko alag kiya jata hai (keval tabhi TS errors ko dabaya jata hai); hataya jaa sakta hai) - do-aargmeint hastakshar ko update karein. kuchh bhi nahi return karta hai.
  • revalidatePath: revalidateTag ke saath Relationship un tag ka upyog karke ALL pages mein vishisht tag ke saath data ko avaidh roop se declare karta hai; revalidatePath vishisht page/layout path ko avaidh roop se declare karta hai. ve vibhinn uddeshyon ki serve karte hain aur unhein ek saath istemal karne ki requirement ho sakti hai.
  • Examples: Server Action — 'use server' action call addPost() to revalidateTag('posts', 'max'). Route Handler - app/api/revalidate/route.ts ne tag ko request.nextUrl.searchParams se padha aur revalidateTag(tag, 'max') ko call kiya, jo { revalidated: true, now: Date.now() } ko return karta hai. jab amanyata Server Action ke bahar aati hai (webhook/another serve ek Route Handler bula rahi hai), updateTag upalabdh nahi hai - turant data samapt karne ke liye { expire: 0 } paas karein: revalidateTag(tag, { expire: 0 }).
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: ne 'max' ke saath default roop se stale-time par declare kiya; { expire: 0 } = bloking rivaait; call khud hi phir valid nahi hai - agla request karta hai; single-required roop deprecated; updateTag tatkal-expiry vikalp hai lekin keval Server Actions mein hai.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai unauthorized. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: unauthorized — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Setup, Where it can be invoked, Good to know, Example — after streaming has started, Examples, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: EXPERIMENTAL (production ke liye recommended nahi; GitHub par pratikriya). unauthorized() ek error throw karta hai jo andhikrit UI ko render karta hai - authentication errors ke liye jab ek request par hastakshar nahi kiya jata hai; unauthorized.js file ke saath UI ko customize karein. yeh ek NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;401 error throw karta hai aur root segment ke rendering ko samapt karta hai jahan ise phenk diya gaya tha. Next.js ne <meta name="robots" content="noindex" /> ko injekt kiya taaki page anukrmit na ho. kyonki yeh throw karne se kaam karta hai, ise render path mein kahte hain - ek component, ya ek component ka wait karta hai. bina await kiye gaye vade mein chhore gaye ek call throw karta hai jahan kuchh bhi ise nahi pakadta hai aur koi andhikrit UI render karta hai.

  • Setup: next.config (experimental: { authInterrupts: true }) mein experimental authInterrupts enable banata hai.
  • Kahan ise radd kiya jaa sakta hai: Server Components, Server Functions, Route Handlers. 'next/navigation' se import kiya gaya:
tsx
  // app/dashboard/page.tsx
  import { verifySession } from '@/app/lib/dal'
  import { unauthorized } from 'next/navigation'
  export default async function DashboardPage() {
    const session = await verifySession()
    if (!session) {
      unauthorized()
    }
    return <main><h1>Welcome to the Dashboard</h1><p>Hi, {session.user.name}.</p></main>
  }
  • Good to know: ko root layout mein nahi bulaya jaa sakta hai. koi return unauthorized() ki zaroorat hai - yeh throw karta hai (TypeScript never), to execution band ho jata hai. call ke chaaron or ek try/catch intercept ko daba data hai - ise rokne ke liye unstable_rethrow ka upyog karta hai. ek unauthorized() ne bina await kiye gaye vade mein chhor diya, jahan kuchh bhi ise nahi pakadta (dev logs ⨯ unhandledRejection: NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;401) - hamesha await us karya ko jo ise bula sakta hai.
  • Example - streaming ke baad shuru hua hai: ne DAL function mein ek dusre ki check ki hai jo data ko load karta hai, jise <Suspense>-wrapped component mein render kiya gaya hai - check boundary ke andar chalta hai isliye shell dharaon ko hal karta hai. jab sign in nahi kiya jata hai, to getAccount ne unauthorized() ko call kiya, exception nikatatam unauthorized boundary ko propagate kiya gaya hai, bhale hi shell pahle se hi bheja gaya ho. route ke saath unauthorized.tsx jorein (e.g). <h1>401 - Unauthorized</h1> + "kripya <link href="/login"> apne khaate ko dekhne ke liye</Link> mein sign in karein. pratikriya <Suspense> boundary se unauthorized() run se pahle streaming shuru hoti hai, isliye yeh apni 200 sthiti rakhta hai aur Next.js ek noindex tag jodta hai. unauthorized() ek 401 lauta hai jab yeh pratikriya shuru hone se pahle chalta hai, jismein render karne ke dauraan (sthiti code dekhein) shamil hai.
  • Examples: ne login UI — unauthorized() ko app/dashboard/page.tsx + mein ek app/unauthorized.tsx ko ek <Login /> component pradan kiya; Server Actions — 'use server' updateProfile ke saath mutation jab kaaryvaahee se pahle koi session nahi hota hai, to unauthorized() ko call karta hai; Route Handlers — app/api/profile/route.ts GET session ko verify karta hai aur unauthorized() ko ek khali 401 pratikriya wapas karne ke liye call karta hai.
  • Version history: v15.1.0 — unauthorized pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: authInterrupts ke pichhe experimental; NEXT_HTTP_ERROR_FALLBACK;401 throw karta hai; kabhi ise wapas nahi return; ise na pakro (ya phir se pheinko); hamesha kolar ka wait karte hain; 401 streaming se pahle, 200 + noindex streaming shuru hone ke baad; root layout mein permission nahi; 401 = sign in nahi (vs forbidden 403 = sign in karein lekin permission nahi).

unstable_cache

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai unstable_cache. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: unstable_cache — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Unsupported operations, Parameters, Returns, Example, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: unstable_cache cache mahnge opreshans (e.g. database queries) ke parinam aur unhein multiple requests par pun: upyog karte hain. adhikansh upyog ke mamlon ke liye, use cache is API ko Next.js 16 mein badal data hai - use cache nirdeshan aur Cache Components ko migrate karta hai. padhna jari rakhein gair-fetch data ke liye unstable_cache ka upyog karna, jo deployment mein bane rahna chahiye: use cache / use cache: remote cache entries NOT ko ek nai deployment par le jati hain kyonki unki cache key mein build ID ya deploymentId shamil hain. yeh requests aur deployment ke parinamon ko banaye rakhne ke liye Next.js ke built-in cache ka upyog karta hai.

jsx
  import { getUser } from './data'
  import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
  const getCachedUser = unstable_cache(async (id) => getUser(id), ['my-app-user'])
  export default async function Component({ userID }) {
    const user = await getCachedUser(userID)
    // ...
  }
  • Unsupported operation: ko passed function aane wale request par nirbhar nahi ho sakta hai - cache skop ke andar headers/cookies tak pahunchna supported nahi hai; cached function ke bahar data parhein aur tark ke roop mein manon ko paas karein (ve cache key ka hissa ban gaye hain). cached function bhi nahi kar sakta: connection() ko call karein (ek aane wale request ki requirement); enable/disable draft mode; cache execution ke dauraan revalidateTag(), updateTag() ya revalidatePath() ko call karein; ya ek function ko call karein jo use cache: private directive ka upyog karta hai. request-nirbhar karya BEFORE ne cached function ko call kiya; mutations/revalidation AFTERWARD ko Server Action ya Route Handler se call kiya. unstable_cache
  • Parameters: unstable_cache(fetchData, keyParts, options)() — fetchData: ek async function ek Promise lautne; keyParts: identity ke liye chaabiyon ki extra array - default roop se tark + string function key banate hain; zyadatar mamlon mein optional, jab unhein parameter ke roop mein passed kiye bina external char (bandee) ka upyog karne ki requirement; options: { tags, revalidate } — tags array niyantran cache amanyata (NOT vishisht roop se function ki identity karne ke liye upyog kiya jata hai); revalidate sekand jiske baad cache rivaaidet karta hai - galti se cache karne ke liye false ko chhor data hai ya revalidateTag()/revalidatePath() se match karne tak use bulaya jata hai.
  • Returns: ek aisa karya hai jo, jab bula liya jata hai, to cached data ko ek Promise ko hal karne mein madad karta hai; yadi cache nahi kiya jata hai, to pradan kiye gaye karya ko radd kar diya jata hai aur iska parinam cached aur lauta diya jata hai.
  • Example:
tsx
  // app/page.tsx
  import { unstable_cache } from 'next/cache'
  export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ userId: string }> }) {
    const { userId } = await params
    const getCachedUser = unstable_cache(
      async () => { return { id: userId } },
      [userId], // add the user ID to the cache key
      { tags: ['users'], revalidate: 60 }
    )
    //...
  }
  • Version history: v14.0.0 — unstable_cache pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: Next.js 16 mein use cache dwara superseded hai lekin gair-frech data ke kros-diploymeint dridhta ke liye rakha gaya hai; cached function ke andar koi request data (cookies/headers bahar parhein, arg ke roop mein passed); tag function ki identity nahi karte hain, keyParts/args do; revalidate: false = anishchita.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/unstable_cache

jsx
  import { unstable_noStore as noStore } from 'next/cache'
  export default async function ServerComponent() {
    noStore()

    // ...
  }
  • Usage: ka upyog jab aap fetch (cache: 'no-store', next: { revalidate: 0 }) ko extra vikalp nahi dena chahte hain ya jab fetch upalabdh nahi hai - noStore() un sabhi mamlon ko replace karta hai.

unstable_rethrow

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai unstable_rethrow. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: unstable_rethrow — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: APIs that rely on throwing and must be rethrown, Good to know, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: UNSTABLE — parivartan ke adhin, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. unstable_rethrow jab aap apne code mein errors ko sambhalte hain to Next.js dwara phenki gai internal errors ko catch se bachata hai. notFound() ne not-found.js ko render karne ke liye ek internal Next.js error ko phenk diya - lekin ek try/catch ke andar, error ko pakda jata hai aur not-found.js kabhi render nahi karta hai. unstable_rethrow ke saath phir se barhne se apekshit behavior bahal ho jata hai:

tsx
  import { notFound, unstable_rethrow } from 'next/navigation'
  export default async function Page() {
    try {
      const post = await fetch('https://.../posts/1').then((res) => {
        if (res.status === 404) notFound()
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.statusText)
        return res.json()
      })
    } catch (err) {
      unstable_rethrow(err)
      console.error(err)
    }
  }
  • API jo throw karne par bharosa karte hain aur ise phir se viksit kiya jana chahiye: notFound(), redirect(), permanentRedirect(). iske alava, yadi kisi route segment ko throw karne ke liye chihnit kiya jata hai jab tak ki yeh static nahi hai, to request samay API ne phenk errors ko call kiya hai jise pakda nahi jana chahiye: cookies, headers, searchParams, fetch(..., { cache: 'no-store' }), fetch(..., { next: { revalidate: 0 } }) (PPR) is behavior ko bhi affected karta hai.
  • Good janne ke liye: ise pakar block ke top par bulata hai, error object ko apne ekmatr tark ke roop mein guzarta hai; iska upyog ek Promise .catch handler mein bhi kiya jaa sakta hai. aap ise API call ko throw karne aur kolar ko exception ko sambhalne ki ijaajat dekar bach sakte hain. keval tabhi iska upyog karein jab pakda exceptions mein BOTH application errors aur phremavark-controlled exceptions (jaise redirect() ya notFound()) shamil ho sakte hain. sansadhan cleanup (intervals/timers ko saaf karna) BEFORE ko unstable_rethrow call ya finally block mein hona chahiye.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: Next.js niyantran flow karyon ko throw karne ke dwara kaam karte hain - ek kanbal try/catch unhein nigalate hain; unstable_rethrow bache hue haich hai, jise pahle catch block mein rakha gaya hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/unstable_rethrow

updateTag

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai updateTag. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: updateTag — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage, Client cache behavior, Parameters, Differences from `revalidateTag`, Example, When to use. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: updateTag ne Server Actions ke bhitar se ek vishisht cache tag ke liye data on-demand ko update kiya. read-your-own-writes paridrishy ke liye design kiya gaya: ek user ek badlav (e.g) banata hai. yeh turant expires tag ke liye cached data - agla request stale content serve karne ke bajaay fresh data lane ka wait karta hai, isliye user turant apne badlav ko dekhte hain.

  • Usage: ONLY ko Server Actions — NOT ke bhitar se Route Handlers, Client Components, ya kisi any sandarbh mein bulaya jaa sakta hai (yeh Route Handler mein daalakar "updateTag ko keval Server Action ke bhitar se bulaya jaa sakta hai). Route Handlers ya any sandarbhon mein invalid tag karne ke liye, revalidateTag ka upyog karein.
  • Client cache behavior: jab ek Server Action ne updateTag ko call kiya, to Next.js vartaman route ko phir se render karta hai aur action ki pratikriya mein update UI bhejta hai, chahe route tag ka upyog karta ho ya nahi. Uncached data phir se prapt kiya jata hai; bina tag ke server-side cache data ka pun: upyog kiya jata hai. client vartaman route ko phir se render karne ke liye action ki pratikriya ka upyog karta hai aur har previous route ko saaf karta hai aur back/forward navigation ke liye rakhe gaye root data - na keval un routes ka upyog karta hai jo tag ka upyog karte hain. yogy view link phir se prefetch kar sakte hain. pages activity ke aadhar par preserve hote hain aur apne React state ko banaye rakhte hain; jab aap unhein wapas navigate karte hain to unka server data taza hota hai. revalidateTag ka ek saman prabhav hota hai jab iski profile expire: 0 ko hal karti hai (ko cover karta hai { expire: 0 }), expire: 0 ke saath ek named profile, aur deprecated single tark prapatr; ek nonzero expire (e.g) ke sath. 'max'), yeh stale ke roop mein data ko tag karta hai aur phir se prastutakarta aur client cache clearing ko chhor data hai (any kols in action, jaise refresh, abhi bhi ek phir prastutakarta ko trigger kar sakta hai). Server Action
  • Parameters: updateTag(tag: string): void — tag kes-sanvedanshil, adhikatam 256 varn hai. tag ko pahli bar saunpa jana chahiye: fetch(url, { next: { tags: ['posts'] } }) ke madhyam se ya cacheTag('posts') ke madhyam se ek 'use cache' function/component. return ke andar kuchh bhi nahi.
  • Differences from revalidateTag: updateTag — Server Actions; agla request fresh data ke liye wait karta hai (koi stale content serve nahi); read-your-own-writes. revalidateTag - Server Actions AND Route Handlers; profile="max" ke saath background mein fresh lane ke dauraan cached data pradan karta hai; custom profile ke saath, kisi bhi cache life profile; profile ke bina, ke barabar legacy vyavhar. updateTag
  • Example:
ts
  // app/actions.ts
  'use server'
  import { updateTag } from 'next/cache'
  import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
  export async function createPost(formData: FormData) {
    const title = formData.get('title')
    const content = formData.get('content')
    const post = await db.post.create({ data: { title, content } })
    updateTag('posts')           // affects any page that displays a list of posts
    updateTag(`post-${post.id}`) // affects the individual post detail page
    redirect(`/posts/${post.id}`) // user will see fresh data, not cached
  }

ek Route Handler mein iske bajaay revalidateTag('posts', 'max') ka upyog kiya jata hai.

  • Kaise to use: updateTag — ek Server Action mein, parhne ke apne-apne likhne ke liye tatkal amanyata ki requirement hai, agle request ko update data dekhna hoga. revalidateTag — root Handler/other non-action sandarbh, stale-time-revalidate semantics, webhook/API cache amanyata ke liye endpoint.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: updateTag = ab + tatkal UI phir prastutakarta samapt ho gaya; revalidateTag('max') = maark stale + SWR; expire: 0 ke saath revalidateTag Server Actions mein updateTag ki tarah behavior karta hai; client cache clearing global (sabhi previous routes) hai, na ki tag-skaipda.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useLinkStatus. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useLinkStatus — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Good to know, You might not need it, Parameters, Example — inline link hint, Gracefully handling fast navigation, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useLinkStatus hook ek <Link> ke pending state ko track karta hai - sukshm, inline feedback (e.g) ke liye, jabki navigation pura karta hai. ek Client Component mein 'next/link' (No 'next/navigation') se aayaatita. loading.js ke saath route star ki fallback ko priority dein aur tatkal transition ke liye prefetch karein. upyogi kab: prefetching disabled hai ya pragti mein (navikaran blocked) ya destination route dynamic hai AND mein koi loading.js file nahi hai jo tatkal navigation ki permission dega.

tsx
  // app/hint.tsx
  'use client'
  import Link from 'next/link'
  import { useLinkStatus } from 'next/link'
  function Hint() {
    const { pending } = useLinkStatus()
    return <span aria-hidden className={`link-hint ${pending ? 'is-pending' : ''}`} />
  }
  export default function Header() {
    return (
      <header>
        <Link href="/dashboard" prefetch={false}>
          <span className="label">Dashboard</span> <Hint />
        </Link>
      </header>
    )
  }
  • Good janne ke liye: ka upyog Link ke vanshaj component ke bhitar kiya jana chahiye; prefetch={false} ke saath sabse upyogi; yadi linkd route prefetch kiya gaya hai, to pending state chhor diya jata hai; tvarit inheritance mein multiple link par click karte samay keval antim link ka pending state dikhaya gaya hai; NOT ne Pages Router mein support kiya - hamesha { pending: false } lauta diya. inline sanketak layout badlav ka karan ban sakte hain - ek nishchit size, hamesha render sanket element aur togal apaaradarshitaa ko pasand karte hain, ya animation ka upyog karte hain.
  • You ko iski requirement nahi ho sakti: yadi destination static hai aur production mein preepheech kiya gaya hai, to pending step ko chhor diya jaa sakta hai; yadi route mein loading.js hai, to route star ki fallback ke saath tatkal transition pahle se hi maujud hai. navigation aamtaur par tej hota hai - jab aap dhimi gati se transition ki identity karte hain to tvarit paich ke roop mein useLinkStatus ka upyog karte hain, phir prefetching ya loading.js phlembaik ke saath root karan ko theek karte hain.
  • Parameters: koi nahi - const { pending } = useLinkStatus(). Returns: ek sanpatti ke saath ek object: pending (boolean) - true history update se pahle, false ke baad.
  • Example - inline link sanket: ek nishchit size ka sanket hai jo layout ko affected nahi karta hai, app/components/loading-indicator.tsx (Client Component) mein, pratyek <Link> ke andar ek menoobaar layout (app/shop/layout.tsx, link Electronics/Clothing/Books) mein pradan kiya gaya.
  • Gracefully tezi se navigation ko sambhalne: fast navigation sanket ko anavashyak roop se flash kar sakta hai - ek initial animation delay (e.g) jorein. 100ms) aur adrishy (opacity: 0): .link-hint nishchit size (0.6em, margin-left 0.25rem, boundary trijyaa 9999px, visibility: hidden reserved sthan ke liye); .link-hint.is-pending — visibility: visible, fadeIn (200ms, 100ms delay, opacity 0.35) + pulse (1s anant, 50% → opacity 0.15) keyframes.
  • Version history: v15.3.0 — useLinkStatus pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: 'next/link' se import; keval <Link> ke vanshaj; yadi prefetched; Pages Router return { pending: false }; loading.js + Prefetch First pasand karte hain; tej navigation par phlaishing se bachne ke liye sanket ~ 100ms mein delay.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Parameters, Examples, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: EXPERIMENTAL (production ke liye recommended nahi). useOffline hook ek bolaan lauta hai ki kya app vartaman mein offline hai - connectivity-eveyar UI ke liye (ek bainar jab user network kho data hai, ya ek offline-eveyar Suspense Fallback). ek Client Component mein 'next/offline' se import kiya gaya. yeh ek badi visheshata ka ek tukda hai: enable experimental.useOffline offline connectivity ka pata lagane aur blocked navigation, prefetch aur Server Action requests ki automatic wapsi par badal jata hai, aur is hook ko expose karta hai taaki Client Components state ko parh sakein. flag ke bina, hook hamesha false. lauta hai

js
  // next.config.js
  module.exports = {
    experimental: {
      useOffline: true,
    },
  }
tsx
  // app/offline-status.tsx
  'use client'
  import { useOffline } from 'next/offline'
  export function OfflineStatus() {
    const isOffline = useOffline()
    return <div>{isOffline ? 'Offline' : 'Online'}</div>
  }
  • Parameters: koi nahi. Returns: boolean — true = app offline hai (ek network request fail ho gaya hai, ya browser ne offline iveint ko fire kiya); false = online, ya server par render karna (yeh bhi hydration pura hone se pahle initial value).
  • Examples: offline bainar - ek Client Component online jab null lauta hai, anyatha <div role="status" className="offline-banner">You are offline. Some content may be unavailable.</div>; ise root layout mein render karta hai taaki yeh har route par dikhai de. Offline-aware Suspense Fallback - app/destination/loading.tsx (Client Component) mein, offline hone par 'Waiting for connection to load this page...' dikhate hain, aur 'Loading...'; jab connectivity bahal ho jati hai, to Next.js blocked request aur automatic roop se dynamic content dharaon ko restore karta hai.
  • Version history: v16.x.0 — useOffline hook shuru kiya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: experimental; experimental.useOffline config flag (always false) ke bina mrit; false bhi pre-hydration/SSR maan hai; blocked navigation/prefetch/Server action requests ki automatic wapsi ke saath jore - useOffline config docs mein "kaise kaam karta hai" dekhein.

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useParams. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useParams — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Parameters, Behavior — Cache Components, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useParams ek Client Component hook ('next/navigation' se) hai jo vartaman URL dwara bhara ek route ke dynamic params ko padhta hai.

tsx
  'use client'
  import { useParams } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function ExampleClientComponent() {
    const params = useParams<{ tag: string; item: string }>()
    // Route -> /shop/[tag]/[item]
    // URL -> /shop/shoes/nike-air-max-97
    // `params` -> { tag: 'shoes', item: 'nike-air-max-97' }
    console.log(params)
    return '...'
  }
  • Parameters: koi nahi. Returns: vartaman route ke bhare dynamic mapdandon ka ek object hai - pratyek sanpatti ek active dynamic segment hai; naam = segment naam, maan = yeh kya bhara hai; maan ek string hai ya segment prakar ke aadhar par string s ki array hai; koi dynamic params → khali object {}; Pages Router mein, initial render karne par null lauta data hai aur ek bar router taiyar hone ke baad update karta hai.

| Route | URL | useParams() |

| app/shop/page.js | /shop | {} |

| app/shop/[slug]/page.js | /shop/1 | { slug: '1' } |

| app/shop/[tag]/[item]/page.js | /shop/1/2 | { tag: '1', item: '2' } |

| app/shop/[...slug]/page.js | /shop/1/2 | { slug: ['1', '2'] } |

  • Behavior - Cache Components: cacheComponents enable ke saath , useParams ko Suspense boundary ki requirement ho sakti hai, yeh nirbhar karta hai ki kya previous ke dauraan param ko hal kiya jaa sakta hai. generateStaticParams ke saath static routes aur routes: har dynamic param build samay par jana jata hai - useParams server par samadhan karta hai, koi Suspense ki zaroorat nahi hai. generateStaticParams dwara cover nahi kiye gaye dynamic param ke saath root: param request samay tak known nahi hai - useParams suspended; ek Suspense boundary mein component (ya ek parent) ko lapeto taaki prerendering ke dauraan iski fallback jari ki jati hai, anyatha build fail rahta hai (dekhein "Next.js ne Suspense ke bahar Client Component mein URL data ka samna kiya" theek options/trade-offs ke liye).
  • Version history: v13.3.0 — useParams pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: Client Component hook; catch-all segments ki wapsi array; Pages Router pahle lauta null; Cache Components ke saath, agyat-built-in param suspended - Suspense mein lapeto ya build fail ho gaya; server-side samtuly params prop (a Promise) hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/use-params
