Asaan bhasha me samjho: usePathname — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Good to know, Parameters, Behavior — Cache Components, Examples, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: usePathname ek Client Component hook ('next/navigation' se) hai jo vartaman URL ke pathname ko padhta hai. yeh janboojhkar ek Client Component ki requirement hai - Client Components ek de-optimization nahi hai, ve Server Components architecture ke abhinn hain. usePathname ka upyog karke ek Client Component ko initial load par HTML mein render kiya gaya hai; navigation par yeh phir se kheencha nahi gaya hai - component ko ek bar (klieint JS bundle) download kiya jata hai aur vartaman sthiti ke aadhar par re-render kiya jata hai.

tsx
  'use client'
  import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function ExampleClientComponent() {
    const pathname = usePathname()
    return <p>Current pathname: {pathname}</p>
  }
  • Good to know: ek Server Component se vartaman URL ko parhne ke liye NOT supported hai - janboojhkar, layout state ko page navigation par preserve karne ka support karne ke liye. yadi page static roop se render kiya gaya hai aur application ne next.config ya Proxy file mein phir se likha hai, to usePathname() hydration dhundh errors ka karan ban sakta hai (initial value server se aata hai aur routing ke baad actual browser pathname se mel nahi khaa sakta hai) - neeche diye gaye shaman udaharan dekhein. Pages Router compatibility: yadi usePathname ka upyog karne wale component Pages Router routes mein import kiye jate hain, to yeh null ko wapas kar sakta hai yadi router abhi tak shuru nahi hua hai (e.g. Fallback route, Automatic Static Optimization); donon app aur pages directories ke saath, Next.js automatic roop se return prakar ko adjusted karta hai.
  • Parameters: koi nahi. Returns: vartaman URL ke path naam ka ek string — / → '/', /dashboard → '/dashboard', /dashboard?v=2 → '/dashboard' (query stripped), /blog/hello-world → '/blog/hello-world'.
  • Behavior - Cache Components: cacheComponents enable ke saath, usePathname ko Suspense boundary ki requirement ho sakti hai. generateStaticParams ke saath static route / route: pratyek segment ko build samay par jana jata hai - previous ke dauraan path naam ka hal, koi Suspense ki zaroorat nahi hai. dynamic param ke saath roots ko generateStaticParams dwara cover nahi kiya gaya hai: request samay tak fallback param agyat - usePathname suspended; ek Suspense boundary mein component (ya parent) ko lapeto, anyatha build fail ho jata hai. yeh tab bhi lagu hota hai jab component usePathname ko bulata hai woh khud static hota hai - e.g. ek sidebar jismein ek layout mein diye gaye active link ke saath iske neeche kisi bhi page par suspended hote hain jismein ek agyat dynamic param hota hai; shesh layout ko render rakhne ke liye Suspense mein usePathname component ko lapeta jata hai.
  • Examples: route parivartan par kuchh karte hain - usePathname + useSearchParams ke saath useEffect(() => { /*... */ }, [pathname, searchParams]). Rewrites ke saath hydration ki kami se bachein - jab koi page /blog/hello ke liye prerender kiya jata hai lekin ek rewrite/Proxy ise ek alag URL par karya karta hai, to browser anurodhit URL aur usePathname() ko client par browser URL ko parhaataa hai, phir se likhne wala destination nahi; pathname-nirbhar bhag ko alag karke kam karein: server par ek static fallback render karein aur ise mount ke baad update karein (difrerd reed actual path naam se pahle ek sankshipt fallback dikhata hai; phlikar-mukt techniques ke liye "hydration se pahle flash ko rokna" dekhein:
tsx
  'use client'
  import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
  import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function PathnameBadge() {
    const pathname = usePathname()
    const [clientPathname, setClientPathname] = useState('')
    useEffect(() => { setClientPathname(pathname) }, [pathname])
    return <p>Current pathname: <span>{clientPathname}</span></p>
  }
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — usePathname pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: Client Component keval - Server Components mein koi usePathname nahi; query string ko return se chheen liya gaya hai; rewrites/Proxy + prerendering → hydration mismaich (mount ke baad parhne ki raksha); Cache Components ke saath, ek agyat dynamic param neeche hook ko suspended kar data hai - Suspense mein lapeta hai; Pages Router router init se pahle null wapas kar sakta hai.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The `metric` object, Web Vitals covered, Sending results to external systems, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useReportWebVitals hook ki report Core Web Vitals aur kisi bhi analytics serve ke saath istemal kiya jaa sakta hai. ek Client Component mein 'next/web-vitals' se import kiya gaya. hook ko passed naye karyon ko us point tak upalabdh maitriks ke saath bulaya jata hai - dupliket data riporting ko rokne ke liye, callback function sandarbh ko static rakhein (yeh pratyek render par phir se built-in nahi hai).

jsx
  // app/_components/web-vitals.js
  'use client'
  import { useReportWebVitals } from 'next/web-vitals'
  const logWebVitals = (metric) => {
    console.log(metric)
  }
  export function WebVitals() {
    useReportWebVitals(logWebVitals)
    return null
  }

<WebVitals /> ko mool layout mein import karein (ek alag 'use client' file mein, 'use client' kisi bhi import se pahle top par) client boundary ko is module aur iske import tak simit rakhne ke liye.

  • metric object: id (current page load ke context me metric ke liye unique identifier); name (metric name — TTFB, FCP, LCP, INP, CLS); delta (current aur previous value ke beech ka fark, aam taur par ms); entries (detailed info ke saath Performance Entries ki array); navigationType (PerformanceNavigationTiming.type se — "navigate", "reload", "prerender", "back-forward" ("back_forward" se normalized), "back-forward-cache" (BFCache restore), "restore" (discard ke baad restore), "soft-navigation"); navigationId (mape gaye navigation ka ID); navigationURL (navigation se juda URL — soft navigations ke liye useful kyunki ek metric URL ke phir badalne ke baad report ho sakta hai); navigationStartTime; navigationInteractionId (soft navigations ke liye, use trigger karne wali interaction ka ID); rating ("good", "needs-improvement", "poor", predefined thresholds ke against); value (actual value/duration, aam taur par ms).
  • Web Vitals cover karte hain: TTFB (Time to First Byte), FCP (First Contentful Paint), LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift), INP (Interaction to Next Paint). Results ko ek switch me metric.name ke through handle karo:
tsx
  type ReportWebVitalsCallback = Parameters<typeof useReportWebVitals>[0]
  const handleWebVitals: ReportWebVitalsCallback = (metric) => {
    switch (metric.name) {
      case 'FCP': { /* handle FCP results */ }
      case 'LCP': { /* handle LCP results */ }
      // ...
    }
  }
  • Results external systems ko bhejna: real-user monitoring ke liye metrics kisi bhi endpoint ko bhejo — available ho to navigator.sendBeacon(url, JSON.stringify(metric)) use karo, warna fetch(url, { body, method: 'POST', keepalive: true }). Google Analytics ke saath, window.gtag('event', metric.name, { value: Math.round(metric.name === 'CLS' ? metric.value * 1000 : metric.value), event_label: metric.id, non_interaction: true }) use karo — values integers honi chahiye; id tumhe metric distributions manually banane deta hai (percentiles aadi).
  • Dhyaan do / interview point: 'next/web-vitals' se import karo ('next/navigation' se NAHI); callback reference stable rakho warna metrics do baar report hote hain; ise root layout me ek chhote 'use client' component me rakho; LCP/CLS/INP Core Web Vitals hain, TTFB/FCP additional vitals hain; navigationType me soft-navigation aur BFCache cases shamil hain.

useRouter

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useRouter. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useRouter — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Methods, Good to know, Migrating from `next/router`, Examples, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useRouter hook programmatic roop se Client Components ('next/navigation' se) ke andar routes ko badalta hai. sifarish: navigation ke liye <Link> component ka upyog karein jab tak ki aapke paas useRouter ke liye ek vishisht requirement na ho.

tsx
  'use client'
  import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function Page() {
    const router = useRouter()
    return <button type="button" onClick={() => router.push('/dashboard')}>Dashboard</button>
  }
  • Methods:
  • router.push(href, { scroll, transitionTypes }) — client side navigation ke liye route; browser ke history stack mein ek naya access jodta hai. optional transitionTypes ko navigation transition ke andar React.addTransitionType ko passed kiya jata hai.
  • router.replace(href, { scroll, transitionTypes }) — saman, lekin WITHOUT ek naya history entry jorte hain.
  • router.refresh() — vartaman route ko taza karta hai: server ke liye naye request, data requests ko phir se taiyar karta hai, phir se render karta hai Server Components. client bina kisi client ke paksh React (e.g) ko khone ke bina update RSC payload ko marj karta hai. useState) ya browser state (e.g). vartaman route ke liye Client Cache ko saaf karta hai, lekin NOT server-side cache ko invalid karta hai - iske liye revalidatePath/revalidateTag ka upyog karta hai.
  • router.prefetch(href, options?: { onInvalidate?: () => void }) - tezi se transition ke liye route ko rokta hai; onInvalidate ko tab bulaya jata hai jab prefetched data stale ban jata hai (adhikansh prefetch request ke anusar - jab update route data ke liye ek naya prefetch trigger hota hai).
  • router.back() - history mein previous route par vaapasa. router.forward() - agle page ke liye aage. back()/forward() do NOT trigger view transition enimeshana.
  • router.bfcacheId — opaque string pahchankarta vartaman route segment ke dayre mein aaya; jab aaspas ke segment ko ek push/replace navigation dwara fresh roop se banaya jata hai tab badal jata hai, aur back/forward navigation, router.refresh() aur khoj-param- ya hash-only navigation ke liye saman rahta hai.
  • Good to know: NEVER untrusted/unsanitized URL ko router.push/router.replace — XSS jokhim (e.g) ko bhejta hai. javascript: URL ko page sandarbh mein executed kiya jayega. <Link> automatic roop se routes ko taiyar karta hai kyonki ve viewport mein dikhai dete hain. yadi requests ko cache kiya jata hai to refresh() usi parinam ko pun: generated kar sakta hai; any request samay API jaise cookies/headers bhi pratikriya ko badal sakta hai.
  • Migrating from next/router: import useRouter se next/navigation, nahi next/router; pathname hata → usePathname() ka upyog karein; query hata → useSearchParams() ka upyog karein; router.events badal gaya (neeche dekhein).
  • Examples: router iveints - App Router mein koi router.events nahi; usePathname + useSearchParams ko useEffect (log ${pathname}?${searchParams}) mein compiled karke page parivartan ko sunne ke liye, <Suspense fallback={null}> mein lapete gaye ek layout mein import kiya kyonki useSearchParams() client ke paksh ko previous ke dauraan nikatatam Suspense boundary tak render karne ka karan banta hai. scroll ko top par alag karna - Next.js default roop se navigation par top par scroll karta hai; { scroll: false } ko router.push()/router.replace() mein paas karta hai. bfcacheId - ise back/forward par bahal karte samay fresh navigation par state sanrakshan se bahar nikalane ke liye React key ke roop mein passed karein:
tsx
  const { bfcacheId } = useRouter()
  return <form key={bfcacheId}>{/* ... */}</form>

cacheComponents ke saath, App Router React <Activity> ke madhyam se navigation par Client Component state ko surakshit rakhta hai; bfcacheId par keering ise pratyek fresh navigation par reset karti hai jabki ise back/forward. Prefer reeseting state ko spasht roop se ek iveint handler (e.g) mein preserve karti hai. onSubmit) ya apne data (e.g. server se ek draft ID); keval ek antim risort (e.g) ke roop mein bfcacheId ka upyog karein.

  • Version history: v13.0.0 — next/navigation se useRouter ki shuruaat hui; v15.4.0 — optional onInvalidate callback router.prefetch ke liye.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: <Link> pahle; push banam replace = history entry; refresh() keval client cache ko saaf karta hai, server cache nahi; kabhi bhi unsanitized URL (XSS); koi router.events — usePathname + useSearchParams rachna; bfcacheId ek key ke roop mein ek antim-resort state reset hai.

useSearchParams

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useSearchParams. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useSearchParams — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Parameters, Good to know, Behavior — Prerendering, Behavior — Dynamic Rendering, Server Components — Pages vs Layouts, Example — updating `searchParams`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useSearchParams ek Client Component hook ('next/navigation' se) hai jo vartaman URL ke query string ko padhta hai. yeh ek read-only URLSearchParams objekt return karta hai.

tsx
  // app/dashboard/search-bar.tsx
  'use client'
  import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function SearchBar() {
    const searchParams = useSearchParams()
    const search = searchParams.get('search')
    // URL -> `/dashboard?search=my-project`
    // `search` -> 'my-project'
    return <>Search: {search}</>
  }
  • Parameters: koi nahi. Returns: read-only URLSearchParams read-only tarikon ke saath: get() (first value — /dashboard?a=1 → '1', /dashboard?a= → '', /dashboard?b=3 → null, /dashboard?a=1&a=2 → '1', getAll() ka upyog sabhi values ke liye), has() (/dashboard?a=1 → true, /dashboard?b=3 → false), plus getAll(), keys(), values(), entries(), forEach(), toString().
  • Good janne ke liye: Client Component hook keval - NOT ne Server Components mein support kiya ( partial rendering ke dauraan stale values ko rokne ke liye). khoj param ke aadhar par ek Server Component mein data prapt karne ke liye, page ke searchParams prop ko parhein aur props dwara ise paas karein. yadi app mein /pages daairektree shamil hai, to ReadonlyURLSearchParams | null (migration compatibility ke liye zero) ko lauta data hai, kyonki sarch param ko kisi page ke prerendering ke dauraan nahi jana jaa sakta hai jo getServerSideProps ka upyog nahi karta hai).
  • Behavior - Prerendering: yadi ek route prarit hai, to useSearchParams ne Client Component tree ko nikatatam Suspense boundary tak client-side render kiya - route prareindron ka hissa jabki useSearchParams ka upyog karne wala dynamic hissa client-side pradan karta hai. With Cache Components, boundary client-side hai, jab baki route pahle se render kiya jata hai; yadi route par koi component request data (e.g) padhta hai. cookies(), Next.js actual khoj maanadandon ke saath request samay par server par boundary pradan karta hai. ek component ko rakhne ke liye jo browser-keval API (e.g) ko padhta hai. sessionStorage) server render se bahar, useSearchParams boundary par bharosa karne ke bajaay use(browser()) ka upyog karein. <Suspense> mein component ko lapeto, isliye iske upar ke components ko prerender kiya jaa sakta hai aur initial HTML ke roop mein bheja jaa sakta hai. dev mein, root on-demand pradan karte hain taaki useSearchParams ko suspended nahi kiya jata hai aur cheezein Suspense ke bina kaam karne ke liye dikhai de sakti hain; production build mein, useSearchParams ka upyog karke ek static page ek Suspense boundary ke bina build fail ho jata hai "useSearchParams ke saath Suspense boundary ko nasht kar data hai". yadi route ko dynamic roop se render kiya jana chahiye, to ek Server Component mein connection() ko ek aane wale request ke liye wait karne ke liye pasand karein (prerendering se neeche sab kuchh chhorakar); pahle export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' ka upyog kiya gaya tha - iske bajaay connection() pasand karte hain.
  • Behavior — Dynamic Rendering: yadi route dynamic roop se render kiya gaya hai, to useSearchParams ko Client Component ke initial server render ke dauraan server par upalabdh hai (initial render ke dauraan aur baad mein navigation par client par server par kho diya gaya). E.g. ek page jo 'next/server' se await connection() hai, tab seedhe <SearchBar /> ko render karta hai, koi Suspense ki zaroorat nahi hai.
  • Server Components — page banam layout: page (Server Components) searchParams prop ka upyog karte hain. layout kya NOT ko searchParams prop prapt hota hai - navigation ke dauraan ek sajha layout ko phir se render nahi kiya jata hai, jisse navigation ke beech stale searchParams ho sakta hai. iske bajaay ek Client Component mein page searchParams prop ya useSearchParams hook ka upyog karein ( latest searchParams ke saath client par re-render). aap page searchParams prop ko seedhe Client Component mein bhi paas kar sakte hain aur ise React ke use() ke saath kholna - yeh suspended kar data hai, isliye Suspense boundary mein lapeta hai.
  • Example — update searchParams: naya searchParams set karne ke liye useRouter ya <Link> ka upyog karta hai; navigation ke baad, vartaman page.js ko ek update searchParams prop prapt hota hai:
tsx
  'use client'
  export default function ExampleClientComponent() {
    const router = useRouter()
    const pathname = usePathname()
    const searchParams = useSearchParams()
    const createQueryString = useCallback(
      (name: string, value: string) => {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString())
        params.set(name, value)
        return params.toString()
      },
      [searchParams]
    )
    return (
      <>
        <p>Sort By</p>
        <button onClick={() => { router.push(pathname + '?' + createQueryString('sort', 'asc')) }}>ASC</button>
        <Link href={pathname + '?' + createQueryString('sort', 'desc')}>DESC</Link>
      </>
    )
  }
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — useSearchParams pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: keval parhne ke liye - values ko badalane ke liye ek NEW URLSearchParams ka build; hamesha <Suspense> mein lapeto (production build iske bina fail rahta hai); kabhi Server Components mein upyog nahi kiya jata hai (page searchParams prop ka upyog karein); layout NO searchParams prop (advertisement par phir se render nahi kiya gaya); lapta-saspeins error ko chhipata hai.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useSelectedLayoutSegment — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Good to know, Parameters, Returns, Behavior — Cache Components, Example — active link component, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useSelectedLayoutSegment ek Client Component hook ('next/navigation' se) hai jo active route segment one star ko se neeche padhta hai. navigation UI ke liye upyogi - parent ke layout ke andar tab jo active baal segment ke aadhar par style ko badalta hai.

tsx
  'use client'
  import { useSelectedLayoutSegment } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function ExampleClientComponent() {
    const segment = useSelectedLayoutSegment()
    return <p>Active segment: {segment}</p>
  }
  • Good to know: layout default roop se Server Components hain, isliye is hook ko aamtaur par ek Client Component ke madhyam se ek layout mein import kiya jata hai. yeh keval ONE star ko neeche lauta data hai - ALL active segment ke liye, useSelectedLayoutSegments dekhein. catch-all routes ke liye, match kiye gaye segments ko ek singal jvaaint string - e.g ke roop mein wapas kiya jata hai. app/blog/[...slug]/page.js ko /blog/a/b/c mein app/blog/layout.js se bulaya jata hai, 'a/b/c' ko return karta hai.
  • Parameters: optional parallelRouteKey — us parallel roots slot ke bhitar active segment padhta hai: useSelectedLayoutSegment(parallelRouteKey?: string).
  • Returns: active segment ka ek string, ya null yadi koi maujud nahi hai:

| Layout | Visited URL | Returned Segment |

| app/layout.js | / | null |

| app/layout.js | /dashboard | 'dashboard' |

| app/dashboard/layout.js | /dashboard | null |

| app/dashboard/layout.js | /dashboard/settings | 'settings' |

| app/dashboard/layout.js | /dashboard/analytics | 'analytics' |

| app/dashboard/layout.js | /dashboard/analytics/monthly | 'analytics' (keval ek star neeche) |

| app/blog/layout.js | /blog/a/b/c (catch-all) | 'a/b/c' |

  • BHavior — Cache Components: cacheComponents enable ke saath, yeh ek Suspense boundary ki requirement ho sakti hai. generateStaticParams ke saath static route / route: build samay par known pratyek segment - server par hal karta hai, koi Suspense ki zaroorat nahi hai. dynamic param ke saath roots ko generateStaticParams dwara cover nahi kiya gaya hai: request samay tak agyat wapsi - hook suspended; ek Suspense boundary mein component (ya parent) ko lapeto, anyatha build fail ho jata hai. yeh tab bhi lagu hota hai jab calling component khud static hota hai - e.g. parent ke layout mein ek tab bar iske neeche kisi bhi page par ek agyat dynamic param ke saath suspended ho jata hai; shesh layout ko poorvjit rakhne ke liye Suspense mein hook calling component ko lapetein.
  • Example - active link component: ek Client Component BlogNavLink app/blog/blog-nav-link.tsx mein apne slug prop ki tulna useSelectedLayoutSegment() (isActive = slug === segment) ke saath karta hai aur active link (style={{ fontWeight: isActive? 'bold': 'normal' }}) ko bold karta hai; yeh blog layout (app/blog/layout.tsx, ek Server Component) mein import kiya gaya hai jo nakshe mein BlogNavLink item ke liye post chitrit kiye gaye hain. /blog/hello-world ko navigate karna segment ke liye 'hello-world' return data hai.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — useSelectedLayoutSegment pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: keval ek star neeche (single); null jab layout ke apne star par; catch-all / ke saath jur jata hai; Client Component ko (server) layout ke andar ek Client Component ki requirement hoti hai; Cache Components ke saath, neeche ek agyat dynamic param ise suspended kar data hai - Suspense mein lapeta hai.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Good to know, Parameters, Returns, Behavior — Cache Components, Version history, Gotchas / interview points. Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useSelectedLayoutSegments ek Client Component hook hai ('next/navigation' se) jo active route segments ko padhta hai below ko layout se bulaya jata hai (unmein se sabhi). parent layout mein UI ke liye upyogi, jinhein active baal segments, jaise ki bredakranbs ke gyaan ki requirement hoti hai.

tsx
  'use client'
  import { useSelectedLayoutSegments } from 'next/navigation'
  export default function ExampleClientComponent() {
    const segments = useSelectedLayoutSegments()
    return (
      <ul>
        {segments.map((segment, index) => (
          <li key={index}>{segment}</li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    )
  }
  • Good to know: layout default roop se Server Components hain, isliye hook ko aamtaur par ek Client Component ke madhyam se ek layout mein import kiya jata hai. laute segment INCLUDE Route Groups - unhein .filter() ke saath bracket se shuru hone wali cheezon par filter karo yadi aap unhein UI mein nahi chahte hain. catch-all routes ke liye, match kiye gaye segments ko array ke bhitar ek jur string ke roop mein wapas kar diya jata hai - e.g. app/blog/[...slug]/page.js ko /blog/a/b/c mein app/layout.js se bulaya gaya, ['blog', 'a/b/c'], NOT ['blog', 'a', 'b', 'c'] lauta.
  • Parameters: optional parallelRouteKey — us parallel root slot ke bhitar active segments ko padhta hai.
  • Returns: active segments ke taaron ki ek array calling layout se neeche ek star — ya ek khali array yadi koi maujud nahi hai:

| Layout | Visited URL | Returned Segments |

| app/layout.js | / | [] |

| app/layout.js | /dashboard | ['dashboard'] |

| app/layout.js | /dashboard/settings | ['dashboard', 'settings'] |

| app/dashboard/layout.js | /dashboard | [] |

| app/dashboard/layout.js | /dashboard/settings | ['settings'] |

| app/layout.js | /blog/a/b/c (catch-all) | ['blog', 'a/b/c'] |

| app/blog/layout.js | /blog/a/b/c (catch-all) | ['a/b/c'] |

  • BHavior — Cache Components: cacheComponents enable ke saath, yeh ek Suspense boundary ki requirement ho sakti hai. generateStaticParams ke saath static route / route: build samay par known sabhi segment - server par hal karta hai, koi Suspense ki zaroorat nahi hai. dynamic param ke saath roots ko generateStaticParams dwara cover nahi kiya gaya hai: request samay tak fallback param agyat - hook suspended; ek Suspense boundary mein lapeto, anyatha build fail ho jata hai. yahan tak ki jab calling component static hota hai, to bhi lagu hota hai - e.g. parent ke layout mein ek bredakranb kisi agyat dynamic param ke saath neeche kisi bhi page par suspended ho jata hai; shesh layout ko poorvjit rakhne ke liye ise Suspense mein lapeto.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 — useSelectedLayoutSegments pesh kiya gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: bahuvachan = layout ke neeche full path (breadcrumb upyog ka mamla); root group leak in - filtar (-preephaaid item; catch-all ek string mein shamil ho jata hai; ek hi Suspense niyam ekmatr hook ke roop mein.

useServerInsertedHTML

App RouterAPI Reference

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useServerInsertedHTML. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useServerInsertedHTML — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Parameters, Behavior — the callback runs once per flush, Prefer other options for inline scripts, Gotchas / interview points. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useServerInsertedHTML hook ek Client Component injekshan markup ko HTML dastavez Next.js generated karta hai, kahin bhi per mein. keval App Router - keval Pages Router mein kuchh bhi nahi hai. aapke dwara badle gaye nods ko aapke page se alag se render kiya jata hai aur HTML mein sammilit kiya jata hai kyonki Next.js ise generated karta hai. yeh CSS-in-JS style registries ke liye maujud hai, jo ek render ke dauraan utpaadit niymon ko ikattha karta hai aur unhein markup se aage dastavez mein phlash karta hai jo unka upyog karta hai.

tsx
  // app/registry.tsx
  'use client'
  import { useState } from 'react'
  import { useServerInsertedHTML } from 'next/navigation'
  import { StyleRegistry, createStyleRegistry } from 'styled-jsx'
  export default function StyledJsxRegistry({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    const [registry] = useState(() => createStyleRegistry())
    useServerInsertedHTML(() => {
      const styles = registry.styles()
      registry.flush()
      return <>{styles}</>
    })
    return <StyleRegistry registry={registry}>{children}</StyleRegistry>
  }

full setup (style wale components sahit) ke liye CSS-in-JS guide dekhein.

  • Parameters: useServerInsertedHTML(callback: () => React.ReactNode) — callback generated HTML document me insert karne ke liye nodes return karta hai. Returns: kuch nahi.
  • Behavior — callback har flush par ek baar chalta hai: Next.js document ko chunks me flush karta hai jaise tree suspend aur resolve hota hai, aur har registered callback HAR flush par chalta hai, har render par ek baar nahi — ek single component ka callback kai baar bulaya ja sakta hai, isliye use side effects se free rakho. Callback tab chalta hai jab bhi Next.js ek HTML document generate karta hai, direct navigation par aur kisi bhi prerender ke dauraan. <head> bheje jane se pehle insert ki gayi content <head> me jati hai; baad me insert ki gayi <body> me — jaise Header (head band hone se pehle render hota hai) → uske CSS rules <head> me jate hain; <Suspense> ke andar Feed (head band hone ke baad resolve hota hai) → uske CSS rules <body> me jate hain. (Maan lo Header ke upar kuch suspend nahi karta — agar karta hai, to Header head band hone ke baad render hoga aur uske rules bhi <body> me jayenge.) Style registry pattern me, styled-jsx tree ke render hone par CSS rules collect karta hai; har flush par callback ab tak collect hue rules return karta hai aur registry clear kar deta hai, isliye agla flush sirf wahi le jata hai jo naya hai. Har baar wahi nodes return karo aur document har flush ki ek copy ke saath khatm hoga. Style registries kaam karti hain kyunki ek <style> tag poore document par lagu hota hai chahe wo kahin bhi khatm ho. Client navigation par hook kuch nahi karta — CSS-in-JS library browser me khud rules inject karti hai.
  • Inline scripts ke liye dusre options prefer karo: React Server Components me inline scripts declare karna prefer karo ('Preventing a flash before hydration' dekho). Hook un nodes ke liye hai jo render ho rahe tree ko support karte hain, jaise <style> tags jo ek CSS-in-JS registry collect karti hai. Ek script <head> me sirf tab shamil hoti hai jab uske upar kuch suspend na hua ho — tree me ek badlav use bina error ke <body> me le ja sakta hai. Agar hook ko script ke liye use karte ho, to callback ko ek useRef flag se guard karo taaki script ek baar insert ho, har flush par nahi. Na hook se return ki gayi script aur na JSX me likhi inline script client navigation par chalti hai — dono sirf unstyled content ki flash rokne ya dusre one-time side effects ke liye sahi hain. React JSX me likhi script ke liye dedicated warning deta hai, jabki hook use chupchaap chhod deta hai. Next.js tumhare return kiye nodes me nonce add NAHI karta — ek script-src policy ke tahat jise nonce chahiye, browser use block kar dega.
  • Dhyaan do / interview point: sirf App Router; callback har flush par chalta hai (side-effect-free rakho, har baar registry flush karo); head vs body placement is par nirbhar hai ki content kab render hota hai (Suspense boundaries use move karti hain); client navigation par koi effect nahi; scripts ke liye use mat karo — RSC inline scripts prefer karo; koi nonce add nahi hota (CSP use block kar sakta hai).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/functions/use-server-inserted-html

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Returned object properties, Gotchas / interview points, Pages read: 93 of 93 — slice COMPLETE., Pages read in this continuation session: 19, Pages still unread: 0., Note. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: userAgent helper extra gun aur request se user agent object ke saath negotiation karne ke tarike ke saath Web Request API ka vistar karta hai. 'next/server' se import kiya gaya; aam taur par proxy.ts (ya Route Handlers) mein NextRequest ke saath prayog kiya jata hai.

ts
  // proxy.ts
  import { NextRequest, NextResponse, userAgent } from 'next/server'
  export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
    const url = request.nextUrl
    const { device } = userAgent(request)
    // device.type can be: 'mobile', 'tablet', 'console', 'smarttv',
    // 'wearable', 'embedded', or undefined (for desktop browsers)
    const viewport = device.type || 'desktop'
    url.searchParams.set('viewport', viewport)
    return NextResponse.rewrite(url)
  }
  • Returned objekt gun:
  • isBot — boolean, chahe request ek known bot se aata hai.
  • browser - { name, version } (strings, ya undefined yadi identity yogy nahi hai).
  • device — { model, type, vendor } — type console, mobile, tablet, smarttv, wearable, embedded, ya undefined (desktop browser) mein se ek hai.
  • engine — { name, version } — injan naam values mein Amaya, Blink, EdgeHTML, Flow, Gecko, Goanna, iCab, KHTML, Links, Lynx, NetFront, NetSurf, Presto, Tasman, Trident, w3m, WebKit, ya undefined shamil hain.
  • os - { name, version } (strings, ya undefined).
  • cpu — { architecture } — values mein 68k, amd64, arm, arm64, armhf, avr, ia32, ia64, irix, irix64, mips, mips64, pa-risc, ppc, sparc, sparc64, ya undefined shamil hain.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview point: server-side keval (NextRequest) leta hai; vishisht upyog proxy.ts mein ek viewport param ke saath phir se likhne ke liye device-prakar ka pata lagana hai; device.type desktop ke liye undefined hai; isBot known bots ka pata lagata hai; field wapas undefined tak gir jata hai jab identity yogy nahi - hamesha nishchit roop se kodit hota hai.

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai next.config.js (index of all options). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: next.config.js (index of all options) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Basic shape (verbatim), ESM variant — `next.config.mjs`, Gotcha, Configuration as a function, Async configuration (since 12.1.0), Phase. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Next.js ko ek default export ke saath project root (package.json ke bagal mein) mein next.config.js file ke madhyam se configure kiya gaya hai. yeh ek niymit Node.js module hai, NOT ek JSON file hai. iska upyog Next.js server aur build steps dwara kiya jata hai aur yeh not browser build mein shamil hai.

  • Basic shape (verbatim):
js
// @ts-check

/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  /* config options here */
}

module.exports = nextConfig

// @ts-check + @type {import('next').NextConfig} JSDoc plain JS mein autocomplete/type-checking data hai.

  • ESM version — next.config.mjs:
js
// @ts-check

/**
 * @type {import('next').NextConfig}
 */
const nextConfig = {
  /* config options here */
}

export default nextConfig
  • Dhyaan do: .cjs / .cts extensions next.config ke liye supported NAHI hain.
  • Ek function ke roop me configuration: config ek function ke roop me receive ho sakta hai (phase, { defaultConfig }):
js
// @ts-check

export default (phase, { defaultConfig }) => {
  /**
   * @type {import('next').NextConfig}
   */
  const nextConfig = {
    /* config options here */
  }
  return nextConfig
}
  • Async config (12.1.0 ke baad se): module.exports = async (phase, { defaultConfig }) => { … return nextConfig } — jaise return karne se pehle remote config fetch karne ke liye useful.
  • Phase: phase current context hai jisme config load hota hai. Phases ko next/constants se import kiya ja sakta hai, jaise PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER:
js
// @ts-check

const { PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER } = require('next/constants')

module.exports = (phase, { defaultConfig }) => {
  if (phase === PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER) {
    return {
      /* development only config options here */
    }
  }

  return {
    /* config options for all phases except development here */
  }
}
  • TypeScript version — next.config.ts:
ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  /* config options here */
}

export default nextConfig
  • Dhyaan do: naye JS features se bacho jo tumhare target Node.js version me available nahi hain — next.config.js Webpack ya Babel dwara parse NAHI hota, isliye ye Node par as-is chalta hai.
  • Koi option required nahi hai: koi bhi config required nahi hai; jo feature chahiye use dekho. Allowed keys Next.js repo me packages/next/src/server/config-shared.ts me defined hain.
  • Unit testing config (experimental, 15.1 ke baad se): next/experimental/testing/server unstable_getResponseFromNextConfig export karta hai, jo provided request info ke saath next.config.js se headers, redirects, aur rewrites functions chalata hai aur ek NextResponse return karta hai — isliye routing configuration unit-test ho sakta hai:
js
import {
  getRedirectUrl,
  unstable_getResponseFromNextConfig,
} from 'next/experimental/testing/server'

const response = await unstable_getResponseFromNextConfig({
  url: 'https://nextjs.org/test',
  nextConfig: {
    async redirects() {
      return [{ source: '/test', destination: '/test2', permanent: false }]
    },
  },
})

expect(response.status).toEqual(307)
expect(getRedirectUrl(response)).toEqual('https://nextjs.org/test2')

Limitation: pratikriya keval next.config.js field par vichar karti hai - yeh not proxy ya file system routes par vichar karta hai, isliye production behavior ikai testing se bhinn ho sakta hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: AI coding agent dwara taiyar Next.js issues riporton ke liye ek samiksha flow enable banata hai. experimental.agentFeedback controlled karta hai ki kya next dev creates/updates directive jo pata chala AI coding agent ko insaan ki samiksha ke liye Next.js jari report taiyar karte hain.

  • Status: experimental, badal sakta hai, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    agentFeedback: true,
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • Ye kaise kaam karta hai, step by step: (1) Jab enabled ho aur next dev ek AI coding agent detect karta hai, Next.js AGENTS.md me <!-- BEGIN:nextjs-agent-feedback --> aur <!-- END:nextjs-agent-feedback --> ke beech ek managed block banata/update karta hai. Next.js sirf markers ke beech ki content update karta hai aur baaki file preserve rakhta hai. (2) Current user request ke dauraan, agent anonymized facts ko meaningful/recurring Next.js issues ke liye feedback candidates ke roop me rakhta hai: crashes, hangs, OOM, unexpected slowness; galat behaviour/output/errors/diagnostics; missing, unclear ya conflicting documentation; unexpected CLI/codemod/Skill/upgrade behavior aur non-obvious workarounds. Routine debugging feedback NAHI hai. Agent ko retain karne se pehle changes verify karne chahiye, aur kabhi code, logs, paths, URLs, secrets, personal info ya project-specific data retain nahi karna chahiye. (3) Final response se pehle, agent ek reporting pass chalata hai (npx --no-install next internal agent-feedback-instructions ek baar, file ki directory se, output ko pipe/truncate kiye bina) aur har distinct qualifying issue ko ek alag report draft ke roop me taiyaar karta hai (generic setup, repro steps, observed facts, expected result, optional control/workaround). (4) Agent har draft ko default browser me ek alag review form me ek baar kholne ki koshish karta hai. User details edit kar sakta hai, bina bheje band kar sakta hai, ya Send feedback choose kar sakta hai. Sirf form khulne se kuch nahi bheja jata. Kholne se pehle, agent report ko anonymize karta hai (generic descriptions; source code, logs, paths, URLs, secrets, personal info hata kar). Submit karne par reviewed content + agent ka naam + Next.js version bheja jata hai; ye automatically project files ya machine metadata attach NAHI karta.
  • Disable karna: experimental.agentFeedback: false set karo ya option hata do; agla next dev run managed block hata deta hai (agar AGENTS.md me sirf wahi block tha to poori file delete ho jati hai). Telemetry disable karne se bhi block hat jata hai; telemetry disabled hone par feedback command koi reporting instructions return nahi karta.
  • Dhyaan do: agentFeedback aur top-level agentRules independently kaam karte hain — ek ko badalna dusre ko affect nahi karta. Jab dono enabled hon, Next.js AGENTS.md me dono managed blocks rakhta hai.
  • Version history: v16.4.0 me joda gaya.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh Next.js 16 ka AI-agent ergonomiks hai: dhancha directive likhta hai for agent ko devalapar ke hath se likhne ke bajaay AGENTS.md mein likha gaya hai, aur kuchh bhi bhejne se pahle feedback insaan samiksha ki jati hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: next upgrade --agent ke liye default niti ka chayan karein aur next dev aur next build ke dauraan upgrade reminders ko controlled karein.

  • Default: 'security'.
  • Values: false = disabled upgrade reminder; 'security' (default) = security salaahkaaron ke liye static organizations ki check karta hai aur jab koi upalabdh ho to surakshit upgrade ki sifarish karta hai; 'latest' = app ke vartaman static ya canary chainal par ek naye pramukh ya mamuli release ki sifarish karta hai; 'experimental-future' = latest niti + lagu Future Defaults ki bhi sifarish karta hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    agentUpgrade: 'latest',
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • Key Point: vikalp not ko automatic roop se app ko upgrade karta hai. yeh keval reminders aur policy ko controlled karta hai jab next upgrade --agent value ke bina chala jata hai.
  • Reminder behavior: ek interactive tarminal mein, next dev/next build ke dauraan ek yogy reminder pradan karta hai: Upgrade now (vartaman order band ho jata hai, configure ki gai niti ke saath next upgrade --agent shuru hota hai), Skip (chalti hui command ki or lauta hai, baphar output ko phir se chala jata hai), agle sanskaran tak Skip (installed sanskaran + niti ke liye barkhaastgee bachata hai). jab aap tay karte hain to command prompt aur baphar output ke pichhe jari rahta hai. yadi aap 10 sekand ke bhitar chayan nahi karte hain, ya baphar output previous ~ 10 MiB badhta hai, to reminder automatic roop se chhor data hai. jab ek coding agent next dev / next build chalata hai, to pahla paatr reminder upgrade ki report karne ke nirdeshon ke saath command ko band kar data hai; usi command ko turant phir prapt karne se mool karya ek warning ke saath jari rahta hai. Reminders experimental.agentUpgrade support karne ke liye installed Next.js sanskaran ki requirement hoti hai - vartaman canary upgrade chal raha hai CLI ek purani installation ke liye reminder nahi jodta hai. next dev ke dauraan, DevTools ek Vulnerability Insight bhi dikha sakta hai jab installed sanskaran ek known security vulnerability se affected hota hai, ek coding agent ke saath security upgrade shuru karne ke liye ek copy karne yogy sanket ke sath.
  • Status: experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. joda gaya v16.4.0.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
security banam latest — default janboojhkar roorhivaadee (keval security advisor) hai, isliye teams ko pramukh upgrade mein shamil nahi kiya gaya hai.

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai allowedDevOrigins. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), Matching rules (important), Wildcards, Typical use, Gotcha / interview. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: extra mool ko configure karta hai jo dev server ka request kar sakta hai. Next.js ne default roop se development ke dauraan dev-only assets/endpoints ko kros-origin requests ko blocked kiya, taaki andhikrit pahunch ko roka jaa sake.

  • Default: localhost, iske up domain aur hostname server ko pahle se hi permission di gai thi; kisi any hostname ko entry ki requirement hoti hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  allowedDevOrigins: ['local-origin.dev', '*.local-origin.dev'],
}
  • Matching niymon (aayaatak): request ke Origin header ke keval hostname se match karta hai. yojna, port, path, query string ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai - bina https:// ke bare hostname ke roop mein entries ko likhna aur bina kisi port ke (e.g) http://local-origin.dev:3000/dashboard?tab=1 ke liye, match value local-origin.dev hai). ek no-kor kros-site request (e.g. ek <script> tag ek dev asset load ho raha hai) koi Origin header bhejta hai - ve iske bajaay Referer hostname par match kar rahe hain.
  • Wildcards: * = bilkul ek labels; ** = ek ya adhik lebala. *.local-origin.dev team.local-origin.dev se match karta hai, lekin NOT local-origin.dev aur team.eu.local-origin.dev se match karta hai; **.local-origin.dev donon team… aur team.eu… se match karta hai, lekin NOT bare domain hai. yahi karan hai ki udaharan do entries (bare + *) ko listed karta hai. partial pratisthapan NOT supported hai (team-*.local-origin.dev invalid hai); ** keval pattern ki shuruaat mein supported hai.
  • Typical use: ek surang rimot devalapameint ke liye istemal kiya: allowedDevOrigins: ['*.tunnel.example.com'].
  • Dhyaan Do / interview: yeh dev-keval security hai, production ke liye CORS nahi - yeh kros-origin durvyavahaar (e.g) se dev-keval endpoints ki raksha karta hai. keval hostname, kabhi URL nahi.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/allowedDevOrigins

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai assetPrefix. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: assetPrefix — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim, phase-aware — no CDN in dev), How it works, What to upload, Limitation, Gotcha / interview. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: sarv Next.js ki khud ki JS/CSS assets ko /_next/ asset URL ko set karke ek CDN se bachata hai.

  • Default: koi nahi (aiseset ne app ke apne domain se serve ki). Vercel ki deployment automatic roop se ek global CDN ko configure karti hai - NOT ko manual roop se assetPrefix set kiya gaya hai.
  • Example (verbatim, step-aware - koi CDN dev mein):
js
// @ts-check
import { PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER } from 'next/constants'

export default (phase) => {
  const isDev = phase === PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER
  /**
   * @type {import('next').NextConfig}
   */
  const nextConfig = {
    assetPrefix: isDev ? undefined : 'https://cdn.mydomain.com',
  }

  return nextConfig
}
  • yeh kaise kaam karta hai: Next.js automatic roop se JS/CSS ke liye upasarg ka upyog karta hai jo /_next/ (.next/static/) se load hota hai. E.g /_next/static/chunks/4b9b…js https://cdn.mydomain.com/_next/static/chunks/4b9b…js ban jata hai. domain Next.js ko hal karne ke liye CDN ki utpatti ko configure karna hai.
  • Kya to upload: keval .next/static/ ki content, _next/static/ ke roop mein aplod ki gai. Do NOT ne baki .next/ E ko aplod kiya - jo server code ko expose karega aur public roop se configure karega.
  • Limitation: assetPrefix keval _next/static ko cover karta hai. yeh NOT ko public/ folder mein files ko affected karta hai - ek CDN par un logon ki serve karne ke liye aapko apne aap ko define karna hoga.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview: assetPrefix ≠ basePath. basePath (C2.10) ek up-path ke tahat pure app ki hosting ke liye hai jaise ki /docs ( ke baad, us upyog ke mamle ke liye recommended tareeka); assetPrefix ek alag domain (CDN) ke liye ek hi app ki static assets ki serve karta hai. ek up-path ko nakli karne ke liye assetPrefix ka upyog na karein.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/assetPrefix

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai cacheComponents. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: cacheComponents — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage (verbatim), Gotchas, Good to know, What it unlocks, Navigation with Activity, Migration. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Cache Components, use cache directive ki madad se component aur function level par caching on karta hai. Data fetching default roop se dynamic hoti hai — tum khud chunte ho ki page, component ya function, kis level par kya cache hoga. Next.js pehle ek static HTML shell turant serve karta hai, aur dynamic content taiyaar hote hi stream hokar usi page me aa jata hai — matlab ek hi route ke andar static aur dynamic content ek saath mil sakta hai.

  • Usage: next.config.ts me cacheComponents: true set karo, saath me partialPrefetching: true bhi:
ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  partialPrefetching: true,
}

export default nextConfig
  • Dhyaan do: partialPrefetching ko hamesha khud set karo — ise bina set kiye chhodne par ek warning log hoti hai (Cache Components ke pehle release me Partial Prefetching shamil nahi tha). Ise false sirf tab set karo jab tum kisi aise purane app ko migrate kar rahe ho jisne Cache Components ko Partial Prefetching se pehle apnaya tha. Agli major release me dono features har jagah by default on honge aur ye options hi hata diye jayenge.
  • Good to know: Cache Components ko Node.js runtime chahiye, aur ye runtime route segment config ko support nahi karta — isliye apne saare runtime exports hata do, chahe wo runtime = 'nodejs' ho ya deprecated runtime = 'edge'. Dusre server-side JS runtimes ke kaam karne ki koi guarantee nahi hai.
  • Ye kya unlock karta hai: use cache directive, aur uske saath use hone wale cacheLife aur cacheTag functions. Saath hi ye Partial Prerendering (PPR) ko App Router ka default behavior bana deta hai — experimental.ppr flag aur experimental_ppr route segment config ki ab zaroorat nahi rahi, dono hata diye gaye hain.
  • Activity ke saath navigation: Enable hone par Next.js client-side navigation ke dauraan React ke <Activity> component ka use karta hai taaki component state bana rahe — pichhla route unmount hone ke bajaay "hidden" ho jata hai, isliye wapas navigate karne par uski state waisi ki waisi milti hai. Hidden hone par effects cleanup ho jate hain aur dobara visible hone par phir se bante hain. Kuch haal hi me visit kiye gaye routes hidden rakhe jate hain; purane routes DOM se hata diye jate hain. Jo components mount hone par alag behavior karte hain (dropdown, dialog, testing wale patterns), unke liye Preserving UI State guide dekho.
  • Migration: Agar tum experimental.useCache ya experimental.dynamicIO use kar rahe the, to Version 16 upgrade guide se migrate karo; route segment configs aur dusre caching patterns ke liye Migrating to Cache Components guide dekho. Agar tum Next.js 15 me experimental PPR use kar rahe the, to Version 16 upgrade guide ka PPR section dekho.
  • Version history: v16.0.0 — cacheComponents stable hua aur experimental.cacheComponents se hatkar top-level option ban gaya; ye ek hi flag ab ppr, useCache aur dynamicIO — teeno purane flags ko control karta hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Ek hi flag poore Cache Components model (PPR by default, use cache directive, cacheLife / cacheTag) ka switch hai. PPR ab default behavior hai, koi experiment nahi. Sirf Node.js runtime chalega — koi runtime segment config nahi. Activity-based navigation client navigation par purane route ko unmount karne ke bajaay uski state preserve karti hai.

cacheHandlers

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai cacheHandlers. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: cacheHandlers — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Status, Example (verbatim, TypeScript), When to use, Handler types, CacheEntry type. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ne 'use cache' aur 'use cache: remote' directive ke liye custom cache storej karyanvayan ko define kiya - isliye cached components/functions default in-memory cache ke bajaay external storej (Redis, Memcached, DynamoDB, disk, database) mein rah sakte hain. 'use cache: private' NOT config yogy hai.

  • Default: koi cacheHandlers configured nahi → Next.js default aur remote dono ke liye built-in in-memory LRU cache use karta hai. Reference implementation: Next.js repo me packages/next/src/server/lib/cache-handlers/default.ts.
  • Status: v16.0.0 me stable — experimental.cacheHandlers se top-level cacheHandlers me move hua.
  • Example (verbatim, TypeScript):
ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheHandlers: {
    default: require.resolve('./cache-handlers/default-handler.js'),
    remote: require.resolve('./cache-handlers/remote-handler.js'),
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • Kaise use karein: zyadaatar apps ko custom handlers ki zaroorat NAHI hoti — default in-memory cache achhi tarah kaam karta hai. Inhe tab use karo jab (a) tumhe multiple instances me shared cache chahiye (default cache per-process, isolated hai aur restart par kho jata hai — har server/container ka apna hota hai), ya (b) tum storage type badalna chahte ho (restarts ke paar persistence, kam memory use me stability, maujooda infra ke saath integrate). Tum strategies mix kar sakte ho: 'use cache' → in-memory default handler, 'use cache: remote' → external remote handler, ek hi app me.
  • Handler types: default = 'use cache' dwara use hota hai; remote = 'use cache: remote' dwara use hota hai. Tum extra named handlers (jaise sessions, analytics) bhi define kar sakte ho aur unhe 'use cache: <name>' se reference kar sakte ho.
  • CacheEntry type (next/cache se CacheHandler ke saath export hota hai):
ts
interface CacheEntry {
  value: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>
  tags: string[]
  stale: number
  timestamp: number
  expire: number
  revalidate: number
}

value = cached data ko ek single-upyog dhara ke roop mein; tags = cache tag (sopht tag ko chhorakar); stale = client-side staleness ka sekand; timestamp = build samay (ms); expire = kitni der tak entry ka upyog kiya jaa sakta hai (sekeind); revalidate = kitni der tak ise phir valid kiya jana chahiye (sekeind).

  • Entry value stream — do sakht constraints: (1) Ise sirf ek baar padha ja sakta hai — ise set() me consume karo, har get() me stored data par ek NAYI stream banao; dobara padhi gayi stream bina data ke rehti hai ya throw karti hai. (2) Ye us request se judi hai jisne entry produce ki — set() resolve hone ke baad ise mat rakho (ye request ki memory tab tak rakhti hai jab tak evict na ho); Next.js render ke liye apni copy rakhta hai. Store me buffering ya piping dono theek hain jab tak tum use asal me ek baar consume karo; badi entries piping ke layak hain (ek S3-jaisa backend bina memory me dusri copy ke chunks accept kar sakta hai). Do destinations ke liye fan-out: .tee() use karo aur set() resolve hone se pehle dono branches consume karo — lekin ek stored tee branch abhi bhi source stream/request ko rakhti hai, isliye ye value ko 'rakhne' ka tareeka nahi hai. Interrupted values: stream mid-render error kar sakti hai, ek incomplete value chhod kar — discard karna surakshit hai, kyunki incomplete value incomplete page banati hai.
  • API — ek handler 5 methods implement karta hai:
  • set(cacheKey, pendingEntry: Promise<CacheEntry>): Promise<void> — pehle pendingEntry ko await karo (entry abhi bhi generate ho sakti hai), phir value stream consume karo aur use persist karo. Example: new Uint8Array(await new Response(entry.value).arrayBuffer()) ke through buffer karo.
  • get(cacheKey, softTags: string[]): Promise<CacheEntry | undefined> — miss par undefined return karo. Access age khud check MAT karo: Next.js har read par timestamp vs expire compare karta hai (bahut purana = miss) aur dusre server cache me likhte waqt revalidate vs revalidate bhi. expire se pehle → discarded aur regenerated; revalidate ke baad lekin expire ke andar → background me regenerate hota hai. Eviction TUMHARA kaam hai — Next.js tumhare store se kabhi delete nahi karta (expire se TTL use karo, ya size-bound LRU). Ek tagged entry ko invalid declare karna: undefined return karo ya revalidate: -1 ke saath entry return karo (background me serve + regenerate karo). Har hit par stored bytes ko hamesha ek fresh stream me wrap karo.
  • refreshTags(): Promise<void> — per request ek baar call hota hai, is handler type ke liye pehle cache read se pehle, taaki handler tag state ko external store se sync kar sake. In-memory cache ke liye no-op; distributed cache ke liye required (kuch bhi serve karne se pehle dusre instances dwara kiye gaye invalidations jaanne ke liye). Ek request jo is handler se kuch nahi padhta, use kabhi call nahi karta.
  • getExpiration(tags: string[]): Promise<number> — tags ke set ke liye maximum revalidation timestamp: 0 agar kabhi revalidate nahi hue, sabse recent revalidation ka ms timestamp, ya soft-tag checks ko get() par chhodne ke liye Infinity. Agar tum timestamps track nahi karte to 0 return karo.
  • updateTags(tags, durations?: { expire?: number }): Promise<void> — tab call hota hai jab tags revalidate/expire hote hain. durations absent = turant invalid (entries phir serve nahi honi chahiye); updateTag() aur single-arg revalidateTag() ye path lete hain. durations present = tags ab stale hain lekin entries ab bhi tab tak serve ho sakti hain jab tak durations.expire seconds background refresh ke dauraan na guzar jayein (revalidateTag(tag, 'max') ye path leta hai). Har tag ka invalidation time record karo; get() use entry timestamp se compare karta hai, getExpiration() soft tags ke liye waisa hi hai (soft tags ek entry ke tags me store nahi hote, isliye tag le jaane wali entries revalidatePath() ko cover NAHI karti).
  • Soft tags: Next.js dwara route path se generate kiye gaye implicit tags — har segment ko ek layout tag plus leaf route milta hai (jaise /blog/hello → /layout, /blog/layout, /blog/hello/layout, /blog/hello, internally _N_T_ prefix ke saath). Ve revalidatePath() ko usi tag system se kaam karate hain. Ve get() me softTags param ke roop me aate hain; check karo ki access ke timestamp ke baad koi soft tag invalid to nahi hua (ya getExpiration() se direct compare karke). Built-in handler dono use karta hai: expire ke liye undefined, stale ke liye revalidate: -1.
  • Distributed tag sync (multi-instance): default in-memory handler tags ko locally track karta hai, isliye ek instance par revalidateTag() dusron ko affect nahi karta. Coordination ke through: (1) updateTags() invalidation timestamp shared storage me likhta hai; (2) refreshTags() per request ek baar shared storage se recent invalidations padhta hai; (3) getExpiration() sabse recent revalidation timestamp (Math.max(...timestamps, 0)) return karta hai. Docs ek full Redis example dete hain (ek revalidated-tags set + tag:<name> keys, local Map ko refreshTags me sync kiya gaya).
  • Error handling: set() failure — response ab bhi serve hoti hai (set response flow ke baad async chalta hai); entry kho jati hai aur agli request phir render hoti hai. Phir bhi apni errors pakdo: ek rejected set() request ke pending return work aur surfaces me failed background work ke roop me shamil ho jata hai. get() failure — internal errors pakdo aur undefined return karo (cache miss ki tarah); framework get() ko try/catch me wrap NAHI karta, isliye unbalanced exception render error ke roop me propagate hota hai. Partial writes — agar partially written entry padhi jaye to behavior undefined hai; atomic writes ya write-then-rename use karo.
  • Page par examples: ek full in-memory Map handler (pendingSets tracking ke saath taaki get in-flight set ko dekh sake, tag {stale, expired} timestamps, per hit fresh stream) aur ek Redis handler (base64-inline, EX TTL expire se — expire: Infinity ke liye koi TTL nahi / hamesha rehta hai).
  • Platform support: Node.js server — haan; Docker — haan; static export — nahi; adapter — platform-specific.
  • Dhyaan do / interview: stream single-use hai aur request se bound hai — custom handler me #1 bug stream ko uske bytes ke bajaye store karna hai. Age checks Next.js karta hai, tumhara get() nahi. Eviction aur tag sync tumhari zimmedari hai — Next.js tumhare store se kabhi delete nahi karta. getExpiration ka 0 return karna ek valid 'main tags track nahi karta' jawaab hai. 'use cache: private' handler ko puri tarah bypass karta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/cacheHandlers

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: define custom cache profile (stale / revalidate / expire avdhi ke naam par set) ki cacheLife() function 'use cache' components/functions. ke andar chayan kar sakte hain

  • Default: built-in profile maujud hain (default, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, max); koi custom profile nahi hai jab tak ki yahan define nahi kiya gaya hai.
  • Status: v16.0.0 mein static - experimental.cacheLife se top level ke cacheLife mein le jaata gaya.
  • Prerequisite: ko cacheComponents flag enable karne ki requirement hai.
  • Example (verbatim, TypeScript):
ts
import type { NextConfig } from 'next'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  cacheLife: {
    blog: {
      stale: 3600, // 1 hour
      revalidate: 900, // 15 minutes
      expire: 86400, // 1 day
    },
  },
}

export default nextConfig
  • code mein Usage (verbatim):
tsx
import { cacheLife } from 'next/cache'

export async function getCachedData() {
  'use cache'
  cacheLife('blog')
  const res = await fetch('https://api.example.com/data')
  const data = await res.json()
  return data
}
  • Profile field (sabhi optional, sekand): stale = client server ki check ke bina ek value cache karta hai; revalidate = kitni bar server cache ko taza karta hai (state value ko phir valid karte samay served jaa sakta hai); expire = adhikatam avdhi dynamic svich karne se pahle ek value stale bana reh sakta hai - revalidate se lamba hona chahiye.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview: aap ek hi naam (default, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, max) ke saath define karke ek built-in profile ko override kar sakte hain. expire > revalidate ek kathin badha hai. profile sirph naam hain - ek hi blog profile ko kai karyon dwara pun: upyog kiya jaa sakta hai, isliye ek caching-policy badlav ek config sampadan hai. related: cacheLife() function sandarbh (Part B) aur cacheHandlers (C2.11), jahan entries vastav mein sangrahit ho jati hain).

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), What it sizes (two separate caches), Setting `0`, Gotcha. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: pratyek Next.js server udaharan rakhta hai, in-memory cache ke size ko bytes mein set karein.

  • Default: 50 MB (50 * 1024 * 1024).
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheMaxMemorySize: 50 * 1024 * 1024, // 50 MB, the default
}
  • Kya yeh size (do alag cache): (1) server cache prerender kiye gaye pages, root handler pratikriyaon aur customize images ko sangrahit karta hai - ise ek custom cacheHandler (incrementalCacheHandlerPath) ko apnane par 0 ko set karein, isliye padhta hai ki prati-insteins copy ke bajaay apne store par jaein. (2) 'use cache' ke pichhe built-in handler - yadi aap apne khud ke handler ko cacheHandlers (C2.11) ke madhyam se panjikrit karte hain, to woh handler apni memory ka prabandhan karta hai aur yeh vikalp ab iske liye lagu nahi hota hai.
  • Setting 0: disabled karta hai donon in-memory kaisha. iske alava, yeh janne ka ek tareeka hai ki kaise 'use cache' server rahit environment mein behavior karta hai, jahan entries shayad hi kabhi requests ke beech jivit rahti hain.
  • Dhyaan Do: next dev apne in-memory cache ko is vikalp (reelods fast) ke bawajud rakhta hai; production vastav mein configure kiye gaye value ka samman karta hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
prati-insteins kaip - ek bahu-insteins pariniyojan mein pratyek server ko apna khud ka 50 MB milta hai; ise hit dar ke liye memory ka vyapar karta hai, aur sajha karne ke liye actual fix ek custom cache handler hai, na ki ek bada in-memory kaisha.

Purpose: kantrol Next.js ki built-in gzip kanpreshan of reindard kanteint aur static phaailsa.

  • Kaise to check: pratikriya ke Accept-Encoding (jo browser accept karta hai) aur Content-Encoding (vastav mein kya upyog kiya jata hai) header ko dekho.

js
module.exports = {
  compress: false,
}

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
compress keval server target (next start / custom server) ke saath kaam karta hai; ek static export ya CDN-served build host/CDN se compression ho jata hai, na ki yeh dhvaja.

js

cssChunking (experimental)

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai cssChunking (experimental). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: cssChunking (experimental) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Status, Default, Example (verbatim), Options, Choosing a strategy, Tuning `graph` (object form). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: niyantran kaise CSS files ko vibhajit kiya gaya hai aur phir se kramaadeshit kiya gaya hai.

  • Status: experimental, badal sakta hai, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Default: true (experimental.cssChunking ke tahat).
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    cssChunking: true, // default
  },
} satisfies NextConfig
  • Options: true (default, webpack + Turbopack) — jab bhi mumkin ho CSS merge karo, import order use karke explicit/implicit dependencies set karo, chunk count aur requests kam karo. false (sirf webpack) — koi merging ya re-ordering nahi. 'strict' (sirf webpack) — CSS files ko exact imported order me load karo; zyada chunks/requests. 'graph' (sirf Turbopack) — cost-based graph algorithm routes ke paar CSS group karta hai, per-route downloaded bytes vs requests ko balance karke.
  • Strategy choose karna: default true zyadaatar apps ke liye sahi hai. Turbopack me, performance tuning ke liye graph par switch karo (zyada requests ki cost par per-route unused CSS kaato). Webpack me, correctness ke liye 'strict' par switch karo — jaise agar a.css aur b.css alag files me alag orders me import hote hain aur b.css a.css par nirbhar hai, to true unhe galat order me merge kar sakta hai; 'strict' merge rokta hai aur import order me load karta hai. false merging puri tarah disable karta hai.
  • graph ko tune karna (object form):
ts
experimental: {
  cssChunking: {
    type: 'graph',
    requestCost: 100000,
    weightDistribution: 0.1,
  },
}

requestCost (default 20000, bytes) = ek extra CSS request ki anumanit lagat; bare values ko kam, bare sajha tukron ki or poorvaagraha. weightDistribution (default 0.1) = kaise ek sajha chank ki lagat ko un routes par vitrit kiya jata hai jo ise load karte hain, jo pratyek route ko kitne CSS import karte hain; 0 vajan har route saman roop se; uchch values ne zon se spesing chhote-CSS routes (jaise /login) ko priority di.

  • graph kaise decide karta hai: har route ke ordered CSS imports se ek weighted graph banata hai (same order me ek saath import ki gayi files ko heavier edges milte hain), use ek line me flatten karta hai frequently-paired files ko paas rakhte hue, phir line ko chunks me kaatne ke points rakhta hai; ek route har wo chunk load karta hai jisme uski import ki gayi file hai. Ye SAARI routes me total download cost minimize karta hai, per route nahi — isliye ek route kuch CSS le ja sakta hai jo usne kabhi import nahi ki, jab ye overall cost neeche rakhta hai. Decide karne wala factor ye hai ki un-imported CSS ka size jo ek merge ek route par dhakel dega vs requestCost.
  • Unused CSS debug karna: Lighthouse 'Reduce unused CSS' flag karta hai; Chrome DevTools Coverage panel per stylesheet applied (green) vs unused (gray) CSS dikhata hai. Dhyaan do: :hover/:focus/JS-toggled classes trigger hone tak unused mane jate hain. Unused CSS ya to tumhari apni stylesheet ke dead rules se aata hai (source me fix karo; CSS Modules styles ko importing component tak scope karte hain) ya bundler ke dusri stylesheet ko shared chunk me merge karne se (is strategy se governed; graph mode ise fine-tune karta hai).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh classic bytes-vs-requests vyapar band hai, ab prati bundler tyoonebal hai - aur webpack 'strict' mode maujud hai kyonki CSS kaisked ordar ek saheenes issue hai, na ki sirph ek pradarshana.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/cssChunking

Asaan bhasha me samjho: deploymentId — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), Env var alternative, How it works (5 effects), Use cases, Gotchas. Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ek deployment ke liye ek pahchankarta set karta hai, jiska upyog roling deployment ke dauraan version skew security aur cache busting ke liye kiya jata hai.

  • Default: koi nahi.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  deploymentId: 'my-deployment-id',
}
  • Env var optional: NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID=my-deployment-id next build. ek gair-khali NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID config value par priority leta hai.
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai (5 prabhav): (1) static asset URL (JS, CSS, images) ke liye ?dpl=<deploymentId> ko render karta hai; (2) client-side navigation requests ke liye x-deployment-id header ko jodta hai; (3) navigation pratikriyaon ke liye x-nextjs-deployment-id header ko jodta hai; (4) <html> element par ek data-dpl-id visheshata ko injekt karta hai; (5) 'use cache' cache key mein deploymentId shamil hai, jab deployment ID mein parivartan hota hai to cache entries ko avaidh karta hai. jab client apni deployment ID aur server (uttree uttraadhikaaree ke madhyam se) ke beech ek galatfahmi ka pata lagata hai, to yeh client-side navigation ke bajaay hard navigation (full page reload) ko trigger karta hai - isliye user hamesha ek susangat deployment sanskaran se assets aur Server Functions prapt karte hain.
  • Use case: roling deployment (kuchh udaharan naye sanskaran par, kuchh purane - ek ID ke bina, upyogkartaon ko old/new assets aur errors ka mishran mil sakta hai); ek load baileinsar ke pichhe bahu server environment (ek hi deployment ke sabhi udaharan ek ID, e.g sajha karte hain. deploymentId: process.env.DEPLOYMENT_VERSION || process.env.GIT_SHA)
  • Dhyaan Do: Next.js NOT ne aane wale requests par ?dpl= query parameter ko padha - yeh keval cache busting (browsers/CDNs) ke liye hai, na ki routing. prati-nirdharan maan keval sandeh se bach jata hai yadi request ALSO hain jo deployment se guzarta hai - woh routing aapke host/CDN se aata hai; iske bina, client rollout ke dauraan kisi any deployment se ek udaharan tak pahunchte hain, navigate karne ke bajaay phir se load ho jayega. related: generateBuildId (C2.25).
  • Version history: v13.4.10 mein experimental.deploymentId ke roop mein pesh kiya gaya; v14.1.4 mein static top level; v16.2.0 — Pages Router build ID ke bajaay pratikriya header se sanskaran ka pata lagata hai, aur build ID static hai jab deploymentId set kiya gaya hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
deploymentId banam generateBuildId - build ID build ki identity karta hai; deployment ID deployment ki identity karta hai aur active roop se upyogkartaon ko runtime par sanskaran tirchhe se bachata hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/deploymentId

Purpose: set ek custom stale-while-revalidate samapt hone ka samay CDN ke liye ISR enable pages ke liye Cache-Control header mein upbhog karne ke liye.

  • Default: ne is page par koi ullekh nahi kiya hai (Next.js revalidate avdhi se default computation karta hai).
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  // one hour in seconds
  expireTime: 3600,
}
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: jab Next.js Cache-Control header bhejta hai, to samapti samay page ke punarmulyankan avdhi se computation ki jati hai. udaharan: 15 minat (900s) + expireTime ka ek ghante (3600s) → Cache-Control: s-maxage=900, stale-while-revalidate=2700 - page 15 minat ke liye static samay (3600 - 900 = 2700) ki tulna mein kam rahta hai.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview: yeh ek CDN-facing header chinta hai, na ki in-app cache - yeh batata hai ki kaise lanbe samay tak ek stale ISR page ko background mein phir se valid karte samay served jaa sakta hai. yeh keval ek CDN ke pichhe ISR pages ke liye mayne rakhta hai.
