Purpose (Historical): ne next export ke saath HTML files ke roop mein export ke liye page gantavyon ke request path ke manchitran ko nirdisht kiya.

  • Status: legacy, deprecated - iske bajaay getStaticPaths (Pages Router) ya generateStaticParams (App Router) ka upyog karein. phir bhi pichhre compatibility ke liye support kiya. next export ke liye vishesha.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  exportPathMap: async function (
    defaultPathMap,
    { dev, dir, outDir, distDir, buildId }
  ) {
    return {
      '/': { page: '/' },
      '/about': { page: '/about' },
      '/p/hello-nextjs': { page: '/post', query: { title: 'hello-nextjs' } },
      '/p/learn-nextjs': { page: '/post', query: { title: 'learn-nextjs' } },
      '/p/deploy-nextjs': { page: '/post', query: { title: 'deploy-nextjs' } },
    }
  },
}
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: An async function prapt (1) defaultPathMap (Next.js ka default naksha) aur (2) ek object { dev, dir, outDir, distDir, buildId } — dev development mein sach hai (jahan exportPathMap routes ko define karta hai) aur next export ke dauraan jhoothi; outDir dev mein zero hai. yeh pathname → { page, query } (page = pages/ ke andar page) ka ek naksha return karta hai; query = previous, default {} jab objekt getInitialProps ko passed kar data hai. eksport kiye gaye page HTML files, e.g ban jate hain. /about → /about.html. export kiye gaye path ka naam /readme.md ki tarah ek file naam bhi ho sakta hai, lekin phir ise serve karte samay aapko Content-Type: text/html set karne ki requirement ho sakti hai.
  • Dhyaan Do: query field ka upyog automatic roop se static roop se customize pages ya getStaticProps pages ke saath nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - ve build samay par HTML ko render karte hain aur extra query jankari next export ke dauraan pradan nahi ki jaa sakti hai. exportPathMap ko getStaticPaths dwara pages ke andar override kiya jata hai - unhein ek saath upyog nahi karte hain. trailingSlash: true ke saath, /about ko /about/index.html ( pre-Next.js-9 default) ke roop mein export kiya jata hai. output directory default out/, next export -o outdir ke saath optimization.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh purana static-export tantr hai; App Router yug mein barabar output: 'export' + generateStaticParams hai (C2.38 output dekhein).

Purpose: mein ek production build mein Instant Navigation testing API shamil hain, isliye @next/playwright se instant() helper request samay ki content ko rok sakta hai jabki ek end-to-end testing UI par jor data hai jo turant upalabdh hai.

  • Default: false / unset - testing API ko production build se bahar rakha gaya hai.
  • Status: experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. parichay v16.2.0
  • Prerequisite: ko cacheComponents enable karna hoga. jab Cache Components ko enable kiya jata hai to development automatic roop se testing API ko expose karta hai.
  • keval ek samarpit testing build (verbatim): ke liye Enable
ts
const exposeTestingApi = process.env.EXPOSE_TESTING_API === '1'

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  experimental: {
    exposeTestingApiInProductionBuild: exposeTestingApi,
  },
}
bash
EXPOSE_TESTING_API=1 pnpm build
EXPOSE_TESTING_API=1 pnpm start
  • Dhyaan Do: server startup par next.config ko phir se load karta hai - jab aap next start chalate hain to vikalp ko enable rakhein; yadi aap ise startup par disabled karte hain, to instant() client navigation ko rokein jabki request samay content pradan karne ke liye initial page load ki permission data hai. keval next start ke liye sthiti set karna NOT ek maujuda build ke liye testing API ko jodta hai (yeh build samay par bhi hona chahiye).
  • Security warning: Do NOT ise user-facing production pariniyojan ke liye enable banata hai - ise local production build, preview pariniyojan, ya any environment ko antim-too-eind parikshanon ke liye istemal kiya jata hai.

Purpose: ne build ID Next.js ko configure kiya hai, yeh pata lagane ke liye next build ke dauraan generated hota hai ki kis sanskaran ko lagu kiya jaa raha hai.

  • Default: Next.js auto-generates ek random ID prati nirmaan.
  • Kab ka upyog karne ke liye: yadi aap apne environment ke pratyek step (dev/staging/prod pratyek run next build) ke liye punarnirman karte hain, to usi taarkik build ko kai kantenron mein boot karna chahiye, jismein ek susangat ID hota hai - ise nishchit roop se generated karta hai, e.g. latest git hash se.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  generateBuildId: async () => {
    // This could be anything, using the latest git hash
    return process.env.GIT_HASH
  },
}
  • Dhyaan Do: jab deploymentId set ho jata hai, to Next.js ek static build ID ka upyog karta hai jab tak ki aap spasht roop se generateBuildId ko configure nahi karte hain, aur iske bajaay sanskaran SK5 ki deployment se pata lagaya jata hai. C2.17
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
ID = jo build karta hai; deployment ID = kaun deployment karta hai. ek git-hash build ID ne karya sanskaran ko ek commit ke liye trace karne mein enable banaya - bahu-container rollout mein "jo code live hai" ko debugging karne ke liye upyogi.

js

headers

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai headers. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: headers — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Basic example (verbatim), Shape, Overriding behaviour, Path matching (path-to-regexp), Header / Cookie / Query matching (`has` / `missing`). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: set custom HTTP headers ek diye gaye path ke liye ek aane wale request ke jawab para.

  • Default: koi custom header nahi; Next.js apne aap set (e.g) immutable-asset Cache-Control.
  • Basic udaharan (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  headers() {
    return [
      {
        source: '/about',
        headers: [
          { key: 'x-custom-header', value: 'my custom header value' },
          { key: 'x-another-custom-header', value: 'my other custom header value' },
        ],
      },
    ]
  },
}
  • Shape: headers ek async ya async function hai jo { source, headers, basePath?, locale?, has?, missing? } ki ek array ko return karta hai. source = aane wale request path pattern; headers = { key, value } ki array; basePath: false = match karte samay basePath shamil nahi hai; locale: false = match karte samay local logon mein shamil nahi hai; has/missing = sashart match vastuon ki array. header ko BEFORE file system (pages aur /public files) ki check ki jati hai.
  • Overriding behavior: yadi do niyam saman path se mel khaate hain aur usi header key ko set karte hain, to LAST ek jeet (e.g). /:path* x-hello: there set karta hai, phir /hello set x-hello: world → /hello ko world mil jata hai.
  • Path match (paith-too-regexp): /blog/:slug /blog/first-post se match karta hai lekin NOT ne /blog/a/b ko nested diya; pattern shuru mein langrit hain (Won't match /archive/blog/first-post). sanshodhak: * zero-or-more, + ek-or-more, ? zero-or-one — /blog/:slug* match /blog, /blog/a, /blog/a/b/c. match kiye gaye param ka upyog header key/value (value: ':slug', key: 'x-slug-:slug') mein kiya jaa sakta hai. Regex: /blog/:post(\d{1,}) match /blog/123 nahi /blog/abc. varn ( ) { }: * +? source mein vishesh hain - \\ (e.g) ke saath sakshar logon ko chhor dein. /english\(default\)/:slug).
  • Header / cookie / query match (has / missing): donon source aur ALL has item match hona chahiye, aur ALL missing item ko NOT match hona chahiye, header ko lagu karne ke liye. pratyek item: type (header) | cookie, key, value (string ya undefined) - aparibhashit kisi bhi value se match karta hai; ek regeks jaisi string naam ke capture grup, e.g ka upyog kar sakti hai. first-(?<paramName>.*) ne first-second ke khilaf match kiya, :paramName = second ko header key/value mein upyog karne yogy banata hai. page par udaharan: keval ek header ko lagu karein yadi request hai to header x-add-header maujud hai; keval tabhi yadi x-no-header anupasthit hai; keval tabhi query karein page=home AND cookie authorized=true; keval tabhi jab header x-authorized (?<authorized>yes|true) se match karta hai; keval host example.com hai. host query
  • basePath support: pratyek source automatic roop se basePath ke saath samapt ho jata hai jab tak ki niyam basePath: false set nahi karta.
  • i18n support: pratyek source automatic roop se configure kiye gaye local logon ko sambhalne ke liye taiyar kiya jata hai jab tak ki locale: false - tab aapko apne aap mein ek local vyakti ke saath source ko set karna hoga. not: /(.*) /(en|fr|de)/(.*) ban jata hai aur NOT match top-leval / ya /fr ko jis tarah se /:path* hoga.
  • Cache-Control: Next.js vastav mein achal sanpatti (SHA-hash in filename, e.g. static image import) ke liye Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable set karta hai - yeh CANNOT override kiya jaa sakta hai, aur aap un assets ke liye next.config.js mein Cache-Control set nahi kar sakte hain. aap CAN ne ise any responses/data. ke liye set kiya
  • Common security header (page par udaharan): CORS — Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (+ Allow-Methods/Allow-Headers) ek vishisht mool Route Handlers ka upyog karne ke liye /api/:path* para. X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: on Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload (2 varsh, sabhi up domain HTTPS-keval block page jo keval HTTP par serve kar sakte hain). X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (eintee-klikjaiking; CSP frame-ancestors) dwara superseded. Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), browsing-topics=() (purv mein feature-niti). X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (keval vaidh maan); MIME sniffing/XSS ko aplod ke madhyam se rokta hai. Referrer-Policy: origin-when-cross-origin CSP - Content Security Policy guide dekhein.
  • Version history: v9.5.0 header joda gaya; v10.2.0 has joda gaya; v13.3.0 missing joda gaya.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview: order mamle (ek hi key ke liye antim match niyam jeet). has/missing maan support jiska naam regex capture group hai jo :paramName ke roop mein pun: prayojy hai. Immutable-asset Cache-Control janboojhkar unoverridable hai. yeh vahi headers() function hai jo unstable_getResponseFromNextConfig unit test (C2.1) hai. related: redirects (C2.49) aur rewrites (C2.50) ek hi source/has/missing match bhasha sajha karte hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/headers

  • Dhyaan Do: nirdisht htmlLimitedBots OVERRIDES puri tarah se default list (yeh vilay nahi karta) - advanced behavior; default zyadatar mamlon ke liye paryapt hai. puri tarah se streaming metadata ko inactive karne ke liye: htmlLimitedBots: /.*/ (har user agent ko match karta hai).
  • Version history: ne v15.2.0 ka parichay diya.

yeh streaming ke SEO samakaksh hai - streaming manushyon (fast shell) ko madad karti hai, metadata blocked karne se bot (full pahla HTML) mein madad milti hai. yadi koi link preview koi title/image dikhata hai, to is list se lapta ek bot ek pramukh sandigdh hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: server-side fetch() calls ke liye use hone wale HTTP agent ko control karta hai — asal me iska kaam HTTP Keep-Alive ko disable karna hai.

  • Default: Keep-Alive enabled. Node.js 18 se pehle ke versions me, Next.js automatically undici ke saath fetch() ko polyfill karta tha aur default roop se HTTP Keep-Alive enable rakhta tha.
  • Keep-Alive disable karna ho to (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  httpAgentOptions: {
    keepAlive: false,
  },
}
  • Kab use karein: Bahut rare — sirf tab jab koi server-side fetch() target persistent connections ke saath galat behave kare (jaise koi legacy upstream jo reused socket par hang ho jata ho). Keep-Alive TCP connections ko reuse karta hai aur normal case me ye ek performance jeet hai; ise disable karne se har request ke liye naya connection setup karna padta hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Ye Node 18 se pehle ke zamane (undici polyfill) ki bachi hui ek niche escape hatch hai; modern Node par fetch built-in hai aur ye option zyadatar historic hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ek custom image loader ko configure karke, Next.js ke built-in Image Optimization API ke bajaay images ko customize karne ke liye ek cloud provider ka upyog karein.

  • Default: built-in loader (Next.js Image Optimization API). full built-in vikalp set (remotePatterns, domains, deviceSizes, imageSizes, formats, minimumCacheTTL, aadi) ko <Image> component page (Part B — Image Configuration Options) par pralekhit kiya gaya hai, yahan nahi.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  images: {
    loader: 'custom',
    loaderFile: './my/image/loader.js',
  },
}
js
// my/image/loader.js
'use client'

export default function myImageLoader({ src, width, quality }) {
  return `https://example.com/${src}?w=${width}&q=${quality || 75}`
}
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: loaderFile app root ke relative ek file ko point karta hai jo ek default function ka export karta hai jo { src, width, quality } prapt karta hai aur customize image URL string ko return karta hai. optional roop se, vyaktigat <Image> udaharanon mein loader prop ko paas karein. not: loader file ko customize karne ke liye Client Components ko pradan kiye gaye karya ko kramabaddh karne ke liye (loader file mein 'use client') ki requirement hoti hai.
  • Provider loader vyanjnon on the page (pratyek ({ src, width, quality }) => url function hai; quality default roop se 75 tak): Akamai (?imwidth=${width}); AWS CloudFront (format=auto&width=&quality=); Cloudinary (f_auto,c_limit,w_${width},q_${quality||'auto'} path param); Cloudflare (/cdn-cgi/image/width=,quality=,format=auto/); kanteintphul (fm=webp&w=&q=) Thumbor (${width}x0/filters:quality()); ImageKit.io (?tr=w-,q-) - gunavatta default 80); naaitrojan AIO (aio=w-;q- params). auto=format&fit=max&w=&q= t.resize(w:)~t.compress(q:) ?f_auto=true cdn.sanity.io/images/<project>/<dataset> auto=format&fit=max&w=&q= format=optimal&w=&q= width=&quality= ImageEngine PixelBin auto=webp&width=&quality= format=auto&w=&q= ?imgeng=/w_${width}/cmpr_${100-quality}
  • Dhyaan Do / interview: ek custom loader ka matalab hai Next.js ab image ko khud customize ya cache nahi karta hai - provider sabhi resizing/format karya karta hai, isliye provider ka URL API ab aapka anubandh hai. rimot image ko abhi bhi bilt-in loader ke liye permission (remotePatterns) ki requirement hai; ek custom loader ke saath URL ka build aapke karya dwara kiya jata hai, isliye provider ki permission-list provider ki chinta hai.

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai cacheHandler (incrementalCacheHandlerPath). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: cacheHandler (incrementalCacheHandlerPath) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), API — 4 methods, Cache keys are opaque, Build artifacts, Image optimization caching. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: configure karein jahan Next.js stors aur apne server kaish (ISR pages, route handler pratikriyaon, customize images) ko pun: valid karta hai - ise tikau storage ke liye jari rakhta hai ya ise containers/instances (e.g) ke par sajha karta hai. redis, memkaicheda.

  • Default: .next/cache ke tahat filesystem kaisha.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  cacheHandler: require.resolve('./cache-handler.js'),
  cacheMaxMemorySize: 0, // disable default in-memory caching
}
  • CRITICAL bhed - cacheHandler (singular) banam cacheHandlers (plural): Singular cacheHandler server cache opreshan ke liye hai (ISR, route handler pratikriyaon, customize images). yeh NOT hai jiska upyog 'use cache' nirdeshon dwara kiya jata hai - ve bahuvachan cacheHandlers (C2.11) ka upyog karte hain. cacheMaxMemorySize (C2.13) donon se alag hai aur in-memory cache ko size data hai.
  • API — 4 methods: get(key, ctx) — cached maan ya null return karta hai; ctx.kind 'APP_PAGE', 'APP_ROUTE', 'PAGES', 'FETCH', 'IMAGE' mein se ek hai. set(key, data, ctx) - data ek kind hai; buffer, etag, extension, revalidate ke saath images kind: 'IMAGE' ke liye; Promise<void> ritarna. revalidateTag(tag | string[]) — return Promise<void>. resetRequestCache() - agle request se pahle asthayi prati-request in-memory cache ko reset karta hai; void return karta hai.
  • Cache key opaque hain: puri key ko preserve karta hai jab reading/writing — ek key NOT ek request path naam hai. uttar key mein pratikriya ki tarah aur ek SHA-256 hash oph sors root (e.g) shamil hain. /blog/[slug] se /blog/post ke liye ek Pages Router pratikriya /route-cache/PAGES/<64-hex-SHA-256>/$/blog/post ka upyog karti hai), isliye vibhinn route entries ko sajha nahi kar sakte hain aur source route apne hash se recover nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. App Router sootr route samuhon aur parallel slot sahit full page module naam ka upyog karte hain. custom handler ko apardarshi skoping key prapt hoti hai aur ise aprivartit banaye rakhna chahiye; root nemaspes ko hata kar ya path naam-keval entries mein wapas girte hue route algav ko hara data hai. Fetch cache key aprivartit kar rahe hain.
  • Build artifacts: ek build adapter ke bina, purvnirdharit pratikriyaein historic server/pages / server/app path par rahti hain; bilt-in filesystem cache apne metadata ko verify karta hai, phir server/route-cache ki puri pratikriya ko badhava data hai. ek adapter ke saath, build-time artifacts ko seedhe unke dayre wale server/route-cache key mein likha jata hai taaki collaborator routes ko adapter package se pahle ek dusre ko overwrite nahi kar sake. output: 'export' abhi bhi common public export files ka utsarjan karta hai.
  • Image optimization caching: set images.customCacheHandler: true apne cacheHandler ke madhyam se customize-image entries ko root karne ke liye bhi (kind: 'IMAGE', e.g ke madhyam se alag-alag). yeh opt-in agle pramukh sanskaran mein DEFAULT ban jata hai - ise set karna ab aapke handler ko taiyar karta hai.
  • Good to know: revalidatePath cache tag ke top par ek feature parat hai - yeh aapke revalidateTag ko call karta hai, aur aap chun sakte hain ki kya cache key ko path se tag karna hai.
  • Platform support: Node.js server - han; Docker — han; static export — No; adapter — manch-vishishta.
  • Version history: v12.2.0 experimental incrementalCacheHandlerPath; v13.4.0 revalidateTag + standalone-output support; v14.1.0 ka naam badalakar cacheHandler, static; v16.2.0 image-virodhee caching samarthana.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Next.js caching config mein #1 bhram hai vilakshan banam bahuvachan — cacheHandler = purane server/ISR cache, cacheHandlers = naya 'use cache' cache. ek interviewer puchhte hain ki "aap events mein cache kaise sajha karte hain? kya aap puchhte hain ki kis cache ka matalab hai?

Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: inlineCss (experimental) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), Why it helps, When external CSS is better, Limitations. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: inline CSS <head> mein - har jagah Next.js common roop se ek <link> tag ka utsarjan karega, iske bajaay ek generated <style> tag ho jata hai.

  • Default: disabled. experimental, parivartan ke adhin, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    inlineCss: true,
  },
}
  • Kyun yeh madad karta hai: aam taur par browser download HTML, ise par karta hai, <link> tag ki khoj karta hai, phir rendering se pahle stylesheet ka request karta hai - ek request jalpaata. Inlining HTML mein styles dalta hai, isliye browser turant render karta hai. sabse badi jeet: pahli bar visitor (koi cached stylesheet abhi tak nahi), FCP/LCP metric, slow/high-latency kanekshan, aur Tailwind jaise parmanu CSS (Utility-first CSS) UI size ki parvah kiye bina kompaikt rahta hai, isliye inlining HTML ko bahut kharab nahi karta hai).
  • Kab external CSS behatar hai: inline styles ko HTML se alag-alag cache nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - pratyek page load usi CSS ko phir se download karta hai. adhikansh mamlon mein visitors ko wapas lene ke liye (cached external stylesheet jeeteinge), bare CSS bundles (Bootstrap/Material UI - inlining inflates TTFB aur har HTML pratikriya), aur kai page sajha karne wali shailiyan (external sheet ek page par cache kiya gaya tha jo dusron ke liye navigation ko gati data hai).
  • Limitations: vishv star par lagu - prati page configure nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. initial page load ke dauraan styles ko dupliket kiya jata hai (SSR ke liye <style> tag mein ek bar RSC payload mein). jab prerender kiye gaye pages ko navigate karte hain, to styles ne dohraav se bachne ke liye CSS ko inline CSS ke bajaay <link> tag ka upyog kiya. production keval - development mode mein upalabdh nahi hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
inline banam external CSS ek hi caching-vs-first-peint tred-oph hai, jaisa ki assetPrefix CDN nirnay: inline thandee visit ko customize karta hai, external dohrane ki visit ko customize karta hai. sahi uttar aapke yatayat mishran par nirbhar karta hai, saarvbhaumik niyam par nahi.

instrumentationClientInject

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai instrumentationClientInject. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: instrumentationClientInject — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Intended audience, Plugin pattern (verbatim), Direct setting (verbatim), Execution order on the client, Router navigation hook. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: apne side iphekt BEFORE ke liye client par import kiye gaye module ki ek list user ke instrumentation-client.{js,ts} file run, React hydration se aage hai.

  • Default: koi (empty) nahi.
  • Intended darshkon: Primarily next.config.js PLUGINS (e.g). withSentry / withAnalytics wrapper) - ek plugin apne khud ke client instrumentation module (ek navigation hook sahit) ko ek instrumentation-client file ko adhikrit karne ya sanshodhit karne ke liye har project ki requirement ke bina injekshan kar sakta hai. aavedan code aam taur par seedhe instrumentation-client.{js,ts} file convention ka upyog karna chahiye.
  • Plugin pattern (verbatim):
js
module.exports = function withMyInstrumentation(nextConfig = {}) {
  return {
    ...nextConfig,
    instrumentationClientInject: [
      ...(nextConfig.instrumentationClientInject ?? []),
      'my-instrumentation-package/client',
    ],
  }
}
  • Direct setting (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  instrumentationClientInject: [
    'my-analytics-package',
    './lib/sentry-client.js',
  ],
}

pratyek entry ek bare npm package ka naam (node_modules se alag) hai ya projekt root ke relative ek path hai.

  • client par Execution order: (1) pratyek instrumentationClientInject entry, array kram mein; (2) project ke instrumentation-client.{js,ts}, yadi maujud ho; (3) React hydration.
  • Router navigation hook: pratyek injekshan module optional roop se onRouterTransitionStart(url, navigationType) export kar sakte hain ( instrumentation-client convention mein lagabhag hastakshar). Next.js ek single hook ki rachna karta hai jo pratyek navigation par pratyek eksport kiye gaye onRouterTransitionStart ko, array kram mein, user ke file hook ke saath antim chal raha hai. bina export ke module navigation ke dauraan chhor diye jate hain.
  • Version history: ne v16.3.0 ka parichay diya.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh instrumentation-client ka plugin-lekhak sanskaran hai - vahi hook satah, pahle boot ordar mein, design kiya gaya hai taaki wrapper user ki file ko band karne ke bajaay rachna karte hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/instrumentationClientInject

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai logging. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: logging — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Fetching, Server Functions, Incoming Requests, Browser Console Logs (`browserToTerminal`), Disable all dev logging. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ne configure kiya hai ki Next.js tarminal ko development mode mein log karta hai: loging, Server Function call, aane wale requests ko prapt karta hai, aur browser console ko aage badhata hai tarminal mein log karta hai.

  • Default: development log on (Ftches logged, Server Functions logged, sabhi aane wale request log in).
  • Fetching: logging.fetches.fullUrl: true ne dev mein pratyek ke full URL ko log in kiya. Fetches Server Components HMR cache se bahal kar rahe hain NOT default roop se log in - logging.fetches.hmrRefreshes: true ke saath sakshama.
  • Server Functions: run dev mein default roop se log in kiye jate hain; logging.serverFunctions: false ke saath nishkriya. jab enable ho jata hai, to tarminal pratyek call ko naam, arg aur avdhi ke saath dikhata hai:
bash
POST /
  └─ ƒ myAction(arg1, arg2) in 5ms app/actions.ts
  • Incoming Requests: sabhi aane wale requests ko default roop se dev mein log in kiya gaya hai. regexes ke saath vishisht logon ko andekha karein: logging.incomingRequests: { ignore: [/\/api\/v1\/health/] } (e.g) ek health check endpoint ko chuppee karne ke liye jo log ko baarh data hai). puri tarah se disabled karein: logging.incomingRequests: false. dev keval - production build ko affected nahi karta hai.
  • Browser Console Logs (browserToTerminal): phoravard browser console.log/warn/error ko dev mein tarminal ke liye, isliye aap bina kisi opan kiye client code ko debug kar sakte hain. maan: 'warn' (default jab enable - warning + keval errors), 'error' (keval aatank), true (sabhi console output), false (disebal). phoravard log mein default roop se source sthan, e.g shamil hain. [browser] Hello World (app/page.tsx:8:17) DevTools
  • Disable all dev loging: logging: false.
  • Version history: v14.0.0 logging.fetches static (App Router); v15.0.0 logging: false, fetches.hmrRefreshes; v15.2.0 incomingRequests; v15.4.0 experimental.browserDebugInfoInTerminal; v16.2.0 browserToTerminal joda gaya ( experimental flag se nikala gaya).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
ye sabhi dev-DX knobs hain - unmein se koi bhi production behavior ko nahi badalta hai. abhyas mein sabse upyogi: incomingRequests.ignore ke saath health check shor ko badalane aur browserToTerminal ke saath tarminal mein client log dekhne ke liye.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/logging

Purpose: Compile MDX nai Rust compiler ka upyog kar files, @next/mdx ke saath experimental upyog ke liye.

  • Default: disabled. experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
const withMDX = require('@next/mdx')()

/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  pageExtensions: ['ts', 'tsx', 'mdx'],
  experimental: {
    mdxRs: true,
  },
}

module.exports = withMDX(nextConfig)
  • yah kaise kaam karta hai: @next/mdx plugin (jo config lapeta hai) aur pageExtensions sahit mdx ke saath milakar istemal kiya jata hai, isliye .mdx files ko pages ke roop mein ilaj kiya jata hai. The Rust compiler tezi se build ke liye default JS aadharit MDX compilation ko replace karta hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: niyantran kaise dev server development ke dauraan mang par aadharit memory pages ko niptane ya rakhta hai.

  • Default: maxInactiveAge: 25 * 1000 (25 sekand), pagesBufferLength: 2.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  onDemandEntries: {
    // period (in ms) where the server will keep pages in the buffer
    maxInactiveAge: 25 * 1000,
    // number of pages that should be kept simultaneously without being disposed
    pagesBufferLength: 2,
  },
}
  • kaise yeh kaam karta hai: In Dev, pages ko pahli bar daura karte samay mang par compiled kiya jata hai. maxInactiveAge = kitna lamba (ms) ek inactive page band hone se pahle baphar mein rahta hai; pagesBufferLength = kitne pages ko niptaan ke bina rakha jata hai. donon ko uthate hue adhik pages ko garm rakhta hai (faster sanshodhit karta hai, adhik memory); unhein jald hi memory ko mukt karta hai (pages ke roop mein kam sanshodhit karta hai).
  • Dhyaan Do: dev-keval chinta - production pahle se built-in pages par karya karta hai, isliye is vikalp ka koi production prabhav nahi hai. yadi dev server kai pages ke beech svich karte samay dhima mehsoos karta hai, to pagesBufferLength ko uthana leevar hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: bundler ko keval un modyoolon ko load karta hai jo aap vastav mein ek package se upyog karte hain jo saikron ya hazaron module export karte hain - jabki aap kai named export ke saath suvidhajanak bairal import likhte hain.

  • Default: ek built-in list default roop se customize hai (neeche dekhein); any package nahi hain.
  • Status: experimental, parivartan ke adhin, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  experimental: {
    optimizePackageImports: ['package-name'],
  },
}
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: import { Button } from 'huge-library' common roop se library ki bairal file ko khinchta hai, jo pratyek module mein draig kar sakta hai. yahan package ko listed karna keval vastav mein upyog kiye gaye module ko import ko phir se likhte hain, dev (faster compile) aur production (chhote bundle) performance mein sudhar karte hain.
  • default roop se Optimized: lucide-react, date-fns, lodash-es, ramda, antd, react-bootstrap, ahooks, @ant-design/icons, @headlessui/react, @headlessui-float/react, @heroicons/react/20/solid, @heroicons/react/24/solid, @heroicons/react/24/outline, @visx/visx, @tremor/react, rxjs, @mui/material, @mui/icons-material, recharts, react-use, @material-ui/core, @material-ui/icons, @tabler/icons-react, mui-core, react-icons/*, effect, @effect/*
  • Dhyaan Do / interview: keval un paikejon ko jodti hai jinki bairal import vastav mein dhimi hai - optimization import ko phir se likhte hain, isliye side-prabhavi module prarambhikaran ke saath ek package alag tarike se behavior kar sakta hai. yadi aapki icon library default list mein pahle se hi hai, to aapko ise jorne ki requirement nahi hai. manual vikalp gahre path (import Button from 'lib/Button') se import kar raha hai, jo yeh vikalp anavashyak banata hai.

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai output. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How file tracing works, Turbopack NFT extensions, Standalone output (verbatim), Env files in standalone, Caveats / tracing options. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: build output mode ko controlled karta hai - do maan 'standalone' (ek minimum sva-niyojit deployment) aur 'export' (static HTML export; Static Exports guide mein vistrit) hain. page khud hi zyadatar Output File Tracing E, donon ke pichhe tantr ke bare mein hai.

  • Kaise file anurekhan karya: next build ke dauraan , Next.js @vercel/nft ka upyog static roop se import, require aur fs ke upyog ka vishleshan karne ke liye karta hai aur pratyek file ko ek page load ho sakta hai. production server ka bhi pata lagaya jata hai (.next/next-server.js.nft.json). yeh naatkeey roop se deployment ko sikurtaa hai - Next.js 12 se pahle, Docker deployment ko next start chalane ke liye installed sabhi dependencies ki requirement hoti hai; ab keval known files ki requirement hoti hai. isne serverless target ki requirement ko bhi hata diya.
  • Turbopack NFT extension: Turbopack .nft.json files fileHashes ( ke liye parallel array - caching/dedup ke liye ek content pahchankarta) aur symlinks (map file indeks ko tatkal target tak) jodti hai. experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots ka upyog karne wale treson mein additionalRoots bhi shamil hai (jise source jaron ka naam diya gaya hai, pratyek apne files/fileHashes/symlinks ke saath; .nft.json directory ke relative path). files
  • Standalone production (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  output: 'standalone',
}

keval required files (chunein node_modules sahit) yukt .next/standalone/ banata hai - node_modules installed kiye bina apne aap mein deployed. ek minimum server.js bhi output hai (next start ke bajaay upyog karein): node.next/standalone/server.js. yeh default roop se NOT pratilipi public/ ya .next/static karta hai (ek CDN ko ideal roop se unhein sanbhaalnaa chahiye) - manual roop se copy karein yadi aap unhein serve dene ke liye server.js chahte hain: cp -r public.next/standalone/ && cp -r.next/static.next/standalone/.next/. Port/hostname ke madhyam se PORT/HOSTNAME env vars (e.g). PORT=8080 HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 node server.js. Windows par, directory simblinks ko privileges/Developer mode ki unnti ki requirement ho sakti hai; ek jankshan phlembaik ek full target store karta hai aur woh output moved nahi hota hai.

  • standalone mein Env files: next build pratilipi .env / .env.production ko .next/standalone mein bhejta hai; server.js unhein default roop se padhta hai - server par set kiye gaye env vars previous hote hain. .env.local / .env.production.local NOT copy kiye gaye hain (unka value abhi bhi previous pages aur inlined NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars ki tarah build-samay par kaam karne ke liye lagu hota hai, lekin request-samay server code keval unhein dekhne ke liye agar shuru mein set kiya gaya hai). output ke saath copies ship ke baad se, unmein keval gair-sachiv default rakhein aur runtime par rahasyon ko paas karein (Docker udaharan .dockerignore ke madhyam se build sandarbh se .env ko bahar karta hai). rm -f.next/standalone/.env.next/standalone/.env.production ke saath copies nikalein - lekin phir aapko har parivartaniy server ki zaroorat ko runtime par set karna hoga. yeh pratilipi file tresing se alag hai, isliye outputFileTracingExcludes ise hata nahi data hai.
  • Caveats / anurekhan vikalp: monorepo mein, project dir default roop se anurekhan root hai - iske bahar ki files ko bahar rakha gaya hai; outputFileTracingRoot (e.g) set karein. ise chauda karne ke liye path.join(__dirname, '../../')). jab anurekhan ek required file yaad aati hai ya ismein ek anavashyak ek shamil hota hai, to outputFileTracingIncludes / outputFileTracingExcludes ka upyog karein: key route glob (route path ke khilaf paich, e.g) hain. /api/hello), maan glob pattern project root se hal kar rahe hain. ek src/ dir ke saath, chabiyan abhi bhi route path se mel khaati hain, maan src/... ko sandarbhit kar sakte hain. ek global '/*' key sabhi routes ko lakshit karta hai. ye vikalp keval server trace par lagu hote hain - Edge Runtime routes aur puri tarah se static pages ko aprabhavit kiya jata hai. standalone bhi production server trace ki pratilipi banata hai; ise vishesh 'next-server' key (keval exception) ke saath bahar rakha gaya hai. phoravard slaish ko priority dein; pattern ko sankirn rakhein (ripo root par **/* ko chhor dein). aam mein shamil hain: node_modules/sharp/**/*, node_modules/aws-crt/dist/bin/**/* (mool binree static vishleshan nahi dekh sakte hain).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
output: 'standalone' Docker/self-hosting uttar hai ("main ek minimum image kaise deploy karoon?) jabki output: 'export' static hosting uttar hai. anurekhan asaphalta runtime par lapta mool Binaries ke roop mein dikhai dete hain - classic fix outputFileTracingIncludes hai.

  • Default: koi nahi.

js
const nextConfig = {

}

donon Webpack aur Turbopack ke saath kaam karta hai.

  • Version history: joda gaya v16.3.0.

content hash common roop se tabhi badalta hai jab content mein parivartan hota hai; ek namak aapko ek global cache-bast (e.g) ko bina kisi tach code ke global cache-bast (e.g) ko majbur karne data hai. deploymentId (C2.17) se alag, jo asset files ko naam dene ke bajaay runtime par sanskaran tirchha ke khilaf security karta hai.

partialPrefetching

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai partialPrefetching. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: partialPrefetching — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Prerequisite, Example (verbatim), How prefetches resolve, Opting into more, Per-segment override. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Enable Partial Prefetching app-wide — default roop se pratyek route ke keval static bhagon ko prefetch karein.

  • Default: Unset false (previous prefetch behavior) ki tarah behavior karta hai aur cacheComponents enable hone par warning data hai. donon features ko agle pramukh release mein har jagah enable kiya jayega aur vikalpon ko hata diya jayega.
  • Prerequisite: ko cacheComponents ki requirement hoti hai - iske bina, next dev aur next build config validation par phenk dete hain. parichay v16.3.0
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  cacheComponents: true,
  partialPrefetching: true,
}
  • Kaise prefetches hal: Before Partial Prefetching, Next.js view link prati prefetched — N routes ke saath ek page built-in ~N route prefetches link viewport mein access ke roop mein. partialPrefetching: true ke saath, Next.js ne prati route ONE pun: prayojy App Shell ko priority di. The App Shell mein render output shamil hai jo ek link ke URL par nirbhar nahi karta hai; URL-vishisht content ( ya searchParams par nirbhar karta hai) navigation ke baad hal karta hai. App Shells ko client par cache kiya jata hai, isliye usi route ke sabhi link ek prefetch ka pun: upyog karte hain - SPA mein prati root code vibhajan ki tarah: prati route ek artifact, pratyek link ne ise point kiya. jin roots ne cookies() ya headers() ko padha tha, ve session data sahit App Shell ka production karte hain; phremavark auto-ditekts is ko hata data hai aur client par prati session shell ko cache karta hai. params
  • adhik mein Opting: ek link App Shell se <Link prefetch={true}> ke saath adhik maangaa jaa sakta hai - prefetch tab URL data (params, searchParams, full URL) aur iske pichhe cached content ko bhi hal karta hai. <Link prefetch={true}> ka upyog ek route par karna jisne Partial Prefetching mein chayan nahi kiya hai, app-void partialPrefetching ya prati segment prefetch = 'partial' ka sujhav dene wale ek dev console error ko trigger karta hai.
  • Per-segment override: ek segment ek spasht prefetch route-segment config value ka export us route ke liye app-star default override karta hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Partial Prefetching Cache Components ka previous aadha hai - yeh en link prefetch ko prati route 1 shell prefetch mein badal data hai, yahi karan hai ki ise cacheComponents ki requirement hoti hai aur kyon donon agle pramukh mein default ho jate hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/partialPrefetching

prefetchInlining (experimental)

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai prefetchInlining (experimental). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: prefetchInlining (experimental) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, How it works, Disable (verbatim), Override thresholds (verbatim). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: override kaise App Router ek saath chhote prefetch pratikriyaon ko bundle karta hai.

  • Default: true (v16.3.0 ke baad default roop se enable). Inlining khud App Router ka ek sthayi hissa hai - keval yeh config experimental hai aur iska vikalp badal sakta hai. v16.2.0
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: jab App Router ek route ko taiyar karta hai, to yeh chhote segment pratikriyaon ko ek alag se request karne ke bajaay ek single pratikriya mein bundle kar sakta hai - kam prefetch request, routes mein kuchh sajha segment data ko dohrane ki lagat para. adhikansh apps ise chhor dena chahiye.
  • Disable (verbatim):
ts
experimental: { prefetchInlining: false }

tab pratyek segment ko apne khud ke request ke roop mein taiyar kiya jata hai. jab navigation ke muddon ko debugging ya request ki matra ko mapne mein upyogi hota hai.

  • Override threshold (verbatim):
ts
experimental: {
  prefetchInlining: {
    maxSize: 2048,
    maxBundleSize: 10240,
  },
}

donon threshold ko gzip-compressed segment pratikriya ke bytes mein maapaa jata hai; omitted maan default rahte hain. maxSize (default 2048) = sabse bada ek segment pratikriya abhi bhi inlining ke liye yogy ho sakti hai. maxBundleSize (default 10240) = sabse bada kul size jise ek path ke saath ek bundle prefetch pratikriya mein shamil kiya jaa sakta hai. loar threshold adhik prati segment didyooshan rakhte hain; uchch threshold adhik data ko rekhankit karte hain aur request mein katauti karte hain.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
ek any byte-vs-requests vyapar-band, is bar prefetch path par - kam requests ke liye vyaapaaron ko dupliket sajha-segment byte karna. yeh ek debugging/measurement switch hai, ek performance feature nahi hai jo adhikansh apps ko sparsh karna chahiye.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/prefetchInlining

js

  productionBrowserSourceMaps: true,

Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: proxyClientMaxBodySize (experimental) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Why it exists, Formats (verbatim), Behaviour when the body exceeds the limit, Example flow, Gotchas. Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: set adhikatam request body ka size baphar jab proxy (middleware) prayog kiya jata hai.

  • Default: 10 MB experimental, parivartan ke adhin, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Kyun yeh maujud hai: jab proxy chalti hai, to Next.js automatic roop se request body ko klon karta hai aur ise memory mein baphar karta hai taaki ise kai bar padha jaa sake - donon proxy mein aur built-in route handler mein. boundary bada body se atydhik memory upyog ko rokta hai.
  • Format (verbatim): string (recommended) - experimental: { proxyClientMaxBodySize: '1mb' } ikaiyon ke saath b, kb, mb, gb; ya bytes mein nanbar - proxyClientMaxBodySize: 1048576 // 1MB in bytes.
  • Behaviour jab body boundary se adhik ho jata hai: (1) keval pahla N bytes (boundary tak) baphar ho jata hai; (2) ek warning ko us route ka namkaran karne ke liye log kiya jata hai jo boundary se adhik ho jata hai; (3) request common roop se prasanskaran jari rahta hai, lekin keval partial body upalabdh hai; (4) request NOT client ko ek error ko fail ya wapas kar data hai. yadi aapko full body ki requirement hai, to boundary ko barhaaein ya partial body ko sundar dhang se sambhal lein.
  • Example flow: proxy.ts await request.text() padhta hai; vahi body abhi bhi app/api/upload/route.ts mein pathniy hai - lekin agar yeh boundary se adhik hai, to donon hi keval partial data dekhein.
  • Dhyaan Do: keval tabhi lagu hota hai jab proxy ka upyog kiya jata hai. boundary pratinirdhaarit hai, jo concurrent requests par global nahi hai. badi file aplod ke liye, usi hisaab se boundary barhaaein - lekin is memory tak har concurrent aplod baphar ko yaad rakhein.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
aashcharyajanak behavior yeh hai ki error ke bajaay chupchap body ko tornaa - ek file-aplod bag jahan "keval pahla 10 MB aaya" is setting par seedhe ankit karta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/proxyClientMaxBodySize

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: automatic roop se component rendering ko customize karne ke liye React Compiler ko enable karta hai - useMemo / useCallback ke saath manual memoization ki requirement ko kam karta hai.

  • Default: disabled. v16.0.0 mein static - experimental.reactCompiler se top level ke reactCompiler mein le jaata gaya.
  • Setup: plugin installed karein, phir enable karein:
bash
pnpm add -D babel-plugin-react-compiler
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  reactCompiler: true,
}
  • kaise yeh kaam karta hai: React Compiler ek Babel plugin ke madhyam se chalata hai. fast banane ke liye, Next.js ek custom SWC optimization jodta hai jo keval prasangik files (JSX ya React hook ke saath) ke liye compiler ko lagu karta hai. build abhi bhi default Rust aadharit compiler ki tulna mein thoda dhima ho sakta hai, lekin prabhav chhota aur local hai.
  • Opt-in mode (compilationMode: 'annotation'):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  reactCompiler: {
    compilationMode: 'annotation',
  },
}

phir "use memo" directive ke saath vishisht components/hooks ko nirdisht karein (aur "use no memo" ko chunne ke liye).

tsx
export default function Page() {
  'use memo'
  // ...
}
  • maujuda sansmaran guarantee: configure karta hai ki kya sankalak useMemo / useCallback / React.memo ko reactCompiler.environment.enablePreserveExistingMemoizationGuarantees ke madhyam se guarantee data hai ( ko se set karein). jab omitted, Next.js active React Compiler karyanvayan se default ka upyog karta hai - aur chunki default implementations/versions ke beech bhinn ho sakte hain, to ise spasht roop se susangat behavior ke liye set karein. false
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
compiler automatic roop se yaad karta hai, lekin yeh magic nahi hai - code jo React ke niymon ka ullanghan karta hai (render, sashart hook ke dauraan mutation) abhi bhi toot sakta hai, aur enoteshan mode bare kodbes ke liye surakshit rollout path hai. related: turbopackRustReactCompiler (C2.72) usi vichar ka tarbopaik-native sanskaran hai.

Purpose: enable React Strict Mode — ek development-keval mode jo sambhavit samasyaon (unsafe lifecycles, legacy API upyog, impure renders) ko expose karta hai.

  • Default: Next.js 13.5.1 ke baad se App Router ke saath default roop se true (aur automatic roop se app directory ka upyog karte samay C2.7 ke anusar enable). config keval Pages Router ke liye required hai. reactStrictMode: false ke saath disabled karein.
  • Enable (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  reactStrictMode: true,
}
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: Strict Mode dabal-inks renders, iphekts, aur any karyon ko satah side iphekt ke development mein - classic lakshan prabhav dev mein do bar chal raha hai (e.g. ek useEffect do bar firing laate hain, ya ek console.log do bar dikhai dete hain). yeh NOT production behavior ko affected karta hai.
  • Incremental god lene: yadi pure app taiyar nahi hai, to global star par ise enable karne ke bajaay <React.StrictMode> mein vyaktigat pages/trees ko lapeto.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"main apne useEffect ko dev mein do bar kyon chala sakta hoon? - Strict Mode dabal-invaikashan, design dwara, gair-idempotent prabhav ko expose karne ke liye. kabhi bhi ise Strict Mode ko inactive karke "fix" nahi kiya jata hai; prabhav ko theek karein. Next.js dridhta se bhavishy mein React ke liye taiyar karne ke liye ise chhorne ki sifarish karta hai.

redirects

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai redirects. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: redirects — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Basic example (verbatim), Shape, Query passthrough, Header / Cookie / Query matching (`has` / `missing`), basePath. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ek alag destination path ke liye ek aane wale request path ko redirect karta hai.

  • Default: No redirects.
  • Basic udaharan (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  redirects() {
    return [
      {
        source: '/about',
        destination: '/',
        permanent: true,
      },
    ]
  },
}
  • Shape: redirects ek async ya async function hai jo { source, destination, permanent, basePath?, locale?, has?, missing?, statusCode? } ko return karta hai. permanent: true → 308 (clients/search injan dwara hamesha ke liye banaya gaya); permanent: false → 307 (asthayi, cache nahi). kyon 307/308 aur 301/302? browser historic roop se 301/302 - e.g par GET ko request vidhi ko phir se shuru karte hain. POST /v1/users → 302 → GET /v2/users apekshit POST ke bajaye. 307/308 spasht roop se request vidhi ko preserve karte hain.
  • Query passthrough: request mein Query maan ko destination ke madhyam se passed kiya jata hai - /old-blog/post-1?hello=world → /blog/post-1?hello=world ke saath source: '/old-blog/:path*', destination: '/blog/:path*'. gotcha: hamesha path mapdandon (/old-blog/:slug) mein : se pahle / ko shamil kiya jata hai - anyatha path ko ek sakshar string ke roop mein mana jata hai aur aap anant punarnirdeshon ka jokhim uthate hain. /old-blog:slug
  • Path match (Ame path-to-regexp bhasha headers, C2.27) ke roop mein: /old-blog/:slug keval ek segment se match karta hai; sanshodhak */+/?; regex group /post/:slug(\d{1,}); \\ ke saath sakshar vishesh akshar ( ) { }: * +? se bhag lein.
  • Header / cookie / query match (has / missing): header ke roop mein saman size — type (header | cookie | host | query), key, value ((?<authorized>yes|true) jaise namon wale capture samuhon ko phir se destination mein :authorized ke roop mein pun: prayojy). sabhi has match hona chahiye, sabhi missing match nahi hona chahiye. page ke udaharanon mein ek nakaratmak-lookahead source /:path((?!another-page$).*) shamil hai jo destination ko khud (anant-loop guard) ko redirect karne se bachne ke liye, aur example.com ke liye host-aadharit redirect se bachne ke liye.
  • basePath: source aur destination automatic roop se basePath ke saath samapt ho jate hain jab tak ki niyam basePath: false ko set nahi karta hai ( https://example.com jaise external redirects ki requirement hoti hai).
  • i18n (App Router): local logon ko config redirects mein keval haardkoded path hain - e.g. /:locale/old-path → /:locale/new-path, ya /:locale(en|fr|de)/:path* → /:locale/new-section/:path*. dynamic prati-request local handling ke liye, iske bajaay dynamic route segments + proxy ka upyog karein.
  • Custom sthiti code: purane HTTP grahakon ke liye permanent (donon) ke bajaay statusCode ka upyog karta hai. ek Refresh header automatic roop se IE11 compatibility ke liye 308 ke liye joda jata hai.
  • any redirect tantr: ke andar API Routes/Route handler (request-time), aur getStaticProps/getServerSideProps (Pages Router) ke andara.
  • Ordering: Redirects ko file system (pages aur /public files) se pahle check kiya jata hai. Pages Router mein, redirect NOT hain jo client-side routing (Link, router.push) par lagu hote hain jab tak ki Proxy maujud nahi hai aur path se match karta hai.
  • Version history: v9.5.0 joda gaya; v10.2.0 has; v13.3.0 missing.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
308 banam 301 classic interview jaal hai - vidhi sanrakshana. aur permanent: true ek SEO nirnay hai (anusandhan injan naye URL mein rainking moved karte hain aur ise hamesha ke liye cache karte hain), isliye ek galat sthayi redirect pahle permanent: false ke saath testing karne ke liye dardnaak hai.

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai rewrites. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: rewrites — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Basic example (verbatim), Shape, Ordering — the crucial part, Rewrite parameters, Path matching. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: map ek alag destination path ke liye ek aane wale request path, ek URL proxy ke roop mein karya karta hai ki MASKS destination - user koi URL parivartan nahi dekhta hai. iske viprit, punarnirdeshan (C2.49) phir se shuru aur naye URL ko dikhane ke liye.

  • Default: No rewrites.
  • Basic udaharan (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  rewrites() {
    return [
      {
        source: '/about',
        destination: '/',
      },
    ]
  },
}

Rewrites client-side routing par bhi lagu hote hain: <Link href="/about"> / se content par karya karta hai jabki URL /about rahta hai.

  • Shape: rewrites ek async ya async function hai jo kisi sarani ya objekt { beforeFiles, afterFiles, fallback } ko return karta hai. pratyek niyam: { source, destination, basePath?, locale?, has?, missing? }
  • Ordering — mahatvapurn hissa: ek plain array lagu kiya gaya hai AFTER file system (pages aur /public) aur BEFORE dynamic routes ki check karein. objekt form theek niyantran data hai:
  • beforeFiles - headers/redirects/proxy aur BEFORE ke baad sabhi files (_next/static aur public files sahit); page files ko override kar sakte hain. not: beforeFiles phir se likhte hain ki ek match ke turant baad filesystem/dynamic routes ki check nahi ki jati hai - ve tab tak jari rahte hain jab tak ALL beforeFiles ki check nahi ki jati hai.
  • afterFiles - pages/public files ke baad lekin dynamic routes se pahle check kiya gaya; pahla punarlekhan jo static file, page ya dynamic route ko hal karta hai.
  • fallback - pages/public files ke baad check kiya gaya AND dynamic routes, theek se 404 page se pahle. getStaticPaths Fallback (true/'blocking') dynamic route fallback rewrites par priority lete hain.
  • full check order: (1) header, (2) redirect, (3) proxy, (4) beforeFiles, (5) static filein (public, _next/static, gair-dynamic page), (6) afterFiles, (7) dynamic route, (8) fallback phir se likhte hain.
  • Rewrite parameter: yadi kisi source parameter ko destination mein prayukt NOT hai, to yeh automatic roop se query (source: '/old-about/:path*' → destination: '/about' ek query param ke roop mein :path se guzarta hai) mein passed ho jata hai. yadi koi parameter IS destination mein upyog kiya jata hai, to koi bhi auto-paas nahi hota hai - lekin aap unhein manual roop se jor sakte hain (destination: '/:first?second=:second'). Rewrites se static-page prerender param ko hydration ke baad client par par kar diya jata hai aur query mein pradan kiya jata hai.
  • Path match: ek hi path se related bhasha ke roop mein headers/redirects (:slug, */+/? sanshodhak, regeks group, bache hue sakshar). Header / cookie / query match (has / missing): C2.27/C2.49. ke saman size
  • Rewriting to an External URL: destination: 'https://example.com/blog/:slug' proxy to another site — bahu-jon setup ka aadhar aur Next.js ki vriddhishil god lena. trailingSlash: true ke saath, source aur destination donon mein trailing slash jorte hain.
  • Incremental god lene pattern (verbatim): A fallback purane site (source: '/:path*', destination: 'https://custom-routes-proxying-endpoint.vercel.app/:path*') ke liye phir se likhte hain. Next.js
  • basePath: source aur destination svath taiyar kiye gaye hain, jab tak ki niyam basePath: false set nahi karta hai - jiska upyog keval external punarlekhan ke liye kiya jaa sakta hai, internal destination nahi. basePath
  • Version history: v9.5.0 joda gaya (page par talika visham roop se kahtee hai "headers joda" - sambhavna ek docs taaipo); v10.2.0 has; v13.3.0 missing.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Redirect banam punarlekhan #1 routing sawaal — redirect = naya URL user + naye request ke liye drishyaman; Rewrite = saman URL, server-side proxy. aur beforeFiles banam afterFiles banam fallback anuvartee hai: yeh faisla karta hai ki kya aapka punarlekhan actual page file ko override kar sakta hai ya keval yaadon ko pakar sakta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/rewrites

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai sassOptions. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: sassOptions — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), Gotchas. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ne .scss/.sass files ke liye istemal kiye gaye Sass compiler ko configure kiya hai.

  • Default: koi custom vikalp nahi; Next.js ne Sass ko compiled kiya jab sass package installed ho jata hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const sassOptions = {
  additionalData: `
    $var: red;
  `,
}

const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  sassOptions: {
    ...sassOptions,
    implementation: 'sass-embedded',
  },
}

additionalData = Sass code pratyek Sass file (e.g. global char jaise $var: red; import ke bina har jagah upalabdh hai) ko prepended. implementation: 'sass-embedded' embedded Sass compiler ka chayan karta hai.

  • Dhyaan Do: sassOptions ko implementation ke bahar type nahi kiya gaya hai - Next.js any sambhavit gunon ko nahi banaye rakhta hai (ve Sass compiler ke madhyam se gujarate hain). functions sanpatti ( mein define custom Sass karyon) keval webpack-only hai - Turbopack ke tahat, custom Sass function anupalabdh hain kyonki Turbopack ki Rust architecture is vikalp ke madhyam se passed JS karyon ko executed nahi kar sakti hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
additionalData pratyek file mein @import ke bina sabhi Sass files mein variables/mixins ko sajha karne ka manak tareeka hai; aur custom functions par Turbopack boundary ek actual migration gotcha hai jab ek Sass-heavy app ko Turbopack par le jaata jata hai.

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai serverActions. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: serverActions — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Status, `allowedOrigins`, Host matching rules, Reverse proxies / tunnels, `bodySizeLimit`, Enabling (v13 only). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Tune Server Actions behavior — CSRF mool check (allowedOrigins) aur request body ka size boundary (bodySizeLimit).

  • Status: Server Actions Next.js 14 ke baad se default roop se static aur enable hain; ye do vikalp experimental.serverActions ke tahat experimental rahte hain.
  • allowedOrigins: extra vishvasniy host ki ek list jismein se Server Actions ko bulaya jaa sakta hai. CSRF security: Next.js request ke Origin header mein x-forwarded-host (or host) ke saath host ki tulna karta hai jab x-forwarded-host anupasthit hai); jab tak ki mool host ek entry se mel nahi account hai, tab tak ek bemel ko kharij kar diya jata hai. WITHOUT ek Origin header ka request karta hai.
js
module.exports = {
  experimental: {
    serverActions: {
      allowedOrigins: ['my-proxy.com', '*.my-proxy.com'],
    },
  },
}
  • Host match niyam: keval host (hostname + port jab URL ek) Origin header ka match hota hai - https://my-proxy.com/checkout → my-proxy.com; https://my-proxy.com:8443/checkout → my-proxy.com:8443. wildcard: * = vastav mein ek labels, ** = ek ya adhik (keval pattern ke prarambh mein); *.my-proxy.com app.my-proxy.com se match karta hai lekin bare domain aur app.my-proxy.com:8443 nahi; **.my-proxy.com up domain se match karta hai lekin bare domain nahi. partial pratisthapan NOT supported (app-*.my-proxy.com avaidh) hai. ek port wildcard nahi ho sakta hai - ise likhna (my-proxy.com:8443, *.my-proxy.com:8443).
  • Reverse proxy / surngon: ek rivars proxy ke pichhe, jab tak proxy x-forwarded-host mein public host ko aage badhata hai tab tak koi entry ki requirement nahi hai. yadi proxy apne host ko iske bajaay aage badhata hai, to browser my-proxy.com bhejta hai jabki server localhost:3000 ki report karta hai - browser ke edres bar mein dikhai dene wale host ko jodta hai, internal nahi. production AND development mein check rana. top level ke allowedDevOrigins (C2.6) ke viprit, jo dev-server assets/endpoints tak pahunch ko controlled karta hai - ek surang ko aksar BOTH settings (donon suchiyon mein sam hostname) ki requirement hoti hai.
  • bodySizeLimit: Server Action ke liye default adhikatam request body 1 MB E hai (adhik server sansadhanon ko bare data + DDoS ko par karta hai). bytes ya bytes-package string (1000, '500kb', '3mb') ke saath configure karein:
js
experimental: {
  serverActions: {
    bodySizeLimit: '2mb',
  },
}

boundary RAW HTTP body par lagu hoti hai, jismein multipart/form-data ovarahed (baaundreez, paart header, field metadata) shamil hain - boundary ke paas vishisht malteepaart aplod ke liye 10-20 KB hedroom chhor dein.

  • Enabling (keval V13): on Next.js 13, experimental.serverActions: true ne unhein enable banaya; 14+ par ve default roop se chalu hain.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
do sabse aam Server Action deployment viphaltaon (1) "Server Action mere proxy ke pichhe fail" → allowedOrigins host mismatch, aur (2) "aplod fail" → 1 MB bodySizeLimit. donon config hain, code bag nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: cache fetch pratikriyaon mein Hot Module Replacement (HMR) local development mein taza - tezi se pratikriyaein aur sampadan karte samay kam build API kola. Server Components

  • Default: true (enabled). prayogik, production ke liye recommended nahi hai (yeh kisi bhi tarah se ek dev-keval behavior hai).
  • Disable (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    serverComponentsHmrCache: false, // defaults to true
  },
}
  • Dhyaan Do - aashchary ki baat default: HMR cache ALL fetch request par lagu hota hai, INCLUDING un cache: 'no-store' ke saath - isliye bina kisi request ke NOT ko HMR riphresh ke beech fresh data dikhai dega. cache ko navigation ya phul-page reload par saaf kiya jata hai, isliye ek hard riphresh fresh data dikhata hai. yadi aap code edit karte hain aur data dev mein stale dikhta hai, to yeh cache sambhavit karan hai - ise disabled karein, ya page ko phir se load karein.
  • Observability: development ke dauraan console mein cache hits/misses lane ke liye logging.fetches (C2.34) ka upyog karein; logging.fetches.hmrRefreshes: true vishesh roop se log is HMR cache se bahal ho jate hain.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"meraa no-store lane ke liye dev mein stale data pradarshit karta hai lekin production mein fresh" - HMR cache janboojhkar eksayeks ko refresh mein override karta hai; yeh ek dev-DX tred-of hai (API call ko edit karte samay bachaao), ek prodakshan caching bag nahi. no-store

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Opt vishisht dependency OUT of Server Components bundling, isliye ve iske bajaay mool Node.js require ke saath load kiye gaye hain.

  • Default: Next.js Server Components aur Route Handlers ke andar use hone wali saari dependencies ko bundle karta hai; popular packages ki ek built-in list automatically external hai (neeche dekho).
  • Example (verbatim):
js
const nextConfig = {
  serverExternalPackages: ['@acme/ui'],
}
  • Kab use karein: jab koi dependency Node.js-specific features use karti hai jo bundle karne par toot-te hain — native bindings (.node files), dynamic require, fs se apni files tak access, ya Node internals patch karne wale packages (APM agents, instrumentation). Aise packages ko bundle karna runtime me "module not found" ya broken native-addon errors produce kar sakta hai; externalize karna unhe node_modules ke against plain require ke roop me rakhta hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Let Proxy Next.js ke samanyikrit sanskaran ke bajaay ORIGINAL request ko dekhte hain - internal URL, query parameter aur header sahit client-side navigation ke dauraan upyog kiya jata hai.

  • Default: false (samanyikaran). adhikansh pariyojnaon ko is vikalp ki requirement nahi hai - yeh vishisht routing mamlon aur debugging ke liye advanced Proxy jhande mein se ek hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  skipProxyUrlNormalize: true,
}
  • Kya samanyikaran common roop se karta hai: client-side navigation ke dauraan, Next.js ek internal request (ek full dastavez bhar nahi) ka upyog karta hai aur ise Proxy se pahle samanyikrit karta hai, isliye Proxy client navigation aur full page bhar ke liye usi destination URL ko dekhta hai. Next.js bhi samanyikrit karta hai ki Proxy return kya data hai, isliye rewritten/redirected URL match karne ke liye phir se likha jata hai.
  • flag ke saath, na to samanyikaran run - matbhed: request.nextUrl ne anurodhit path naam ko bheja hai (antararaashtreey data ko hal karne ke bajaay URL route path + ilaake mein wapas); request.url mool URL hai (samanyikrit nahi); internal _rsc query parameter preserve hai (chhidrit nahi); internal navigation header (rsc, next-router-state-tree, next-router-prefetch, next-router-segment-prefetch, next-hmr-refresh) ko request.headers mein preserve kiya jata hai (hat nahi); NextResponse.rewrite() gantavyon ko likhit roop mein bheja jata hai (build ID ke saath phir se prasaarit nahi); NextResponse.redirect() Location ko trailing slash preserve (ek rishtedaar URL ko phir se likhit nahi) ke saath likha jata hai; trailingSlash: true ke saath, path ka naam aprivartit hokar guzarta hai ( Proxy run se pahle koi slaish nahi).
  • Example: proxy.ts mein , request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('_rsc') enable hone par joda gaya maan Next.js lauta data hai; request.headers.get('rsc') enable hone par client-side navigation ke dauraan '1' lauta data hai. null null
  • Deprecated alias: purv mein skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize (jab se Proxy ko midilveyar kaha jata tha) - abhi bhi ek deprecation warning ke saath kaam karta hai; setting BOTH ek config error throw karta hai ("ek hi samay mein set nahi kiya jaa sakta hai"). v16 codemod iska naam badalta hai.
  • Good to know: client navigation banam phul page load ke liye alag-alag content wapas karne ke liye internal navigation header ka upyog karne se bachein. aapko yeh simit karne ke liye is vikalp ki requirement nahi hai ki kaun sa route Proxy par chalta hai - matcher config abhi bhi destination URL se match karta hai. keval kya Proxy parivartan dekhta hai; filesystem routing, config redirects, aur rewrites saman behavior karte hain.
  • Version history: v13.1.0 skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize joda gaya; v16.0.0 ko skipProxyUrlNormalize naam diya gaya.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"samanyikaran" kyon Proxy aamtaur par ek full load se client navigation ko nahi bataa sakta hai - yeh flag debugging ya videshee routing ke liye amoorttaa ko hata data hai, jo Next.js androoni (_rsc, rsc: 1) ko dekhne ki lagat se aapko tark ka build nahi karna chahiye.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: automatic treling-slaish redirect ko inactive karta hai taaki aap apne aap ko Proxy mein treling ko sambhal sakein.

  • Default: false — Next.js pratyek request ko redirect karta hai, isliye trailing slash aapke trailingSlash setting (C2.61) se match karta hai. adhikansh pariyojnaon ko is vikalp ki requirement nahi hai - vishisht routing mamlon aur debugging ke liye advanced Proxy dhvaja.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  skipTrailingSlashRedirect: true,
}
  • Default behavior yeh disabled hai: trailingSlash: false → /about = 200, /about/ = 308, /about ko redirect; trailingSlash: true → /about = 308, /about/, /about/ = 200 ko redirect karte hain. flag ke saath, BOTH /about aur /about/ return 200 - na to redirect - aur Next.js client-side navigation (<Link> aur router URL) ke dauraan trailing slash ko badalna band kar data hai. apne khud ke config redirects aur rewrites abhi bhi lagu hote hain.
  • Dot-in-path edge case ( ke bawajud): yadi LAST path segment mein ek dot hota hai, to Next.js ek file ke roop mein path ka ilaj karta hai aur trailing slash ko hata data hai - /gcc.git/ aur /version/1.2.3/ donon 308 unke slaish-les form ke liye kisi bhi setting mein. pahle segment mein ek dot ka koi prabhav nahi hota hai (/version/1.2.3/my-page/ common roop se behavior karta hai), .well-known/ ke alava, jo default punarnirdeshon se mukt hota hai jab trailingSlash: true (/.well-known/x/ = 200). skipTrailingSlashRedirect: true ke saath, in punarnirdeshon ke NONE generated hote hain - pratyek path ko request ke roop mein served jata hai. trailingSlash
  • Good janne ke liye: setting pahle trailingSlash rakhein - yeh abhi bhi URL ko controlled karta hai Next.js generated karta hai aur output: 'export' ke liye output file naam (jahan flag /me ko /me/ ko hal karne ke bajaay href ko preserve karta hai). SEO warning: donon /about aur /about/ par ek page par kaam karne se sarch injan do URL milte hain - metadata mein ek kainonikal URL set karein ya Proxy mein redirect karein.
  • Example use: Incremental migration — Proxy apne khud ke routes par ek trailing slash jodta hai jabki legacy ke upasarg (/docs, /blog) ko anatach kiya gaya (page ek full proxy.ts udaharan data hai jismein ek regeks hota hai jo files aur .well-known pathon ko chhor data hai).
  • Version history: joda gaya v13.1.0.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
flag ka actual upyog mamla "meri legacy sthal aur meri Next.js site trailing slash ke bare mein asahamat hai" hai - aap global niyam ko band kar dete hain aur dhanche ke 308 se larne ke bajaay ise Proxy mein prati-prefix lagu karte hain.

Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ne Client Cache ke invalid samay ko override kiya - kitne lanbe page segments ko navigation phir se prapt karne se pahle browser ke Router Cache mein cache kiya gaya tha.

  • Default: dynamic: 0 sekand (cache nahi), static: 300 sekand (5 minat). experimental, parivartan ke adhin, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
const nextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    staleTimes: {
      dynamic: 30,
      static: 180,
    },
  },
}
  • Kya dynamic banam static matalab: ve link prefetching ke prakar ke anurup hain. dynamic tab lagu hota hai jab page na to static roop se generated hota hai aur na hi puri tarah se prefetched (e.g). prefetch={true} ke bina) - default 0s, i.e. dynamic pages ko har navigation par phir se attract kiya jata hai. static static roop se generated pages par lagu hota hai, ya jab <Link> par prefetch true hota hai, ya jab router.prefetch() — default 5 minat kahte hain.
  • Good to know: loading boundaries ko static avdhi ke liye pun: prayojy mana jata hai. yeh NOT partial rendering ko affected karta hai - sajha layout automatic roop se har navigation par nahi badla jata hai, keval badalate page khanda. yeh NOT parivartan back/forward caching behavior karta hai (jo layout shift ko rokta hai aur scroll sthiti ko preserve karta hai).
  • Version history: v14.2.0 experimental staleTimes pesh kiya gaya; v15.0.0 ko dynamic default roop se 30s se 0s mein badal diya gaya.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh server caching ka client-side samakaksh hai - yeh jawab data hai "main ek page par wapas navigate karta hoon mainne abhi daura kiya, yeh kyon badla? (dynamic staleTime 0) aur "main apne static page ko dobaaraa dekhne mein kyon laga? (static staleTime 300s). dynamic ki installation snaippiyar navigation ke liye tazgi ka vyapar karti hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: tune Static Generation (prerendering) prakriya build samay par, advanced upyog ke mamlon ke liye - retry behavior aur worker samaanaantaravaada.

  • Default: ne page par nahi kaha (Next.js machine ke aadhar par default chunta hai). experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    staticGenerationRetryCount: 1,
    staticGenerationMaxConcurrency: 8,
    staticGenerationMinPagesPerWorker: 25,
  },
}
  • Options: staticGenerationRetryCount = build fail hone se pahle asaphal page pidhi ko phir prapt karne ke liye samay ki sankhya (upyogi taur par jab prerendering ek flaky external API hit karta hai - ek retry ek build ko bacha sakti hai). staticGenerationMaxConcurrency = prati worker sansadhit pages ki adhikatam sankhya. staticGenerationMinPagesPerWorker = ek naya worker shuru karne se pahle prakriya karne ke liye minimum pages ki sankhya (niyantran kaise kaam shramikon mein vibhajit hai).
  • Kab upyog karne ke liye: hazaron static pages ke saath badi saaitein - build machine ke CPU/memory se match karne ke liye sahamati dhunein, aur yadi kabhi-kabhi kshanik errors par fail ho jata hai to ek phir prapt computation set karein. ek chhoti see site par ye switch apraasngik hain.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
ye build-throoput switch hain, jo switch render nahi karte hain - ve kaise tezi se badal jate hain aur kaise lacheele dhang se next build prastutakarta hain, na ki pages mein kya shamil hai.
