Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: jab aapke adapter ne unke liye support enable kiya hai to aparivartaniy static assets se bahar nikal jate hain.

  • Default: adapter par nirbhar karta hai - agar adapter ne feature ko enable nahi kiya hai, to is vikalp ka koi prabhav nahi hai. main roop se ADAPTER lekhkon ke liye irada; adapter-vishisht muddon ko pareshaan karte samay app devalapars ko keval ise set karna chahiye. warning: jab aapka provider/adapter support nahi karta hai to feature ko enable karne ke parinamsvarup tootee deployment ho sakti hai.
  • background: jab skew sanrakshan enable hai (dekhein deploymentId, C2.17), static asset requests mein ek deployment-vishisht query parameter — GET /_next/static/chunks/0d_ks0ow7ur6m.js?dpl=<unique-deployment-id> shamil hai. downside: browser aprivartit hone par bhi pratyek deployment ke baad static assets ko phir se download karte hain. Immutable static assets assets ke liye ?dpl parameter ko accept karte hain aur file naam - GET /_next/static/immutable/chunks/0d_ks0ow7ur6m.js dwara content-addressed - isliye browser unhein anishchit roop se cache karte hain aur baad mein deployment mein files ko aplod karte samay aprivartit assets ko chhor diya jaa sakta hai.
  • Opt bahar (verbatim):
js
const nextConfig = {
  supportsImmutableAssets: false,
}
  • Version history: joda gaya v16.3.0. adapter-side vivaran: "Supporting Immutable Static Assets" (C5.13) is sankshipt mein.

taint (experimental)

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai taint (experimental). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: taint (experimental) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Enable (verbatim), Side effects of the flag, When it helps, Tainting an object (verbatim pattern), Tainting a unique value (verbatim pattern). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Enable experimental React taint APIs ki galti se server → client boundary par se sanvedanshil data ko rokne. jab enable ho jata hai, to aap experimental_taintObjectReference (ek objekt sandarbh ko point karein) aur experimental_taintUniqueValue (ek unique value set karein); yadi ek tented object/value ko Client Component mein passed kiya jata hai, to React ek error throw karta hai.

  • Default: disabled. experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Enable (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    taint: true,
  },
}
  • flag ke Side prabhav: active yeh React experimental chainal ko app directory ke liye bhi enable banata hai, aur ise puri tarah se Client Component mein passed nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. process.env
  • jab yeh madad karta hai: jab data parhne ki vidhi aapke niyantran se bahar ho jati hai, jab aap sanvedanshil data size ke saath kaam karte hain jo aapko define nahi hote hain, ya jab sanvedanshil data ko Server Component rendering ke dauraan access kiya jata hai. recommended drishtikon abhi bhi data/APIs ko modal karne ke liye hai, isliye sanvedanshil data kabhi wapas nahi kiya jata hai jahan iski requirement nahi hai - chintan ek rakshaatmak net hai, design nahi hai.
  • ek objekt ko Tainting (verbatim pattern):
ts
import { experimental_taintObjectReference } from 'react'

async function getUserDetails(id: string): Promise<UserDetails> {
  const user = await db.queryUserById(id)
  experimental_taintObjectReference(
    'Do not use the entire user info object. Instead, select only the fields you need.',
    user
  )
  return user
}

vyaktigat field (firstName, lastName) ko ek Client Component mein paas karna abhi bhi kaam karta hai; pure user objekt throw karta hai.

  • ek unique maan (verbatim pattern):
ts
import { experimental_taintUniqueValue } from 'react'

experimental_taintUniqueValue(
  'Do not pass configuration tokens to the client',
  config,
  config.SERVICE_API_KEY
)

passing SERVICE_API_KEY — yahan tak ki ek naye char pahle — throw karne ke liye isteephaa de diya. lekin isse ek maan DERIVED (` version::${config.SERVICE_API_KEY} `) NOT tainted hai aur WILL ko expose kiya gaya hai - behatar drishtikon puri tarah se wapsi data se key ko hatane ke liye hai.

  • Caveats: taaining objekts ko keval REFERENCE dwara track karta hai - kisi objekt ko copy karne se ek untainted sanskaran banta hai ( pratilipi ko bhi badal data hai). bilt-in process.env tain keval objekt sandarbh par lagu hota hai - process.env.MY_VAR ko padhna aur resulting string ko paas karna aprabhavit hai, jaisa ki {...process.env } jaisi ek prati paas kar raha hai. tainting ek tainted value se prapt data ko track nahi kar sakta hai - vyutpann value ko bhi point karta hai. jab tak unke lifetime ka sandarbh gunjaish mein hota hai tab tak manon ko tapt kiya jata hai.
  • Warning: Do NOT sanvedanshil data ko expose karne se rokne ke liye apne ekmatr tantr ke roop mein tent API par bharosa karte hain - server Components/Actions. ke liye Next.js ki security recommendations dekhein
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
taaining RSC boundary ke liye ek "seetbelt" hai: yeh client bundle mein ek chup leak ke bajaay render time mein ek achaanak gupt risaav ko badal data hai. classic interview demo ek password hash ke saath ek user objekt ko tain kar raha hai aur dikha raha hai ki <UserCard user={user} /> ne <UserCard name={user.name} /> kaam karte samay phenk diya hai.

Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: yeh configure karta hai ki kya page ek trailing slash ke saath ya uske bina hal karte hain.

  • Default: false — trelar slaish ke saath URL ek (/about/ → /about, 308) ke bina apne samakaksh ko redirect karte hain.
  • Enable (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  trailingSlash: true,
}

is set ke saath, /about /about/ ko redirect karta hai.

  • Exceptions (No slash appended with true): static file URL ( extension ke saath path - /file.txt, images/photos/picture.png) aur .well-known/ (e.g) ke tahat kisi bhi patha. .well-known/subfolder/config.json) full dot-in-paith behavior talika ke liye C2.56 dekhein.
  • Static export: output: 'export' ke saath , /about page default /about.html ke bajaay /about/index.html output karta hai.
  • Related: skipTrailingSlashRedirect (C2.56) in automatic punarnirdeshon ko puri tarah se band kar data hai taaki Proxy prati root slaish ko sambhal sake.
  • Version history: joda gaya v9.5.0.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
trailing slash ek canonical-URL/SEO nirnay hai jo ek routing ke roop mein hota hai - ek roop chunein aur dusre ko redirect karein, ya khoj injan index donon. launch ke baad ise badalna har URL mein badlav ka matalab hai, isliye jaldi nirnay lein.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), When you need it, Gotchas, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: transpile aur bundle dependency monorepo workspace package ya node_modules libraries se jo TypeScript, JSX, ya aadhunik syntax ship karte hain - unhein anatach runtime code ke roop mein ilaj karne ke bajaye.

  • Default: Next.js default roop se node_modules ke andar NOT compilation code karta hai. maan package naam hain (@scope/pkg jaise dayre wale namon sahit); path aur glob pattern NOT supported hain.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
const nextConfig = {
  transpilePackages: ['package-name', '@scope/pkg'],
}

yeh purane next-transpile-modules package ko replace karta hai.

  • Kab aapko iski requirement hai: Turbopack transpile workspace package automatic roop se donon routers ke tahat, aur webpack App Router ke liye saman hota hai - isliye keval ek package jorein: (1) ek node_modules dependency ships kachche TypeScript/JSX (ismein shamil hai, ya package ko plain JS aur point main/exports mein compiled output par banaya gaya hai); (2) aap Pages Router ke liye webpack ke saath build karte hain aur dependency ka source app directory (e.g) ke bahar rahta hai. apps/web ek monorepo mein packages/ui import karte hain; (3) Pages Router + aap ek node_modules dependency ko route mein bundle karna chahte hain (Pages Router server-side node_modules deps ko Node require ke madhyam se runtime par load karta hai; indexing mein source ko bundle karta hai). App Router pahle se hi server Component/Route handler dependency ko bundle karta hai jab tak ki package serverExternalPackages mein na ho.
  • Dhyaan Do: ek package CANNOT donon transpilePackages aur serverExternalPackages mein dikhai dete hain - Next.js build shuru mein throw karta hai agar yeh karta hai (ve viprit hain: transpile = ise bundle karte hain, external = ise mool roop se requirement hoti hai). optimizePackageImports (C2.37) mein package aur default-transpiled-packages.json mein entries ko automatic roop se joda jata hai - unhein dohraanaa nahi hai.
  • Version history: joda gaya v13.0.0.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
classic monorepo error "Unexpected token / JSX in node_modules" hai - fix sajha workspace package ke liye transpilePackages hai. aur transpile-vs-external pair (C2.54 banam C2.62) pratyek server dependency ko spasht roop se banata hai bundling nirnay hai.

turbopack (config object)

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai turbopack (config object). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: turbopack (config object) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: History, Key point, Options table, Root directory, Additional roots (experimental, v16.4.0), Webpack loaders in Turbopack. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: customize Turbopack — vibhinn files (webpack loader) ko badal data hai aur module ko kaise hal kiya jata hai.

  • History: pehle experimental.turbo (v13.0.0–15.2.x), v15.3.0 me top-level turbopack rename hua; purana naam abhi bhi ek alias ke roop me kaam karta hai. Purane config ko npx @next/codemod@latest next-experimental-turbo-to-turbopack . ke saath migrate karo.
  • Key point: Turbopack ko built-in functionality ke liye koi loaders NAHI chahiye — CSS aur modern JS natively compile hote hain, isliye koi css-loader/postcss-loader/babel-loader nahi (jab tak tum @babel/preset-env use na karo).
  • Options table: root (absolute path — app root dir); rules (webpack loaders apply karne ke liye); resolveAlias (aliased imports ko modules se map karna); resolveExtensions (import karte samay try karne wale extensions); debugIds (bundles + source maps me TC39 debug IDs generate karna).
  • Root directory: Turbopack sirf root ke andar modules resolve karta hai (cache validation improve karta hai, filesystem watching kam karta hai, kam resolution steps). Next.js ise pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, bun.lock, bun.lockb dhoondh kar auto-detect karta hai. Manually override karo: turbopack: { root: path.join(__dirname, '..') }. Root ke bahar npm linked deps ke liye, ya to root ko common parent tak widen karo ya ek additional root use karo. root ko zyada broad mat karo (jaise home dir) — Turbopack roots ke andar saari files watch karta hai, jo badi performance problems cause kar sakta hai.
  • Additional roots (experimental, v16.4.0): experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots Turbopack ko un symlinks ko follow karne deta hai jinke targets turbopack.root ke bahar hain (jaise npm link ya ek pnpm global virtual store). Sirf symlink boundaries par crossable — ek root se escape karne wale direct relative imports supported nahi. Har key ek root ka naam deti hai ({ linkedPackages: { path: path.join(__dirname, '../packages') } }); path absolute ya Next.js cwd ke relative; ignoreIfMissing (default false) warning suppress karta hai jab ek root path build/dev start par missing ho. Root naam: 1-40 chars, ASCII letters/digits/_/-, Windows device naam nahi, case-insensitively unique. Roots turbopack.root ya ek dusre ko overlap nahi kar sakte. Additional roots trace format (C2.38) badalte hain aur, output: 'standalone' ke saath, unse unbundled files root ke naam wali subdirectory me copy hoti hain. Gotcha: symlink + target dev/build start hone se pehle build machine par hone chahiye; CI/deployment tools unhe copy nahi kar sakte; Windows par, symlink creation ke liye Developer Mode/elevated permissions chahiye (junction fallback absolute paths use karta hai → output relocatable nahi).
  • Turbopack me webpack loaders: tested loaders: babel-loader (Babel config file exist karne par auto-configured), @svgr/webpack, svg-inline-loader, yaml-loader, string-replace-loader, raw-loader, sass-loader (auto), graphql-tag/loader. Turbopack loaders ko webpack ke loader-runner ke through chalata hai (standard loader API ka aksar hissa). Supported NAHI: this.importModule, this.loadModule, this.emitFile, this.utils; this.fs sirf partially (fs.readFile). Limits: sirf JavaScript return karne wale loaders supported hain (stylesheet/image transformers supported nahi); loader options plain primitives/objects/arrays hone chahiye (values ke roop me require()ed plugin modules nahi).
  • Loaders configure karna (verbatim, SVGR example):
js
module.exports = {
  turbopack: {
    rules: {
      '*.svg': {
        loaders: ['@svgr/webpack'],
        as: '*.js',
      },
    },
  },
}

niymon ka mulyankan kram mein kiya jata hai. jab tak glob mein / shamil nahi hota tab tak glob file naam se match karta hai; Windows path / ko samanyikrit kiya jata hai. loader vikalpon ke liye objekt form: { loader: '@svgr/webpack', options: { icon: true } }. v13.4.4 se pahle, turbopack.rules turbo.loaders tha aur globs (*.mdx) ke bajaay keval extension (.mdx) accept kiye gaye the.

  • Advanced conditions: condition ke saath restrict karo ki ek rule kahan chale: boolean operators {all: [...]}, {any: [...]}, {not: ...}; operators {path: string|RegExp}, {content: RegExp}, {query: string|RegExp}, {contentType: string|RegExp} (ek object me multiple operators = AND lagu). Built-in conditions: browser (client code; {not: 'browser'} = server), foreign (node_modules + Next.js internal — aam taur par performance ke liye {not: 'foreign'} se loaders restrict karte hain), development, production, node, edge-light (Edge runtime, deprecated). Rules ek object ya objects ki array ho sakte hain (per-mode asymmetric conditions, jaise browser me SVGR, server par custom loader). Saare matching rules order me execute hote hain.
  • Module types: bina loader ke type seedhe set karo (webpack ke rule.type jaisa): asset (file emit karo, URL return karo — import svgUrl from './icon.svg' se <img src={svgUrl}>), ecmascript, typescript, css, css-module, json, wasm, node (native addons), raw/text (content string ke roop me), bytes (Uint8Array). type ko loaders ke saath combine karo — loaders pehle chalte hain, phir result per type process hota hai. v16.2.0 me joda gaya.
  • Import attributes ke through inline loaders (v16.2.0): ek with segment (Turbopack-specific, webpack nahi) ke saath ek import par loader apply karo; with chahiye, assert nahi:
tsx
import rawText from '../data.txt' with { turbopackLoader: 'raw-loader', turbopackAs: '*.js' }

visheshata: turbopackLoader, turbopackLoaderOptions (JSON string, e.g). '{"search":"X","replace":"Y"}', turbopackAs, turbopackModuleType.

  • resolveAlias (verbatim): turbopack: { resolveAlias: { underscore: 'lodash', mocha: { browser: 'mocha/browser-entry.js' } } } — import 'underscore' lodash load karta hai; conditional aliasing sirf browser condition (Node conditional-export style) support karta hai.
  • resolveExtensions (verbatim): default list ko overwrite karta hai, isliye tumhe jo chahiye wo sab shamil karna hoga: default .tsx, .ts, .jsx, .js, .mjs, .json (server native modules ke liye .node jodta hai; client par .node list karna harmless hai). Sirf tumhari apni source files par lagu hota hai — node_modules ke andar imports apni extension list rakhte hain.
  • debugIds (v16.0.0): turbopack: { debugIds: true } bundles/source maps me TC39 debug IDs generate karta hai aur ek polyfill auto-add karta hai; IDs globalThis._debugIds par available hain.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 experimental.turbo; v15.3.0 naam badalkar turbopack; v16.0.0 debugIds, rules.*.condition; v16.2.0 turbopackLoader attributes, rules.*.type, condition.contentType, condition.query; v16.4.0 experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Turbopack config webpack-compatibility parat hai - loader ke liye rules, resolveAlias/resolveExtensions resolution ke liye. migration sawaal hamesha "webpack se kya toot jata hai? - uttar: loader emitFile / importModule, custom Sass functions ka upyog karte hain, aur turbopack.root ke bahar kuchh bhi karte hain.

turbopackChunking (experimental)

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai turbopackChunking (experimental). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: turbopackChunking (experimental) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default (verbatim), Size thresholds, Component chunks (experimental), Heuristics (assumptions about user behaviour). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: yeh configure karta hai ki kaise Turbopack client-side JavaScript ko production mein chankne mein vibhajit karta hai - is dharna ko badal data hai ki chankar user ke behavior ke bare mein banata hai, kachche size ki threshold ko tor data hai, aur experimental component chankon ko enable banata hai.

  • Default (verbatim):
ts
experimental: {
  turbopackChunking: {
    minChunkSize: 50000,
    maxChunkCountPerGroup: 40,
    maxMergeChunkSize: 200000,
    minComponentChunkSize: 20000,
    generateComponentChunks: false,
  },
}
  • Size thresholds (UNCOMPRESSED, unminified code ke bytes — roughly compressed/minified output ka 5 guna): minChunkSize (default 50000) — Turbopack isse chhote ek se zyada chunks banane se bachta hai (chhote chunks merge karke). maxChunkCountPerGroup (default 40) — per chunk group (ek route ya dynamic import); kam → zyada aggressive merging, per page kam requests; badhao → chhote chunks, navigate karte waqt cache hits ki sambhavna zyada. maxMergeChunkSize (default 200000) — Turbopack isse bade chunk ko kabhi dusron ke saath merge nahi karta, bade-chunk code ko multiple bade output chunks me duplicate hone se rokta hai. Merge trade-off: behtar initial page load (kam requests) navigation performance ki cost par (chhote chunks pages ke paar zyada reusable hote hain).
  • Component chunks (experimental): merged chunks ke first-load benefits reusability khoye bina dene ka lakshya — runtime dynamically choose karta hai ki merged chunk ko ek file ke roop me load karna hai ya sirf wo component chunks jo uske paas pehle se nahi hain; merged chunk ke hisse ke roop me pehle load hua chunk dobara download nahi hota. generateComponentChunks (default false) — har merged production chunk apne constituent component chunks bhi saath emit karta hai. minComponentChunkSize (default 20000) — chhote component chunks alag emit hone ke bajaye ek me fold ho jate hain, taaki bahut saare tiny chunks na banein.
  • Heuristics (user behavior ke baare me assumptions): clusters (RegExp ki arrays ki array, jaise [[/^\/dashboard/, /^\/settings/]]) — route groups jo aam taur par ek saath visit hote hain; ek cluster ke routes dwara shared chunks zyada eagerly merge hote hain. firstPageLoadPriority (0-1) — ek page load ke liye merging benefit ko kitna weight dena hai; zyada → zyada eager merging; agar behtar value nahi hai to tumhari site ki bounce rate ek achha estimate hai. priorityRoutes (RegExp[]) — routes jin par aksar pehle land hote hain (jaise homepage); unke bundles kahin aur navigate karne par extra requests ki cost par single-route request cost kaatne ke liye eagerly merge hote hain. priorityBoost (default 1.5) — priorityRoutes ki single-request probability par multiplier. requestCost (default 200000, uncompressed code ke bytes) — ek extra request ki estimated cost; badi values kam, bade chunks ki taraf bias karti hain.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh Turbopack ka webpack ke splitChunks ka uttar hai - lekin hath se likhne wale cache samuhon ke bajaay, aap ek lagat modal (request kost banam bytes) plus behavior sanket (klastars, priority route, uchhal dar) ko dekhte hain. component-chank feature dilachasp hai: pahli load ke liye vilay, navigation ke liye vibhajan, phir se download kiye bina.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Let Turbopack ranon ke beech .next ke tahat apne kaam ko bachane aur bahal karne ke liye, baad mein build aur samarpit satron ko bahut tej karta hai.

  • Defaults: donon default roop se - turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev: true (.next/dev/cache/turbopack mein cache) aur turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild: true (.next/cache/turbopack mein cache) ko phir se shuru karne ke baad garm shuru hota hai. ya to bahar nikalane ke liye false set karein.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  experimental: {
    turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev: true,
    turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild: true,
  },
}
  • Build environment - key warning: build cache .next/cache mein rahta hai, aur jab us directory pratyek build se pahle RESTORED hoti hai to keval tezi se build hota hai. sva-hosted builds automatic roop se usi karya directory labh ka pun: upyog karte hain. kantenreekrit build ek svachchh parat se shuru hota hai aur jab tak aap cache karte hain ya ise spasht roop se mount nahi karte tab tak NOT ko le jate hain. CI pradataon ko .next/cache ke liye configure kiye gaye caching ka build karne ki requirement hai. yadi aapka environment kabhi .next/cache ko preserve nahi karta hai, to turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild: false ko ek cache likhne ke liye set karein jise kabhi padha nahi jayega. .next/cache
  • Version history: v15.5.0 lagatar caching canary par experimental ke roop mein jari kiya gaya; alag dev/build jhande ke saath v16.0.0 bita; v16.1.0 dev ke liye default roop se enable; v16.3.0 build ke liye default roop se sakshama.
  • Related: turbopackGc (C2.66) - memory aur lagatar cache se unavailable kaam ko hata data hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Turbopack ke in-memory aur lagatar cache ke liye kachra sangrah enable karta hai - aparivartaniy kaam ko hata dein taaki cache hamesha ke liye nahi badhta hai.

  • Default: false (disabled). experimental, joda gaya v16.4.0. jab ve Turbopack ka upyog karte hain to next dev aur next build donon ke liye lagu hota hai.
  • Enable (verbatim):
ts
experimental: { turbopackGc: true }
  • Object form (verbatim):
ts
experimental: {
  turbopackGc: {
    minProgressMs: 200,
    rootTtlMs: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
  },
}

minProgressMs (default 100) = minimum samay ek GC paas chalata hai isse pahle ki yeh ek rukavat ka samman karta hai. rootTtlMs (default 259200000 = 3 din) = samay ek GC root Turbopack ko hataye jaane se pahle anchahe rah sakta hai.

  • Prerequisites / negotiation: GC ko Turbopack FileSystem cache (C2.65) ki requirement hoti hai - vartaman command ke liye cache disabled hone par iska koi prabhav nahi padta hai. lanbe samay tak chalne wale parhne wale satron mein, Turbopack GC ko inactive karta hai jab turbopackMemoryEviction (C2.71) ko false par set kiya jata hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
lagatar cache ko ek GC kahani ki requirement hoti hai - ek ke bina, .next/cache har hataye gaye file/renamed route ke saath badhta hai. yeh flag yeh kahani hai, aur iski 3-divseey root TTL "kaise lanbe samay tak ham files ke liye kaam karte rahte hain, koi bhi sandarbh nahi hai" javaaba.

Purpose: vishisht Turbopack errors aur CLI output aur error overlay se warning data hai - known warning ke liye jo aapke app ko affected nahi karte hain, jaise ki janboojhkar ansulajh optional dependency.

  • Default: koi samasya nahi dabaya. keval Turbopack (next dev --turbopack) ka upyog karte samay upalabdh hai. parichay v16.2.0
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
const nextConfig: NextConfig = {
  turbopack: {
    ignoreIssue: [
      {
        path: '**/vendor/**',
      },
    ],
  },
}
  • Rule field: path (required, string glob ya RegExp) - us file path se match karta hai jahan issue generated hua), title (optional, satik string ya RegExp — ank shirshak se match karta hai), description (optional, satik string ya RegExp — ank vivaran se match karta hai). jab yeh path AND any sabhi nirdisht kshetron se match karta hai to ek issue dabaya jata hai; keval path ke saath, kisi match file se koi bhi issue dabaya jata hai.
  • Canonical udaharan - optional dependency: ek optional require() ke aaspas try/catch ke saath code Turbopack se "module nahi mila" warning ko trigger karta hai; ise { path: '**/lib/optional-feature/**', title: 'Module not found' } se daba data hai. multiple niyam gathabandhan (e.g). { path: '**/vendor/**' }, { path: '**/legacy/**', title: 'Module not found' }, { path: /generated\//, description: /expected identifier/ }.
  • Dhyaan Do: ank titles/descriptions Turbopack sanskaranon ke beech badal sakte hain - title/description match par vishisht path pattern ko pasand karte hain. path aam taur par static hai lekin sabhi prakar ke muddon ki guarantee nahi hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh webpack ke ignoreWarnings ke barabar Turbopack hai - anushaasit upyog sankirn hai, known-benign warning ke path-coped daman, ek kanbal mute nahi hai jo actual errors ko chhipata hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/turbopackIgnoreIssue

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: Defer client-side dynamic import() target ko compiled karta hai jab tak ki browser pahle unhein next dev ke dauraan request karta hai - isliye application ko kabhi bhi import nahi kiya jata hai, pure dev session ke liye asntusht rahta hai, bare apps par dev startup ko tej karta hai.

  • Default: false; keval next dev ke dauraan Turbopack ko affected karta hai - production aprivartit banata hai. experimental, joda gaya v16.4.0.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
experimental: { turbopackLazyDynamicImports: true }
  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: flag ke saath, Turbopack client ke side dynamic import() ke target ko compiled karne ka wait karta hai jab tak ki browser apne hisse ka request nahi karta hai. udaharan: ek Client Component mein, await import('./get-greeting') ek click handler ke andar keval ./get-greeting ko compiled karta hai jab visitor button par click karta hai.
  • Dhyaan Do: ek deferred module mein errors keval tabhi dikhai deti hain jab Turbopack pahle us module ko compiled karta hai - isliye ek toote hue lazily imported module tab tak chup rahta hai jab tak aap ise trigger nahi karte. kuchh next/dynamic target abhi bhi utsuk hain. server par Client Components ko render karte samay dynamic import ko sthagit karne ke liye, turbopackLazyDynamicImportsSSR (C2.69) ka upyog karein.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh dev-time lazy compilation hai, runtime lazy loading nahi - next/dynamic pahle se hi runtime par lazy load ho raha hai; yeh flag extra roop se COMPILING ko pahle dev mein upyog tak chhor data hai, jo bada app ke dev server ko tezi se shuru karta hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: niyantran kya Turbopack memory ko phir prapt karta hai jabki lagatar (FileSystem) cache enable hai - Turbopack disk ke liye apne cache ka ek snapshot likhne ke baad, yeh in-memory pratilipiyon ko identity sakta hai aur unhein demand par disk se phir se load kar sakta hai.

  • Default: 'auto'. prayogik, active development ke tahat v16.3.0 jari kiya gaya.
  • Values: false = kabhi bhi evict (cached data prakriya lifetime ke liye memory mein rahta hai); 'auto' (default) = keval ek bar paryapt memory ke baad evict ko allocated kiya gaya hai kyonki antim prayas ise sarthak banane ke liye - OS se thresholds aur memory-preshar feedback ka upyog karta hai; 'full' = har bar jab ham disk ko bachaate hain to memory se sabhi sambhavit data ko nasht kar data hai.
  • Scope: keval next dev satron mein ek prabhav dalta hai jab FileSystem cache (C2.65) enable ho jata hai, kyonki eviction pahle se hi disk par bane data par nirbhar karta hai.
  • intrekshan: lanbe samay tak chalne wale parhne wale satron mein, Turbopack kachra sangrah (turbopackGc, C2.66) ko inactive karta hai jab yeh false par set hota hai.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
experimental: { turbopackMemoryEviction: 'auto' }
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh lagatar cache tikree ki memory paksh hai - FileSystem cache (parsist vark), GC (anrichebal vark), Memory Eviction ( snaipshoting ke baad drop-in-memory copies). 'auto' sensibal default hai; 'full' kam se kam memory ke liye phir load-se-disk vilambata ka vyapar karta hai, jo memory-controlled dev masheenon par upyogi hota hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/turbopackMemoryEviction

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: ka chayan kaise Turbopack webpack loader, Babel aur PostCSS ke liye Node.js mulyankan chalata hai - baal processes ya worker dhage mein.

  • Default: 'childProcesses'. experimental, joda gaya v16.4.0.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
experimental: { turbopackPluginRuntimeStrategy: 'workerThreads' }
  • Values: 'childProcesses' (default) = Node.js mulyankan ko baal processes ke ek pool mein chalata hai, jo soket par sanvad karta hai. 'workerThreads' = ise Next.js prakriya ke bhitar worker dhage mein chalata hai - memory ko kam kar sakta hai aur CPU ovarahed banam ek child-proses poola. 'forceWorkerThreads' = affected Node.js sanskaranon par bhi worker dhage ka upyog karta hai (neeche dekhein); is prakriya ko pratibndhit kar sakta hai.
  • Node.js compatibility gotcha: on Node.js 24.13.1+, ek worker-thred teardown ishyoo (nodejs/node#65100) jab koi worker bahar nikalta hai to prakriya ko kharab kar sakta hai jabki ek mool addon mein live nod-API thred-surakshit function hota hai. jab ek affected sanskaran par 'workerThreads' ko set kiya jata hai, to Next.js ek warning ko print karta hai aur 'childProcesses' par wapas gir jata hai; 'forceWorkerThreads' garbhpaat ke jokhim par fallback ko rokta hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Turbopack Rust hai, lekin webpack loaders/Babel/PostCSS JS hain - unhein kahin ek Node.js runtime mein chalana hoga. ranniti vikalp ek prakriya-algav banam ovarahed tred-oph hai, aur Node 24.13.1 teardown bag kyon ab ke liye baal processes par default rahta hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: yeh configure karta hai ki kaise Next.js production ke build ke dauraan TypeScript errors ko sambhalti hai aur ek custom tsconfig file nirdisht karti hai.

  • Defaults: ignoreBuildErrors: false, tsconfigPath: 'tsconfig.json'.
  • Example (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  typescript: {
    ignoreBuildErrors: false,
    tsconfigPath: 'tsconfig.json',
  },
}
  • ignoreBuildErrors: Next.js FAILS next build jab TypeScript errors maujud hain. ignoreBuildErrors: true ki installation khatarnak roop se prakar ki errors ke bawajud production ke build ko pura karne ki permission deti hai. mahatvapurn: yeh puri tarah se SKIPS type-cheking step - yeh TypeScript ko nahi chala aur errors ko dabata hai, yeh puri tarah se check ko bypass karta hai. yadi aap ise disabled karte hain, to apne build/deploy prakriya mein alag se type check chalaein, ya yeh bahut khatarnak hai. (Docs !! WARN!! tippniyon ke saath udaharan ko chihnit karte hain.)
  • tsconfigPath: builds/tooling, e.g ke liye ek alag TypeScript config file ka upyog karein. tsconfigPath: 'tsconfig.build.json' custom-tsconfig vivaran ke liye TypeScript config page (C3.1) dekhein.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
ignoreBuildErrors: true ek "hamesha yeh vaise bhi hai" bhaago haich - CI mein ek asthayi anablok ke roop mein svikarya, kabhi ek sthayi setting ke roop mein nahi, kyonki yeh chupchap ship production ke liye errors ke prakaara. surakshit pattern CI mein ek alag tsc --noEmit kadam hai.

Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: import module seedhe external URL (local disk / node_modules ke bajaay) se.

  • Default: disabled. experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai.
  • Opt-in (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  experimental: {
    urlImports: ['https://example.com/assets/', 'https://cdn.skypack.dev'],
  },
}

phir: import { a, b, c } from 'https://example.com/assets/some/module.js' — prayog karne yogy har jagah common package import kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • Security modal: keval apne machine ko download karne aur executed karne ke liye aap TRUST domain ka upyog karte hain - ek URL import build/dev samay par durasth code execution hai. permission list raksha ki pahli pankti hai; long-term design URL ko Edge Runtime ke madhyam se browser saindboks mein import karta hai.
  • Lockfile: Next.js ek next.lock directory banata hai jismein ek lockfile + prapt sanpatti hoti hai - yeh MUST git ke liye commit hai, nahi .gitignore d. next dev naye khoje gaye URL ne lockfile mein import kiya; next build ONLY ko lockfile ka upyog karta hai (aam taur par koi network request nahi hai, aur ek purana lockfile build fail ho jata hai). exception: Cache-Control: no-cache ka jawab dene wale sansadhan ek no-cache lockfile entry prapt karte hain aur hamesha pratyek build par network se prapt hote hain.
  • page par Examples: SkyPack CDN package (import confetti from 'https://cdn.skypack.dev/canvas-confetti'); ek URL (import logo from 'https://example.com/assets/logo.png' + <Image src={logo} placeholder="blur" />) se static image import; CSS (background: url('https://example.com/assets/hero.jpg')) mein URL; new URL('https://example.com/assets/file.txt', import.meta.url) ke madhyam se asset import (hathe hue local path /_next/static/media/file.a9727b5d.txt print).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
URL import Next.js mein Deno-style durasth module hain - interview kon security/lockfile vyapar band hai: koi npm install nahi, lekin ab aap ek durasth server ke code par bharosa karte hain aur lockfile ko karna chahiye taaki banata hai pratilipikaran yogy offline hain.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: eksperimeintal saport for yoojing Lightning CSS (A fast Rust CSS transformer/minifier) with webpack, bajaay PostCSS.

  • Default: false — webpack par, Next.js default roop se postcss-preset-env ke saath PostCSS use karta hai. Turbopack Next 14.2 se default roop se Lightning CSS use karta hai — is option ka Turbopack par koi effect NAHI hai (ye hamesha Lightning CSS use karta hai).
  • Example (verbatim):
js
experimental: {
  useLightningcss: true, // disables PostCSS on webpack
}
  • lightningCssFeatures (v16.2.0): default roop se Lightning CSS decide karta hai ki tumhare browserslist targets ke hisaab se kaunsi CSS features transpile karni hain. Ye option use override karta hai: include specific features ko hamesha transpile karne par force karta hai (bhale hi targets unhe support karein), exclude features ko kabhi transpile na karne par force karta hai (bhale hi targets unhe support na karein). Dono webpack (jab useLightningcss on ho) aur Turbopack par lagu hote hain.
ts
experimental: {
  useLightningcss: true,
  lightningCssFeatures: {
    include: ['light-dark', 'oklab-colors'],
    exclude: ['nesting'],
  },
}
  • Available features: Individual — nesting (CSS Nesting), not-selector-list (:not multiple selectors ke saath), dir-selector (:dir()), lang-selector-list (:lang() multiple languages ke saath), is-selector (:is()), text-decoration-thickness-percent, media-interval-syntax, media-range-syntax (width >= 600px), custom-media-queries (@custom-media), clamp-function, color-function, oklab-colors (oklab()/oklch()), lab-colors, p3-colors (Display P3), hex-alpha-colors (alpha ke saath 4/8-digit hex), space-separated-color-notation (rgb(0 0 0)), font-family-system-ui, double-position-gradients, vendor-prefixes, logical-properties, light-dark (light-dark()). Composite groups — selectors (nesting, not-selector-list, dir-selector, lang-selector-list, is-selector), media-queries (media-interval-syntax, media-range-syntax, custom-media-queries), colors (color-function, oklab-colors, lab-colors, p3-colors, hex-alpha-colors, space-separated-color-notation, light-dark).
  • Version history: v14.2.0 Turbopack ke default CSS processor ko @swc/css se Lightning CSS me badla gaya (useLightningcss Turbopack par ignored); v15.1.0 useSwcCss support Turbopack se hataya gaya; v16.2.0 lightningCssFeatures joda gaya.
  • Dhyaan do / interview: webpack par useLightningcss enable karna PostCSS ko DISABLE karta hai — isliye Tailwind (jo classic setup me ek PostCSS plugin ke roop me chalta hai) aur dusre PostCSS plugins tab tak ruk jate hain jab tak reconfigure na karo. Flag asal me ek webpack-only migration path hai; Turbopack par tum pehle se Lightning CSS par ho aur sirf lightningCssFeatures matter karta hai.

useOffline (experimental)

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useOffline (experimental). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useOffline (experimental) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default, Example (verbatim), What happens when enabled, How retry works — entering offline state (two paths), The connectivity check, Backoff. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: enable offline connectivity ka pata lagane + asaphal navigation, prefetch aur Server Action requests ki automatic wapsi. iske alava Client Components mein offline state parhne ke liye useOffline hook ( next/offline se) ko expose karta hai.

  • Default: disabled. Experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. v16.x.0 me introduce hua.
  • Example (verbatim):
ts
experimental: { useOffline: true }
  • Enabled hone par kya hota hai: Next.js browser ke offline/online events sunta hai; navigation, prefetch aur Server Action requests par network failures detect karta hai; offline ke dauraan HEAD requests + backoff ke saath connectivity ke liye poll karta hai; connectivity lautne par blocked requests automatically retry karta hai; useOffline hook available karata hai.
  • Retry kaise kaam karta hai — offline state me enter karna (do paths): (1) Browser event — window.addEventListener('offline') state ko turant flip karta hai jab OS network interface down report karta hai. (2) Failed fetch — koi bhi navigation/prefetch/Server Action fetch() jo non-abort, non-timeout error se reject ho, offline state me enter karta hai (captive portals, broken DNS, dead upstream pakadta hai — aise cases jahan navigator.onLine abhi bhi true hai lekin origin unreachable hai).
  • Connectivity check: har check current page ke URL par ek single HEAD request bhejta hai, RSC header set ke saath (wahi endpoint jo navigations use karte hain), 200 ms ke baad abort hota hai. Do outcomes 'online' mane jate hain: fetch normally resolve ho jaye, YA 200 ms timeout use abort kar de (asal offline request lagbhag turant DNS/TCP error se fail hoti hai, isliye 200 ms par abhi bhi pending ka matlab hai TCP handshake successful hua aur server reachable hai). Koi aur rejection agla check schedule karta hai. Offline period ke dauraan ek successful framework fetch bhi state ko wapas online flip kar deta hai.
  • Backoff: stepped, exponential nahi, 3s par capped — attempt 1: 500 ms, 2: 1 s, 3: 2 s, 4+: 3 s. Browser ka online event wait ko short-circuit karta hai aur turant ek check chalata hai.
  • Give up karna: polling loop kabhi apne aap give up NAHI karta — ye 3 s cap par tab tak jaari rehta hai jab tak ek check succeed na ho ya page unload na ho (ghanton offline device reconnection par normally resume ho jata hai).
  • Framework requests ki retry: offline hote hue, koi bhi navigation/prefetch/Server Action agle connectivity check ke succeed hone ka wait karta hai (chahe naye issue hue hon ya connection girne par pehle se in flight the); check succeed hone par, request ek baar bina extra backoff ke chalta hai. Agar ye network error se fail ho jaye, to app offline state me phir enter karta hai aur polling restart hoti hai.
  • Reconnection par traffic (koi thundering herd nahi): offline hote hue, failed fetches browser network layer par locally reject hote hain (origin tak kabhi nahi pahunchte); polling ek samay me ek HEAD hai, har 3 s me max; return par, har pending navigation/Server Action ek baar fire hota hai (sirf last navigation attempt pending rakha jata hai; ek typical form button uski action pending hote hue disabled rehta hai); prefetches existing prefetch queue se jate hain, sab ek saath nahi. Per offline user ekmatra extra traffic HEAD polling hai, jo connectivity lautte hi band ho jata hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh Next.js ka uttar hai "kya ek flaky tren vaaee-phaaee par mere app ke liye hota hai? - sukshm design vistar 200 ms abort-as-online heuristic (pending = accessable) aur kabhi-give-up polling paas hai. yeh ek PWA serve worker ko poorak karta hai (lekin iske liye pratisthapan nahi hai) - yeh in-flight phremavark requests ko sambhalta hai, na ki asset kaishinga.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/useOffline

Purpose: ne production build ke dauraan type cheking ke liye project-local TypeScript CLI (tsc) ko chalane ke bajaay TypeScript JavaScript compiler API load karne ke liye chalaya.

TypeScript nidan seedhe tsc se mudrit kiye jate hain - Next.js-vishisht code frame aur error punarlekhan NOT lagu hote hain. configure kiye gaye tsconfig dwara chaynit COMPLETE project ki check ki jati hai, jismein testing files aur .next/dev/types shamil hote hain; --debug-build-paths is set ko simit nahi karta hai aur CLI chekar ke saath sanyukt hone par warning paida karta hai. typescript.tsconfigPath (C2.75) ne tsc ko passed project ka chayan kiya; typescript.ignoreBuildErrors puri tarah se type-cheking step ko chhor data hai, jismein CLI chekar shamil hai.

"why" TypeScript 7 (mool port) hai - iska JS API abhi tak maujud nahi hai, isliye type-check ka ekmatr tareeka tsc tak khulnaa hai. vyapar band Next.js ke sundar error frame kho raha hai aur sirph build set ke bajaay pure project (testing sahit) ki check kar raha hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Purpose: webpack configuration ko vistarit karta hai Next.js internal roop se upyog karta hai.

  • Warning pahle: webpack config mein badalta hai NOT semver dwara cover kiya gaya hai - apne jokhim par aage barhein (Next.js ek mamuli release mein apne internal webpack setup ko badal sakta hai aur apne optimization ko tor sakta hai).
  • Check first: custom webpack configuration jorne se pahle check karein ki kya Next.js pahle se hi upyog ke mamle ka support karta hai: CSS import, CSS module, Sass/SCSS import aur modyoola. common plugin ki zaroorat @next/mdx aur @next/bundle-analyzer dwara cover ki gai hai.
  • Shape (verbatim):
js
module.exports = {
  webpack: (
    config,
    { buildId, dev, isServer, defaultLoaders, nextRuntime, webpack }
  ) => {
    // Important: return the modified config
    return config
  },
}
  • Execution: webpack function server (Node.js runtime aur Edge runtime) ke liye do bar THREE bar chalata hai aur ek bar client ke liye. client banam server configuration ko alag karne ke liye isServer ka upyog karein. dusra tark gun: buildId (bilding ke beech unique pahchankarta), dev (development mein sanbandh?), isServer (server compilation ke liye route), nextRuntime ("edge") server ke liye "nodejs", client ke liye undefined), defaultLoaders (Next.js ke internal loader - defaultLoaders.babel default babel-loader config), webpack (webpack module hi) hai.
  • Example — ek loader jorne jo bebel-loader (@next/mdx plugin source se) par nirbhar karta hai:
js
module.exports = {
  webpack: (config, options) => {
    config.module.rules.push({
      test: /\.mdx/,
      use: [
        options.defaultLoaders.babel,
        {
          loader: '@mdx-js/loader',
          options: pluginOptions.options,
        },
      ],
    })

    return config
  },
}
  • Dhyaan Do: nextRuntime: "edge" vartaman mein keval Edge runtime mein proxy aur Server Components ke liye hai. hamesha RETURN sanshodhit config (sthan mein computation aur wapas lautne ke liye bhool jana classic bag hai). yeh function keval webpack builds par lagu hota hai - Turbopack iske bajaay turbopack.rules (C2.63) ka upyog karta hai, aur webpack configure ko vahan nazarandaz kar diya gaya hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
teen-invocation modal (client + nod server + Edge server) ek mahatvapurn tathy hai - ek loader jo aap sabhi teenon ke liye run jorte hain jab tak ki aap isServer/nextRuntime par get nahi karte hain, jo ki log galti se client mein Node-only code ko bundle karte hain.

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai TypeScript. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: TypeScript — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Using TypeScript 7, IDE plugin, End-to-end type safety (App Router), Route-aware type helpers, `next-env.d.ts`, Type-checking config files. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Next.js TypeScript-first — create-next-app sankul installed karta hai aur automatic roop se settings ko configure karta hai. ek maujuda project mein TS jorne ke liye, .ts/.tsx mein ek file ka naam badalakar next dev/next build — Next.js auto-install dependency ko chalate hain aur recommended vikalpon ke saath tsconfig.json jorte hain. yadi aapke paas pahle se hi ek jsconfig.json hai, to apne paths ko naye tsconfig.json mein copy karein aur jsconfig.json ko hata dein.

  • Using TypeScript 7: TS 7 koi JavaScript compiler API pradan karta hai, isliye next build default roop se project-local tsc CLI ka upyog karta hai - pnpm add -D typescript@^7 ke saath installed karein aur koi extra config ki requirement nahi hai (useTypeScriptCli, C2.79 dekhein). CLI prakar ki check print mool tsc nidan (koi Next.js code frame ya routes/pages/layouts/route handler ke liye error punarlekhan nahi) aur apne tsconfig dwara chaynit COMPLETE project ki check karta hai (jab shamil hon to testing files aur .next/dev/types sahit); next build --debug-build-paths ise sankirn nahi karta hai aur jab sanyukt hota hai to warning data hai. typescript.tsconfigPath abhi bhi tsc ko passed config ka chayan karta hai; typescript.ignoreBuildErrors CLI chekar sahit type cheking ko chhor data hai.
  • IDE plugin: Next.js ne VS Code aur any editors ke liye ek custom TS plugin/type chekar bhej diya. Command Palette → "TypeScript: Select TypeScript Version" → "Use Workspace Version" ke madhyam se VS Code mein sakshama. plugin invalid segment-configure values par warning data hai, upalabdh vikalp + in-kontekst docs dikhata hai, yeh sunishchit karta hai ki 'use client' ka sahi dhang se upyog kiya jata hai, aur client hook (e.g) ko sunishchit karta hai. useState) keval Client Components mein upyog kiya jata hai.
  • End-to-end type safety (App Router): (1) vijetaa function aur page ke beech koi dhaaraavaahikeekaran nahi - seedhe Server Components mein prapt karein aur bina string mein parivartit kiye Date, Map, Set aadi lautein (pahle aapko manual roop se server/client boundary type karna tha). (2) suvyavasthit data flow - koi _app ka matalab pages aur _app ke beech koi hard-too-type data flow nahi hai; colocated data lane ke issues ko hata data hai. full ant se ant security abhi bhi database/content provider ko TypeScript (ORM) ya type-surakshit query builder ka support karne ki requirement hai.
  • Route-aware type helpers: Next.js next dev, next build, ya next typegen: PageProps, LayoutProps, RouteContext (Part B file conventions mein varnit) ke dauraan global helper (koi import ki requirement nahi) generated karta hai.
  • next-env.d.ts: project root mein generated; sandarbh Next.js prakar paribhashaein isliye TS gair-code import (images, stylesheets) aur Next.js-vishisht prakar ko pehchanta hai. next dev, next build, next typegen dwara punarnirmita. Next.js dwara prabndhit - manual roop se NOT edit karein; ise .gitignore mein jorein (aur track kiye jaane par git se hata dein); yeh tsconfig.json ke include (create-next-app) mein hona chahiye.
  • Type-checking config files: import type { NextConfig } from 'next' ke saath next.config.ts ka prayog karein. next.config.ts mein module resolution default roop se CommonJS tak simit hai - ESM syntax Node.js mool TypeScript halkiyaa (Node v22.10.0+) ke madhyam se kaam karta hai, jise process.features.typescript ke madhyam se pata chala hai; v22.18.0+ mein default roop se enable, ya v22.10.0-22.17.x ke liye NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-transform-types ke saath chunein. CommonJS pariyojnaon ke liye, ESM sintaiks (top level await, dynamic import()) ke liye next.config.mts ko pasand karte hain; ESM pariyojnaon ("type": "module") ke liye seedhe next.config.ts likhte hain. plain JS mein, // @ts-check + /** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */ (C2.1 dekhein) ka upyog karein.
  • Statically Typed Links: ko typedRoutes: true (C2.74) + TypeScript ki requirement hoti hai. <Link href> ke liye donon routers mein kaam karta hai; App Router mein yeh next/navigation vidhiyon (push, replace, prefetch) ko bhi type karta hai - yeh Pages Router mein NOT prakar next/router methods karta hai. litaral href strings ko valid kiya gaya hai (<Link href="/aboot" /> = TypeScript error); gair-leetaral hrefs ko as Route ke saath ek cast ki requirement hoti hai. Next.js sabhi routes ko listed karne wale .next/types mein ek link paribhasha generated karta hai; gair-create-next-app pariyojnaon ko .next/types/**/*.ts ko tsconfig.json ki include ko jodna hoga. pattern: import type { Route } from 'next'; <Link href={/blog/${slug}} /> (template literal OK); <Link href={('/blog/' + slug) as Route} /> (concatenation) ko jaati ki requirement hoti hai; wrapper component ek common Route<T> | URL ka upyog karte hain; Nv-item array NavItem<Route>[] ke roop mein type kiya gaya; proxy-define redirect route (e.g). /proxy-redirect) ko as Route ki bhi requirement hai. tantr: next typegen / next dev / next build .next mein ek chhipe hue .d.ts generated karte hain, jismein sabhi vaidh routes ke saath href prakar ke hote hain.
  • Env vars ke liye Type IntelliSense: Dev ke dauraan , Next.js editor IntelliSense ke liye load kiye gaye env vars ke saath .next/types mein ek .d.ts generated karta hai. experimental.typedEnv: true + TypeScript ke saath chunein. prakar dev runtime par load kiye gaye char se aate hain - .env.production* char ko default roop se bahar rakha jata hai; unhein shamil karne ke liye NODE_ENV=production ke saath next dev chalaein.
  • Async Server Components: ko TypeScript ≥ 5.1.3 aur @types/react ≥ 18.2.8 ki requirement hoti hai - purane sanskaran 'Promise<Element>' is not a valid JSX element dete hain.
  • Incremental type check: ne v10.2.1 ke baad se support kiya jab tsconfig.json mein enable ho gaya - bare app mein type cheking ko tej karta hai.
  • Custom tsconfig path: typescript.tsconfigPath (C2.75) — e.g. tsconfigPath: 'tsconfig.build.json', ya step-nirbhar (isProd? 'tsconfig.build.json': 'tsconfig.json'). kyon: build ke liye check ko aaram (monorepo sajha deeps jo aapke standards ko pura nahi karte hain, ya local roop se sakht settings ke liye migrate karte samay CI check ko dheelaa nahi karte hain) - e.g. ek build config "useUnknownInCatchVariables": false ke saath aadhar ko vistarit karta hai. aaeedeeee abhi bhi tsconfig.json parhte hain, isliye editor warning sakht rahti hai jabki production mein aaram se settings ka upyog hota hai. Caveats: dev mein, keval tsconfig.json ko dekha jata hai - ek optional file edit karne ke baad dev server ko phir se shuru karein; configure ki gai file ka upyog next dev, next build aur next typegen mein kiya jata hai.
  • Disabling TS errors production mein: Same as C2.75 — typescript.ignoreBuildErrors: true (!! WARN!! tippniyon ke saath); yadi aap iska upyog karte hain to CI mein khud ko chalaein. tsc --noEmit
  • Custom prakar declarations: NEVER edit next-env.d.ts (auto-generated, atirnjit). apni khud ki file (e.g) banaein. new-types.d.ts) aur ise next-env.d.ts aur .next/types/**/*.ts ke saath tsconfig.json ke include mein joda gaya.
  • Version history: v10.2.1 vriddhishil prakar ki check; v12.0.0 SWC default roop se TS/TSX compiled karta hai; v13.2.0 static roop se type link (beta); v15.0.0 next.config.ts samarthana.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
do "janit prakar" kahaaniyaan - route prakar (.next/types) aur env-var prakar (experimental.typedEnv) - donon next dev / next build / next typegen kodjen se aate hain, yahi karan hai ki next typegen ek standalone command ke roop mein maujud hai. aur TS 7 kahani: koi JS compiler API → tsc (C2.79) ko shell dein.

ESLint

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai ESLint. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: ESLint — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Three configs, `next lint` is REMOVED, Setup (flat config, verbatim), Monorepo root directory, Disabling rules, With TypeScript. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Next.js eslint-config-next pradan karta hai, ek ESLint config package jo common muddon ko pakadta hai. yeh @next/eslint-plugin-next plugin ke saath-saath eslint-plugin-react aur eslint-plugin-react-hooks se recommended niyam set ko bundle karta hai.

  • Three configs: eslint-config-next (base — Next.js + React + React hook niyam; JS aur TS filein); eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals (bes + upgrade niyam warning se Core Web Vitals ko affected karte hain - adhikansh pariyojnaon ke liye recommended; naye create-next-app app mein auto-shamil); eslint-config-next/typescript (TypeScript-vishisht niyam typescript-eslint se, plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended par aadharit; bes ya kor-web-viton ke saath upyog karein).
  • next lint REMOVED: Next.js 16, next lint ke saath shuru hua aur next.config.js mein eslint vikalp ki zaroorat nahi hai - ise hata dein. linting ab seedhe ESLint CLI ke saath kiya jata hai ( se ESLint CLI tak migrate karne ke liye ek codemod maujud hai). next lint
  • Setup (flat config, kriyaasheel):
bash
pnpm add -D eslint eslint-config-next
js
// eslint.config.mjs
import { defineConfig, globalIgnores } from 'eslint/config'
import nextVitals from 'eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals'

const eslintConfig = defineConfig([
  ...nextVitals,
  // Override default ignores of eslint-config-next.
  globalIgnores([
    // Default ignores of eslint-config-next:
    '.next/**',
    'out/**',
    'build/**',
    'next-env.d.ts',
  ]),
])

export default eslintConfig

pnpm exec eslint. (ya npx eslint.) ke saath bhag lein. nots: eslint-config-next ESLint 9 aur 10 (ESLint 10 ki zaroorat Node ^20.19.0, ^22.13.0, ya >=24); eslint-config-next@16.4.0 ke baad se, ESLint 10 ke saath default React sanskaran ka pata lagane ka kaam karta hai (kisi bhi settings.react.version workaround ko context.getFilename error ke liye joda gaya); kuchh shamil plagins abhi tak sahakarmi deeps mein ESLint 10 ko listed nahi karte hain, isliye package mainejar sahakarmi warning dikha sakte hain ya sakht sahakarmi ke saath fail ho sakte hain.

  • Included @next/eslint-plugin-next niymon (sabhi recommended config mein): google-font-display (Google Fonts ke saath font-display ko lagu karein), google-font-preconnect (Google Fonts ke saath preconnect ko lagu karein), inline-script-id (X par id ko inline content ke saath lagu karein), next-script-for-ga (inline Google Analytics ke liye next/script), no-assign-module-variable, no-async-client-component (Client Components) pages ko nahi hona chahiye), no-before-interactive-script-outside-document, no-css-tags (koi manual stylesheet tag nahi), no-document-import-in-page, no-img-element (Use next/image - dhimi LCP + anyatha baindvidth), no-page-custom-font, no-script-component-in-head, no-styled-jsx-in-document, no-sync-scripts, no-title-in-document-head, no-typos (data-fetching function namon mein aam typos), no-unwanted-polyfillio (koi dupliket Polyfill.io polyfill nahi). warnings/errors inline dekhne ke liye ek editor ekikaran ka upyog karein. no-duplicate-head no-head-element no-head-import-in-document no-html-link-for-pages <Link> <a> next/script
  • Monorepo root directory: yadi Next.js root mein installed nahi hai, to us plugin ko bataaein jahan yeh app settings.next.rootDir ('packages/my-app/') ke madhyam se hai. "packages/*/"
  • Disabling niymon: eslint.config.mjs rules (e.g) mein ovararaaida. 'react/no-unescaped-entities': 'off', '@next/next/no-page-custom-font': 'off'.
  • TypeScript ke saath : ...nextVitals ke baad eslint-config-next/typescript se ...nextTs jorein. TypeScript 7 gotcha: eslint-config-next ko abhi bhi typescript-eslint ke liye TS 6 compiler API ki requirement hai - TS 7 ko seedhe typescript brek ESLint config loading ke roop mein installed karna. npm ke saath, package.json mein alias: "@typescript/native": "npm:typescript@7.0.2" aur "typescript": "npm:@typescript/typescript6@6.0.2" — TS 6 API linting tool ke liye, tsc TS 7 chalata hai; tsc6 TS 6 chalata hai (maaikrosopht side-baay-side setup; taaipaskript-eslaaint traiks mool TS 7 support jari karne ke liye #10940).
  • With Prettier: jorein eslint-config-prettier/flat (eslint-config-prettier installed karein) AFTER ko Next.js config isliye iske formatting niyam Prettier ke saath sangharsh nahi karte hain.
  • lint-staged: .lintstagedrc.js ke saath *.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}: [buildEslintCommand] chal raha hai eslint --fix manchan files para.
  • Migrating an maujuda config — do drishtikon: (1) plugin seedhe - akele @next/eslint-plugin-next ka upyog karein (...nextPlugin.configs.recommended.rules ke saath) jab aapke paas pahle se hi sangharshasheel plagins (airbnb, react-app, ya alag react / react-hooks / jsx-a11y / import), custom parserOptions (custom Babel configuration), ya custom halkon ke saath eslint-plugin-import hai - do bar usi plugins/parsers ko import karne se takrav se bach jata hai. (2) apne array mein eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals se config — ...nextConfig ko phailayein; ESLint kram mein config lagu karta hai, isliye baad mein pahle wale logon ko override karta hai. saral setup ke liye achha; jatil sangharsh setup seedhe plugin ka upyog karna chahiye.
  • Version history: v16.0.0 next lint + eslint config vikalp hata diya gaya; v16.4.0 ESLint 10 compatibility + default React sanskaran ka pata lagana.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Next.js 16 mein headline parivartan yeh hai ki linting ne phremavark chhor diya - next lint chala gaya hai, ESLint ek standalone CLI hai jo ek phlait config ke saath chinta karta hai. sabse interview prasangik niyam ve hain jo Next.js ko sarvottam prathaon ko kodit karte hain: no-img-element (next/image ka upyog karein), no-html-link-for-pages (<Link> ka upyog karein), no-async-client-component (keval server par async). # C4. CLI

Asaan bhasha me samjho: create-next-app — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Basic usage (verbatim), Options, Interactive prompts, Linter options, Examples. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: platform CLI — default template se ek naya Next.js app banaein ya ek public GitHub repo se ek udaharan banaein. shuru karne ka sabse aasan tareeka.

  • Basic upyog (verbatim):
bash
pnpm create next-app [project-name] [options]
npx create-next-app@latest [project-name] [options]
yarn create next-app [project-name] [options]
bun create next-app [project-name] [options]
  • Options: -h/--help, -v/--version; --no-* negets default (e.g). --no-ts; --ts/--typescript (default), --js/--javascript; --tailwind (default); --react-compiler; --cache-components (App Router ke liye default); --eslint, --biome, --no-linter; --app (App Router), --api (ROute-handlers-only project); --src-dir; --turbopack() --yes (sabhi vikalpon ke liye pichli priorities ya chookon ka upyog karein). --webpack --import-alias <alias> @/* --empty --use-npm/--use-pnpm/--use-yarn/--use-bun -e/--example [name] [github-url] --example-path <path> --reset-preferences --skip-install --disable-git --agents-md AGENTS.md --agent-feedback --no-agent-feedback Next.js C2.3
  • interactive sanket: "aapki project ka naam kya hai? → "kya aap recommended Next.js default ka upyog karna chahte hain? han, recommended chookon ka upyog karein (TypeScript, ESLint, No React Compiler, Tailwind CSS, No src/ directory, App Router, Cache Components, AGENTS.md, agent feedback) / No, pichli settings ka pun: upyog karein / No, settings ko customize karein. optimization puchhta hai: TypeScript? Linter (ESLint / Biome / koi nahi)? React Compiler? Tailwind CSS? src/ directory? App Router? Cache Components? Alia import? AGENTS.md shamil hain? agent feedback ke madhyam se Next.js ko behatar banane mein madad karein ( experimental.agentFeedback: false ke saath kabhi bhi disabled)?
  • Linter vikalp: ESLint (traditional, @next/eslint-plugin-next niymon ke saath - C3.2 dekhein); Biome ( + Prettier ke sanyojan ke tezi se aadhunik linter+formatter, built-in Next.js / React support ke saath); non (skip - baad mein ek linter jorein). ESLint
  • Examples: official udaharan - pnpm create next-app --example [example-name] [your-project-name] (github.com/vercel/next.js/tree/canary/examples). kisi bhi public GitHub udaharan - --example "https://github.com/.../" [your-project-name].
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
16.x mein recommended default dhanche ki disha ki kahani batate hain: TypeScript + Tailwind + App Router + Cache Components + Turbopack + AGENTS.md + agent pheedbaika. not --agents-md/--agent-feedback 16.x yug mein naye hain - CLI ab default roop se AI-agent ergonomics machaanaa (aur --no-agents-md opt-out hai, C2.4 dekhein).

next CLI

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai next CLI. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: next CLI — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Commands, `next dev` options, `next build` options, `next start` options, `next info`, `next telemetry`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: main next CLI — viksit, build, prarambh, inspect aur apne aavedan ka prabandhana. mool upyog pnpm next [command] [options] (npm: npx next; yarn: yarn next; ban: bunx next). npm run ke saath, -- ke saath CLI flag to npm unhein aage badhata hai. koi order ke saath Running next next dev. ke liye ek aaliyaa hai

  • Commands: dev (HMR ke saath dev mode, error riporting); build (customize production build, root tebal); start (production server - pahla build); info (system/package) bag report ke liye vivaran); telemetry (enable/disable anonymous telemetry); typegen (ek full build ke bina TS paribhasha generated); upgrade ( latest ke liye upgrade); analyze (Turbopack bundle vishleshan; koi build artifacts).
  • next dev vikalp: [directory]; --turbopack (default on; alias --turbo) / --webpack; -p/--port (default 3000, env PORT); -H/--hostname (default 0.0.0.0); --experimental-https (+ --experimental-https-key/cert/ca custom certs ke liye); --experimental-upload-trace <traceUrl>; --experimental-cpu-prof (V8 profile bahar nikalane par .next-profiles/). Dev .next/dev E (No .next) ko output banata hai, isliye next dev aur next build concurrent roop se chal sakte hain.
  • next build vikalp: --turbopack (default) / --webpack; --analyze (ek Turbopack build ke dauraan bundle vishleshan data); -d/--debug (verbose production - punarlekhan, punarnirdeshan, header); --profile (React Profiler); --no-mangling (keval DEbug); --experimental-app-only (App Router keval); --experimental-build-mode [mode] (compile) output root tebal ka build karein: ○ static (prerendered), ƒ dynamic (server-rendered). generate default --debug-prerender --debug-build-paths=<patterns> --experimental-cpu-prof
  • next start vikalp: -p/--port, -H/--hostname, --keepAliveTimeout <ms> (adhikatam emayes inactive kanekshan band karne se pahle - neeche proxy timeout udaharan dekhein), --experimental-cpu-prof.
  • next info: print OS platform/arch/version, memory/CPU, Binaries (Node, npm, yarn, pnpm), prasangik package sanskaran (next, react, react-dom, typescript, eslint-config-next), aur Next.js vinyas. ise ek GitHub issues ko kholne ke dauraan shamil karein. --verbose adhik ekatr karta hai.
  • next telemetry: puri tarah se anonymous upyog telemetry; --enable / --disable.
  • next typegen (v15.5.0): routes, pages, layout aur ek full build ke bina route handler ke liye TypeScript paribhasha generated karta hai - production ko <distDir>/types (.next/dev/types in Dev, .next/types in prod), saath hi ek generated next-env.d.ts (jitar ise); yeh tsconfig.json mein shamil hai). CI mein upyog karein: next typegen && tsc --noEmit. pahle prakar keval dev/build. gotcha ke dauraan dikhai diya: yeh production build step ka upyog karke next.config ko load karta hai - required env vars/deps upalabdh hona chahiye.
  • next upgrade (v16.1.0): app ko upgrade karta hai. vikalp: --revision <revision> (latest, canary, 15.0.0); aapke vartaman release chainal mein default, --verbose, --agent [type] — ek coding agent (security, latest, experimental-future) ke saath upgrade; experimental.agentUpgrade config ya security ke liye default; --revision ke saath sanyukt nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • next analyze (v16.1.0; v16.4.0 mein export): E ne Turbopack ke saath bundle output ka vishleshan kiya - JS, CSS aur any assets ka size aur structure; NOT ek build ka production karta hai. default roop se root dwara filtar karne ke liye ek interactive UI ke saath ek local server (port 4000, env PORT) shuru hota hai, client/server vicharon ko svich karta hai, ek module ke liye full import shrinkhla ko dekhta hai, aur server → client boundaries aur dynamic aayaton par import karta hai. vikalp: --no-mangling, --profile, -o/--output (Save snapshot + UI) bina serve ke <distDir>/diagnostics/analyze ko filein), --snapshot <name>, --port. next analyze export: ek maujuda snapshot ko JSON lines (koi vishleshan nahi, koi UI): --snapshot <name> (naye se adhik ke liye dosh), --route <route> (ek route par pratibandh laga diya gaya hai, phir bhi ismein full module graph shamil hain), --dist-dir <directory>.
  • Examples — debugging prerender errors: next build --debug-prerender disables server minification (experimental.serverMinification = false, experimental.turbopackMinify = false), server source map generated karta hai, aur pathniy stack nishan ke liye pahli prerender error (experimental.prerenderEarlyExit = false) ko jari rakhta hai. keval development - aise build ko deploy nahi karte hain.
  • Building vishisht routes: next build --debug-build-paths="app/page.tsx" (comma-separated, app/**/page.tsx, ! prefix jaise glob, e.g). "app/**/page.tsx,!app/admin/**"; src/ upasarg ke saath ya uske bina kaam karta hai; route talika mein keval match route dikhai dete hain, saath hi built-in /_not-found). --debug-prerender ke saath milakara.
  • port: next dev -p 4000 ya PORT=4000 next dev. Dhyaan Do: PORT ko .env E mein set nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - any code shuru hone se pahle HTTP server joote.
  • development mein HTTPS: next dev --experimental-https https://localhost:3000 par ek sva-sign pramaan generated karta hai; --experimental-https-key / --experimental-https-cert / --experimental-https-ca ke madhyam se custom certs. dev keval - production mein theek se jari certs ka upyog karein. mkcert
  • Downstream proxy timeout: jab ek load baileinsar (AWS ELB/ALB) ke pichhe, ne proxy (next start --keepAliveTimeout 70000) ki tulna mein agla ke live timeout LARGER set kiya, anyatha Node ek kanekshan ko samapt karta hai jo proxy abhi bhi sochtaa hai ki jivit hai aur pun: upyog par proxy errors hain.
  • passing Node args: NODE_OPTIONS='--throw-deprecation' next, NODE_OPTIONS='--inspect' next, aadi.
  • CPU profiling: dev/build/start par --experimental-cpu-prof; .cpuprofile files ko Chrome DevTools performance tab mein khula hai. file upasarg: dev-main-* / dev-server-* (server ek ka vishleshan), build-main-* / build-turbopack-* ya build-webpack-client-*/server-*/edge-server-*, start-main-*.
  • Version history: v16.0.0 JS bundle size metric next build se hata diya gaya; v15.5.0 next typegen; v15.4.0 --debug-prerender; v16.1.0 next upgrade, next experimental-analyze; v16.4.0 next analyze export.

Adapters — Creating an Adapter

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Creating an Adapter. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Creating an Adapter — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The interface (verbatim, key parts), Minimal adapter (verbatim structure), How it works step by step. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: An adapter ek module hai jo NextAdapter intarafes ko lagu karne wali object ka export karta hai, jise next package (import type { NextAdapter } from 'next') se ek prakar ke roop mein import kiya jata hai.

  • The intarafes (verbatim, key bhagon):
typescript
export interface NextAdapter {
  name: string
  modifyConfig?: (
    config: NextConfigComplete,
    ctx: { phase: PHASE_TYPE; nextVersion: string; projectDir: string }
  ) => Promise<NextConfigComplete> | NextConfigComplete
  onBuildComplete?: (ctx: {
    routing: {
      beforeMiddleware: Array<Route>
      middlewareMatchers: Array<Route>
      beforeFiles: Array<Route>
      afterFiles: Array<Route>
      dynamicRoutes: Array<Route>
      onMatch: Array<Route>
      fallback: Array<Route>
      shouldNormalizeNextData: boolean
      rsc: RoutesManifest['rsc']
    }
    outputs: AdapterOutputs
    projectDir: string
    repoRoot: string
    distDir: string
    config: NextConfigComplete
    nextVersion: string
    buildId: string
  }) => Promise<void> | void
}

Route mein source?, sourceRegex, destination?, headers?, has?/missing? (RouteHas[]), status?, priority? hai. AdapterOutputs group pages, middleware?, appPages, pagesApi, appRoutes, prerenders, staticFiles.

  • Minimal adapter (verbatim structure):
js
// my-adapter.js
/** @type {import('next').NextAdapter} */
const adapter = {
  name: 'my-custom-adapter',
  async modifyConfig(config, { phase }) {
    if (phase === 'phase-production-build') {
      return { ...config /* your modifications */ }
    }
    return config
  },
  async onBuildComplete({ routing, outputs, projectDir, repoRoot, distDir, config, nextVersion, buildId }) {
    console.log('Build completed with', outputs.pages.length, 'pages')
    console.log('Build ID:', buildId)
    console.log('Dynamic routes:', routing.dynamicRoutes.length)
    for (const page of outputs.pages) console.log('Page:', page.pathname, 'at', page.filePath)
    for (const apiRoute of outputs.pagesApi) console.log('API Route:', apiRoute.pathname, 'at', apiRoute.filePath)
    for (const appPage of outputs.appPages) console.log('App Page:', appPage.pathname, 'at', appPage.filePath)
    for (const prerender of outputs.prerenders) console.log('Prerendered:', prerender.pathname)
  },
}
module.exports = adapter
  • kaise yeh kadam se kadam kaam karta hai: modifyConfig config ke dauraan chalata hai - yeh hal NextConfigComplete plus build step (phase-production-build, aadi), Next.js sanskaran, aur project dir, aur (possibly sanshodhit) config wapas aata hai. build ke baad onBuildComplete run - yeh full routing tebal (sabhi steps) prapt karta hai, pratyek build production ko prakar, project/repo/dist dirs, antim config, sanskaran aur build ID dwara grouped kiya jata hai, aur kuchh bhi nahi data hai (keval side iphekt, e.g. lekhan manch deployment prakat hota hai).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
ek adapter ek hosting platform (e.g) hai. Cloudflare, Netlify, AWS) apne buniyadi dhanche ke bare mein Next.js sikhata hai - do hook configure-time (modifyConfig) aur post-build (onBuildComplete) hain; routing step aur output prakar anubandh hain jo ek manch ko apne khud ke primitives (karya, static hosting, punarlekhan) mein ek Next.js ka anuvad karne data hai. full vivaran ke liye C5.4 (API sandarbh), C5.10 (output prakar), C5.11 (routing jankari) dekhein.
