Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — API Reference. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — API Reference — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `async modifyConfig(config, context)`, `async onBuildComplete(context)`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: sandarbh NextAdapter intarafes ke do hook ke liye.

  • async modifyConfig(config, context): ne kisi bhi CLI command ke liye call kiya jo next.config.js ko load karta hai, jisse adapter ko configuration ko sanshodhit karne ki permission milti hai. parameters: config (full Next.js config object); context.phase (vartaman build step), phase docs ko next.config.js page par dekhein); context.nextVersion; context.projectDir (project ka rasta). sanshodhit config object (async ho sakta hai) return karta hai.
  • async onBuildComplete(context): ne build pura hone ke baad, routes aur output ke bare mein vistrit jankari ke saath call kiya. parameters: context.routing — routing step aur metadata: beforeMiddleware (mediation se pahle executed roots), middlewareMatchers (mediation maichar paribhashaein — yeh tay karne ke liye upyog kiya jata hai ki kisi request ke liye midalaveyar run karta hai), beforeFiles (file system root match se pahle check kiye gaye routes ko phir se likhna), afterFiles (faain system maiching ke baad check kiye gaye routes), dynamicRoutes (dynamic root matching tebal), onMatch (ek saphal match ke baad lagu roots, e.g. imyootebal static asset cache header), fallback (antim phir likhne wale fallback raaste), shouldNormalizeNextData (chahe /_next/data/<buildId>/... URL ko samanyikrit kiya jana chahiye); rsc (React Server Components routing ke liye root metadata). plus: context.outputs (sabhi prakar ke dwara aayojit production production ka build), projectDir, repoRoot (anusuchit repositree root ke liye path) distDir (build output directory ke liye path ko alag karein), config (antim config, modifyConfig lagu ke saath), nextVersion, buildId (vartaman build ke liye unique pahchankarta).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
routing step request pipeline ki tarah padha - beforeMiddleware → midalaveyar → beforeFiles → file system match → afterFiles → dynamicRoutes → onMatch → Fallback. ek adapter ka kaam in steps ka anuvad karne ke saath-saath host platform ke apne routing primitives mein type kiye gaye output ka anuvad karna hai.

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Testing Adapters. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Testing Adapters — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Harness environment variables, Deploy script contract, Logs script contract, Cleanup script contract. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Next.js edeptar ko valid karne ke liye ek testing dohan pradan karta hai - apne adapter ke khilaf dhanche ke end-to-end deployment parikshanon ko chala raha hai.

  • Example GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/test-e2e-deploy.yml): do jobs. build: adapter repo aur vercel/next.js repo (ek nextjsRef workflow input se ref, default canary) checkout karta hai, Next.js install/build karta hai (Node 20, corepack ke through pnpm), Playwright Chromium install karta hai, adapter build karta hai, phir nextjs, adapter aur ~/.cache/ms-playwright ko key build-<sha>-<run_id> ke tahat cache karta hai. test: 16 groups ka matrix (1/16... 16/16, fail-fast: false), cache restore karta hai, adapter/scripts/e2e-deploy.sh, e2e-logs.sh, e2e-cleanup.sh ko executable banata hai aur node run-tests.js --timings -g <group> -c 2 --type e2e chalata hai env ke saath: NEXT_TEST_MODE=deploy, NEXT_E2E_TEST_TIMEOUT=240000, NEXT_EXTERNAL_TESTS_FILTERS=test/deploy-tests-manifest.json, ADAPTER_DIR=<workspace>/adapter, IS_TURBOPACK_TEST=1, NEXT_TEST_JOB=1, NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 aur teen script paths.
  • Harness environment variables: NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_SCRIPT_PATH (executable jo isolated test app banata aur deploy karta hai), NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_LOGS_SCRIPT_PATH (us deployment ke build/runtime logs return karta hai), NEXT_TEST_CLEANUP_SCRIPT_PATH (optional — run ke baad deployment ko teardown karta hai).
  • Deploy script contract (NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_SCRIPT_PATH, cwd = harness ke banaye isolated temporary app ke saath chalta hai): failure par non-zero exit karo; stdout me SIRF deployment URL print karo (harness usi se verify karta hai); diagnostics stderr ya working directory ki files me likho; baad me chahiye wala data (build IDs, server logs) working directory ki files me persist karo, kyunki deploy aur logs scripts alag processes ke roop me chalte hain. Example: package.json me adapter ko file: dependency ke roop me jodo, export NEXT_ADAPTER_PATH="${ADAPTER_DIR}/dist/index.js", pnpm build, BUILD_ID, DEPLOYMENT_ID aur NEXT_SUPPORTS_IMMUTABLE_ASSETS ("1" set karo agar adapter immutable static assets enable karta hai, warna "0") .adapter-build.log me likho, phir deploy karo aur URL echo karo.
  • Logs script contract (NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_LOGS_SCRIPT_PATH, NEXT_TEST_DIR aur NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_URL receive karta hai): output me BUILD_ID:, DEPLOYMENT_ID:, NEXT_SUPPORTS_IMMUTABLE_ASSETS: se shuru hone wali lines shamil honi chahiye — phir koi bhi additional build/server logs. Pattern: deploy script .adapter-build.log / .adapter-server.log likhta hai; logs script unhe cat karke wapas deta hai.
  • Cleanup script contract (NEXT_TEST_CLEANUP_SCRIPT_PATH, NEXT_TEST_DIR aur NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_URL milta hai): deploy script dwara banaye gaye resources saaf karo; tests poore hone ke baad chalta hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
adapter validation ek actual e2e deployment paas hai - dohan aapke adapter ke saath ek throw karne wala app banata hai, ise aapki script ke madhyam se deploy karta hai, aur live URL ke khilaf Next.js ke apne pariniyojit testing prakat (16 shards) ko chalata hai. teen-script anubandh (deploy → URL on stdout, logs → teen marker laainein, cleanup) intarafes ko yaad rakhne ke liye hai.

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Routing with @next/routing. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Routing with @next/routing — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works (verbatim pattern), `resolveRoutes()` returns, Worked example. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: @next/routing npm package ek adapter ko Next.js root-maiching behavior ko pun: pesh karne data hai, iske bajaay host platform par router ko phir se lagu karne ke bajaay, onBuildComplete se data ka upyog karte hue.

  • yah kaise kaam karta hai (verbatim pattern):
typescript
import { resolveRoutes } from '@next/routing'

const pathnames = [
  ...outputs.pages,
  ...outputs.pagesApi,
  ...outputs.appPages,
  ...outputs.appRoutes,
  ...outputs.staticFiles,
].map((output) => output.pathname)

const result = await resolveRoutes({
  url: new URL(requestUrl),
  buildId,
  basePath: config.basePath || '',
  i18n: config.i18n,
  headers: new Headers(requestHeaders),
  requestBody, // ReadableStream
  pathnames,
  routes: routing,
  invokeMiddleware: async (ctx) => {
    // platform-specific middleware invocation
    return {}
  },
})

if (result.resolvedPathname) {
  console.log('Resolved pathname:', result.resolvedPathname)
  console.log('Resolved query:', result.resolvedQuery)
  console.log('Invocation target:', result.invocationTarget)
}

ise request URL/headers/body, build ID, basePath/i18n se config, sabhi output pathnames, onBuildComplete se full routing objekt aur ek pletform-vishisht invokeMiddleware kolbaika.

  • resolveRoutes() return: middlewareResponded (true) jab midalaveyar pahle se hi ek pratikriya bhejta hai - adapter ko NOT ko ek entry point ka invocation karna hoga); externalRewrite (A URL) jab routing kisi external punarlekhan destination ke liye hal ho jati hai); redirect ({ url: URL, status }) jab request ko redirect kiya jana chahiye); resolvedPathname ( match route template, e.g). dynamic routes ke liye /blog/[slug]; resolvedQuery (rewrites/middleware ke baad antim query ne khoj param ko joda ya replace kiya); invocationTarget (concrete pathname + query inkol karne ke liye); resolvedHeaders (A Headers objekt vid header added/modified) routing ke dauraan; status (HTTP sthiti routing dwara set, e.g) ek redirect/rewrite niyam se; routeMatches (named maichon ko dynamic segments se nikala gaya).
  • Worked udaharan: /blog/post-1?draft=1 matching /blog/[slug]?slug=post-1 resolvedPathname = /blog/[slug] data hai jabki invocationTarget.pathname = /blog/post-1 — template banam. concrete path ko bulane ke liye.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh key adapter bilding block hai - iske bajaay Next.js routing steps ko platform config (C5.4/C5.11 dekhein) mein traanslet karne ke bajaay, ek adapter request samay par actual routing lojik chala sakta hai aur sirph entry point ko bula sakta hai. resolvedPathname (template) aur invocationTarget (concrete) ke beech antar vahi hai jo Next.js mein kahin bhi dynamic routes ko debugging karte samay mayne rakhta hai.

Adapters — Implementing PPR in an Adapter

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Implementing PPR in an Adapter. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Implementing PPR in an Adapter — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Step 1 — Seed shell + postponed state at build time. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: kaise ek adapter Partial Prerendering (PPR) ka support karta hai, jo fallback output aur cache hook ka upyog karta hai. partial roop se prerender kiye gaye app routes ke liye, onBuildComplete aapko outputs.prerenders[].fallback.filePath data hai (prithveedaar fallback ke shell, e.g). HTML) aur outputs.prerenders[].fallback.postponedState (serialized sthagit state rendering ko phir se shuru karne ke liye istemal kiya).

  • Step 1 - beej shell + build samay par sthagit state: mein onBuildComplete, ek fallback ke saath pratyek prerender ke liye, fallback.filePath se shell HTML ko padha aur ise path naam ke tahat platform cache mein store karein, postponedState, initialHeaders, initialStatus, initialRevalidate aur initialExpiration ke saath milakara.
  • Step 2 - Runtime flow: cached shell ki serve karein aur background mein phir se shuru karein: request samay par, adapter ONE pratikriya ko stream karta hai jo (1) ka sanyojan hai cached HTML shell stream aur (2) phir se shuru kiye gaye render stream (anupryukt state ke saath entry point handler ko invited karke generated). phlo: client GET /ppr-route → adapter router ne cached shell + postponedState ko platform cache se parh liya hai → responseStream = concat(shellStream, resumedStream) banata hai → shell ko turant client (pahli bytes) ke liye pipe karna shuru kar data hai → handler(req, res, { requestMeta: { postponed } }) ko invited karta hai → stream mein phir se shuru hone wale hisse ko render karta hai. client ko ek single HTTP pratikriya ke roop mein [shell bytes........][resumed bytes........] prapt hota hai.
  • Step 3 - requestMeta.onCacheEntryV2: ke saath cache ko update karein jab ek pratikriya cache entry ko dekha ya generated kiya jata hai - update shell/postponed data jari rakhne ke liye iska upyog karein. handler ko run karte samay postponed: cachedPprEntry?.postponedState aur onCacheEntryV2 callback ko requestMeta mein paas karein. callback mein, yadi cacheEntry.value?.kind === 'APP_PAGE', HTML (cacheEntry.value.html.toUnchunkedString()) ko nikalta hai aur meta.url || req.url || '/' ke tahat platform cache ke liye { shell: html, postponedState: cacheEntry.value.postponed, headers, status, cacheControl } ko jari rakhta hai. Return false jab tak adapter ne pahle hi pratikriya khud hi likhi to (true laghu-parivartit common Next.js pratikriya flow). dhyaan dein: requestMeta.onCacheEntry abhi bhi kaam karta hai lekin ise deprecated kiya gaya hai - onCacheEntryV2 ko pasand karte hain; agar adapter ke paas ek internal onCacheCallback amoorttaa hai, to ise onCacheEntryV2 par vaayar karein.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
ek adapter mein PPR ek do tarphaa anubandh hai - samay ke beej ka build shell + sthagit state ke saath cache, request samay dharaon ke baad phir se shuru hota hai. onCacheEntryV2 return value (true = adapter ne ise sambhala, false = common flow jari rakha) ek prakar ka vistar hai jo ek hath se lahraate hue ek se actual karyanvayan ko alag karta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/adapters/implementing-ppr-in-an-adapter

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Runtime Integration. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Runtime Integration — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The split, Handler context, PPR chain headers. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: kaise build-time adapter aur runtime cache intaraphes ek saath kaam karte hain - full manch ekikaran sataha.

  • The vibhajan: The Deployment Adapter API ek build-time intarafes hai - yeh manch batata hai ki kya banaya gaya tha aur kaise requests ko root karne ke liye. Runtime behavior (request handling, streaming, caching) ko khud Next.js server dwara controlled kiya jata hai aur cache intaraphes cacheHandler ( incrementalCacheHandlerPath dekhein) aur cacheHandlers (C2.11 dekhein) dwara controlled kiya jata hai. saath mein: Adapter (build-time) prakriyaaein production ka build karti hain, routing ko configure karti hain, pletform-vishisht buniyadi dhanche ko installed karti hain; Cache Interfaces (runtime) - cacheHandler ISR/server cache storej ka prabandhan karta hai aur udaharanon mein revalidation; cacheHandlers 'use cache' directive backend aur tag samanvay ko configure karta hai. C2.11/legacy
  • Handler sandarbh: jab access points ko run karte hain, to edeptar Next.js handler ko ctx objekt paas karte hain. key field: ctx.waitUntil — ek function ek Promise accept; prayog yeh server rahit karya ko jivit rakhne ke baad pratikriya bheja jata hai to background kaam jaise cache revalidation pura kar sakte hain. requestMeta.onCacheEntryV2 (addRequestMeta ke madhyam se set) - ek callback jo cache entry generated hone ya dekhne par aag lagata hai; ise ALL cache opreshan (keval PPR) ka inspect karne aur platform ke storej backend ko cache update karne ke liye upyog karein. yeh us udaharan par aag lagata hai jo request ko sambhalta hai - multi-insteins deployment ke liye adapter ko sajha storage ("How Revalidation Works" guide for samanvay pattern) ke liye update ka prachar karna hoga.
  • PPR chen header: prerender output prakar mein, pprChain.headers mein phir se shuru protokol ke liye required hai - vishesh roop se { 'next-resume': '1' }. jab adapter ek cached static shell ke saath ek PPR-enable route ka pata lagata hai: (1) pprChain.headers ko Next.js handler ke internal request par set karta hai; (2) request ko postponedState ke saath ek POST ke roop mein request bhejte hain; (3) handler keval deferred Suspense boundaries ko render karta hai aur parinam ko stream karta hai. not: manak next start mein, server automatic roop se ek paas mein shell aur dynamic render donon ko sambhalta hai - phir se shuru protokol adapter-aadharit deployment aur CDN-to-origin architecture ke liye hai jo shell ko alag se parosnaa chahte hain ( PPR Platform Guide dekhein).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
adapter/cache vibhajan mental modal hai - adapter build-time hain, cache handler runtime hain. waitUntil server rahit jivan kaal ke bache hue haich hai, aur onCacheEntryV2 har cache opreshan ke liye prachlit hook hai, na keval PPR.

Adapters — Invoking Entrypoints

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Invoking Entrypoints. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Invoking Entrypoints — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Edge runtime (`runtime: 'edge'`) — DEPRECATED. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: build output entrypoints ek handler(..., ctx) intarafes ka upyog karte hain, jismein runtime-vishisht request/response prakar hote hain.

  • Node.js runtime (runtime: 'nodejs') - intarafes (verbatim):
typescript
handler(
  req: IncomingMessage,
  res: ServerResponse,
  ctx: {
    waitUntil?: (promise: Promise<void>) => void
    requestMeta?: RequestMeta
  }
): Promise<void>

jab seedhe Node.js access points ko run karte hain, to adapter seedhe internal par bharosa karne ke bajaay requestMeta par sahayakon ko paas kar sakte hain. supported kshetron mein hostname, revalidate aur render404 shamil hain:

ts
await handler(req, res, {
  requestMeta: {
    // Relative path from process.cwd() to the Next.js project directory.
    relativeProjectDir: '.',
    // Optional hostname used by route handlers when constructing absolute URLs.
    hostname: '127.0.0.1',
    // Optional internal revalidate function to avoid revalidating over the network
    revalidate: async ({ urlPath, headers, opts }) => {
      // platform-specific revalidate implementation
    },
    // Optional function to render the 404 page for pages router `notFound: true`
    render404: async (req, res, parsedUrl, setHeaders) => {
      // platform-specific 404 rendering implementation
    },
  },
})

prasangik kor template: packages/next/src/build/templates/app-page.ts, app-route.ts, pages-api.ts.

  • Edge runtime (runtime: 'edge') - DEPRECATED: Edge Runtime ko deprecated kiya gaya hai; naye routes ko Node.js runtime ka upyog karna chahiye. Edge entrypoints handler(request: Request, ctx: { waitUntil?, signal?: AbortSignal, requestMeta? }): Promise<Response> - saman handler(..., ctx) size, vibhinn request/response aadi ka upyog karte hain. runtime: 'edge' ke saath output ke liye, Next.js bhi canonical invocation metadata ke saath output.edgeRuntime pradan karta hai: { modulePath, entryKey, handlerExport } - kinaare ke runtime mein panjikrit module ke liye full path, kinaare entry registry dwara upyog ki jaane wali kainonikal key, export naam ko invited karne ke liye (vartaman mein 'handler'). Edge runtime load ke baad aur modulePath ke liye chankon ka mulyankan karne ke baad, global registry globalThis._ENTRIES[output.edgeRuntime.entryKey] se access ko padha, phir handlerExport ko bulana:
ts
const entry = await globalThis._ENTRIES[output.edgeRuntime.entryKey]
const handler = entry[output.edgeRuntime.handlerExport]
await handler(request, ctx)

file naam se recovery registry key ya handler namon ke bajaay edgeRuntime ka upyog karein. prasangik kor template: edge-ssr.ts, edge-app-route.ts, pages-edge-api.ts, middleware.ts.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
do runtimes handler(req/res-or-Request, ctx) size ko sajha karte hain lekin primitives mein bhinn hote hain - Node IncomingMessage/ServerResponse ka upyog karta hai aur void ko return karta hai; Edge web Request/Response ka upyog karta hai aur ek Response return karta hai. requestMeta bach hatches (revalidate, render404, hostname) maujud hain, isliye ek manch internal roop se network round-trip ke bina sanshodhit kar sakta hai. aur Edge Runtime ko hata diya gaya hai - us par naye routes ka build na karein.

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Output Types. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Output Types — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The `outputs` arrays, Prerenders (`outputs.prerenders`) — the richest type, Static files (`outputs.staticFiles`). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: sabhi build production prakar ke liye sandarbh outputs objekt mein adapter ke sanpark mein hai.

  • The outputs array: outputs.pages (React pages se pages/), outputs.pagesApi (API routes se pages/api/), outputs.appPages (React pages se app/), outputs.appRoutes (API) aur metadata routes se app/), outputs.prerenders (ISR-enabled routes aur static parirakshakon), outputs.staticFiles (static assets aur auto-static roop se customize pages), outputs.middleware (beech wala function, yadi vartaman mein). Dhyaan Do: jab config.output 'export', ONLY outputs.staticFiles population hai - any sabhi array khali hain, kyonki pure app ko static files ke roop mein export kiya jata hai. runtime: 'edge' ke saath kisi bhi root output ke liye, edgeRuntime ko kainonikal entry metadata (Edge Runtime) ke saath shamil kiya gaya hai.
  • pages/API routes/app pages/app routes/middleware ke liye Common size: { type, id, filePath, pathname, sourcePage, runtime: 'nodejs' | 'edge', assets, assetsHashes, wasmAssets?, edgeRuntime?, config } jahan assets ka pata lagaya jata hai dependency (key: repo root se relative path, maan: full path), assetsHashes pratyek asset ki content hash, wasmAssets bundle wali theme files, edgeRuntime = { modulePath, entryKey, handlerExport } (C5.9 dekhein), aur config = { maxDuration?, preferredRegion? (deprecated), env? (edge only) }. antar: APP_PAGE pathnames mein RSC routes ke liye .rsc suffix shamil hain; madhyveyar ka pathname hamesha /_middleware, sourcePage hamesha 'middleware' hai, aur iska config matchers ({ source, sourceRegex, has?, missing? }) jodta hai.
  • Prenders (outputs.prerenders) - sabse ameer prakar: { type: 'PRERENDER', id, pathname, parentOutputId (ID of the source page/route), groupId (revalidation group — prerenders with the same groupId revalidate together), route (source route matcher with dynamic segments kept, e.g. /blog/[slug] for prerendered /blog/first ), routeType?: 'route' | 'fallback' | 'shell' | 'page', response?: 'empty' | 'initial' | 'complete', compute?: 'blocking' | 'resuming' | 'static', htmlSize?, pprChain?: { headers } (e.g. 'next-resume': '1'), parentFallbackMode?: false | null | string (false = no additional paths — fallback: jhutha ; null = blocking render; string = path to HTML fallback), fallback?: { filePath, initialStatus?, initialHeaders?, initialExpiration? (seconds), initialRevalidate? (seconds, or false for fully static), postponedState (serialized PPR state) }, config: { allowQuery?, allowHeader?, bypassFor?, renderingMode?: 'STATIC' | 'PARTIALLY_STATIC' (PPR), partialFallback?, bypassToken? } }.
  • Prender classification (routeType / pratikriya / compute, ek prerender group mein prathmik pratikriya par ek saath utsarjit; related RSC/data/segment output unhein chhor dete hain; fallback: false ke saath Pages Router template bhi unhein chhor dete hain): routeType — route (gair UI route, e.g). Route Handler), page (page jiska URL mein koi lapta preereindrebal parameter nahi hai), shell (urls ke apne class ke liye sabse vishisht pun: prayojy page shell), fallback (pun: prayojy page pratikriya adhik previous mapdandon ko bharne ke dwara vishesh). response — empty (koi initial page pratikriya nahi ki jaa sakti), initial (ek initial pratikriya served jaa sakta hai, lekin pura page UI nahi hai - keval partial roop se previous UI routes ke liye), complete (rispans pura ho gaya hai; ek 204 ki tarah ek zero-byte body shamil ho sakta hai). compute — blocking (request samay se pahle koi initial pratikriya shuru hoti hai; uttar ek bar compute shuru hone ke baad stream kar sakta hai), resuming (initial karya phir se shuru hone ke dauraan serve ki gayi initial pratikriya), static (request ke anusar koi server compute nahi). htmlSize keval prathmik App Router HTML output (0 = khali shell); Pages Router prerenders, Route Handlers, aur related RSC/data/segment output omit.
  • Static filein (outputs.staticFiles): { type: 'STATIC_FILE', id, filePath (absolute), pathname (routable URL pathname), immutableHash?: string } — immutableHash content hash hai jab file ka naam ek hash hota hai, yeh darshata hai ki file immutable hai (C5.13 dekhein).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Prerender triplet routeType/response/compute ek prerendered pratikriya hai aur kya request samay kaam rahta hai - PPR PARTIALLY_STATIC + resuming hai. groupId yeh hai ki kaise return group ek saath render karta hai. aur output: 'export' sabhi ko staticFiles mein patan karta hai.

Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Routing Information — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The phases (in request order), Common route fields. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: sandarbh ke liye routing steps aur route kshetron mein expose onBuildComplete. routing object pariniyojan ke liye taiyar sansadhit pattern ke saath full routing jankari pradan karti hai.

  • The steps (request kram mein): routing.beforeMiddleware — madhyveyar execution se pahle lagu routes, jismein generated header aur redirect behavior shamil hain; routing.middlewareMatchers — madhyveyar maichar paribhashaein is build ke liye utsarjit hoti hain, yeh tay karne ke liye upyog ki jati hain ki midalaveyar ko kisi diye gaye request ke liye bulaya jana chahiye; routing.beforeFiles — phir se likhne wale routes ko filesystem root match se pahle check kiya gaya; routing.afterFiles — phir se likhne wale routes ko file system root match ke baad check kiya gaya; routing.dynamicRoutes - dynamic maichars jo route segments jaise [slug] aur catch-ol routes se generated hote hain; routing.onMatch — route jo ek saphal match ke baad lagu hote hain, jaise ki heshd static assets ke liye aparivartaniy cache header; routing.fallback — antim phir likhne wale routes ki check jab pahle step match ka production nahi karte the. (saath hi object mein: shouldNormalizeNextData aur rsc — C5.4 dekhein.)
  • Common route field: pratyek route entry mein source (mool route pattern; generated internal niymon ke liye optional), sourceRegex (santulan requests ke liye jatil regeks), destination (internal ya redirect destination), headers (siriyon ko lagu karne ke liye), has (pojitiv match ki sthiti), missing (nakaratmak match ki sthiti), status (direct sthiti code), priority (internal route priority flag) shamil hain.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh data form mein request pipeline hai - beforeMiddleware → midalaveyar → beforeFiles → file system → afterFiles → dynamicRoutes → onMatch → Fallback. ek adapter in steps ko host platform ke routing config mein badal data hai; sourceRegex purv-sanbaddh yojak hai isliye pletform ko Next.js route sintaiks ko phir se vyavasthit karne ki requirement nahi hai.

Adapters — Supporting Immutable Static Assets

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Supporting Immutable Static Assets. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Supporting Immutable Static Assets — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works, Adapter implementation (two steps). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya is: kaise ek adapter immutable static assets ka support karta hai. eind-user-phesing jankari config.supportsImmutableAssets page par hai (C2.71 dekhein).

  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: jab config.supportsImmutableAssets enable ho jata hai, to Next.js public path /_next/static/immutable/* ke tahat achal content se jure static assets ka production karta hai. yeh upasarg ek CDN ko gair-asthir logon se aparivartaniy static assetyon ko alag karne data hai. runtime mein in aparivartaniy assets ko WITHOUT ko ?dpl query parameter se request kiya jata hai, isliye ve deployment ke dauraan sajha namespace mein rahte hain. The platform ko yeh guarantee dena chahiye ki ve kabhi badal nahi rahe hain (yahan tak ki ek nai deployment ke baad bhi) aur kabhi bhi nasht nahi hua (halanki koi bhi active deployment abhi bhi unka upyog karti hai). Next.js ek truncated laghu content hash ka upyog file naam ke roop mein kar sakta hai, isliye outputs.staticFiles[].immutableHash mein FULL kanteint hash shamil hai, jiska upyog yeh verify karne ke liye kiya jaa sakta hai ki koi hash takrav nahi hua hai. config.outputHashSalt content hash ke liye ek namak set kar sakte hain, yadi required ho to hash ko ghumaane ke liye (e.g). gair-immutable static assets ko abhi bhi support diya jana chahiye - ve deployment ke beech badal sakte hain aur ?dpl query parameter (e.g. public folder, ya purane Next.js sanskaranon) ke saath request karna jari rakh sakte hain.
  • Adapter karyanvayan (do steps): (1) modifyConfig mein, config.supportsImmutableAssets ko true mein set karein - lekin keval tabhi jab user pahle se hi ise false mein set nahi kar chuka hai ( true ko default) user opt-out ki permission data hai): config.supportsImmutableAssets = config.supportsImmutableAssets?? true ( phase-production-build step mein); optional roop se config.outputHashSalt set kiya gaya. (2) onBuildComplete mein, outputs.staticFiles[].immutableHash ko yeh tay karne ke liye parhein ki kaun se assets aparivartaniy hain aur ?dpl ke bina request kiya jana chahiye:
js
// my-adapter.js
/** @type {import('next').NextAdapter} */
const adapter = {
  name: 'my-custom-adapter',
  async modifyConfig(config, { phase }) {
    if (phase === 'phase-production-build') {
      config.supportsImmutableAssets =
        // Default to true, but allow users to opt-out
        config.supportsImmutableAssets ?? true
      // Optionally, pass a salt for the content hashes
      // config.outputHashSalt = getSaltForCurrentProject()
    }
    return config
  },
  async onBuildComplete({ outputs }) {
    for (const output of outputs.staticFiles) {
      if (output.immutableHash != null) {
        // This has to be requestable at `output.pathname`
        // even without the `?dpl` query parameter.
        uploadOrVerifyImmutableStaticAsset(
          output.filePath,
          output.pathname,
          output.immutableHash
        )
      } else {
        // This is a non-immutable static asset and will be requested with
        // the `?dpl` query parameter, scoped to the deployment.
        uploadStaticAsset(output.filePath, output.pathname)
      }
    }
    // Process other outputs....
  },
}
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
?dpl query param pariniyojan scoping tantr hai - achal sanpatti ise chhor deti hai aur deployment mein sajha ho jati hai, yahi karan hai ki "kabhi bhi parivartan nahi hota hai, jabki upyog mein kabhi bhi nasht nahi hota" guarantee puri anubandh hai. immutableHash (full hash) maujud hai kyonki file naam ek truncated hash le sakta hai.

Edge Runtime

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Edge Runtime. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Edge Runtime — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Caveats, Supported APIs — Network, Supported APIs — Encoding, Supported APIs — Streams, Supported APIs — Crypto, Supported APIs — Web Standard. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Next.js mein do server runtime hain: Node.js Runtime (default — full Node.js APIs, rendering ke liye istemal kiya) aur Edge Runtime E (API ka ek adhik simit set, Proxy/middleware mein istemal kiya gaya). not: ek route runtime ke roop mein Edge Runtime ko deprecated kiya gaya hai (C5.9 dekhein); yeh page API satah ko jari rakhta hai, main roop se Proxy ke liye.

  • Caveats: Edge Runtime sabhi Node.js APIs ka support nahi karta hai - kuchh package ummid ke anusar kaam nahi kareinge. yeh NOT support Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) karta hai. donon runtimes deployment adapter ke aadhar par streaming ka support kar sakte hain.
  • supported API - network: Blob, fetch, FetchEvent, File, FormData, Headers, Request, Response, URLSearchParams, WebSocket.
  • supported API - enkoding: atob, btoa, TextDecoder, TextDecoderStream, TextEncoder, TextEncoderStream.
  • supported API - dhara: ReadableStream, ReadableStreamBYOBReader, ReadableStreamDefaultReader, TransformStream, WritableStream, WritableStreamDefaultWriter.

Hissa 296 / 471 · App Router · API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Turbopack

App RouterAPI Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke API Reference — Configuration, CLI, Adapters hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Turbopack. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Turbopack — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why Turbopack (design principles), Supported platforms, Using Webpack instead, Supported features — Language, Supported features — Framework/React, Supported features — CSS/styling. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Turbopack ek incremental bundler hai jise JavaScript aur TypeScript ke liye customize kiya gaya hai, jise rust mein likha gaya hai, aur Next.js mein banaya gaya hai. yeh page aur App Router donon ke saath bahut tezi se local development anubhav ke liye kaam karta hai. chunki Next.js 16 yeh default bandalr hai - koi configuration ki requirement nahi hai (next dev / next build sirph iska upyog karte hain); --webpack ke saath prati command chunein.

  • Kyun Turbopack (design principles): Unified Graph — Next.js kai environments (client aur server) ko target karta hai; multiple compilers aur stitched bundles ko ek saath manage karna mushkil hai, isliye Turbopack saare environments ke liye ek unified graph use karta hai. Bundling vs Native ESM — dev me bundling skip karke browser ke native ESM par bharosa karne wale tools chhote apps ke liye kaam karte hain lekin bade apps excessive network requests se slow ho jate hain; Turbopack dev me bundle karta hai, lekin optimized tareeke se. Incremental Computation — kaam cores ke paar parallel hai aur function level tak cache hota hai; kaam ka ek tukda ek baar ho jaye, to Turbopack use repeat nahi karega aur results runs ke beech disk par persist hote hain. Lazy Bundling — sirf wahi bundle hota hai jo dev server asal me request karta hai, initial compile time aur memory use kam hota hai.
  • Supported platforms: macOS (Darwin) x64/ARM64, Windows x64/ARM64, Linux glibc x64/ARM64, Linux musl x64/ARM64 ke liye native bindings. Bina native bindings wale platforms (jaise FreeBSD, OpenBSD) par, Next.js WASM bindings par fallback karta hai, jo core SWC features (compilation, minification) support karte hain, lekin Turbopack NAHI — wahan --webpack use karo.
  • Iske bajaye Webpack use karna: package.json me "dev": "next dev --webpack", "build": "next build --webpack".
  • Supported features — Language: JS aur TypeScript (neeche SWC); type-checking Turbopack NAHI karta — tsc --watch chalao ya apne IDE par bharosa karo; ECMAScript (ESNext, SWC coverage se match); CommonJS (require() out of the box handle hota hai); ESM (static aur dynamic import fully supported); Babel — Next.js 16 ke baad se, Turbopack Babel automatically use karta hai agar ye ek Babel config file detect kare; webpack ke vipreet, SWC hamesha Next.js ke internal transforms aur downleveling ke liye use hota hai. node_modules ki files exclude hoti hain jab tak tum manually babel-loader configure na karo.
  • Supported features — Framework/React: JSX/TSX (SWC); Fast Refresh (koi config nahi); React Server Components (App Router ke liye sahi server/client bundling); automatic root layout banana unsupported hai — Turbopack tumse use manually banane ko kehta hai.
  • Supported features — CSS/styling: global CSS (.css seedhe import karo); CSS Modules (.module.css, Lightning CSS ke through); CSS nesting (modern nesting); @import; PostCSS (config files Node.js worker pool me auto-processed — Tailwind, Autoprefixer); Sass/SCSS out of the box supported, LEKIN custom Sass functions (sassOptions.functions) supported NAHI hain (Rust architecture JS functions execute nahi kar sakta — agar tumhe unki zaroorat hai to webpack use karo); Less plugins ke through planned hai (default roop se abhi supported nahi); Lightning CSS transformations handle karta hai, lekin kuch kam-use CSS Modules features (jaise standalone :local/:global pseudo-classes) abhi supported nahi hain.
  • Supported features — Assets: static assets (images, fonts — import img from './img.png') <Image /> ke liye ek object return karta hai; JSON imports (named ya default).
  • Supported features — Module resolution: path aliases (tsconfig.json paths / baseUrl padhta hai); turbopack.resolveAlias se manual aliases (webpack.resolve.alias ke bajaye); turbopack.resolveExtensions se custom extensions; AMD partially supported (basic transforms; advanced use limited).
  • Supported features — Execution: Fast Refresh (JS/TS/CSS) bina full refresh ke; incremental bundling (sirf wahi banata hai jo request hua); file system cache (compiler artifacts disk par persist — turbopackFileSystemCache, C2.66 dekho).
  • Magic comments: webpack-compatible magic comments dynamic import(), require(), require.resolve() aur new Worker() ke saath kaam karte hain (static import ke saath NAHI): webpackIgnore: true (dono — bundling skip karo, import preserve karo), turbopackIgnore: true (sirf Turbopack — bundling skip karo), turbopackOptional: true (sirf Turbopack — resolution errors suppress karo), webpackOptional: true (is list me NAHI hai, ya to supported nahi).
  • import.meta.env (sirf Turbopack): built-in env metadata, statically analyze hota hai isliye unreachable branches hatayi jati hain: DEV (boolean, MODE !== "production"), PROD (boolean, MODE === "production"), MODE (string, compile-time NODE_ENV, default "development"), BASE_URL (string, Next.js basePath trailing slash ke saath, default "/"), SSR (boolean, server bundles me true, client me false). Whole-object reads, destructuring aur static bracket access supported hain. Custom VITE_* vars, Vite custom modes, envPrefix aur envDir supported NAHI hain.
  • import.meta.glob() (Turbopack ke saath available, webpack ke saath nahi): kai modules ko ek glob pattern se ek baar me import karne ke liye Vite-compatible API; result ek object hai jo calling file ke relative file paths se keyed hai. Patterns importing file ke relative hain (./, ../) ya project root se absolute (/); keys pattern follow karti hain (relative → relative keys, root-absolute → root-absolute keys). node_modules kisi bhi dusri directory ki tarah match hota hai — import.meta.glob('/**/*.js') jaisa broad pattern dependencies me ghus jayega aur seconds le sakta hai; use narrow karo ya negative patterns use karo. .next kabhi traverse nahi hoti. Keys dev aur production me deterministically aur identically sorted hoti hain — bytewise sort, isliye '10-ten.js' '2-two.js' se pehle sort hota hai, _ lowercase se pehle, uppercase lowercase se pehle, aur subdirectories ki files siblings ke saath interleave hoti hain, group nahi hoti; multiple patterns ek sorted object me merge hote hain. Lazy (default): har value ek thunk () => Promise<module> hai. Eager: { eager: true } sab kuch upfront import karta hai; values seedhe module objects hain. Named import: { import: 'default' } (lazy: () => Promise<exportValue>; eager: export value). Query strings: { query: '?raw' } ya ek object ({ bar: 'foo', raw: true } → ?bar=foo&raw=true); query module rules ke through pass hoti hai aur iska apna koi matlab nahi — Vite ke vipreet, Turbopack me koi built-in ?raw/?url handling NAHI hai, isliye query ko ek turbopack.rules entry se match karo (jaise '*.txt': { condition: { query: '?raw' }, type: 'text' }). Multiple patterns aur negation: ek array pass karo; exclude karne ke liye ! prefix (['./src/**/*.js', '!**/*.test.js']). Base path: { base: '../../content' } patterns ko ek alag directory ke against resolve karta hai; keys base ke relative ho jati hain (v16.4.0 — pehle keys import file ke relative thi). TypeScript: types automatically tsconfig.json me "moduleResolution": "bundler" (ya node16/nodenext) ke saath shamil hote hain; lazy return Record<string, () => Promise<unknown>>, eager Record<string, unknown>; exports describe karne ke liye ek generic pass karo (import.meta.glob<Mod>(...)). Options reference: eager (boolean, default false), import (string), query (string ya record), base (string), caseSensitive (boolean, default true). Deprecated Vite as option aur legacy import.meta.globEager() supported NAHI hain.
  • Webpack ke saath known gaps (migration gotchas): Filesystem Root — Turbopack project root se modules resolve karta hai; iske bahar ki files resolve nahi hoti (jaise npm link/yarn link/pnpm link dependencies) — symlinked deps ke liye turbopack.root configure karo ya experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots, jab app detected root ke bahar files import karta hai. CSS Module Ordering — Turbopack otherwise-unordered CSS Modules ke liye JS import order follow karta hai (webpack kabhi-kabhi side-effect-free files ke liye JS-inferred order ignore karta hai) — migration par subtle rendering changes; explicit @import order ya de-conflicted rules se fix karo. Sass node_modules imports — legacy tilde ~ syntax (@import '~bootstrap/...') supported NAHI hai; ~ hata do, ya use turbopack.resolveAlias: { '~*': '*' } se map karo. CSS/Sass decimal precision — Lightning CSS webpack ke 10 ke bajaye 5 digits precision use karta hai (jaise 25/17 ke liye line-height: 1.47059 vs 1.4705882353) — line-height/letter-spacing jaise computed values ke liye subtle rendering fark. Webpack plugins — supported NAHI (loaders turbopack.rules ke through supported HAIN); Turbopack-compatible alternatives dhoondho ya webpack par raho.
  • Unsupported aur unplanned features: legacy CSS Modules features (standalone :local/:global pseudo-classes — sirf function form :global(...) supported hai; @value; :import/:export ICSS rules; .module.css me composes jo ek .css file ko compose kare — Turbopack ke saath .css file hamesha global hai, isliye use .module.css me badlo; @import se .css ko CSS Module me module ke roop me import karna — plain theek hai); sassOptions.functions (custom Sass functions — Rust JS execute nahi kar sakta; webpack use karo); next.config.js me webpack() config (pehchana nahi jata — iske bajaye turbopack config use karo); Yarn PnP (planned nahi); experimental.urlImports (planned nahi); experimental.esmExternals (planned nahi); kuch experimental flags — experimental.nextScriptWorkers, experimental.fallbackNodePolyfills (bhavishya ke liye planned).
  • Configuration: next.config.js ke through turbopack key ke tahat — rules (file conversions ke liye webpack loaders), resolveAlias (manual aliases), resolveExtensions (module resolution extensions badlo/extend karo), ignoreIssue (specific Turbopack errors/warnings). experimental ke tahat experimental options (dev default / build default): turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev (true / N/A), turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild (N/A / true), turbopackModuleFragments (modules ko segments me todta hai, chunks sirf use hue fragments import karte hain), turbopackRemoveUnusedImports (false / true — turbopackRemoveUnusedExports chahiye), turbopackRemoveUnusedExports (false / true), turbopackMangleExportNames (false / true — export naam chhote; observable modules original naam rakhte hain), turbopackMangleViaMaterializedNamespaceObject (false / false — mangling explicitly on hone par default true), turbopackInferModuleSideEffects (true / true — behtar tree-shaking ke liye side-effect-free modules), turbopackScopeHoisting (false / true — dev me hamesha disabled), turbopackSharedRuntime (N/A / true — routes ke paar browser runtime ek runtime.js me share karo, sirf prod builds), turbopackClientSideNestedAsyncChunking (false / true), turbopackServerSideNestedAsyncChunking (false / false), turbopackImportTypeBytes (false / false — with { type: "bytes" } ESM imports), turbopackUseBuiltinBabel (true / true), turbopackUseBuiltinSass (true). Example: turbopack: { resolveAlias: { underscore: 'lodash' }, resolveExtensions: ['.mdx', '.tsx', '.ts', '.jsx', '.js', '.mjs', '.node', '.json'] }. Aur: turbopackGc (.next/cache), turbopackLazyDynamicImports (false), turbopackLazyDynamicImportsSSR (false), turbopackPluginRuntimeStrategy ('childProcesses'), turbopackMinify (false / true), turbopackSourceMaps ({ server, client, edge }), turbopackInputSourceMaps (true), turbopackModuleIds ('named' / 'deterministic'), turbopackLocalPostcssConfig (false), turbopackWorkerAssetPrefix (undefined — output.workerPublicPath Web Worker URLs ke liye).
  • Performance debugging: next dev --internal-trace .next-profiles/trace-turbopack.bin produce karta hai — Next.js repo par GitHub issue file karte waqt use shamil karo.
  • Version history: v15.0.0 Turbopack dev ke liye stable; v15.3.0 experimental build support; v15.5.0 build beta; v16.0.0 build stable + Turbopack default bundler + Babel config file milne par automatic Babel support; v16.4.0 import.meta.glob base option, keys base ke relative.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Turbopack ke teen vichar - sabhi environments ke liye ek ekikrit graph, karya-star ki vriddhishil caching disk par bani rahti hai, aur keval kya request kiya gaya hai, iska lazy bandlinga. migration gotchas jo vastav mein kaatte hain: projekt root (linkd deps) ke bahar files, CSS module ne JS import order ka palan kiya, ~ Sass prefix, 5-digit CSS decimal precision aur koi webpack plugin nahi. import.meta.env/import.meta.glob tarbopaik-keval visheshataein hain - ve webpack ke tahat maujud nahi hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/turbopack
Hissa 297 / 471 · App Router · Glossary

Glossary

App RouterGlossary

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Glossary hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Glossary. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Glossary — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: A — App Router, B — Build time, C — Cache Components, D — Dynamic rendering, E — Environment Variables, F — Font Optimization. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: single glossary page (suchak IS content - koi leaf page nahi hain) Next.js docs ke dauraan istemal ki jaane wali common sharton ko define karna, routing, rendering aur caching ko cover karna.

  • A - App Router: router Next.js 13, React Server Components par banaya gaya; layout, nested routing, loading states, error handling ke saath file system routing. App Shell: ek prati root prerender jismein page ke kuchh bhag shamil hain jo URL data par nirbhar nahi karte hain. jab iski stale samay kam se kam 5 minat hai, to cached kanteint ko shamil kiya jata hai, kyonki shell ko kam jivit content se lanbe samay tak istemal kiya jata hai, fresh rahta hai. jin rooton ne cookies() ya headers() ko padha tha, unmein session data bhi shamil hai, client par prati session cache kiya. client navigation ke dauraan default prefetch payload ke roop mein upyog kiya jata hai, loading state jab ek prati link prefetch taiyar nahi hota hai, aur Cache Components ke saath ISR ke liye fallback hoti hai.
  • B - samay ka build: manch jab app compiled ho - Next.js code ko customize production files mein badal data hai, static pages ko generated karta hai, deployment ke liye assets taiyar karta hai (next build).
  • C — Cache Components: feature "use cache" directive ke madhyam se component/function-level caching ko enable banata hai; static, cached aur dynamic content ko static HTML shell se pahle ek route mein mila data hai, jabki dynamic content dharaon mein turant serve ki jati hai. cacheLife() ke saath avdhi ko configure karein, cacheTag() ke saath tag karein, updateTag() ke saath invalid karein. Catch-all segment: dynamic segment kai URL bhagon ko [...folder]/page.js (e.g) ke madhyam se match karte hain. Client Bundles: JS bundles ne browser ko bheja, automatic roop se module graph dwara vibhajit kiya. Client Component: browser mein chalata hai (bhi initial page pidhi ke dauraan server par render); state, prabhav, event handler, browser API ka upyog kar sakte hain; "use client" ke saath chihnita. Client-side navigation: <Link> ke madhyam se ek full phir load ke bina page content update; sajha layout interactive, browser state preserve rahte hain. Client Cache: in-memory browser cache storej RSC payload for visited/prefetched routes - layout aur loading states turant client ke side navigation ke dauraan server request ke bina serve karte hain; pages ko default roop se cache nahi kiya gaya lekin back/forward. ke dauraan phir upyog kiya jata hai page riphresh par saaf kiye gaye; vastav mein revalidateTag, revalidatePath, updateTag, router.refresh(), cookies.set ya cookies.delete ke saath programmatic roop se upalabdh karaya gaya. duniya bhar mein staleTimes ke saath ya cacheLife mein stale sanpatti ke madhyam se prati root ko configure karein (recommended). Code Splitting: ne is app ko chhote JS tukron mein vibhajit kiya taaki keval required code load ho sake; automatic roop se Next.js mein.
  • D - dynamic rendering: ek component build samay ke bajaay request samay par pradan ki jati hai; ek component dynamic ho jata hai jab yeh request samay API ka upyog karta hai. Dynamic route segment: request samay par data se generated segment, square brackets ([slug]) me folder ka naam rakhkar banaya gaya.
  • E — Environment Variables: config value build ya request samay par; NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefixed vars browser, any server keval ke sanpark mein hain. Error Boundary: ek React component apne children ke per mein JS errors ko catch aur fallback UI dikha raha hai; Next.js mein, ek error.js file error boundary mein root segment lapettee hai.
  • F — Font Optimization: automatic: font optimization next/font — sva-hosted fonts, koi layout shift nahi; Google Fonts aur local files. File-system caching: ek Turbopack feature tezi se compiles (turbopackFileSystemCache) ke liye ranon ke beech disk par compiler artifacts ka storage.
  • H - Hydration: React ne server-render static HTML ko yeh interactive banane, client JS ke saath server markup ko phir se installed karne ke liye iveint handler ko sanlagn kiya.
  • I - Import Aliases: custom path maipings (bar-bar nirdeshkon ke liye shortaind). Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR): puri site ke punarnirman ke bina static content update karta hai - background punarvikaas ke saath prati page static pidhi; jise Revalidation bhi kaha jata hai. Intercepting Routes: maujuda layout (e.g) ke bhitar app ke dusre hisse se ek route load karta hai, jabki URL ko sajha karne yogy rakhta hai. Image Optimization: <Image> ke madhyam se automatic optimization - on-demand, aadhunik formats jaise WebP, lazy loading, uttardayi aakaar.
  • L - layout: UI multiple pages ke beech sajha; state ko preserve karta hai, interactive rahta hai, navigation par phir se render nahi karta hai; layout.js dwara define kiya gaya hai. Loading UI: Fallback UI jabki ek route segment bhar; loading.js ek Suspense boundary mein page lapeta hai.
  • M — Module Graph: file dependency ka graph; pratyek file ek nod hai, import/export sanbandh kinaaron hain; Next.js ise bundling/code-splitting. Metadata: ke liye vishleshan karta hai browsers/search injan ke liye page jankari (shirshak, vivaran, OG images) metadata export ya generateMetadata ke madhyam se. Memoization: ek function ke return maan ko pakadta hai, isliye ek bar mein ek render paas ke dauraan multiple call karta hai; fetch GET usi URL/options ke saath request automatic roop se Server Components, layout, pages, generateMetadata/generateStaticParams (lekin NOT Route Handlers) ke beech memoz kiya jata hai, kyonki ve React component tree ka hissa nahi hain); gair-fetch karya ke liye React cache() ka upyog karte hain. Middleware: Proxy dekhein.
  • N - navigation step: un points par point karta hai jis par client navigation ke dauraan server-render kiye gaye kaam upalabdh ho jate hain; Partial Prefetching ke saath steps mein App Shell, ek prati-link prefetch aur navigation hai. Not Found: vishesh component dikhaya gaya hai jab ek route maujud nahi hota ya notFound() ko bulaya jata hai; not-found.js ke saath banaya gaya.
  • P — Private Folders: folders _ (e.g) ke saath prefixed. _components) ko routing se bahar rakha gaya hai - code organization/shared upyogitaon ke liye. Page: UI ek route ke liye unique hai, jise app mein page.js dwara define kiya gaya hai. Parallel Routes: simultaneously/conditionally naam slot (@folder) - dashboard, modal, jatil layout ke madhyam se ek hi layout mein multiple pages ko render karta hai. Partial Prefetching: Cache Components routes ke liye ek prefetching ranniti jahan ek <Link> pure page ke bajaay default roop se prati root App Shell ko priority data hai; partialPrefetching: true ke saath enable karein. Partial Prerendering (PPR): ek route mein render karne aur dynamic rendering ko jodti hai - static shell turant serve karte hain, dynamic content stream. Prefetching: user navigate karne se pahle background mein ek route load ho raha hai; Next.js auto-prefetches <Link> route jab ve viewport mein access karte hain. Prendering: build samay par ya revalidation ke dauraan background mein rendering; parinam HTML + RSC payload, kaishebal aur CDN-servable hai; un components ke liye default jo request samay API ka upyog nahi karte hain. Proxy: ek request pura karne se pahle ek proxy.js file chalane wala server code - loging, redirect, riraaiting; purv mein madhyveyar ke roop mein jana jata hai.
  • R - Redirect: upyogkartaon ko ek URL se dusre mein bhej raha hai; next.config.js mein configure kiya gaya, Proxy se lautaya gaya, ya redirect() ke saath trigger kiya gaya. Request-time API: request-vishisht data tak pahunchne ka karya karta hai, jo dynamic rendering mein ek component ka chayan karta hai: cookies(), headers(), searchParams, draftMode(). Runtime rendering: dynamic rendering dekhein. Revalidation: ne cache data ko update kiya - samay aadharit (cacheLife()) ya on-demand (cacheTag() + updateTag()). Rewrite: ne browser URL ko badalane ke bina ek alag destination ke liye ek aane wale request path ko map kiya; next.config.js mein configure kiya gaya ya Proxy se lauta; external sevaon ya legacy URL ko proxy karne ke liye upyogi. Route Groups: URL structure ko affected kiye bina routes ka event karta hai - paireints, e.g mein ek folder naam lapeta hai. (marketing); prati group layout enable banata hai. Route Handler: ek function handling HTTP requests ke liye, jise route.js mein define kiya gaya hai; web Request/Response API ka upyog karta hai; GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS ko sambhalta hai. Route Segment: app mein ek folder dwara define URL path (do slaish ke beech) ka ek hissa hai. RSC payload: React Server Component payload - pradan kiye gaye RSC per ka ek kompaikt binary pratinidhitv; ismein Server Component parinam, Client Components ke liye plesholdar aur unke beech passed props shamil hain.
  • S - Server Component: App Router mein default component prakar; server par render karta hai, seedhe data prapt karta hai, client JS bundle mein kuchh bhi nahi jodta hai; state ya browser APIs ka upyog nahi kar sakta hai. Server Action: ek Server Function ko ek prop ke roop mein Client Component se passed kiya gaya ya form action par badhya kiya gaya; aamtaur par form sabmishan aur data mutation ke liye upyog kiya jata hai. Server Function: server par chal rahe ek async function, jise "use server" ke saath chihnit kiya gaya hai; ise Client Components se bulaya jaa sakta hai; jab prop ke roop mein passed kiya jata hai ya form action ko badhya kiya jata hai to use Server Action kaha jata hai. Static Export: pariniyojan mode puri tarah se static site (HTML/CSS/JS) generated karta hai, jo output: 'export' ke saath enable hota hai; bina kisi static file server par host karne yogy Node.js. Static rendering: Prerendering dekhein. Static Assets: files jaise images/fonts/videos ne seedhe prosesing ke bina serve ki, aam taur par public mein. Static Shell: ek page ki purvnirdharit HTML structure turant serve pradan karti hai; PPR ke saath ismein static roop se reindrebal kanteint plus Suspense mein dynamic content jo baad mein dharaon ke liye wapas aata hai. Streaming: server ek page ke kuchh hisson ko bhejta hai kyonki ve pure render ke liye wait karne ke bajaay taiyar ho jate hain; automatic roop se loading.js ya manual <Suspense> boundaries ke saath sakshama. Suspense boundary: ek React <Suspense> lapetan async content ke saath girbaik UI jabki yeh load karta hai; Next.js mein, Suspense simaein define karti hain jahan static shell samapt hota hai aur streaming shuru hoti hai, jisse PPR enable ho jata hai.
  • T — Turbopack: tezi se Rust aadharit bundler Next.js ke liye banaya gaya; next dev ke liye default aur next build ke liye upalabdh; Webpack ki tulna mein kaafi tezi se sankalana. Tree Shaking: ne build ke dauraan JS bundles se apryukt code ko hata diya; Next.js mein svachaalita.
  • U — URL data: data ek vishisht URL — path naam aur query param ki identity; App Router mein jo params aur searchParams hai, saath hi usePathname/useSearchParams jaise client hook hai. URL data prati link badalta hai, prati session nahi, isliye yeh sajha App Shell ka hissa nahi ho sakta hai. "use cache" directive: ek component/function ko kaishebal ke roop mein chihnit karta hai; ek file (sabhi export kaishebal) ke top par ya keval ek function/component (keval us dayre) ke top para. "use client" directive: server/client boundary ko chihnit karta hai; import se pahle ek file ke top par hona chahiye; file ka component, helper tool, char aur sabhi imported dependencies client bundle mein jati hain. "use server" directive: client code se call karne yogy Server Function ke roop mein ek karya ko chihnit karta hai; file ke top par (sabhi export Server Functions hain) ya kisi function ke top par inline.
  • V - sanskaran skew: ek nai deployment ke baad , abhi bhi active client ek purane build se JS/CSS/data ko sandarbhit kar sakte hain; is client/server sanskaran ka galatfahmi lapta assets, Server Action errors aur navigation viphaltaon ka karan ban sakta hai. Next.js sanskaran ka pata lagane aur sambhalne ke liye deploymentId ka upyog karta hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh page pure SPA ke liye glossary list hai - App Shell, Client Cache, PPR ki paribhasha, previous banam dynamic rendering, aur teen "use" directive concept interviewer sabse adhik check karte hain. satik bhed not karein: memoization (per-render-pass, fetch/cache()) banam caching (Across request, cacheLife/tags) banam client cache (browser, RSC payloads); aur App Shell (per-route, no URL data) banam Static Shell (per-page, Suspense Fallbacks). ## C9. architecture

Architecture — Accessibility

App RouterArchitecture

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Architecture hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Architecture — Accessibility. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Architecture — Accessibility — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Route announcements, Linting, Accessibility resources. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Next.js ki built-in pahunch suvidhaein.

  • Route announcements: server-rendered pages (jaise <a href>) ke beech transition karte samay, screen readers aur assistive technology load par page title announce karti hain taaki users ko pata chale ki page badal gaya. Client-side transitions (next/link) ke liye, Next.js me default roop se ek route announcer shamil hai taaki un navigations ki bhi announcement ho. Announcer page ka naam pehle document.title inspect karke dhoondhta hai, phir <h1> element, aur aakhir me URL pathname. Sabse accessible experience ke liye, har page ko ek unique, descriptive title do.
  • Linting: Next.js out of the box ek integrated ESLint experience deta hai (C3.2 dekho), jisme accessibility issues ko jaldi pakadne ke liye eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y default roop se shamil hai — aria-props, aria-proptypes, aria-unsupported-elements, role-has-required-aria-props, role-supports-aria-props aur aur par warnings. Ye img tag par alt text, sahi aria-* attributes, sahi role attributes wagera sunishchit karne me madad karta hai.
  • Accessibility resources: WebAIM WCAG checklist, WCAG 2.2 guidelines, The A11y Project, foreground aur background elements ke beech color contrast ratio check karo, aur animations ke saath kaam karte samay prefers-reduced-motion use karo.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
route declare karne wala vivaran hai ki adhikansh log nahi jante hain - Next.js default roop se readers ko screen karne ke liye client-side navigation ki ghoshna karta hai, aur iska ghoshna source order document.title → <h1> → URL pathname hai, yahi karan hai ki unique varnanatmak shirshak ka mamla hai.

Hissa 300 / 471 · App Router · Architecture

Architecture — Fast Refresh

App RouterArchitecture

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Architecture hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Architecture — Fast Refresh. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Architecture — Fast Refresh — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works, Error resilience, Limitations (why state resets on edit), Tips, Fast Refresh and Hooks. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: Fast Refresh ek React feature hai jise Next.js mein ekikrit kiya gaya hai, jab aap ek file sev karte hain to asthayi client-side state ko banaye rakhte hue browser page ko live-reload karte hain. 9.4 ya naye par sabhi Next.js app mein default roop se enable; adhikansh sampadan ek sekand ke bhitar dikhai dete hain.

  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: yadi aap ek file ko edit karte hain to only React component(s) export karta hai, to Fast Refresh us file ke liye code ko update karta hai aur component ko phir se render karta hai - aap styles ko edit kar sakte hain, tark render kar sakte hain, event handler, ya prabhaava. yadi aap export ke saath ek file edit karte hain ki aren't React component, Fast Refresh us file aur file donon ko import karte hain (e.g. sampadan theme.js donon Button.js aur Modal.js update donon dwara imported). yadi aap files dwara imported ek file edit karte hain to outside React tree, Fast Refresh ek full phir load ho jata hai — e.g. ek component file jo ek gair-riyekt upyogita dwara imported static export karti hai. theek karein: donon dwara import ki gai ek alag file ko static karein.
  • Error lachilapan: Syntax errors — theek hai aur phir se bachane ke liye; error automatic roop se gayab ho jati hai, koi phir load ki zaroorat hai, aur aap NOT component state kho dete hain. Runtime trutiyon — ek sandarbh overlay dikhai data hai; error ko theek karne se ise phir load kiye bina kharij kar diya jata hai. yadi rendering ke dauraan error nahi hui to component state ko barkarar rakha jata hai; yadi yeh rendering ke dauraan hui thi, to React ne update code ke saath app ko wapas bhej diya. error simaein ek rendering error ke baad agle sampadan par rendering karti hain, jo hamesha root app state ko reset karne se rok sakti hain - lekin unhein bahut danedar nahi banate hain; unhein janboojhkar design karein kyonki ve production mein bhi upyog kiye jate hain.
  • Limitations (why state edit par reset): local state NOT class components (keval karya components aur hook preserve state) ke liye preserve hai; file mein React component ke alava any export hain; file HOC(WrappedComponent) jaise uchch-order component ke parinam ka export karti hai - yadi lautaya gaya component ek class hai, to iska state reset; export default () => <div /> ki tarah anonymous teer karya local state ko preserve nahi karte hain (bare kodbes ke liye name-default-component codemod ka upyog karein). chunki kodbes components aur hook ko karya karne ke liye aage badhta hai, isliye state ko adhik mamlon mein preserve rakha jata hai.
  • Tips: Fast Refresh default roop se karya components aur hook mein local state ko preserve karta hai. force ko ek state riset aur remount (e.g. ek mount-onlee animation tveeking), file mein kahin bhi // @refresh reset jorte hain - yeh us file ke liye local hai aur pratyek sampadan par iske components ko phir raashi pradan karta hai. aap development ke dauraan edit components mein console.log ya debugger; daal sakte hain. import kes-sanvedanshil hote hain - './header' banam './Header' tezi se aur full taza donon ko tor sakte hain.
  • Fast Refresh aur hook: useState aur useRef apne previous values ko tab tak preserve rakhte hain jab tak aap apne tark ya hook call ke order ko nahi badalate hain. dependency ke saath hook - useEffect, useMemo, useCallback — ALWAYS update Fast Refresh ke dauraan; unki dependency list ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai jabki Fast Refresh ho raha hai (e.g. sampadan useMemo(() => x * 2, [x]) ko useMemo(() => x * 10, [x]) phir se shuru kiya gaya hai, bhale hi x mein badlav nahi hua - anyatha aapka sampadan nahi dikhai dega). isliye Fast Refresh ke dauraan ek bar khali dependency array ke saath ek useEffect bhi phir se chala jata hai. kabhi-kabhi phir se chalne ke liye prasangik lekhan prabhav vaise bhi achha abhyas hai, aur ise React Strict Mode dwara lagu kiya gaya hai ( dekhein), jo docs ko atydhik enable karne ki salah data hai. C2.57
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
teen mamlon (Component-only file → hot update; mishrit export → phir run aayaatkon; React per → full reload ke bahar import kiya gaya) main mental modal hain. // @refresh reset bach haich aur "Dps hamesha Fast Refresh ke dauraan phir se run ke saath hilaataa hai" niyam classic interview anuvartee hain.
