Hissa 301 / 471 · App Router · Architecture

Architecture — Next.js Compiler

App RouterArchitecture

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Architecture hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Architecture — Next.js Compiler. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Architecture — Next.js Compiler — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why SWC, Supported features — Styled Components, Supported features — Jest, Supported features — Relay, Supported features — Remove React Properties, Supported features — Remove Console. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: The Next.js Compiler, jise SWC ka upyog karke Rust mein likha gaya hai, production ke liye apne JavaScript ko badalta hai aur chhota karta hai. yeh production bundles ko chhota karne ke liye vyaktigat files aur tersar ke liye Babel ko replace karta hai. compilation Babel ki tulna mein 17x tej hai aur yeh default roop se Next.js 12 ke baad se enable hai. yadi aapke paas maujuda Babel configuration hai ya bina supported features ka upyog karte hain, to aapka app Next.js Compiler se bahar nikalta hai aur Babel ka upyog karta rahta hai.

  • Kyun SWC: SWC fast developer tools ki agli generation ke liye ek extensible Rust-based platform hai — compilation, minification, bundling aur zyada ke liye usable, aur extend hone ke liye designed (code transformations perform karne ke liye callable, built-in ya custom, Next.js jaise higher-level tools ke through). Ise choose karne ke kaaran: Extensibility — SWC ko design constraints ke aas-paas fork ya work kiye bina Next.js ke andar ek crate ke roop me use kiya ja sakta hai; Performance — SWC par switch karne ke baad lagbhag 3x tez Fast Refresh aur lagbhag 5x tez builds, aur optimization jaari hai; WebAssembly — Rust ka WASM support saare platforms support karne aur Next.js development har jagah le jane ke liye zaroori hai; Community — Rust community aur ecosystem.
  • Supported features — Styled Components: babel-plugin-styled-components ka ek port; compiler: { styledComponents: true } se enable karo. Advanced options: displayName (dev me default enabled, prod me file size kam karne ke liye disabled — set karna saare environments ke liye default override karta hai), ssr (default enabled), fileName (default enabled), topLevelImportPaths (default empty), meaninglessFileNames (default ["index"]), minify (default enabled), transpileTemplateLiterals (default enabled), namespace (default empty), pure (default disabled), cssProp (default enabled). Note: ssr aur displayName transforms Next.js me styled-components ke liye main requirement hain.
  • Supported features — Jest: compiler tests transpile karta hai aur Next.js ke saath Jest setup simplify karta hai: .css, .module.css (aur .scss variants) aur image imports ki auto-mocking; SWC use karke transform automatically set karta hai; .env (aur saare variants) ko process.env me load karta hai; test resolving/transforms se node_modules ignore karta hai; test resolving se .next ignore karta hai; flags ke liye next.config.js load karta hai. Setup (verbatim): const nextJest = require('next/jest'), const createJestConfig = nextJest({ dir: './' }), phir module.exports = createJestConfig(customJestConfig) — is tarah export kiya gaya taaki next/jest async Next.js config load kar sake.
  • Supported features — Relay: compiler: { relay: { src: './', artifactDirectory: './__generated__', language: 'typescript', eagerEsModules: false } } — relay.config.js se match karo. Gotcha: pages me saari JS files routes mani jati hain, isliye artifactDirectory pages ke BAHAR hona chahiye, warna relay-compiler source ke bagal me files generate karta hai jinhe routes mana jata hai aur production builds toot jati hain.
  • Supported features — React properties hatao: JSX properties hatata hai, aksar testing ke liye use hota hai (jaise babel-plugin-react-remove-properties). compiler: { reactRemoveProperties: true } ke saath default regex ^data-test; custom properties: reactRemoveProperties: { properties: ['^data-custom$'] } — dhyaan do ki regexes Rust me process hote hain, isliye syntax JavaScript RegExp se alag hai (docs.rs/regex dekho).
  • Supported features — Console hatao: application code (NAHI node_modules) me saare console.* calls hatata hai, jaise babel-plugin-transform-remove-console. compiler: { removeConsole: true }; console.error rakhne ke liye removeConsole: { exclude: ['error'] }.
  • Supported features — Legacy Decorators: jsconfig.json/tsconfig.json me experimentalDecorators se auto-detected; aam taur par MobX jaisi libraries ke purane versions ke saath use hota hai. Sirf compatibility — naye apps ke liye recommended nahi.
  • Supported features — importSource: jsconfig.json/tsconfig.json me jsxImportSource se auto-detected; aam taur par Theme UI jaisi libraries ke saath use hota hai.
  • Supported features — Emotion: @emotion/babel-plugin ka ek port; compiler: { emotion: boolean | { sourceMap?: boolean (default true; production me disabled), autoLabel?: 'never' | 'dev-only' | 'always' (default 'dev-only'), labelFormat?: string (default '[local]'; allowed [local], [filename], [dirname]; sirf tab kaam karta hai jab autoLabel 'dev-only' ya 'always' ho; jaise "my-classname--[local]"), importMap?: { [packageName]: { [exportName]: { canonicalImport?, styledBaseImport? } } } } }.
  • Minification: Next.js ka SWC compiler v13 se default roop se minification ke liye use hota hai — Terser se 7x tez. Note: v15 se shuru karke, minification next.config.js se customize nahi ho sakti; swcMinify flag hata diya gaya hai.
  • Module Transpilation: Next.js local packages (monorepos) ya external dependencies (node_modules) se dependencies ko automatically transpile aur bundle karta hai — next-transpile-modules package ko replace karta hai: transpilePackages: ['@acme/ui', 'lodash-es'] (C2.74 dekho).
  • Modularize Imports: Next.js 13.5 me optimizePackageImports dwara superseded (C2.38 dekho) — naye option par upgrade karo, jise manual import-path configuration nahi chahiye.
  • Define (build ke dauraan variables badalna): compiler.define build time par saare environments (server, edge, client) ke liye variables ko statically replace karta hai; compiler.defineServer sirf server-side (server aur Edge) code ke liye variables define karta hai:
js
module.exports = {
  compiler: {
    define: {
      MY_VARIABLE: 'my-string',
      'process.env.MY_ENV_VAR': 'my-env-var',
    },
    defineServer: {
      MY_SERVER_VARIABLE: 'my-server-var',
    },
  },
}
  • Build Lifecycle Hooks: vartaman me ek hook — runAfterProductionCompile: production build compilation khatm hone ke baad execute hota hai, lekin type checking aur static page generation jaise post-compilation kaam se pehle; { distDir, projectDir } receive karta hai (distDir default .next); third-party tools ke liye useful jo sourcemaps jaise output collect karte hain:
js
module.exports = {
  compiler: {
    runAfterProductionCompile: async ({ distDir, projectDir }) => {
      // Your custom code here
    },
  },
}
  • Experimental — SWC trace profiling: experimental: { swcTraceProfiling: true } SWC ke internal transform traces Chromium trace-event format me .next/ ke tahat swc-trace-profile-${timestamp}.json ke roop me generate karta hai; chrome://tracing, ui.perfetto.dev, ya speedscope.app me dekha ja sakta hai.
  • Experimental — SWC Plugins: SWC ke transforms ko experimental WASM plugins use karne ke liye configure karta hai: experimental: { swcPlugins: [['plugin', {...pluginOptions }]] } — tuples ki array; har tuple plugin path (ek npm module package ka naam ya .wasm binary ka full path) plus ek config object hai.
  • Unsupported features: jab tumhare app me .babelrc file hoti hai, to Next.js individual files ko transform karne ke liye automatically Babel par fallback karta hai (custom Babel plugins ke liye backward compatibility). Team custom Babel setup wale users se apna config share karne ko kehti hai; ve commonly used Babel transforms ko port kar rahe hain aur plugin support ki taraf kaam kar rahe hain.
  • Version history: v12.0.0 Next.js Compiler launch hua; v12.1.0 Styled Components, Jest, Relay, React properties hatao, Legacy Decorators, Remove Console, jsxImportSource; v12.2.0 SWC plugins experimental; v12.3.0 SWC Minifier stable; v13.0.0 SWC Minifier default roop se enabled; v13.1.0 Module Transpilation aur Modularize Imports stable.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
shirshak sankhya - 17x tezi se compilation ki tulna mein Babel, ~ 3x tezi se Fast Refresh, ~ 5x tezi se build, 7x tej minification of Terser. opt-out niyam (ek .babelrc ka arth hai Babel, nahi SWC) classic hachaa hai. swcMinify v15 ke baad se chala gaya hai - minification ab config yogy nahi hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/architecture/nextjs-compiler
Hissa 302 / 471 · App Router · Architecture

Architecture — Supported Browsers

App RouterArchitecture

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Architecture hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Architecture — Supported Browsers. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Architecture — Supported Browsers — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Browserslist, Polyfills, Custom polyfills, JavaScript language features. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya yeh hai: browser support aur kaun se JavaScript Next.js support pradan karta hai. Next.js zero config ke saath modern browsers ka support karta hai: Chrome 111+, Edge 111+, Firefox 111+, Safari 16.4+.

  • Browserslist: vishisht browsers ya features ko lakshit karne ke liye, Next.js package.json mein browserslist configuration ka support karta hai. default hai:
json
{
  "browserslist": ["chrome 111", "edge 111", "firefox 111", "safari 16.4"]
}
  • Polyfills: Next.js vyapak roop se istemal kiya polyfills, fetch() ( / unfetch ki jagah), URL (.js url package ki jagah) aur Object.assign() (object-assign, object.assign, core-js/object/assign ki jagah) sahit injekshan data hai. yadi kisi bhi dependency mein in polyfill shamil hain, to ve dohraav se bachne ke liye production build se automatic roop se samapt ho jate hain. bundle size ko kam karne ke liye, Next.js keval un browsers ke liye in poleephils ko load karta hai jinki requirement hoti hai - global web traiphik ka bahumat unhein download nahi karega. whatwg-fetch Node
  • Custom polyfills: yadi aapka apna code ya koi npm dependency ki zaroorat hai to aapke target browsers (e.g) dwara supported nahi hai. IE 11), apne aap ko jorte hain. App Router: unhein instrumentation-client.js file (import './polyfills') mein import karta hai. Pages Router: apne custom <App> (pages/_app.tsx) ya vyaktigat component mein vishisht polyfill ke liye ek top level ka import jodti hai. Conditionally load ho raha hai polyfills (sabse achha drishtikon): vishisht UI sections ke liye unsupported features ko alag karta hai aur keval zaroorat parne par polyfill load - e.g. check if (!('structuredClone' in globalThis)) to const mod = await import('polyfills/structured-clone'); globalThis.structuredClone = mod.default callback ke andar hai ki yeh zaroorat hai.
  • JavaScript bhasha visheshataein: Next.js aapko box se latest JS ka upyog karne data hai - ES6 features plus async/await (ES2017), objekt Rest/Spread (ES2018), dynamic import() (ES2020), Optional Chaining (ES2020), Nullish Coalescing (ES2020), Class Fields aur Static Properties (ES2022), aur adhika. TypeScript banaya gaya hai. Custom Babel config sanbhav hai (advanced).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)

Community — Contribution Guide (Docs)

App RouterCommunity

Ye page App Router (naya, recommended tareeka) ke Community hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Community — Contribution Guide (Docs). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Community — Contribution Guide (Docs) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How to contribute, Writing MDX, File structure, Metadata, App and Pages docs / shared pages, Code blocks. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye App Router wala tareeka hai — Server Components yahan default hote hain, isliye jo baat yahan kahi gayi hai wo Pages Router par waisi ki waisi lagu nahi hogi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Kya is: kaise Next.js pralekhan mein yogdan karne ke liye. docs yogdan shuruaati logon ke liye khula source prapt karne aur experienced devalapars ke liye jatil vishyon ko spasht karne ka ek achha tareeka hai. Typos, bhramit classes, aur lapta vishyon sabhi svaagat yogdan hain.

  • Contribute kaise karein: Docs content Next.js repo (github.com/vercel/next.js/tree/canary/docs) me rehti hai. Files ko seedhe GitHub par edit karo ya repo clone karke locally edit karo. GitHub par naye ho: GitHub Open Source Guide padho (fork → branch → pull request). Note: underlying docs code ek private codebase me rehta hai jo public repo me sync hota hai, isliye tum docs ko locally preview NAHI kar sakte — tumhare changes PR merge hone ke baad nextjs.org par dikhte hain. Next.js ya Developer Experience teams review karti hain, feedback deti hain aur ready hone par merge karti hain. Tip: submit karne se pehle pnpm prettier-fix chalao.
  • MDX likhna: Docs MDX (Markdown + JSX) me likhe jate hain, isliye React components embed kiye ja sakte hain. VSCode preview: settings.json me *.mdx ko markdown ke saath associate karo ("files.associations": { "*.mdx": "markdown" }), phir Markdown: Preview File / Open Preview to the Side use karo. Recommended extensions: MDX (IntelliSense + syntax highlighting) aur Prettier (save par format).
  • File structure: Docs file-system routing use karte hain — /docs ke neeche har folder/file ek route segment hai jo URL path, navigation aur breadcrumbs generate karta hai. Navigation items default roop se alphabetically sort hote hain; order badalne ke liye folder/file naam par two-digit number (00-) prepend karo. 04-functions/ easy lookup ke liye alphabetical hai, jabki 01-getting-started/ learning order me numbered hai. Manifest kyun nahi: manifest files ke saath out of sync ho jayega; file-system routing structure ke baare me sochne par majboor karta hai aur Next.js ke native jaisa lagta hai. ⌘/Ctrl + P aur slug se page jaldi dhoondho.
  • Metadata: har page me teen dashes ke beech ek frontmatter block hota hai. Required: title (<h1>, SEO aur OG images ke liye use hota hai) aur description (<meta name="description"> me use hota hai). Achhi practice: title 2-3 shabd, description 1-2 sentences. Optional: nav_title (jab title bahut lamba ho to navigation me use override karta hai), source (shared page me content kheenchta hai — neeche dekho), related (related pages ki list, neeche cards me badal jati hai), version (ek stage: experimental, legacy, unstable, RC).
  • App aur Pages docs / shared pages: App Router aur Pages Router docs alag sections (02-app aur 03-pages) me rehte hain kyunki zyadaatar features alag hain; shared features source field ke through duplication se bachte hain — jaise Pages <Link> page me source: app/api-reference/components/link plus ek DO NOT EDIT THIS PAGE comment hai, isliye App version ko edit karne se dono update hote hain. Shared content: router-specific blocks <AppOnly> / <PagesOnly> components me wrap hote hain (jaise shallow prop sirf Pages me hai).
  • Code blocks: har code block ek minimum working example hona chahiye jo copy-paste karke bina extra config ke chal sake — commit karne se pehle examples hamesha locally chalao. Header me language aur filename shamil karo (jaise tsx filename="app/page.tsx"); CLI commands ke liye package prop use karo taaki command har package manager ke hisaab se dikhe. Zyadaatar examples tsx/jsx hain, kuch bash. Language/extension mapping: JSX wala JS → jsx + .js; bina JSX wala JS → js + .js; JSX wala TS → tsx + .tsx; bina JSX wala TS → ts + .ts. Note: JSX wali JavaScript files ke liye .jsx extension use karo. TS and JS Switcher: TS/JS toggle karne ke liye switcher jodo — pehle TypeScript, phir JavaScript, switcher prop se linked. Line highlighting: highlight={1} (single), highlight={1,3} (multiple), highlight={1-5} (range).
  • Icons: <Check size={18} /> aur <Cross size={18} /> available hain; docs me emojis use NAHI hote.
  • Notes: important lekin secondary jaankari ke liye **Good to know**: ... use karo (single line ya bullet item ke saath multi-line).
  • Related Links: main content ke neeche cards ke saath user ki learning journey ko guide karta hai; child pages wale pages ke liye auto-generated jodta hai. Ye related metadata field (description, links) se bante hain — leading slash ke bina relative URL path, jaise app/api-reference/file-conventions/page; title optional hai ('Next Steps').
  • Diagrams: Figma me Vercel ke design guide ke hisaab se bante hain; ve private Next.js site me /public me rehte hain — update/add karne ke liye, apne ideas ke saath ek GitHub issue kholo.
  • Custom components aur HTML: available docs components hain <Image /> (next/image), <PagesOnly />, <AppOnly />, <Cross />, <Check />. <details> tag ke alawa raw HTML allowed NAHI hai. Naye component ideas GitHub issue me aate hain.
  • Style guide — page template: docs pages me repeat hone wale sections: Overview (pehle paragraph me — ye kya hai aur kis ke liye hai — uske baad minimum working example ya API reference), Conventions, Examples (alag use cases), API tables (jahan mumkin ho, upar overview table code-to-section links ke saath), Next Steps (Related Links). Page types: conceptual pages ek concept/feature samjhate hain (lambe, zyada jaankari; Building Your Application me) vs reference pages ek specific API ke (chhote, zyada focused; API Reference me). Voice alag hoti hai: conceptual pages instructional hote hain aur reader ko address karte hain; reference pages technical, imperative ('create, update, accept') hote hain. Voice guidelines: saaf, chhote sentences; uljhe hue sentences se bacho (comma-bhare sentences ko kai sentences ya list me todo); complex shabdon ki jagah simple shabd; active voice ko passive par prefer karo; 'easy', 'quick', 'simple', 'bas' jaise subjective shabdon se bacho; negative shabdon se bacho (uske bajaye batao kya karna hai); second person (you/your); gender-neutral bhasha (seller, user, reader); pakka karo ki code examples sahi formatted aur kaam karne wale hon. Gehri padhai: Google Technical Writing Course.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/community/contribution-guide

Installation

Pages RouterGetting Started

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Getting Started hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Installation. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Installation — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Create with CLI (recommended), ⚠️ Pages vs App Router difference, Manual install, Pages Router manual setup (verbatim essentials), TypeScript, Absolute imports/aliases. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: system requirements - Node.js 20.9+ minimum; macOS, Windows (incl). WSL, Linux. supported browser (zero config): Chrome/Edge/Firefox 111+, Safari 16.4+.

  • CLI (recommended): npx create-next-app@latest (ya pnpm create next-app, yarn create next-app, bun create next-app) se create karo. Prompts: project ka naam; recommended defaults (TypeScript, ESLint, No React Compiler, Tailwind CSS, No src/, App Router, Cache Components, AGENTS.md) banam customize — TypeScript? linter (ESLint/Biome/None), React Compiler?, Tailwind?, src/?, App Router? (recommended) No/Yes, Cache Components?, import alias @/*?, AGENTS.md?
  • Pages Router banam App Router antar: create-next-app default roop se App Router ke liye hota hai. Pages Router app banane ke liye customize settings mein "Would you like to use App Router?" ka jawab "No" dena hoga, ya manual install karke ek pages/ directory banaani hogi.
  • Manual install: npm i next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest, phir package.json (verbatim) mein script:
json
{ "scripts": { "dev": "next dev", "build": "next build", "start": "next start", "lint": "eslint", "lint:fix": "eslint --fix" } }

next dev = dev server (Turbopack default; --webpack Webpack ka upyog karne ke liye). next build = production ka nirmaan. next start = production sarvara.

  • Pages Router manual setup (verbatim essentials): export default function Page() { return <h1>Hello, Next.js!</h1> } ke saath pages/index.tsx banata hai; pages/_app.tsx:
tsx
import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
export default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
  return <Component {...pageProps} />
}

next/document se Html, Head, Main, NextScript ke saath pages/_document.tsx aur pages/_document.tsx. public/ folder (optional) / (e.g) se static assets ka karya karta hai. public/profile.png → /profile.png).

  • TypeScript: minat TS v5.1.0; .ts/.tsx ko ek file ka naam badlein aur next dev - Next.js auto-install deps chalaein aur tsconfig.json jorte hain. Linting: ESLint ya Biome; next lint chala gaya hai - seedhe ESLint CLI ka upyog karein; codemod npx @next/codemod@canary next-lint-to-eslint-cli.. Since Next.js 16, next build ab automatic roop se linter chalata nahi hai.
  • Absolute imports/aliases: tsconfig.json/jsconfig.json baseUrl + paths, e.g. @/components/* → components/*; baseUrl: "src/"
  • Upgrade: npx next upgrade (ya pnpm next upgrade); ek agent sanchalit upgrade ke liye npx next@canary upgrade --agent=latest.
  • Dhyaan Do / interview points: Pages Router apne package.json se React sanskaran ka upyog karta hai; App Router built-in React canary release ka upyog karta hai. dev server http://localhost:3000 par chalta hai. public/ mein files ko root se served jata hai.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router manual setup app/page.tsx + app/layout.tsx ka upyog karta hai; Pages Router pages/index.tsx + pages/_app.tsx + pages/_document.tsx ka upyog karta hai. koi layout.tsx, koi loading.tsx, Pages Router mein koi Route Handlers nahi hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/getting-started/installation

Images (Image Optimization)

Pages RouterGetting Started

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Getting Started hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Images (Image Optimization). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Images (Image Optimization) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Local images, Static import (preferred), Remote images, Gotchas, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next/image se <Image> <img> ka vistar karta hai: size optimization (tool ke anusar sahi size, WebP/AVIF), view stability (koi CLS - layout shift roka), tezi se load (mool lazy load ho raha hai, keval viewport mein load karta hai, optional blar-ap plesholdar), on-demand rimot images ke liye bhi reesaaij karta hai.

  • Local images: public/ ke tahat store, / se sandarbh:
tsx
import Image from 'next/image'
export default function Page() {
  return <Image src="/profile.png" alt="Picture of the author" width={500} height={500} />
}
  • Static import (preferred): import ProfileImage from './profile.png' to <Image src={ProfileImage} alt="..." /> — Next.js auto-provides width, height, blurDataURL. static import ke bina, ek Server Component (App Router pattern docs mein dikhaya gaya hai) mein dynamic import() ka upyog karein; Pages Router mein aap common roop se static import ka upyog karte hain ya manual roop se width/height paas karte hain.
  • Remote images: src ke liye ek URL string paas karta hai, lekin aap MUST supply width + height manual roop se (Next.js build samay par durasth files ko nahi parh sakte) ya fill ka upyog karte hain. aur aap MUST ki permission next.config.js images.remotePatterns mein hostlist karte hain ( jitna sanbhav ho utna vishisht ho - protocol/hostname/pathname, e.g). s3.amazonaws.com + /my-bucket/**) durbhavnapurn upyog ko rokne ke liye.
  • Dhyaan Do: width/height ko string src ke liye required hai; unhein bhool jana #1 error hai. alt ki requirement hai. remotePatterns ke bina durasth chhaviyan runtime par fail raheen.
  • Fark banam App Router: <Image> API donon routers mein saman hai; keval aaspas ke page file bhinn hoti hai (pages/*.tsx banam app/page.tsx).

Fonts

Pages RouterGetting Started

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Getting Started hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Fonts. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Fonts — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Local fonts, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next/font auto-optimize fonts aur external network requests ko hata data hai; built-in self-hosting — fonts apne domain se served jata hai, Google ke liye koi request nahi hai, koi layout shift (CLS).

  • Google Fonts (verbatim pattern — dhyaan dein: Pages Router mein yeh ek root layout mein pages/_app, NOT mein chala jata hai):
tsx
import { Geist } from 'next/font/google'
import type { AppProps } from 'next/app'
const geist = Geist({ subsets: ['latin'] })
export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
  return (<main className={geist.className}><Component {...pageProps} /></main>)
}

veriyebal fonts ki sifarish ki; gair parivartaniy fonts ko eksaplikit weight, e.g ki requirement hoti hai. Roboto({ weight: '400', subsets: ['latin'] })

  • Local fonts: src: './my-font.woff2' ke saath import localFont from 'next/font/local'; src ek parivar ki kai files ke liye { path, weight, style } objekts ki ek sarani ho sakti hai. fonts public/ mein ya pages/ ke andar rah sakte hain.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router root layout.tsx mein fonts lagu karta hai (aksar CSS char variable: '--font-geist' ke madhyam se); Pages Router unhein pages/_app.tsx mein className ke madhyam se lagu karta hai.

Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: style vikalp: Tailwind CSS, CSS module, global CSS, external stylesheet, Sass, CSS-in-JS.

  • Tailwind (v4): npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss; '@tailwindcss/postcss': {} ke saath postcss.config.mjs; styles/globals.css mein @import 'tailwindcss';; import karein ki pages/_app.js mein CSS. (v3 setup ek alag guide hai.)
  • CSS module: file ka naam *.module.css → local roop se dayar class ke naam, koi takrav nahi: import styles from '@/styles/blog.module.css' to className={styles.blog}. pages/ ke andar kisi bhi component se import karne yogya.
  • Global CSS: ne pages/_app.js (import '@/styles/global.css') mein ONLY import kiya - global CSS import kahin aur ek error hai. yeh ek classic interview gotcha hai.
  • External stylesheets: 9.5.4 ke baad se , CSS ko node_modules se kahin bhi import kiya jaa sakta hai; global log (bootstrap, nprogress) _app.js mein jate hain; component CSS (e.g). @reach/dialog/styles.css) ko component file mein import kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • Ordering and merging: production build chunks/merges stylesheets; order code mein import order ka palan karta hai. Recommendation: mein CSS ek entry file mein import karta hai; root par globals/Tailwind import karta hai; component styles ke liye Tailwind, CSS module ko pasand karta hai; susangat <name>.module.css namkaran; sajha components mein sajha styles ko nikalne; import-sanyojan linters (unka brek CSS ordar); cssChunking config vikalp maujud hai. dev banam prod: dev = Fast Refresh tatkal update; prod = kai chhota, code-split .css files, minimum CSS prati route; CSS load yahan tak ki JS ke saath prod mein disabled hai, lekin JS ko Fast Refresh ke liye dev mein required hai. CSS ordar dev aur prod ke beech bhinn ho sakta hai - hamesha next build. ke saath verify karein
  • Fark banam App Router: saman CSS visheshataein; ekmatr antar import sthan hai - pages/_app.js (Page) banam root app/layout.js (App).

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: built-in performance maapa. do routes: useReportWebVitals hook (DIY riporting) ya Vercel analytics (prabndhit serve).

  • Client instrumentation: frontend code shuru hone se pahle project root run par instrumentation-client.js|ts - global analytics/error tracking/performance nigrani setup ke liye aadarsha.
  • build your own (verbatim, Pages Router — hook pages/_app.js mein rahta hai):
jsx
import { useReportWebVitals } from 'next/web-vitals'
function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
  useReportWebVitals((metric) => { console.log(metric) })
  return <Component {...pageProps} />
}
  • Web Vitals mein shamil hain: TTFB, FCP, LCP, CLS, INP. metric.name svich dwara sambhal lein. Custom Next.js metric: Next.js-hydration (+phinish hydrating shuru karne ka samay), Next.js-route-change-to-render, Next.js-render ( API ka support karne wale sabhi browsers mein kaam karte hain). _app mein legacy pattern export function reportWebVitals(metric) bhi dikhaya gaya hai. User Timing
  • Sending parinam: navigator.sendBeacon(url, body) pasandida, Fallback fetch(url, { body, method: 'POST', keepalive: true }). Google Analytics: window.gtag('event', metric.name, { value: Math.round(metric.name === 'CLS'? metric.value * 1000: metric.value), event_label: metric.id, non_interaction: true }) — not CLS maan × 1000 aur integer maana.
  • Fark banam App Router: saman hook/API; App Router aam taur par ise _app ke bajaay client component ya root layout mein kahte hain.

Authentication

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Authentication. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Authentication — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Login flow (Pages Router), Session management — two types, Stateless cookie (verbatim pattern), Database sessions, Authorization — two check types, Proxy (middleware) optimistic checks. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts (3 khanbhe): 1) Authentication — identity verify karein (username/password). 2) Session Management - requests ke anusar dusre state ko track karein. 3) Authorization - yeh tay karta hai ki user kis routes/data ka upyog kar sakta hai. Docs ek auth library (Auth0, Better Auth, klark, Descope, Kinde, Logto, NextAuth.js/Auth.js, Ory, Stack Auth, Supabase, Stytch, WorkOS) ka upyog karne ki salah dete hain; page ka username/password udaharan shaikshik hai.

  • Login flow (Pages Router): pages/login.tsx me form next/router se useRouter aur FormData use karta hai, JSON ko /api/auth/login par POST karta hai; response.ok par → router.push('/profile'). API route pages/api/auth/login.ts (NextApiRequest/NextApiResponse) signIn('credentials', { email, password }) call karta hai; CredentialsSignin par 401, warna 500.
  • Session management — do types: Stateless — session data/token browser cookie me, har request ke saath bheja jata hai, server par verify hota hai (simpler, galat tareeke se karne par kam secure). Database — session DB me, browser sirf encrypted session ID rakhta hai (zyada secure, complex/server load). Recommended libs: iron-session, Jose.
  • Stateless cookie (verbatim pattern): ek API route me, encrypt(sessionData), phir serialize('session', encrypted, { httpOnly: true, secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', maxAge: 60*60*24*7, path: '/' }), res.setHeader('Set-Cookie', cookie). Cookie flags matter karte hain: httpOnly (koi JS access → XSS protection), prod me secure, maxAge 1 hafta.
  • Database sessions: sessions ke liye DB table; insert/update/delete functions; cookie me session ID encrypt karo; DB + cookie sync me rakho (Proxy me optimistic checks enable karta hai).
  • Authorization — do types ke checks: Optimistic (sirf cookie data — fast, UI show/hide aur redirects ke liye) vs Secure (DB data — sensitive data/actions ke liye). Recommendations: ek Data Access Layer (DAL) me centralize karo; sirf zaroori data return karne ke liye DTOs use karo; optionally optimistic checks ke liye Proxy use karo.
  • Proxy (middleware) optimistic checks: root par proxy.ts, next/server se NextRequest/NextResponse; protectedRoutes = ['/dashboard'], publicRoutes = ['/login', '/signup', '/'] list karta hai; session cookie decrypt karta hai; unauthenticated → /login redirect, public route par authenticated → /dashboard; matcher: ['/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|.*\.png$).*)']. Critical gotcha: Proxy prefetched samet HAR route par chalta hai — session sirf cookie se padho (optimistic), wahan kabhi DB check mat karo (performance). Proxy tumhari ekmatra defense NAHI hai — asal security checks data source ke jitna ho sake paas rehte hain (DAL).
  • API routes protect karna (verbatim pattern): session check karo → missing ho to 401; session.user.role !== 'admin' check karo → 401; tabhi handler chalao.
  • App Router se fark: Pages Router auth API Routes (pages/api/*, NextApiRequest/NextApiResponse) aur getServerSideProps me hota hai; App Router Server Actions / Route Handlers (app/api/route.ts, NextRequest/NextResponse) aur next/headers se cookies padhne wale Server Components use karta hai. Proxy file Next.js 16 me dono routers me shared hai (root proxy.ts). Dhyaan do ki docs ka Proxy example is page par bhi cookies ko next/headers (App Router API) se import karta hai — ek pure Pages Router app me, cookies API routes me req.cookies se / getServerSideProps me req.headers.cookie se padho.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/authentication

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js ne next/babel preset ko ship kiya, jismein React app aur server-side code ko compiled karne ke liye required sab kuchh shamil hai. yadi aap default Babel config ka vistar karna chahte hain, to aap project root mein .babelrc file (ya babel.config.js) ko define karke — kar sakte hain. yadi aisi file payi jati hai, to yeh saty ka source ban jata hai aur khud next/babel preset shamil hona chahiye.

  • Adding presets/plugins bina config (verbatim): {"presets": ["next/babel"], "plugins": []} — e.g. "@babel/plugin-proposal-do-expressions" ko plugins kahte hain.
  • Customizing presets/plugins config ke saath (verbatim): ["next/babel", {"preset-env": {}, "transform-runtime": {}, "styled-jsx": {}, "class-properties": {}}] ke roop mein next/babel preset par paas vikalpa. prati vikalp vivaran ke liye, babeljs.io/docs. dekhein
  • Good to know / gotchas: Next.js server-side compilation ke liye vartaman Node.js sanskaran ka upyog karta hai. preset-env par modules vikalp ko false rakhna chahiye, anyatha webpack code vibhajan ko band kar diya jata hai. udaharan repo: optimization babel config (https://github.com/vercel/next.js/tree/canary/examples/with-custom-babel-config); next/babel purv set source: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/packages/next/src/build/babel/preset.ts.
  • Fark banam App Router / aadhunik default: SWC (Rust compiler) aadhunik Next.js mein default compiler hai; ek custom Babel config jodna SWC se bahar nikalta hai aur Babel ko wapas girta hai, jo dhimi hai. Next.js 16, Turbopack se automatic roop se Babel ka upyog karta hai agar yeh ek config file ka pata lagata hai (jabki SWC abhi bhi internal roop se badalta hai). interview point: jab aapko vastav mein ek Babel-only plugin/transform ki requirement hoti hai to keval ek Babel config jorte hain - anyatha SWC default par rahta hai.

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai CI Build Caching. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: CI Build Caching — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Per-provider configs (verbatim essentials). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js ne build ke beech sajha kiye gaye .next/cache ko ek build cache bacha liya. CI mein aapko ise build ke beech banaye rakhna hoga ya aapko "No Cache Detected" error aur dhimi gati se build karna hoga.

  • Per-provider configs (verbatim essentials): Vercel — automatic, karne ke liye kuchh bhi nahi. CircleCI - key: dependency-cache-{{ checksum "yarn.lock" }} ke saath save_cache path ./node_modules + ./.next/cache. Travis — cache.directories: [$HOME/.cache/yarn, node_modules,.next/cache]. GitLab - cache: { key: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}, paths: [node_modules/,.next/cache/] }. Netlify - @netlify/plugin-nextjs ka upyog karein. AWS CodeBuild — buildspec.yml cache path node_modules/**/* + .next/cache/**/*. GitHub karya - actions/cache@v4, path: ~/.npm + ${{ github.workspace }}/.next/cache, key: ${{ runner.os }}-nextjs-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.js', '**/*.jsx', '**/*.ts', '**/*.tsx') }}, restore-keys ke saath lockfile-keval key par wapas aa gaya. Bitbucket — definitions.caches.nextcache:.next/cache, step caches mein sandarbhita. herokoo - package.json mein "cacheDirectories": [".next/cache"]. Azure Pipelines - Cache@2 karya, key: next | $(Agent.OS) | yarn.lock path $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/.next/cache. jenkins - Job Cacher plugin, cache node_modules (validity file package-lock.json) aur .next/cache (validity file ek next-lock.cache file $GIT_COMMIT se likha gaya hai).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
cache key mein lockfile hash (deps change → new cache) plus sors-file hash shamil hona chahiye; punarsthaapnaa key ek partial-hit fallback de sakti hai.

Content Security Policy (CSP)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Content Security Policy (CSP). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Content Security Policy (CSP) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Nonces, Adding a nonce with Proxy (verbatim core), Matcher, How nonces work in Next.js, Critical: nonces REQUIRE dynamic rendering., Reading the nonce (Pages Router, verbatim). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: CSP XSS ke khilaf guard, klikjaiking, scripts, styles, images, fonts, objekts, media, aaeephrems ke liye mool indexing dwara code injekshana. udaharan repo: saath-saath-strict-csp.

  • Nonces: ek nonce ek unique random ek bar string hai; ek script/style keval tabhi chalta hai jab yeh match nonse karta hai, isliye attacker ko yeh anuman lagana chahiye. prati request apratyashit aur unique hona chahiye.
  • Proxy (verbatim kor) ke saath ek nonce ko Adding: proxy.ts const nonce = Buffer.from(crypto.randomUUID()).toString('base64') generated karta hai aur ek CSP header ki tarah set karta hai:
code
default-src 'self';
script-src 'self' 'nonce-${nonce}' 'strict-dynamic'${isDev ? " 'unsafe-eval'" : ''};
style-src 'self' 'nonce-${nonce}';
img-src 'self' blob: data:;
font-src 'self';
object-src 'none';
base-uri 'self';
form-action 'self';
frame-ancestors 'none';
upgrade-insecure-requests;

yeh ek x-nonce request header aur Content-Security-Policy pratikriya header donon set karta hai (vhaaitaspes .replace(/\s{2,}/g, ' ').trim() ke madhyam se gir gaya). Dev gotcha: 'unsafe-eval' ko development mein required hai kyonki React ne advanced debugging (server error stack ko punarnirman) ke liye eval ka upyog kiya hai; NOT ko production mein required hai.

  • Matcher: api, _next/static, _next/image, favicon.ico ko bahar nikalta hai aur prefetch request (missing: [{ type: 'header', key: 'next-router-prefetch' }, { type: 'header', key: 'purpose', value: 'prefetch' }]) ko andekha karta hai.
  • Kaise nonces Next.js: 1) Proxy mein kaam karte hain, ise CSP + x-nonce header mein jodta hai. 2) Next.js ne CSP header ko render karne aur 'nonce-{value}' pattern ke madhyam se nonce nikalne ke dauraan parse kiya. 3) Next.js automatic roop se ise phremavark script, page bundle, inline styles/scripts aur kisi bhi <Script nonce={...}> se jodti hai. koi manual taiging ki zaroorat nahi hai.
  • Critical: nonces REQUIRE dynamic rendering. static page build samay par generated hote hain jismein koi request/response header nahi hote hain, isliye koi nons injekshan nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. parinam: sabhi page dynamic, koi static optimization nahi, ISR disabled, koi CDN default roop se caching nahi, PPR asangat, dhimi bhar + uchch server lagata. App Router next/server se await connection() ke madhyam se dynamic shakti pradan karta hai; Pages Router ne getServerSideProps E (kisi bhi page ka export yeh SSR hai) ke madhyam se dynamic shakti pradan ki hai.
  • nonce padhna (Pages Router, kriyaaklaap): ke madhyam se getServerSideProps: const nonce = req.headers['x-nonce']; return { props: { nonce } }, phir <Script src="https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js" strategy="afterInteractive" nonce={nonce} />. ya pages/_document.tsx mein: getInitialProps ne ctx.req?.headers?.['x-nonce'] ko padha aur nonce ko <Head nonce={nonce} /> aur <NextScript nonce={nonce} /> ko paas kiya. _app.tsx mein, pageProps.nonce ko padha aur <Script nonce={nonce}> ko paas kiya.
  • Without nonces: ne CSP ko static roop se next.config.js async headers() mein source: '/(.*)' aur key: 'Content-Security-Policy' ke saath set kiya, jiska upyog 'unsafe-inline' ke liye 'unsafe-inline' (weaker lekin static rendering rakhta hai) ka upyog kiya jata hai. script/style
  • Troubleshooting: third-party lipiyon ko CSP + nonce prop mein apne domain ki requirement hoti hai; aam ullanghan - inline styles (gair-aware CSS-in-JS ya external files ka upyog karein), dynamic import ( script-src mein permission), WebAssembly ('wasm-unsafe-eval'), serve kaaryakartaaon (add policies). sanskaran history: v14.0.0 experimental SRI support hash-aadharit CSP ke liye; v13.4.20 uchit gairej handling ke liye sifarish ki.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"Why do a nonce meri static site dynamic banate hain? - kyonki nonce prati-request hai aur keval SSR ke dauraan injekt kiya jaa sakta hai; static HTML ka koi request sandarbh nahi hai.

Custom Server

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Custom Server. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Custom Server — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Minimal custom server (verbatim), `next()` options, Gotchas, Disabling file-system routing. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next start built-in server hai; ek custom server aapko programmatic roop se custom pattern (ejecting) ke liye Next.js shuru karne data hai. adhikansh apps ko kabhi iski requirement nahi hoti hai; iska upyog keval tabhi kiya jata hai jab ekikrit router aavashyaktaon ko pura nahi kar sakta hai. ek maujuda backend hona NOT ek custom server hai - aap ise proxy kar sakte hain.

  • Minimal custom server (verbatim):
js
import { createServer } from 'http'
import next from 'next'
const port = parseInt(process.env.PORT || '3000', 10)
const dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'
const app = next({ dev })
const handle = app.getRequestHandler()
app.prepare().then(() => {
  createServer((req, res) => { handle(req, res) }).listen(port)
  console.log(`> Server listening at http://localhost:${port} as ${dev ? 'development' : process.env.NODE_ENV}`)
})

script: "dev": "node server.js", "build": "next build", "start": "NODE_ENV=production node server.js". nodemon dev reload ke liye istemal kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • next() vikalp: conf (next.config.js ke roop mein sam object), dev (default jhooth), dir (default '.'), quiet, hostname, port, httpServer, turbopack (default on), webpack.
  • Dhyaan Do: (1) Set apne khud ke pratikriya header BEFORE calling handle E — Next.js shuru hota hai andar handle bhej raha hai, isliye iske baad res.headersSent true hai aur baad mein res.setHeader() ko chupchap tyaag diya jata hai (jab Express/Fastify mein lapeta jata hai). (2) server.js NOT ko Next.js compiler/bundler ke madhyam se chalaya jata hai - iska vakya aapke Node.js sanskaran ke saath sangat hona chahiye. (3) Standalone output mode custom server files ka pata nahi lagata hai aur apne khud ke minimum server.js ko output karta hai - donon ka upyog ek saath nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • Disabling file system routing: next.config.js → useFileSystemPublicRoutes: false SSR file naam routes ko band kar data hai (ek custom server apne routes ko define karte samay dupliket content/SEO muddon ko rokta hai). Caveat: yeh keval SSR file naam routes ko inactive karta hai; client-side routing abhi bhi un pathon tak pahunch sakti hai - programmatic roop se guard aur client-side ko block karne ke liye router.beforePopState ka upyog karte hain.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"jab aap ek custom server ka upyog kareinge? - lagabhag kabhi nahi; keval custom routing pattern ke liye built-in router vyakt nahi kar sakta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/custom-server

Debugging

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Debugging. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Debugging — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: VS Code `.vscode/launch.json` (verbatim, 4 configs), WebStorm, Browser DevTools — client-side, Browser DevTools — server-side, Inspect server errors, Windows gotcha. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: debag frontend + full source manchitron ke saath backend VS Code debugger, Chrome DevTools, ya Firefox DevTools ka upyog karte hain. koi bhi debugger jo Node.js karyon se jur sakta hai.

  • VS Code .vscode/launch.json (verbatim, 4 configs): (1) 'Next.js: debug server-side' — type: node-terminal, command: "npm run dev -- --inspect". (2) 'debug client-side' — type: chrome, url: http://localhost:3000. (3) 'debug client-side (Firefox)' — type: firefox, reAttach: true, pathMappings webpack://_N_E → ${workspaceFolder} (Firefox Debugger extension chahiye). (4) 'debug full stack' — type: node, program: ${workspaceFolder}/node_modules/next/dist/bin/next, runtimeArgs: ["--inspect"], skipFiles: ["<node_internals>/**"], serverReadyAction: { action: "debugWithEdge" (ya debugWithChrome), pattern: "- Local:.+(https?://.+)", uriFormat: "%s", webRoot: "${workspaceFolder}", killOnServerStop: true }. Monorepo (Turborepo) me "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}/apps/web" jodo. Debug panel (Ctrl+Shift+D) se start karo → config chuno → F5.
  • WebStorm: URL http://localhost:3000 ke saath ek JavaScript Debug config banao; use chalao — debug mode me 2 apps (Node app + browser app).
  • Browser DevTools — client-side: next dev chalao, localhost:3000 kholo, DevTools Sources (Chrome) / Debugger (Firefox); debugger statements par execution rukta hai; Ctrl+P se files search karo — source paths webpack://_N_E/./ se shuru hote hain. Components inspect karne, props/state edit karne aur perf problems ke liye React DevTools extension.
  • Browser DevTools — server-side: --inspect ke saath dev chalao (npm run dev -- --inspect, pnpm dev --inspect, yarn dev --inspect, bun run dev --inspect); remote/Docker debugging ke liye --inspect=0.0.0.0. Chrome: chrome://inspect → Remote Target → Inspect. Firefox: about:debugging → This Firefox → Remote Targets. Server source paths webpack://{application-name}/./ jaise dikhte hain. --inspect-brk / --inspect-wait ke liye NODE_OPTIONS=--inspect-brk next dev use karo.
  • Server errors inspect karna: error overlay version indicator ke neeche ek Node.js icon dikhata hai; server process ko inspect karne ke liye DevTools URL copy karne ke liye use click karo.
  • Windows gotcha: Windows Defender har file read ko check karta hai aur next dev ke saath Fast Refresh ko bahut slow kar deta hai — project folder ke liye use disable karo (known issue, Next.js ki galti nahi).
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/debugging

Draft Mode

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Draft Mode. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Draft Mode — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Step 1 — API route (verbatim), Securing it from a headless CMS, Step 2 — update `getStaticProps`, More details, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Static Generation (getStaticProps/getStaticPaths) ka build samay par kiya jata hai - ek hedles-CMS draft ka preview karne ke liye buraa. Draft Mode ek vishisht request ke liye Static Generation ko bypass karta hai: page request samay par render hota hai aur prakashit content ki bajaay draft content prapt karta hai.

  • Step 1 — API route (verbatim): pages/api/draft.ts res.setDraftMode({ enable: true }) call karta hai, jo __prerender_bypass naam ka ek cookie set karta hai. minimum testing route: res.setDraftMode({ enable: true }); res.end('Draft mode is enabled').
  • Securing it from a headless CMS: (1) keval application + CMS ke liye known ek gupt token banati hai; (2) CMS draft URL ko https://<your-site>/api/draft?secret=<token>&slug=<path> mein set karein; (3) route mein, req.query.secret aur slug ko verify karein, yeh pushti karne ke liye slag dwara post prapt karein, res.setDraftMode({ enable: true }) ko call karein, phir res.redirect(post.slug) (307) ko call karein. Security gotcha: ne post ke slag ko redirect kiya, NOT ko req.query.slug — yeh ek khula-redirect vulnerability hoga. Wrong secret/slug → 401.
  • Step 2 — update getStaticProps: cookie set ke saath, getStaticProps request time par chalta hai aur context.draftMode === true (aur context.params yadi getStaticPaths ka upyog kiya jata hai) prapt karta hai. iske bare mein shakha banam prakashit data ka format prapt karne ke liye:
js
export async function getStaticProps(context) {
  const url = context.draftMode ? 'https://draft.example.com' : 'https://production.example.com'
  const res = await fetch(url)
  // ...
}
  • More vivaran: Draft Mode session samapt hota hai jab browser band ho jata hai; manual roop se API route ke saath saaf karein, jise res.setDraftMode({ enable: false }) kaha jata hai - yadi aap ise <Link> ke saath link karte hain, to prefetch={false} ko paas karein ya prefetching galti se cookie ko hata dega. getServerSideProps ke saath bhi kaam karta hai (draftMode sandarbh mein) aur API roots (req.draftMode) ke sath. pratyek next build par ek naya bypass cookie maan generated hota hai, isliye yeh anuman nahi lagaya jaa sakta hai. Draft Mode ke saath Cache-Control set na karein (yeh bypass nahi kiya jaa sakta) - iske bajaay ISR ka upyog karein. HTTP par local testing ko third-party ke cookies + local storage pahunch ki permission dene ke liye browser ki requirement hoti hai.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router Draft Mode Server Components / Route Handlers mein next/headers (async) se draftMode() ka upyog karta hai, aur setDraftMode ko (await draftMode()).enable() / .disable() dwara replace kiya jata hai; concept (cookie __prerender_bypass) saman hai. (purv mein Preview Mode kaha jata hai - D2.25 dekhein)
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/draft-mode

Environment Variables

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Environment Variables. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Environment Variables — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Loading, `@next/env`, Referencing other variables, `NEXT_PUBLIC_` inlining, Runtime env vars, Test env. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: built-in .env* → process.env load ho raha hai. do cheezein: vars load karne ke liye .env files ka upyog karein; unhein browser ke liye bundle karne ke liye NEXT_PUBLIC_ ke saath upasarg karein. Never commit .env filein (create-next-app gitignores unhein).

  • Loading: DB_HOST=localhost aadi ke saath .env load automatic roop se, data-fetching vidhiyon (getStaticProps, getServerSideProps) aur API routes mein upyog karne yogya. process.env.DB_HOST
  • @next/env: ko Next.js runtime (ORM config, test ranar) ke bahar env vars load karne ke liye, @next/env installed karein aur e.g mein loadEnvConfig(process.cwd()) ko call karein. envConfig.ts, phir ise orm.config.ts mein import karein. usi function ka upyog jest global setup file mein kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • Referencing any char: $VARIABLE vistar .env files ke andar kaam karta hai: TWITTER_URL=https://x.com/$TWITTER_USER → https://x.com/nextjs. \$ ke roop mein ek shabdik $ se bache.
  • NEXT_PUBLIC_ inlining: non-preephaaid var keval Node mein maujud hain; browser mein ek ko expose karne ke liye, NEXT_PUBLIC_ - Next.js ne build Time ko JS bundle mein maan ko inline kiya, jisse process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_X ko hard-kodit maan ke saath badal diya gaya. build ke baad Dhyaan Do: , app ab in vars mein badlav ka jawab nahi data hai - environment mein propagate ek Docker image build samay values ko jamee rahti hai. runtime manon ke liye, unhein apne khud ke API se parosein ya unhein getServerSideProps mein parhein. Dynamic lookup NOT inlined hain: process.env[varName] aur env.NEXT_PUBLIC_X (const env = process.env) ke madhyam se NOT ko replace kiya jata hai - keval direct process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_X sandarbh hain.
  • Runtime env vars: ne unhein getServerSideProps (ya App Router) ke madhyam se padha taaki ek Docker image ko environment mein badhava diya jaa sake. server startup code instrumentation register ke madhyam se chala sakta hai.
  • Test env: .env.test load jab NODE_ENV=test; .env.development/.env.production testing mein load ho raha hai. antar: .env.local NOT testing mein load kiya gaya hai (param sabhi ke liye pun: prayojy hona chahiye). Commit .env.test, kabhi .env.test.local nahi.
  • Load order (pahli bar jeet mili): 1) process.env (real shell env), 2) .env.$(NODE_ENV).local, 3) .env.local (NODE_ENV=test), 4) .env.$(NODE_ENV), 5) .env. NODE_ENV ne manon ki permission di: production, development, test; yadi unset, next dev → development, any sabhi command → generation. .env.* files ek /src directory ke saath bhi projekt root mein rahti hain. v9.4.0.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
" browser mein meraa rahasy kyon dikhai data hai? - keval NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars ko client JS mein rekhankit kiya gaya hai; kuchh aur server-keval rahta hai. "Why badal gaya env var deploy application badal gaya? - NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars build samay par jame hue hain; punarnirman ya runtime parhne ka upyog karein.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/environment-variables

Forms

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Forms. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Forms — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Server form (verbatim), Good to know, Validation, Error handling / loading state, Redirecting after mutation, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: rupon create/update data; Pages Router mein, mutation API Routes ke madhyam se jana jata hai. pattern: client form → fetch('/api/submit', { method: 'POST', body: formData }) → API route handler mutation (DB call) → JSON pratikriya.

  • Server form (verbatim): pages/api/submit.ts:
ts
import type { NextApiRequest, NextApiResponse } from 'next'
export default async function handler(req: NextApiRequest, res: NextApiResponse) {
  const data = req.body
  const id = await createItem(data)
  res.status(200).json({ id })
}

Client: onSubmit(event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) → event.preventDefault() → new FormData(event.currentTarget) → fetch('/api/submit', { method: 'POST', body: formData }) → await response.json().

  • Good to know: API roots NOT set CORS header - keval default roop se saman moola. API root server par chalte hain, isliye ve surakshit roop se sanvedanshil values (API key) ka upyog client ko expose kiye bina env var ke madhyam se kar sakte hain.
  • Validation: HTML authentication (required, type="email") buniyadi client-side chekon ke liye; server-side schema validation Zod ya Valibot ke saath mutation se pahle: const schema = z.object({... }); const parsed = schema.parse(req.body).
  • Error handling / loading state: React state pattern — isLoading + error (useState); request prarambh mein spasht error; try/catch/finally ke aaspas lane ke aaspas; if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Failed to submit the data. Please try again.'); setError(error.message); {error && <div style={{ color: 'red' }}>{error}</div>} pradan karein; 'Loading...' ko loading aur svaip labels karte samay disabled jama batana.
  • Redirecting after mutation: in API route, res.redirect(307, \/post/${id}\) (307 preserve vidhi).
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router rupon ka upyog Server Actions E ('use server', useActionState, plain <form action={...}> ke saath pragtishil vriddhi) aur <Form> component; Pages Router mein koi Server Actions nahi hai - mutation fetch → API root hain. App Router mein useFormStatus/useFormState bhi hai; Pages Router samtuly manual useState loading/error pattern upar dikhaya gaya hai.

ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Minimal example (verbatim, `pages/blog/[id].tsx`), How it works, step by step, Handling uncaught exceptions, Troubleshooting, Caveats, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ISR aapko puri site ke punarnirman ke bina runtime par create/update static pages ki feature data hai: full punarnirman ke bina static content ko update karein, server load ko kam karein (adhikansh request previous static pages ki serve karte hain), automatic cache-control header, lanbe next build bar ke bina bada content set ko sambhalte hain. (yeh guide ISR Non Cache Components hai; cacheComponents enable ke saath, App Router ISR-with-Cache-Components Guide dekhein.)

  • Minimal udaharan (verbatim, pages/blog/[id].tsx): getStaticPaths sabhi padon ko prapt karta hai, { paths: [{ params: { id } }], fallback: 'blocking' } ko return karta hai; getStaticProps ek post prapt karta hai aur { props: { post }, revalidate: 60 } ko return karta hai.
  • kaise yeh kaam karta hai, kadam se kadam: 1) next build sabhi known padon ko generated karta hai. 2) un pages ke liye request cached aur tatkal hain. 3) 60 ke dashak ke baad, agle request abhi bhi cached (stol) page return karta hai. 4) cache invalid hai; ek naya sanskaran background mein generated hota hai. 5) ek bar generated hone ke baad, agle request update page lauta hai aur ise cache karta hai. 6) /blog/26 jaise agyat path on-demand (fallback: 'blocking' ke saath) generated hota hai; yadi post maujud nahi hai → 404. yeh page star par stale-time-revalidate hai - interviewer is vaakyaansh se pyaar karte hain.
  • On-demand revalidation with res.revalidate() (verbatim): API route pages/api/revalidate.ts check req.query.secret!== process.env.MY_SECRET_TOKEN → 401; phir await res.revalidate('/posts/1') → { revalidated: true }; error → 500 'Error revalidating' aur Next.js previous saphaltapurvak generated page ko dikha raha hai. actual path paas karein, ek phir likhit path nahi (e.g). /posts/1. on-demand revalidation ke saath aapko getStaticProps (default false) mein revalidate samay ki requirement nahi hai.
  • Handling uncaught exception: yadi getStaticProps background punarjanm ke dauraan throw karta hai, to antim saphaltapurvak generated page pradarshit rahta hai aur agle request par Next.js ritreej karta hai. pattern: if (!res.ok) throw new Error(\ Failed padon ko prapt karne ke liye, ${res.status} \) ki sthiti prapt ki taaki ek asaphal prapt cache ko jahar na dein.
  • Troubleshooting: debug cached fetch next.config.js logging: { fetches: { fullUrl: true } } ke saath call karta hai. local roop se next build + next start ke saath production behavior ko verify karein, saath hi .env NEXT_PRIVATE_DEBUG_CACHE=1 log in karne ke liye ISR cache hits/misses.
  • Caveats: ISR keval Node.js runtime (default) ke saath kaam karta hai; NOT ne Static Export (output: 'export') ke saath support kiya; Proxy NOT on-demand ISR requests ke liye chal raha hai, isliye rewrites/Proxy tark lagu nahi hai - satik path ko phir valid karein. cache sthan kantenron mein tikau storage / sajha karne ke liye config yogy (custom cacheHandler, v14.1.0 ke baad se static) hai.
  • Version history: v9.5.0 ISR (Pages); v12.0.0 bot-aware ISR Fallback; v12.2.0 on-demand ISR static; v13.0.0 App Router ne pesh kiya; v14.1.0 custom cacheHandler sthira.
  • Fark banam App Router: page ISR = revalidate: N getStaticProps + res.revalidate() mein API routes mein. App Router ISR = revalidate mein fetch vikalp / Route Segment Config + revalidatePath()/revalidateTag() server Actions/Route handler mein. saman stale-time-revalidate vichar, vibhinn API sataha.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/incremental-static-regeneration

Instrumentation

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Instrumentation. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Instrumentation — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Convention, OpenTelemetry example (verbatim), Importing files with side effects, Runtime-specific code, Gotcha, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: instrumentation = monitoring/logging tool (e.g) ko ekikrit karna. OpenTelemetry) apne app mein performance/behavior ko track karne aur production ke muddon ko dibag karne ke liye.

  • Convention: project root (ya src/ ke andar) mein instrumentation.ts|js banata hai. ek register() function ka export karein; ise Once kaha jata hai jab ek naya Next.js server udaharan shuru hota hai aur server haindal request se pahle pura hona chahiye. app/ pages/
  • OpenTelemetry udaharan (verbatim):
ts
import { registerOTel } from '@vercel/otel'
export function register() {
  registerOTel('next-app')
}
  • side iphekt ke saath Importing files: register() ke andar import (file ke top par nahi) to sabhi side iphekt colocated hain: export async function register() { await import('package-with-side-effect') }.
  • Runtime-vishisht code: register ko sabhi environments mein bulaya jata hai - antath process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME: 'nodejs' → await import('./instrumentation-node') ka upyog karke runtime dwara import kiya jata hai; 'edge' → await import('./instrumentation-edge').
  • Dhyaan Do: yadi pageExtensions config ek pratyay jodti hai, to instrumentation file naam ko iska match karna chahiye.
  • Fark banam App Router: saman convention/file — routers ke beech sajha.

Internationalization (i18n)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Internationalization (i18n). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Internationalization (i18n) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Config (verbatim), Two locale strategies, Automatic Locale Detection, Prefixing the default locale (workaround), Accessing locale info, Transitioning locales. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: v10.0.0 (Pages Router) ke baad se built-in i18n routing keval i18n config App Router mein maujud nahi hai). locales, defaultLocale, optional domain vishisht local logon ko pradan karein; Next.js routing sambhalta hai. yeh i18n libraries (riyekt-intl, riyektiv-i18next, lingui, rosetta, agli-intl, agli-translate, tolgee, paraglide, agli-intlayer, gt-react) ka poorak hai.

  • Config (verbatim): next.config.js → i18n: { locales: ['en-US', 'fr', 'nl-NL'], defaultLocale: 'en-US', domains: [{ domain: 'example.com', defaultLocale: 'en-US' }, { domain: 'example.nl', defaultLocale: 'nl-NL' }, { domain: 'example.fr', defaultLocale: 'fr', http: true }] }. Locales UTS Locale Identifiers hain (language-region-script, jaise en-US, nl-NL, nl). Fallback: user locale nl-BE listed nahi hai → agar available ho to nl par redirect, warna default locale par. Bare country locales ko fallbacks ke roop me shamil karo.
  • Do locale strategies: Sub-path Routing — path me locale: pages/blog.js → /blog, /fr/blog, /nl-nl/blog; default locale ka KOI prefix nahi hota. Domain Routing — har locale ke liye alag domain: example.com/blog, example.fr/blog, example.nl/blog, example.nl/nl-BE/blog (ek domain extra locales jaise ['nl-BE'] list kar sakta hai jo us par redirect hote hain). Domain value me subdomain shamil hona chahiye (jaise fr.example.com); http: true locale domains ko locally http par test karne deta hai.
  • Automatic Locale Detection: / visit karne par, Next.js Accept-Language header + current domain padhta hai aur redirect karta hai: sub-path → locale-prefixed path (/fr); domain → wo domain jiska default locale match karta hai (jaise example.com par Accept-Language: fr → example.fr). localeDetection: false se disable karo.
  • Default locale ko prefix karna (workaround): ek fake 'default' locale jodo (locales: ['default', 'en', 'de', 'fr'], defaultLocale: 'default', localeDetection: false) + Proxy jo /_next, /api/, public files ko skip karta hai, aur req.nextUrl.locale === 'default' ko NEXT_LOCALE cookie ya 'en' use karke /${locale}${pathname} par redirect karta hai.
  • Locale information access karna: useRouter() locale (active), locales (all), defaultLocale deta hai. getStaticProps/getServerSideProps context me: locale, locales, defaultLocale; getStaticPaths context me bhi locales + defaultLocale hai.
  • Locales ke beech transition: <Link href="/another" locale="fr"> ya router.push('/another', '/another', { locale: 'fr' }); sirf locale badalne ke liye pathname/query preserve karte hue: router.push({ pathname, query }, asPath, { locale: nextLocale }). Jab href me pehle se locale ho to auto-prefixing se opt out karne ke liye: <Link href="/fr/another" locale={false}>.
  • NEXT_LOCALE cookie: NEXT_LOCALE=<locale> set karna baad ki visits par Accept-Language par priority leta hai (language switcher pattern).
  • SEO: Next.js <html> me lang auto-add karta hai; hreflang meta tags tumhe khud next/head ke through jodne honge.
  • Static Generation ke saath interaction: output: 'export' ke saath integrate NAHI hota (koi routing layer nahi). getStaticProps wale dynamic routes ke liye, getStaticPaths me har path ke liye ek locale field return karo (jaise { params: { slug: 'post-1' }, locale: 'fr' }); locale ke bina, sirf default locale generate hota hai. Auto-statically-optimized aur non-dynamic getStaticProps pages ke liye, HAR locale ke liye ek version generate hota hai — build-time cost guna hoti hai: 50 locales × 10 pages = 500 getStaticProps calls. fallback mode se mitigate karo (sirf popular paths/locales prerender karo). Kisi locale se opt out karne ke liye getStaticProps se notFound: true return karo.
  • Limits: max 100 locales, max 100 locale domain items (build-time guard; custom Proxy routing se workaround).
  • App Router se fark: App Router me KOI i18n next.config option nahi hai — i18n ek [locale] dynamic segment + Proxy + next-intl jaisi libraries se hota hai. Pages Router ka built-in i18n config sirf Pages Router feature hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/internationalization

Lazy Loading

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Lazy Loading. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Lazy Loading — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `next/dynamic`, Rules/gotchas, Named exports, No SSR, External libraries, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: lazy loading ek route pradan karne ke liye required JS ko kam karta hai, initial load performance mein sudhar karta hai.

  • next/dynamic: React.lazy() + Suspense ka ek samagr; app/ aur pages/ (enables vriddhishil migration) mein saman behavior karta hai. dynamic roop se imported component ko page ke initial JS bundle se bahar rakha gaya hai; Suspense fallback pahle render karta hai, phir hal hone par component:
jsx
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'
const DynamicHeader = dynamic(() => import('../components/header'), {
  loading: () => <p>Loading...</p>,
})
export default function Home() { return <DynamicHeader /> }
  • Rules/gotchas: import() path ko spasht roop se likha jana chahiye - koi template string nahi, koi char nahi. import() ko dynamic() call ke andar hona chahiye taaki Next.js webpack bundles/module ID se mel khaa sakein aur render karne se pahle preload kar sakte hain. dynamic() ka upyog React ke andar nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - yeh module ke top level (jaise React.lazy) par hona chahiye.
  • Named export: dynamic(() => import('../components/hello').then((mod) => mod.Hello)).
  • No SSR: dynamic(() => import('../components/header'), { ssr: false }) keval client par load karta hai - jab ek dependency/component browser APIs jaise window par nirbhar karta hai to iska upyog karta hai. (not: ssr: false NOT ko Server Components mein App Router mein ek mahatvapurn antar hai; Pages Router mein yeh kahin bhi kaam karta hai.)
  • External libraries: ek event handler, e.g ke andar mang par loda. onChange ke andar const Fuse = (await import('fuse.js')).default - library keval user ke prakaron ke baad download kiya jata hai.
  • Fark banam App Router: next/dynamic API sajha kiya gaya hai, lekin App Router ssr: false mein Server Components mein istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta hai (Client Component mein hona chahiye); Pages Router ka koi pratibandh nahi hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/lazy-loading
