MDX

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai MDX. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: MDX — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Install, Configure `next.config.mjs` (verbatim), `mdx-components.tsx`, Rendering — file-based routing, Custom styles/components, Frontmatter. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: markdown = laaitvet markup (I **love** using [Next.js](https://nextjs.org/) → <p>I <strong>love</strong> using <a href="https://nextjs.org/">Next.js</a></p>). MDX = markdown suparaset aapko seedhe markdown files mein JSX likhne ki permission data hai - content mein React components ko embed karein. Next.js local MDX ( ke madhyam se) ka support karta hai aur durasth MDX ne server par dynamic roop se access kiya. @next/mdx

  • Install: npm install @next/mdx @mdx-js/loader @mdx-js/react @types/mdx.
  • Configure next.config.mjs (verbatim):
js
import createMDX from '@next/mdx'
const nextConfig = {
  pageExtensions: ['js', 'jsx', 'md', 'mdx', 'ts', 'tsx'],
}
const withMDX = createMDX({ /* markdown plugins here */ })
export default withMDX(nextConfig)

default roop se keval .mdx ko compiled kiya gaya hai; .md ko sambhalne ke liye, extension: /\.(md|mdx)$/ ko createMDX mein paas karein.

  • mdx-components.tsx: root-level file (pages/app ke roop mein ya src/ ke andar) useMDXComponents() ka export ek MDXComponents map wapas kar raha hai. Required for App Router; Pages Router ke liye , global component abhi bhi is file se aate hain.
  • Rendering — file aadharit routing: ne /pages ko /pages mein daal diya; yeh React components ko import kar sakta hai aur JSX ka upyog kar sakta hai; /mdx-page ka daura ise render karta hai. Rendering — import: import Welcome from '@/markdown/welcome.mdx' in pages/mdx-page.tsx and render <Welcome />. pages/mdx-page.mdx
  • Custom styles/components: markdown nakshe HTML (## heading → <h2>). Global: mdx-components.tsx, e.g mein define karta hai. h1: ({ children }) => <h1 style={{ color: 'red', fontSize: '48px' }}>{children}</h1> aur img: (props) => <Image sizes="100vw" style={{ width: '100%', height: 'auto' }} {...props} />. Local: paas components prop — <Welcome components={overrideComponents} /> merges with/overrides Globals. Shared layout: ne .mdx file ke andar export default function MDXPage({ children }) { return <MdxLayout>{children}</MdxLayout> } ke madhyam se ek layout component mein MDX content ko lapeta; Tailwind ke saath, layout mein @tailwindcss/typography prose kakshaon ka upyog kiya.
  • Frontmatter: @next/mdx NOT default roop se phrantmetar ka support karta hai (tippan-phrantmetar, comment-mdx-phrantar, ya gre-maatar ka upyog karein). iske bajaay yeh JS export ka support karta hai: MDX file ke andar export const metadata = { author: 'John Doe' }, import BlogPost, { metadata } from '@/content/blog-post.mdx' ke roop mein import karne yogya. fs/globby (keval server-side) ka upyog karke padon ki ek directory ko bahal karne aur ek indeks page banane ke liye kiya jata hai.
  • remark/rehype plagins: Turbopack mein paas; remark/rehype ecosystem tantr ESM hai, isliye next.config.mjs/.ts ka upyog karein. With Turbopack: upgrade @next/mdx aur paas plugin naam strings ('remark-gfm', ['remark-toc', { heading: 'The Table' }], 'rehype-slug', ['rehype-katex', { strict: true, throwOnError: true }]) ke roop mein; gair-serialable vikalp (karya) ke saath plagins ka upyog Turbopack ke saath nahi kiya jaa sakta kyonki JS karyon ko Rust ko passed nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. createMDX({ options: { remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm], rehypePlugins: [] } })
  • Deep gotaa - kaise markdown HTML ho jata hai: unified().use(remarkParse) (markdown → AST) → .use(remarkRehype)) (→ HTML AST) → .use(rehypeSanitize) → .use(rehypeStringify)) (→ serialized HTML). @next/mdx aapke liye yeh karta hai; plagins sintaiks highlighting (rehype-pretty-code), heding link, TOC (remark-toc) ke liye maujud hain.
  • Rust MDX compiler (experimental, prod ke liye nahi): experimental: { mdxRs: true } config mein withMDX ko passed kiya gaya; vikalp: jsxRuntime, jsxImportSource, providerImportSource, mdxType: 'gfm' | 'commonmark'.
  • Fark banam App Router: setup saman hai (@next/mdx + pageExtensions + mdx-components.tsx); antar keval vahi hai jahan MDX page rahte hain (pages/*.mdx banam app/**/*.mdx) aur App Router MDX default roop se Server Components mein chalata hai.

Hissa 331 / 471 · Pages Router · Guides

Migrating: App Router (Pages → App)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Migrating: App Router (Pages → App). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Migrating: App Router (Pages → App) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Upgrading new features (work in both routers), `<Image>`, `<Link>`, `<Script>`, Font optimization, Migration steps. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: App Router (introduced v13) ko full migration path ke liye 13.4+ ki requirement hoti hai; us samay minimum Node 18.17) pages directory ke saath coexists, incremental page-by-page migration ko enable karta hai. Next.js 13 mein upgrade karne ke liye NOT ko App Router — pages ka upyog karne ki requirement hoti hai, aur nai suvidhaein jo donon mein kaam karti hain (naya <Image>, <Link>, <Script>, next/font) ko pahli bar apnaya jaa sakta hai.

  • nai features ko upgrade karna (donon routers mein kaam karna):
  • <Image>: v12 ke next/future/image sudhar v13 mein default next/image ban gaya. Codemods: next-image-to-legacy-image (surakshit roop se next/image → next/legacy/image, ek hi behavior ka naam badalta hai) aur next-image-experimental (Dangerously inline styles ko jodta hai, apryukt props ko hata data hai - pahla legacy codemod chalate hain).
  • <Link>: ko ab ek nested <a> children ki requirement nahi hai; <Link> hamesha <a> ko render karta hai aur props ko aage badhata hai. V12: <Link href="/about"><a>About</a></Link>; v13: <Link href="/about">About</Link>. Codemod: new-link.
  • <Script>: ne _document.js se root layout mein beforeInteractive script ko moved kiya; experimental worker ranniti app mein kaam nahi karti hai (iske bajaay lazyOnload ka upyog karein); onLoad/onReady/onError Server Components mein kaam nahi karte hain - ek Client Component par jaein.
  • Font optimization: next/font module (v13) donon routers mein kaam karta hai; purane font-CSS abhi bhi pages mein kaam karta hai lekin app mein NOT - next/font ka upyog karein.
  • Migration step:
  • Step 1 - banane app/: update latest Next.js karne ke liye, project root (ya src/) par app/ banane ke liye.
  • Step 2 - root layout: app/layout.tsx MUST maujud hain, MUST <html> aur <body> ko define karta hai (Next.js unhein auto-create nahi karta hai) aur pages/_app.tsx + pages/_document.tsx ko replace karta hai. <head> ko metadata export (export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'Home', description: 'Welcome to Next.js' }) ke madhyam se prabndhit kiya jata hai. _app / _document se global styles/providers ko root layout mein copy karein - lekin KEEP _app / _document ko migrate karte samay to pages/* routes ko tor nahi sakte; unhein puri tarah se migrate hone par hi hata dein. React sandarbh pradataon ko ek Client Component mein moved karna hoga. Per-page layout: Page.getLayout pattern (Page.getLayout = (page) => <DashboardLayout>{page}</DashboardLayout>) ko mool nested layout.js files dwara replace kiya jata hai; layout content ko 'use client' component mein moved karein yadi ise paarasparik kriya ki requirement ho, to ise app/dashboard/layout.js (A Server Component) mein import karein, aur client JS ko kaatne ke liye server layout mein non-interactive bhagon ko moved karein.
  • Step 3 - next/head → Metadata API: <Head><title>My page title</title></Head> (next/head se) export const metadata = { title: 'My Page Title' } (dynamic zaroorat generateMetadata) ban jata hai.
  • Step 4 — page migrate: route manchitran — pages/index.js → app/page.js (/), pages/about.js → app/about/page.js, pages/blog/[slug].js → app/blog/[slug]/page.js. app mein Pages default roop se Server Components hain; pages mein page Client Components. hain do-step path (adhikansh comparative behavior): (1) default-export page component ko 'use client' Client Component file (e.g) mein le jate hain. app/home-page.tsx) - yeh abhi bhi state/effects ho jata hai aur ise pahle load par static HTML mein render kiya jata hai; (2) app/page.tsx (Server Component) banate hain jo naye APIs ke saath data prapt karte hain aur <HomePage recentPosts={recentPosts} /> render karte hain. yadi purane page mein useRouter ka upyog kiya jata hai, to naye routing hook ko update karein.
  • Step 5 - routing hook: useRouter, usePathname, useSearchParams ka upyog keval next/navigation (Client Components) se karta hai. next/router ke useRouter se antar: koi pathname string (usePathname ka upyog karein), koi query objekt (useSearchParams + useParams ko alag se upyog karein), isFallback hata diya gaya (fallback replace), locale / locales / defaultLocale / domainLocales hata diya gaya (koi built-in i18n app mein), basePath hata diya gaya, asPath hata diya gaya (koi as concept), isReady hata diya gaya (unnecessary - useSearchParams component runtime par client par prerendering aur render nahi), route hata diya gaya). router.push()/replace() ab ek Promise wapas nahi lautte - ve ek React transition paida karte hain aur turant wapas lautte hain; UI ko pending karne ke liye, useTransition ke startTransition ke andar call karein aur isPending ko parhein. router ke beech Sharing component: next/compat/router se useRouter ka upyog karta hai (pages ka hook, sajha components ke liye); keval ek bar next/navigation par svich karein. usePathname useSelectedLayoutSegments
  • Step 6 - data lane (mool manchitran): getServerSideProps/getStaticProps/getInitialProps) ko fetch() + async Server Components dwara replace kiya jata hai. maiping: fetch(url, { cache: 'force-cache' }) ≈ getStaticProps; fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' }) ≈ getServerSideProps (default laao behavior); fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 10 } }) ≈ getStaticProps ke saath revalidate: 10. SSR udaharan: pages getServerSideProps projects lane aur ek Async Server Component ke andar props → app async function getProjects() { const res = await fetch('https://...', { cache: 'no-store' });... } ke roop mein gujarane. Request objekt: pages getServerSideProps({ req, query }) req.cookies['theme'] / header ke saath → application headers()/cookies() se next/headers (Web APIs, read-only, Server Components mein seedhe ya karyon ko prapt karne mein enable; Next.js 16 mein ve async: await headers(), await cookies()) hain. SSG: pages getStaticProps → application fetch() default roop se force-cache ko define karta hai. Dynamic path: getStaticPaths lautte { paths: [{ params: { id: '1' } }] } → generateStaticParams() lautte [{ id: '1' }, { id: '2' }] (phlait segment objekts, no nested params; layout mein bhi prayog karne yogy). Replacing fallback: fallback: true | false | 'blocking' → Route Segment Config dynamicParams: true (default - segment generateStaticParams mein nahi) ya false (→ 404) par generated hote hain. 'blocking' mein koi samtuly nahi hai - banam true streaming ke saath atuly hai. ISR: pages revalidate: 60 mein getStaticProps → application fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 60 } }). API root: pages/api/* aprivartit kaam karta rahta hai, lekin iske barabar ka application Route Handlers E (app/api/route.ts) hai. yadi aap client se external API ko call karne ke liye API routes ka upyog karte hain, to Server Components ab ise surakshit roop se bajaay kar sakta hai. export async function GET(request: Request) {} Request/Response
  • Step 7 - styling: pages mein , global styles pages/_app.js tak simit hain; app mein pratibandh uthaya jata hai - kisi bhi layout/page/component. Tailwind mein global import kiya jaa sakta hai: './app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx,mdx}' ko tailwind.config.js content mein jorein, aur app/layout.js mein global import karein.
  • donon router ek saath Using: router = hard nevigeshan ke beech navigate; next/link prefetching NOT router bhar mein kaam karta hai. (Vercel) mein hard navigation ko customize karne ke liye ek guide hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh page hi Pages↔App cheat sheet hai — isme ek mapping table hona chahiye: _app+_document → root layout.js; next/head → metadata; getStaticProps → fetch force-cache; getServerSideProps → fetch no-store; getStaticPaths → generateStaticParams; fallback → dynamicParams; pages/api → Route Handlers; useRouter (next/router) → useRouter+usePathname+useSearchParams (next/navigation); getLayout → nested layouts; _error → error.js; 404 → not-found.js.

Migrating: from Create React App

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Migrating: from Create React App. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Migrating: from Create React App — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Additional considerations, Bundler, Gotcha, Next steps after migration. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: kyon CRA (shuddh client side rendering / SPA) se svich karein: dhimi initial load (browser data lane se pahle pure bundle ke liye wait karta hai), koi automatic code vibhajan (manual spliting jokhim network waterfall), data-fetching waterfall (kachcha keval parent ke bhar ke baad hi prapt karta hai), koi janboojhkar loading states nahi. Next.js kahte hain: server data lane (kushal jharne), Suspense, per-page/component banam SSR, Proxy (auth redirects, A/B testing, i18n), built-in Image/font/script optimization ke madhyam se streaming. ranniti: ek kaam kar rahe Next.js application ko tezi se ek shuddh client-side SPA pahle (apne maujuda router rakhein) ke roop mein ilaj karke prapt karein, phir Next.js features ko badha kar apnaein.

  • Steps (not: yeh guide SPA mode mein App Router par utarta hai): 1. npm install next@latest 2. next.config.ts: output: 'export' (SPA static export) + distDir: 'build'. warning: output: 'export' ka matalab NO server features (SSR/APIs) hai; baad mein unka upyog karne ke liye line ko hata dein. 3. root layout: app/layout.tsx (App Router) CRA ke public/index.html ke barabar hai; pratilipi index.html content, <div id="root">{children}</div> ke saath <div id="root"> ki jagah hai. Next.js ne CRA ke public/manifest.json, icon, testing config ko andekha kiya - iske bajaay Metadata API + testing setup ka upyog karein. 4. metadata: Next.js auto-shamil charset + viewport; top level app/ mein favicon/icon/robots.txt files ko moved karein (<head> ke liye auto-added) tab title/description ko export kiye gaye metadata objekt mein le jaein. 5. shailiyan: CSS module box se bahar kaam karte hain; app/layout.tsx (import '../index.css') mein global CSS import karte hain. 6. access point page: CRA ka src/index.tsx → App Router route; ALL routes ko SPA ke roop mein intercepting karne ke liye, generateStaticParams() { return [{ slug: [''] }] } ke saath optional catch-all app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx ka upyog karein ( khali slag ke liye singal route). 7. client-keval access point: app/[[...slug]]/client.tsx 'use client' + const App = dynamic(() => import('../../App'), { ssr: false }) ke saath; page.tsx <ClientOnly /> pradan karta hai. Client Components abhi bhi default roop se server par prerender kar rahe hain - ssr: false ise vastav mein client-keval banata hai. 8. static image import: CRA import image from './img.png' ek URL string return karta hai; Next.js ek object return karta hai - ise <Image> ke saath prayog karein ya image.src ko <img> (<img src={logo.src} />) paas karein. nirpeksh /logo.png import ko relative (../public/logo.png) mein kanavart karein; ya public URL ko seedhe (/logo.png) ka sandarbh dein. TS gotcha: next-env.d.ts ko tsconfig.json include ya .src access errors mein shamil karein. <Image> auto set width/height ( layout shift ko rokta hai) lekin keval ek dimension ke saath chitrit images ko vikrit kar sakta hai jo auto par set nahi hai - shuru mein <img> rakhein, baad mein migrate karein. 9. Env vars: REACT_APP_* → NEXT_PUBLIC_* ka naam badlein. 10. script: "dev": "next dev", "build": "next build", "start": "npx serve@latest./build"; .next + next-env.d.ts ko .gitignore mein jorein. 11. clean ap: public/index.html, src/index.tsx, src/react-app-env.d.ts, reportWebVitals setup ko hata dein, react-scripts ko aninstol karein.
  • Additional vicharon: custom homepage field → next.config mein basePath: '/my-subpath'. custom serve worker → navigator.serviceWorker.register(new URL('../serviceWorker.js', import.meta.url),...). CRA proxy field package.json → rewrites() mein next.config (source: '/api/:path*', destination: 'https://your-backend.com/:path*'). custom webpack/Babel → next.config mein webpack: (config, { isServer }) => {... return config } (next dev --webpack ki requirement). TypeScript: tsconfig.json include: ["next-env.d.ts", "app/**/*", "src/**/*"].
  • Bundler: CRA webpack ka upyog karta hai; Next.js default roop se Turbopack (next dev), next dev --webpack ke liye webpack ke liye.
  • Dhyaan Do: static export (output: 'export') vartaman mein useParams hook ya any server features ka support nahi karta hai - ise sabhi Next.js features ka upyog karne ke liye hata dein.
  • previous steps ke baad migration: migrate React router → App Router (auto code vibhajan, streaming, RSC)), images/fonts/scripts ka optimization, ESLint ko recommended niymon ko enable banata hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/migrating/from-create-react-app

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Migrating: from Vite. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Migrating: from Vite — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Steps (differences from CRA highlighted), Next steps. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: saim "why svich" CRA (SPA dhimi initial load, koi auto code vibhajan, data jharne, koi janboojhkar loading states nahi; Next.js server lane, streaming/Suspense, prati page SSG/SSR vikalp, Proxy, built-in optimization) jodta hai. ek hi ranniti: client-side SPA ke roop mein pahli bar bhumi (purv mein maujuda router rakhein), Next.js ko bare paimane par features ko apnaate hain. (CRA guide ki tarah, yeh SPA mode mein App Router par utarta hai.

  • Steps (CRA se bhinntaa par prakash dala gaya): 1. npm install next@latest 2. next.config.mjs: output: 'export', distDir: './dist' (vaait ka default output dir, rakha gaya). .js ya .mjs donon theek hain. 3. TypeScript config (vaait-vishisht): ne tsconfig.node.json ke liye project sandarbh ko hata diya; ./dist/types/**/*.ts + ./next-env.d.ts ko include mein jorein, ./node_modules ko exclude mein jorein; "plugins": [{ "name": "next" }] jorein; esModuleInterop: true set karein, jsx: react-jsx, allowJs: true, forceConsistentCasingInFileNames: true, incremental: true. udaharan tsconfig (target ES2020, module ESext, moduleResolution bundler, allowImportingTsExtensions, resolveJsonModule, isolatedModules, noEmit, sakht, noUnusedLocals/Parameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch). 4. root layout: Vite ke index.html se src/app/layout.tsx (<div id="root">{children}</div> ke saath body.div#root + body.script ko badalna); Next.js auto-shamil charset + viewport; metadata files ko top level app/ mein le jaein; title/description ko export metadata objekt mein le jaein. 5. access point page: vit ka main.tsx → app/[[...slug]]/page.tsx (optional catch-ol, generateStaticParams() { return [{ slug: [''] }] }); yeh global CSS (import '../../index.css') import karta hai aur yeh ek previous Server Component hai. client-keval app: 'use client' + dynamic(() => import('../../App'), { ssr: false }) ke saath app/[[...slug]]/client.tsx; page <ClientOnly /> render karta hai. 6. static image import: Vite ek URL string ('/assets/img.2d8efhg.png'); Next.js ek object lauta data hai - <img> ke saath <Image> ya logo.src ka upyog karta hai; /logo.png ko relative ../public/logo.png mein full import parivartit karta hai; TS .src prakar ki errors ko guide ke ant tak surakshit roop se andekha kiya jaa sakta hai. 7. Env vars: VITE_* → NEXT_PUBLIC_*. Turbopack compat: Vite ka import.meta.env.MODE, DEV, PROD, BASE_URL, SSR bina kisi badlav ke kaam karte hain (BASE_URL basePath + trailing slash ko darshata hai). import.meta.glob kisi bhi parivartan ke saath Turbopack mein kaam karta hai. No ?raw / ?url queries ke liye built-in handling: Vite ke { as: 'raw' } (Vite 5) → { query: '?raw' } + next.config mein ek match turbopack.rules entry: '*': { condition: { query: '?raw' }, type: 'text' }. Custom Vite bes URL → basePath: '/some-base-path'. 8. script: "dev": "next dev", "build": "next build", "start": "next start"; .gitignore .next, next-env.d.ts, dist jodta hai. 9. clean ap: main.tsx, index.html, vite-env.d.ts, tsconfig.node.json, vite.config.ts ko hata dein; Vite deps ki installation radd karein.
  • agla step: ne React router → App Router ko migrate kiya, images/fonts/scripts ko optimize kiya, ESLint ko update kiya. (Reference udaharan PR: inngest/vite-to-nextjs.)

Multi-Zones

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Multi-Zones. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Multi-Zones — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Navigation behavior, Defining a zone, Routing requests to the right zone, Linking between zones, Sharing code, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: bahu-jon = sukshm-frontends drishtikon: ek domain par ek bare app ko chhote Next.js app mein vibhajit karein, pratyek path ke ek set (e.g) ki serve karte hain. /blog/*, /dashboard/*, /* baki ke liye). labh: chhote apps → tezi se build, prati jon kam mrit code; jon alag ho jate hain aur yahan tak ki vibhinn dhanche ka bhi upyog kar sakte hain; pratyek jon develops/deploys svatantr roop se.

  • Navigation behavior: saman field navigation = soft nevigeshan (koi page phir load nahi, e.g). / → /products). kros-zon navigation = hard nevigeshan (vartaman page sansadhanon ko utaartaa hai, naye page ko load karta hai). aksar ek saath aane wale pannon ko usi field mein rahna chahiye.
  • ek field ko define karna: ek common Next.js app + assetPrefix asset sangharsh se bachne ke liye: nextConfig = { assetPrefix: '/blog-static' } — JS/CSS /assetPrefix/_next/... ke tahat serve ki. default app (catch-all path) ko assetPrefix ki requirement nahi hai. Pre-Next.js-15 aapko beforeFiles phir likhne ki bhi requirement hai (source: '/blog-static/_next/:path+' → destination: '/_next/:path+'); Next.js-15 mein ab required nahi hai.
  • sahi field ke liye Routing request: kisi bhi HTTP proxy ka upyog karta hai, ya ek Next.js app ko rewrites(): e.g ke madhyam se router ke roop mein upyog karta hai. source: '/blog' → destination: ${process.env.BLOG_DOMAIN}/blog; source: '/blog/:path+' → saman pattern; source: '/blog-static/:path+' → static asset. destination ko jon ke production domain (ya localhost in dev) ka ek full URL (yojna + domain) hona chahiye. Paths prati jon - do jon /blog = routing sangharsh ki serve karte hain, unique hona chahiye. Rewrites ki sifarish ki jati hai (sabse kam vilambata); Proxy ka upyog tab kiya jaa sakta hai jab routing ko dynamic nirnay (e.g) ki requirement hoti hai. if (pathname === '/your-path' && myFeatureFlag.isEnabled()) return NextResponse.rewrite(...)
  • jonon ke beech Linking: ek plain <a> tag ka upyog karta hai, NOT <Link> — <Link> + sopht-neveeget ko prefetch karne ki koshish karta hai, jo pure jonon mein kaam nahi karta hai.
  • Sharing code: jon kisi bhi repo mein rah sakte hain; ek monorepo sheyring ko aasan banata hai, anyatha public/private npm paikeja. feature jhande alag-alag samay par jari kiye gaye kshetron mein jahar mein enable/disable features ki madad karte hain.
  • Fark banam App Router: bahukshetr router-agnostic (config-level); donon ke liye ek hi setup hai.

OpenTelemetry

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai OpenTelemetry. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: OpenTelemetry — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Quick start with `@vercel/otel`, Manual configuration, Testing, Deployment, Custom spans. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: observability (loging, metriks, nishan) understanding/optimizing app behavior ke liye mahatvapurn hai. OpenTelemetry ki recommended hai, platform-egnosetik instrumentation — bina kisi code ko badalane ke observability pradataon ko svich karein. shartein: avdhi, trace, niryaataka. Next.js khud ko box se bahar likhta hai: otal ko automatic roop se apne code (e.g) ko lapetne mein enable banata hai. getStaticProps) helper visheshataon ke saath phaile hue hain.

  • Quick start with @vercel/otel: npm install @vercel/otel @opentelemetry/sdk-logs @opentelemetry/api-logs @opentelemetry/instrumentation, phir root instrumentation.ts:
ts
import { registerOTel } from '@vercel/otel'
export function register() {
  registerOTel({ serviceName: 'next-app' })
}
  • Manual config: @opentelemetry/sdk-node @opentelemetry/resources @opentelemetry/semantic-conventions @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node @opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-http installed karta hai; ek alag instrumentation.node.ts mein NodeSDK ko shuru karta hai ( resourceFromAttributes({ [ATTR_SERVICE_NAME]: 'next-app' }), spanProcessor: new SimpleSpanProcessor(new OTLPTraceExporter()), sdk.start() ke saath), keval instrumentation.ts se hi import kiya jata hai jab process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'nodejs' — NodeSDK NOT ko dhaar runtime ke saath sangat hai. manual setup = @vercel/otel ke saman lekin adhik eksteinsibal; yadi kinaare ka support required hai, to @vercel/otel ka upyog karein.
  • Testing: aapko ek otel kalektar + sangat backend ki requirement hai; Vercel ke opanatelemetree-kalektar-dev-setup ko local testing ke liye recommended kiya jata hai. karya setup ek root server spain labels GET /requested/pathname ko nested avdhi ke saath dikhata hai. Next.js default roop se pradarshit hone ki tulna mein adhik spain utsarjit karta hai - unhein dekhne ke liye NEXT_OTEL_VERBOSE=1 set karein.
  • Deployment: @vercel/otel Vercel par kaam karta hai (ek observability provider ko jorne ke liye Vercel tresing docs ka palan karein) aur khud-hosted (Spin up your own OTel Collector per OTel Collector Getting Started guide). A Collector optional hai - custom exporter setup ke saath kaam karte hain.
  • Custom spans: ka upyog @opentelemetry/api: trace.getTracer('nextjs-example').startActiveSpan('fetchGithubStars', async (span) => { try { return await getValue() } finally { span.end() } }). register ek naye environment mein apne code se pahle chalata hai; ek request ko sambhalne ke dauraan banaya gaya spain us request ke nishan mein shamil ho jata hai. Dhyaan Do: spans banaya gaya hai jabki instrumentation file load ya register ke andar ek request trace shamil nahi hai (anusuchit karne se pahle shuru kiya gaya spain rikord nahi kiya gaya hai; SDK shuru hone ke baad register ke andar spain alag-alag root trace hote hain) - request-handling code (page rendering, Route Handler, API root) mein spain banata hai.
  • Default Next.js (next.* custom visheshataon ke saath) mein phaile hue hain: next.span_name, next.span_type, next.route (root pattern e.g). /[param]/user, next.rsc (true/false — RSC/prefetch request), next.page (App-router vishesh file, keval next.route ke saath unique). avdhi list: [http.method] [next.route] (BaseServer.handleRequest, root spain prati request, http.method/status_code/route/target); render route (app) [next.route] (AppRender.getBodyResult); fetch [http.method] [http.url] (AppRender.fetch - NEXT_OTEL_FETCH_DISABLED=1 ke saath disabled); executing api route (app) [next.route] (AppRouteRouteHandlers.runHandler); getServerSideProps [next.route] (Render.getServerSideProps); getStaticProps [next.route] (Render.getStaticProps); render route (pages) [next.route] (Render.renderDocument); generateMetadata [next.page] (ResolveMetadata.generateMetadata); resolve page components (NextNodeServer.findPageComponents); resolve segment modules (NextNodeServer.getLayoutOrPageModule); start response (NextNodeServer.startResponse)
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Next.js = instrumentation.ts + register() + @vercel/otel; Next.js auto-spain getStaticProps/getServerSideProps/fetches; @opentelemetry/api ke madhyam se custom spaina.

Package Bundling

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Package Bundling. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Package Bundling — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Tools, Optimizing large bundles, Packages with many exports, Heavy client workloads, External packages not pre-bundled, Opting packages out. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: bundling customize client/server output files mein app code + dependency ko jodti hai. chhote bundle tezi se load hote hain, JS execution samay mein katauti karte hain, Core Web Vitals mein sudhar karte hain, kam server thand shuru hota hai. Next.js code vibhajan, vriksh-sheking aadi ke madhyam se auto-optimizes, lekin kabhi-kabhi manual optimization ki requirement hoti hai.

  • Tools: (1) Next.js Bundle Analyzer (v16.1+, Turbopack-integrated module graph, precise import tracing): npx next analyze → browser me interactive UI; route, environment (client/server), type (JS/CSS/JSON) se filter karo, file se search karo; treemap jahan rectangle area = module size; size + full import chain + kahan use hota hai dekhne ke liye module par click karo. npx next analyze --output sharing/diffing ke liye static output .next/diagnostics/analyze me likhta hai (cp -r .next/diagnostics/analyze ./analyze-before-refactor). (2) Analysis data export karna (v16.4+): npx next analyze --output --snapshot before phir npx next analyze export --snapshot before > bundle-graph.jsonl — rebuild kiye bina scripts/AI tools ke liye saved snapshot ko JSON Lines ke roop me stream karta hai. (3) next-bundle-optimizer skill (v16.4+): npx skills add vercel/next.js --skill next-bundle-optimizer ek AI agent ko bundle analyzer data deta hai audit karne (report-only mode) ya issues fix karne ke liye, optionally ek route tak scoped. (4) Webpack ke liye @next/bundle-analyzer: npm install @next/bundle-analyzer, config wrap karo: const withBundleAnalyzer = require('@next/bundle-analyzer')({ enabled: process.env.ANALYZE === 'true' }), ANALYZE=true npm run build chalao — report teen browser tabs kholti hai.
  • Bade bundles optimize karna:
  • Bahut saare exports wale packages (icon/utility libs): next.config me experimental.optimizePackageImports: ['icon-library'] — sirf asal me use hue modules load hote hain, convenient named-import syntax bana rehta hai. Kuch libraries ko Next.js pehle se auto-optimize karta hai.
  • Heavy client workloads: Client Components me expensive rendering (syntax highlighting, charts, markdown parsing) poori library client ko bhejta hai jabki output static HTML hota hai. Fix: kaam ko Server Component me move karo — jaise ek 'use client' page me prism-react-renderer ko shiki ke codeToHtml() wale async Server Component se badlo; client ko sirf dangerouslySetInnerHTML ke through rendered markup milta hai.
  • Pre-bundled na hue external packages: monorepo/node_modules packages default roop se bundle nahi hote; specific walon ke liye transpilePackages: ['package-name'] use karo, ya saare packages automatically bundle karne ke liye bundlePagesRouterDependencies: true (default false) (Pages Router option).
  • Packages ko opt out karna: serverExternalPackages: ['package-name'] specific packages ko automatic bundling se bahar rakhta hai (bundlePagesRouterDependencies: true ke saath bhi use ho sakta hai).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"kaise aapko pata chalta hai ki client bundle ko bada bana raha hai?" - next analyze (Turbopack) / @next/bundle-analyzer (webpack), phir lazy-loading, optimizePackageImports dwara theek karein, Server Components ya transpilePackages/serverExternalPackages ke liye kaam karte hain.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/package-bundling

PostCSS

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai PostCSS. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: PostCSS — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Customizing target browsers, CSS Modules, Customizing plugins — BIG WARNING. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js CSS ko PostCSS ke saath compiled karta hai. Default behavior (koi config nahi): Autoprefixer seller upasarg (IE11 ke liye wapas) jodti hai; phleksboks bag kalpnaa karne ke liye sahi; naye CSS features IE11 (all sanpatti, brek gun, font-variant, gap gun, media query reinj) ke liye sanklita. NOT default roop se compiled: CSS grid aur Custom Properties (CSS char) - grid ko CSS file ke top par comment /* autoprefixer grid: autoplace */ ke saath prati file enable kiya jaa sakta hai, ya autoprefixer config (grid: 'autoplace') ke madhyam se project-vyaapee; CSS char surakshit roop se compiled nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - iske bajaay Sass char ka upyog karein (ve compile door).

  • Customizing target browser: browserslist ke madhyam se - package.json, e.g mein browserslist key jorein. [">0.3%", "not dead", "not op_mini all"]; browsersl.ist par drishya.
  • CSS module: koi config ki zaroorat nahi hai; .module.css ko file ka naam badlein.
  • Customizing plagins — BIG WARNING: ek custom PostCSS config file ko define karta hai purn roop se default behavior ko disabled karta hai - aapko manual roop se sab kuchh yaad karna chahiye, jismein Autoprefixer, aur manual roop se npm install plagins (e.g) shamil hain. postcss-flexbugs-fixes postcss-preset-env) default config (verbatim): plag-in postcss-flexbugs-fixes + postcss-preset-env { autoprefixer: { flexbox: 'no-2009' }, stage: 3, features: { 'custom-properties': false } } ke sath. file vikalp ko configure karein: postcss.config.json (ya .postcssrc.json), ya package.json mein ek postcss key) ya postcss.config.js (ya .postcssrc.js) - JS form env (e.g) dwara sashart plagins ki permission data hai. development mein koi parivartan nahi, production mein full purv set nahi hai. Do NOT require() ka upyog PostCSS plagins ko import karne ke liye karta hai - unhein strings ke roop mein pradan karta hai. any non-Next.js tool ke saath introp ke liye, objekt-aadharit format ka upyog karein: plugins: { 'postcss-flexbugs-fixes': {}, 'postcss-preset-env': {... } }.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"main ek postcss.config joda aur meri upasarg gayab ho gaya" - custom config badal data hai (vistarit nahi) difolta.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/post-css

Preview Mode (LEGACY)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Preview Mode (LEGACY). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Preview Mode (LEGACY) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it worked, Differences from Draft Mode. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Status: LEGACY — Draft Mode (D2.9) dwara superseded. phir bhi pichhre compatibility ke liye support kiya; ise vartaman API. CMS udaharanon ke roop mein nahi parhaayaa jata hai: chapalataa, Builder.io, ButterCMS, Contentful, Cosmic, DatoCMS, DotCMS, Drupal, Enterspeed, GraphCMS, keeston, Kontent.ai, Makeswift, Plasmic, Prepr, Prismic, Sanity, Sitecore XM Cloud, Storyblok, straipee, TakeShape, Tina, Umbraco, Webiny, WordPress, Blog Starter.

  • Ye kaise kaam karta tha: wahi problem/solution jo Draft Mode ka hai, bas purana API. API route pages/api/preview.js res.setPreviewData({}) call karta hai, jo __prerender_bypass + __next_preview_data cookies set karta hai. Secure CMS flow Draft Mode jaisa hi hai (secret token + slug, dono verify karo, post fetch karo, post.slug par redirect karo — kabhi req.query.slug par nahi, open-redirect risk). getStaticProps me, preview cookies use request time par chalate hain, context.preview === true aur context.previewData ke saath — context.previewData wahi object hai jo setPreviewData ko pass kiya gaya tha (session info ko getStaticProps me pass karne ke liye use hota hai); us par branch karke fetch karo, jaise fetch(`https://.../${context.preview ? 'preview' : ''}`).
  • Draft Mode se fark: setPreviewData(data, { maxAge, path }) — optional maxAge (seconds, jaise 60*60 = 1 ghanta) aur path (cookie scope, default /); res.clearPreviewData() se clear karo (agar path set tha to wahi path pass karo); previewData ek cookie me store hota hai → 2KB size limit; next/router rendering ke dauraan ek isPreview flag expose karta hai. getServerSideProps (context me preview / previewData) aur API Routes (req.preview, req.previewData) ke saath kaam karta hai. Har next build par bypass cookie value aur previewData ko encrypt karne wali private key dono badal jate hain. Preview Mode ke saath Cache-Control set mat karo (bypass nahi ho sakta) — ISR use karo. Local HTTP testing ke liye third-party cookies + local storage allowed hona chahiye. <Link> se jude clearing route ko prefetch={false} chahiye.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Preview Mode → Draft Mode naam badlein; setPreviewData/clearPreviewData/context.preview/context.previewData legacy naam hain; aadhunik code setDraftMode/context.draftMode ka upyog karta hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/preview-mode

Production Checklist

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Production Checklist. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Production Checklist — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Automatic optimizations (on by default, no config), During development — routing/rendering, Before going to production. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: teen baaltee mein purv production sarvottam prathaon: automatic: optimization, development ke dauraan, production ke liye jaane se pahle.

  • automatic optimization (default roop se, koi config nahi) Code-splitting - app pages dwara vibhajit hai; keval vartaman page ke navigation par code load (plus lazy load third-party libs jahan upyukt). Prefetching - jab ek <Link> viewport mein access karta hai, to Next.js background mein route ko priority data hai, jisse nikat-insteint navigation ho sakta hai (bahar nikal sakta hai). Automatic Static Optimization — koi blocked data aavashyaktaon wale pages ko static, cached ke roop mein render kiya jata hai aur kai CDN sthanon se serve ki jati hai; unmein SSR ka chayan karein jahan upyukt ho.
  • During development — routing/rendering: client-side navigation + prefetching ke liye <Link> ka upyog karta hai; custom 500/404 error page. Data fetching/caching: API roots (jise "Route Handlers" kaha jata hai) yahan - Pages Router mein ve API roots hain, jo rahasyon ko expose kiye bina backend sansadhanon tak pahunchne ke liye; data requests ko verify karna cache kiya gaya hai (caching mein opt, e.g). getStaticProps; full punarnirman ke bina static pages ko update karne ke liye ISR; auto-cached static assets ke liye public/ dir. UI/accessibility: font module (sva-hosted, koi external request nahi, kam layout shift); <Image> (auto-optimaaijd, WebP, koi layout shift nahi); <Script> (main dhage se third-party ki script ko hata data hai); ESLint eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y jaldi se 11y muddon ko catch ke liye. Security: .gitignore mein .env.*, keval public vars NEXT_PUBLIC_; XSS/clickjacking/injection. : next/head ke khilaf CSP par vichar karein. Type security: TypeScript + TS plagina. Pages Router Metadata/SEO titles/descriptions
  • Before production karne ke liye jaa raha hai: ne build errors ko catch ke liye local roop se next build ko chalaya, phir next start ek production ki tarah environment mein performance ko mapne ke liye. Core Web Vitals: ne inkognito mein Lighthouse ko chalaya (simulet test - field data ke saath pair). Analyzing bundles: bare module khojne ke liye @next/bundle-analyzer; Import Cost (VS Code), Package Phobia, Bundle Phobia, naye nirbhartaon ko rokne ke liye bundles.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh page "kya aap ek Next.js app shiping se pahle ki check karte hain? uttar - bundle vishleshan, Lighthouse, next build + next start draaee run, caching/ISR validation, CSP, env svachhta.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/production-checklist

Redirecting

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Redirecting. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Redirecting — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `useRouter` hook, `redirects` in next.config.js (verbatim), `NextResponse.redirect` in Proxy, Managing redirects at scale (advanced). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ek talika ki tulna mein teen redirect tantr:

| API | Purpose | Where | Status code |

| useRouter | client-side navigation | components | N/A |

| redirects in next.config.js | path dwara redirect | next.config.js | 307 (asthayi) ya 308 (sthayi) |

| NextResponse.redirect | sthiti dwara redirect | Proxy | any |

  • useRouter hook: const router = useRouter() (next/router se) tab router.push('/dashboard') ek iveint handler (e.g button onClick) mein. yadi aapko programmatic navigation ki requirement nahi hai, to iske bajaay <Link> ka upyog karein.
  • next.config.js mein redirects (verbatim): async redirects() { return [{ source: '/about', destination: '/', permanent: true }, { source: '/blog/:slug', destination: '/news/:slug', permanent: true }] }. path, header, cookie aur query match ka support karta hai. permanent: true → 308, false → 307. Limits: platform kaip redirect (Vercel: 1,024) - 1000+ ke liye ek Proxy samadhan ka upyog karein. Order: redirects BEFORE Proxy E
  • Proxy mein NextResponse.redirect: sthiti aadharit redirects (auth, session) ya bare redirect set ke liye. udaharan: matcher: '/dashboard/:path*' ke saath proxy.ts — authenticate(request); yadi adhikrit NextResponse.next(), to NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url)). Order: Proxy redirects ke BAAD aur rendering se PEHLE chalta hai.
  • Managing paimane par redirect karta hai (advanced): 1000+ redirects ke liye , ek Proxy samadhan ka build karta hai taaki aap prati redirect nahi karte: (1) redirect map — ek pramukh value store (Vercel Global Config, Redis) ya JSON file mein { "/old": { "destination": "/new", "permanent": true } } store karein; Proxy ise padhta hai (await get(pathname)), entry ko par karta hai, aur NextResponse.redirect(destination, permanent? 308: 307) return karta hai; koi match nahi → NextResponse.next(). (2) Optimize lookup - prati request ek bada dataset padhna slow/expensive hai; ek tezi se parhne wala DB and/or ek Bloom filtar ka upyog karein: ek generated bloom filtar JSON ko Proxy mein import karein; yadi bloomFilter.has(pathname), ek API root (/api/redirects?pathname=...) ke liye aage hai jo actual redirects.json ki check karta hai aur entry return karta hai (is haindal mein jhoothi positivity hai - anupasthit hone par 400 'No redirect' ki wapsi); Proxy tab 308/307. ke saath redirect hota hai jo filtar ko bloom-filters npm package ke saath generated karta hai. durbhavnapurn requests ko rokne ke liye API root ko request valid karein.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"aap 10,000 redirect kaise sambhalte hain? - nahi next.config.js redirect (platform limit ~ 1,024); Proxy + KV store + bloom philtar pree-check ka upyog karein.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/redirecting

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: built-in Sass support ek bar sass package installed kiya gaya hai (npm install --save-dev sass). donon .scss aur .sass extension kaam karte hain; component-star Sass CSS module ke madhyam se .module.scss / .module.sass ke sath.

  • do syntax: .scss = SCSS syntax (CSS ka suparaset) — yadi anishchit ho to sifarish ki; .sass = Indented Syntax.
  • Customizing Sass vikalp: next.config, e.g mein sassOptions. additionalData: '$var: red;' (har Sass file ke liye taiyar - global char ke liye upyogi). implementation sanpatti Sass karyanvayan ka chayan karti hai; default sass package, e.g hai. implementation: 'sass-embedded'
  • JS mein Sass char: Next.js :export ke madhyam se CSS module files se export kiye gaye Sass char ka support karta hai:
scss
$primary-color: #64ff00;
:export { primaryColor: $primary-color; }
jsx
import variables from '../styles/variables.module.scss'
// variables.primaryColor === '#64ff00'
<Layout color={variables.primaryColor}><Component {...pageProps} /></Layout>
  • Fark banam App Router: saman; keval import sthan bhinn hota hai (pages/_app.js banam root layout).

Scripts

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Scripts. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Scripts — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Strategies, Worker strategy (experimental), Inline scripts, Event handlers, Additional attributes, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next/script third-party lipiyon ka optimization karta hai. Application script: next/script se Script import karta hai aur ise pages/_app.js mein ALL routes par load karne ke liye shamil karta hai; Next.js yeh sunishchit karta hai ki yeh navigation ke dauraan bhi keval ek bar load ho raha hai. sifarish: third-party ki lipiyon ko keval vishisht pages/layouts par perf prabhav ko kam karne ke liye shamil kiya gaya hai.

  • Strategies: beforeInteractive - kisi bhi Next.js code se pahle aur hydration se pahle; afterInteractive — default, jaldi lekin kuchh hydration ke baad; lazyOnload — baad mein, browser inactive samay ke dauraan; worker — experimental, ek web worker mein.
  • Worker ranniti (experimental): ne Partytown ke madhyam se ek web worker ko script oflod kiya, jo main dhage ko mukt karta hai. next.config mein experimental: { nextScriptWorkers: true } ki requirement hai; dev chal raha hai to npm install @qwik.dev/partytown ko prerit karta hai. warning: abhi tak static nahi hai, NOT App Router ke saath kaam karta hai. Custom Partytown config pages/_document.js <Head> mein ek <script data-partytown-config dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: 'partytown = { lib: "/_next/static/~partytown/", debug: true };' }} /> ke roop mein jata hai - data-partytown-config ko Next.js default ko override karne ki requirement hoti hai, aur lib: "/_next/static/~partytown/" ko shamil kiya jana chahiye (yadi ek ka upyog karte hain to lib mein assetPrefix ko preeped karein). vyapar-band partytown.qwik.dev/trade-offs. mein document
  • Inline scripts: ne bachchon (<Script id="show-banner">{ document.getElementById('banner').classList.remove('hidden')}</Script>) ya dangerouslySetInnerHTML ke madhyam se support kiya. An id prop inline scripts ke liye REQUIRED hai, isliye Next.js unhein track/optimize kar sakte hain.
  • Event handler: onLoad ( script ke baad load ho raha hai), onReady (jaisa ki har bar component mount load ho raha hai), onError (bhar viphalta). Pages Router mein ye kisi bhi 'use client' nirdeshan ke bina components mein kaam karte hain (contrast: App Router Server Components unka upyog nahi kar sakte hain - Client Component mein moved karein).
  • Additional visheshataon: extra DOM visheshataon (nonce, data-*, id) ko antim customize <script> element ko agreshit kiya jata hai.
  • Fark banam App Router: worker ranniti App Router mein kaam nahi karti hai; beforeInteractive script root layout mein jate hain (No _document); iveint handler ko App Router mein Client Components ki requirement hoti hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/scripts

Self-Hosting

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Self-Hosting. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Self-Hosting — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Reverse proxy, Image Optimization, Proxy, Environment variables, Caching and ISR, Static assets. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: apne khud ke buniyadi dhanche (Node server, Docker, static export) ke liye Next.js features ko configure karta hai.

  • Reverse proxy: ne ise seedhe expose karne ke bajaay next start ke samne nginx (ya isi tarah) daal diya - proxy vikrit requests ko sambhalti hai, dhimi-kanekshan hamlon, payload boundary, dar simit karne, Next.js server ko render karne par dhyaan dene ki permission deti hai.
  • Image Optimization: next start ke tahat zero config ke saath sva-hosted kaam karta hai; ek alag optimization serve ke liye ek custom image loader ka upyog karein; static export ke saath next.config mein ek custom loader ko define karte hain (chitron ko runtime par customize kiya jata hai, build nahi hota). Glibc Linux par, atydhik memory upyog se bachne ke liye tej ko extra config ki requirement ho sakti hai. optimization (unoptimized) ko inactive kar sakte hain aur any next/image labhon ko rakh sakte hain; minimumCacheTTL ke madhyam se TTL ko configure karein.
  • Proxy: next start ke tahat zero config ke saath sva-hosted kaam karta hai; NOT static export ke saath supported hai (aavak request ki requirement hai). yadi aapko node-onlee lojik ki requirement hai, to ise ek layout/Server component (headers + redirect) mein le jaein, to next.config header/cookie/query redirects/rewrites ya ek custom server ka upyog karein.
  • Environment char: NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars build samay par inlined hain; runtime manon ke liye getServerSideProps (ya App Router) ka upyog karein taaki ek Docker image ko environment mein badhava diya jaa sake. server startup code instrumentation register ke madhyam se.
  • Caching and ISR: Next.js cache pratikriyaon, generated static pages, production, static assets ka nirmaan. ISR ek hi server cache ka upyog karta hai, jo pratyek server udaharan ke local file system par default roop se sangrahit hota hai - lagatar disk ke saath ek single next start ke liye theek hai; samne ke kai udaharan / ephemeral compute / CDN ke liye, ek sajha cache ko configure karein. automatic caching header: vastav mein achal sanpatti (SHA-hash in filename, e.g. static image import) ko Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable milta hai - override nahi kiya jaa sakta hai. ISR pages ko s-maxage: <revalidate seconds>, stale-while-revalidate milta hai (getStaticProps revalidate se; revalidate: false → ek varsh ka cache) - aapke CDN/reverse proxy ko in nirdeshon ka samman karna chahiye aur cache key parivartanasheeltaa ya pratikriyaon ko CDN caching ko bypass kar sakte hain. dynamic roop se render kiye gaye pages ko private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate (Draft Mode shamil) milta hai, isliye user-vishisht data kabhi cache nahi kiya jata hai.
  • Static assets: next.config mein assetPrefix ek any domain/CDN se JS/CSS serve pradan karta hai (lagat: extra DNS/TLS samay).
  • Configuring caching (custom cacheHandler): next.config.js: cacheHandler: require.resolve('./cache-handler.js'), cacheMaxMemorySize: 0 (disebal default in-memory caching); default 50MB in-memory + disk hai. handler class get, set, revalidateTag, resetRequestCache ko lagu karta hai. production ki requirements: store jahan har udaharan ise tak pahunch sakta hai (Redis, S3 - ek prakriya-local Map pratyek phalee ko phir se apni pratilipi data hai); badhya store size (TTL/size eviction); serialize entries (praveshiyon mein Buffer jaise rscData aur Map shamil ho sakte hain, jaise segmentData ki JSON.stringify round-trip nahi kar sakte hain - segmentData.get is not a function ya failed to pipe response ke roop mein viphalta sho); index entries (APP_PAGE / APP_ROUTE / PAGES entries x-next-cache-tags header mein tag le jaa sakti hain; entries ko prapt karne ke liye ctx.tags - sajha store mein indeks ko banaye rakhein taaki har jagah ek udaharan par revalidateTag ko avaidh declare kiya jaa sake); storage errors ko sambhalne (taaimaauts, giraaye gaye kanekshan). not: revalidatePath cache tag par ek feature parat hai; 'use cache' directive backend cacheHandlers config ka upyog karte hain.
  • Build cache / build ID: next build ek ID generated karta hai jo sarv kiye gaye sanskaran ki identity karta hai; usi build ko kai kantenron ko boot karna chahiye. yadi prati environment variablesan ka punarnirman kiya jata hai, to generateBuildId: async () => process.env.GIT_HASH ke madhyam se ek susangat ID generated karein. jab deploymentId set ho jata hai, to Next.js ek static build ID ka upyog karta hai jab tak generateBuildId ko spasht roop se configure nahi kiya jata hai.
  • Multi-server deployment: (1) Server Functions encryption key - Next.js enkripted Server Function band char; default key prati build unique hai, isliye sabhi udaharanon ko ek sajha karna chahiye: NEXT_SERVER_ACTIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY set karein (base64, AES lambaaee 16/24/32 bytes; default 32) build samay par, aur "Failed to find Server Action" errors ko par karne ke liye. (2) Deployment pahchankarta — roling deployment mein sanskaran-skew sanrakshan ke liye deploymentId set karein. (3) Shared kaish — default in-memory cache sajha nahi hai; external storage ke saath 'use cache: remote' + custom cache handler ka upyog karein.
  • Version skew: roling deployment ke dauraan , client lapta assets ko maar sakte hain, Server Function ID mismatches, ya incompatible prefetched data. deploymentId ke saath configure kiya gaya: static assets ko ?dpl=<deploymentId> milta hai, client navigation ek x-deployment-id header bhejta hai, server ID ki tulna karta hai, aur galat tarike se ek hard navigation (full reload) ko trigger karta hai, isliye client ek susangat sanskaran prapt karta hai. Caveat: phir load in-memory component state (useState); URL state/localStorage bani hui hai. Immutable static assets ko yeh aasan banata hai: unhein static folder/CDN baaltee mein jorte rahein aur deployment ID par nazar rakhne ke bina koi tirchha nahi hai.
  • Manual graceful shutdown: set env NEXT_MANUAL_SIG_HANDLE=true (package.json script mein, NOT in .env), phir pages/_document.js (e.g) log + process.exit(0)) mein process.on('SIGTERM'/'SIGINT',...) handler panjikrit karein. next dev mein upalabdh nahi hai.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
self-hosting cheklist = rivars proxy, multi-insteins ke liye sajha cache handler, sanskaran skew ke liye sangat build ID + deploymentId, Server Actions encryption key, getServerSideProps ke madhyam se runtime env varrs sajha kiya.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/self-hosting

Static Exports

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Static Exports. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Static Exports — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Configuration, Supported, Unsupported (need a Node server / dynamic logic), Deploying, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ek static site/SPA ke roop mein shuru hota hai, baad mein server features mein upgrade hota hai. next build prati route ek HTML file generated karta hai, isliye ek sakht SPA vyaktigat HTML files mein toot jata hai - kam client JS, tej load. kisi bhi static web server (S3, Nginx, Apache, GitHub page) par host karne yogy hai.

  • Configuration: next.config.js: output: 'export' (optional roop se trailingSlash: true ko /me → /me/ ko badalane aur /me.html → /me/index.html ka utsarjan karne ke liye skipTrailingSlashRedirect: true auto /me → /me/ ko rokne ke liye; distDir: 'dist' ko out folder badalane ke liye). next build ke baad, assets out/ folder mein utaratee hain. prati page ek HTML file generated karne ke liye getStaticProps + getStaticPaths ka upyog karein (dynamic routes ke liye adhik).
  • Supported: getStaticPaths ke saath dynamic route, next/link, JS preloading, dynamic import, sabhi styling vikalp (CSS module, style-jsx), client-side data lane, getStaticProps, getStaticPaths ke saath prefetching. Image Optimization keval ek custom loader (e.g) ke saath kaam karta hai. Cloudinary: images: { loader: 'custom', loaderFile: './my-loader.ts' } jahan loader https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/f_auto,c_limit,w_${width},q_${quality || 'auto'}${src} ki tarah URL ka build karta hai.
  • Unsupported (ek Node server / dynamic tark ki zaroorat hai): i18n routing, API roots, punarlekhan, punarnirdeshan, header, Proxy, ISR, Image Optimization default loader, Draft Mode, fallback: true ya 'blocking', getServerSideProps ke saath getStaticPaths.
  • Deploying: next build → out/ with e.g. /out/index.html, /out/404.html, /out/blog/post-1.html, /out/blog/post-2.html. Nginx udaharan: root /var/www/out; location / { try_files $uri $uri.html $uri/ =404; }, plus location /blog/ { rewrite ^/blog/(.*)$ /blog/$1.html break; } jab trailingSlash: false; error_page 404 /404.html; location = /404.html { internal; } ke sath. GitHub page template upalabdh hai.
  • Version history: v13.3.0 next export ko output: 'export' ke paksh mein avagat karaya gaya; v13.4.0 App Router static badhi hui static export (RSC + Route Handlers); v14.0.0 next export hata diya gaya.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
"kya aap output: 'export' ke saath nahi kar sakte?" - uprokt unsupported list; classic traip ek static host par kaam karne ke liye API roots / ISR / getServerSideProps ki ummid hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/static-exports

End-to-End (E2E) — user ek browser ki tarah, production ki tarah environment (e.g) mein bahtee hai. Snapshot - ek snapshot file mein render output ko capture karein; baad mein iske khilaf vartaman output ki tulna karein; bhinntaa flag apratyashit behavior parivartana.

  • Tool guide: Cypress (E2E + component), Jest (Unit), Playwright (E2E + ekikaran), Vitest (Unit, React Testing Library ke saath). D2.34-D2.37 mein vivarana.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Cypress E2E aur Component Testing ke liye ek testing runner hai. setup: npm install -D cypress script "cypress:open": "cypress open" ko package.json mein jorein, npm run cypress:open chalaein - pahla run ka wizard cypress.config.js + ek cypress/ folder banata hai; E2E and/or Component Testing chunein.

  • Warning: 13.6.3 ke neeche Cypress TypeScript 5 ko moduleResolution: "bundler" ke saath support nahi karta hai - ≥13.6.3 ka upyog karein.
  • First E2E testing: cypress.config.ts: defineConfig({ e2e: { setupNodeEvents(on, config) {} } }). test file cypress/e2e/app.cy.js: describe('Navigation', () => { it('should navigate to the about page', () => { cy.visit('http://localhost:3000/'); cy.get('a[href*="about"]').click(); cy.url().should('include', '/about'); cy.get('h1').filter(':visible').contains('About') }) }). Running E2E: Next.js server chalana chahiye; production code (npm run build && npm run start) ke khilaf actual behavior ko pratibinbit karne ke liye testing karein. tip: cy.visit("/") ka upyog karne ke liye config mein baseUrl: 'http://localhost:3000' set karein; ya start-server-and-test ("test": "start-server-and-test start http://localhost:3000 cypress") ka upyog karein aur parivartanon ke baad punarnirman karein. cypress:open
  • First component testing: Cypress app mein Component Testing uthate hain, phremavark ke roop mein Next.js ka chayan karte hain; config component: { devServer: { framework: 'next', bundler: 'webpack' } } ho jata hai. test cypress/component/about.cy.js: import AboutPage from '../../pages/about'; cy.mount(<AboutPage />); cy.get('h1').contains('About'); cy.get('a[href="/"]').should('be.visible'). component testing pure app ko bundle kiye bina ya server shuru kiye bina ek component ko mount karte hain; nimnlikhit link E2E mein hain.
  • Dhyaan Do: Cypress async Server Components ke liye Component Testing ka support nahi karta; server-nirbhar features jaise <Image /> bina kisi server ke component parikshanon mein kaam nahi kar sakta.
  • CI: hedles ke madhyam se cypress run; package.json script e.g. "e2e:headless": "start-server-and-test dev http://localhost:3000 \"cypress run --e2e\"" "component:headless": "cypress run --component"

Jest

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Jest. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Jest — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Manual setup (Next.js 12+ built-in), Jest with Babel (opted out of the Compiler), Fonts mock, Absolute imports, Custom matchers, First test. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Jest + React Testing Library ke liye Unit Testing E aur Snapshot Testing. not: jest NOT support async Server Components karta hai - unit-test tulyakalik Server/Client component, Async logon ke liye E2E ka upyog karte hain. Quickstart: npx create-next-app@latest --example with-jest with-jest-app.

  • Manual setup (Next.js 12+ bilt-in): npm install -D jest jest-environment-jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom @testing-library/jest-dom ts-node @types/jest. ek config platform (npm init jest@latest) generated karein, phir ise next/jest ka upyog karne ke liye phir se likhna:
ts
// jest.config.ts
import type { Config } from 'jest'
import nextJest from 'next/jest.js'
const createJestConfig = nextJest({ dir: './' }) // loads next.config.js and .env in tests
const config: Config = { coverageProvider: 'v8', testEnvironment: 'jsdom' }
export default createJestConfig(config)

next/jest hud ke tahat sambhalta hai: Next.js Compiler, auto-moking stylesheet (.css/.module.css/scss), image import aur next/font ke madhyam se badal jata hai, .env variant ko process.env mein load karta hai, node_modules aur .next ko testing samadhan se andekha karta hai, SWC jhande ke liye next.config.js load karta hai. seedhe env vars ka testing karne ke liye, unhein ek setup script ya jest config mein manual roop se load karein.

  • Jest with Babel (Compiler se bahar niklaa): ne babel-jest + identity-obj-proxy installed kiya aur manual roop se configure kiya: collectCoverage, coverageProvider: 'v8', collectCoverageFrom, out/, .next/, *.config.js, coverage/; moduleNameMapper: CSS module → identity-obj-proxy, plain CSS → __mocks__/styleMock.js, images → __mocks__/fileMock.js (module.exports = 'test-file-stub'), @/components/* alias, @next/font/next/font → nextFontMock.js server-only empty.js transform: { '^.+\\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$': ['babel-jest', { presets: ['next/babel'] }] } testEnvironment: 'jsdom' *.d.ts node_modules
  • Fonts nakli: __mocks__/nextFontMock.js - kisi bhi font getar ke liye () => ({ className: 'className', variable: 'variable', style: { fontFamily: 'fontFamily' } }) lautane wala Proxy hai.
  • Absolute import: darpan tsconfig.json paths ("@/components/*": ["components/*"]) moduleNameMapper: '^@/components/(.*)$': '<rootDir>/components/$1' mein.
  • Custom matchers: import '@testing-library/jest-dom' ke saath setupFilesAfterEnv: ['<rootDir>/jest.setup.ts'] (enable .toBeInTheDocument() aadi). not: @testing-library/jest-dom v6 ne extend-expect ko hata diya - package root import karein, /extend-expect nahi.
  • First test: __tests__/index.test.js: import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react'; import Home from '../pages/index'; describe('Home', () => { it('renders a heading', () => { render(<Home />); const heading = screen.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 }); expect(heading).toBeInTheDocument() }) }). snapshot sanskaran: expect(container).toMatchSnapshot(). script: "test": "jest", "test:watch": "jest --watch".
  • Dhyaan Do: kabhi pages/ directory ke andar testing files ko kabhi nahi dalta - pratyek file ko root ke roop mein ilaj kiya jata hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/testing/jest

Key concepts: Playwright automatic roop se Chromium, Firefox aur WebKit ko E2E (aur ekikaran) testing ke liye ek single API E ke saath automatic roop se automatic karta hai. Quickstart: npx create-next-app@latest --example with-playwright with-playwright-app. manual setup: npm init playwright (wizard playwright.config.ts banata hai).

  • First E2E test (tests/example.spec.ts): import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('should navigate to the about page', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('http://localhost:3000/'); await page.getByRole('link', { name: 'About' }).click(); await expect(page).toHaveURL('http://localhost:3000/about'); await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })).toContainText('About') }). page.goto("/") likhne ke liye config mein baseURL: 'http://localhost:3000' ka upyog karein.
  • Running: Next.js server chal raha hai; production code (npm run build && npm run start) ke khilaf chalaein, phir ek any tarminal mein npx playwright test chalaein. optional roop se Playwright ke webServer config vikalp ka upyog karne ke liye Playwright dev server shuru karne ke liye aur jab tak yeh upalabdh nahi hai tab tak await karein.
  • CI: testing default roop se hedles chalate hain; npx playwright install-deps ke saath system deps installed karein.
  • Playwright banam Cypress: Playwright ka antar teen actual browser injnon (Chromium/Firefox/WebKit) banam Cypress ke Electron/Chromium-centric dhaavkon mein ek API hai; donon ko E2E ke liye chal rahe app server ki requirement hoti hai.

})

Key concepts: @next/third-parties — lokapriy third-party libraries (performance + DX) ke liye customize components/utilities. Experimental, active development ke tahat - @latest ya canary: npm install @next/third-parties@latest next@latest ke saath sthaapita. All Google ekikaran @next/third-parties/google se import karte hain.

  • Google Tag Manager: pages/_app.js (saare routes) me <GoogleTagManager gtmId="GTM-XYZ" /> ya ek single page; hydration ke baad original inline script fetch karta hai. sendGTMEvent({ event: 'buttonClicked', value: 'xyz' }) dataLayer ke through events bhejta hai (<GoogleTagManager /> component ek parent ya usi file me hona chahiye). Options: gtmId (required, GTM- se start), gtmScriptUrl (default https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js; server-side tagging / tag gateway ke liye — gtmScriptUrl diye jaane par gtmId omit ho sakta hai), dataLayer, dataLayerName (default dataLayer), auth (gtm_auth), preview (gtm_preview).
  • Google Analytics (GA4): _app me <GoogleAnalytics gaId="G-XYZ" /> ya ek page; hydration ke baad gtag.js load karta hai. Agar GTM pehle se shamil hai, to ek alag component ke bajaye GTM ke through GA configure karo. Events ke liye sendGAEvent('event', 'buttonClicked', { value: 'xyz' }) (component present hona chahiye). Pageviews browser history changes par automatic hain — client-side navigation bina kisi configuration ke pageview bhejta hai; verify karo ki Enhanced Measurement Admin me "browser history events ke basis par page changes" ke saath enabled hai. Agar tum pageviews manually bhejte ho, to duplicates se bachne ke liye default measurement disable karo. Options: gaId (required, G- se start), dataLayerName, debugMode, nonce (CSP).
  • Google Maps Embed: <GoogleMapsEmbed apiKey="..." height={200} width="100%" mode="place" q="Brooklyn+Bridge,New+York,NY" />; default roop se loading attribute ke through lazy load hota hai (agar above the fold ho to badlo). Options: apiKey + mode required; height/width (default auto), style, allowfullscreen, loading (default lazy), q (marker; per mode required ho sakta hai), center, zoom, maptype, language, region.
  • YouTube Embed: <YouTubeEmbed videoid="ogfYd705cRs" height={400} params="controls=0" /> — under the hood lite-youtube-embed ke through tez load hota hai. Options: videoid required; width/height (default auto), playlabel (play button ke liye visually-hidden a11y label), params (query string, jaise params="controls=0&start=10&end=30"), style.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/guides/third-party-libraries
