Codemods

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Codemods. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Codemods — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Upgrade command, Codemod catalog (by version), 16.3, 16.0, 15.0, 14.0. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Codemods programmatic badlav hain jo thok mein kodbes par lagu hote hain, basharte ki API updated/deprecated. upyog: npx @next/codemod <transform> <path>; --dry (sookhee run, koi sampadan nahi), --print (print ne tulna ke liye output badal diya). hamesha project folder se chalate hain.

  • Upgrade command: npx @next/codemod upgrade [revision] — upgrade Next.js, React, React DOM aur auto run kodmoda. revision optional: patch | minor (default) | major (latest/canary/rc) | satik sanskaran (15.0.0). vikalp: --verbose; --skip-react-upgrade (React deps/types ko preserve karein, React codemods ko chhor dein); --skip-eslint-upgrade (Eslint deps ko preserve karein, next-lint-to-eslint-cli ko chhor dein - manual roop se full lint migration); -y, --yes (skip sabhi prompts, dipholts accept karte hain; auto-enable jab stdin ek TTY, i.e nahi hai. CI/AI agent) yadi target ≤ vartaman sanskaran, parivartan ke bina bahar nikalta hai. chhorein jhande sahakarmi-dependency aavashyaktaon ko bypass nahi karte hain. agent optional: npx next@canary upgrade --agent=latest.
  • Codemod catalog (by version):
  • 16.3: cache-components-instant-false — pratyek {page,layout,default} file mein export const instant = false (@next-codemod-ignore comment ke saath) ko jodti hai, isliye aap cacheComponents ko enable kar sakte hain, phir route se opt-out route ko hata sakte hain (skips "use client" files). remove-partial-prefetch - export const prefetch = 'partial' (keval us maan) ko hata data hai, isliye partialPrefetching ko vishv star par enable banaya jaa sakta hai. tip: src / pariyojnaon mein ./src/app paas karein; asaphal hone ke bajaay ek galat path report 0 ok.
  • 16.0: remove-experimental-ppr — export const experimental_ppr = true ko App Router pages/layouts. remove-unstable-prefix — unstable_cacheTag → cacheTag aadi se hata data hai. middleware-to-proxy - middleware.ts → proxy.ts, middleware → proxy, config experimental.middlewarePrefetch → experimental.proxyPrefetch, experimental.middlewareClientMaxBodySize → experimental.proxyClientMaxBodySize, experimental.externalMiddlewareRewritesResolve → externalProxyRewritesResolve, skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize → skipProxyUrlNormalize. next-lint-to-eslint-cli — migrates next lint → ESLint CLI: eslint.config.mjs (FlatCompat vistarit next/core-web-vitals, next/typescript, node_modules/**, .next/**, out/**, build/**, next-env.d.ts) ka build karta hai, lint script ko eslint. mein badalta hai, ESLint ko jodta hai, maujuda config ko barkarar rakhta hai.
  • 15.0: app-dir-runtime-config-experimental-edge (App Router) - runtime = 'experimental-edge' → 'edge'. next-async-request-api — migrates cookies()/headers()/draftMode() aur params/searchParams props to async: unhein Server Components mein / React.use() ke saath Client Components mein lapetein; jahan yeh tay nahi kar sakta, @next-codemod-error tippniyon aur asthayi UnsafeUnwrapped* casts — build errors ko sammilit karta hai jab tak ki inhein spasht roop se hata diya jata hai (/docs/messages/sync-dynamic-apis dekhein). next-request-geo-ip — @vercel/functions installed karta hai, req.geo/req.ip ko geolocation(req)/ipAddress(req) ke saath badal data hai.
  • 14.0: next-og-import — ImageResponse import next/server → next/og. metadata-to-viewport-export — themeColor/viewport ko metadata se viewport export mein le jata hai.
  • 13.2: built-in-next-font — Uninstalled @next/font, rewrites @next/font/google → next/font/google.
  • 13.0: next-image-to-legacy-image — next/image → next/legacy/image aur next/future/image → next/image. next-image-experimental — dangerously migrates next/legacy/image → naya next/image: layout/objectFit/objectPosition props (adds style) ko hata data hai, lazyBoundary/lazyRoot ko hata data hai. new-link - <Link> ke andar <a> ko hata data hai. onClick <Link>
  • 11: cra-to-next — ek banana React app projekt ko Next.js (Pages Router) mein migrate karta hai, jo client-side-only shuru hota hai taaki window ko SSR ke dauraan brek karne se roka jaa sake.
  • 10: add-missing-react-import — import React from 'react' ko jodta hai jahan lapta, naye JSX ke liye badal jata hai.
  • 9: name-default-component — naam agyat default export (file naam se kaimal-kes) to Fast Refresh kaam karta hai.
  • 8: withamp-to-config — withAmp HOC → export const config = { amp: true }. not: built-in AMP support aur is codemod ko Next.js 16. mein hata diya gaya tha.
  • 6: url-to-withrouter — page → withRouter + router prop par auto-injekted url prop ko hata diya gaya.

Upgrading — Version 11 (10 → 11)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Upgrading — Version 11 (10 → 11). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Upgrading — Version 11 (10 → 11) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Webpack 5 is now the default, Cleaning `distDir` is now a default, `PORT` env var now supported, `next.config.js` customization to import images, Removals (previously deprecated), Moment.js locales excluded by default. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: upgrade: npm i next@11 react@17 react-dom@17 (TS ke liye @types/react / @types/react-dom ko upgrade bhi karein).

  • Webpack 5 ab difolt (koi custom webpack config → pahle se hi webpack 5 par) hai; custom configs ko webpack-5 migration docs ki requirement hoti hai.
  • Cleaning distDir ab ek default hai: .next ko Next.js cache ko chhorakar build par manjooree di gai hai. next.config mein cleanDistDir: false ke saath bahar nikalna.
  • PORT env var ne ab next dev/next start (e.g) ke liye ka support kiya. PORT=4000 next start; -p/--port abhi bhi recommended hai.
  • images ko import karne ke liye next.config.js optimization: next/image ke saath static image import ko image-import prasanskaran ki requirement hoti hai; yadi aap next-images/next-optimized-images ka upyog karte hain, to images: { disableStaticImages: true } ke saath built-in support ya akshamataa ke liye migrate karein.
  • Removal (purv mein deprecated): pages/_app.js mein super.componentDidCatch() (V9 ke baad se koi nahi) Container import next/app se; props.url page components par (v4 ke baad se deprecated); getStaticProps/getServerSideProps pahle se hi ise nasht kar diya); next/image par unsized (layout="fill" ka upyog karein); next/dynamic par modules/render vikalp (9.5 ko deprecated), API ab React.lazy ke karib); Head.rewind ( ke baad se nahi).
  • Moment.js local logon ko default dwara bundles ko sikurne ke liye bahar rakha gaya; ek spatial hisse ko spasht roop se load karein: import 'moment/locale/ja'; moment.locale('ja') excludeDefaultMomentLocales: false ke saath bahar nikalna (recommended nahi).
  • router.events: ab render karne ke dauraan pradan nahi kiya gaya hai - ise keval useEffect ke andar hi access karein (router.events.on('routeChangeStart', handler) ke saath sadasyata lein aur .off ke saath cleanup mein sadasyata lein). public router.events ka upyog karein, internal router.router.events nahi.
  • React 16 → 17: minimum React ab 17.0.2 hai. React 17 ke naye JSX transform ka matalab hai ki JSX ke liye koi import React from 'react' ki requirement nahi hai; Next.js auto ka upyog karta hai. yeh NOT banata hai React ek global (purane Next.js behavior galti se kiya) - files ke liye add-missing-react-import codemod ka upyog karein jo ise import kiye bina React ka upyog karte hain.

Upgrading — Version 12 (11 → 12)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Upgrading — Version 12 (11 → 12). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Upgrading — Version 12 (11 → 12) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: SWC replacing Babel, SWC replacing Terser for minification (opt-in), styled-jsx CSS parsing improved, `next/image` changed wrapping element, HMR connection now uses a WebSocket, Webpack 4 support removed. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: upgrade: npm i next@12 react@17 react-dom@17 eslint-config-next@12 (TS ke liye @types/react / @types/react-dom ka upgrade bhi karta hai). minimum Node.js ne 12.0.0 → 12.22.0 E (mool ESM ke saath sabse pahle Node); minimum React 17.0.2. midalaveyar user purv 12.2: midalaveyar upgrade guide dekhein.

  • SWC ne baabel ko replace kiya: Next.js 12 Rust aadharit SWC compiler ka upyog karta hai - 17 × tej vyaktigat files ki compilation, 5 × tez Fast Refresh taka. default morph (style-jsx, getStaticProps / getStaticPaths / `getServerSideProps) ke per-sheking ko Rust tak port kiya gaya. purn pichhre compat: ek custom Babel config Next.js ko SWC se bahar nikaal data hai aur baabul (V11) mein wapas gir jata hai. SWC Styled Components / Emotion / rile ke liye badal data hai agle port par rakha jaa raha tha.
  • SWC ne Terser ko chhota karne ke liye (opt-in): next.config mein swcMinify: true - 7 × tej miniphikeshan tak; 12.1 mein default ho gaya.
  • styled-jsx CSS parsing mein sudhar hua: nai Rust aadharit CSS paarsar errors jo pahle se chali gai hai - avaidh CSS ab dev aur next build (keval shailibaddh) mein phenkti hain.
  • next/image ne raiping element ko badal diya: <img> ko ab <div> ke bajaay <span> mein lapeta jata hai - CSS jaise .container span ab galat tarike se wrapper se mel khaa sakte hain, aur .container div chayankarta purane wrapper stop match ko lakshit karte hain; ek spasht wrapper <div className="wrapper"> pasand karte hain. className abhi bhi built-in <img> mein chala jata hai.
  • HMR kanekshan ab ek WebSocket E ka upyog karta hai (server bheje gaye iveints). proxy ko upgrade ko agreshit karna chahiye: nginx location /_next/webpack-hmr { proxy_pass...; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade; proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade"; }; Apache ws://localhost:3000/_next/webpack-hmr ko phir se likhna; custom server (eksapres) app.all('/_next/webpack-hmr',...) ka upyog karte hain. not: Next.js 16 mein HMR WebSocket path ka naam /_next/webpack-hmr se /_next/hmr tak rakha gaya.
  • Webpack4 support hata diya (webpack 5 v11 ke baad se default tha; v11 opt-out phlaig ab errors).
  • target vikalp built-in output tresing ke paksh mein ko deprecated: next build automatic roop se pratyek page + dependency ka pata lagata hai taaki production ki deployment ke liye required files ko set kiya jaa sake. target: 'serverless' upyogkartaon ko naye output config ka upyog karna chahiye.

Key concepts: upgrade: npm i next@13 react@latest react-dom@latest eslint-config-next@13. minimum Node.js ne 12.22.0 → 16.14.0 (12.x/14.x EOL); minimum React 17.0.2 → 18.2.0. supported browser badal gaye: Internet Explorer ne ko gira diya, aadhunik browsers ko lakshit kiya. swcMinify default flipped false → true.

Codemods: next-image-to-legacy-image (V12 behavior rakhne ke liye surakshit naam) tab optional roop se next-image-experimental (migrates legacy → nai image, apryukt props ko hata data hai, inline styles ko jodta hai; experimental, static upyog keval).
  • Link parivartan: <Link> ab ek <a> bachcha nahi leta hai - yeh hamesha <a> khud ko render karta hai aur aage ise badhava data hai ( mein experimental tha). new-link codemod ke saath migrate karein, ya purane behavior ko banaye rakhne ke liye legacyBehavior jorein. 12.2
  • target config hataya, Output File Tracing (output config) dwara superseded.
  • App Router optional hai: 13 mein upgrade karne ke liye NOT ko naye app directory ka upyog karne ki requirement hoti hai - aap pages rakh sakte hain aur phir bhi naya Image/Link/Script component aur next/font prapt kar sakte hain. Font Optimization: v13 purane font-CSS inlining ki jagah next/font (optimization font loading, performance + privacy) pesh karta hai. next/script ne pages aur app donon ko support dene ke liye update kiya.

  • React 19: Pages Router both React 18 aur React 19 ka support karta hai - React ko upgrade karna optional hai. useFormState ko useActionState dwara replace kiya gaya (React 19 mein define) hata diya jayega; useActionState direct pending parhne ko jodta hai). useFormStatus labh data, method, action keys (keval React 19); iske bina keval pending).
  • next/font: @next/font package ko bilt-in next/font (codemod built-in-next-font) ke paksh mein hata diya gaya.
  • Config naam (experimental → static): experimental.bundlePagesExternals → bundlePagesRouterDependencies: true; experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages: ['package-name'] → serverExternalPackages: ['package-name'].
  • Speed Insights: auto instrumentation ko Next.js 15 mein hata diya gaya - ise rakhne ke liye Vercel Speed Insights kvikastaart ka palan karein.
  • NextRequest bhoo-sthan hata diya gaya: geo aur ip gun NextRequest se hata diye gaye (value aapke hosting provider se aate hain). Codemod next-request-geo-ip ise automatic karta hai; Vercel par iske bajaay @vercel/functions se geolocation(request) / ipAddress(request) ka upyog karta hai.
  • Troubleshooting: installed React 19 upgrade ke baad fail ho jata hai → react/react-dom/types/react-is ko previous sanskaranon mein badal dein yadi koi sahakarmi di pee React 19 ko reject karta hai; restore/remove prakar overrides; --skip-react-upgrade ke saath phir prayas karein. ESLint 9 viphaltaon → previous eslint/eslint-config-next/4 sanskaranon aur lint config ko restore karein; --skip-eslint-upgrade ke saath phir prayas karein aur manual roop se Lint migration ko pura karein. @next/eslint-plugin-next
  • Migration checklist: React deps/types router ki React 19 aavashyaktaon ko pura karte hain; next/font se font; static config namon ka istemal kiya; NextRequest geo/ip upbhokta hosting provider source ka upyog karte hain; Speed Insights ko spasht roop se ekikrit kiya jata hai, yadi required ho to check paas karein.

Hissa 360 / 471 · Pages Router · Guides

Upgrading — Version 16 (15 → 16)

Pages RouterGuides

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Guides hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Upgrading — Version 16 (15 → 16). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Upgrading — Version 16 (15 → 16) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Requirements, Turbopack by default, React Compiler (stable), `middleware` → `proxy`, `next/image` breaking changes, Concurrent `dev` and `build`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: recommended: coding agent - npx next@canary upgrade --agent=latest (prepares migration guide + codemods, agent + verifies). manual: npx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest ya npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest (+ @types/react/@types/react-dom for TS). upgrade codemod naye turbopack config ko next.config update karta hai, migrates next lint → ESLint CLI, middleware → proxy ko hata data hai, unstable_ upasargon ko hata data hai aur experimental_ppr - lekin NOT har codemod ko chalata hai: yadi aap abhi bhi async params/searchParams/cookies()/headers()/draftMode() ka upyog karte hain, to yeh bhi npx @next/codemod@canary next-async-request-api. chala jata hai. upgrade karne se pahle, sanskaran-built-in docs par AGENTS.md ko point karein: npx @next/codemod@canary agents-md ( upgrade karne ke baad, ise node_modules/next/dist/docs/ mein bundle kiye gaye dastaavezon par verify karein; 16.2+ next dev par is block ko update rakhta hai; yadi koi sandarbh nahi hai to .next-docs/ ko hata dein).

  • Requirement: Node.js 20.9.0+ (LTS) — Node 18 ab supported nahi hai; TypeScript 5.1.0+; browser Chrome/Edge/Firefox 111+, Safari 16.4+.
  • default roop se Turbopack: next dev aur next build ke liye static aur default - --turbopack/--turbo jhande ki zaroorat nahi hai (unmein script se unhein chhor dein). yadi project mein ek custom webpack config hai, to next build fails ko galat config ko rokne ke liye: vikalp - kisi bhi tarah Turbopack ke saath build (next build --turbopack), webpack configure ko Turbopack vikalp ko migrate karein, ya Webpack ko --webpack (e.g) ke saath rakhein. "build": "next build --webpack". yadi koi build ek webpack configuration mein fail ho jata hai to aapne define nahi kiya tha, to ek plugin ek webpack vikalp jor raha hai. experimental.turbopack ab next.config mein top leveleey turbopack: {... } hai. client code mein Node ke mool nivaasiyon ke liye Resolve-alias Fallback: turbopack.resolveAlias: { fs: { browser: './empty.ts' } } (iske bajaay import export ko priority dein). Sass: Turbopack node_modules import ka support karta hai lekin NOT legacy ~ upasarg - @import 'bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css' ke bajaay @import '~bootstrap/...' (ya resolveAlias: { '~*': '*' }). Turbopack file system caching dev aur build (experimental.turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev / ...ForBuild) ke liye default roop se hai.
  • React Compiler (static): next.config mein reactCompiler: true (vyaavsaayik, abhi bhi NOT default se prerit) + npm install -D babel-plugin-react-compiler; auto-memoz components, kam phir prastutakarta, zero code parivartan; uchch compilation samay ki ummid (yeh Babel par nirbhar karta hai).
  • middleware → proxy: filename deprecated → proxy.ts/proxy.js; export middleware → proxy (export function proxy(request: Request) {}) naam diya. Important: proxy runtime nodejs hai aur ise configure nahi kiya jaa sakta hai; edge runtime proxy mein supported NOT hai - yadi aapko Edge runtime ki requirement hai, to middleware (pharath Edge directive ek mamuli release mein Promise kiya) ka upyog karte rahein. Config jhande ka naam badal diya gaya hai: skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize → skipProxyUrlNormalize (plus experimental.middlewarePrefetch → proxyPrefetch). middleware-to-proxy
  • next/image breaking badlav: (1) query strings (e.g) ke saath local chhaviyan. /assets/photo?v=1) ko ab images.localPatterns: [{ pathname: '/assets/**', search: '?v=1' }] ki requirement hoti hai. (2) images.minimumCacheTTL default 60s → 4 ghante (14400s) . (3) 16 default imageSizes se hata diya gaya (retina DPR 2 kisi bhi tarah 32px prapt karta hai); imageSizes: [16, 32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384] ke saath phir se ed kiya gaya. (4) images.qualities default ab keval [75] hai (pehle saari qualities thi) — jo quality prop array me nahi hai, wo sabse kareeb value par badal diya jata hai; direct /_next/image requests par unsupported q values par 400 return hota hai. (5) default roop se blocked local IP optimization - keval private network ke liye images.dangerouslyAllowLocalIP: true (VPC mein vibhajit-horizon DNS ke saath 400s prapt karne ki zaroorat hai); SSRF jokhim ko samajhate hain. (6) images.maximumRedirects default unlimited → 3 (set 0 se disabled, 5 kinaare ke mamlon ke liye). (7) next/legacy/image deprecated hai - next/image ka upyog karein. (8) images.domains deprecated - images.remotePatterns ([{ protocol: 'https', hostname: 'example.com' }]) ka upyog karein.
  • Concurrent dev aur build: next dev ab .next/dev (build se alag) ko output karta hai, isliye dev aur build concurrent roop se chal sakta hai; ek lockfile usi project par multiple next dev / next build udaharanon ko rokta hai. Turbopack tracing command: npx next internal trace.next-profiles/trace-turbopack.bin.
  • ESLint Flat Config: @next/eslint-plugin-next ab Flat Config (ESLint v10 drops legacy config) ke liye default hai; .eslintrc → phlait config migrate karein.
  • Scroll behavior: Next.js 16 ab SPA route transition ke dauraan global scroll-behavior: smooth ko override nahi karta hai (pahle yeh asthayi roop se auto set karta hai, navigate karta hai, phir restore kiya jata hai). purane behavior ko bahal karne ke liye, pages/_document.tsx mein <Html> element mein data-scroll-behavior="smooth" jorein.
  • Performance/build output: next dev/next start tezi se spasht tarminal output ke saath; next build ab print nahi size aur First Load JS metrics (RSC architecture mein satik; Turbopack/Webpack Client Component payload par asahamat) - Lighthouse ya Vercel analytics (Core Web Vitals) ke saath actual route performance ko maapein. next dev config load parivartan: config ab dev mein do bar load nahi kiya gaya hai, isliye process.argv ab config file mein 'dev' shamil nahi kiya gaya hai - dev-keval side iphekt ke liye process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ya phase tark ka upyog karein.
  • Build Adapters API (alpha): custom adapter build mein hook karte hain (nirbhreekaran platform / custom ekikaran config ko sanshodhit karte hain ya prakriya build output): experimental: { adapterPath: require.resolve('./my-adapter.js') }; adapterPath ne 16.2.0 mein static top level par padonnat kiya.
  • Modern Sass API: sass-loader ne V16 (aadhunik saas sintaiks) par takkar lagaaee.
  • Removals: AMP support puri tarah se hataya - amp config, next/amp (useAmp), export const config = { amp: true }. next lint command ne ko hata diya - seedhe Biome/ESLint ka upyog karein; next build ab linting chalata nahi hai; Codemod next-lint-to-eslint-cli; next.config mein eslint vikalp bhi hata diya gaya. Runtime Configuration ko hata diya gaya - serverRuntimeConfig/publicRuntimeConfig + next/config getConfig(): seedhe env vars ka upyog karein ( Server Components mein process.env ke madhyam se server maan; NEXT_PUBLIC_ upasarg ke madhyam se client values; next/server se await connection() ka prayog karne se pahle, process.env parhne se runtime mulyankan ko majbur kiya jaa sakta hai; Client Components tak leaking server values se bachne ke liye teint API ka istemal karta hai. devIndicators vikalp appIsrStatus, buildActivity, buildActivityPosition hata diya gaya (indiketar khud bani hui hai).
  • Troubleshooting: React 19 installed viphalta → v15 vasuli cheklista. ESLint: eslint-config-next@16 ko ESLint 9+ ki requirement hoti hai; @16.4.0+ ESLint 10 ka support karta hai; ESLint CLI ko migrate karne ke liye ek ESLint upgrade ko majbur nahi karta hai - yadi aapka config eslint-config-next@16 ka upyog nahi karta hai to aap ek sangat ESLint sanskaran rakh sakte hain.
  • Migration checklist: Node/TS/React aavashyaktaon ko pura kiya; dev/build script prabhavi bundler config (plugin, loader, alias, Sass import) ke saath sahamat hain; middleware/proxy parivartan runtime/routing ko preserve karte hain (edge middleware NOT andhaa roop se proxy ko naam diya gaya); image request ichchhit gunavatta ke saath naye restrictions/defaults ke tahat saphal hota hai; cache API call dastaavezit signatures ka palan karta hai; React Compiler/Cache component keval upgrade ko pura karne mein enable nahi hain; hata diya gaya APIs/config mein koi shesh upbhokta nahi hai; runtime-config pratisthapan server/client drishyta aur mulyankan samay ko preserve karte hain; voke0 mein koi scripts/CI nahi; check paas (ek green build akele runtime nishkarshon ko band nahi karta). next lint

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Upgrading — Version 9 (8 → 9) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Breaking changes, Deprecated. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Key concepts: upgrade: npm i next@9 (TS ke liye @types/react / @types/react-dom ko upgrade bhi karein). apne Custom App ki check karein: yadi aap ek do-nothing getInitialProps ke saath udaharan pages/_app.js ki pratilipi banate hain jo keval Component.getInitialProps ko aage badhata hai, to remove it — _app se getInitialProps ko hata kar nai features (Automatic Static Optimization) ko anlok karta hai.

  • Breaking badlav: @zeit/next-typescript ab required nahi hai - ise hata dein (aur .babelrc se @zeit/next-typescript/babel) aur fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin se next.config); TypeScript paribhasha ab next package mein ship karti hai - @types/next ki installation radd karein. prakar naam: NextContext → NextPageContext ('next' se), NextAppContext / DefaultAppIProps → AppContext / AppInitialProps ('next/app' se), NextDocumentContext / DefaultDocumentIProps → DocumentContext / DocumentInitialProps ('next/document' se). config ab ek reserved page export hai - ab aap ek page se config naam ka ek custom parivartaniy export nahi kar sakte hain (yeh page-star Next.js config jaise AMP/API routes ke liye prayog kiya jata hai); apne khud ke config export ka naam badal sakte hain. next/dynamic ab default dwara "loading" ko render nahi karta hai - dynamic component load karte samay kuchh bhi nahi dete hain jab tak ki aap loading: () => <p>Loading</p> paas na karein. withAmp HOC ne export const config = { amp: true } (ya amp: 'hybrid') ke paksh mein ko hata diya; codemod withamp-to-config ise automatic roop se automatic karta hai. next export ab index.html E ke roop mein export pages ko export nahi karta hai - pages/about.js ab out/about.html ( tha); trailingSlash: true ke saath palat dein. pages/api/ ab hai API Routes — vahan files server keval, koi client bundle hain. out/about/index.html
  • Deprecated: next/dynamic ek bar mein multiple module load ho raha hai (modules + render vikalp) - prati component ek dynamic() call dwara replace (React.lazy + Suspense ke karib).

Pages and Layouts

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Pages and Layouts. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Pages and Layouts — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Index routes, Layout pattern, Single shared layout (Custom App), Per-page layouts, TypeScript, Data fetching in layouts. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: A page ek React component hai jo pages/ mein .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx file se export kiya gaya hai; yeh route file naam (pages/about.js → /about) se aata hai.

  • Index route: files ko directory root (pages/index.js → /; pages/blog/index.js → /blog) ke liye index route ka naam diya gaya. Nested route: folder usi tarah nested (pages/blog/first-post.js → /blog/first-post; pages/dashboard/settings/username.js → /dashboard/settings/username). Dynamic route: pages/posts/[id].js → posts/1, posts/2, aadi. (D3.3) dekhein.
  • Layout pattern: sajha component (Navbar, Footer) ek Layout({ children }) component <Navbar /><main>{children}</main><Footer /> rendering mein lapeta jata hai.
  • singal sajha layout (Custom App): pages/_app.js: return <Layout><Component {...pageProps} /></Layout> mein raip - layout ko navigation par pun: upyog kiya jata hai, isliye iski sthiti preserve hai (e.g input maan).
  • Per-page layout: ek page par Page.getLayout = function getLayout(page) { return <Layout><NestedLayout>{page}</NestedLayout></Layout> } sanlagn karta hai, aur _app.js: const getLayout = Component.getLayout?? ((page) => page); return getLayout(<Component {...pageProps} />) mein. yeh prati page jatil nested layout ko enable banata hai. state navigation ke beech rahta hai kyonki React component tree ko banaye rakha jata hai (React reconciliation aprivartit elements ke liye state ko preserve karta hai).
  • TypeScript: ko _app.tsx aur type AppPropsWithLayout = AppProps & { Component: NextPageWithLayout } mein export type NextPageWithLayout<P = {}, IP = P> = NextPage<P, IP> & { getLayout?: (page: ReactElement) => ReactNode } define kiya gaya hai.
  • Data layout mein lane: ek layout ek page nahi hai, isliye yeh getStaticProps/getServerSideProps ka upyog nahi kar sakta hai - useEffect ya SWR (e.g) ke saath client-side prapt karein. useSWR('/api/navigation', fetcher).
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router mein pratham shreni ke layout.js files hain jo segment ke anusar automatic roop se nested karti hain aur Server Components ke roop mein data prapt kar sakti hain; Pages Router ko manual getLayout pattern (ya _app mein raiping) ki requirement hoti hai.

Dynamic Routes

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Dynamic Routes. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Dynamic Routes — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Convention, Catch-all Segments, Optional Catch-all Segments, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Jab route segments ke naam pehle se pata na hon, to Dynamic Segments use karo — ye request time par bhare jate hain, ya build time par getStaticPaths se pehle se render (prerender) kiye jate hain.

jsx
// pages/blog/[slug].js
import { useRouter } from 'next/router'

export default function Page() {
  const router = useRouter()
  return <p>Post: {router.query.slug}</p>
}
  • Convention: File ya folder ke naam ko square brackets me rakho: [segmentName] — jaise [id] ya [slug]. Page ke andar ye value useRouter se milti hai: const router = useRouter(); router.query.slug. Udaharan: pages/blog/[slug].js par /blog/a khule to router.query hoga { slug: 'a' }.
  • Catch-all Segments: Brackets ke andar teen dots (ellipsis) lagane se segment uske baad ke saare hisse pakad leta hai: [...segmentName]. pages/shop/[...slug].js in sab se match karta hai — /shop/clothes, /shop/clothes/tops, /shop/clothes/tops/t-shirts. Yahan value hamesha ek array hoti hai: /shop/a par { slug: ['a'] }, /shop/a/b par { slug: ['a', 'b'] }, /shop/a/b/c par { slug: ['a', 'b', 'c'] }.
jsx
// pages/shop/[...slug].js
import { useRouter } from 'next/router'

export default function Page() {
  const router = useRouter()
  // /shop/a/b par router.query.slug = ['a', 'b'] (ek array)
  return <p>Slug: {JSON.stringify(router.query.slug)}</p>
}
  • Optional Catch-all Segments: Double square brackets [[...segmentName]] lagane se catch-all optional ho jata hai. pages/shop/[[...slug]].js upar wale saare paths ke saath-saath khaali /shop se bhi match karta hai (wahan { slug: undefined } milega). Catch-all se yahi ek farq hai: bina parameter wala route bhi match ho jata hai.
  • App Router se farq: app/ folders me bhi yahi [slug] / [...slug] / [[...slug]] convention chalta hai, lekin wahan params router.query se nahi, params prop se milte hain (v15+ me ye ek Promise hota hai, isliye await karna padta hai).

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Prefetching, Linking to dynamic paths, Injecting the router, Imperative routing, Shallow Routing, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: router ek SPA ki tarah pages ke beech client-side route transition ko enable banata hai. next/link se Link transition karta hai: <Link href="/about">About Us</Link> nakshe / → pages/index.js, /about → pages/about.js, /blog/hello-world → pages/blog/[slug].js.

  • Prefetching: kisi bhi <Link /> viewport mein (initial roop se ya scroll ke madhyam se) default roop se prefetch kiya jata hai, iske data sahit, Static Generation ka upyog karne wale pages ke liye. server-render kiye gaye routes ke liye, data ko only laya jata hai jab link ko par click kiya jata hai.
  • Linking to dynamic path: interpolation — <Link href={/blog/${encodeURIComponent(post.slug)}}> (encodeURIComponent) path UTF-8 sangat rakhta hai) — ya ek URL objekt: href={{ pathname: '/blog/[slug]', query: { slug: post.slug } }} jahan pathname pages/ mein page ka naam hai aur query dynamic segment rakhta hai.
  • Injecting router: useRouter (recommended) ya withRouter (HOC) ke madhyam se router objekt ko next/router se access karta hai.
  • <Link> ke bina client-side navigation ke liye router.push('/about') (e.g) ek button onClick mein.
  • Shallow Routing: ne URL ko phir se chalne wale data ko phir jari kiye bina (getServerSideProps, getStaticProps, getInitialProps) ko badal diya - aapko bina kisi state ko khone ke router objekt ke madhyam se update pathname/query milta hai. { shallow: true } ke saath enable karein: router.push('/?counter=10', undefined, { shallow: true }) (pahle render karne ke baad navigation karein, e.g. useEffect mein); pratikriya karne ke liye router.query.counter dekhein. class-component samakaksh: componentDidUpdate mein query.counter ki check karein (anant loops ke khilaf guard). Caveats: uthle routing keval URL ke liye current page par parivartan ke liye kaam karta hai - ek alag page par dhakelnaa vartaman page ko utaar data hai aur kisi bhi tarah se data prapt karta hai, yahan tak ki shallow: true ke saath bhi. proxy (punarlekhan) ke saath, ek uthle route parivartan ko hamesha uthle ke roop mein mana jana chahiye kyonki proxy phir se likhna data prapt ke bina client-side ko verify nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router useRouter ( se) mein push/replace/refresh/back/forward hai lekin NO query/events/shallow — uthle routing vahan maujud nahi hai; iske bajaay searchParams ka upyog karein. next/navigation

Custom App

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Custom App. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Custom App — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Gotchas, `getInitialProps` with App, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js pages ko shuru karne ke liye App component ka upyog karta hai. ise pages/_app.js (TS: pages/_app.tsx, AppProps) banane ke dwara override karein: 'next/app'

jsx
export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
  return <Component {...pageProps} />
}

Component active page hai (advertisement par parivartan); pageProps data-fetching vidhiyon dwara preload kiya gaya objekt hai, anyatha {}. ise upyog karein: page parivartan ke beech ek sajha layout banaein, pages mein extra data injekt karein, global CSS jorein.

  • Dhyaan Do: yadi aap ek custom app jorte hain jabki dev server chal raha hai, to ise phir shuruaat karein (keval jab pages/_app.js pahle maujud nahi tha). App NOT support getStaticProps/getServerSideProps.
  • App ke saath getInitialProps: ne getStaticProps E ke bina pages ke liye disables Automatic Static Optimization ko jorne ke liye Automatic Static Optimization ko joda - docs NOT is pattern ki sifarish karte hain (ke bajaay App Router ka palan karein, jahan layout aasani se data prapt karte hain). yadi upyog kiya jata hai: MyApp.getInitialProps = async (context: AppContext) => { const ctx = await App.getInitialProps(context); return {...ctx, example: 'data' } } aur extra props (e.g). example) niymit props ke roop mein component mein flow hota hai. getInitialProps
  • Fark banam App Router: _app ko root layout (app/layout.js) dwara replace kiya jata hai; global CSS ko vahan import kiya jata hai, aur sajha layout layout.js files hain - koi getInitialProps samtuly maujud nahi hai (layouts Server Components ke roop mein data prapt karte hain).

Custom Document

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Custom Document. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Custom Document — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Caveats, Customizing `renderPage` (advanced, not recommended), Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ek custom Document ek page render karne ke liye istemal kiye gaye <html> aur <body> tag ko update karta hai. pages/_document.js banaein:

jsx
import { Html, Head, Main, NextScript } from 'next/document'
export default function Document() {
  return (
    <Html lang="en">
      <Head />
      <body>
        <Main />
        <NextScript />
      </body>
    </Html>
  )
}

<Html>, <Head />, <Main /> aur <NextScript /> theek se render karne ke liye page ke liye required hain. _document ko server par keval only pradan kiya jata hai - onClick jaise koi iveint handler nahi.

  • Caveats: _document mein <Head /> NOT next/head hai - iska upyog keval <head> code ke liye hi ALL pages (e.g fonts, meta); prati page <title> (menu/toolbar) aadi ke liye kiya jata hai. <Main /> ke bahar pages/components. React components mein next/head ko browser dwara shuru kiya gaya hai - yahan koi application lojik ya custom CSS (jaise style-jsx) nahi; sajha UI (menu/toolbar) layout mein hai. dastavez NOT support getStaticProps/getServerSideProps karta hai.
  • Customizing renderPage (advanced, recommended nahi): ko keval CSS-in-JS libraries ke liye SSR (bilt-in-style wale-jsx ke liye required nahi hai) ka support karne ki requirement hai. Document ko ek class mein override karein: ctx.renderPage ko capture karein, ise enhanceApp: (App) => App (pure React per ko lapeto) aur enhanceComponent: (Component) => Component (prati page lapeto) ke saath lapeto, phir Document.getInitialProps(ctx) ko call karein. nots: _document mein getInitialProps NOT hai jise client-side transition ke dauraan bulaya jata hai; iska ctx getInitialProps sandarbh objekt plus renderPage ke barabar hai. getInitialProps
  • Fark banam App Router: _document App Router mein maujud nahi hai - mool layout (app/layout.js) <html>/<body> seedhe render karta hai aur metadata next/head ko replace karta hai.

API Routes

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai API Routes. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: API Routes — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Gotchas, Parameters, HTTP methods, Request helpers (parsed from `req`), Custom config, Response helpers (Express-like). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: pages/api ke nakshe mein koi bhi file /api/* ko map karti hai aur ise API ke endpoint ke roop mein mana jata hai, na ki ek page - server-side keval bundles, isliye ve client-side bundle size ko nahi barhaate hain. udaharan pages/api/hello.ts: export default function handler(req: NextApiRequest, res: NextApiResponse<ResponseData>) { res.status(200).json({ message: 'Hello from Next.js!' }) }.

  • Dhyaan Do: API root keval default (NO CORS header) dwara same-origin hain - CORS request sahayakon ke saath handler ko customize karne ke liye lapeto. ve can static export (App Router Route Handlers) ke saath istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta. ve pageExtensions config se affected hain.
  • Parameters: req http.IncomingMessage hai, res http.ServerResponse (Node built-in, sahayakon ke saath vistarit) hai.
  • HTTP vidhi: req.method (if (req.method === 'POST') {... } else {... }) par shakha.
  • Request helpers (req se milakar): req.cookies (object, default {}), req.query (query string object, default {}), req.body (koi body nahi hone par content-type, ya null ke barabar).
  • Custom config (export const config): default api: { bodyParser: { sizeLimit: '1mb' } }, maxDuration: 5 (adhikatam function avdhi sekand mein). bodyParser: false ek stream ke roop mein body ka upbhog karne ke liye / raw-body ke saath - kachche webhook nikaayon (e.g) ko verify karne ki requirement hai. GitHub hastakshar validation). bodyParser.sizeLimit bytes-format strings ('500kb') ko accept karta hai. externalResolver: true server ko ek external sankalpak (express/connect) batata hai jo route ko sambhalta hai aur ansulajh-request warning data hai. responseLimit warning data hai jab ek pratikriya body 4MB (default) se adhik ho jata hai; false ya ek byte maan / '8mb' ko badalane ke liye set karein (keval agar server rahit nahi hai aur aap perf prabhav accept karte hain).
  • Rsponse helper (eksapres-jaise): res.status(code); res.json(body) (anusuchit kiya jana chahiye); res.send(body) (string/object/Buffer); res.redirect([status,] path) (default stetas 307 asthayi redirect); res.revalidate(urlPath) — getStaticProps pages ke liye on-demand reevaaideshana.
  • Error pattern: try/catch mein raip async kaam: saphalta par res.status(200).json({ result }), res.status(500).json({ error: 'failed to load data' }) asaphalta para. redirect udaharan: form handling ke baad res.redirect(307, '/'). TypeScript: ne 'next' se NextApiRequest/NextApiResponse import kiya aur pratikriya (NextApiResponse<ResponseData>) type kiya; dhyaan dein req.body ko any type kiya gaya hai - runtime par iske size ko valid karein.
  • Dynamic API root: saman file namkaran pages ke roop mein - pages/api/post/[pid].ts ne req.query.pid (/api/post/abc → Post: abc) ko padha. Catch-all pages/api/post/[...slug].js match /api/post/a, /api/post/a/b,... query: { slug: ['a'] } / { slug: ['a','b'] } ke sath. Optional catch-all pages/api/post/[[...slug]].js bhi bare /api/post (query {}) se match karta hai. Precedence: purvnirdharit routes > dynamic route > catch-all routes (pages/api/post/create.js) /api/post/create ke liye [pid].js par jitta hai; /api/post/abc ke liye [...slug].js par [pid].js jitta hai.
  • Streaming uttar: ne res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' }) + dohraayaa res.write(\ data: ${i}\n\) + res.end() — ke madhyam se support kiya, lekin Next.js 14+ ke liye docs App Router ko apnane aur iske bajaay Route Handlers ka upyog karne ki salah dete hain.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router Route Handlers (app/api/.../route.ts export GET/POST aadi web Request/Response) ya Server Components ke saath ka upyog karta hai; page API root eksapres style sahayakon ke saath Node req/res ka upyog karte hain. API roots App Router mein ek concept ke roop mein maujud nahi hain.

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Custom Errors. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Custom Errors — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Custom 404, Custom 500, Advanced: `pages/_error.js`, Reusing the built-in error page. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js static default 404 aur 500 pages (koi extra files ki zaroorat) - janboojhkar, kyonki server-rendering pratyek visit par ek error page server load, lagat aur vilambata jodta hai. default 404/500 page OS rang yojna (prefers-color-scheme) ka palan karte hain aur app-leval theme ko andekha karte hain; apni khud ki files unhein apne custom app ke andar render karti hain, isliye aapka global styles/theme lagu hota hai.

  • Custom 404: pages/404.js banata hai - static roop se build samay par generated: export default function Custom404() { return <h1>404 - Page Not Found</h1> }. build samay par data prapt karne ke liye iske andar getStaticProps ka upyog kar sakte hain.
  • Custom 500: pages/500.js banata hai - yeh bhi static build samay, ek hi pattern (<h1>500 - Server-side error occurred</h1>); getStaticProps bhi permission di hai.
  • Advanced: pages/_error.js - Error component handling 500 errors client ko override karta hai- aur server-side:
jsx
function Error({ statusCode }) {
  return <p>{statusCode ? `An error ${statusCode} occurred on server` : 'An error occurred on client'}</p>
}
Error.getInitialProps = ({ res, err }) => {
  const statusCode = res ? res.statusCode : err ? err.statusCode : 404
  return { statusCode }
}
export default Error

pages/_error.js ka upyog only production mein kiya jata hai - development mein aapko apne call stack ke saath error milti hai. not: Error NOT support getStaticProps/getServerSideProps karta hai. _error (jaise _app) ek reserved path ka naam hai - /_error 404 render karta hai jab seedhe routing ya custom server ke madhyam se pahunchaya jata hai.

  • built-in error page ka pun: upyog karte hue: import Error from 'next/error' aur <Error statusCode={errorCode} /> ko render karta hai (yeh bhi title prop ko accept karta hai) - e.g. se getServerSideProps, API prapt karte hain, errorCode: res.ok? false: res.status paas karte hain, aur set karte samay <Error> pradan karte hain. yadi aapke paas ek custom Error component hai, to usko iske bajaay import karein.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Sub-pages. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

React

  • do rupon ke prerendering (vi antar WHEN hai) HTML generated hota hai): Static Generation — HTML, jo build Time par generated hota hai, pratyek request par phir upyog kiya jata hai. Server-side Rendering — HTML each request par generated hua. aap prati page chunte hain, isliye ek app hybrid ho sakta hai: adhikansh pages ke liye SSG, SSR jahan zaroorat hai. performance ke liye Prefer Static Generation - static roop se generated pages ko ek CDN dwara cache kiya jaa sakta hai jismein koi extra config nahi hai. SSR ka upyog tab kiya jata hai jab yeh ekmatr vikalp (e.g prati-request data) hai. client-side data prapt karne ko bhi joda jaa sakta hai.
  • Sub-pages: server-side rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), Automatic Static Optimization, client-side rendering (CSR). D3.10-D3.13 mein vivarana.

Server-side Rendering (SSR)

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Server-side Rendering (SSR). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Server-side Rendering (SSR) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ko "SSR" ya "Dynamic Rendering" bhi kaha jata hai. page HTML each request par generated hota hai. ek async function getServerSideProps ko export karke opt in karein - server ise har request par call karta hai:

jsx
export default function Page({ data }) { /* Render data... */ }
// This gets called on every request
export async function getServerSideProps() {
  const res = await fetch(`https://.../data`)
  const data = await res.json()
  return { props: { data } } // Pass data to the page via props
}

jab page ko kisi external API se aksar update data ki requirement hoti hai to iska upyog karein. yeh getStaticProps ke saman size hai - antar keval when hai jo ise chalata hai (bahut request banam build samay). D3.17 mein full mechanical.

  • Fark banam App Router: App Router page default roop se dynamic hote hain jab ve dynamic karyon (cookies(), headers(), searchParams) ka upyog karte hain - koi getServerSideProps nahi hai; pratyek request par seedhe Server Component mein data laya jata hai.

Static Site Generation (SSG)

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Static Site Generation (SSG). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Static Site Generation (SSG) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: SSG without data, SSG with data — two scenarios, When to use SSG, When NOT to use SSG, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: With Static Generation, page HTML build time (jab aap next build chalate hain), pratyek request par pun: upyog kiya jata hai, aur ek CDN dwara kaishebal hota hai. pages ko static roop se with ya bina data generated kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • bina data ke SSG: default - kisi external data ke saath ek page sirph ek component (function About() { return <div>About</div> }) export karta hai; Next.js build samay par prati page ek HTML file generated karta hai.
  • data ke saath SSG — do paridrishy: (1) page content external data → getStaticProps (jise build samay par kaha jata hai) par nirbhar karta hai, props — e.g ke roop mein data prapt karta hai. (2) page paths external data → getStaticPaths (aamtaur par getStaticProps ke saath) par ek dynamic page (pages/posts/[id].js) par nirbhar karta hai: build samay par sabhi padon ko prapt karein, paths: posts.map((post) => ({ params: { id: post.id } })) aur fallback: false (any route 404) lautein; phir getStaticProps({ params }) single post (params.id) prapt karta hai aur { props: { post } } return karta hai. return { props: { posts } }
  • jab bhi aap kisi user ke request se pahle ek page render kar sakte hain to SSG: ka upyog karte hain - ek bar build karein, CDN ke madhyam se serve karein, jo prati-request rendering ki tulna mein bahut tez hai. ke liye achha hai: vipanan page, blog posts/portfolios, e-commerce product list, help/docs. testing: "Can I is page ko ek user ke request se pahle render karte hain?" - han → SSG.
  • HEN NOT ka upyog karne ke liye SSG: page content har request par parivartan / aksar update data dikhata hai. vikalp: SSG + client-side data lane (skip kuchh hisson ko render karna, client JS ke saath population) ya SSR (dhime, CDN-cacheable nahi, balki hamesha up-to-date).
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router static pidhi dynamic karyon ke bina pages ke liye default hai; generateStaticParams getStaticPaths ki jagah leta hai, aur data seedhe getStaticProps ke bajaay Server Component mein laya jata hai.

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Automatic Static Optimization. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Automatic Static Optimization — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works, Build output, Caveats, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js automatic roop se ek page static (prerenderable) set karta hai yadi ismein no blocked data requirements hai - page mein getServerSideProps aur getInitialProps E ki absence dwara set kiya gaya hai. yeh server-render aur static roop se generated pages donon ke saath hybrid app paida karta hai. labh: customize pages ko multiple CDN sthanon se turant server computation aur stream ki requirement nahi hai. static roop se generated page abhi bhi pratikriyaasheel hain - Next.js unhein full interactivity ke liye client-side ko hydrate karta hai.

  • Kaise yeh kaam karta hai: yadi getServerSideProps ya getInitialProps maujud hai, to page prati request (SSR) par nirbhar karta hai. anyatha yeh automatic roop se static HTML ke liye taiyar kiya gaya hai. router ke query objekt ko pahle se render karne ke dauraan khali (ab tak koi query jankari nahi); hydration Next.js ke baad query mein root param pradan karne ke liye ek update trigger hota hai. query ko hydration ke baad update kiya jata hai: page ek dynamic route hai; page mein URL mein query maan hain; phir se likhna next.config mein configure kiya gaya hai (ve param jor sakte hain). query puri tarah se update aur taiyar hone par janne ke liye router.isReady ka upyog karein.
  • Build production: next build static roop se customize pages (e.g) ke liye .html ka utsarjan karta hai. .next/server/pages/about.html; getServerSideProps ko jorne ke bajaay ise JS banata hai (.next/server/pages/about.js).
  • Caveats: (1) getInitialProps ke saath ek custom App is optimization ko getStaticProps ke bina pages mein band kar data hai - _app se do-nothing getInitialProps ko hata dein (D2.48 dekhein). (2) getInitialProps ke saath ek custom Document ko ctx.req ko SSR ko mapne se pahle define kiya gaya hai - ctx.req previous pages ke liye undefined hai. (3) jab tak router.isReady true - static roop se customize page keval client par asPath ko jante hain, tab tak rendering per mein router.asPath ka upyog na karein, isliye ise ek prop ke roop mein upyog karne se hydration dhundh errors ka karan ban sakta hai (ek surakshit pattern ke liye active-class-name udaharan dekhein). not: ek getStaticProps page par dynamic routes ke madhyam se jore gaye param hamesha query mein upalabdh hain.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router is arth mein koi automatic static optimization nahi hai - static banam dynamic Server Components mein prayukt data-fetching/dynamic karyon dwara tay kiya gaya hai; koi getInitialProps/isReady concept nahi hai.

Client-side Rendering (CSR)

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Client-side Rendering (CSR). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Client-side Rendering (CSR) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Two ways to implement CSR in Next.js, Trade-offs. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: mein CSR browser ek minimum HTML page + page ke JS ko download karta hai, phir JS ko DOM update karta hai aur page ko render karta hai. pahla load mamuli delay dikha sakta hai (page puri tarah se tab tak render nahi kiya jata jab tak ki sabhi JS ko download nahi kiya jata hai, to paarsd, executed kiya jata hai); baad mein navigation aamtaur par tez hote hain (keval required data prapt kiya jata hai, JS phir se render kiye gaye hisse bina ek full taza).

  • Next.js: (1) React ke useEffect() ko getStaticProps/getServerSideProps — e.g ke bajaay pages ke andar pages ko lagu karne ke liye do tarike. useState(null) + useEffect(() => { fetchData() }, []) ne Loading... ko phir data pradan kiya. (2) A data-fetching library jaise SWR ya TanStack query (recommended) - const { data, error, isLoading } = useSWR('https://api.example.com/data', fetcher) if (error) return <p>Failed to load.</p> / if (isLoading) return <p>Loading...</p> ke saath - behatar performance, caching, optimistic adyatana.
  • Trade-offs: CSR SEO ko chot pahuncha sakta hai (kuchh krolar JS ko executed nahi karte hain, keval empty/loading state ko dekhte hue) aur dhimi connections/devices par performance (sabhi JS ke liye vot) page dekhne se pahle. Next.js ek hybrid drishtikon ko badhava data hai — SSR + SSG + CSR prati page aavashyakataanusaara. App Router mein, Suspense ke saath UI load ho raha hai, jabki page render karta hai.

getStaticProps

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai getStaticProps. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: getStaticProps — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: When to use, When it runs, No request access, Security gotcha, Write server-side code directly, Where it can be used. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Agar tum kisi page se getStaticProps export karte ho, to Next.js use build time par prerender karta hai — jo props wo return karta hai, unhi se. getStaticProps HTML aur JSON dono files generate karta hai (dono CDN par cache hoti hain); next/link/next/router se client-side navigation par Next.js pehle se bani hui JSON fetch karke use props ki tarah use karta hai — getStaticProps client transitions par dobara call nahi hota (ISR ke saath ye JSON generate karne ke liye background me chalta hai; revalidation ke dauraan ek hi page ke liye kai requests aana expected hai).

jsx
export async function getStaticProps() {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/vercel/next.js')
  const repo = await res.json()
  return { props: { repo } }
}
export default function Page({ repo }) { return repo.stargazers_count }

TS typing: export const getStaticProps = (async (context) => {... }) satisfies GetStaticProps<{ repo: Repo }> aur InferGetStaticPropsType<typeof getStaticProps> page props ke liye.

  • Kab use karein: data kisi request se pehle, build time par available hai; data kisi headless CMS se aata hai; page ko prerender hona chahiye (SEO) aur bahut fast hona chahiye (HTML + JSON dono CDN-cacheable); data publicly cache ho sakta hai (user-specific nahi — kuch specific cases me Proxy rewrite ke through bypass ho sakta hai).
  • Kab chalta hai: hamesha server par, client par kabhi nahi (andar ka code client bundle se hata diya jata hai — next-code-elimination tool se verify kar sakte ho). Hamesha next build ke dauraan; fallback: true ke saath background me; fallback: 'blocking' ke saath initial render se pehle; revalidate ke saath background me; revalidate() (ISR) ke saath on-demand background me. Development (next dev) me ye har request par chalta hai.
  • No request access: getStaticProps ko incoming request (query params, HTTP headers) ki koi access nahi hoti, kyunki ye static HTML generate karta hai — agar request access chahiye, to getStaticProps ke saath ek Proxy bhi use karo.
  • Security gotcha: props page component ko pass hote hain aur initial HTML me client-side dikhai dete hain (hydration ke liye) — isliye sensitive jaankari kabhi props me mat daalo.
  • Server-side code seedhe likho: kyunki ye kabhi client-side nahi chalta, tum iske andar direct DB queries kar sakte ho. Apne khud ke API route ko getStaticProps se fetch mat karo (extra hop) — logic ko ek lib/ module me share karo, jo API route aur getStaticProps dono use karein.
  • Kahan use ho sakta hai: sirf ek page se export hota hai — non-page files, _app, _document ya _error se nahi (React ko render se pehle saara data chahiye hota hai). Ye ek standalone export hona chahiye — page component ki property nahi (Page.getStaticProps kaam nahi karega). Custom App ke saath, dhyaan do ki pageProps page ko pass ho, warna props khali rahenge.
  • Preview Mode: static generation ko temporarily bypass karke page ko request time par render karta hai (jaise CMS drafts ka preview) — Preview Mode / Draft Mode wala section dekho.
  • App Router se farak: wahan getStaticProps nahi hota — Server Components data ko seedhe build/request time par fetch karte hain; revalidate ki jagah revalidatePath/revalidateTag aur fetch-cache options hain.

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai getStaticPaths. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: getStaticPaths — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: When to use, When it runs, Rules, Generating paths on-demand, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ka upyog kar ek dynamic root page getStaticProps ko define karna chahiye ki kis path ko static roop se generated kiya jaaye. dynamic page se getStaticPaths export karein - Next.js sabhi nirdisht pathon ko render karta hai:

jsx
export async function getStaticPaths() {
  return {
    paths: [{ params: { name: 'next.js' } }], // see "paths" section
    fallback: true, // false or "blocking"
  }
}

TS: export const getStaticPaths = (async () => { ... }) satisfies GetStaticPaths.

  • Kab ka upyog karne ke liye: static roop se dynamic root pages ko render karta hai jahan data ek hedles CMS / database / file system se aata hai, public roop se cache kiya jaa sakta hai (user-vishisht nahi), aur SEO + gati (HTML + JSON CDN-cacheable) ke liye prerender kiya jana chahiye.
  • Kab yeh chalata hai: keval production mein build ke dauraan - kabhi runtime par (code client bundle se chheen liya), agle code unmulan ke saath verify karein. dev (next dev) mein yeh har request par chalta hai. getStaticProps pratyek wapsi path ke build par chalta hai; fallback: true ke saath background mein; fallback: 'blocking' ke saath initial rendering se pahle.
  • Rules: getStaticPaths MUST ka upyog getStaticProps ke saath kiya jata hai; yeh CANNOT ka upyog getServerSideProps ke saath kiya jata hai; keval Dynamic Route page se jo getStaticProps ka upyog karta hai; kabhi bhi gair-page files se nahi; ek standalone export hona chahiye, na ki ek page-component sanpatti.
  • Generating paths on-demand: build = dhime builds. paths: [] lautne se bachav - pages ke hundreds/thousands ke saath preview ya saaiton ke liye upyogi: e.g. if (process.env.SKIP_BUILD_STATIC_GENERATION) return { paths: [], fallback: 'blocking' } (faster builds, dhime initial page load); production mein fallback: false ke saath sabhi pathon ko purv mein render kiya gaya. full fallback semantics (false / true / 'blocking') API sandarbh (D4) mein hain.
  • Fark banam App Router: ne app/ mein generateStaticParams() (parameter objekts ki ek array) ko badal diya - koi fallback concept nahi; agyat params 404 default roop se ya dynamicParams ke aadhar par dynamic roop se render kiye jate hain.

getServerSideProps

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai getServerSideProps. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: getServerSideProps — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: When to use, Behavior, Error handling, Edge case — caching SSR, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: getServerSideProps har request ke time par data fetch karke page ko usi time render karta hai. Ise kisi page file se export karo:

jsx
export async function getServerSideProps() {
  const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/vercel/next.js')
  const repo = await res.json()
  return { props: { repo } }
}

TypeScript me iska type-safe tareeka: export const getServerSideProps = (async () => { ... }) satisfies GetServerSideProps<{ repo: Repo }> — aur page ke props ko InferGetServerSidePropsType<typeof getServerSideProps> se type karo.

  • Kab use karein: Jab page aise data par nirbhar ho jo sirf request time par hi pata chal sakta hai — jaise personalized user data, authorization header, ya user ki geolocation. Agar data ko request time ki zaroorat nahi hai, ya tum caching ke saath pehle se render kiya hua (prerendered) HTML chahte ho, to getStaticProps behtar rahega.
  • Behavior: Ye function sirf server par chalta hai aur sirf kisi page file se hi export ho sakta hai; ye JSON me badle ja sakne wale props return karta hai. Pehli visit par ye request time par data laakar initial HTML render karta hai. Uske baad next/link ya next/router se client-side navigation ho to Next.js server ko ek API request bhejta hai, jo getServerSideProps chalata hai. Dhyaan do: props initial HTML me client ko dikhai dete hain (hydration ke liye zaroori hai), isliye props me kabhi sensitive jaankari mat bhejo. Apne khud ke API Route ko call karne ki bhi zaroorat nahi — ye server par chalta hai, isliye CMS, database ya third-party API ko seedha yahin se call karo.
  • Error handling: getServerSideProps ke andar error throw ho to user ko pages/500.js wala page dikhta hai (development me uski jagah dev error overlay dikhta hai).
  • Edge case — SSR responses cache karna: Iske andar Cache-Control header set karke dynamic responses ko cache bhi kiya ja sakta hai, jaise res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, s-maxage=10, stale-while-revalidate=59') — response 10 second tak fresh rahega, aur uske baad 59 second tak purana (stale) response chalega jabki background me cache refresh hota rahega. Lekin pehle ye check kar lo ki getStaticProps + ISR tumhare case ke liye behtar to nahi hai.
  • App Router se farq: App Router me getServerSideProps hai hi nahi — wahan dynamic Server Components har request par seedha data fetch kar lete hain. Cache headers wahan Route Handlers ya route segment config me headers() / NextResponse se set hote hain.

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Client-side Fetching. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Client-side Fetching — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Performance caveat, With `useEffect`, With SWR (highly recommended), Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: client-side pheeling tab upyogi hoti hai jab page ko SEO anukraman ki requirement nahi hoti hai, ise aksar previous data ya content update ki requirement nahi hoti hai. server-side API ke viprit, yeh component Level par kaam karta hai: page star par, data ko runtime par laya jata hai aur page data parivartan ke roop mein update karta hai; component star par, data component mount par prapt hota hai aur component data parivartan ke roop mein update karta hai.

  • Performance warning: yeh app performance aur page load gati ko affected kar sakta hai - mount samay par hota hai aur (visit fetch) data cache nahi hota hai.
  • useEffect ke saath: load karne ke liye useState(null) + useState(true); useEffect(() => { fetch('/api/profile-data').then(res => res.json()).then(data => { setData(data); setLoading(false) }) }, []); Loading... / No profile data / profile (data.name, data.bio) pradan karta hai.
  • With SWR (atydhik recommended): Next.js team ki React hook library for client data pheevring - haindal caching, rivelideshan, phokas traiking, riphlaiting on antraala. const fetcher = (...args) => fetch(...args).then((res) => res.json()); const { data, error } = useSWR('/api/profile-data', fetcher); if (error) return <div>Failed to load</div>; if (!data) return <div>Loading...</div>; SWR auto catch aur revalidates stale data.
  • Fark banam App Router: saman SWR/useEffect pattern Client Components mein lagu hote hain; App Router default ke roop mein Server Components mein server-side lane ki peshakash bhi karta hai.

Error Handling

Pages RouterBuilding Your Application

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke Building Your Application hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Error Handling. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Error Handling — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Development errors, Server errors, Client errors — React Error Boundaries, Reporting errors, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: development, server-side aur client-side errors ko cover karta hai.

  • Development errors: dev mein ek runtime error page ko cover karne wale overlay modal ko dikhati hai - keval next dev ke saath dikhai data hai; production mein kabhi nahi; error ko theek karne ke liye auto-diskes ise hata data hai.
  • Server errors: Next.js default roop se ek static 500 page pradan karta hai ( ke madhyam se customize, D3.8 dekhein). 500 page user ko vishisht errors ko nahi dikhata hai. vishisht runtime errors jaise file-not-found ke liye 404 page ka upyog karein. pages/500.js
  • Client errors — React Error Boundaries: client JS errors ko sambhalne ka shaandaar tareeka, isliye baki application kaam karta rahta hai, ek custom fallback UI aur error loging ke sath. ek class component ErrorBoundary extends React.Component banaein: state { hasError: false }; static getDerivedStateFromError(error) { return { hasError: true } } (previous render karne se fallback UI) dikhata hai; componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) { console.log({ error, errorInfo }) } (apne khud ki error loging serve mein plag); render() fallback ko lauta data hai UI (e.g). "Oops, vahan ek error hai! + ek "Try again?" button jo this.setState({ hasError: false }) ke saath reset ho jata hai) jab hasError, anyatha this.props.children. phir pages/_app.js: <ErrorBoundary><Component {...pageProps} /></ErrorBoundary> mein Component prop ko lapeto.
  • Reporting errors: monitar client errors ki tarah ek serve ke saath Sentry, Bugsnag, ya Datadog (Next.js ek saath sentry udaharan hai).
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router mein pratham shreni ke error.js (Error Boundary prati segment) aur _app mein manual ErrorBoundary class ke bajaay global-error.js convention hain.

# D4 API sandarbh (Pages Router)
