Font (`next/font`)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Font (`next/font`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Font (`next/font`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage (all pages), Options table (google vs local), Apply in `<head>` (no wrapper), Specifying a subset, Multiple fonts, Local fonts. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next/font automatic roop se fonts (custom fonts sahit) ko customize karta hai, external network requests (private + performance) ko hata data hai, built-in automatic sva-hosting ke saath - optimal roop se web fonts ko no layout shift (CLS) ke saath load karta hai. Google Fonts ke liye, CSS + font files ko build samay par download kiya jata hai aur aapki static assets ke saath sva-host kiya jata hai; no requests ko Google ko browser dwara bheja jata hai.

  • Usage (saare pages): pages/_app.js me: import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'; const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'] }) ko <main className={inter.className}><Component {...pageProps} /></main> me jodo. Variable fonts ko koi weight nahi chahiye; non-variable fonts ko weight REQUIRED hai (jaise Roboto({ weight: '400', subsets: ['latin'] })). Multi-word font naam underscores use karte hain: Roboto_Mono. Multiple weights/styles arrays ke through: weight: ['400', '700'], style: ['normal', 'italic'].
  • Options table (Google vs local): src (sirf local, required — string ya Array<{path, weight?, style?}> loader call site ke relative); weight (string ya array; agar variable nahi to required — jaise Inter '100'–'900' ya 'variable' default; variable range '100 900'); style (default 'normal'; Google: normal/italic; local: koi bhi standard value); subsets (sirf Google — ['latin'] jaisi array; subsets me fonts ko ek preload <link> milta hai jab preload true ho; preload: true ke saath subsets omit karna warn karta hai); axes (sirf Google — extra variable-font axes, jaise ['slnt']; file size kam rakhne ke liye default roop se sirf weight shamil hai); display (auto/block/swap/fallback/optional, default 'swap'); preload (boolean, default true — ek call me saari files ise share karti hain); fallback (array, jaise ['system-ui', 'arial']); adjustFontFallback (Google: boolean, default true; local: 'Arial'/'Times New Roman'/false, default 'Arial' — ek auto fallback font ke saath CLS kam karta hai); variable (CSS variable naam, jaise '--my-font'); declarations (sirf local — @font-face descriptor key-values ki array, jaise { prop: 'ascent-override', value: '90%' }; font-family set karna Next.js ke generated naam ko replace karta hai — use exported constant ke barabar rakho).
  • <head> me apply karo (koi wrapper nahi): _app.js me <style jsx global>{`html { font-family: ${inter.style.fontFamily}; }`}</style>. Single page: us page me font function call karo aur wahan inter.className use karo.
  • Ek subset specify karo: Google Fonts auto-subset hote hain (chhoti files); define karo ki kaunse subsets preload karne hain (subsets: ['latin']).
  • Multiple fonts: (a) utility file har font export karti hai (app/fonts.ts: export const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'], display: 'swap' }), export const roboto_mono = Roboto_Mono({...})) — ek font sirf tab preload hota hai jab render hota hai; (b) CSS-variable approach (html { font-family: var(--font-inter) }, h1 { font-family: var(--font-roboto-mono) }). Multiple fonts conservatively use karo — har ek ek extra download hai.
  • Local fonts: import localFont from 'next/font/local'; localFont({ src: './my-font.woff2' }) — files pages ke andar colocate ho sakti hain. Multiple files: src: [{ path: './Roboto-Regular.woff2', weight: '400', style: 'normal' }, { path: './Roboto-Italic.woff2', weight: '400', style: 'italic' }, ...]. Variable fonts prefer karo.
  • Tailwind CSS: variable option + wrapper par inter.variable/roboto_mono.variable classes use karo (<main className={`${inter.variable} ${roboto_mono.variable} font-sans`}>); Tailwind v4: @theme inline { --font-sans: var(--font-inter); --font-mono: var(--font-roboto-mono); }; Tailwind v3: theme.extend.fontFamily: { sans: ['var(--font-inter)'], mono: ['var(--font-roboto-mono)'] } phir font-sans/font-mono utilities.
  • Styles apply karna — teen tareeke: className (<p className={inter.className}> — read-only CSS class); style (<p style={inter.style}> — read-only style object, style.fontFamily samet); CSS variable (variable: '--font-inter' + parent par className={inter.variable} + external CSS .text { font-family: var(--font-inter); font-weight: 200; font-style: italic; }).
  • Font definition file: har font function ko host karne ke liye ek example — agar ek hi font multiple jagah use hota hai, to use ek baar ek definition file (styles/fonts.ts jo inter, lora, sourceCodePro400/700, greatVibes export karti hai) me load karo aur wahan se import karo (optionally ek path alias ke through "@/fonts": ["./styles/fonts"]).
  • Preloading scope: ek font sirf un routes par preload hota hai jahan ye use hota hai — ek unique page → sirf us route par; custom app me → /pages ke under saare routes.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 @next/font joda gaya; v13.2.0 naam badalkar built-in next/font rakha gaya.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Form (`next/form`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Behavior, Props (string action), Caveats. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: <Form> ne HTML <form> element ko jama karne par client-side navigation ke saath vistarit kiya aur progressive enhaansmeint . un rupon ke liye sarvashreshth jo URL khoj param (anusandhan prapatr) ko update karte hain - boyalaraplet ko hata data hai:

jsx
import Form from 'next/form'
export default function Page() {
  return (
    <Form action="/search">
      {/* On submission, the input value will be appended to the URL, e.g. /search?query=abc */}
      <input name="query" />
      <button type="submit">Submit</button>
    </Form>
  )
}
  • BHavior: action prakar par nirbhar karta hai. jab action ek string hai, to <Form> GET ka upyog karke ek mool HTML form ki tarah behavior karta hai: form data ko URL mein khoj param ke roop mein kodit kiya jata hai aur rendering us URL ko navigate karta hai - lekin Next.js ek full page reload ke bajaay ek client-side navigation karta hai, sajha UI aur client-side state ko banaye rakhta hai. (A function action — Server Actions — ek App Router pattern hai; yeh page keval string formats ko sandarbhit karta hai.)
  • Props (string action): action (required, URL) ya relative path; "" update khoj param ke saath ek hi route par navigate karta hai); replace (boolean, default false — push karne ke bajaay vartaman history ki sthiti ki jagah); scroll (boolean, default true — naye route ke top par scroll karein; back/forward navigation ke liye scroll sthiti banaye rakhein).
  • Caveats: onSubmit rendering tark ko sambhal sakta hai, lekin event.preventDefault() ne <Form> behavior (koi navigation nahi) ko override kiya hai. method, encType, target NOT supported hain (ve <Form> behavior ko override karte hain); isi tarah formMethod/formEncType/formTarget mool browser behavior mein wapas aate hain - yadi aapko unki requirement ho to ek plain HTML <form> ka upyog karein. ek string action ke saath <input type="file"> keval file naam (browser behavior) render karta hai, na ki file object.

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Head (`next/head`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Head (`next/head`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Avoid duplicated tags, Use minimal nesting, Use `next/script` for scripts, No `html`/`body` tags, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ne page ke <head> mein elements ko samapt karne ke liye built-in component: import Head from 'next/head'; <Head><title>My page title</title></Head> kahin bhi page/component tree mein.

  • Avoid dupliket tag: tag par key prop ka upyog karta hai - prati key keval ek tag pradan kiya jata hai (e.g. do <meta property="og:title" key="title"> → keval dusra renders). <title> aur <base> ko Next.js dwara auto-dupliket kiya gaya hai, koi key required nahi hai. sir ki content component unmount par cleared hain - pratyek page ko puri tarah se define karna chahiye ki use head mein kya zaroorat hai, bina yeh samjhe ki any pages ko kya joda gaya hai.
  • Use minimum nested: title/meta/script aadi <Head> ke direct children hona chahiye, ya <React.Fragment> ya array ke adhikansh star par lapeta jana chahiye - anyatha tag client-side navigation par sahi dhang se nahi uthaaye jaenge.
  • next/head mein manual roop se <script> banane ke bajaay script ke liye Use next/script.
  • No html/body tag: aap <html> ya <body> par visheshataon ko set karne ke liye <Head> ka upyog nahi kar sakte - woh errors (next-head-count is missing); next/head keval <head> ke andar tag sambhalti hai.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router next/head ko metadata export (static/dynamic) ke saath badal data hai - next/head vahan maujud nahi hai.

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Props, Config (`images` in next.config.js), `getImageProps` function, Styling, Theme detection, Security note. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: automatic image optimization ke saath HTML <img> ko vistarit karta hai. mool: <Image src="/profile.png" width={500} height={500} alt="Picture of the author" /> (Pre-v13 docs: next/legacy/image ka upyog karein)

  • Props: src (required — internal path, absolute external URL (jise remotePatterns chahiye), ya static import); alt (required — screen readers/SEO ke liye image describe karta hai; purely decorative images ke liye empty string alt=""); width/height (intrinsic px size — aspect ratio infer karne aur layout shift se bachne ke liye space reserve karne me use hota hai; rendered size NAHI hai, wo CSS-controlled hai; dono required hain jab tak image statically imported na ho ya fill use na ho); fill (boolean — parent ke size tak expand hota hai; parent position: relative|fixed|absolute hona MUST hai; img default position: absolute leta hai; objectFit: contain|cover ke saath use karo); loader (custom function ({ src, width, quality }) => url — jaise `https://example.com/${src}?w=${width}&q=${quality || 75}`; ya saare instances ke liye next.config me loaderFile); sizes (breakpoint sizes, jaise "(max-width: 768px) 100vw, (max-width: 1200px) 50vw, 33vw" — fill ya responsive CSS ke saath use karo; iske bina browser 100vw assume karta hai aur oversized images download kar sakta hai; srcset generation ko affect karta hai — bina sizes + width → limited srcset (1x/2x); bina sizes + fill → srcset sirf deviceSizes se; sizes ke saath → full srcset jaise 640w/750w); quality (1–100, default 75; configured qualities allowlist ke bahar ho to nearest allowed value par coerce hota hai, dev warn karta hai); preload (boolean, default false — true <head> me ek <link> preload insert karta hai; known LCP/hero image ke liye use karo; tab use MAT karo jab multiple images LCP ho sakti hon, ya jab loading/fetchPriority use ho — zyadaatar cases me iske bajaye loading="eager" + fetchPriority="high" use karo); priority (**v16 me deprecated** — preload ya loading="eager" use karo); loading (lazy default — viewport ke paas aane tak defer; eager — turant load); placeholder (empty default; blur — blurred placeholder, blurDataURL chahiye; ya ek data:image/... data URL); style (underlying img ke liye CSS — custom width set karte ho to aspect ratio preserve karne ke liye height: 'auto' bhi set karo); onLoadingComplete (**v14 me deprecated** — onLoad use karo); onLoad (event ke saath callback, e.target = <img> — load hone aur placeholder hatne par fire hota hai); onError (load failure par fire hota hai); blurDataURL (data URL placeholder, jpg/png/webp/avif ke static imports ke liye auto-set hota hai jab tak animated na hon; dynamic/remote ke liye manual — png-pixel.com ya Plaiceholder se generate karo; chhota rakho, 10px ya kam recommended); unoptimized (Image Optimization API skip karo, as-is serve karo — chhote 1KB se kam, SVG, GIF ke liye; 12.3 se next.config me images.unoptimized se globally bhi set ho sakta hai); overrideSrc (generated srcset rakhte hue generated src attribute override karo — <img> se migrate karte waqt SEO image ranking/recrawl preserve karne ke liye useful); decoding (default async; sync/auto). Baaki props underlying <img> ko pass ho jate hain, srcSet ke alawa (uske liye Device Sizes use karo).
  • Config (images next.config.js me): localPatterns ([{ pathname: '/assets/images/**', search: '' }] — sirf matching local paths optimize ho sakte hain, baaki 400; search omit karne se saari query strings allow hoti hain — exact value pin karo jaise '?v=2'); remotePatterns ([new URL('https://example.com/account123/**')] ya object { protocol, hostname, port, pathname, search } — mismatch → 400; wildcards: * = ek segment/subdomain, ** = koi bhi sankhya lekin sirf end/beginning par; fields omit karne ka matlab ** — recommended nahi; search ek exact query string pin kar sakta hai; allowed pattern se redirects bina re-validate kiye follow hote hain — maximumRedirects se cap); loaderFile (loader: 'custom', loaderFile: './my/image/loader.js' — project root ke relative, default exported function jo URL return karta hai); path (default /_next/image — optimization API path change/prefix karo); deviceSizes (default [640, 750, 828, 1080, 1200, 1920, 2048, 3840]); imageSizes (default [32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384] — v16 me 16 hataya gaya; sirf sizes prop ke saath use hota hai, saare chhote deviceSizes se chhota); qualities (default [75] — allowlist ke bahar ki quality → nearest allowed, direct API par unused quality → 400); formats (default ['image/webp'] — browser ka Accept header format choose karta hai, pehla match jeet-ta hai, array order matter karta hai; AVIF: ['image/avif'] ya ['image/avif', 'image/webp'] — AVIF encode hone me lagbhag 50% slow, lagbhag 20% chhota; har format alag cache hota hai; saamne proxy/CDN ho to Accept header forward kare); minimumCacheTTL (default 14400 = v16 me 4 ghante; pehle 60s tha; expiry = max(minimumCacheTTL, upstream Cache-Control); koi invalidation mechanism nahi — src badlo/kam karo ya <distDir>/cache/images delete karo); disableStaticImages (static image imports disable karta hai, jaise import icon from './icon.png'); maximumRedirects (default 3; 0 disables); maximumDiskCacheSize (default: startup par available disk ka 50%; LRU eviction; 0 disk cache inactive karta hai; custom cacheHandler ke saath ignore hota hai); maximumResponseBody (default 50MB source-image size limit); dangerouslyAllowLocalIP (default false — sirf private networks ke liye; SSRF risk; split-horizon DNS wale VPC me 400s ke liye zaroori ho sakta hai); dangerouslyAllowSVG (default false — SVG kabhi optimize nahi hota: vector format ko optimization ki zaroorat nahi + embedded scripts se XSS risk; SVG ke liye unoptimized use karo, src .svg par khatm hone par auto; agar enable karo to contentDispositionType: 'attachment' + contentSecurityPolicy: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; sandbox;" bhi set karo); contentDispositionType (default attachment, v15 se — seedhe visit par download force karta hai); contentSecurityPolicy (images ke liye header). Deprecated: domains (v14 ke baad se deprecated — koi wildcard/protocol/path restrictions nahi; remotePatterns use karo).
  • getImageProps function: import { getImageProps } from 'next/image' — wo props return karta hai jo <img> par jayenge taaki tum unhe dusre component/style/canvas me pass kar sako: const { props } = getImageProps({ src, alt, width, height }). Ye useState se bachata hai (better perf) lekin placeholder ke saath use nahi ho sakta (placeholder kabhi hataya nahi jata). Use cases: art direction (har breakpoint ke liye alag getImageProps call ke saath <picture><source media="(min-width: 1000px)" srcSet={desktop} />...<img {...rest} /></picture>) aur background CSS (srcSet ko image-set() CSS me badlo).
  • Styling: className (CSS Modules/global stylesheet) ya style use karo — styled-jsx NAHI (global tak seemit). fill ke saath, parent positioned hona chahiye. Static import ke saath responsive: sizes="100vw" + style={{ width: '100%', height: 'auto' }} (width/height import se auto-set). Remote URL: width/height manually do (aspect ratio) + optional blurDataURL. Background image: fill + sizes="100vw" + style={{ objectFit: 'cover' }} + placeholder="blur" + quality={100}.
  • Theme detection: do <Image> wrap karo aur CSS @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) se toggle karo (.imgDark { display: none } / dark: .imgLight { display: none }, .imgDark { display: unset }). loading="lazy" (default) rakho, taaki sirf sahi image load ho — preload/loading="eager" use MAT karo (dono load honge); iske bajaye fetchPriority="high" use karo.
  • Security Note: default loader src image fetch karte waqt headers forward NAHI karta — agar source ko auth chahiye, to unoptimized use karo.
  • Known browser bugs: native lazy loading Safari 15.4 se pehle eager ho jata hai; blur placeholder Safari 12 se pehle khaali ho jata hai; width/height: auto styles Safari 15 se pehle layout shift kar sakti hain (koi aspect-ratio preservation nahi); Safari 15-16.3 loading ke dauraan grey border dikhata hai (16.4 me fixed; workaround @supports (font: -apple-system-body) and (-webkit-appearance: none) { img[loading="lazy"] { clip-path: inset(0.6px) } } ya loading="eager"); Firefox 67+ load hote waqt white background dikhata hai (AVIF formats enable karo ya placeholder use karo).
  • Version history (selected): v10.0.0 next/image introduce hua; v13.0.0 naam badla next/legacy/image, next/future/image → next/image, layout/objectFit/objectPosition/lazyBoundary/lazyRoot hataye gaye, alt required, <span> wrapper hataya gaya; v14.0.0 onLoadingComplete + domains deprecated; v14.1.0 getImageProps static; v14.2.0 overrideSrc; v14.2.14 remotePatterns.search; v14.2.15 localPatterns; v15.0.0 contentDispositionType attachment; v15.3.0 decoding; v16.0.0 qualities default → [75], preload prop joda gaya, priority deprecated, dangerouslyAllowLocalIP + maximumRedirects jode gaye; v16.1.2 maximumResponseBody; v16.1.7 maximumDiskCacheSize.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Legacy API, ab recommended nahi hai lekin abhi bhi pichhre compatibility ke liye support kiya hai. v16.0.0 mein Deprecated aur bhavishy ke sanskaran mein hata diya jayega - next/image. v13 mein purane next/image ka naam next/legacy/image ko diya gaya tha jab component phir se likha gaya tha.

  • Comparison banam naye next/image: <span> wrapper ko <img> (native computed pahlu anupat) ke aaspas hata data hai; kainonikal style prop ko jodta hai aur layout / objectFit / objectPosition props (style / className ka upyog karta hai); mool lazy loading ke paksh mein IntersectionObserver karyanvayan ko hata data hai ( lazyBoundary / lazyRoot ko hata data hai - koi mool nahi); loader prop ke paksh mein loader config ko hata data hai; alt ki requirement ke liye optional se badal gaya; onLoadingComplete ko ab <img> element ke liye ek sandarbh prapt hai.
  • Required props: src (static import, path string, ya nirpeksh external URL - external URL ko remotePatterns ki requirement hoti hai; enimeted ya agyat formats (No JPEG/PNG/WebP/AVIF/GIF/TIFF) ko SVG ya dangerouslyAllowSVG tak blocked kiya gaya); width/height (static import ya layout="fill" ke alava prapt); layout="intrinsic"/"fixed" ke saath ve rendered size hain; "responsive"/"fill" ke saath ve keval original size ko affected kar rahe hain. unoptimized
  • layout (legacy-only): intrinsic (default - paimane par image size tak container ko phit karne ke liye; srcset 1x, 2x; wrapper + shepar hai), fixed ( vastav mein width/height, koi uttaradaayeetaa nahi), responsive (container chaudai phit karne ke liye skel); srcset 640w…3840w; sizes 100vw; parent ki zaroorat display: block), fill (X aur Y mein kheencho container ko bharne ke liye; parent ko position: relative hona chahiye; aamtaur par objectFit ke saath milakar) hona chahiye.
  • Optional props: loader (custom ({ src, width, quality }) => url); overrides config loader; sizes (breakpoint chaudai - responsive/fill ke liye mamle, intrinsic/fixed ke liye andekha; yeh bhi srcset ko chhantnee karta hai - bina 33vw browser ek image ko download kar sakta hai 9 × chaudai ke saath file size ke paimane se bada; quality (1-100, default 75); priority (uchch priority + preload; lazy loading ko disabled karta hai; LCP image par upyog karein, keval guna se upar); placeholder (empty default / blur - blurDataURL svath population static jpg/png/webp/avif import ke liye; dynamic images ko manual blurDataURL ki requirement hai.
  • Advanced props: style (layout mods ki apni styles ki priority hoti hai; yadi style chaudai, to height: auto bhi set karein); objectFit (- — CSS objekt-phit ke saath); objectPosition (objectPosition — CSS objekt-pojeeshan ke saath); onLoadingComplete () (lazy default / eager); blurDataURL (base64, ≤10px recommended); lazyBoundary (CSS margin, default "200px" - margin) lazyRoot (React) ek scroll karne yogy mool element, default null = dastavez viewport; ek DOM element ya ek forwardRef component ko point karna chahiye); unoptimized (ke roop mein rakhta hai); 12.3 ke baad se images.unoptimized ke madhyam se bhi vaishvika. any props <img> ko chhorakar srcSet (Device Sizes ka upyog karein), ref (onLoadingComplete ka upyog karein), decoding (always "async") ko chhorakar <img> ke madhyam se gujarate hain. IntersectionObserver layout="fill" layout="fill" { naturalWidth, naturalHeight } loading
  • Config: remotePatterns (kuchh nai image); domains (V14) ke baad se deprecated; loader config (images: { loader: 'imgix'|'cloudinary'|'akamai'|'custom', path: 'https://example.com/myaccount/' } — built-in loader: default, Vercel, Imgix, Cloudinary, Akamai, custom loader prop ke madhyam se); path (default /_next/image); deviceSizes (default [640, 750, 828, 1080, 1200, 1920, 2048, 3840]); imageSizes (default [32, 48, 64, 96, 128, 256, 384]); formats (default ['image/webp']) not: images ko build samay par output: 'export' ke saath customize nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - keval on-demand; static export ke saath legacy image ko gair-default loader ki requirement hoti hai. minimumCacheTTL 14400 disableStaticImages dangerouslyAllowSVG contentDispositionType: 'attachment' contentDispositionType attachment AVIF
  • Caching behavior (default loader): images ko request par customize kiya gaya hai, jise <distDir>/cache/images mein sangrahit kiya gaya hai; ek request par ek cached-but-expired file se match karta hai, stale image ko turant served jata hai, phir background mein phir se optimize kiya jata hai aur ek nai samapti ke saath bachaya jata hai. x-nextjs-cache header (x-vercel-cache) ke madhyam se cache stetas: MISS (cache, pahli visit mein nahi), STALE (background mein vistarit, update), HIT (cache, fresh mein). samapti = adhikatam (minimumCacheTTL, upstream Cache-Control adhikatam aayu; s-maxage ko max-age par priority di gai; max-age ko CDNs/browsers ke madhyam se passed kiya gaya). koi amanyata nahi - TTL ko kam rakhein ya src ko badal dein / cache dir ko hata dein. Vercel
  • Animated images: default loader auto bypass enimeted images (GIF/APNG/WebP, best-phort ditekshan) ke liye optimization ko shamil karta hai aur is tarah kaam karta hai; ise majbur karne ke liye unoptimized ka upyog karein.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 next/image → next/legacy/image; v16.0.0 deprecated, hatane ki yojna banai.

Link (`next/link`)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Link (`next/link`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Link (`next/link`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Props, Examples, Gotchas, Sticky headers, Prefetching links in Proxy, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: <Link> HTML <a> element ka vistar karta hai jismein prefetching + client side nevigeshan ke saath routes ke beech hota hai. yeh Next.js mein navigate karne ka prathmik tareeka hai. chunki v13.0.0 ko ab ek children ki requirement nahi hai <a> tag (ek codemod unhein hata data hai).

  • Props:
  • href (required, string ya objekt): path/URL to navigate karne ke liye. objekt form: { pathname: '/about', query: { name: 'test' } } → /about?name=test; dynamic route: { pathname: '/blog/[slug]', query: { slug: 'my-post' } } → /blog/my-post. kisi bhi Node.js URL module sanpatti ka upyog kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • replace (default false): ek nai entry ko dhakka dene ke bajaay vartaman history ki sthiti ko replace karta hai.
  • scroll (default true): default scroll behavior maintains scroll sthiti jaise browser back/forward ke liye karte hain; yadi naya page viewport mein dikhai nahi data hai, to Next.js pahle page element ke top par scroll karta hai. scroll={false} us par chhor data hai. jab scroll karte hain, to Next.js top level ke elements ka inspect karta hai, gair-skrolebal / gair-reindred / stikee-or-phiksd / gair-visible elements ko chhor data hai jab tak ki yeh ek drishyaman skrolebal element nahi pata hai.
  • prefetch (default true): jab <Link> viewport mein access karta hai to root + data ko prefetch karta hai; only production mein enable hai. false abhi bhi hovar par prefetches - hovar lane ko bhi hatane ke liye, ek plain <a> tag (ya App Router) ka upyog karein, jo hovar prefetch ko inactive kar sakta hai). v15.4.0 ne default behavior ke liye ek alias ke roop mein auto ko joda.
  • shallow (default false): vartaman page Non phir se chalne wale getStaticProps, getServerSideProps, ya getInitialProps E ke path ko update karein.
  • locale (string Tube1): active local automatic roop se taiyar kiya gaya hai; ek alag spatial ya false paas karein ( phir href ko local roop se hi shamil hona chahiye). false
  • as: browser bar mein dikhaye gaye URL ke liye optional decoration (purv 9.5.3 dynamic-root tantr); bare paimane par v10 auto-risolvs dynamic href) ke baad se superseded. Still ko Proxy rewrites (neeche dekhein) ke madhyam se prefetching ke liye required hai.
  • onNavigate (v15.3.0): handler jise during client-side nevigeshan kaha jata hai; navigation ko radd karne ke liye preventDefault() ke saath ek program prapt karta hai. banam onClick: onClick sabhi klikon ke liye aag (incl). Ctrl/Cmd+click, external URL, download link; onNavigate keval ek hi mool client-side navigation ke liye - yeh sanshodhak key click, external URL, ya download link ke liye NOT fire karta hai.
  • transitionTypes (v16.2.0): prop joda gaya (is page par koi vivaran nahi).
  • kisi bhi <a> visheshataon (className, target="_blank", aadi) ko built-in <a> se guzarna padta hai.
  • Examples: dynamic root template literals (<Link href={/blog/${post.slug}}>{post.title}</Link>) ke madhyam se listed hash (href="/dashboard#settings"); URL-object form (above); pratisthapan (<Link href="/about" replace>); scroll-too-top (<Link href="/#hashid" scroll={false}>) ko disabled karein. id
  • Gotchas:
  • Sticky headers: Next.js scroll target ko khojne ke dauraan sticky/fixed elements ko chhor data hai, isliye content ek sticky header ke pichhe chhipi hui ho sakti hai. CSS html { scroll-padding-top: 64px; } (ya target elements par scroll-margin-top) ke saath theek karein - jab bhi Next.js mool scrollIntoView() ka upyog karta hai, jismein hash navigation shamil hai.
  • Proxy: mein Prefetching link jab Proxy phir se likhte hain (e.g). /dashboard → /auth/dashboard ya /public/dashboard et cookie dwara), <Link> ko pradarshit URL aur prefetch URL donon ko bataya jana chahiye, anyatha yeh proxy ke madhyam se anavashyak roop se prapt hota hai: <Link as="/dashboard" href={path}> jahan path actual route (e.g) hai. isAuthed? '/auth/dashboard': '/public/dashboard'. dynamic routes ke saath: <Link href={{ pathname: '/dashboard/authed/[user]', query: { user: username } }} as="/dashboard/[user]">.
  • Version history: v16.2.0 transitionTypes; v15.4.0 prefetch="auto" alias: v15.3.0 onNavigate; v13.0.0 koi bachcha <a> ki requirement nahi hai; v10.0.0 dynamic href auto-punarnirmit, koi as ki requirement nahi hai; v8.0.0 ne preephechmeint mein sudhar kiya; v1.0.0 next/link ki shuruaat hui.
  • Fark banam App Router: saman component/import, ek hi kor props (href, replace, scroll, prefetch, onNavigate); Pages Router ekstraaz shallow aur locale (local page mein App-Router-migration/i18n-specific hai), aur as pejon mein prabhavi roop se legacy hai lekin abhi bhi Proxy prefetching ke liye upyog kiya jata hai. App Router mein, behaviour/values ko prefetch karna thoda bhinn hota hai (e.g). prefetch={false} puri tarah se disabled, koi hover prefetch).

Script (`next/script`)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Script (`next/script`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Script (`next/script`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Props, `strategy` — four loading strategies, `onLoad`, `onReady`, `onError`, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: third-party lipiyon ka optimization karta hai. <Script src="https://example.com/script.js" /> Features/usage Optimizing Scripts guide par hain; yeh page props sandarbh hai.

  • Props: src (Inline script tak required); nirpeksh external URL ya internal path); strategy; onLoad; onReady; onError.
  • strategy - chaar loading rannitiyon:
  • beforeInteractive: kisi bhi Next.js code se pahle aur kisi bhi page hydration se pahle load karein; server se initial HTML mein injekt kiya gaya, kisi bhi Next.js module se pahle download kiya gaya, jise ordar mein rakha gaya tha. execution not block hydration karta hai. Must ko Document component (pages/_document.js) ke andar rakha jaa sakta hai; site-void (kisi bhi page load server-side) ko load karta hai. hamesha <head> ke andar injekt kiya jata hai, bhale hi component mein rakha gaya ho. mahatvapurn lipiyon ke liye ONLY ka upyog ASAP: bot ditektron, cookie sahamati prabandhakon ki zaroorat hai.
  • afterInteractive ( default): injekted client-side, jaldi load hota hai lekin kuchh hydration ke baad. kisi bhi page/layout mein rakha jaa sakta hai, us page (ya group) ke khulne par hi load ho jata hai. script ke liye upyog ki zaroorat hai ASAP lekin pahle party code se pahle nahi: tag mainejar, analytics.
  • lazyOnload: browser inactive samay ke dauraan client-side injekt kiya gaya, kyonki sabhi sansadhanon ko prapt kiya gaya hai. background/low-priority script ke liye: chait support plagins, soshal media vijeta.
  • worker (experimental, static nahi, does App Router E ke saath kaam nahi karte): main dhage ko mukt karne ke liye script ko web varkar se utara; sabhi third-party lipiyon ka support karne ki guarantee nahi hai. next.config.js mein experimental: { nextScriptWorkers: true } ki requirement hai; only pages/ directory mein prayog kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • onLoad: script khatm load ho raha hai (afterInteractive / lazyOnload ke saath) ke baad code chalate hain. kya NOT Server Components (Client Components) ke saath kaam karta hai aur iska upyog beforeInteractive ke saath nahi kiya jaa sakta hai - iske bajaay onReady ka upyog karein. udaharan: lodash CDN + onLoad={() => console.log(_.sample([1, 2, 3, 4]))}.
  • onReady: script ke load iveint ke baad chalta hai jab yeh pahli bar pratyek baad ke component phir-mount (e.g) ke baad AND ko load karta hai. keval Client Components. udaharan: pratyek mount (new google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, { center: { lat: -34.397, lng: 150.644 }, zoom: 8 })) par ek Google Maps ko phir se installed karein.
  • onError: script load viphaltaon (onError={(e) => console.error('Script failed to load', e)}) ko pakadta hai. keval Client Components; beforeInteractive ke saath istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.
  • Version history: v11.0.0 next/script ne pesh kiya; v12.2.2 beforeInteractive ne _document mein permission di; v12.2.4 onReady joda; v13.0.0 beforeInteractive/afterInteractive ko app support karne ke liye sanshodhit kiya gaya.
  • Fark banam App Router: saman component aur ranniti; App Router beforeInteractive script mein root layout (No _document) mein jana jata hai, aur worker ranniti sabhi par App Router mein kaam nahi karti hai. onLoad/onReady/onError donon routers mein client-Component-keval hain.

instrumentation.js

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai instrumentation.js. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: instrumentation.js — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Exports, Specifying the runtime, Version history, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: instrumentation.js|ts avlokan tool ko ekikrit karta hai - track performance aur behavior, production mein muddon ko debug karta hai. ise aavedan ke root mein rakhein, ya src/ ke andar yadi ek src folder ka upyog kiya jata hai.

  • Exports:
  • register() (optional) async ho sakta hai: Once kaha jata hai jab ek naya Next.js server udaharan shuru kiya jata hai, aur server ke requests ko sambhalne ke liye taiyar hone se pahle must pura kiya jata hai. vishisht upyog: import { registerOTel } from '@vercel/otel'; export function register() { registerOTel('next-app') }.
  • onRequestError(err, request, context) (optional, v15.0.0): track server errors ko ek custom avlokan provider ke liye. iske andar kisi bhi Async karya ko chhor dein; yeh tab aag lag jati hai jab Next.js server error ko capture karta hai. error udaharan mool phenka error nahi ho sakta hai (React ise Server Components rendering ke dauraan sansadhit kar sakta hai) - actual error prakar ki identity karne ke liye apni digest sanpatti ka upyog karein. hastakshar: onRequestError(error: unknown, request: { path, method, headers }, context: { routerKind: 'Pages Router' | 'App Router', routePath, routeType: 'render' | 'route' | 'action' | 'proxy', renderSource: 'react-server-components' | 'react-server-components-payload' | 'server-rendering', revalidateReason: 'on-demand' | 'stale' | undefined, renderType: 'dynamic' | 'dynamic-resume' }): void | Promise<void>. TS ke liye, ise 'next' se Instrumentation.onRequestError ke roop mein type karein. error unknown hai - message/digest parhne se pahle sankirn; request keval padha jata hai.
  • runtime ko nirdisht karein: Node.js aur Edge runtime donon mein kaam karta hai; braanch mein process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME ka upyog karein: if (process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge') return require('./register.edge'); else return require('./register.node') (onRequestError ke liye saim pattern).
  • Version history: v13.2.0 experimental; v14.0.4 Turbopack support; v15.0.0 onRequestError ne shuruaat ki, instrumentation sthira.
  • Fark banam App Router: file aur donon export router ke beech sajha kiye jate hain - context.routerKind runtime par 'App Router' se 'Pages Router' ko alag karta hai. Pages Router mein, routeType aam taur par 'render' (page/API-route rendering) ya 'proxy' hai.

Proxy (`proxy.js|ts`)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Proxy (`proxy.js|ts`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Proxy (`proxy.js|ts`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Location, Exports, Matcher, Params, NextResponse, Execution order. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: The middleware file convention ko proxy (v16.0.0) ke naam se define aur naam diya gaya hai. proxy.js|ts server before par code chalata hai ek request pura ho gaya hai; aane wale request ke aadhar par aap phir se likhna, redirect kar sakte hain, request/response header ko sanshodhit kar sakte hain, ya seedhe jawab de sakte hain. routes se pahle executed kiya jata hai - auth, loging, redirect ke liye. iska matalab yeh hai ki preshak code se alag-alag bulaya jaaye aur customize mamlon mein CDN ko deploy kiya gaya; do sajha module ya Globals par bharosa nahi karta hai. Proxy se app mein jankari paas karne ke liye header, cookies, rewriting, redirects, ya URL ka upyog karein.

  • Location: project root, ya src/ ke andar yadi lagu ho, to pages ya app ke saman star para. yadi pageExtensions ko customize kiya gaya hai (e.g). .page.ts, iska naam proxy.page.ts hai.
  • Exports: ek single karya, ya to ek default export ya named proxy (ek file se multiple proxy supported nahi hain) ke roop mein. optional export const config = { matcher:... }
  • Matcher: ek yojak ke bina , Proxy every request par chalta hai, jismein _next/static, _next/image aur public/ assets shamil hain - unhein bahar nikalne ke liye nakaratmak-match pattern ka upyog karein, ya auth logic/redirects anjaane mein CSS/JS/images. singal string ('/about'), array (['/about/:path*', '/dashboard/:path*']), ya regex ('/((?!api|_next/static|_next/image|.*\\.png$).*)') ko block kar sakte hain. maichar objekts source (paith pattern) ka support karte hain, locale: false (local routing ki ignore), has ( vartaman mein headers/query/cookies par shart), missing (anupasthit elements par shart). source pattern: / ke saath shuru hona chahiye; naam par params /about/:path (single segment); sanshodhak * (zero ya adhik), ? (zero ya ek), + (ek ya adhik); parens /about/(.*) mein regeks; path shuru karne ke liye langar (/about match /about aur /about/team, /blog/about nahi). maichar maan static hona chahiye (static roop se build samay par vishleshan); dynamic values ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai. baikavard kampait: /public ko hamesha /public/index ke roop mein mana jata hai.
  • Params: proxy(request, event) — request NextRequest hai; event waitUntil(promise) ke saath NextFetchEvent hai jo background ke kaam (logging/analytics) ke liye invoiseshan ko jivit rakhne ke liye hai. NextProxy prakar (next/server se) donon parameter prakaron ko affected karta hai.
  • NextResponse: redirect, rewrite (ek diye gaye URL)), set request header (API roots ke liye, getServerSideProps, phir se likhne wale gantavyon ke liye), set pratikriya cookies, set pratikriya haidara. ek pratikriya ka production karne ke liye: ek route (page ya Edge API root) ko phir se likhna jo ek pratikriya generated karta hai, ya seedhe NextResponse/Response ko return karta hai. v13.1.0
  • Execution order: 1. headers (next.config.js) → 2. redirects (next.config.js) → 3. Proxy → 4. beforeFiles rewrites → 5. file system routes (public/, _next/static/, pages/, app/) → 6. afterFiles rewrites → 7. dynamic route → 8. fallback phir likhte hain. gotcha: Server Functions alag route nahi hain - ve us route par POSTs hain jahan istemal kiya gaya tha, isliye ek Proxy maichar ek path ko chhorakar Server Function ko us raaste par call bhi chhor data hai; hamesha pratyek Server Function ke andar keval Proxy par bharosa karne ke bajaay ek dusre ko verify karta hai.
  • Runtime: Proxy default roop se Node.js runtime (v16) ke liye. runtime config vikalp NOT hai jo Proxy files mein upalabdh hai - ise set karna ek error hai.
  • Advanced flags (v13.1): skipTrailingSlashRedirect (Disable Next.js trailing-slash redirects so Proxy unhein prati-path sambhal sakta hai - vriddhishil migration ke liye upyogi); skipProxyUrlNormalize (Disable URL samanyikaran isliye direct visits aur client transitions ko usi tarah sambhala jata hai; mool URL, e.g ke madhyam se full niyantran data hai. /_next/data/build-id/hello.json /hello ko common karne ke bajaay saman rahta hai.
  • Examples: sashart punarlekhan (/about → /about-2, /dashboard → /dashboard/user); cookies — request: request.cookies.get/getAll/set/delete/has/clear; uttar: response.cookies.get/getAll/set/delete (set Set-Cookie); headers — klon request header aur NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } }) (NOT NextResponse.next({ headers })) ke madhyam se guzarta hai, jo response header set karta hai; bare header (431 error) se bachein. RSC request aur phir se likhte hain: Next.js internal flight header (rsc, next-router-state-tree, next-router-prefetch) ko request se Proxy mein khinchta hai; NextResponse.rewrite() auto-propaagets ki requirement hoti hai RSC ne sheershlekhan - custom fetch() punarlekhan unhein manual roop se aage badhana chahiye (ya skipProxyUrlNormalize enable karein). CORS: ek anumtisoochee ke khilaf origin ki check karta hai, NextResponse.json({}, { headers: preflightHeaders }) ke saath OPTIONS preephlaait ko sambhalta hai, Access-Control-Allow-Origin/Methods/Headers set karta hai. Producing a uttar: Response.json({ success: false, message: 'authentication failed' }, { status: 401 }) jab authenticated nahi kiya jata hai. Negative match: sabhi ko chhorakar api, _next/static, _next/image, favicon.ico, sitemap.xml, robots.txt regeks lukhed ke madhyam se match karta hai; has / missing (e.g) ke saath jor sakte hain. next-router-prefetch header ke madhyam se prefetch requests ko bahar rakha gaya hai. gotcha: yahan tak ki jab _next/data ko nakaratmak maichar mein bahar rakha gaya hai, to Proxy abhi bhi /_next/data/* routes ke liye chala jata hai - janboojhkar, ek page ki security ko rokne ke liye lekin iske data route ko bhool jate hain.
  • Unit testing (experimental, v15.1+): next/experimental/testing/server — unstable_doesMiddlewareMatch({ config, nextConfig, url }) ne dava kiya ki kya proxy URL/headers/cookies ke liye chal raha hai; isRewrite(response), getRewrittenUrl(response), getRedirectUrl(response) ke saath pure karya ka testing karein.
  • Platform support: Node.js server han; Docker Yes; static export sankhya; adapter manch-vishishta.
  • Migration to Proxy: "middleware" ko Express.js midilveyar ke saath bhramit kiya gaya tha aur atydhik upyog ko encourage kiya gaya - yeh feature ek antim risort hai; iska naam spasht karta hai ki yeh app ke samne ek network boundary hai. Codemod: npx @next/codemod@canary middleware-to-proxy. (renames file + function middleware → proxy).
  • Version history: v12.0.0 Middleware (Beta); v12.2.0 static; v13.0.0 request/response header sanshodhan + direct uttar; v13.1.0 advanced jhande; v15.2.0 Node.js runtime (visheshajny); v15.5.0 Node.js runtime (static); v16.0.0 midalaveyar deprecated/renamed se Proxy, Proxy dipholts ko Node.js rantaaima.
  • Fark banam App Router: Proxy convention sajha kiya gaya hai; Pages Router mein usi proxy.ts project root / src ke saath pages/ par baithta hai. dhyaan dein App Router docs kros-link (/docs/app/...) pure — built-in NextRequest/NextResponse API saman hai.

catchError (`next/error`)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai catchError (`next/error`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: catchError (`next/error`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Advantages over a custom React error boundary, API, Returns, Example, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: catchError ek component banata hai jo apne bachchon ko ek error boundary mein lapeta hai - ek programmatic vikalp jise ek custom React error-boundary class likhne ke liye, component-star error recovery ko kahin bhi component tree mein enable banata hai.

  • ek custom React error boundary par Advantages: built-in error vasuli - reset() phir se boundary ke bachchon ko phir se render karta hai taaki user full page reload ke bina theek ho jaaye; client-navikaran handling — error sthiti automatic roop se spasht ho jati hai jab aap ek client navigation ko ek alag route par karte hain.
  • API: catchError(fallback) ek tark leta hai - fallback function jo error UI pradan karta hai. yeh do tark prapt karta hai: props (props wrapper ko passed kiya gaya, children ko chhorakar) aur errorInfo — { error: unknown, reset: () => void }. error unknown hai - message parhne se pahle instanceof Error ke saath tang. reset() error ki sthiti ko saaf karta hai aur phir se bachchon ko render karta hai.
  • Returns: ek React component jo fallback pahle tark ke saman props ko accept karta hai, saath hi children; ek error boundary mein children ko lapeta hai aur fallback ko render karta hai jab ek error children mein pakdi jati hai.
  • Example:
tsx
  import { catchError, type ErrorInfo } from 'next/error'

  function ErrorFallback(props: { title: string }, { error, reset }: ErrorInfo) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
    return (
      <div>
        <h2>{props.title}</h2>
        <p>{message}</p>
        <button onClick={() => reset()}>Try again</button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  export default catchError(ErrorFallback)

upyog: <ErrorWrapper title="Dashboard Error">{children}</ErrorWrapper> - wrapper ko pass kiye gaye props fallback ko forward kar diye jate hain, isliye ek hi boundary ko alag-alag configurations ke saath dobara use kiya ja sakta hai.

  • Version history: v16.2.0 unstable_catchError ne pesh kiya; v16.3.0 catchError sthira.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh Next.js mein class error boundaries ke liye aadhunik, functional pratisthapan hai - koi class component required nahi hai; reset() in-place recovery data hai, aur error state navigation-eveyar hai.

getInitialProps (function reference)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai getInitialProps (function reference). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: getInitialProps (function reference) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Example, Context object, Gotchas / caveats, Security, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Legacy API — iske bajaay getStaticProps ya getServerSideProps ka upyog karein. getInitialProps ek async function hai jo ek page ke default export kiye gaye React component mein joda gaya hai. yeh page transition ke dauraan client par phir se server AND par chalta hai; iska return value ko props ke roop mein component ko agreshit kiya jata hai.

  • Example:
tsx
  import { NextPageContext } from 'next'

  Page.getInitialProps = async (ctx: NextPageContext) => {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/vercel/next.js')
    const json = await res.json()
    return { stars: json.stargazers_count }
  }

  export default function Page({ stars }: { stars: number }) {
    return stars
  }
  • Context objekt: pathname (vartaman route, /pages mein page ka path), query (keval query string objekt ki tulna mein), asPath (actual path incl. query browser mein dikhaya gaya), req (Node HTTP request, server keval), res (Node HTTP pratikriya, server keval), err (error objekt yadi koi error generated hui hai).
  • Dhyaan Do / guphaaein:
  • jab server rendering - ek plain Object, NOT Date, Map, ya Set lauta hai to data wapas kiya jata hai.
  • initial page load: keval server par chalta hai. phir client par tab chalta hai jab <Link> ya next/router ke madhyam se navigate kiya jata hai.
  • yadi getInitialProps ka upyog ek custom _app.js mein kiya jata hai aur target page getServerSideProps ka upyog karta hai, to getInitialProps server par only chalata hai.
  • keval pages/ top level ki files mein upyog karne yogy, NOT nested component (nested/component-level ke liye, App Router ka upyog karein).
  • Security: static/dynamic ki parvah kiye bina, props ke roop mein laute data initial HTML mein client par dikhai data hai (hydration ke liye required) - kabhi props mein sanvedanshil jankari paas nahi.
  • Fark banam App Router: koi samtuly nahi - App Router ne iske bajaay Server Components / Route Handlers mein data prapt kiya; getInitialProps ka dohree server + client execution modal maujud nahi hai.

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai getServerSideProps (function reference). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: getServerSideProps (function reference) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Example (TS, typed), Context parameter, Return values — exactly one of, Version history, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ek page se getServerSideProps ka export karne se Next.js prerender ko pratyek request par page banaya jata hai laute data ka upyog karke - data ke liye jo aksar badalta hai aur chalu hona chahiye. getServerSideProps mein upyog ke liye top level ke dayre mein imported module client ke liye not bundle kiye gaye hain - aap seedhe server-side code likh sakte hain, jismein database access shamil hai.

  • Example (TS, typed):
tsx
  import type { InferGetServerSidePropsType, GetServerSideProps } from 'next'
  type Repo = { name: string; stargazers_count: number }

  export const getServerSideProps = (async () => {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/vercel/next.js')
    const repo: Repo = await res.json()
    return { props: { repo } }
  }) satisfies GetServerSideProps<{ repo: Repo }>

  export default function Page({ repo }: InferGetServerSidePropsType<typeof getServerSideProps>) {
    return <main><p>{repo.stargazers_count}</p></main>
  }
  • Context parameter: params (dynamic root parameter, e.g). [id].js ke liye { id }; req (Node IncomingMessage + extra cookies objekt, string key → string maan); res (Node uttar object); query (kkvaayree string object, jismein dynamic route param shamil hain); preview (draftMode ke liye taiyar) true () mein true) mool queries shamil hain draftMode, setPreviewData dwara set; draftMode (true); resolvedUrl (samanyikrit request URL, ke liye mool queries), locale / locales / defaultLocale (i18n, yadi enable ho). previewData _next/data Preview Mode Draft Mode
  • Return maan — bilkul ek: props (page component dwara prapt key-value jore); ek dharavahik object hona chahiye — JSON.stringify-able); notFound: true (Returns 404 status + 404 page, bhale hi ek page saphaltapurvak pahle generated hua ho - hataye gaye user-generated content ke liye); redirect: { destination, permanent } (internal/external); purane HTTP grahakon ke liye durlabh mamlon mein permanent ke bajaay statusCode ka upyog karein, donon kabhi nahi).
  • Version history: v9.3.0 parichay: v10.0.0 locale/locales/defaultLocale/notFound joda gaya; v13.4.0 App Router saral data lane ke saath sthira.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router mein koi getServerSideProps nahi hai - ek page default roop se Server Component hai aur prati request seedhe (dynamic rendering) prapt karta hai. context objekt (req/res/query) ko params/searchParams props aur headers()/cookies() APIs dwara replace kiya gaya hai; notFound/redirect notFound()/redirect() function ban gaya.

getStaticPaths (function reference)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai getStaticPaths (function reference). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: getStaticPaths (function reference) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `paths`, `fallback: false`, `fallback: true`, `fallback: 'blocking'`, Fallback pages, Example (isFallback + revalidate). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: eksport getStaticPaths ek page se Dynamic Routes aur Next.js ka upyog karke static roop se purv render sabhi pathon ko yeh nirdisht karta hai. return { paths, fallback } (donon ki requirement).

  • paths: jo previous ke liye path karta hai. pratyek entry: { params: {... } } (+ optional locale jab i18n ko configure kiya gaya hai). params key page ke dynamic segments se mel khaati hai: [postId]/[commentId] → { postId, commentId }; catch-ol [...slug] → slug ek array (['hello','world'] → /hello/world); optional catch-ol [[...slug]] → null/[]/undefined/false ka upyog karke root (slug: false → /) ko render karne ke liye kiya jata hai. Params strings kes-sanvedanshil hain - unhein samanyikrit karein (WoRLD keval WoRLD se match karta hai, nahi world).
  • fallback: false: koi bhi rasta nahi lauta → 404. next build keval wapsi path banata hai. path ke ek chhote, static set ke liye achha; naye path ko punarnirman ki requirement hoti hai.
  • fallback: true: path build samay par generated nahi hote hain, NOT 404 - pahla request page ka "fallback" version (khaali props ke saath); router.isFallback === true ke madhyam se pata lagata hai, loading/skeleton UI dikhate hain); background mein Next.js getStaticProps chalata hai, HTML + JSON generated karta hai, browser ko full page mein JSON aur svaip prapt hota hai, aur path ko previous list mein joda jata hai. Caveats: web krolars ko iske bajaay fallback: 'blocking' behavior milta hai; <Link>/next/router ke madhyam se client-side navigation bhi 'blocking' (koi fallback nahi) ke roop mein behavior karta hai. NOT ne output: 'export' ke saath support kiya. kya NOT pahle se hi banaye gaye pages ko update karta hai - iske liye ISR ka upyog karein. bahut badi sankhya mein pages ke liye sarvashreshth (e.g. bada e-commerce catalog) jahan sabhi pathon ka build bahut dhima hai.
  • fallback: 'blocking': naye path HTML janreshan (SSR-like) ke liye wait karte hain, phir cache kiye gaye hain - loading state ka koi flash nahi; user "request" → full page ko dekhta hai. true ke saman background caching vyavhar. NOT ne output: 'export' ke saath support kiya. iske alava default roop se generated pages ko update nahi karta hai - ISR ke saath pair.
  • Fallback pages: props khali; router.isFallback true hai - pidhi khatm hone tak <div>Loading...</div> pradan karta hai.
  • Example (isFallback + revalidate):
jsx
  import { useRouter } from 'next/router'
  function Post({ post }) {
    const router = useRouter()
    if (router.isFallback) return <div>Loading...</div>
    // Render post...
  }
  export async function getStaticPaths() {
    return {
      paths: [{ params: { id: '1' } }, { params: { id: '2' } }],
      fallback: true,
    }
  }
  export async function getStaticProps({ params }) {
    const res = await fetch(`https://.../posts/${params.id}`)
    const post = await res.json()
    return { props: { post }, revalidate: 1 }
  }

getStaticProps (function reference)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai getStaticProps (function reference). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: getStaticProps (function reference) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Example (typed), Context parameter, Reading files — use `process.cwd()`, Version history, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: eksporting getStaticProps pre-renders ek page at build samay lautaye gaye props ka upyog karte hue. ismein upyog kiye jaane wale top-leval import client ke liye not bundle kiye gaye hain - server-side code (incl. Direct database kverees) yahan surakshit hai.

  • Example (typed):
tsx
  import type { InferGetStaticPropsType, GetStaticProps } from 'next'
  export const getStaticProps = (async (context) => {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.github.com/repos/vercel/next.js')
    const repo = await res.json()
    return { props: { repo } }
  }) satisfies GetStaticProps<{ repo: Repo }>
  export default function Page({ repo }: InferGetStaticPropsType<typeof getStaticProps>) {
    return repo.stargazers_count
  }
  • Context parameter: params (dynamic root param; getStaticPaths ke saath upyog); preview (draftMode ke liye deprecated); previewData (draftMode ke liye deprecated); draftMode (true) Draft Mode mein); locale / locales / defaultLocale (i18n); revalidateReason - kyon is function ko bulaya gaya tha: "build" (build samay), "stale" (revalidate avdhi samapt ho gai, ya development mode mein chal rahi hai), "on-demand" (on-mandan).
  • Return maan — props, redirect, ya notFound, plus optional revalidate:
  • props: seeriylebal objekt (JSON.stringify-able) page component ko passed kiya gaya.
  • revalidate (sekeind, default false = no revalidation): ISR — Next.js us page ko phir se banane ka prayas karta hai jab koi request aata hai, to pratyek N sekand mein ek baar. x-nextjs-cache header ke madhyam se ISR cache sthiti: MISS (cache nahi, pahli visit), STALE (background mein vistarit, update), HIT (cached, fresh).
  • notFound: true: 404 sthiti + 404 page, bhale hi koi page saphaltapurvak generated ho (user-janit content ko hata diya gaya). usi revalidate behavior ka anusaran karta hai. NOT ko fallback: false (keval getStaticPaths pathon ko vaise bhi render kiya jata hai) ke saath requirement hoti hai.
  • redirect: { destination, permanent }: internal/external; statusCode ke bajaay durlabh mamlon mein permanent ke bajaay; basePath: false ne configuration redirect ki tarah support kiya. yadi redirect samay par jana jata hai, to unhein iske bajaay next.config.js mein daal dein.
  • Reading files — process.cwd(): files ka upyog seedhe getStaticProps mein file system se kiya jaa sakta hai. kya NOT __dirname ka upyog karta hai - Next.js ek alag directory mein code compiled karta hai taaki yeh galat path lauta sake. process.cwd() ka upyog karein (jahan Next.js ko executed kiya gaya hai): const postsDirectory = path.join(process.cwd(), 'posts'); const filenames = await fs.readdir(postsDirectory) - phir parse/transform (e.g). markdown → HTML) aur { props: { posts: await Promise.all(posts) } } wapas lautein.
  • Version history: v9.5.0 ISR static; v10.0.0 locale/locales/defaultLocale/notFound + fallback: 'blocking'; v12.1.0 on-demand ISR (bita); v12.2.0 on-demand ISR static; sarleekrit data lane ke saath v13.4.0 App Router sthira.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router mein , static pidhi Server Components (Fetch + revalidate/dynamic = 'force-static') ke liye default hai, jismein koi getStaticProps function nahi hai; revalidate ke nakshe revalidate mein fetch() vikalp ya revalidate segment config; notFound/redirect notFound()/redirect() call ban jate hain.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: NextRequest extra feature vidhiyon ke saath Web Request API ka vistar karta hai. yeh Proxy (aur Route Handlers) mein request tark hai.

  • cookies - request ke Set-Cookie header ko parhein ya mute karein:
  • set(name, value): request.cookies.set('show-banner', 'false') → request ko Set-Cookie:show-banner=false;path=/home milta hai.
  • get(name): yadi nahi mila to { name, value, Path } ya undefined return karta hai; yadi multiple cookies match hota hai, to pahla wapas aa jata hai.
  • getAll(name?): ek naam ke liye maan, ya sabhi cookies yadi koi naam nahi diya gaya hai.
  • delete(name): yadi hata diya gaya hai to true ko lauta data hai, to false ko hata diya gaya hai.
  • has(name): boolean — cookie maujud hai.
  • clear(): request se sabhi cookies ko hata dein.
  • nextUrl — deshi URL API ko Next.js-vishisht gunon ke saath vistarit karta hai: basePath (string), buildId (string trum aparibhashit, generateBuildId ke madhyam se optimization), defaultLocale, domainLocale ({ defaultLocale, domain, http }), locales (string[]), locale (vartaman mein active local), url (URL objekt). udaharan: request.nextUrl.pathname → /home; request.nextUrl.searchParams → { name: 'lee' } for /home?name=lee.
  • Version history: v15.0.0 ip aur geo ko NextRequest se hata diya gaya.
  • Fark banam App Router: saman API — NextRequest sajha kiya gaya hai; Pages Router mein yeh main roop se Proxy mein dekha jata hai, jabki App Router mein yeh Route Handler request prakar bhi hai.

Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: NextResponse extra feature vidhiyon ke saath Web Response API ka vistar karta hai. yeh Proxy (aur Route Handlers) mein prayukt pratikriya class hai.

  • cookies - pratikriya ke Set-Cookie header ko parhne ya mute karein: set(name, value) (response.cookies.set('show-banner', 'false') → Set-Cookie:show-banner=false;path=/home), get(name) ({ name, value, Path } ya undefined return); pahla match agar multiple), getAll(name?) (naam ke liye maan, ya sabhi cookies), has(name) (boolean), delete(name) (true/false).
  • json(): ek JSON body: return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal Server Error' }, { status: 500 }) ke saath ek pratikriya generated karta hai.
  • redirect(): ek redirect pratikriya generated karta hai: return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/new', request.url)). Build/modify pahle URL — e.g. klon request.nextUrl, loginUrl.searchParams.set('from', request.nextUrl.pathname) set, phir /login?from=<original path> par redirect karein.
  • rewrite(): ne browser mein mool URL ko preserve karte hue ek URL ko punarlekhan (proxy) kiya: aane wale /about → /proxy ko phir se likha, browser abhi bhi /about dikhata hai.
  • next(): jaldi wapas lauta hai aur routing jari rakhta hai - Proxy varkhors: return NextResponse.next(). phoravard sanshodhit request header upstream NextResponse.next({ request: { headers: newHeaders } }) ke saath - ye target page/route/server action tak pahunchte hain aur NOT client ke sanpark mein aate hain. Do NOT NextResponse.next({ headers }) E ka upyog karta hai - jo pramukhon ko client ko bhejta hai, achha abhyas nahi hai, aur phremavark ki ummeedon ko tor sakta hai (e.g) Server Actions → submissions/broken streaming mein fail raha). iske alava, grahakon ya external sevaon ke prati sanvedanshil data ko leak karne se bachne ke liye ek permission-list (drop custom x-*, authorization, cookie) ka upyog karein. Content-Type
  • Fark banam App Router: saman API — NextResponse sajha kiya gaya hai; Pages Router mein iska upyog Proxy mein bhi kiya jata hai. Route Handlers App Router

useParams (Pages Router)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useParams (Pages Router). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useParams (Pages Router) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Returns, Behavior during prerendering, With `getServerSideProps`, Comparison with `router.query`, Sharing components with App Router, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useParams (next/navigation, NOT next/router se imported) ne vartaman URL dwara bhara route ke dynamic params ko padha. koi parameter nahi leta hai; type kiya jaa sakta hai: useParams<{ slug: string }>(). yeh ek React hook hai - kakshaon ke saath istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • Returns: vartaman route ke dynamic mapdandon ka ek object, ya null prerendering ke dauraana. sanpatti ka naam segment naam hain; maan string ya string[] (catch-all segment) hain. koi dynamic params → khali object {}. udaharan: /shop → {}; /shop/1 [slug] → { slug: '1' } ke saath /shop/1/2; [tag]/[item] → { tag: '1', item: '2' } ke saath /shop/1/2; [...slug] → { slug: ['1', '2'] } ke saath /shop/1/2.
  • Prerendering ke dauraan Behavior: static roop se customize pages ke liye , useParams initial rendering par null lauta hai (paaram dynamic routes ke liye static pidhi ke dauraan known nahi kiya jaa sakta); hydration ke baad yeh router taiyar hone ke baad actual param ko update karta hai. Hamesha ek fallback UI E (if (!params) return <ShopPageSkeleton />) ke saath guard - yeh hydration dhundh ko rokta hai.
  • With getServerSideProps: page prati request server-render kiya gaya hai, isliye useParams turant actual params lauta data hai aur gir wapas kabhi nahi pradan ki jati hai - lekin fallback ko rokte rahein taaki component ko bina getServerSideProps ke pages par pun: upyog kiya jaa sake.
  • router.query ke saath Comparison: useParams return ONLY dynamic route parameter; router.query (useRouter se) mein dynamic params AND query string param shamil hain. E.g URL /shop/shoes?color=red: router.query → { slug: 'shoes', color: 'red' }, params → { slug: 'shoes' }.
  • App Router ke saath Sharing component: next/navigation se useParams BOTH routers mein kaam karta hai, isliye ek sajha component (e.g). bredakranb pages/ aur app/ mein kaam karta hai. App Router useParams mein kabhi-kabhi null ko wapas nahi milta hai, isliye girtee hui shakha ko kabhi bhi vahan render nahi kiya jata hai.
  • Version history: v13.3.0 useParams pesh kiya gaya.

useReportWebVitals (`next/web-vitals`)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useReportWebVitals (`next/web-vitals`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useReportWebVitals (`next/web-vitals`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Usage (in `pages/_app.js`), The `metric` object, Web Vitals included, Sending results to external systems, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useReportWebVitals hook apne vishleshnaatmak serve ke saath upyog ke liye Core Web Vitals E ki report karta hai. iske liye passed naye karyon ko us point tak upalabdh metric ke saath bulaya jata hai. To riporting dupliket data ko rokne ke liye callback function sandarbh sthir (jaise udaharanon mein, component ke bahar ise alag karein) rakhein.

  • Usage (pages/_app.js mein):
jsx
  import { useReportWebVitals } from 'next/web-vitals'
  const logWebVitals = (metric) => { console.log(metric) }
  function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
    useReportWebVitals(logWebVitals)
    return <Component {...pageProps} />
  }
  • The metric objekt: id (vartaman page load mein metric ke liye unique pahchankarta); name (metric name — TTFB, FCP, LCP, INP, CLS); delta (previous value banam parivartit karein, aam taur par emayes); entries (PerformanceEntry array vistrit event jankari ke saath); navigationType ("navigate", "reload", "prerender", "back-forward", "back-forward-cache", "restore", "soft-navigation" - PerformanceNavigationTiming.type se maapaa gaya); navigationURL (us navigation ke URL - naram navigation ke liye upyogi jahan URL phir se badal jaane ke baad metric ki soochna di jaa sakti hai); navigationStartTime; navigationInteractionId (sopht navigation ke liye, us negotiation ne ise trigger kiya); rating ("good") | "needs-improvement" | "poor" banam threshold); value (actual value/duration, aam taur par emayes). navigationId
  • Web Vitals mein shamil hain: TTFB (First Byte ke liye samay), FCP (First Contentful Paint), LCP (Largest Contentful Paint), CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift), INP (Next Paint ke liye intrekshan). metric.name par svich karke parinam sanbhaalein.
  • Custom metric (Next.js-vishisht, hydration/render samay): Next.js-hydration (samay shuru karne aur hydrating khatm karne ke liye), Next.js-route-change-to-render (samay ek route parivartan ke baad rendering shuru karne ke liye), Next.js-render (samay ek route parivartan ke baad render karne ke liye). Important vibhajan: Web Vitals useReportWebVitals mein jate hain, lekin custom metric reportWebVitals function ko pages/_app se export kiya jata hai - pratyek entry point apne khud ke set ki report karta hai, isliye donon ko prapt karne ke liye hook ke saath reportWebVitals export karein:
jsx
  export function reportWebVitals(metric) {
    switch (metric.name) {
      case 'Next.js-hydration': /* handle hydration results */ break
      case 'Next.js-route-change-to-render': break
      case 'Next.js-render': break
      default: break
    }
  }

ye sabhi browsers mein kaam karte hain jo User Timing API ka support karte hain.

  • external pranaliyon ke liye Sending parinam: kisi bhi endpoint par bhej data hai - upalabdh hone par navigator.sendBeacon(url, body) ka upyog karta hai, wapas fetch(url, { body, method: 'POST', keepalive: true }) par gir jata hai. For Google Analytics, metric vitaran (percentiles) ke build ke liye id maan ka upyog karein; window.gtag('event', metric.name, { value: Math.round(metric.name === 'CLS'? metric.value * 1000: metric.value), event_label: metric.id, non_interaction: true }) bhejein (maanvon ko integer hona chahiye); CLS ko skel × 1000 hai).
  • Fark banam App Router: hook sajha kiya gaya hai (next/web-vitals); App Router mein iska upyog Client Component mein kiya jata hai ( ko reportWebVitals export karne ke liye pages/_app nahi hai).
