useRouter (`next/router`)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai useRouter (`next/router`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useRouter (`next/router`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: The `router` object — fields, Methods, Resetting state after navigation, `next/compat/router` export, ESLint, `withRouter`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useRouter (next/router se) kisi bhi karya component ke andar router objekt tak pahunch pradan karta hai. yeh ek React hook hai - iska upyog kakshaon ke saath nahi kiya jaa sakta hai; iske bajaay withRouter HOC (ya kisi function component mein class ko lapeto) ka upyog karein.

  • The router objekt - field:
  • pathname (string): /pages- basePath, locale ke baad vartaman route file ka path, aur trailing slash NOT shamil hain.
  • query (object): parsed query string, jismein dynamic root param shamil hain; yadi page SSR ka upyog nahi karta hai to prerendering ke dauraan khali {}.
  • asPath (String): browser mein dikhaye gaye marg. khoj mandand, trailingSlash config ka samman; basePath aur locale NOT shamil the. Avoid asPath ka upyog karte hue jab tak isReady saty hai - yeh SSR/automatic static optimization ke tahat client aur server ke beech galatfahmi kar sakta hai.
  • isFallback (boolean): page fallback mode (fallback: true) mein hai.
  • basePath, locale, locales, defaultLocale, domainLocales (Array<{domain, defaultLocale, locales}>) - yadi enable ho to.
  • isReady (boolean): router feelds ko client-side update kiya gaya hai aur upyog ke liye taiyar kiya gaya hai - keval useEffect ke andar hi upyog karein, server par sashart rendering ke liye nahi.
  • isPreview (boolean): application Preview Mode mein hai.
  • Methods:
  • router.push(url, as, options): client-side transition; url (UrlObject) | string), as (optional URL-bar Decorator, purv 9.5.3 dynamic-root tantr), options: { scroll (default true), shallow (default false — update path without re-running getStaticProps/getServerSideProps/getInitialProps), locale }. external URL ke liye upyog na karein - window.location behatar hai. URL-object prapatr <Link> ({ pathname: '/post/[pid]', query: { pid: post.id } }) ki tarah kaam karta hai. Dhyaan Do: omitting pathname route ke bajaay browser URL (asPath) ko query lagu karta hai - yeh punarlekhit-served pages (query-only nauvahan visitor-requested URL ko punarlekhan destination ka khulasa karne ke bajaay preserve karta hai) par barkarar rakhta hai. URL khud ko as ke saath mask karte samay, pathname ko spasht roop se paas karein ya query maaskd URL par lagu hoti hai aur ek alag page ko hal kar sakti hai: router.push({ pathname: '/', query: { photoId: 2 } }, '/p/2', { shallow: true }).
  • router.replace(url, as, options): push ke saman API, lekin ek history entry nahi jodti hai.
  • router.prefetch(url, as, options): tezi se client-side transition ke liye pages ko prefetch karein; keval <Link> (Link prefetches automatic roop se) ke bina upyogi; production only (dev mein koi prefetch nahi). vikalp: locale (vibhinn local, ya false) ko URL mein local logon ki requirement hoti hai. udaharan: ek login page par useEffect mein /dashboard ko prefetch karein, phir tezi se transition ke liye login karne ke baad router.push('/dashboard').
  • router.beforePopState(cb): router karya karne se pahle popstate ko sunein; cb { url, as, options } ko prapt karta hai aur false ko wapas return karta hai, Next.js ise sambhalta hai (aap ise khud sambhalte hain - e.g. bal SSR andhikrit routes ke liye window.location.href = as ke madhyam se taza karte hain).
  • router.back(): window.history.back(). router.reload(): window.location.reload().
  • router.events: routeChangeStart(url, { shallow }), routeChangeComplete(url, { shallow }), routeChangeError(err, url, { shallow }) (err.cancelled sach jab navigation ko radd kar diya gaya, e.g. do link tezi se click kiye gaye), beforeHistoryChange(url, { shallow }), hashChangeStart / hashChangeComplete (haash-keval parivartan). useEffect (or componentDidMount) mein rajistar karein aur bina kisi raashi ke .off() ke saath sadasyata lein; pages/_app.js mein sadasyata lein taaki yeh navigation se bach sake. events mein url browser URL incl hai. basePath
  • navigation ke baad Resetting state: usi page par navigate karne se NOT reset state (React) unmount — saman top level ka component nahi hai) hota hai. theek karein: router.query.slug par useEffect mein state ko reset karein, ya _app.js: <Component key={router.asPath} {...pageProps} /> mein ek key ke saath phir se mount karein.
  • next/compat/router export: saman useRouter, app aur pages donon mein prayog kiya jaa sakta hai; next/router ke viprit yeh NOT throw karta hai jab Pages Router ko mount nahi kiya jata hai - NextRouter | null return karta hai. migration ke dauraan donon routers mein kaam karne ke liye components ko parivartit karne ke liye iska upyog karein (next/navigation se useSearchParams ke saath sanyojan); app/ searchParams mein turant taiyar hain, pages/ mein router taiyar hone ke baad). ek Next.js sandarbh (e.g) ke bahar components ko render karne ke liye bhi upyogi hai. getServerSideProps ke andar renderToString. Note: useRouter() compat return se null — ise seedhe errors ko nasht karna; router &&!router.isReady ke saath guard.
  • ESLint: router.push/replace/prefetch return promaaij - no-floating-promises enable ke saath, ya to prati line (// eslint-disable-next-line no-floating-promises), void router.push('/login'), ya await ko ek Async function aur void ke andar inactive karne mein enable hai. onClick handler ke andar lagu nahi hai.
  • withRouter: HOC ek hi router objekt ko ek prop — withRouter(Page), phir function Page({ router }) { return <p>{router.pathname}</p> } ke roop mein jorte hain. TS class components ke liye: interface WithRouterProps { router: NextRouter }, class MyComponent extends React.Component<MyComponentProps>.
  • Fark banam App Router: App Router is API — useRouter ko next/navigation (push/replace/refresh/back/forward/prefetch keval, koi query/asPath/events/isReady), plus usePathname, useSearchParams, useParams se vibhajit karta hai. router.events aur beforePopState ke paas koi App Router samtuly nahi hai; next/compat/router theek se pul migration ke liye maujud hai.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: useSearchParams (Pages Router) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Reading methods, Behavior during prerendering, With `getServerSideProps`, Updating search params, Sharing components with App Router, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: useSearchParams (next/navigation se) vartaman URL ke query string ko padhta hai. Prerendering ke dauraan ek read-only URLSearchParams, ya null return karta hai. koi parameter nahi leta hai; yeh ek React hook hai - kakshaon ke saath istemal nahi kiya jaa sakta hai.

  • Reading Methods: get(name) (first value; /dashboard?a=1 → '1'; ?a= → ''; ?b=3 → a ke liye null; ?a=1&a=2 → '1' — sabhi values ke liye getAll() ka upyog karein), has(name) (boolean), plus pathan-keval getAll(), keys(), values(), entries(), forEach(), toString(). udaharan: URL /dashboard?search=my-project → searchParams.get('search') → 'my-project'.
  • Prerendering ke dauraan Behavior: static roop se customize pages (getServerSideProps ka upyog nahi) ke liye , Prerendering ke dauraan null lauta hai - khoj param static pidhi ke dauraan known nahi kiya jaa sakta kyonki ve request par nirbhar karte hain; hydration ke baad yeh actual param ko update karta hai. hydration dhundh ko rokne ke liye ek fallback UI (if (!searchParams) return <DashboardSkeleton />) ke saath guard.
  • With getServerSideProps: server prati anurodhit, isliye actual khoj param turant upalabdh hain; fallback kabhi render nahi ki jati hai - lekin ise rakhne ke liye isliye component getServerSideProps ke bina pages par pun: prayojy hai.
  • Updating search params: hook keval padha jata hai, isliye ise next/router se useRouter ke saath jor dein: new URLSearchParams(searchParams?.toString()), params.set(name, value) ke madhyam se ek naya query string banaein, phir router.push(router.pathname + '?' + createQueryString('sort', 'asc')) ( useCallback mein lapeta) searchParams par key.
  • App Router ke saath Sharing component: next/navigation se useSearchParams donon routers mein kaam karta hai. App Router mein, previous support ke liye ek <Suspense> boundary mein component ko lapeta (ismein kabhi null ko wapas nahi kiya jata hai).
  • Version history: v13.0.0 ki shuruaat hui.

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai userAgent (`next/server`). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: userAgent (`next/server`) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Example (device-based rewrite in Proxy), Returned object. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: userAgent helper request se user-agent objekt ke saath negotiation karne ke liye properties/methods ke saath Web Request API ka vistar karta hai. next/server se import karein; request ke saath call karein: const { device } = userAgent(request).

  • Example (Proxy me device-based rewrite):
ts
  import { NextRequest, NextResponse, userAgent } from 'next/server'
  export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
    const url = request.nextUrl
    const { device } = userAgent(request)
    // device.type can be: 'mobile', 'tablet', 'console', 'smarttv',
    // 'wearable', 'embedded', or undefined (for desktop browsers)
    const viewport = device.type || 'desktop'
    url.searchParams.set('viewport', viewport)
    return NextResponse.rewrite(url)
  }
  • Returned object:
  • isBot: boolean — kya request ek known bot se aati hai.
  • browser: { name: string | undefined, version: string | undefined }.
  • device: { model: string | undefined, type: 'console' | 'mobile' | 'tablet' | 'smarttv' | 'wearable' | 'embedded' | undefined, vendor: string | undefined } — type desktop browsers ke liye undefined hai.
  • engine: { name, version } — naam Amaya, Blink, EdgeHTML, Flow, Gecko, Goanna, iCab, KHTML, Links, Lynx, NetFront, NetSurf, Presto, Tasman, Trident, w3m, WebKit, ya undefined me se ek hai.
  • os: { name, version } (string | undefined).
  • cpu: { architecture } — 68k, amd64, arm, arm64, armhf, avr, ia32, ia64, irix, irix64, mips, mips64, pa-risc, ppc, sparc, sparc64, ya undefined.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
user-agent parsing server-side (Proxy/Route handler) hai - bot ditekshan, device-eveyar rewriting aur anukoolee rendering ke liye upyogi; security nirnyon ke liye is par bharosa na karein (UA strings spoophebal hain).

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js ko default export ke saath project root mein next.config.js file ke madhyam se configure kiya gaya hai:

js
  // @ts-check
  /** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
  const nextConfig = { /* config options here */ }
  module.exports = nextConfig
  • next.config.js ek regular Node.js module hai, JSON NAHI — Next.js server aur build phases dwara use hota hai, browser build me shamil NAHI hai. ESM ke liye next.config.mjs (export default ke saath); .cjs/.cts extensions supported NAHI hain.
  • Ek function ke roop me config: export default (phase, { defaultConfig }) => { const nextConfig = {...}; return nextConfig }. 12.1.0 ke baad se async: module.exports = async (phase, { defaultConfig }) => {...}. phase current context hai (phases next/constants se import karo, jaise PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER) — per phase alag config return karo.
  • TypeScript: import type { NextConfig } from 'next' ke saath next.config.ts use karo. Naye JS features se bacho jo target Node.js version me available nahi hain — next.config.js Webpack ya Babel dwara parse NAHI hota. Saari allowed configs packages/next/src/server/config-shared.ts me defined hain; koi bhi required nahi hai.
  • Unit testing (experimental, v15.1+): next/experimental/testing/server — unstable_getResponseFromNextConfig({ url, nextConfig }) headers/redirects/rewrites functions chalata hai aur NextResponse return karta hai; routing assert karne ke liye getRedirectUrl(response) ke saath combine karo. Caveat: ye sirf next.config.js fields consider karta hai, proxy ya filesystem routes nahi, isliye production results differ kar sakte hain.

allowedDevOrigins (config option)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai allowedDevOrigins (config option). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: allowedDevOrigins (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Example, Matching rules, Wildcards, Defaults. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js ne andhikrit pahunch ko rokne ke liye default roop se development ke dauraan dev-keval assets/endpoints ko kros-orgin requests ko blocked kiya. allowedDevOrigins extra mool ko configure karta hai jo dev server ka request kar sakta hai ( hostname se pare server ko default roop se localhost ke saath shuru kiya gaya tha).

  • Example: allowedDevOrigins: ['local-origin.dev', '*.local-origin.dev'].
  • Matching niyam: keval request ke Origin header ka hostname match kiya jata hai - yojna, port, path aur query ko nazarandaz kar diya jata hai, isliye bare hostname (koi https://, koi port nahi) ke roop mein entries ko likhte hain. ek no-kor kros-site request (e.g. ek <script> ek dev asset load ho raha hai) koi Origin header bhejta hai - ve iske bajaay Referer hostname par mel khaate hain.
  • Wildcards: * = bilkul ek hostname labels; ** = ek ya adhik lebala. local-origin.dev keval khud se match karta hai; *.local-origin.dev team.local-origin.dev se match karta hai lekin bare host ya team.eu.local-origin.dev se match karta hai; **.local-origin.dev team.local-origin.dev aur team.eu.local-origin.dev se match karta hai lekin bare host nahi hai. partial pratisthapan NOT supported hai (team-*.local-origin.dev avaidh hai); ** keval pattern ki shuruaat mein supported hai.
  • Defaults: dev server pahle se hi localhost, iske up domain aur hostname ke saath shuru hone ki permission data hai. kisi any hostname ko ek entry ki requirement hoti hai - e.g durasth development ke liye ek surang: allowedDevOrigins: ['*.tunnel.example.com'].

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: assetPrefix apne application ke JS/CSS assets ke liye ek CDN ko configure karta hai. Vercel ki deployment automatic roop se ek global CDN ko configure karti hai - koi manual eset priphiks ki zaroorat nahi hai. /docs jaise up-path par hosting ke liye, iske bajaay basePath ka upyog karein (behatar upyukt); iske liye ek custom eset priphiks ki sifarish nahi ki jati hai.

  • Setup: domain ko hal karne ke liye CDN ki utpatti ko configure karta hai Next.js ki hosting ki gai hai; prati step assetPrefix set karein (dev mein aparibhashit):
js
  import { PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER } from 'next/constants'
  export default (phase) => {
    const isDev = phase === PHASE_DEVELOPMENT_SERVER
    const nextConfig = {
      assetPrefix: isDev ? undefined : 'https://cdn.mydomain.com',
    }
    return nextConfig
  }
  • Kya karta hai: Next.js JS/CSS ke liye upasarg ka upyog karta hai jo /_next/ path (.next/static/ folder): /_next/static/chunks/….js → https://cdn.mydomain.com/_next/static/chunks/….js. keval .next/static/ ki content ko CDN ko _next/static/ ke roop mein aplod karein - do NOT ne baki .next/ (server code/config ko public roop se expose nahi kiya jana chahiye) aplod kiya.
  • Not assetPrefix: files ko public/ folder mein shamil kiya gaya hai (yadi aap unhein CDN par chahte hain to apne aap ko set kiya gaya); /_next/data/ pages ke liye /_next/data/ request (main domain ke khilaf raaste - static nahi); /_next/data/ pages ke liye request karta hai (main domain ke khilaf hamesha, ISR ko lagatar support dene ke liye, bhale hi apryukt ho). getServerSideProps getStaticProps

Asaan bhasha me samjho: compress (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Check, Disabling. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: default Next.js dwara next start ya ek custom server ka upyog karte samay render content aur static files ko sanpeerit karne ke liye gzip ka upyog karta hai. yeh keval server target ke saath kaam karta hai. yadi compression pahle se hi ek custom server ke madhyam se configure kiya gaya hai, to Next.js apni khud ki nahi joregaa.

  • Check: pratikriya ke Accept-Encoding (browser-accepted vikalp) aur Content-Encoding (vartaman mein prayukt elgorithm) header ka inspect karta hai.
  • Disabling: compress: false. Not anushnsit jab tak compression apne server par configure nahi kiya jata hai - compression baindvidth ko kam karta hai aur performance mein sudhar karta hai. udaharan: nginx ka upyog karke aur brotli ke liye sviching — set compress: false to give nginx handle Compression.

deploymentId (config option)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai deploymentId (config option). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: deploymentId (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: How it works, Use cases, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: deploymentId ne aapki deployment ke liye ek pahchankarta set kiya, jiska upyog roling deployment ke dauraan version skew security aur cache busting ke liye kiya jata hai. config (deploymentId: 'my-deployment-id') mein set karein ya NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID env var (NEXT_DEPLOYMENT_ID=my-deployment-id next build) ke madhyam se - ek gair-khali env var config value par priority leta hai.

  • Ye kaise kaam karta hai: jab configured ho, Next.js (1) static asset URLs (JS, CSS, images) me ?dpl=<deploymentId> append karta hai; (2) client-side navigation requests ke liye ek x-deployment-id header jodta hai; (3) navigation responses ke liye ek x-nextjs-deployment-id header jodta hai; (4) <html> element par ek data-dpl-id attribute inject karta hai; (5) 'use cache' cache key me deploymentId shamil karta hai, jo badalne par cache entries invalidate ho jati hain. Jab client apni deployment ID aur server ki ID (response header ke through) ke beech mismatch detect karta hai, to ye client-side navigation ke bajaye hard navigation (full page reload) trigger karta hai — users ko hamesha ek consistent deployment version se assets milte hain. Note: Next.js incoming requests par ?dpl= query parameter NAHI padhta — ye cache busting ke liye hai, routing ke liye nahi; version-aware routing host/CDN se aani chahiye.
  • Use case: rolling deployment (kuch instances naye version par, kuch purane par — ek ID ke bina, users ko old/new assets aur errors ka mix mil sakta hai); load balancer ke peeche multi-server environment — same deployment ke saare instances ko ek deploymentId share karna chahiye, jaise deploymentId: process.env.DEPLOYMENT_VERSION || process.env.GIT_SHA. Caveat: per-deployment value skew se sirf tab bachata hai jab requests bhi deployment ke hisaab se route hon; us routing ke bina, rollout ke dauraan dusre deployment ke instance tak pahunchne wale clients navigate karne ke bajaye reload ho jayenge.
  • Version history: v13.4.10 experimental.deploymentId introduce hua; v14.1.4 top-level option ke roop me stabilize hua; v16.2.0 Pages Router build ID ke bajaye response header se version skew detect karta hai, aur deploymentId set hone par build ID constant rehti hai.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/api-reference/config/next-config-js/deploymentId

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Exclusive to next export and DEPRECATED, getStaticPaths (pages) / generateStaticParams (app). map export ke dauraan page gantavyon ke liye routes ka request karte hain. yahan define path next dev mein bhi upalabdh hain.

  • Example:
js
  module.exports = {
    exportPathMap: async function (defaultPathMap, { dev, dir, outDir, distDir, buildId }) {
      return {
        '/': { page: '/' },
        '/about': { page: '/about' },
        '/p/hello-nextjs': { page: '/post', query: { title: 'hello-nextjs' } },
        '/p/learn-nextjs': { page: '/post', query: { title: 'learn-nextjs' } },
        '/p/deploy-nextjs': { page: '/post', query: { title: 'deploy-nextjs' } },
      }
    },
  }

pages ko HTML files (/about → /about.html) ke roop mein export kiya jata hai.

  • Function hastakshar: async function prapt defaultPathMap (Next.js ka default naksha) aur ek dusra objekt: dev (development mein troos - jahan yeh routes ko define karta hai - next export ke dauraan jhooth), dir (absolute project path), outDir (absolute out/ path; null jab dev sahi hai), distDir (absolute .next/ path), buildId. laute nakshe: key = path ka naam, maan = { page: String (page inside pages/), query: Object (passed to getInitialProps when prerendering, default {}) }. export kiye gaye path ka naam ek file naam (e.g) bhi ho sakta hai. /readme.md, lekin jab aap ise serve karte hain to aapko Content-Type: text/html set karna hoga.
  • Dhyaan Do: query field CANNOT ka upyog automatic roop se static roop se customize pages ya getStaticProps pages ke saath kiya jata hai (build samay par HTML ko render kiya gaya); next export ke dauraan koi extra query jankari pradan nahi ki jaa sakti hai. Deprecated and overridden by getStaticPaths in pages — unhein ek saath prayog na karein.
  • Trailing slash: trailingSlash: true pages ko index.html files ke roop mein export karta hai, jismein trailing slash (/about → /about/index.html) ki requirement hoti hai, jo /about/ ke madhyam se routable hai); yeh Next.js 9. se pahle default tha.
  • Custom production directory: next export default roop se out ka upyog karta hai; -o: next export -o outdir ke saath customize karein.

headers (config option)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai headers (config option). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: headers (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Overriding behaviour, Path matching, Header/Cookie/Query matching (`has`/`missing`), basePath support, i18n support, Cache-Control. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next.config.js mein headers() (sync ya async function) { source, headers: [{ key, value }] } objekts ki ek array data hai, jo match pathon ke liye pratikriyaon par custom HTTP header set karta hai. extra field: basePath: false (mel karte samay basePath shamil nahi hai), locale: false (mel karte samay local roop se shamil nahi kiya gaya), has (hai-objects ki array), missing ( lapta-objects ki array). Headers ko filesystem (pages aur /public files) se pahle check kiya jata hai.

  • Overriding behavior: yadi do entries saman path se mel khaati hain aur usi header key ko set karti hain, to last ek jeet (/:path* → x-hello: there, phir /hello → x-hello: world ⇒ /hello ko world milta hai).
  • Path match: /blog/:slug /blog/first-post se match karta hai lekin nahi /blog/a/b (koi nested path nahi) aur nahi /archive/blog/first-post (shuruaat shuru karne ke liye taiyar). sanshodhak: * (zero ya adhik), + (ek ya adhik), ? (zero ya ek) - /blog/:slug* /blog, /blog/a, /blog/a/b/c se match karta hai. Regex: /blog/:post(\\d{1,}) se match karta hai /blog/123 nahi /blog/abc. match kiye gaye param ka upyog header keys/values (value: ':slug', key: 'x-slug-:slug') mein kiya jaa sakta hai. vishesh akshar ( ) { }: * +? ko \\ ke saath bhag lena chahiye, jab shabdik roop se upyog kiya jata hai (e.g). /english\\(default\\)/:slug.
  • Header/Cookie/Query match (has/missing): donon source AND sabhi has item match hona chahiye, aur sabhi missing vastuon ko NOT match hona chahiye. pratyek item: type (header) - cookie, host, value, value, value (String) - aparibhashit match kisi bhi value; ek regeks jaisi string named samuhon, e.g par capture kar sakti hai. first-second par first-(?<paramName>.*) :paramName ko second ke roop mein prayog karne yogy banata hai. udaharan: keval ek header lagu karein jab x-add-header maujud hai; keval jab x-no-header anupasthit hai; jab query page=home AND cookie authorized=true (then value: ':authorized'); jab header x-authorized (?<authorized>yes|true) se match karta hai; jab host example.com hai. key query
  • basePath support: pratyek source ko automatic roop se basePath ke saath samapt kiya jata hai jab tak ki basePath: false entry par set nahi hota.
  • i18n support: pratyek source automatic roop se configure kiye gaye local logon ko sambhalne ke liye taiyar kiya jata hai jab tak ki locale: false - tab aapko apne aap mein ek local vyakti (e.g) ke saath source ko set karna hoga. /nl/with-locale-manual. locale: false ke saath /en / se match karta hai jab en default sthan par hai. not: /(.*) /(en|fr|de)/(.*) ban jata hai aur NOT match top-leval / ya /fr jaise /:path* hoga.
  • Cache-Control: Next.js vastav mein achal sanpatti (SHA-hash in filename, e.g. static image import) ke liye Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable set karta hai - cannot overridden ho sakta hai, aur aap unke liye next.config.js mein cache-kantrol set nahi kar sakte. any pratikriyaon ke liye: getStaticProps mein revalidate ke madhyam se static pages ko pun: valid karein; res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 's-maxage=86400') ke saath cache API root pratikriyaein; context.res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'public, s-maxage=10, stale-while-revalidate=59') ke saath cache dynamic getServerSideProps pratikriyaein - fresh 10s, stale-but-renderable 59s tak jabki ek background revalidation cache ko taza karti hai.
  • Common security header (options section): CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *) /api/:path*, plus Allow-Methods/Allow-Headers par); X-DNS-Prefetch-Control: on; Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload (2 varsh, HTTPS-keval incl. subdomains); X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (CSP frame-ancestors dwara superseded); Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), browsing-topics=() (purv mein feature-policy); X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff ( MIME sniffing/XSS ko rokta hai); Referrer-Policy: origin-when-cross-origin; content-security-niti ( guide dekhein).
  • Version history: v9.5.0 header joda gaya; v10.2.0 has joda gaya; v13.3.0 missing joda gaya.
Source — Asli Pagehttps://nextjs.org/docs/pages/api-reference/config/next-config-js/headers

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next/image loader ke liye custom vinyas. bilt-in Image Optimization API: images: { loader: 'custom', loaderFile: './my/image/loader.js' } ke bajaay cloud provider ka upyog karna. loaderFile ko app root ke relative hona chahiye aur ek default function ko ek string lautane ka export karna chahiye:

js
  export default function myImageLoader({ src, width, quality }) {
    return `https://example.com/${src}?w=${width}&q=${quality || 75}`
  }

optional roop se, <Image> par loader prop ke madhyam se prati-insteins function ko paas karein. built-in Image Optimization API behaviour/options ke liye, image component ke Configuration Options (D4.5/D4.6) ko dekhein.

  • Example loader config (sabhi usi ({ src, width, quality }) => url hastakshar ka palan karein): Akamai (?imwidth=${width}), AWS CloudFront (format=auto&width&quality), Cloudinary (f_auto,c_limit,w_${width},q_${quality||'auto'}), Cloudflare (cdn-cgi/image/width=…,quality=…,format=auto/), kanteintphul (fm=webp&w&q), Fastly (auto=webp&width&quality), Gumlet (format=auto&w&q), ImageEngine (w_${width},cmpr_${100-quality}), Imgix (auto=format&fit=max&w&q), PixelBin (t.resize(w:…)~t.compress(q:…) paraX + ?f_auto=true) naaitrojan AIO (w-… / q-… ko aio query param mein sanlagn karta hai). cdn.sanity.io/images/<project>/<dataset> auto=format&fit=max&w&q format=optimal&w&q width&quality ${width}x0/filters:quality(…) ?tr=w-…,q-… ImageKit.io

  • Browser console log (browserToTerminal): development ke dauraan tarminal ke liye browser console.log/warn/error ko aage badhata hai, isliye client-side code ko DevTools kholne ke bina dibag kiya jaa sakta hai. maan: 'warn' (default - warning aur errors keval), 'error' (keval aatankavaadee), true (sabhi output: log, jankari, warning, error), false (disebal). source sthan (file path + line nanbar) default, e.g dwara shamil kiya gaya hai. [browser] Hello World (pages/index.tsx:6:17)
  • Disabling all logs: logging: false.
  • Version history: v14.0.0 logging.fetches static (App Router); v15.0.0 logging: false joda gaya, fetches.hmrRefreshes joda gaya (App Router); v15.2.0 incomingRequests joda gaya; v15.4.0 experimental.browserDebugInfoInTerminal pesh kiya gaya; v16.2.0 browserToTerminal joda gaya ( experimental se nikala gaya).

js
  module.exports = {
    onDemandEntries: {
      // period (in ms) where the server will keep pages in the buffer
      maxInactiveAge: 25 * 1000,
      // number of pages that should be kept simultaneously without being disposed

    },
  }

maxInactiveAge (ms) — server pages ko buffer me kitni der rakhta hai; pagesBufferLength — kitne pages bina dispose hue ek saath rakhe jate hain.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Turbopack NFT extensions, `output: 'standalone'`, Env files in standalone output, Caveats / tracing options. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: next build ke dauraan , Next.js automatic roop se pratyek page aur iski dependency (Output File Tracing) ka pata lagata hai, jo @vercel/nft ke madhyam se static roop se import/require/fs upyog ka vishleshan karta hai) production pariniyojan ke liye required sabhi files ko set karne ke liye - tezi se deployment size ko kam karta hai. Next.js 12 se pahle, Docker deployment ko next start chalane ke liye installed sabhi dependencies ki requirement hoti hai; ab keval known files ki requirement hoti hai. yeh deprecated serverless target ki requirement ko bhi hata data hai. production server ko bhi pata lagaya gaya hai, .next/next-server.js.nft.json par output; .nft.json files ka upyog karne ke liye, pratyek trace ki file list ( ke relative) parhein aur unhein deployment sthan par copy karein. .nft.json

  • Turbopack NFT extension: Turbopack .nft.json files ko fileHashes ( ke liye parallel array - saman length/order, caching/dedup ke liye content pahchankarta ke roop mein upyog kiya jaa sakta hai) aur symlinks ( files mein tatkal target ke liye map index); entry ke bina filein common files/dirs hain. experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots ka upyog karke trais mein additionalRoots (ordar named source jarein, pratyek apne files/fileHashes/symlinks ke saath); .nft.json dir ke relative path) bhi shamil hai. files
  • output: 'standalone': Next.js Auto-creates a .next/standalone folder keval required files (incl. chunein node_modules) ki pratilipi - node_modules ki installation ke bina apne aap mein deployed. Windows par, directory simblinks ko privileges/Developer mode ki requirement ho sakti hai; ek jankshan girbaik ek full target store karta hai aur woh transfer yogy nahi hai. ek minimum server.js ko next start ke pratisthapan ke roop mein bhi output kiya jata hai - node.next/standalone/server.js chalaein; ek vishisht port/host (e.g) ke liye PORT/HOSTNAME env var set karein. PORT=8080 HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 node server.js. server.js NOT pratilipi public ya .next/static default roop se (vishesh roop se ek CDN dwara serve); manual roop se pratilipi: cp -r public.next/standalone/ && cp -r.next/static.next/standalone/.next/ — jiske baad server.js unhein karya karta hai. next.config.js ko server.js mein build aur serial ke dauraan padha jata hai.
  • standalone output mein Env files: jab next build .env ya .env.production load karta hai, standalone output mein .next/standalone mein ek pratilipi shamil hai; runtime server.js mein unhein default roop se padhta hai - server par set kiye gaye env vars precedence lete hain. .env.local / .env.production.local NOT copy kiye gaye hain (unke values ko abhi bhi previous pages aur inlined NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars jaise build-samay par kaam karne ke liye lagu kiya jata hai, lekin request-samay server code keval unhein dekhne ke liye agar shuru mein set kiya gaya hai). Keep unmein keval gair-sachiv default; start (host env settings ya ek gupt manager) par rahasy pradan karte hain. rm -f.next/standalone/.env.next/standalone/.env.production ke saath copies nikalein (unke fallback values ko bhi hata data hai - runtime par har required char set karein). yeh pratilipi file anurekhan se alag hai - outputFileTracingExcludes in files ko door nahi karta hai. jab project dir ke upar outputFileTracingRoot ank hote hain, to files ko us root (e.g) ke relative copy kiya jata hai. .next/standalone/packages/web-app/.env)
  • Caveats / anurekhan vikalp: monorepoj mein project dir default anurekhan root hai - iske bahar ki files ko bahar rakha gaya hai; unhein shamil karne ke liye outputFileTracingRoot: path.join(__dirname, '../../') set karein. yadi tresing mis ki requirement hoti hai ya ismein apryukt vyakti shamil hain, to outputFileTracingIncludes / outputFileTracingExcludes ka upyog karein - objekt jinki keys route globs (route path ke khilaf paich, e.g) hain. /api/hello) aur maan glob pattern project root: outputFileTracingExcludes: { '/api/hello': ['./un-necessary-folder/**/*'] }, outputFileTracingIncludes: { '/api/another': ['./necessary-folder/**/*'], '/api/login/\\[\\[\\.\\.\\.slug\\]\\]': ['./node_modules/aws-crt/dist/bin/**/*'] } se hal hain. src/ ke saath, key abhi bhi route path se mel khaati hai; maan src/ path ka sandarbh de sakte hain. '/*' ke saath sabhi routes ko lakshit karein. ye vikalp keval server trace par lagu hote hain - Edge Runtime route aur puri tarah se static page aprabhavit hain; ve copy kiye gaye .env files ko bhi affected nahi karte hain. production server trace (.next/next-server.js.nft.json) ke liye, kunjiyon ko next-server naam (route path nahi) ke khilaf match kiya jata hai - outputFileTracingExcludes mein 'next-server' key ka upyog karein. pattern mein aage ki slaish ko pasand karein; ovarasaaizd trace (Repo root par **/*) se bachne ke liye pattern ko sankirn rakhein. aam mein pattern shamil hain: node_modules/sharp/**/*, node_modules/aws-crt/dist/bin/**/*.

Key concepts: jab Proxy ka upyog kiya jata hai, to Next.js automatic roop se request body ko klon karta hai aur ise memory mein baphar karta hai taaki ise kai bar padha jaa sake - donon Proxy mein aur built-in route handler mein. yeh vikalp atydhik memory upyog ko rokne ke liye baphard body size ko kaip karta hai. Default: 10MB.

  • Options: string format (recommended) - experimental: { proxyClientMaxBodySize: '1mb' } (units b, kb, mb, gb); ya sankhya format bytes - 1048576 (= 1MB).
  • Behaviour jab adhik ho gaya: Next.js baphar keval pahla N bytes (boundary tak) hai, jo route ka namkaran warning data hai, aur request common roop se keval partial body ke saath hi jari rahta hai - it NOT fail karta hai ya client ko error wapas kar data hai. yadi app ko full body ki requirement hoti hai, to boundary ko barhaaein ya partial body ko sundar dhang se sambhal lein.
  • Example: ne Proxy (const body = await request.text()) mein body ko padha - yeh abhi bhi route handler (POST(request) { const body = await request.text() }) mein baad mein upalabdh hai.
  • Good janne ke liye: keval tabhi lagu hota hai jab Proxy ka upyog kiya jata hai; boundary prati-request hai, jo concurrent requests mein global nahi hai; badi file aplod ke liye, usi hisaab se boundary badhati hai.

Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Redirects ek alag destination path ke liye ek aane wale request path ka naksha hai. redirects() (sync ya async) { source, destination, permanent } ki ek array data hai. permanent: true → 308 (clients/search injan dwara hamesha ke liye banaya gaya); false → 307 (asthayi, cache nahi). Next.js 302/301 ke bajaay 307/308 ka upyog karta hai kyonki ve request vidhi ko preserve karte hain - 302 ke saath, ek POST /v1/users destination par GET /v2/users ban sakta hai. extra field: basePath: false, locale: false, has, missing. Redirects ko filesystem (pages aur /public) se pahle check kiya jata hai.

  • Pages Router gotcha: redirects NOT client-side routing (<Link>, router.push) par lagu hote hain jab tak ki Proxy maujud nahi hai aur path se match karta hai.
  • Query passthrough: request query maan destination ke madhyam se guzarta hai: /old-blog/:path* → /blog/:path* /blog/post-1?hello=world mein /old-blog/post-1?hello=world ko badal data hai. path params (/old-blog/:slug, nahi /old-blog:slug) mein : se pahle / ko shamil karein - anyatha path ko ek shabdik string ke roop mein mana jata hai aur anant punarnirdesh ka karan ban sakta hai.
  • Path match: header ke saman niyam - /old-blog/:slug keval single segments se match karta hai, jo shuru karne ke liye langar dalta hai; sanshodhak */+/?; regex /post/:slug(\\d{1,}); literary hone par \\ ke saath vishesh chars ( ) { }: * +? se bhag lein. destination (/news/:slug) mein match kiye gaye param upyog yogya.
  • Header/Cookie/Query match (has/missing): header ke saman modal - source + sabhi has match karna chahiye, sabhi missing ko nahi hona chahiye; item { type: 'header'|'cookie'|'host'|'query', key, value? } naam ka darjaa support ((?<authorized>yes|true) → destination mein :authorized ke roop mein upyog karne yogy). /home?authorized=:authorized.
  • basePath support: source aur destination ko basePath ke saath auto-render kiya jata hai jab tak ki basePath: false ( jaise external redirects ke liye false ka upyog karein). https://example.com
  • i18n support: svath local logon ko sambhalne ke liye taiyar hai jab tak ki locale: false - tab apne aap mein ek local vyakti ke saath source/destination ka upasarg ho jata hai. locale: false ke saath /en / se match karta hai jab en default hai; /:locale/page manual roop se sabhi local logon se mel khaa sakta hai; /(.*) /(en|fr|de)/(.*) ban jata hai aur top level / ya /fr se mel nahi account hai.
  • Custom sthiti code: durlabh mamlon mein purane HTTP grahakon ke liye permanent (kabhi donon) ke bajaay statusCode ka upyog karta hai; ek Refresh header IE11 compatibility ke liye 308 ke liye auto-added hai.
  • other redirects: API roots / Route Handlers (request-based), aur getStaticProps / getServerSideProps (per-page, request-time) ke andar .
  • Version history: v9.5.0 joda gaya; v10.2.0 has; v13.3.0 missing.

rewrites (config option)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai rewrites (config option). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: rewrites (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Three phases (object form), Route-check order, Rewrite parameters, Path matching, Rewriting to an external URL, basePath support. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Rewrites ek alag destination path ke liye ek aane wale request path ka naksha hai, jo ek URL proxy ke roop mein karya karta hai jo destination ko mask karta hai - user sthan ko badalane ke liye prakat nahi hota hai. Redirects, iske viprit, reroute aur URL parivartan dikhane ke liye. Rewrites ARE client-side routing (<Link href="/about"> / se content pradan karta hai jabki URL /about ko banaye rakhta hai) par lagu hota hai. rewrites() (sync ya async) { source, destination } ki ek array ya array { beforeFiles, afterFiles, fallback } (v10.1+) ki ek object ko return karta hai. extra field: basePath: false, locale: false, has, missing.

  • Three steps (object form): beforeFiles — headers/redirects ke baad, ALL files ko sammilit karne se pahle check kiya gaya. _next/static aur public files, isliye ve override page files (e.g) kar sakte hain. /some-page → /somewhere-else jab query overrideMe maujud hai); afterFiles - pages/public files ke baad, dynamic routes se pahle; fallback - pages/public files ke baad AND dynamic routes, 404 page (e.g) se pahle lagu hote hain. /:path* → https://my-old-site.com/:path*). beforeFiles ne ek match ke turant baad filesystem/dynamic routes ki check nahi ki - sabhi beforeFiles pahle check kiye gaye hain.
  • Route-check order: 1. headers → 2. redirects → 3. beforeFiles rewrites → 4. static filein (public/, _next/static, gair-dynamic pages) → 5. afterFiles rewrites (sabse pahle ek static file/page/dynamic route jeet ke liye hal) → 6. dynamic route → 7. fallback rewrites. Dhyaan Do: yadi getStaticPaths fallback: true/'blocking' ka upyog karta hai, to fallback ne next.config.js mein phir se likha hoga NOT rana. ek plain array wapsi = afterFiles behavior (file system ke baad, dynamic routes se pahle).
  • Rewrite mapdandon: params default roop se query mein passed kar rahe hain jab NOT destination (/old-about/:path* → /about ⇒ :path query mein bhumi) mein istemal kiya. yadi destination mein upyog kiye jaane wale param IS hain, to koi bhi auto-paas (/docs/:path* → /:path*) nahi hai. aap abhi bhi destination (/:first/:second → /:first?second=:second) mein query likhne ke dwara unhein manual roop se paas kar sakte hain. Automatic Static Optimization / Prerendering parse se static pages ko hydration ke baad client par param ko phir se likhna aur unhein query mein pradan karna.
  • Path match: ke saman niyam headers/redirects — singal-segment param, sanshodhak */+/?, regex (\d{1,}), vishesh chars ( ) { } [ ] | \ ^.: * + -? $ ko \\ ke saath literary hone par bhag lete hain. has/missing modal headers/redirects. ke saman
  • Rewriting to an External URL: source: '/blog' → destination: 'https://example.com/blog' — key for vetan vriddhi (multi-zone udaharan: with-zones). trailingSlash: true ke saath, source aur destination (/blog/ → https://example.com/blog/) donon mein trelar slaish shamil hain. Incremental god lene pattern: ek fallback ek proxy endpoint (/:path* → https://custom-routes-proxying-endpoint.vercel.app/:path*) proxy ko maujuda site par sabhi Next.js routes ki check ke baad phir likhte hain - adhik pages ke migrate ke roop mein koi config parivartan ki requirement nahi hai.
  • basePath support: source/destination auto-render jab tak basePath: false — not basePath: false ka upyog internal punarlekhan ke liye nahi kiya jaa sakta hai (keval external destination jaise https://example.com).
  • i18n support: local logon ke liye auto-render jab tak locale: false ( phir manual roop se upasarg); locale: false ke saath /en default ilaake ke liye / se match karta hai; /:locale/api-alias/:path* manual roop se sabhi sthanon se match kar sakte hain; /(.*) /(en|fr|de)/(.*) ban jata hai aur top level wale / ya /fr se mel nahi khaati.
  • Version history: v9.5.0 joda gaya; v10.2.0 has; v13.3.0 missing.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: skipProxyUrlNormalize (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: What changes when enabled, Example, Deprecated alias, Good to know, Version history. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Lets Proxy Next.js ke samanyikrit sanskaran ke bajaay riginal request ko dekhte hain - internal URL, query parameter aur header sahit client-side navigation ke dauraan upyog kiya jata hai. Most pariyojnaon ko is ki requirement nahi hai - vishisht routing mamlon aur debugging ke liye ek advanced Proxy dhvaja. skipProxyUrlNormalize: true

  • enable hone par Kya badalta hai: default roop se , client-side navigation ke dauraan Next.js Proxy se pahle internal request ko common karta hai (to Proxy client-side nev aur phul page load ke liye usi destination URL ko dekhta hai) aur yeh bhi common karta hai ki Proxy return kya data hai. flag ke saath, na to samanyikaran run - Proxy ko bheje gaye request prapt hota hai, aur rewrite/redirect gantavyon ko likhit roop mein bheja jata hai:
  • request.nextUrl: default internal data ko hal karta hai URL wapas route path par aur local ko nikalta hai; enable → anurodhit path naam ko bheje jaane ke roop mein rakhta hai.
  • request.url: default samanyikrit URL hai; enable → mool request URL.
  • internal _rsc query parameter: default roop se chheen liya; enable hone par sanrakshita.
  • internal navigation header (rsc, next-router-state-tree, next-router-prefetch, next-router-segment-prefetch, next-hmr-refresh)): default roop se request.headers se hata diya gaya; enable hone par sanrakshita.
  • NextResponse.rewrite() destination: default roop se build ID ke saath phir se serialize kiya gaya; enable hone par likhit roop mein bheja gaya.
  • NextResponse.redirect() Location: default roop se ek relative URL ko phir se likha gaya, jab enable ho jata hai to likhit (traailing slaish preserve) ke roop mein bheja gaya.
  • trailingSlash: true ke saath, default roop se Proxy run se pahle ek trailing slash lagaya jata hai; enable hone par rootnaam aprivartit hokar guzarta hai.
  • Example: client-side navigation ke dauraan Next.js /_next/data/build-id/hello.json ka request karta hai; enable vikalp ke saath, request.nextUrl.pathname /_next/data/build-id/hello.json hai; disabled, yeh /hello hai.
  • Deprecated alias: purv naam skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize (jab se Proxy ko midalaveyar kaha jata tha) abhi bhi kaam karta hai lekin ek deprecation warning log karta hai; setting donon ek error phenk data hai. v16 codemod iska naam badalta hai.
  • Good to know: client-side nev banam phul page load ke liye alag-alag content wapas karne ke liye internal navigation header ka upyog karne se bachna; aapko is vikalp ki requirement nahi hai ki kaun se routes ko simit karein Proxy ( matcher abhi bhi destination URL se match karta hai); keval request/response Proxy parivartan dekhta hai - file system routing, redirects aur rewrites saman behavior karte hain.
  • Version history: v13.1.0 skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize joda gaya; v16.0.0 ko skipProxyUrlNormalize naam diya gaya.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Default behaviour (table), Paths containing a dot, Good to know, Example — handling trailing slashes in Proxy, Version history. Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: automatic redirects ko band kar data hai jo ek trailing slash ko jodta hai ya hata data hai - aap kisi bhi redirect ko sambhalte hain jo aap abhi bhi Proxy mein chahte hain. Most pariyojnaon ko is ki requirement nahi hai - vishisht routing mamlon aur debugging ke liye ek advanced Proxy dhvaja. skipTrailingSlashRedirect: true

  • Default behavior (tebal): trailingSlash: false, /about → 200, /about/ → 308 ke saath /about ko redirect karein; trailingSlash: true, /about → 308 ke saath /about/, /about/ → 200 ko redirect karein. flag enable hone ke saath, donon /about aur /about/ return 200 (koi bhi redirect nahi) aur Next.js client-side navigation (<Link> / router URL) ke dauraan trailing slash ko badalna band kar data hai. aapka khud ka redirects/rewrites abhi bhi lagu hota hai.
  • ek dot yukt Paths: yadi antim path segment mein ek dot hota hai, to Next.js ek file ke roop mein path ka ilaj karta hai aur trailingSlash (/gcc.git/) aur /version/1.2.3/ → 308 ko donon mode mein slaish-les form mein hata data hai; /version/1.2.3/my-page/ → 200 trailingSlash: true ke saath, false ke saath 308). ek pahle segment mein ek dot ka koi prabhav nahi hai, iske alava .well-known/ ke tahat, jo ki trailingSlash: true (/.well-known/x/ → 200) ke baad default punarnirdeshon se mukt hai. flag enable hone ke saath, in punarnirdeshon mein se koi bhi generated nahi hota hai - pratyek path ko request ke roop mein served jata hai.
  • Good to know: ne pahle trailingSlash ki installation ki - yeh abhi bhi Next.js ko controlled karta hai, output: 'export' ke liye file naam generated karta hai aur output karta hai (jahan flag /me ko /me/ ko hal karne ke bajaay href ko preserve karta hai). donon /about aur /about/ par ek page par kaam karne se sarch injan do URL milte hain - metadata mein ek kainonikal URL set karein ya Proxy mein redirect karein.
  • Example - Proxy mein trailing slash ko sambhalne: ne legesee priphiks (/docs, /blog) ko anatach (NextResponse.next()) kiya aur any pathon ke liye regeks /((?!\.well-known(?:\/.*)?)(?:[^/]+\/)*[^/]+\.\w+)/ ke madhyam se ek trailing slash (skiping files aur .well-known path): return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(${pathname}/, request.nextUrl)).
  • Version history: v13.1.0 joda gaya.

  • Kab aapko iski requirement hai: Turbopack transpile workspace package automatic roop se donon routers ke tahat monorepos mein; webpack App Router ke liye saman hai. jab ek package jorein: (1) ek node_modules dependency ship kachche TypeScript/JSX — Next.js default roop se node_modules code ko compiled nahi karta hai (optional roop se, package ko plain JS aur point main/exports ko compiled output par banaya gaya); (2) aap Pages Router ke liye webpack ke saath build karte hain aur dependency ka source app directory (e.g) ke bahar rahta hai. apps/web ek monorepo mein packages/ui import karte hain; (3) aap Pages Router ka upyog karte hain aur ek node_modules dependency ko route mein bundle karna chahte hain - Pages Router server-side node_modules deps ko Node.js require ke madhyam se runtime par listed karna; package ko iske bajaay route mein apne source ko bundle karta hai. (App Router pahle se hi server Component/Route handler deps ko bundle karta hai jab tak ki serverExternalPackages mein listed nahi kiya gaya hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: turbopack vikalp files ko badalane aur module resolution badalane ke liye Turbopack ko customize karta hai. pahle experimental.turbo (v13.0.0-15.2.x) naam diya gaya - abhi bhi ek alias ke roop mein kaam karta hai; naye config top level ke turbopack (npx @next/codemod@latest next-experimental-turbo-to-turbopack. ke saath migration) ka upyog karna chahiye. Turbopack ko built-in efficiency ke liye koi loader ki requirement nahi hai - CSS aur aadhunik JS (NO css-loader/postcss-loader/babel-loader) mein banaya gaya hai.

  • Options: root (application root dir, absolute path); rules (webpack loaders apply karne ke liye); resolveAlias (aliased imports ko modules se map karna); resolveExtensions (import par resolve karne wale extensions); debugIds (JS bundles aur source maps me debug IDs generate karna).
  • Supported loaders (tested): babel-loader (Babel config file milne par auto-configured), @svgr/webpack, svg-inline-loader, yaml-loader, string-replace-loader, raw-loader, sass-loader (auto-configured), graphql-tag/loader. Missing loader-API features (loader-runner ke through): importModule / loadModule — koi support nahi; fs — partial (sirf fs.readFile); emitFile — koi support nahi; utils — koi support nahi.
  • Root directory: Turbopack root se modules resolve karta hai; iske bahar ki files resolve nahi hoti (behtar cache validation, kam FS watching, kam resolution steps). Lockfiles se auto-detected (pnpm-lock.yaml, package-lock.json, yarn.lock, bun.lock, bun.lockb); manually set karo: turbopack: { root: path.join(__dirname, '..') }. Root ke bahar npm link deps ke liye, root ko dono ke parent par set karo, ya ek additional root use karo. Root ko zyada broad bhi mat karo (jaise home dir) — Turbopack roots ke andar saari files watch karta hai aur performance suffer karti hai.
  • Additional roots (experimental, v16.4.0): experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots: { linkedPackages: { path: path.join(__dirname, '../packages') } } — Turbopack ko un symlinks ko follow karne deta hai jinke targets turbopack.root ke bahar hain (npm link, pnpm global virtual store). Sirf symlink boundaries par crossable; root se bahar escape karne wale direct relative imports supported nahi. Symlink + target dev/build se pehle build machine par hone chahiye; CI/deployment tools unhe copy nahi kar sakte. Windows ko symlinks ke liye Developer Mode/elevated permissions chahiye (junction fallback absolute paths use karta hai, output relocatable nahi). Missing root → warning, jab tak ignoreIfMissing: true na ho. Root naam: 1-40 chars, ASCII letters/digits/_/-, Windows device naam nahi, koi case-insensitive duplicates nahi. Additional roots turbopack.root ya ek dusre ko overlap nahi kar sakte. Ve trace format (additionalRoots extension) badalte hain aur, output: 'standalone' ke saath, unbundled files root ke naam wali subdirectory me copy hoti hain.
  • Webpack loaders configure karna: file extensions ko loaders se map karo; rules order me evaluate hote hain; sirf JS return karne wale loaders supported hain (stylesheets/images supported nahi); loader options plain JS primitives/objects/arrays hone chahiye (koi require() plugin modules nahi). Example — SVG ke liye @svgr/webpack: turbopack: { rules: { '*.svg': { loaders: ['@svgr/webpack'], as: '*.js' } } } (options ke liye object form: { loader: '@svgr/webpack', options: { icon: true } }). Globs file naam se match karte hain jab tak unme / na ho (tab full project-relative path); Windows paths / par normalized hote hain. v13.4.4 se pehle, turbopack.rules turbo.loaders tha aur sirf *.mdx ke bajaye .mdx jaise extensions accept karta tha.
  • Advanced conditions: condition ke saath boolean operators {all: [...]}, {any: [...]}, {not: ...} aur operators {path: string|RegExp}, {content: RegExp}, {query: string|RegExp}, {contentType: string|RegExp} (ek object me multiple operators = AND lagu). Built-in conditions: browser, foreign (node_modules + Next.js internal — aam taur par performance ke liye {not: 'foreign'} se restrict karte hain), development, production, node, edge-light (deprecated). Rules ek object ya ek array (combined conditions, jaise browser vs server ke liye alag loaders) ho sakte hain. Saare matching rules order me execute hote hain.
  • Module types: type seedhe set karta hai (webpack type jaisa) — asset (file emit karo, URL return karo — asset/resource jaisa), ecmascript, typescript, css, css-module, json, wasm, node (native addons), raw/text (content string ke roop me), bytes (Uint8Array). loaders ke saath combine ho sakta hai (loaders pehle chalte hain). Example: rules: { '*.svg': { type: 'asset' } } → import svgUrl from './icon.svg' URL return karta hai.
  • Import attributes ke saath inline loader config (v16.2.0): per-import with segment ke through: import rawText from '../data.txt' with { turbopackLoader: 'raw-loader', turbopackAs: '*.js' }. Attributes: turbopackLoader, turbopackLoaderOptions (JSON string, jaise '{"search":"X","replace":"Y"}'), turbopackAs, turbopackModuleType. Turbopack-specific, webpack dwara supported NAHI; with keyword chahiye (assert nahi).
  • Aliases resolve karna: resolveAlias: { underscore: 'lodash', mocha: { browser: 'mocha/browser-entry.js' } } — webpack resolve.alias jaisa; conditional aliasing ke liye sirf browser condition supported hai.
  • Custom extensions resolve karna: resolveExtensions: ['.mdx', '.tsx', '.ts', '.jsx', '.js', '.mjs', '.node', '.json'] — ye default (.tsx, .ts, .jsx, .js, .mjs, .json; server-side .node jodta hai) ko OVERWRITE karta hai, isliye jo chahiye wo sab shamil karo. Tumhari apni source files par lagu hota hai; node_modules ke andar ke imports apni list rakhte hain.
  • Debug IDs: debugIds: true bundles/source maps me debug IDs generate karta hai, ek polyfill jodta hai, jo globalThis._debugIds me available hai.
  • Version history: v13.0.0 experimental.turbo introduce hua; v15.3.0 naam badalkar turbopack rakha gaya; v16.0.0 debugIds + rules.*.condition joda gaya; v16.2.0 turbopackLoader import attributes, rules.*.type, condition.contentType, condition.query jode gaye; v16.4.0 experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots joda gaya.

experimental.turbopackChunking (config option)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai experimental.turbopackChunking (config option). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: experimental.turbopackChunking (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Defaults, Size thresholds, Heuristics. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. experimental.turbopackChunking Turbopack ke production JS chunker ko configure karta hai - user behavior aur iske kachche size ki threshold ke bare mein apni assumptions ko badalta hai.

  • Defaults: minChunkSize: 50000, maxChunkCountPerGroup: 40, maxMergeChunkSize: 200000.
  • Size thresholds (Uncompressed, unminified code - mote taur par 5 × compressed/minified output ke bytes):
  • minChunkSize (default 50000): Turbopack chhote tukron ko milaakar ek se adhik chhote hisse ko banane se rokta hai. → kam, bare hisse; → kam karna, chhote hisse.
  • maxChunkCountPerGroup (default 40): prati chank group adhikatam ank (e.g) ek route ya dynamic import). kam karna → adhik aggressive vilay, prati page kam network request; → chhote hisse ko uthana, navigate karte samay adhik sambhavit cache hita.
  • maxMergeChunkSize (default 200000): Turbopack kabhi bhi dusron ke saath tulna mein bada nahi mila - bare hisse mein code ko multiple bare output tukron mein dupliket karne se rokta hai.
  • vyapar band: vilay navigation performance ki lagat par initial page bhar (fewer request) ko behatar banata hai (chhote hisse pages par adhik pun: prayojy hain).
  • Heuristics (jab vajan hota hai ki kya do segment vilay iske layak hai);
  • clusters (RegExp, e.g ki array ki array). [[/^\/dashboard/, /^\/settings/]]: route group aamtaur par ek saath daura kiya (route pathname ke khilaf match) - ek klastar ke routes dwara sajha kiye gaye hisse ko utsukta se marj kiya jata hai.
  • firstPageLoadPriority (0-1): ek page load ke liye vajan kitna bhari hota hai; uchchatar adhik utsukta se vilay ho jata hai; aapki site ki uchhal dar ek achha anuman hai agar anishchit hai.
  • priorityRoutes (RegExp ki array): route aksar pahle (e.g. hompej) par utre - unke bundles ko kahin aur navigate karte samay extra requests ki lagat par single-route request lagat mein katauti karne ke liye utsukta se vilay kiya jata hai.
  • priorityBoost (default 1.5): priorityRoutes ki single-request sambhavna par gunak; uchchatar un bundles ko aggressive roop se vilay karta hai.
  • requestCost (default 200000): uncompressed/unminified code ke bytes mein ek extra request ki anumanit lagat; bare value kam, bare hisse ki or poorvaagraha.

js

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Security model, Lockfile, Examples. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. URL import aapko local disk ke bajaay external sarvron se seedhe module import karne data hai: experimental: { urlImports: ['https://example.com/assets/', 'https://cdn.skypack.dev'] }, phir import { a, b, c } from 'https://example.com/assets/some/module.js'. har jagah common package import ka upyog kiya jata hai.

  • Security modal: keval un domain ka upyog karta hai jinhein aap bharosa karte hain - download code aapki machine par executed karta hai. experimental flag balon domain ki permission-list ko spasht karta hai; yojna URL ko Edge Runtime ke madhyam se browser saindboks mein import karne ki boundary hai. static hone tak vivek ka prayog karein.
  • Lockfile: Next.js ek next.lock directory banata hai (lockfile + prapt assets) jise must Git (gitignored) ke liye commit hai. next dev download karta hai aur naye khoje gaye URL ko lockfile mein import karta hai; next build lockfile ka upyog karta hai - aam taur par koi network request nahi hota hai, aur ek purana lockfile build ko fail kar data hai. exception: Cache-Control: no-cache ka jawab dene wale sansadhan ek no-cache lockfile entry prapt karte hain aur hamesha pratyek build par network se prapt hote hain. ONLY
  • Examples: SkyPack (import confetti from 'https://cdn.skypack.dev/canvas-confetti'); static image import (import logo from 'https://example.com/assets/logo.png' to <Image src={logo} placeholder="blur" />); CSS (background: url('https://example.com/assets/hero.jpg')); asset import (new URL('https://example.com/assets/file.txt', import.meta.url) → /_next/static/media/file.a9727b5d.txt) mein yooaarayela.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: experimental.useLightningcss (config option) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `lightningCssFeatures` (v16.2.0), Available features, Version history. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Experimental, production ke liye recommended nahi hai. webpack ke saath Lightning CSS (fast rast CSS transformer/minifier) ka upyog karne ke liye prayogik samarthana. iske bina, webpack default roop se postcss-preset-env ke saath PostCSS ka upyog karta hai. Turbopack default roop se Lightning CSS ka upyog karta hai kyonki yeh vikalp Turbopack par koi prabhav nahi padta; Turbopack hamesha webpack (default false) par Lightning CSS. experimental: { useLightningcss: true } disebal PostCSS ka upyog karta hai. Turbopack 14.2

  • lightningCssFeatures (v16.2.0): default roop se Lightning CSS decide karta hai ki tumhare browserslist targets se kaunsi CSS features transpile karni hain; ye option use override karta hai — include features ko hamesha transpile karne par force karta hai, exclude unhe kabhi transpile na karne par force karta hai. Dono webpack (jab useLightningcss on ho) aur Turbopack par lagu hote hain. Example: include: ['light-dark', 'oklab-colors'], exclude: ['nesting'].
  • Available features: nesting (CSS nesting), not-selector-list, dir-selector, lang-selector-list, is-selector, text-decoration-thickness-percent, media-interval-syntax, media-range-syntax, custom-media-queries, clamp-function, color-function, oklab-colors, lab-colors, p3-colors, hex-alpha-colors, space-separated-color-notation, font-family-system-ui, double-position-gradients, vendor-prefixes, logical-properties, light-dark. Composite groups: selectors (nesting, not-selector-list, dir-selector, lang-selector-list, is-selector), media-queries (media-interval-syntax, media-range-syntax, custom-media-queries), colors (color-function, oklab-colors, lab-colors, p3-colors, hex-alpha-colors, space-separated-color-notation, light-dark).
  • Version history: v14.2.0 Turbopack ka default CSS processor @swc/css se Lightning CSS me badla; useLightningcss Turbopack par ignore hone laga; v15.1.0 useSwcCss support Turbopack se hataya gaya; v16.2.0 lightningCssFeatures joda gaya.

TS7 installed karein: pnpm add -D typescript@^7 / npm install -D typescript@^7 / yarn add -D typescript@^7 / bun add -D typescript@^7.

  • BHaviour: Next.js abhi bhi next-env.d.ts aur route prakar generated karta hai aur chekar chalane se pahle iski recommended tsconfig settings lagu karta hai. TypeScript nidan seedhe tsc se mudrit kiye jate hain - Next.js-vishisht code frame aur error punarlekhan NOT lagu hote hain. configure kiye gaye tsconfig dwara chaynit puri project ki check ki jati hai, jismein testing files aur .next/dev/types shamil hain; --debug-build-paths is set ko simit nahi karta hai aur CLI chekar ke saath sanyukt hone par warning paida karta hai. typescript.tsconfigPath project ko tsc ko passed karne ka chayan karta hai; typescript.ignoreBuildErrors CLI chekar sahit type-cheking step ko chhor data hai.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: custom Webpack Config — next.config.js mein webpack function ko define karke Next.js ke webpack upyog ka vistar. Warning: webpack config mein parivartan semver dwara cover nahi kiye gaye hain - apne jokhim par aage barhein. optimization se pahle, check Next.js pahle se hi aapke upyog ke mamle ka support nahi karta hai: CSS imports/modules, Sass/SCSS imports/modules, Babel ko customize karna. aam taur par poochhe jaane wale features plagins ke roop mein upalabdh hain: @next/mdx, @next/bundle-analyzer.

  • The function:
js
  module.exports = {
    webpack: (
      config,
      { buildId, dev, isServer, defaultLoaders, nextRuntime, webpack }
    ) => {
      // Important: return the modified config
      return config
    },
  }
  • Executed teen bar — do bar server (nodejs / dhaar runtime) ke liye aur ek bar client ke liye; isServer ke saath alag karein.
  • Second tark gun: buildId (string - build ke beech unique pahchankarta); dev (Boolean - development mein compilation); isServer (Boolean - server-side ke liye sach, client-side ke liye jhooth); nextRuntime (String | aparibhashit - "edge" ya "nodejs" server-side ke liye; client-side ke liye undefined); defaultLoaders (object - Next.js ke internal default loader, e.g. babel = default babel-loader config).
  • Example: ek loader jorne ke aadhar par bebel loader (@next/mdx source se): config.module.rules.push({ test: /\.mdx/, use: [options.defaultLoaders.babel, { loader: '@mdx-js/loader', options: pluginOptions.options }] }), phir return config.
  • nextRuntime not: isServer sahi hai jab nextRuntime "edge" ya "nodejs" hai; nextRuntime "edge" vartaman mein keval barhat runtime mein proxy aur Server Components ke liye hai.
  • Fark banam App Router: saman webpack config vikalp App Router ke liye maujud hai; yeh keval tabhi lagu hota hai jab webpack ke saath build - Turbopack ise andekha karta hai (iske bajaay turbopack config ka upyog karein).

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: jab Web Vitals muddon ko debugging karte hain, to attribution ne samasya ke source ko point kiya - e.g. CLS ke liye, pahla element jo single sabse bada layout shift ke dauraan moved ho gaya; LCP ke liye, LCP se related element (aur yadi yeh ek image hai, to image sansadhan ke URL ko customize karne ke liye). visheshata PerformanceEventTiming, PerformanceNavigationTiming aur PerformanceResourceTiming entries ki tarah gahan jankari data hai.

  • Usage: default roop se disabled; per metric ko next.config.js: experimental: { webVitalsAttribution: ['CLS', 'LCP'] } mein enable karein. valid maan NextWebVitalsMetric prakar mein sabhi web-vitals metric hain.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)

TypeScript (config page)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai TypeScript (config page). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: TypeScript (config page) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Using TypeScript 7, `next-env.d.ts`, Type-checking config files, Statically Typed Links, Type IntelliSense for Environment Variables, Static Generation / SSR types (Pages Router). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js TypeScript-first — built-in TS, auto-instoling package aur create-next-app ke saath settings ko configure karna hai. ek maujuda project mein TS jorne ke liye, .ts/.tsx mein ek file ka naam badlein, next dev/next build ko chalaein - auto-install ko deps karein aur recommended vikalpon ke saath tsconfig.json ko joda gaya hai. yadi aapke paas jsconfig.json hai, to apne paths compiler vikalp ko naye tsconfig.json mein copy karein aur jsconfig.json ko hata dein.

  • TypeScript 7 use karna: TS7 me abhi tak koi JavaScript compiler API nahi hai; typescript@^7 ke saath install karo. Next.js default roop se project-local tsc CLI use karta hai (koi extra config nahi); JS compiler API use karne ke liye iske bajaye experimental.useTypeScriptCli: false set karo. CLI checking native tsc diagnostics print karta hai (koi Next.js code frames/route error rewriting nahi); tsconfig dwara selected poore project ko check karta hai (test files aur .next/dev/types samet); next build --debug-build-paths use narrow nahi karta (warn karta hai); typescript.tsconfigPath tsc ko pass hone wali config choose karta hai; typescript.ignoreBuildErrors CLI checker samet type checking skip karta hai.
  • next-env.d.ts: project root me generated; Next.js type definitions ko reference karta hai taaki TS non-code imports (images, stylesheets) aur Next.js types ko pehchane. next dev, next build, next typegen dwara regenerate hota hai. Next.js dwara managed — manually edit mat karo; .gitignore me jodo (agar tracked hai to git se hatao); tsconfig.json ke include array me hona chahiye (create-next-app ye karta hai).
  • Config files ki type-checking: import type { NextConfig } from 'next' ke saath next.config.ts (v15.0.0+). next.config.ts me module resolution default roop se CommonJS tak limited hai; ESM syntax Node.js native TypeScript resolver (Node v22.10.0+, process.features.typescript) ke through available hai; v22.18.0+ se default enabled, pehle NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-transform-types se opt in karo. CommonJS projects ke liye, next.config.mts prefer karo (top-level await + dynamic import supported); ESM projects ("type": "module") ke liye, next.config.ts ko seedhe ESM ke saath likho. next.config.js ke saath, // @ts-check + /** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */ JSDoc use karo.
  • Statically Typed Links: typedRoutes: true + TypeScript ke saath opt in karo. next/link href ke liye Pages aur App Router dono me kaam karta hai; App Router me next/navigation methods (push, replace, prefetch) ko bhi type karta hai; Pages Router me next/router methods ko type NAHI karta. Literal href strings validate hoti hain; non-literal hrefs ko as Route cast chahiye. Next.js saare routes ke saath .next/types me ek link definition generate karta hai (next typegen / next dev / next build ke through). Bina create-next-app ke, .next/types/**/*.ts ko tsconfig.json include me jodo. Proxy-defined redirect routes bhi shamil hain ('/proxy-redirect' as Route cast karo). next/link wrap karne wale custom components ke liye, ek generic use karo: function Card<T extends string>({ href }: { href: Route<T> | URL }). Data structure pattern: type NavItem<T extends string = string> = { href: T; label: string } aur NavItem<Route>[].
  • Environment Variables ke liye type IntelliSense: experimental.typedEnv: true + TypeScript ke saath opt in karo. Next.js .next/types me ek .d.ts generate karta hai jisme loaded env vars shamil hain; duplicates per env load order dedupe hote hain. Types dev runtime par load hue vars par based hain — default roop se .env.production* exclude hota hai; production-specific vars shamil karne ke liye NODE_ENV=production ke saath next dev chalao.
  • Static Generation / SSR types (Pages Router): GetStaticProps, GetStaticPaths, GetServerSideProps types — satisfies (TS 4.9+) use karo: export const getStaticProps = (async (context) => { /*... */ }) satisfies GetStaticProps.
  • API Routes ke saath: NextApiRequest, NextApiResponse (response data ke liye generic: NextApiResponse<Data>).
  • Custom App ke saath: next/app se AppProps — export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps).
  • Incremental type checking: v10.2.1 ke baad se supported jab tsconfig.json me enabled ho — bade apps me type checking tez karta hai.
  • Custom tsconfig path: typescript: { tsconfigPath: 'tsconfig.build.json' } (NODE_ENV se switch ho sakta hai). Kyun: locally strict settings rakhte hue migrate karna, CI me monorepos (alag standards ke saath shared deps) me checks relax karna. tsconfig.build.json base ko extend karta hai aur useUnknownInCatchVariables: false set karta hai. IDEs abhi bhi tsconfig.json padhte hain; dev me sirf tsconfig.json watch hota hai (optional file edit karne ke baad dev server restart karo); configured file next dev, next build, next typegen me use hoti hai.
  • Production me TS errors disable karna: typescript: { ignoreBuildErrors: true } khatarnak roop se type errors ke saath builds ko allow karta hai (type checking puri tarah skip); tsc --noEmit khud chalao (jaise CI/CD me).
  • Custom type declarations: kabhi next-env.d.ts (auto-generated) edit mat karo; ek nayi file banao (jaise new-types.d.ts) aur use next-env.d.ts aur .next/types/**/*.ts ke saath tsconfig.json include me jodo.
  • Version changes: v10.2.1 incremental type checking; v12.0.0 SWC default roop se TS/TSX compile karta hai; v13.2.0 statically typed links (beta); v15.0.0 next.config.ts support.
  • App Router se fark: typed links dono routers ko cover karte hain, lekin App Router next/navigation methods ko bhi type karta hai jabki Pages Router ke next/router methods type NAHI hote; Pages Router data-fetching types GetStaticProps/GetServerSideProps hain (is router me koi Server Component/params typing nahi).
