Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai ESLint (config page). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: ESLint (config page) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Setup (ESLint CLI, flat config), `@next/eslint-plugin-next` rules (recommended), `next lint` removal, Monorepo root directory, Disabling rules, With TypeScript. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js eslint-config-next pradan karta hai, jo @next/eslint-plugin-next ko bundle karta hai aur eslint-plugin-react aur eslint-plugin-react-hooks se niyam-set ki sifarish karta hai. teen config: eslint-config-next (base — Next.js + React + React hook niyam, JS aur TS); eslint-config-next/core-web-vitals (base + upgrade Core Web Vitals-impacting niymon warning se errors tak - adhikansh pariyojnaon ke liye sifarish ki, build-next-app dwara auto-shamil); eslint-config-next/typescript (TypeScript-vishisht niyam typescript-eslint se, aadhar ya kor-web-vivaran ke saath upyog karte hain).

  • Setup (ESLint CLI, phlait config): 1) pnpm add -D eslint eslint-config-next (npm npm i -D eslint eslint-config-next, yarn, ban samtuly). 2) defineConfig([...nextVitals, globalIgnores(['.next/**', 'out/**', 'build/**', 'next-env.d.ts'])]) ke saath eslint.config.mjs banaein. 3) run pnpm exec eslint. / npx eslint. / yarn eslint. / bunx eslint.. ESLint 9 aur 10 (ESLint 10 ko Node ^20.19.0, ^22.13.0, ya >=24) ka support karta hai; eslint-config-next@16.4.0 default React sanskaran ka pata lagana ESLint 10 ke saath kaam karta hai (kisi bhi settings.react.version workaround ko hata dein); kuchh shamil plagins abhi tak sahakarmiyon mein ESLint 10 ki list nahi hain - package mainejar sakht saathiyon ke saath warn/fail kar sakte hain.
  • @next/eslint-plugin-next niyam (recommended): google-font-display ( ke saath font-display ko lagu karein) google-font-preconnect inline-script-id (inline next/script par id ko lagu karta hai) next-script-for-ga ( inline script ke liye next/script ko pasand karte hain), no-assign-module-variable no-async-client-component no-before-interactive-script-outside-document (keval pages/_document.js mein beforeInteractive) no-css-tags no-document-import-in-page no-duplicate-head no-head-element no-head-import-in-document no-html-link-for-pages (antarraashtreey pages ke liye koi <a> nahi), no-img-element (Slower LCP) adhik baindvidth no-page-custom-font no-script-component-in-head22X no-sync-scripts24 no-typos (Next.js data-fetching karyon mein taaippos), no-unwanted-polyfillio. warnings/errors inline dekhne ke liye ek editor ekikaran ka upyog karein. no-styled-jsx-in-document no-title-in-document-head Google Fonts Google Analytics
  • next lint hatane: Next.js 16, next lint ke saath shuru REMOVED hai; next.config.js mein eslint vikalp ki zaroorat nahi hai aur ise surakshit roop se hataya jaa sakta hai. ek codemod ESLint CLI ko migrate karne ke liye maujud hai.
  • Monorepo root directory: @next/eslint-plugin-next batata hai jahan application eslint.config.mjs mein settings: { next: { rootDir: 'packages/my-app/' } } ke madhyam se rahta hai. "packages/*/"
  • Disabling niyam: ne rules (e.g) mein override kiya. 'react/no-unescaped-entities': 'off', '@next/next/no-page-custom-font': 'off'.
  • TypeScript ke saath: create-next-app --typescript ne eslint-config-next/typescript (plugin:@typescript-eslint/recommended par aadharit) ko joda: ...nextVitals,...nextTs ko phailaayaa. TypeScript 7: eslint-config-next ko abhi bhi typescript-eslint ke liye TS 6 compiler API ki requirement hai; TS7 ko seedhe typescript brek ESLint config loading ke roop mein installed karna. npm ke saath aliases ka upyog karein: "@typescript/native": "npm:typescript@7.0.2", "typescript": "npm:@typescript/typescript6@6.0.2" — TS6 API linting ke liye jabki tsc TS7 chalata hai; tsc6 TS6.
  • With Prettier: ne praaroopan-rule sangharsh se bachne ke liye eslint-config-prettier (flat: import prettier from 'eslint-config-prettier/flat') ko jor diya.
  • Lint charanabaddh files: buildEslintCommand ke saath .lintstagedrc.js → eslint --fix <filenames> *.{js,jsx,ts,tsx} ke liye.
  • Migrating maujuda config: do drishtikon — (a) seedhe plugin ka upyog karein (@next/eslint-plugin-next, plugins: { '@next/next': nextPlugin }, rules: {...nextPlugin.configs.recommended.rules }) jab aapke paas sangharshasheel plagins (airbnb, pratikriya-app, pratikriya, pratikriya-hook, jsx-a11y, import), custom parserOptions (custom Babel), ya custom halkon ke saath eslint-plugin-import; (b) seedha setup ke liye apne array (...nextConfig) mein config phailaa hua hai - config kram mein lagu hote hain, baad mein pahle niymon ko override karte hain.
  • Version parivartan: v16.0.0 next lint + eslint config vikalp hata diya gaya (codemod upalabdh); v16.4.0 eslint-config-next joda gaya ESLint 10 compatibility incl. default React sanskaran ka pata lagane.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
no-html-link-for-pages, no-img-element, no-sync-scripts aur google-font-* niyam maujud hain kyonki plain <a>, <img> aur async scripts ne Next.js ke client-side routing, image optimization aur font optimization ko hara diya - jhukaav dhanche ke performance modal ko lagu karta hai.

create-next-app CLI

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai create-next-app CLI. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: create-next-app CLI — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Options, Interactive prompts, Linter options, Examples, Difference vs App Router. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: create-next-app CLI default template se ek naya Next.js app banata hai ya ek public GitHub repo se ek udaharan banata hai - shuruaat karne ka sabse aasan tareeka. upyog: pnpm create next-app [project-name] [options] / npx create-next-app@latest [project-name] [options] / yarn create next-app / bun create next-app.

  • Options: -h/--help; -v/--version; --no-* ne chookon (e.g) ko reject kar diya. --no-ts; --ts/--typescript (default); --js/--javascript; --tailwind (default); --react-compiler; --cache-components ( ke liye default); --eslint; --biome; --no-linter; --app (App Router project); --api (keval route handlers ke saath); --src-dir; --turbopack (folt dwara enable), --webpack; --import-alias <alias> (default @/*); --empty; --use-npm/--use-pnpm/--use-yarn/--use-bun; -e/--example [name] [github-url]; --skip-install27 / --no-agent-feedback (prepare anaamit Next.js pratikriya samiksha ke liye; kabhi bhi experimental.agentFeedback: false ke saath inactive); --yes (sabhi vikalpon ke liye pichli priorities ya default ka upyog karein). --example-path <path> --reset-preferences --disable-git --agents-md --agent-feedback App Router AGENTS.md
  • interactive sanket: "aapki project ka naam kya hai? phir default (TypeScript, ESLint, No React Compiler, Tailwind CSS, No src / directory, App Router, Cache Components, AGENTS.md, agent feedback) ya "pichli settings ka upyog karein" ya "setting ko customize karein" - jo puchhta hai: TypeScript?; linter (ESLint / Biome / None); React Compiler?; Tailwind CSS? import alias (@/* default) ko customize karein? iske baad, yeh folder banata hai aur dependency installed karta hai. src/ AGENTS.md Cache Components App Router Next.js
  • Linter vikalp: ESLint (paramparik, @next/eslint-plugin-next); Biome (fast aadhunik linter+formatter sanyojan ESLint+Prettier, built-in Next.js/React support); koi nahi (skip, baad mein jorein).
  • Examples: official udaharan - pnpm create next-app --example [example-name] [your-project-name] (github.com/vercel/next.js/tree/canary/examples par list); kisi bhi public GitHub udaharan - --example "https://github.com/.../" [your-project-name].
  • Fark banam App Router: CLI router-agnostic hai; --app ek Pages Router project ke liye App Router ko chunta hai, "No" ko "Would aap App Router ka upyog karna chahte hain? aur CLI ke bajaay pages/ machaana. app/

next CLI

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai next CLI. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: next CLI — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Commands, `next dev` options, `next build` options, `next start` options, `next info`, `next telemetry`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js CLI viksit karta hai, banata hai, aur apne application shuru karta hai. upyog: pnpm next [command] [options] / npx next [command] [options] / yarn next / bunx next. npm run ke saath, CLI jhande se pahle -- ka upyog karein, isliye npm unhein aage badhata hai ( pnpm/yarn/bun ke liye required nahi). bina kisi command ke next chalana next dev ke liye ek aaliyaa hai.

  • Commands: dev (HMR ke saath dev mode, error reporting); build (optimized production build, route info); start (production mode — pehle build karo); info (bug reports ke liye system details); telemetry (anonymous telemetry enable/disable); typegen (bina full build ke TS definitions generate karna); upgrade (Next.js upgrade karna); analyze (Turbopack ke saath bundle output analyze karna, koi build artifacts nahi).
  • next dev options: [directory] (default current dir); --turbopack (force, default; --turbo bhi); --webpack (iske bajaye webpack use karo); -p/--port (default 3000, env PORT); -H/--hostname (default 0.0.0.0, LAN devices ke liye useful); --experimental-https (self-signed cert), --experimental-https-key, --experimental-https-cert, --experimental-https-ca; --experimental-upload-trace <traceUrl> (debug trace subset remote URL par report karna); --experimental-cpu-prof (V8 inspector profiles exit par .next-profiles/ me save). Dev .next/dev (na ki .next) par output karta hai isliye next dev aur next build concurrently chal sakte hain.
  • next build options: --turbopack (default), --webpack; --analyze (ek Turbopack build ke dauraan interactive analyzer ke liye bundle analysis data); -d/--debug (verbose output — rewrites, redirects, headers); --profile (React production profiling); --no-mangling (mangling disable — sirf debug); --experimental-app-only (sirf App Router routes build karo); --experimental-build-mode [mode] (choices compile, generate, default default); --debug-prerender (dev me prerender errors debug karna); --debug-build-paths=<patterns> (sirf specific routes build karo); --experimental-cpu-prof. Route table symbols: ○ (Static — static content ke roop me prerendered), ƒ (Dynamic — on demand server-rendered).
  • next start options: [directory]; -p/--port (default 3000, env PORT); -H/--hostname (default 0.0.0.0); --keepAliveTimeout <ms> (inactive connections band karne se pehle max wait); --experimental-cpu-prof.
  • next info: OS platform/arch/version, memory, CPU cores, binaries (Node, npm, Yarn, pnpm), package versions (next, react, react-dom), aur Next.js config print karta hai — GitHub issues report karne ke liye. Option --verbose extra debugging info collect karta hai.
  • next telemetry: anonymous telemetry optional hai; --enable / --disable.
  • next typegen: bina full build ke routes (plus next-env.d.ts) ke liye TS definitions generate karta hai — IDE autocomplete aur CI type-checking ke liye: next typegen && tsc --noEmit (pehle route types sirf next dev/next build ke dauraan generate hote the, isliye direct tsc --noEmit unhe validate nahi kar sakta tha). Output <distDir>/types par (dev me aam taur par .next/dev/types, production me .next/types). Production build phase use karke next.config load karta hai — env vars/deps available hone chahiye. Type-checking se pehle next typegen chalao taaki next-env.d.ts ka exist hona ensure ho (use .gitignore me jodo).
  • next upgrade: --revision <revision> (jaise latest, canary, 15.0.0; current release channel ke liye default); --verbose; --agent [type] — security, latest, ya experimental-future use karke ek coding agent ke saath upgrade; experimental.agentUpgrade ya security ke liye defect; --revision ke saath combine nahi ho sakta.
  • next analyze: Turbopack (JS, CSS, dusri assets) ke saath bundle output analyze karta hai; ek application build produce NAHI karta. Default roop se analysis ke baad ek local server (port 4000) start hota hai bundle structure explore karne ke liye — route se filter karo, client/server views switch karo, full import chains dekho, server-to-client boundaries aur dynamic imports me imports trace karo. --output snapshot + UI files ko bina serve kiye <distDir>/diagnostics/analyze par likhta hai; --snapshot <name> ek named snapshot save karta hai; --no-mangling; --profile; --port <port>. next analyze export --snapshot audit-1 > graph.jsonl ek saved snapshot ko JSON Lines ke roop me export karta hai (koi re-analysis nahi, koi UI nahi); export options: --snapshot, --route <route>, --dist-dir <directory>.
  • Examples:
  • Prerender errors debug karna: next build --debug-prerender — server minification (experimental.serverMinification = false, experimental.turbopackMinify = false) disable karta hai, server source maps (experimental.serverSourceMaps = true) generate karta hai, pehle prerender error ke baad continue rehta hai (experimental.prerenderEarlyExit = false). Sirf dev — is tarah ke builds deploy mat karo (performance impact).
  • Specific routes build karna: next build --debug-build-paths="app/page.tsx" / "app/page.tsx,pages/index.tsx" / "app/(marketing)/about/page.tsx" / glob "app/**/page.tsx" / "pages/*.tsx" / ! ke saath exclude: "app/**/page.tsx,!app/admin/**". App aur Pages Routers dono ke liye kaam karta hai; src/ paths src/ prefix ke saath ya bina resolve hote hain; sirf matching routes route table me dikhte hain (App Router me built-in /_not-found bhi shamil hai). --debug-prerender ke saath combine karo. Note: CLI checker ke saath, --debug-build-paths type checking ko limit nahi karta.
  • Port badalna: next dev -p 4000 ya PORT=4000 next dev. PORT ko .env me set nahi kiya ja sakta — koi code start hone se pehle HTTP server bind hota hai.
  • Dev me HTTPS: next dev --experimental-https (mkcert ke through self-signed cert, https://localhost:3000); --experimental-https-key/--experimental-https-cert/--experimental-https-ca ke saath custom key/cert/CA. Sirf dev — production ko properly issued certificates chahiye.
  • Proxy timeout: ek downstream proxy (jaise AWS ELB/ALB) ke peeche, proxy ki tulna me Next ka timeout LARGER set karo, warna Node connection terminate kar deta hai jabki proxy use reuse karne ki koshish karta rehta hai: next start --keepAliveTimeout 70000.
  • Node args: NODE_OPTIONS='--throw-deprecation' next, NODE_OPTIONS='-r esm' next, NODE_OPTIONS='--inspect' next.
  • CPU profiling: next build/dev/start --experimental-cpu-prof → .next-profiles/ me .cpuprofile files, Chrome DevTools Performance tab me kholo. Profile naam: dev-main-* / dev-server-* (dev), build-main-* / build-turbopack-* ya build-webpack-client-*/server-*/edge-server-* (build), start-main-* (start).
  • Version changes: v15.4.0 --debug-prerender; v15.5.0 next typegen; v16.0.0 JS bundle size metrics next build se hataye gaye; v16.1.0 next upgrade + next experimental-analyze jode gaye; v16.4.0 next analyze export joda gaya.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
next dev banam next start (dev HMR banam prodakshan server, ko pahle build ki requirement hoti hai); kyon dev production .next/dev (concurrent dev+build); next typegen maujud hai isliye CI ek full build ke bina routes ki check kar sakte hain; --debug-build-paths ek bare app mein ek route ko debug karne ka sabse tez tareeka hai.

Adapters (index)

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters (index). Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters (index) — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: build aur valid deployment adapter jo Next.js ke build aur runtime modal ke saath ekikrit hote hain. up-page:

  • config - ek custom deployment adapter ka upyog karne ke liye adapterPath ya NEXT_ADAPTER_PATH ko configure karein.
  • ek adapter banana - NextAdapter intarafes ko karyanvit karne wala ek adapter module banaein.
  • API sandarbh - NextAdapter intarafes mein modifyConfig aur onBuildComplete ke liye sandarbha.
  • Testing Adapters - Next.js compatibility testing dohan aur custom lifecycle script ke saath adapter ko valid karte hain.
  • @next/routing ke saath routing - edeptar mein Next.js route match behavior ko lagu karne ke liye @next/routing ka upyog karein.
  • Runtime Integration - kaise build-time adapter aur runtime cache intaraphes ek saath kaam karte hain.
  • Invoking Entrypoints - adapter runtime sandarbh ke saath Node.js aur Edge build entrypoints ko invited karta hai.
  • Output Types - edeptar ke sanpark mein aane wale sabhi build output prakaron ke liye sandarbha.
  • Routing Information - onBuildComplete mein expose routing steps aur route kshetron ke liye sandarbha.
  • Use Cases - deployment adapter karyanvayan ke liye common pattern aur udaharan.
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
adapter is tarah hain ki kaise Next.js gair-versal platforms par deploy karta hai - ve build (modifyConfig, onBuildComplete) ko hook karte hain aur runtime/cache ekikaran pradan karte hain, balki har platform Next.js hard-coding ke bajaye.

Adapters — Creating an Adapter

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Creating an Adapter. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Creating an Adapter — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Interface, Minimal adapter, Two hooks. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: ek adapter ek module hai jo NextAdapter intarafes ko lagu karne wali ek object ka export karta hai (: import type { NextAdapter } from 'next' se prakar ka import karein). next

  • Interface:
typescript
  type Route = {
    source?: string
    sourceRegex: string
    destination?: string
    headers?: Record<string, string>
    has?: RouteHas[]
    missing?: RouteHas[]
    status?: number
    priority?: boolean
  }

  export interface AdapterOutputs {
    pages: Array<AdapterOutput['PAGES']>
    middleware?: AdapterOutput['MIDDLEWARE']
    appPages: Array<AdapterOutput['APP_PAGE']>
    pagesApi: Array<AdapterOutput['PAGES_API']>
    appRoutes: Array<AdapterOutput['APP_ROUTE']>
    prerenders: Array<AdapterOutput['PRERENDER']>
    staticFiles: Array<AdapterOutput['STATIC_FILE']>
  }

  export interface NextAdapter {
    name: string
    modifyConfig?: (
      config: NextConfigComplete,
      ctx: { phase: PHASE_TYPE; nextVersion: string; projectDir: string }
    ) => Promise<NextConfigComplete> | NextConfigComplete
    onBuildComplete?: (ctx: {
      routing: {
        beforeMiddleware: Array<Route>
        middlewareMatchers: Array<Route>
        beforeFiles: Array<Route>
        afterFiles: Array<Route>
        dynamicRoutes: Array<Route>
        onMatch: Array<Route>
        fallback: Array<Route>
        shouldNormalizeNextData: boolean
        rsc: RoutesManifest['rsc']
      }
      outputs: AdapterOutputs
      projectDir: string
      repoRoot: string
      distDir: string
      config: NextConfigComplete
      nextVersion: string
      buildId: string
    }) => Promise<void> | void
  }
  • Minimal adapter:
js
  /** @type {import('next').NextAdapter} */
  const adapter = {
    name: 'my-custom-adapter',
    async modifyConfig(config, { phase }) {
      if (phase === 'phase-production-build') {
        return { ...config /* modifications */ }
      }
      return config
    },
    async onBuildComplete({ routing, outputs, projectDir, repoRoot, distDir, config, nextVersion, buildId }) {
      console.log('Build completed with', outputs.pages.length, 'pages')
      console.log('Build ID:', buildId)
      console.log('Dynamic routes:', routing.dynamicRoutes.length)
      for (const page of outputs.pages) console.log('Page:', page.pathname, 'at', page.filePath)
      for (const apiRoute of outputs.pagesApi) console.log('API Route:', apiRoute.pathname, 'at', apiRoute.filePath)
      for (const appPage of outputs.appPages) console.log('App Page:', appPage.pathname, 'at', appPage.filePath)
      for (const prerender of outputs.prerenders) console.log('Prerendered:', prerender.pathname)
    },
  }
  module.exports = adapter
  • do hook: modifyConfig config loading ke dauraan chalata hai (build step ke anusar config adjusted kar sakte hain, e.g). phase-production-build; onBuildComplete full routing jankari aur sabhi output ke saath build ke baad chalta hai, isliye adapter unhein platform ke format mein deploy/translate kar sakta hai.

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `async onBuildComplete(context)`. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

async modifyConfig(config, context): ne kisi bhi CLI command ke liye bulaya jo config ke sanshodhan ki permission dene ke liye next.config.js ko load karta hai. parameter: config (full Next.js config object); context.phase (vartaman build step); context.nextVersion; context.projectDir (project directory ke liye amoort path). sanshodhit config object (async ho sakta hai) lauta hai.

  • async onBuildComplete(context): ne build pura karne ke baad vistrit route aur production jankari ke saath bulaya. parameter:
  • context.routing - routing step aur metadata: beforeMiddleware (madhyveyar se pahle executed roots - header aur redirect handling shamil hain); middlewareMatchers (beech wala maichar paribhaashaaon ka upyog yeh tay karne ke liye kiya jata hai ki midalaveyar ko request ke liye bulaya jana chahiye); beforeFiles (file system root match se pahle check kiye gaye routes ko phir se likhna); afterFiles (file system root match ke baad check kiye gaye route); dynamicRoutes (dynamic route match talika); onMatch (ek saphal match ke baad lagu roots, e.g. immutable static-asset cache header); fallback (antim phir likhne wale fallback route); shouldNormalizeNextData (chahe /_next/data/<buildId>/... URL ko match ke dauraan samanyikrit kiya jana chahiye); rsc ( Server Components routing ke liye root metadata). React
  • context.outputs - sabhi prakar ke production ka event kiya jata hai.
  • context.projectDir, context.repoRoot (detected repository root), context.distDir (build production dir), context.config (Final config with modifyConfig lagu), context.nextVersion, context.buildId (unique build pahchankarta).

Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Harness environment variables, Deploy script contract, Logs script contract, Cleanup script contract. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js valid edeptar ke liye ek testing dohan pradan karta hai - end-to-end pariniyojit parikshanon ko chala raha hai. udaharan GitHub action varkaflo (.github/workflows/test-e2e-deploy.yml, workflow_dispatch nextjsRef input ke saath canary ko default roop se, optional naaitlee kron): ek build job check out adapter repo aur vercel/next.js (set ref, pheephaa 25 par), Node 20 + pnpm (korpaik), installs/builds Next.js (pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm install) installed karta hai, Playwright Chromium installed karta hai, adapter banata hai, aur nextjs + adapter + ~/.cache/ms-playwright cache karta hai; ek test naukree (maitriks 16 group 1/16... 16/16, asaphal-fast jhutha, 60 minat timeout) cache ko restore karta hai, node run-tests.js --timings -g ${{ matrix.group }} -c 2 --type e2e ko env NEXT_TEST_MODE: deploy, NEXT_E2E_TEST_TIMEOUT: 240000, NEXT_EXTERNAL_TESTS_FILTERS: test/deploy-tests-manifest.json, ADAPTER_DIR, IS_TURBOPACK_TEST: 1, NEXT_TEST_JOB: 1, NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: 1 aur teen script pathon ke saath chalata hai.

  • Harness environment variables: NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_SCRIPT_PATH (executable jo prithak testing app banata hai aur deploy karta hai); NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_LOGS_SCRIPT_PATH (us deployment ke liye build/runtime log return karta hai); NEXT_TEST_CLEANUP_SCRIPT_PATH (optional - run ke baad deployment ko phaad data hai).
  • Deploy script anubandh: ne cwd = prithak asthayi app ko haarnes banata hai. viphalta par gair-zero se bahar niklein; deployment URL ko stdout mein print karein (niyantran ko verify karne ke liye upyog kiya jata hai - stdout ke liye aur kuchh bhi nahi likhein); nidan karya directory mein stderr ya files ke liye jate hain. deploy aur log script alag-alag prakriyaaein hain - kaam karne wali directory mein files ke liye sajha data (build ID, server log) banaye rakha hai. udaharan scripts/e2e-deploy.sh: testing app ke package.json mein ek file: dependency ke roop mein adapter ko injekt karta hai, NEXT_ADAPTER_PATH="${ADAPTER_DIR}/dist/index.js" set karta hai, pnpm build chalata hai, .next/BUILD_ID ko padhta hai, BUILD_ID, DEPLOYMENT_ID, NEXT_SUPPORTS_IMMUTABLE_ASSETS likhte hain (yadi adapter immutable static assets ko enable karta hai to "1" set karta hai), to deploys/starts app ko set karta hai aur URL (e.g) ko echoes karta hai. http://127.0.0.1:3000. .adapter-build.log
  • Logs script anubandh: cwd = prithak app ke saath chal raha hai; NEXT_TEST_DIR aur NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_URL env vars prapt karta hai. output mein BUILD_ID:, DEPLOYMENT_ID:, NEXT_SUPPORTS_IMMUTABLE_ASSETS: se shuru hone wali lines shamil honi chahiye; un markers ke baad, debugging ke liye kisi bhi extra build/server loga. pattern: pariniyojit script mein .adapter-build.log aur .adapter-server.log likha gaya hai; log script un files ko phir se chalati hai.
  • Cleanup script anubandh: cwd = prithak app ke saath chal raha hai; NEXT_TEST_DIR aur NEXT_TEST_DEPLOY_URL prapt karta hai; deployment script dwara banaye gaye sansadhanon ko saaf karta hai; testing pura hone ke baad chalta hai.

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Routing with @next/routing. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Routing with @next/routing — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: `resolveRoutes()` returns, Example. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: onBuildComplete se data ke saath Next.js route match behavior ko pun: generated karne ke liye @next/routing ka upyog karein:

typescript
  import { resolveRoutes } from '@next/routing'

  const pathnames = [
    ...outputs.pages,
    ...outputs.pagesApi,
    ...outputs.appPages,
    ...outputs.appRoutes,
    ...outputs.staticFiles,
  ].map((output) => output.pathname)

  const result = await resolveRoutes({
    url: new URL(requestUrl),
    buildId,
    basePath: config.basePath || '',
    i18n: config.i18n,
    headers: new Headers(requestHeaders),
    requestBody, // ReadableStream
    pathnames,
    routes: routing,
    invokeMiddleware: async (ctx) => {
      // platform-specific middleware invocation
      return {}
    },
  })
  • resolveRoutes() return: middlewareResponded (true jab midalaveyar pahle se hi ek pratikriya bhej diya - adapter ko NOT ko ek access point ka invocation karna chahiye); externalRewrite (ek URL jab routing ek external punarlekhan destination ke liye hal); redirect ({ url: URL, status }) jab request ko redirect kiya jana chahiye); resolvedPathname ( dwara chaynit root ka naam) - dynamic routes ke liye match template, e.g. /blog/[slug]; resolvedQuery ( ke baad antim query ne khoj param ko joda ya badal diya); invocationTarget (concrete pathname + match route ke liye bulane ke liye query); resolvedHeaders (Rubting ke dauraan header added/modified ke saath ek Headers object); status (HTTP sthiti routing dwara set, e.g) ek redirect ya phir punarlekhan niyam se; routeMatches (dynamic route segments se nikaale gaye naam ke maichon ke rikord). Next.js rewrites/middleware
  • Example: /blog/post-1?draft=1 match /blog/[slug]?slug=post-1 → resolvedPathname /blog/[slug] hai jabki invocationTarget.pathname /blog/post-1 hai.

Adapters — Runtime Integration

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Runtime Integration. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Runtime Integration — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Adapter (build-time), Cache Interfaces (runtime), Handler context. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: The Deployment Adapter API ek build-time intarafes hai - yeh aapke pletform ko batata hai ki kya banaya gaya tha aur kaise requests ko root karne ke liye. Runtime behavior (request handling, streaming, caching) ko Next.js server dwara khud aur cache intaraphes cacheHandler aur cacheHandlers dwara sambhala jata hai. saath mein ve full manch ekikaran satah banate hain:

  • Adapter (build-time): prakriyaaein production ka build karti hain, routing ko configure karti hain, manch-vishisht buniyadi dhanche ko installed karti hain.
  • Cache Interfaces (Runtime): cacheHandler, ISR/server cache storej ka prabandhan karta hai aur udaharanon mein revalidation rakhta hai; cacheHandlers ne 'use cache' directive baikeinds aur tag samanvay ko configure kiya hai.
  • Handler sandarbh: jab access points ko run karte hain, to edeptar Next.js handler ko ctx objekt paas karte hain. pramukh field:
  • ctx.waitUntil - ek Promise accept karne wala karya; pratikriya ke baad server rahit karya ko jivit rakhta hai taaki cache revalidation ko pura kiya jaa sake.
  • requestMeta.onCacheEntryV2 (addRequestMeta ke madhyam se set) - ek callback firing jab ek cache entry generated hoti hai ya dekhee jati hai; ALL cache opreshans (keval PPR) ka inspect karein aur apne platform ke storej backend par cache update ka prachar karein. udaharan ke liye, jisne request ko sambhala; bahu-sansthaa deployment ke liye, adapter ko sajha storage ke liye adyatanon ka prachar karna chahiye ("How Revalidation Works" ko samanvay pattern ke liye dekhein).

Adapters — Invoking Entrypoints

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Invoking Entrypoints. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Invoking Entrypoints — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Node.js runtime (`runtime: 'nodejs'`), Edge runtime (`runtime: 'edge'`) — DEPRECATED. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: build output entrypoints ek handler(..., ctx) intarafes ka upyog karte hain, jismein runtime-vishisht request/response prakar hote hain.

  • Node.js runtime (runtime: 'nodejs'):
typescript
  handler(
    req: IncomingMessage,
    res: ServerResponse,
    ctx: {
      waitUntil?: (promise: Promise<void>) => void
      requestMeta?: RequestMeta
    }
  ): Promise<void>

adapter internal par bharosa karne ke bajaay seedhe requestMeta par sahayakon ko paas kar sakte hain. supported kshetron mein hostname, revalidate, render404 shamil hain:

ts
  await handler(req, res, {
    requestMeta: {
      relativeProjectDir: '.', // Relative path from process.cwd() to the Next.js project directory
      hostname: '127.0.0.1', // Optional hostname used by route handlers when constructing absolute URLs
      revalidate: async ({ urlPath, headers, opts }) => { /* platform-specific revalidate implementation */ },
      render404: async (req, res, parsedUrl, setHeaders) => { /* platform-specific 404 rendering for pages router notFound: true */ },
    },
  })

prasangik kor files: packages/next/src/build/templates/app-page.ts, app-route.ts, pages-api.ts.

  • Edge runtime (runtime: 'edge') - DEPRECATED: naye routes ko Node.js runtime ka upyog karna chahiye.
typescript
  handler(
    request: Request,
    ctx: {
      waitUntil?: (prom: Promise<void>) => void
      signal?: AbortSignal
      requestMeta?: RequestMeta
    }
  ): Promise<Response>

runtime: 'edge' output ke liye, Next.js kainonikal metadata ke saath output.edgeRuntime pradan karta hai: { modulePath: string, entryKey: string, handlerExport: string } (handlerExport vartaman mein 'handler' hai). kinaare ke runtime ke baad loads/evaluates ko modulePath ke liye chankne ke baad, global kinaare entry registry (globalThis._ENTRIES) se access parhne ke liye entryKey ka upyog karein, phir handlerExport ko invited karein:

ts
  const entry = await globalThis._ENTRIES[output.edgeRuntime.entryKey]
  const handler = entry[output.edgeRuntime.handlerExport]
  await handler(request, ctx)

file naam se recovery registry key ya handler namon ke bajaay edgeRuntime ka upyog karein. prasangik kor files: edge-ssr.ts, edge-app-route.ts, pages-edge-api.ts, middleware.ts.

Adapters — Output Types

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Output Types. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Output Types — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Prerender classification, Static Files (`STATIC_FILE`), Middleware (`MIDDLEWARE`). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: outputs object me build output types ki arrays hoti hain: outputs.pages (pages/ se React pages), outputs.pagesApi (pages/api/ se API routes), outputs.appPages (app/ se React pages), outputs.appRoutes (app/ se API aur metadata routes), outputs.prerenders (ISR-enabled routes aur static prerenders), outputs.staticFiles (static assets aur auto-statically optimized pages), outputs.middleware (middleware function, agar maujud ho). Note: jab config.output 'export' hota hai, to sirf outputs.staticFiles populate hota hai — baaki saari arrays khali rehti hain (poora app static files ke roop me export hota hai). runtime: 'edge' wale kisi bhi route output ke liye edgeRuntime shamil hota hai (canonical entry metadata); Edge Runtime ab deprecated hai.

  • Pages (PAGES) / API Routes (PAGES_API) / App Pages (APP_PAGE) / App Routes (APP_ROUTE) — sabka shared shape: { type, id (route identifier), filePath (built file), pathname (URL pathname; for APP_PAGE includes .rsc suffix for RSC routes), sourcePage (original source file path), runtime: 'nodejs' | 'edge', assets: Record<string, string> (traced dependencies — key: relative path from repo root, value: absolute path), assetsHashes: Record<string, string> (content hashes of each assets entry), wasmAssets?: Record<string, string> (bundled wasm files), edgeRuntime?: { modulePath, entryKey, handlerExport }, config: { maxDuration?: number (seconds), preferredRegion?: string | string[] (deprecated), env?: Record<string, string> (edge runtime only) } }
  • Prerenders (PRERENDER) — ISR-enabled routes aur static prerenders: { type: 'PRERENDER', id, pathname, parentOutputId (ID of the source page/route), groupId: number (revalidation group — same groupId wale prerenders ek saath revalidate hote hain), route: string (source route matcher, filesystem route ke saath aligned, dynamic segments ke saath — jaise prerendered path /blog/first ke liye /blog/[slug]), routeType?: 'route' | 'fallback' | 'shell' | 'page', response?: 'empty' | 'initial' | 'complete', compute?: 'blocking' | 'resuming' | 'static', htmlSize?: number (prerendered App Router HTML shell ka byte size), pprChain?: { headers: Record<string, string> (jaise 'next-resume': '1') }, parentFallbackMode?: false | null | string (false: koi additional paths nahi = fallback: false; null: blocking render; string: HTML fallback ka path), fallback?: { filePath (HTML/JSON/RSC), initialStatus?, initialHeaders?, initialExpiration? (seconds), initialRevalidate?: number | false, postponedState (resuming ke liye serialized PPR state) }, config: { allowQuery?: string[] (cache key me query params), allowHeader?: string[] (ISR ke liye headers), bypassFor?: RouteHas[] (cache bypass conditions), renderingMode?: 'STATIC' | 'PARTIALLY_STATIC' (PPR-enabled), partialFallback?: boolean (partial fallback shell serve karta hai jo background me full route me upgrade hoti hai), bypassToken?: string (signal ki prerender cache bypass hona chahiye) } }
  • Prerender classification: routeType, response aur compute ek prerender group ki primary response par ek saath emit hote hain; related RSC/data/segment outputs inhe omit kar dete hain; fallback: false wale Pages Router templates bhi inhe omit karte hain (ye unmatched URLs ke liye kabhi serve nahi hote). routeType: route (non-UI route, jaise Route Handler), page (URL me koi missing prerenderable parameter nahi hai), shell (apni class ke URLs ke liye sabse specific reusable page shell), fallback (aur zyada prerenderable parameters bhar kar specialize ki gayi reusable page response). response: empty (koi initial response serve nahi ho sakta), initial (initial response serve ho sakta hai lekin completed UI nahi — sirf partially prerenderable UI routes), complete (response poora hai, 204 Route Handler jaisi zero-byte body samet). compute: blocking (request-time compute shuru hone se pehle koi initial response nahi; uske baad compute chalte hue stream hota rehta hai), resuming (initial response serve hota hai jabki postponed kaam resume hota hai), static (har request par koi server compute nahi). htmlSize sirf primary App Router HTML output par hota hai (0 = khali shell); Pages Router prerenders, Route Handlers aur related RSC/data/segment outputs ise omit karte hain.
  • Static Files (STATIC_FILE): { type: 'STATIC_FILE', id, filePath (absolute filesystem path), pathname (routable URL pathname), immutableHash: string | undefined (content hash jab filename me hash ho — iska matlab file immutable hai) }. immutableHash ke liye "Supporting immutable static assets" wala section dekho.
  • Middleware (MIDDLEWARE): middleware.ts (.js/.ts) ya proxy.ts (.js/.ts), agar maujud ho: { type: 'MIDDLEWARE', id, filePath, pathname: '/_middleware' (hamesha), sourcePage: 'middleware' (hamesha), runtime, assets, assetsHashes, wasmAssets?, edgeRuntime?, config: { maxDuration?, preferredRegion? (deprecated), env?, matchers?: Array<{ source, sourceRegex, has?: RouteHas[], missing?: RouteHas[] }> } }.

Adapters — Routing Information

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Adapters — Routing Information. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Adapters — Routing Information — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Common route fields. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: onBuildComplete mein routing objekt puri routing jankari pradan karta hai jismein sansadhit pattern deployment ke liye taiyar hote hain:

  • routing.beforeMiddleware - madhyveyar execution se pahle lagu route; generated header aur redirect behavior shamil hai.
  • routing.middlewareMatchers - midalaveyar maichar paribhasha is build ke liye utsarjit; yeh tay karne ke liye upyog karein ki kya midalaveyar ko diye gaye request ke liye bulaya jana chahiye.
  • routing.beforeFiles - phir se likhne wale routes ko filesystem route match se pahle check kiya gaya.
  • routing.afterFiles - phir se likhne wale routes ki check file system route match ke baad ki jati hai.
  • routing.dynamicRoutes — dynamic matchers jaise [slug] aur catch-ol routes se generated hota hai.
  • routing.onMatch – routes ek saphal match ke baad lagu kiya gaya, e.g. achal cache header haashed static assets ke liye.
  • routing.fallback — antim phir likhne wale routes ki check tab ki gai jab pahle step match ka production nahi karte the.
  • Common route field (pratyek route entry mein shamil ho sakte hain): source (mool route pattern, generated internal niymon ke liye optional); sourceRegex (santulit requests ke liye panjikrit regeks); destination (internal destination ya redirect destination); headers (siriyon ko lagu karne ke liye); has (pojitiv match ki sthiti); missing (nakaratmak match ki sthiti); status (direct sthiti code); priority (internal route priority flag).
Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
yeh sahi kram hai Next.js khud ek request ko hal karta hai - beforeMiddleware (headers/redirects) → midalaveyar maichars → beforeFiles phir likhte hain → file system → afterFiles phir likhte hain → dynamic route → onMatch → girbaika. ek adapter ko is step ke order ko manch par pun: pesh karna hoga.

Edge Runtime

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Edge Runtime. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Edge Runtime — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Caveats, Supported APIs, Environment variables, Unsupported APIs. Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Next.js mein do server runtime hain: Node.js Runtime (default, full Node.js APIs, rendering ke liye upyog kiya jata hai) aur Edge Runtime E ( set ko simit kiya gaya, jiska upyog Proxy/middleware mein kiya jata hai). Note: Edge Runtime deprecated hai - naye routes Node.js runtime ka upyog karna chahiye.

  • Caveats: Edge Runtime saare Node.js APIs support nahi karta (kuch packages kaam nahi karenge); Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) support NAHI karta; dono runtimes tumhare deployment adapter ke hisaab se streaming support kar sakte hain.
  • Supported APIs:
  • Network: Blob, fetch, FetchEvent, File, FormData, Headers, Request, Response, URLSearchParams, WebSocket.
  • Encoding: atob, btoa, TextDecoder, TextDecoderStream, TextEncoder, TextEncoderStream.
  • Streams: ReadableStream, ReadableStreamBYOBReader, ReadableStreamDefaultReader, TransformStream, WritableStream, WritableStreamDefaultWriter.
  • Crypto: crypto, CryptoKey, SubtleCrypto (hashing, signing, encryption/decryption).
  • Web Standard: AbortController, Array, ArrayBuffer, Atomics, BigInt, BigInt64Array, BigUint64Array, Boolean, clearInterval, clearTimeout, console, DataView, Date, decodeURI, decodeURIComponent, DOMException, encodeURI, encodeURIComponent, Error, EvalError, Float32Array, Float64Array, Function, Infinity, Int8Array, Int16Array, Int32Array, Intl, isFinite, isNaN, JSON, Map, Math, Number, Object, parseFloat, parseInt, Promise, Proxy, queueMicrotask, RangeError, ReferenceError, Reflect, RegExp, Set, setInterval, setTimeout, SharedArrayBuffer, String, structuredClone, Symbol, SyntaxError, TypeError, Uint8Array, Uint8ClampedArray, Uint32Array, URIError, URL, URLPattern, URLSearchParams, WeakMap, WeakSet, WebAssembly.
  • Next.js-specific polyfill: AsyncLocalStorage.
  • Environment variables: process.env next dev aur next build dono ke liye kaam karta hai.
  • Unsupported APIs: native Node.js APIs supported NAHI hain (jaise koi filesystem read/write nahi); node_modules use ho sakte hain agar ve ES Modules implement karein aur native Node.js APIs use na karein; require ko seedhe call karna allowed NAHI — ES Modules use karo. Disabled language features (kaam nahi karenge): eval, new Function(evalString), WebAssembly.compile, WebAssembly.instantiate. Rare cases me code me unreachable dynamic-code-evaluation statements ho sakte hain jinhe tree-shaking hata nahi sakta — Proxy config me unstable_allowDynamic ke saath per-file check relax karo:
javascript
  export const config = {
    unstable_allowDynamic: [
      '/lib/utilities.js', // allows a single file
      '**/node_modules/function-bind/**', // glob for a 3rd-party module
    ],
  }

unstable_allowDynamic apne app root ke relative globs (maaikromaich) ki ek jhalak ya array hai. warning: yadi un bayaanon mein ARE ne Edge par action ki, to ve pheinkte hain aur runtime error ka karan bante hain.

Yaad Rakho — Asli Baat (Interview ke liye)
Edge Runtime = keval web manak APIs, koi Node APIs, koi ISR, nahi require, koi eval - yeh network Edge par halke request avrodhan (Proxy) ke liye hai; sab kuchh bhari Node.js runtime par hai.

Turbopack

Pages RouterAPI Reference

Ye page Pages Router (purana, ab bhi fully supported tareeka) ke API Reference hisse ka hai, aur iska topic hai Turbopack. Neeche saare main points ek-ek karke diye hain — code examples bilkul docs jaise hi hain, taaki tumhe asli docs dobara kholne ki zaroorat na pade.

Asaan bhasha me samjho: Turbopack — ye topic Next.js me roz ke kaam ki cheez hai, aur is section ko padhne ke baad tumhe iske liye docs nahi kholne padenge. Isme khaas taur par ye baatein cover hongi: Why Turbopack, Supported platforms, Getting started, Supported features (zero-config for common cases), Magic comments, `import.meta.env` (Turbopack only). Har baat ko neeche alag point me khol kar samjhaya gaya hai — pehle point se shuru karo aur ek-ek karke aage badho. Dhyaan rahe: ye Pages Router wala tareeka hai — yahan sab components client par chalte hain aur data fetching ke liye getStaticProps / getServerSideProps jaise functions hote hain, App Router wale Server Components nahi.

Poori Detail — Saare Points Ek-Ek Karke

Key concepts: Turbopack ek incremental bundler hai jise JavaScript aur TypeScript ke liye customize kiya gaya hai, jise rust mein likha gaya hai, jise Next.js mein banaya gaya hai. bahut tezi se local development anubhav ke liye page aur App Router donon ke saath kaam karta hai. ab default bundler - koi configuration ki requirement nahi hai.

  • Kyun Turbopack: Unified Graph - multiple compiler ke bajaay sabhi output environments (client/server) ke liye ek single graph ek saath stitched; Bundling banam native ESM E — browser ke mool ESM par bharosa karne ke bajaay dev (customize) mein bundles, jo atydhik requests ke saath bare apps ko dhima karta hai; Incremental Computation - kor bhar mein kaam ko parallel banata hai, cache function star tak neeche nikalta hai, kabhi-kabhi aisa karne wale karya ko dohrata nahi hota hai, parinam ranon ke beech disk jari rahta hai; Lazy Bundling — keval bundle karta hai ki dev server vastav mein request karta hai, initial compiled samay aur memory upyog ko kam karta hai.
  • supported pletform: macOS (Darwin) x64/ARM64, Windows x64/ARM64, Linux (glibc) x64/ARM64, Linux (musl) x64/ARM64. platform ke liye common bandhan (FreeBSD, OpenBSD) WASM binding par wapas aate hain - kor SWC features (compilation, minification) kaam lekin Turbopack NOT karta hai; next dev --webpack / next build --webpack ka upyog karein.
  • Getting shuru kiya: default bundler - next dev / next build / next start sirph kaam karte hain. iske bajaay webpack ka upyog karne ke liye: "dev": "next dev --webpack", "build": "next build --webpack".
  • supported suvidhaein (common mamlon ke liye zero config):
  • bhasha: JS & TS (SWC) hud ke tahat; Turbopack NOT type-check karta hai - tsc --watch chalate hain ya IDE par bharosa karte hain); ESext; CommonJS (require() box se bahar); ESM (static + dynamic import). Babel — se Next.js 16, Turbopack automatic roop se Babel ka upyog karta hai, agar yeh ek config file ka pata lagata hai; SWC hamesha Next.js ke internal transforms/downleveling ke liye prayog kiya jata hai (jab ek Babel config maujud hota hai to SWC ko inactive karta hai); node_modules mein files ko tab tak bahar rakha gaya jab tak ki aap manual roop se babel-loader ko configure nahi karte hain.
  • Framework/React: JSX/TSX (SWC); Fast Refresh (No config); React Server Components (App Router ke liye sahi server/client bundling); automatic root-layout build NOT supported hai - Turbopack aapko ise manual roop se banane ka directive data hai.
  • CSS/styling: global CSS (imported .css seedhe); CSS module (.module.css, Lightning CSS); CSS nesting (prakashit CSS); @import syntax; PostCSS (auto-proses postcss.config.js/.mjs/.cjs/.ts/.mts/.cts) ek Node.js worker pool mein - Tailwind, Autoprefixer); Sass/SCSS ne box se bahar support kiya, lekin custom Sass karyon (sassOptions.functions) NOT supported hain (Rust architecture JS karyon ko executed nahi kar sakta hai - webpack ka upyog karein); kam - plagins ke madhyam se planned, abhi tak default roop se supported nahi hai; upyog mein Lightning CSS (kuchh kam upyog wale CSS module mein standalone :local/:global syoodo-class jaise feature abhi tak supported nahi hain).
  • assets: static assets (images/fonts - import img from './img.png' <Image /> ke liye ek object lauta); JSON import (naam ya default).
  • module resolution: path aliases (tsconfig.json paths/baseUrl ko padhta hai); manual aliases (turbopack.resolveAlias); custom extension (turbopack.resolveExtensions); AMD partial roop se supported (besik parivartan; advanced upyog simit).
  • Performance/Fast riphresh: Fast Refresh ne full taza bina JS/TS/CSS ko update kiya; vriddhishil bundling (keval vahi banati hai jo request karti hai); FileSystem cache (DXX ko compiler kalaakritiyaan pradan karti hain - turbopackFileSystemCache dekhein).
  • Magic comments: dynamic import(), require(), require.resolve(), new Worker() (NOT static import) ke liye webpack-sangat magic ki comments: webpackIgnore: true (donon - bundling chhorein, import ko preserve karein), turbopackIgnore: true (Turbopack-only - bundling chhorein), turbopackOptional: true (Turbopack-only - hal errors ko dabaane), webpackOptional: true (NOT supported).
  • import.meta.env (Turbopack keval): built-in env metadata - DEV (boolean, MODE! == 'production'), PROD (boolean, MODE == 'production'), MODE (string, compile-time NODE_ENV, default 'development'), BASE_URL (string, Next.js basePath). static roop se vishleshan kiya gaya - Turbopack aparivartaniy shakhaon (e.g) ko hata sakta hai. if (import.meta.env.DEV) {... }. pure-object parhne, distrakcharing aur static bracket access supported hai. custom VITE_* char, Vite custom mode, envPrefix, envDir NOT samarthita. browser/client '/' SSR
  • import.meta.glob() (Turbopack keval, Vite-compatible): multiple module ko ek bar glob pattern ke madhyam se import karta hai; parinam calling file ke relative file path dwara key ek objekt hai: const modules = import.meta.glob('./dir/*.js') → { './dir/foo.js': () => import('./dir/foo.js'),... }. import file ke relative pattern (./, ../) ya projekt root (/) se nirpeksha. key pattern ka palan karte hain (related pattern ke liye relative key, full pattern ke liye projekt-root-aspasht key). node_modules kisi bhi any dir ki tarah match kiya jata hai - vyapak pattern jaise '/**/*.js' vok dependency aur sekand le sakte hain; sankirn pattern ya nakaaraatmakataa ka upyog karein; .next kabhi traversed nahi hai. key ko nishchit roop se kramabaddh kiya jata hai (bytewise — '10-ten.js', '2-two.js' se pahle, loarakes se pahle _ se pahle oopri mamle); subdirectories ko siblings ke saath interleaved; multiple pattern ek chhantaaee object mein vilay ho jate hain. lazy (default): pratyek maan ek thunk hai jo ek Promise (flexible load ho raha hai) wapas aa raha hai. Eager: { eager: true } - maan seedhe module objekt hain. naam ka import: { import: 'default' } / { import: 'setup', eager: true }. query strings: { query: '?raw' } ya ek object ({ bar: 'foo', raw: true } → ?bar=foo&raw=true); query module niymon se Gujarati hai - vit ke viprit, Turbopack mein koi built-in ?raw/?url handling nahi hai, isliye ek niyam (e.g) ke saath query se match karta hai. '*.txt': { condition: { query: '?raw' }, type: 'text' }. multiple pattern + negeshan: ['./dir/*.js', './other/*.js'], ['./src/**/*.js', '!**/*.test.js']. bes path: { base: '../../content' } - pattern base ke khilaf hal, iske relative key (v16.4.0: base ke saath, chabiyan base, e.g ke relative hain. './alpha.md', import karne wali file ke liye nahi. TS prakar automatic roop se "moduleResolution": "bundler" (ya node16 / nodenext) ke saath shamil the; wapsi ka prakar eager (Record<string, () => Promise<unknown>> banam Record<string, unknown>) se bhinn hota hai; jenerik param export ka varnan: import.meta.glob<Mod>('./dir/*.ts'). vikalp: eager (default jhooth), import (naam export), query (string | rikord), base (directory), caseSensitive (default sach, ASCII mamla). as vikalp (Vite 5 mein define) NOT supported - query + niyam ka upyog karein; legacy import.meta.globEager() NOT supported - { eager: true } ka upyog karein.
  • webpack ke saath Known gap: Filesystem Root - project root ke bahar ki files hal nahi ki jati hain ( npm link ke madhyam se linkd deps aadi ki requirement experimental.turbopackAdditionalRoots ya turbopack.root). CSS Module Ordering — Turbopack CSS module ke liye JS import order ka anusaran karta hai, anyatha order nahi diya gaya hai (webpack kabhi-kabhi JS-inferred order ko andekha karta hai jab yeh ek file ko side-prabhav-mukt karta hai); @import-ing dwara theek karein ya takrav niymon ko hata dein. Sass node_modules import - Turbopack unhein box se bahar ka support karta hai; webpack ki legacy tild ~ sintaiks NOT supported hai (@import '~bootstrap/...' → @import 'bootstrap/...'); ya turbopack.resolveAlias: { '~*': '*' }). CSS/Sass/SCSS decimal precision - Lightning CSS 5 ank banam webpack ke 10 (e.g) ka upyog karta hai. 25/17 → 1.47059 banam 1.4705882353) - line-height, letter-spacing ke liye sukshm rendering antar, computation maana. Webpack plagins - NOT supported (loader ARE supported); tarbopaik-sangat vikalp dhundhein ya webpack par rahein.
  • Unsupported and unplanned: legacy CSS module visheshataein - standalone :local/:global pseudo-classes (keval :global(...) function form), @value niyam (CSS char dwara superseded), :import / :export ICSS niyam, composes mein .module.css ek .css file (Turbopack) ko global roop mein jorne wala .css behavior karta hai - ise .module.css mein badal data hai), @import module mein .css ko ek ke roop mein import karta hai. sassOptions.functions (custom saas function - rast JS ko executed nahi kar sakta); webpack ka upyog karein. next.config.js mein webpack() config (not manyata prapt - turbopack config ka upyog karein). yarn PnP (yojna nahi). experimental.urlImports (Turbopack ke liye yojna nahi). experimental.esmExternals (yojna nahi). kuchh experimental jhande: experimental.nextScriptWorkers, experimental.fallbackNodePolyfills (aane wala ke liye planned).
  • Configuration: turbopack key ke tahat next.config.js/next.config.ts ke madhyam se : rules (webpack loader), resolveAlias, resolveExtensions, ignoreIssue (Suppress vishisht Turbopack errors/warnings CLI output aur error overlay). experimental ke tahat experimental vikalp (dev default | default roop se built-in): turbopackFileSystemCacheForDev (true | N/A), turbopackFileSystemCacheForBuild (N/A) - set jhutha jab build env build ke beech .next/cache ko preserve nahi karta hai), turbopackGc (false | jhutha - memory/persistent cache se unavailable kaam ko hata dein), turbopackLazyDynamicImports (false | N/A) — jab browser pahle unhein request karta hai to client-side dynamic import target ko compiled karein, turbopackLazyDynamicImportsSSR (false | N/A), turbopackPluginRuntimeStrategy ('childProcesses); childProcesses(False )], turbopackMinify (false ) - Boolean or { server, client, edge }), turbopackSourceMaps (true FO18), turbopackInputSourceMaps (true true), turbopackModuleFragments (false | jhoothe - active development mein); segments mein vibhajit module, chank keval istemal kiye gaye tukron ko import karte hain), turbopackRemoveUnusedImports (false | sach - turbopackRemoveUnusedExports) ki requirement hoti hai, turbopackRemoveUnusedExports (false | true), turbopackMangleExportNames (false ) — export naam chhota; module jinke export naam observable mool rakhte hain), turbopackMangleViaMaterializedNamespaceObject (false | jhutha - default roop se sahi hai jab turbopackMangleExportNames spasht roop se sach hota hai), turbopackInferModuleSideEffects (true true — behatar per hilane ke liye side-prabhav-mukt module), turbopackScopeHoisting (false | sach - hamesha dev mein disabled), turbopackSharedRuntime (N/A ] ek runtime.js mein routes ke par browser runtime sajha karein, production keval build karta hai), turbopackClientSideNestedAsyncChunking (false | True), turbopackServerSideNestedAsyncChunking (false FO jhoothi), turbopackImportTypeBytes (False | nakli - with {type: "bytes"} import ke liye with {type: "bytes"}), turbopackUseBuiltinBabel (true | true), turbopackUseBuiltinSass (true true), turbopackModuleIds ('named's 'deterministic'), turbopackLocalPostcssConfig (false FO jhutha — CSS file ki directory se pahle postcss.config.js ko hal karein, phir projekt root), turbopackWorkerAssetPrefix-define Web Worker URLs ke liye custom asset upasarg, assetPrefix overriding; darpan webpack ka output.workerPublicPath). productionBrowserSourceMaps
  • performance debugging ke liye Generating trace files: next dev --internal-trace .next-profiles/trace-turbopack.bin ka production karta hai - ismein Next.js repo par ek GitHub issue shamil hai.
  • Summary: Turbopack tezi se local dev aur builds, vishesh roop se bare kshudhaa ke liye, zero config CSS, React, aur TypeScript support ke saath ek Rust aadharit, vriddhishil bundler hai.
  • Version parivartan: dev static ke liye v15.0.0 Turbopack; build ke liye v15.3.0 experimental support; v15.5.0 build bita; v16.0.0 build static, Turbopack default bundler ban jata hai, automatic Babel support jab ek config file mil jati hai; v16.4.0 import.meta.glob base vikalp key base ke relative hoti hai.

Sawal · Jawab

  
Interview FAQs — Next.js ke Chune Hue Sawal

  
Ye 32 sawal aaj ke interviews me bar-bar poochhe jate hain. Har jawab chhota aur seedha hai — detail ke liye usi topic wala section padh lo.


Next.js kya hai aur plain React se alag kyun hai?
Next.js React ke upar bana ek framework hai jo routing, server rendering, data fetching, caching, image/font optimization aur deployment — ye sab ready-made deta hai. Plain React me ye sab tumhe khud jodna padta hai; Next.js me file-system routing aur Server Components jaise features built-in milte hain.


App Router aur Pages Router me kya farq hai?
Pages Router purana tareeka hai — pages/ folder, getServerSideProps/getStaticProps, sab kuch default Client Components. App Router naya aur recommended hai — app/ folder, Server Components default, layouts, streaming, Server Actions. Dono ek hi project me saath chal sakte hain.


Server Component aur Client Component me kya farq hai?
Server Component sirf server par render hota hai — uska JS browser ko nahi jaata, wo seedha database/API se data la sakta hai. Client Component browser me bhi chalta hai — useState, useEffect, onClick jaise interactive kaam wahi kar sakta hai. File ke upar 'use client' likhne se boundary banti hai.


'use client' kab likhna padta hai?
Jab component ko hooks (useState, useEffect), event handlers (onClick), ya browser APIs (window, localStorage) chahiye. Ye file ke bilkul upar, imports se pehle likha jata hai, aur us file ke saare imports bhi client bundle me aa jate hain — isliye boundary ko jitna neeche (leaf component par) rakho, utna kam JS browser ko jayega.


Server Actions kya hote hain?
'use server' se marked async functions jo server par chalte hain lekin Client Component se seedha bulaye ja sakte hain. Form submit, data mutate karne ke liye API route banane ki zaroorat nahi padti. Arguments aur return value network par serialize hokar jate hain, isliye dono serializable hone chahiye.


Next.js me caching ki kitni layers hain?
Request Memoization (ek render me duplicate fetch dedupe), Data Cache (fetch results server par store, requests ke beech reuse), Full Route Cache (static routes ka HTML/RSC output), aur Router Cache (client-side navigation cache). Cache Components wale naye model me 'use cache' directive se caching aur saaf taur par control hoti hai.


ISR (Incremental Static Regeneration) kya hai?
Static page ko poori site rebuild kiye bina background me refresh karne ka tareeka. revalidate time set karo — us samay ke baad pehli request par purana page milta hai aur background me naya banta hai, phir sab ko naya milta hai. SSG ki speed aur SSR ki freshness dono milti hain.


SSG, SSR aur CSR me kya farq hai?
SSG — page build time par ban jata hai, sabse tez. SSR — page har request par server par banta hai, hamesha fresh lekin server load zyada. CSR — page browser me React se banta hai, server halka lekin pehla paint dhire aur SEO kamzor. Next.js me ye choice per-route hoti hai, poori site ke liye ek nahi.


Ek page ko dynamic kaise banate hain?
Request-time cheezein use karo — cookies(), headers(), ya searchParams padhna page ko dynamic bana deta hai. fetch par cache: 'no-store' lagana bhi data ko har request par fresh laata hai. Dhyaan do: bina soche dynamic karne se Full Route Cache ka fayda khatm ho jata hai.


Route Handler kya hai? API route se alag hai kya?
App Router me route.ts file se banta hai — GET, POST jaise HTTP methods export karo, wahi endpoint ban jata hai. Ye Pages Router ke pages/api/ wale API routes ka App Router version hai. Ek hi segment me page.tsx aur route.ts dono nahi reh sakte.


Middleware — ab Proxy — kya karta hai?
Request poora hone se pehle, edge par chalne wala code: auth check, redirect, rewrite, headers badalna. Next.js 16 me middleware convention ka naam proxy ho gaya hai. Ye halka hona chahiye — bhaari database kaam yahan nahi, kyunki ye har matched request par chalta hai.


next/image kyun use karein, seedha img tag kyun nahi?
next/image har device ke hisaab se sahi size ki image deta hai, WebP/AVIF jaise modern formats me badalta hai, lazy load karta hai aur width/height se layout shift (CLS) rokta hai. Remote images ke liye images.remotePatterns me host allow karna padta hai.


Metadata kaise set karte hain — title, OG image?
App Router me page/layout se metadata object ya generateMetadata function export karo. OG images ke liye opengraph-image.tsx file convention hai jo next/og se image generate karti hai. Pages Router me ye kaam next/head se hota tha.


generateStaticParams kya hai?
Dynamic route ke liye build time par kaun-kaun se params ke pages pehle se banane hain, ye batane wala function. Jaise blog ke saare slugs ki list — unke pages static ban jayenge, baaki on-demand. Pages Router ke getStaticPaths ka App Router version hai.


Streaming aur Suspense ka kya fayda hai?
Page ke dhire hisse <Suspense> me rakho — baki page turant dikhega, dheera hissa load hote hi jagah par aa jayega. loading.tsx file pure segment ke liye yehi kaam karti hai. Isse Time to First Byte aur perceived speed dono sudharte hain.


Parallel Routes aur Intercepting Routes kya hain?
Parallel Routes (@slot folders) ek hi layout me kai hisse alag-alag load karne dete hain — jaise dashboard ke widgets. Intercepting Routes ((.), (..) conventions) ek route ko dusre ke upar modal ki tarah dikhate hain, jaise photo par click karne se modal khulta hai lekin URL photo wala hi rehta hai.


Next.js me data fetching ka sahi tareeka kya hai?
Server Components me seedha await fetch() ya database query — koi useEffect nahi. Jahan data chahiye wahi fetch karo (colocation); upar se props ghumane ki zaroorat nahi. Client side par SWR ya TanStack Query use hota hai. Mutations ke liye Server Actions.


revalidatePath aur revalidateTag me kya farq hai?
Dono cache todtay hain (revalidate karte hain). revalidatePath ek specific route ka cache saaf karta hai; revalidateTag un saare fetches ka jinko woh tag laga tha. Tag wala tareeka bare apps me zyada saaf rehta hai kyunki ek data source ke saare uses ek saath refresh ho jate hain. Cache Components me updateTag/refresh jaise naye tarike bhi aaye hain.


'use cache' directive kya hai?
Cache Components model ki directive — kisi component ya function ke upar lagao to uska output inputs ke hisaab se cache ho jata hai. cacheLife se kitni der cache rahe ye control hota hai, cacheTag se tag lagta hai. Ise on karne ke liye next.config me cacheComponents: true chahiye.


Next.js me authentication kaise handle karte hain?
Session cookie + server par har jagah check. Proxy (middleware) me sirf halka optimistic check (cookie hai ya nahi), lekin asli suraksha Data Access Layer me — har data function ke andar session verify karo, kyunki proxy bypass ho sakta hai. DTO pattern se sirf surakshit fields client ko bhejo.


Turbopack kya hai, Webpack se kyun behtar?
Rust me likha Next.js ka naya bundler, jo ab dev aur build dono me default hai. Bade projects me Webpack se kahin tez HMR aur build deta hai. Webpack chahiye to --webpack flag se ab bhi milta hai. Custom Webpack config wale projects ko migrate karte samay Turbopack ke farq dhyaan se dekhne padte hain.


next.config me sabse kaam ke options kaun se hain?
images.remotePatterns (remote images), redirects/rewrites/headers (async functions), output: 'standalone' (Docker), basePath (sub-path deploy), cacheComponents (naya caching model) aur experimental ke neeche ke naye features. Config file project root me package.json ke paas rehti hai.


Environment variables ka kya niyam hai?
Sirf NEXT_PUBLIC_ se shuru hone wale variables browser ko milte hain — baaki server-only rehte hain. Isliye secret keys par kabhi NEXT_PUBLIC_ mat lagao. .env.local ko git me commit nahi karte. Variables build/run ke samay padhe jate hain, isliye badalne par restart chahiye.


App Router me error handling kaise hoti hai?
error.tsx file us segment ke liye error boundary banti hai (ye Client Component hoti hai), global-error.tsx root layout ki galtiyon ke liye, aur not-found.tsx 404 ke liye. notFound() function kahin se bhi 404 flow chala sakta hai. Layout ke andar ki galti usi segment ke error.tsx se pakdi jati hai, layout khud ki galti parent ki boundary se.


Pages Router ke getServerSideProps / getStaticProps ka App Router me kya hua?
App Router me ye functions nahi hain — component khud async hokar seedha data fetch karta hai. getStaticProps ≈ default cached fetch, getServerSideProps ≈ no-store fetch ya request API ka use, getStaticPaths ≈ generateStaticParams.


Next.js app ko deploy karne ke tarike kya hain?
Node.js server (next build + next start) aur Docker (standalone output) — dono me saare features milte hain. Static export (output: 'export') me server features (SSR, ISR, API routes, server image optimization) nahi milte. Deployment Adapters se dusre platforms build/deploy ko apne hisaab se badal sakte hain; Vercel aur Bun verified adapters hain.


Link component prefetching kaise kaam karta hai?
<Link> viewport me aate hi us route ka data prefetch karne lagta hai — static routes poori tarah, dynamic routes loading.tsx tak (partial prefetching). Isi liye navigation turant lagta hai. prefetch={false} se band kar sakte ho, aur hover par bhi prefetch hota hai.


Font optimization kyun zaroori hai aur next/font kya karta hai?
next/font fonts ko self-host karta hai — Google ko koi request nahi jaati, privacy aur speed dono behtar. Font pehle se load hokar layout shift bhi rokta hai. Google Fonts ek line import se, local fonts next/font/local se. App Router me root layout me, Pages Router me _app me lagta hai.


Draft Mode kya hai?
Headless CMS ke unpublished (draft) content ko production site par preview karne ka tareeka. Ek Route Handler draft mode on karta hai (cookie set hoti hai), phir static pages bhi draft data dikhate hain. Preview khatm karne par mode off. Cache Components ke saath iska tareeka thoda badla hai — docs ka alag guide hai.


Ek hi project me dono routers ho to route conflict ka kya hota hai?
Dono routers ek saath chal sakte hain, lekin agar app/ aur pages/ me ek hi URL ke liye page ho to App Router wala jeet-ta hai. Migration ke samay yahi niyam kaam aata hai — page ko App Router me le jao, purana Pages wala apne aap peeche ho jayega.


Next.js 16 me kya-kya bada badlav aaya?
Turbopack dev ke saath-saath build me bhi default, Cache Components ('use cache') stable, middleware ka naam proxy, next build ab lint nahi chalata, Node.js 20.9+ minimum, aur React 19.2 ke features. Version 16 wale section me poori list aur codemods diye hain.


SEO ke liye Next.js kyun accha hai?
Server rendering se search engine ko poora HTML milta hai, metadata API se har page ke title/description/OG tags saaf taur par set hote hain, sitemap.ts aur robots.ts file conventions se generate hote hain, aur static rendering se pages tez khulte hain — ye sab milkar SEO mazboot banata hai.

Imandaari se — Kya Scope se Bahar Hai

  
    
    
  • /docs/messages/* error-code pages (lagbhag 100 chhote pages) — ye sirf error number dekhne ke liye hote hain, sikhne ka content nahi, isliye shamil nahi kiye.
    • 
    
  • Versioned archives /docs/15/* aur /docs/16/* — purane versions ke docs; ye SPA current version 16.4.6 par hai.
    • 
    
  • /learn/* tutorial courses — ye alag interactive course hai, docs nahi.
    • 
    
  • /blog/* posts — blog articles docs ka hissa nahi hain.
    • 
    
  • Architecture aur Community pages dono routers me ek hi hain (wahi URLs), isliye SPA me ek hi bar aaye hain — Pages Router ki list me dobara ginne par 471 se zyada dikhega, lekin alag-alag pages 471 hi hain.
    •
